Abstract: We introduce avatar referring segmentation, which selects regions of animatable Gaussian avatars from language queries. A query can also specify a pose or motion to select matching intervals. This lets users interact with avatars for local editing and motion inspection. However, making these selections with existing language Gaussian splatting methods poses two challenges: adjacent parts and garments are hard to separate and may be referred to indirectly (region ambiguity), while fine-grained motions can look alike in RGB (motion ambiguity). We address these challenges with HumanSkill-4D, a training-free framework that shares a multimodal large language model (MLLM) and geometric operators across avatars. For each avatar, a semantic memory links body-part and garment categories to persistent Gaussian regions and appearance descriptions. The MLLM uses category names and descriptions to select categories by appearance, relation, or function. To find matching intervals, it composes operators into programs that check query conditions on driving joint trajectories stored in a motion memory. These category choices and operator outputs make selections traceable, while composing or adding operators supports new motion conditions. To evaluate this task, we introduce three human-annotated benchmarks and show that HumanSkill-4D outperforms the baselines in part segmentation and 3D and 4D referring segmentation, with compact memories and only minutes of setup per avatar.

</details>


### [77] [O-SCD++: Replay-Free Online Scene Change Detection via Recursive Evidence Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24462)
*Chamuditha Jayanga Galappaththige,Jason Lai,Lloyd Windrim,Timothy Patten,Donald G. Dansereau,Niko Suenderhauf,Dimity Miller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种无需重放（replay-free）的在线场景变化检测方法：利用参考3DGS地图固定、渲染为线性算子，通过渲染器单次反向传播将观测直接映射到高斯基元，将多视图融合化为每个高斯的精确双标量递推，并给出无标签阈值与选择性预测信号。PASLCD上mIoU 0.489→0.575，吞吐11.8→25.6 FPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线变化检测需在原位、无约束视角、无法获取未来观测的因果条件下进行，精度长期落后于离线方法。O-SCD通过将变化视为3DGS地图的持久属性弥合了差距，但其每帧需对全部历史cue map重新拟合变化场，占用了超过一半的每帧预算，导致精度与速度不可兼得。本文希望消除这一权衡。

Method: 基于参考地图固定不变这一事实，指出变化场的渲染是关于高斯基元的线性操作；因此每帧新观测可经渲染器一次反向传播直接累加到高斯上，把多视图融合转化为每个高斯上的精确双标量递推，无需保存或重访历史观测。同时证明O-SCD所用自监督目标亦可通过排序精确确定决策阈值，得到免标签的逐帧截断值，其margin可作为选择性预测信号。

Result: 在PASLCD数据集上，mIoU由0.489提升至0.575，吞吐由11.8 FPS提升至25.6 FPS；在严格因果设定下甚至超过O-SCD的离线结果。

Conclusion: 该replay-free表述以线性渲染与递推融合取代逐帧重拟合，同时提升精度与速度，突破了在线变化检测中精度—效率的固有权衡，并额外提供了免标签阈值与选择性预测能力。

Abstract: Online scene change detection requires an agent to detect what has changed in a previously mapped environment while it is still on site, observing from unconstrained viewpoints and without access to future observations. This causal setting is strictly harder than its offline counterpart, and online methods have consistently trailed offline accuracy. O-SCD closed that gap by treating change as a persistent property of a 3D Gaussian splatting map of the reference scene, surpassing the strongest offline methods in change detection accuracy while operating at over 10 frames per second. O-SCD optimizes a change field over the Gaussians of the reference map, refitting it to all past cue maps at every frame, a step that consumes more than half of the per-frame budget and forces accuracy to be traded against speed. We present a replay-free formulation that eliminates this trade-off. Because the reference map stays fixed, rendering the change field is a linear operation. Each new observation can therefore be carried onto the map's Gaussians directly, by a single backward pass of the renderer, which reduces multi-view fusion to an exact two-scalar recursion per Gaussian. Past observations are never stored or revisited. The self-supervised objective that O-SCD minimizes by descent also determines the decision threshold exactly, by sorting, yielding a label-free per-frame cutoff whose margin provides a selective-prediction signal. On PASLCD, our method improves mean intersection over union from 0.489 to 0.575 and throughput from 11.8 to 25.6 frames per second, even exceeding O-SCD's offline result while remaining strictly causal.

</details>


### [78] [Unifying Amplitude-Phase Coupling and Reliable Endogenous Priors for Low-Light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24467)
*Tongshun Zhang,Zixuan Zhong,Pingping Liu,Jin Kuang,Yubing Lu,Dong Liu,Qiuzhan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出频率-空间联合框架，通过幅值-相位自适应补偿融合模块建模谱耦合，并用内源可靠先验与双模态引导细化网络恢复纹理，实现SOTA低光照增强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有频域LLIE方法假设幅值与相位可独立恢复，忽视二者的谱耦合，导致信息不一致与结构畸变；同时从原始低光输入直接提取先验不可靠（噪声与欠曝光破坏关键视觉内容）。

Method: 先实证分析幅值-相位耦合关系，提出APACF模块实现二者双向交互而非硬分离，获得谱一致的恢复；再引入ERP，将频域初步恢复、已接近真实光照的中间结果作为高保真先验源，提取伪红外与梯度互补线索；基于ERP设计DGRN，将净化后的结构线索注入解码器。

Result: 在基准数据集上取得SOTA性能，定量指标与视觉质量均持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 幅值-相位耦合建模与可靠先验引导可有效缓解频域方法的信息不一致与结构畸变，提升低光照图像增强的纹理恢复能力。

Abstract: Frequency-domain methods have shown strong potential for low-light image enhancement (LLIE) because they can effectively regulate global illumination. However, most existing methods assume that amplitude and phase can be restored independently, while overlooking their inherent spectral coupling. This artificial decoupling often leads to information inconsistency and structural distortions. To address this issue, we propose a frequency-spatial framework that jointly models spectral interaction and reliable prior guidance. We first empirically analyze the coupling between amplitude and phase and develop an Amplitude-Phase Adaptive Compensation Fusion (APACF) module. Instead of enforcing a hard separation between the two components, APACF enables their bidirectional interaction, resulting in spectrally coherent restoration. In addition, directly extracting priors from raw low-light inputs is unreliable, since severe noise and underexposure destroy critical visual content. To alleviate this problem, we introduce an Endogenous Reliability Prior (ERP). Specifically, we treat an intermediate result, preliminarily restored in the frequency domain and already close to the ground-truth illumination, as a high-fidelity source for extracting complementary pseudo-infrared and gradient cues. Based on ERP, we further design a Dual-Modal Guided Refinement Network (DGRN) to inject these purified structural cues into the decoder, thereby recovering missing fine textures more accurately. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently surpasses existing methods in both quantitative metrics and visual quality. Our code is available at https://github.com/bywlzts/Amplitude-Phase-Coupling-Net.

</details>


### [79] [RiSE: Residual Subspace Expert for Generalizable Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24480)
*Kahim Wong,Kemou Li,Yiming Chen,Haiwei Wu,Jiantao Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RiSE是一种残差子空间专家模型，通过冻结SVD主成分、仅适配残差子空间并结合伪造感知残差专家与潜变量扰动置信度（LPC）选择专家，实现文本图像伪造定位，在真实伪造图像上以1个专家超越先前方法20.4%，扩展至9个专家提升35.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本中心图像伪造定位（TFL）检测器多依赖全参数微调（FPFT），易引发低秩特征塌陷并过拟合训练伪影，难以泛化到未见伪造类型；同时先前方法用单一统一表示捕捉多样伪造痕迹，使细微痕迹纠缠、难以学习。

Method: 提出RiSE：冻结预训练SVD主成分、仅适配残差子空间，并用纯ViT分割器保留预训练先验以避免特征塌陷；引入伪造感知残差专家，每个专家在某特定伪造类型的训练子集上独立训练；推理时使用潜变量扰动置信度（LPC），通过解析计算潜变量扰动后的输出，在单次前向传播中高效估计置信度并选择最自信专家，避免对扰动样本重复前向。

Result: 在合成伪造数据上训练，RiSE单专家在真实伪造图像上较先前方法提升20.4%，训练步数减少10倍；专家数扩展至9个带来35.8%增益；即使大部分参数冻结且仅用RGB预训练，RiSE在DCT特征下仍有效。

Conclusion: 残差子空间适配结合多专家机制与LPC选择，可有效缓解FPFT的特征塌陷与过拟合，并随专家数增加持续提升跨域定位性能，为文本图像伪造检测提供高效可扩展方案。

Abstract: As AI-assisted image editing becomes increasingly prevalent, Text-Centric Image Forgery Localization (TFL) is essential for protecting trust in financial and legal records. However, we observe that existing TFL detectors predominantly rely on Full-Parameter Fine-Tuning (FPFT) and fail to generalize to unseen forgery types because FPFT can induce low-rank feature collapse and overfit training artifacts. Meanwhile, prior detectors capture diverse forgery traces with a single unified representation, making subtle traces entangled and difficult to learn. To address these challenges, we propose RiSE, a Residual Subspace Expert model that preserves pre-trained priors by freezing principal SVD components and adapting only the residual subspaces with a ViT-only segmentor to avoid feature collapse. RiSE introduces forgery-aware residual experts, where each expert is trained independently on a training subset with a particular forgery type, and we show that cross-domain localization performance improves consistently as more experts are added. At inference, we introduce Latent Perturbation Confidence (LPC), which selects the most confident expert by analytically computing the latent-perturbed output. LPC enables efficient confidence estimation with a single forward pass, avoiding repeated forward passes on perturbed samples and improving expert selection. By training on synthetic forgery data, RiSE with 1 expert outperforms prior methods on real-world forgery images by 20.4% while reducing training steps by 10 times. Scaling the number of experts to 9 yields a 35.8% gain. RiSE remains effective with DCT feature, even when the majority of the parameters is frozen with RGB-only pretraining. Code: https://github.com/KahimWong/RiSE.

</details>


### [80] [Investigating Length Bias and Robustness in LVLMs for Multiple-Choice Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24500)
*Md. Atabuzzaman,Hani Alomari,Chris Thomas*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究LVLMs在多项选择问答中的“长度偏置”：模型系统性偏好更长的选项，且该偏差源自后层对视觉证据的抑制；推理时缓解手段均不充分，需架构与训练层面的解决方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLMs在MCQA上表现强劲，但其在偏置条件下的可靠性研究不足，尤其是对长度偏置这一系统性偏好缺乏细粒度视觉域下的受控实验与机制解释。

Method: 构建跨细粒度视觉域的受控基准考察长度偏置；进行逐层机制分析定位偏置来源；通过模糊图像实验考察视觉证据强度的影响；开展弃答（abstention）测试；提出并评估多种推理时缓解策略。

Result: 模型持续偏好长选项，即使与视觉不一致；正确答案较短时准确率下降2–38%，较长时上升1–70%，且该偏置跨模型规模持续存在。机制上，长度偏置源于后层抑制视觉证据、转而依赖语言侧长度先验；视觉证据减弱（模糊图像）时偏置加剧；模型难以拒答错误预测。推理时缓解策略仅带来部分改善，均无法在不依赖推理时不可得的oracle信息下实现可部署的偏置缓解。

Conclusion: 推理时干预不足以解决长度偏置，需转向架构级解决方案与偏置感知训练，以实现LVLMs在MCQA中的可靠评估。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate strong performance on multiple-choice question answering (MCQA), yet their reliability under biased conditions remains underexplored. We investigate length bias, the systematic preference for longer answer options, through controlled benchmarks spanning fine-grained visual domains. LVLMs consistently favor longer options even when visually inconsistent, with accuracy dropping 2--38\% when correct answers are shorter and increasing 1--70\% when longer. This bias persists across model scales. Through layer-wise mechanistic analysis, we reveal that length bias emerges from late-layer suppression of visual evidence in favor of language-side length priors. Blurry-image experiments show that bias intensifies when visual evidence weakens, while abstention tests reveal that LVLMs struggle to refuse incorrect predictions. We propose and evaluate multiple inference-time mitigation strategies; while these provide partial improvements, none achieves deployable bias mitigation without relying on oracle information unavailable at inference time. These results underscore that inference-time interventions are insufficient, pointing to the need for architectural solutions and bias-aware training.

</details>


### [81] [SAP-Depth: Scene-Adaptive Probability Framework for Self-Supervised Monocular Depth Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24506)
*Bowen He,Li Zhang,Yujie Chen,Chang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SAP-Depth，用可学习参数预测器驱动的动态分箱与逐箱概率分布解码器实现场景自适应概率建模的自监督单目深度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督单目深度估计存在细粒度细节丢失、对不同场景结构适应性有限的问题，需要场景自适应的深度分布建模。

Method: 基于Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic框架：Dynamic Bins机制由Learnable Parameter Predictor依据输入图像上下文自适应估计场景特定深度分布；Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder融合多尺度表示，预测稠密深度概率分布；两模块协同耦合实现场景特定深度分布的动态预测。

Result: KITTI上精度优于现有SOTA，复杂边缘细节保持更好；Make3D上验证了良好的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 动态分箱与逐箱概率解码的耦合能提升边界锐利度与结构恢复，泛化性良好。

Abstract: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation remains challenging due to the loss of fine-grained details and limited adaptability to varying scene structures. In this paper, we propose SAP-Depth, a novel architecture based on Scene-Adaptive Probabilistic. Unlike traditional methods, we introduce a Dynamic Bins mechanism powered by a Learnable Parameter Predictor, which adaptively estimates scene-specific depth distributions conditioned on the input image context. Furthermore, a Bin-wise Probability Distribution Decoder is designed to effectively fuse multi-scale representations to predict dense depth probability distributions, significantly enhancing boundary sharpness and structural recovery. Through the collaborative coupling of these proposed modules, our model achieves dynamic prediction of scene-specific depth distributions. Extensive experiments on the KITTI dataset show that SAP-Depth outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, particularly in its ability to better preserve complex edge details. Further, tests on the Make3D dataset validate the model's excellent generalization capability and robustness.

</details>


### [82] [MOMO: Human Motion from Moving Sounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24522)
*Deli Cai,Shuyang Xu,Zhiyang Dou,Zitong Lan,Mingmin Zhao,Changxing Ding,Taku Komura*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出"动态空间音频驱动的人体动作生成"新任务，构建DySAM与DySAL两个数据集，并提出基于扩散模型的MOMO框架（融合定位、理解、生成三原则），在动作保真度、音-动对齐与物理合理性上优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人对声音的反应不仅取决于语义内容，还取决于声源与听者之间随时间演变的空间关系。然而现有音频驱动动作生成方法主要针对非空间或静态声学条件，对动态空间音频这一重要问题鲜有探索，因此需要填补该空白。

Method: 提出新任务与两个动作捕捉数据集：DySAM（含同步双耳音频、3D人体动作与移动声源轨迹，为首个该任务的基准数据集）和辅助的DySAL（双耳定位数据集，配对多样声学事件、头部姿态与移动声源轨迹）。并提出MOMO扩散框架，遵循定位、理解、生成三原则：直接从原始双耳音频估计以头部为中心的空间方向线索（不依赖真值坐标）、提取逐帧音频内容表征、以语义特征与动态空间线索共同条件化动作扩散。

Result: 实验表明MOMO在动作保真度、音频-动作对齐以及物理合理性方面均优于现有基线方法。

Conclusion: 该工作开辟了动态空间音频驱动人体动作生成的研究方向，通过数据集与基准、以及融合空间定位与语义理解的扩散生成框架，为角色动画、人类行为分析与机器人等领域提供了基础支撑。

Abstract: Human responses to sound depend not only on its semantic content, but also on the evolving spatial relationship between source and listener, conveyed through spatial audio and its temporal dynamics. Modeling human reactions to such dynamic spatial audio is important for character animation, human behavior analysis, and robotics. As of yet, existing audio-driven motion generation methods primarily focus on non-spatial or static acoustic conditions, leaving this important problem largely underexplored. To bridge this gap, we formulate the novel task of dynamic spatial-audio-driven human motion generation and introduce two motion-captured datasets. We introduce the Dynamic Spatial Audio and Motion dataset (DySAM) as the first dataset and benchmark for this task, providing synchronized binaural audio, 3D human motions, and moving sound source trajectories. Given the importance of dynamic spatial cues of sound sources, we further provide the Dynamic Spatial Audio Localization dataset (DySAL), an auxiliary binaural localization dataset that pairs diverse acoustic events with head poses and moving source trajectories to support spatial audio perception. For benchmarking, we propose MOMO for human Motion generation from Moving Sounds, a diffusion-based framework guided by three coupled principles: localization, understanding, and generation. MOMO performs localization by estimating head-centric spatial direction cues of the moving source directly from raw binaural audio, avoiding reliance on ground-truth source coordinates. It performs understanding by extracting frame-wise audio-content representations, and performs generation by conditioning motion diffusion on both semantic features and dynamic spatial cues. Experiments show that MOMO outperforms existing baselines in motion fidelity, audio-motion alignment, and physical plausibility.

</details>


### [83] [VisConf: Quality-Aware Consensus for Best-of-N in Vision-Language Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24526)
*Muhammad Usman,Muhammad Qasim Ayub,Usman Ahad,Muhammad Tahir*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VisConf，将视觉参与度与候选校准的Self-Certainty相乘构成rollout质量分数，并配合Rank-Weighted Consensus（RWC）加权聚合，在三个VLM与三个多模态基准上稳定超越强BoN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Best-of-N在纯文本LLM上有效，但对VLM而言，仅依赖答案频率或模型置信度不足，因为采样轨迹在与视觉输入的交互程度上存在差异；作者发现分布置信度与视觉注意力是互补的rollout质量指标，单一指标均有局限，二者同时强则更可能正确。

Method: 提出VisConf：以乘法方式将视觉参与度与候选校准的Self-Certainty结合，对任一信号弱的轨迹施加惩罚；并引入Rank-Weighted Consensus（RWC），一种免调参的聚合规则，将同一问题内VisConf的排序转化为答案级投票权重。

Result: 在MathVista、MMMU-Pro、MMStar上，对三个VLM，VisConf+RWC一致优于强BoN基线；分析显示当正确答案存在但在候选池中占比偏低时增益尤为显著。

Conclusion: 视觉参与度与分布置信度的乘性组合可作为有效的VLM rollout质量信号，配合基于排序的加权投票能更充分地利用被低估的正确轨迹，是一种无需训练的BoN改进方案。

Abstract: Best-of-N methods improve text-only LLM reasoning by sampling multiple trajectories before selecting an answer. For Vision-Language Models (VLMs), answer frequency and model confidence alone can be insufficient, as sampled generations also vary in their engagement with the visual input. We find that distributional confidence and visual attention are complementary indicators of rollout quality. Each is limited on its own, while trajectories that show strong signals in both are more likely to be correct. Motivated by this, we introduce VisConf, a rollout-quality score that multiplicatively combines visual engagement with candidate-calibrated Self-Certainty, penalizing rollouts that are weak in either signal. We incorporate Rank-Weighted Consensus (RWC), a tuning-free aggregation rule that converts within-question VisConf ranks into answer-level vote weights. Across three VLMs on MathVista, MMMU-Pro, and MMStar, VisConf with RWC consistently outperforms strong BoN baselines. Our analysis shows particularly large gains when correct trajectories are present but underrepresented in the candidate pool.

</details>


### [84] [An Optical Music Recognition Tool for String Quartets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24530)
*Jin-Shiang Hu,Bo-Yuan Cheng,Li Su*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出面向弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱的光学音乐识别（OMR）系统，融合SegNet区域分割、CNN符号分类与动态规划节奏约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OMR方法对PDF乐谱中复杂节奏（如连音符）与多声部弦乐四重奏的识别精度不足，需要兼顾符号提取准确性与节奏结构一致性。

Method: 先以基于SegNet的分割模型定位乐谱区域，再用卷积神经网络与图像处理技术对音乐符号进行分类与提取；在节奏层面引入动态规划方法施加拍号约束并显式处理连音符（tuplets）。

Result: 在基准数据集上采用最长公共子序列（LCS）度量，针对多组特征矩阵评估，在音高、起始时刻、时值与变音记号识别上均取得稳健精度。

Conclusion: 该流程化的“分割—识别—节奏约束”框架可有效提升弦乐四重奏PDF乐谱的OMR表现，代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: This paper presents an optical music recognition (OMR) system tailored for PDF scores of string quartet pieces. The approach begins with a SegNet-based segmentation model to localize musical regions, followed by convolutional neural networks and image processing techniques to classify and extract musical symbols. To improve rhythmic precision, dynamic programming methods enforce time signature constraints and explicitly handle tuplets. Evaluation using a longest common subsequence metric across multiple feature matrices demonstrates robust accuracy in recognizing pitch, onset, duration, and accidentals on a benchmark dataset. Code and data are available at https://github.com/lattellie/25-omr.

</details>


### [85] [Contrastive Hypergraph Source-free Domain Adaptive Object Detection in Adverse Weather Conditions--Extended Version](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24532)
*Jicheng Yuan,Tung Kieu,Manh Nguyen-Duc,Manfred Hauswirth,Danh Le-Phuoc*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出REUNION，一个超图引导的无源域自适应框架，用于恶劣天气下的目标检测，通过构建对比超图并以Hyper-InfoNCE在高阶语义层面优化表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 雾、雨、雪、低照度等恶劣天气会引入结构化的能见度退化，严重损害在晴天数据上训练的目标检测器；受隐私与传输约束，源数据不可访问，因此需采用无源域自适应（SFDA）。现有基于成对对比学习的SFDA方法难以捕捉高阶语义，且在严重退化下易出现一致性坍塌（agreement collapse）。

Method: 在目标域候选框上构建对比超图，通过图像内上下文、天气感知分组、基于原型的语义锚点、以及可靠实例与低置信实例间的不确定性感知连接来编码高阶关系；并引入组级Hyper-InfoNCE目标，在超边层面优化表示，使语义信息从高置信候选传播到受损或低对比度实例。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，REUNION能有效缓解域偏移，并在SFDA设定下取得最先进性能。

Conclusion: 以超图建模高阶关系并结合超边级对比目标是应对恶劣天气下SFDA目标检测的有效途径，可克服成对对比的局限与一致性坍塌问题。

Abstract: Adverse weather conditions such as fog, rain, snow, and low illumination introduce structured visibility degradations that severely impair object detectors trained on clear-weather data. When source data are inaccessible due to privacy or trans- mission constraints, source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) becomes necessary. However, existing SFDA methods based on pairwise contrastive learning struggle to capture high-order semantics and often suffer from agreement collapse under severe corruption. We propose REUNION, a hypergraph-guided SFDA framework for object detection in adverse weather conditions. REUNION constructs a contrastive hypergraph over target-domain object proposals, encoding high-order relations through intra-image context, weather-aware grouping, prototype-based semantic anchors, and uncertainty-aware connections between reliable and low-confidence instances. To effectively exploit these structured relations, we introduce a group-wise Hyper-InfoNCE objective that optimizes representations at the hyperedge level, enabling semantic information to propagate from confident proposals to corrupted or low-contrast instances. Experiments with diverse benchmarks demonstrate that REUNION effectively mitigates domain shifts and achieves state-of-the-art performance in SFDA settings.

</details>


### [86] [Write Once, Query Many: Evolving Compact Reusable Memory for Long Videos](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24537)
*Kerui Chen,Jinglu Wang,Yun Wang,Xinjiang Wang,Yan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出可演化的长视频记忆系统 Video-EMem，以时间锚定的感知观测（自由文本+稀疏图像）一次编码视频，并对冻结模型演化 Writer/Reader 工作流，实现远超原始视频存储压缩下更优的长视频问答精度与更低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频超出多模态大模型上下文容量；agentic search 对每个查询重复进行昂贵的视频处理与定位。可复用记忆能摊销成本，但必须在构建时对未知问题保持信息保真度。

Method: 基于时间锚定感知观测的可演化视频记忆框架：表示由紧凑自由文本与稀疏图像组合，跨时间尺度保留语义与互补视觉细节，无需固定语义模式即可支持时间导航。Writer 通过合并重叠的多尺度观测只编码视频一次；Reader 仅从记忆检索并组织证据。底层模型冻结，分别用查询无关的源保真与覆盖度反馈演化 Writer、用证据定位与利用的 QA 失败反馈演化 Reader。

Result: 实验中验证了该分离式反馈对超出开发查询的泛化有效；演化策略比未演化框架平均提升 7.2% 准确率；相对原始视频平均降低约 99.86% 存储，并较直接输入 2048 帧使 Qwen3-VL-30B 在三个长视频 QA 基准上平均提升 2.6%；在与最先进 agentic 方法使用相同 o3 回答模型时，平均准确率提升 2.5% 且单查询延迟更低。

Conclusion: 可复用、时间锚定的记忆结合 Writer/Reader 分离演化，可在冻结模型条件下同时实现高压缩存储、更强长视频问答性能与更低延迟。

Abstract: Long videos often exceed the context capacity of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), while agentic search repeats costly video processing and grounding for each query. Reusable memory can amortize this cost, but must preserve information for questions unknown during construction. We propose Video-EMem, an evolvable video memory harness built on time-anchored perceptual observations. This representation combines compact free-form text with sparse images to preserve semantic content and complementary visual details across temporal scales, supporting temporal navigation without a fixed semantic schema. A Writer encodes each video once by consolidating overlapping multiscale observations, and a Reader retrieves and organizes evidence solely from the resulting memory. With the underlying models frozen, we evolve their workflows and operators using distinct feedback: query-independent source fidelity and coverage for the Writer, and QA failures in evidence localization and utilization for the Reader. Experiments support this separation for generalization beyond development queries, with our evolution strategy improving average accuracy by 7.2% over the unevolved harness. While reducing storage by about 99.86% on average relative to raw videos, Video-EMem improves Qwen3-VL-30B by an average of 2.6% across three long-video QA benchmarks over direct input of 2,048 frames. Using the same o3 answer model as the state-of-the-art agentic method, it improves average accuracy by 2.5% with lower per-query latency.

</details>


### [87] [Cross-polarization pairing for label-free few-shot thin-section classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24546)
*Bingchen Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出跨偏振配对（XPP）无标签预训练方法，利用同一视场的PPL/XPL图像构造正样本对，实现无需鉴定切片的岩石薄片少样本识别，性能匹敌监督模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岩石薄片少样本分类依赖地质学家逐片鉴定，成本高昂；而新采集的薄片集合缺乏这种鉴定标签。希望仅利用显微镜本身天然记录的信息（图像所属切片、成像偏振模式）实现无标签学习，从而摆脱对人工鉴定的依赖。

Method: 首先分析通用无监督伪任务失效原因：无标签条件下找到的正样本要么错误、要么与锚点近乎重复。据此利用偏振光显微镜特性构造正样本：同一视场的PPL与XPL图像显示相同颗粒（构造上必然正确），但外观差异显著。提出XPP方法，将每张切片视为伪类别，并配对其同一视场位置的PPL与XPL视图，迫使模型依赖颗粒形状与纹理而非颜色进行匹配。在南京大学108类岩石数据集上验证，支持集与查询集来自不同切片，并设置颜色增强等对照实验。

Result: 在南京大学108类岩石数据集上，三次随机划分平均下XPP为最佳无标签方法，达到在78个已鉴定岩石类型上训练的监督模型水平；对照实验表明颜色增强及其他成像正样本无法复现该增益；同时发现先前工作的图像级协议已饱和，并提出跨切片协议替代。

Conclusion: 偏振光成像的PPL/XPL配对为无标签少样本岩石识别提供了可靠且具有判别性的自监督信号，可在无鉴定标签条件下获得接近监督的性能；图像级评测协议已饱和，应采用更具挑战性的跨切片协议评估泛化。

Abstract: Few-shot classifiers of rock thin sections are meta-trained on many rock types that a petrographer has identified slide by slide, and this identification is the costly step that new collections lack. We study few-shot recognition of unseen rock types when no training slide is identified, and the only information available is what the microscope records anyway: which slide an image comes from, and whether it was taken in plane-polarized (PPL) or cross-polarized (XPL) light. We first show why generic unsupervised pseudo-tasks fit this setting poorly: the positives they find without labels are either wrong or near-duplicates of the anchor, so they teach the model little. Polarized-light microscopy provides positives that avoid both problems. The PPL and XPL views of one field show the same grains, so they are correct by construction, yet they look very different. We propose cross-polarization pairing (XPP), which treats each slide as a pseudo-class and pairs its PPL and XPL views of the same field location, so that matching must rely on grain shape and texture rather than on colour. On the Nanjing University collection of 108 rock types, with support and query images taken from different slides, XPP is the best label-free method on average over three random splits, and matches a supervised model trained on 78 identified rock types. Controls show that colour augmentation and other acquisition positives do not reproduce the gain. We also show that the image-level protocol of earlier work is saturated, and propose a cross-slide protocol in its place.

</details>


### [88] [Scene-Adaptive VLA: Efficient Autonomous Driving via Dynamic Layer Routing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24590)
*Yujia Yang,Quan Yuan,Jiawei Fan,Yang Li,Tiange Fu,Xiaoyuan Fu,Guiyang Luo,Jinglin Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Scene-Adaptive VLA框架，利用动态层路由按实时场景复杂度自适应调整激活参数，在Bench2Drive上以53.5%的推理算力削减实现几乎无损的驾驶与语言能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型参数量庞大，车载实时推理算力与能耗压力大、影响续航；现有高效化研究集中于序列层面适配（CoT、token调整），忽视了动态驾驶场景下的参数冗余，结构层面适配尚属空白。

Method: 基于帧级时序场景变化与决策偏差刻画模型感知的场景复杂度，并编码为场景感知token及两个专用query；采用预算条件化的层路由机制评估精炼query，分配决定激活参数比例的预算并选择相应层组合；全框架端到端优化。

Result: 在Bench2Drive基准上适配SOTA VLA模型，推理阶段计算开销降低53.5%，驾驶性能与语言能力退化可忽略。

Conclusion: 动态层路由的结构自适应是缓解VLA车载算力瓶颈的有效途径，可兼顾效率、驾驶能力与可解释性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a promising paradigm for autonomous driving. However, the massive parameter scale of VLAs strains onboard computational resources during real-time inference. This directly increases energy consumption and limits vehicle battery range, making it critical to minimize computational overhead without compromising driving capability and explainability. Current research on efficient VLA-based driving focuses on sequential adaptation (\textit{e.g.}, Chain-of-Thought and token adjustment), leaving structural adaptation underexplored despite parameter redundancy across dynamic driving scenes. To address this gap, we propose Scene-Adaptive VLA, an efficient framework leveraging dynamic layer routing to adjust active parameters based on real-time scenes. Inspired by the temporal continuity of scenes and model predictive uncertainty, our approach characterizes model-perceived scene complexity via frame-level temporal scene variations and decision deviations. To uncover latent scene-to-parameter correspondences, we encode this characterization into scene-aware tokens, alongside two specialized queries. A budget-conditioned layer routing mechanism evaluates these refined queries to allocate a budget that determines the active parameter ratio and subsequently selects appropriate layer combinations. The entire framework is optimized end-to-end. Extensive evaluations on the Bench2Drive benchmark show that when adapted to a state-of-the-art VLA model, our approach significantly reduces inference-time computational overhead by 53.5\% with negligible degradation in driving and language capabilities. Code is available at https:github.com/yang-luvu/Scene-Adaptive-VLA.

</details>


### [89] [Dynamic self-ensemble on multi-exit residual vision transformer for small-data image classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24602)
*Stephen Ekaputra Limantoro,Yan-Kai Wang,Ching-Chun Huang,Hong-Han Shuai,Wen-Huang Cheng,Jungwoo Huh,Sanghoon Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多阶段残差ViT（ReSEViT）与自集成学习（含动态学习器选择DLS），以缓解ViT在小规模数据集上的数据饥渴问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ViT在仅训练于大规模数据集时才能取得高性能，存在"数据饥渴"问题；而医疗影像等实际场景中图像数据往往受限，因此需研究ViT在小规模数据上的表现并加以改进。

Method: 设计多阶段残差ViT（ReSEViT）：每个阶段将类ResNet的残差token嵌入与Transformer块结合以建模有效局部结构；并引入自集成学习，在单一模型内集成多阶段分类器，其中采用动态学习器选择（DLS）自适应地为不同阶段分配重要性权重。

Result: 将残差token与自集成学习融入多阶段ViT后，减少了冗余、预测误差与方差，同时在小型图像数据集上保持了高效的模型规模。

Conclusion: ReSEViT结合自集成学习可有效利用中间特征的多层级信息，缓解决策边界复杂导致的单分类器预测错误，为小规模数据下的ViT训练提供可行方案。

Abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) has garnered increased attention for image classification in recent years. However, ViT is notorious for its data-hungry problem as it achieves high-performance results when only trained on large-size datasets. In this paper, we study how ViT specifically works on small-scale datasets with limited data where the availability of image data is often constrained in practice, especially in fields such as medical imaging. To mitigate the issue, we designed a multi-stage residual ViT, dubbed ReSEViT, with the self-ensemble method to utilize multi-level information from intermediate features. Due to the complex decision boundaries for classifications, relying on a single classifier can lead to prediction errors. Hence, we propose a new learning method for ViT, named self-ensemble learning, which ensembles multi-stage classifiers in a single model. Our self-ensemble comprises a novel approach, Dynamic Learner Selection (DLS), to adaptively select the importance of different stages. ReSEViT incorporates residual token embeddings which is a ResNet-like block to model effective local structures alongside with transformer blocks in each stage. The integration of residual tokens and self-ensemble learning into a multi-stage ViT highlights the reduction in redundancy, prediction error and variance while maintaining an efficient model size for small-scale image datasets.

</details>


### [90] [SCOPE-VSR: A Broad-Coverage Training Dataset for Video Super-Resolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24604)
*Gengyu Liao,Yechun Yong,Zheng Chen,Jianze Li,Ziqing Zhang,Linghe Kong,Yulun Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出开放域视频超分数据构建流程SCOPE，构建SCOPE-VSR训练集（约2.7万视频）与SCOPE-test测试集，并提出单步视频复原框架GraCo-VSR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域VSR需要在差异极大的场景与主体间保持时序一致的细节，但现有训练数据语义不均衡、多样性不足，构成数据瓶颈。

Method: SCOPE流程：面向任务的视频筛选 + 分层语义重平衡；在大量数据源上构建SCOPE-VSR与SCOPE-test。模型GraCo-VSR采用可靠性感知设计与显式监督，降低退化在运动与纹理引导中引入的失真，实现单步视频复原。

Result: SCOPE-VSR约含27k视频，对真实世界场景与主体提供均衡且多样的覆盖；GraCo-VSR在重建保真度与感知质量上均取得较强表现。

Conclusion: 数据层面的语义重平衡与模型层面的引导可靠性增强相结合，可有效突破开放域VSR的数据瓶颈并提升单步复原效果。

Abstract: Open-domain video super-resolution (VSR) requires temporally coherent details across widely varying scenes and subjects. However, existing training datasets are often semantically imbalanced and insufficiently diverse. We address this data bottleneck with a structured curation pipeline for open-domain VSR, SCOPE. In this pipeline, we combine task-oriented video selection with hierarchical semantic rebalancing. Applying this pipeline to a large-scale collection of data sources, we construct the SCOPE-VSR dataset for training and SCOPE-test for testing. SCOPE-VSR has approximately 27k videos and provides balanced and diverse coverage of various real-world scenarios and subjects. We further develop GraCo-VSR, a novel framework for one-step video restoration. GraCo-VSR adopts a reliability-aware design with explicit supervision to reduce degradation-induced distortions in motion and texture guidance, allowing the model to benefit more effectively from the diverse training content in SCOPE-VSR. Evaluations show that our model achieves strong reconstruction fidelity and perceptual quality. Our code is available at: https://github.com/gyliao2768/SCOPE-VSR.

</details>


### [91] [IntriAdapt: Generalizable Intrinsic-Guided Test-Time Adaptation for Metric Geometry Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24607)
*Jiaxing Chen,Zizheng Yan,Jingyu Zhuang,Jinwei Chen,Shuguang Cui,Guanying Chen,Qingnan Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 IntriAdapt，一种测试时自适应框架，利用已知相机内参作为输出端几何校验器，通过最小化点云视光线与内参定义视光线之间的闭式几何残差，在冻结的几何基础模型上用 LoRA 微调，无需深度传感器或外部先验即可提升度量 3D 几何精度，并可扩展到视频序列且具备跨序列泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 透视投影的固有歧义使从图像恢复度量 3D 几何本质上是病态问题。现有几何模型在推理时接收或预测内参，却未用其监督模型自适应；而常规测试时自适应（TTA）依赖外部深度测量来修正预测。作者希望寻找一种不依赖深度传感器或外部先验的监督信号。

Method: 将相机内参作为输出侧几何校验器：把预测点云的视光线与已知内参定义的视光线比较，得到直接的几何不一致性度量（闭式残差）。IntriAdapt 在冻结的几何基础模型上优化轻量 LoRA 适配器以最小化该闭式残差，使预测与特定相机模型对齐。方法进一步扩展到视频序列，短序列上自适应后可泛化到同一相机拍摄的其他序列，适配后的模型以单次前馈处理留出图像，无需逐帧重复优化。

Result: 在多种基座模型上，于 10 个单图像基准与 7 个序列基准进行实验，IntriAdapt 在度量精度与相对几何两方面均稳定优于未适配基线，并且优于提供 oracle 内参的基线。

Conclusion: 相机内参可作为有效的输出端自监督信号用于测试时自适应，无需深度传感器或外部先验即可显著改善度量几何预测；短序列适配可跨序列泛化，且适配后模型保持前馈推理效率。

Abstract: Recovering metric 3D geometry from images is fundamentally ill-posed due to perspective projection ambiguity. Current geometry models incorporate supplied or predicted intrinsics during inference, but do not use them to supervise model adaptation. To refine these predictions, test-time adaptation (TTA) typically relies on external depth measurements. In this paper, we instead use camera intrinsics as an output-side geometric verifier. Comparing the point cloud's viewing rays with those defined by the known intrinsics yields a direct measure of geometric inconsistency. We propose \textit{IntriAdapt}, a TTA framework that minimizes this closed-form geometric residual. By optimizing a lightweight LoRA adapter on a frozen geometry foundation model, our method aligns the prediction with the specific camera model without depth sensors or external priors. We further extend this approach to video sequences, demonstrating that adapting a short sequence generalizes to other sequences captured by the same camera. The adapted model processes held-out images in a feed-forward pass, without repeating optimization for each frame. Experiments on ten single-image and seven sequence benchmarks across multiple base models show that \textit{IntriAdapt} consistently outperforms both unadapted and oracle-intrinsics baselines in metric accuracy and relative geometry.

</details>


### [92] [Beyond Geometric Closure: Measuring and Diagnosing Mechanical Consistency in Visual Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24619)
*Qibin Gu,Yunfeng Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一个衡量与诊断视觉动力学中机械一致性的框架，用独立SI审计分解几何、驱动与能量三重约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉精度无法说明预测的运动是否服从动力学规律，需要可度量的机械一致性诊断手段。

Method: 对刚性闭环链进行独立SI审计，区分几何容许性、无反力驱动器做功与功-能平衡；用连续评分对照固定工程目标，用参考重放量化测量误差。3个种子评估KeyCLD与CON（343个平面装配，64/256像素），以及V-JEPA+AC与LingBot-VA（100个共享空间测试装配）。

Result: CON相对persistence将图像MSE降低37.6%/37.2%，但两平面模型均未达到原生几何有效；256像素下校准RGB重放的预测误差远高于测量误差。精确状态下KeyCLD保持几何，RK4训练将分数由52.65升至64.30；两空间路径中CAD/IK重建恢复几何，但平均驱动残差超工程目标五倍以上。

Conclusion: 该干预式诊断可将视觉预测与几何容许性的增益同残余的力与能量误差区分开。

Abstract: Visual accuracy leaves open whether predicted motion obeys dynamics. We introduce a framework for measuring and diagnosing mechanical consistency in visual dynamics. An independent SI audit of rigid closed chains separates geometric admissibility, reaction-free actuator effort, and work--energy balance. Continuous scoring measures progress against fixed engineering targets, while reference replay quantifies measurement error. With three seeds per setting, we evaluate KeyCLD and CON across 343 planar assemblies at 64/256 pixels and V-JEPA + AC and LingBot-VA on 100 shared spatial test assemblies. CON reduces image MSE by 37.6%/37.2% relative to persistence, yet neither planar model attains valid native geometry. At 256 pixels, calibrated RGB replay places forecast errors far above measurement error. With exact states, KeyCLD preserves geometry and RK4 training raises its score from 52.65 to 64.30. In both spatial pathways, CAD/IK reconstruction restores geometry while mean actuator residuals exceed five times the engineering targets. The interventions distinguish gains in visual prediction and geometric admissibility from remaining force and energy errors.

</details>


### [93] [Spectral-Aware Proposal Enhancement for Diffusion-Based Multispectral UAV Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24642)
*Xu Lin,Tingfa Xu,Tianhao Li,Haolin Qin,Huawei Gao,Jichuan Xing,Jianan Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DSATrack，一个扩散引导的光谱感知多光谱无人机多目标跟踪框架，通过光谱编码增强RPN提案质量并用光谱显著性调制置信度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多光谱无人机有向框MOT面临小目标、背景杂乱和帧间关联不稳定等挑战；现有扩散式跟踪器缺乏在多光谱线索利用上的专门设计，即提案初始化与置信度校准环节未利用光谱信息，限制了复杂场景下的鲁棒性。

Method: 轻量级光谱编码器通过特征融合将多光谱信息注入RPN分支，使RPN头生成高质量目标感知提案，并注入初始提案集为扩散精化提供空间先验；同时提出光谱显著性置信度调制策略，在阈值判决前依据局部多光谱显著性对比度重标定跟踪置信度，增强光谱可靠候选、抑制不可靠候选；不改动原始扩散精化头。

Result: 在MMOT基准上，相比适配的DiffusionTrack基线提升4.6 HOTA、9.0 MOTA和7.7 IDF1。

Conclusion: 通过提案质量与精化后候选选择的双重改进，DSATrack在多光谱无人机MOT任务上有效且性能优于扩散跟踪基线。

Abstract: Multispectral UAV multi-object tracking (MOT) with oriented bounding boxes remains challenging due to small targets, cluttered backgrounds, and unstable inter-frame associations. Although diffusion-based MOT provides an effective iterative proposal refinement paradigm, existing diffusion-based trackers lack dedicated designs for exploiting multispectral cues in proposal initialization and confidence calibration, limiting tracking robustness in complex UAV scenarios. This letter proposes DSATrack, a diffusion-guided spectral-aware tracking framework for multispectral UAV MOT. Specifically, a lightweight spectral encoder injects multispectral information into the RPN branch through feature fusion, enabling the RPN head to generate high-quality object-aware proposals. These proposals are then injected into the initial proposal set to provide reliable spatial priors for diffusion refinement. Furthermore, a spectral-saliency confidence modulation strategy recalibrates refined tracking confidence according to local multispectral saliency contrast before score thresholding, enhancing spectrally reliable candidates while suppressing unreliable ones. Without modifying the original diffusion refinement head, DSATrack improves both proposal quality and post-refinement candidate selection. Experiments on the MMOT benchmark demonstrate that DSATrack outperforms the adapted DiffusionTrack baseline by 4.6 HOTA, 9.0 MOTA, and 7.7 IDF1 points, showing its effectiveness for multispectral UAV MOT.

</details>


### [94] [Modeling Uncertainty Propagation in 3D Morphable Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24646)
*Megh Shukla,Edo Collins,Prashanth Chandran,Karel Petránek,Sergio Orts-Escolano,Mathieu Salzmann,Alexandre Alahi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出CLUE（Closed-form Local Uncertainty Estimation），用闭式近似将3DMM参数空间方差映射到逐顶点方差，并用于野外人体网格恢复的训练与推理，在精度与不确定性-误差相关性上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上逐顶点方差用于直观解释学习到的参数不确定性，但通过采样或误差传播将参数空间方差映射到逐顶点计算代价高昂，因此需要一种高效且准确的替代方案。

Method: 基于全方差定律应用于3DMM公式，推导出闭式近似，将3DMM的参数空间分布直接变换为逐顶点方差；方法模块化、计算廉价且准确。随后将CLUE集成到野外人体网格恢复的训练与推理中，并以网格几何作为归纳偏置来预测方差；同时将其与回归器结合，输出高分辨率不确定性图（SAM 3D Body (CLUE)）。

Result: 大量定性与定量实验表明：训练中使用CLUE时，(1) 在关节、网格及不确定性评价指标上优于概率类与确定性基线；(2) 具有最高的不确定性-误差Spearman相关性，可应用于数据挖掘与可解释不确定性；并发布了附带高分辨率不确定性图的SAM 3D Body (CLUE) 及开源代码。

Conclusion: CLUE以闭式方式高效、准确地实现参数方差到逐顶点方差的映射，借助网格几何归纳偏置提升预测精度，可作为训练与推理模块增强人体网格恢复的精度与不确定性可解释性。

Abstract: We study the problem of mapping parameter-space variance of a 3D Morphable Model (3DMM) to per-vertex variance. Traditionally, per-vertex variance has been used to visually interpret the learnt parameter uncertainty. However, mapping parameter-space variance to per-vertex using sampling or error propagation is computationally expensive. We address this limitation with Closed-form Local Uncertainty Estimation (CLUE), which transforms the parameter-space distribution of 3DMMs to per-vertex through a closed-form approximation. CLUE emerges from applying the law of total variance to the 3DMM formulation and is modular, computationally inexpensive, and accurate. Subsequently, we study integrating CLUE for in-the-wild human mesh recovery training and inference. We note that CLUE uses the geometry of the mesh as an inductive bias when predicting the variance, leading to improved accuracy. Through extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments, we show that when used in training, CLUE (1) outpeforms probabilistic and deterministic baselines on metrics evaluating joints, mesh and uncertainty, and (2) has the highest uncertainty-to-error spearman correlation, with applications including data mining and interpretable uncertainty. Finally, we share SAM 3D Body (CLUE) which augments the regressor with high resolution uncertainty maps. We make our code available at https://github.com/vita-epfl/CLUE

</details>


### [95] [Knowledge Diversion: A Novel Paradigm for Pre-training Decomposable Image Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24664)
*Yucheng Xie,Fu Feng,Ruixiao Shi,Jing Wang,Xin Geng,Yong Rui*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出条件感知预训练范式 Knowledge Diversion (KDiv)，将随机初始化权重分解为秩一 Knowledge Units 并分为 learngenes 与 tailors，通过连续条件感知路由实现可分解的生成模型，支持下游条件的选择性重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统预训练目标仅优化源域性能，未显式考虑下游需求，导致可迁移知识与任务特定知识纠缠在共享参数空间中，限制了知识的选择性复用与高效下游适配；该问题在需适配多种条件与域的图像生成模型中尤为突出。

Method: KDiv 在预训练前将随机初始化权重分解为秩一 Knowledge Units，组织为 learngenes 与 tailors；预训练期间通过连续条件感知路由，将跨条件共享知识整合进 learngenes，将条件相关变化导向 tailors，从而形成结构化组织。

Result: 在类条件、文本条件与图像条件生成上的大量实验表明，KDiv 在相近预训练成本下持续匹配或超越稠密基线，并在与低秩适配方法相当的训练参数预算下取得最强的平均下游性能。

Conclusion: KDiv 使生成模型具备内在可分解性：learngenes 捕获可迁移生成先验，tailors 发展条件特定专长，最终模型可按需选择性重组以适配多样下游条件。

Abstract: Large-scale pre-trained models have become foundational to modern machine learning, yet conventional pre-training objectives primarily optimize source-domain performance without explicitly considering downstream requirements. Consequently, transferable and task-specific knowledge remains entangled within a shared parameter space, limiting selective knowledge reuse and efficient downstream adaptation. This limitation is particularly consequential for image-generation models, which must accommodate diverse conditions and domains. To address this challenge, we introduce Knowledge Diversion (KDiv), a condition-aware pre-training paradigm for learning inherently decomposable generative models. Before pre-training, KDiv factorizes randomly initialized weights into rank-one Knowledge Units, which are organized into learngenes and tailors. During pre-training, continuous condition-aware routing consolidates knowledge shared across conditions in learngenes while directing condition-dependent variations to tailors. This structured organization enables learngenes to capture transferable generative priors and tailors to develop condition-specific expertise, allowing the resulting model to be selectively recombined for diverse downstream conditions. Extensive experiments across class-, text-, and image-conditioned generation demonstrate that KDiv consistently matches or surpasses dense baselines at comparable pre-training cost and achieves the strongest average downstream performance with a trainable parameter budget comparable to low-rank adaptation methods.

</details>


### [96] [From Views to Worlds: Active Exploration over 3D Worlds for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24676)
*Qijian Tian,Jiayu Ying,Ke Fan,Lizhuang Ma,Xin Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: V2W将多视图图像重建为含几何、相机位姿与语言接地语义的显式3D世界，并通过视觉与语言接口让VLM多轮主动获取空间证据，实现从被动的视图中心感知到主动的世界中心空间推理的转变，训练无关可用且可通过强化学习优化探索策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM在2D视觉理解上表现优异，但被动的视图中心感知范式限制其3D空间推理能力；3D关系推理常需主动获取当前视图之外的证据（相机位姿、跨视图空间关系），而现有方法要么缺乏主动探索，要么仅在推理阶段补充额外视图，未显式获取超出2D图像的空间证据。

Method: 提出V2W主动探索框架：给定带多视图图像的空间推理任务，先重建显式3D世界（几何、相机位姿、语言接地语义），通过视觉与语言两种接口暴露给VLM；VLM经多轮交互迭代地从3D世界中获取空间证据，完成主动的世界中心空间推理；可与现有VLM以训练无关方式集成，并可用强化学习优化探索策略。

Result: 在空间心智建模基准上的实验表明，V2W在训练无关设置下显著优于VLM基线，在学习得到的探索策略下达到SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 主动探索对空间智能至关重要；V2W通过显式3D世界构建与多轮证据获取，有效提升VLM的空间推理能力，并具备良好的可集成性与可优化性。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in 2D visual understanding tasks, yet the passive view-centric perception paradigm limits their capacity for 3D spatial reasoning. Such reasoning often requires actively acquiring spatial evidence beyond the currently visible views, such as camera poses and cross-view spatial relationships, to infer 3D relationships that are not explicitly represented in 2D images. However, existing methods either lack active exploration or merely provide additional views during inference, without explicitly acquiring such spatial evidence beyond 2D images. In this paper, we propose View-to-World (V2W), an active exploration framework that enables VLMs to actively explore 3D worlds and lifts VLMs from passive view-centric perception to active world-centric spatial reasoning. Given a spatial reasoning task with multi-view images, V2W first reconstructs an explicit 3D world with geometry, camera poses, and language-grounded semantics, and exposes it to VLMs through visual and linguistic interfaces. Through multi-turn interaction with these interfaces, VLMs iteratively acquire spatial evidence from the constructed 3D world, enabling active world-centric spatial reasoning. V2W can be integrated with existing VLMs in a training-free manner and can be further enhanced by optimizing the exploration policy via reinforcement learning. Experiments on spatial mental modeling benchmarks demonstrate that V2W substantially improves VLM baselines in the training-free setting and achieves state-of-the-art performance with the learned exploration policy, highlighting the importance of active exploration for spatial intelligence. Project page: \url{https://fangzhou2000.github.io/projects/v2w}.

</details>


### [97] [MESS: Multi-Exposure Sequence Synthesis for Generalizable Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24680)
*Ruodai Cui,Shuaizheng Liu,Rongyuan Wu,Lei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MESS框架：用ISP仿真从高比特RAW生成多曝光序列并训练扩散模型实现单张RGB到多曝光序列的合成，构建500K训练对，训练轻量网络在多类不良光照增强任务上取得显著更强的泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低光照增强、曝光校正、逆光增强等模型跨场景泛化性差，主要瓶颈是缺乏大规模多样训练数据：真实配对数据需人工拍摄且精确对齐、难以扩展；已有合成数据方法对复杂不良光照条件与相机成像管线的建模能力有限。

Method: (1) 从高比特RAW图像出发，经仿真的ISP管线在不同曝光设置下渲染得到多曝光序列（MES）；(2) 以RAW衍生的MES为监督，训练基于扩散模型的RGB-to-MES生成器，从单张8bit RGB图像合成合理的曝光序列，将合成流程从有限RAW集合扩展到大规模野外RGB数据；(3) 对每张源图随机采样一个合成曝光变体作为退化输入，原高质量RGB图像作为目标，构建500K训练对；(4) 用该数据训练轻量增强网络。

Result: 构建了500K规模的训练对数据集；训练的轻量网络在多种图像增强任务上泛化性能显著优于现有模型。

Conclusion: 通过RAW仿真ISP与扩散生成相结合的多曝光序列合成（MESS），可低成本获得大规模、真实感强的配对数据，是提升图像增强模型野外泛化性的有效途径。

Abstract: Despite the significant progress in image enhancement under adverse illuminations, such as low-light image enhancement, exposure correction, and backlit image enhancement, existing models show limited generalizability to different scenarios. A major bottleneck lies in the lack of large-scale and diverse training data, as these tasks typically rely on manually captured, precisely aligned image pairs that are expensive to scale up. Although synthetic data have been explored as an alternative, existing synthesis methods are limited in modeling complex adverse illumination conditions and camera imaging pipelines. To address this issue, we propose a novel framework to synthesize realistic training pairs for generalizable image enhancement in the wild. Specifically, we first derive multi-exposure sequences (MES) from high-bit RAW images by rendering them under different exposure settings through an emulated ISP pipeline. Using these RAW-derived MES as supervision, we train a diffusion-based RGB-to-MES generator to synthesize plausible exposure sequences from a single 8-bit RGB image, extending the synthesis pipeline from limited RAW collections to large-scale in-the-wild RGB data. For each source image, we randomly sample one synthesized exposure variant as the degraded input and use the original high-quality RGB image as the target. With the proposed MES Synthesis (MESS) approach, we construct a dataset of 500K training pairs and train a lightweight network, which demonstrates significantly better generalization performance than existing models across various image enhancement tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/PolyU-VCLab/MESS.

</details>


### [98] [Geometry-Aware Interpolation for Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24687)
*Pourya Shamsolmoali,Masoumeh Zareapoor*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出几何感知插值网络GAIN，将流形几何引入空间变换与图像重建，以流形局部切空间构造几何引导的强度近似，并用熵正则与卷积归一化改善自适应插值与梯度稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从不完整或退化图像中恢复缺失视觉信息仍具挑战，尤其在存在空间变化与复杂结构时。STN虽能实现空间特征对齐，但依赖线性/双线性插值，难以刻画数据底层几何特性；基于有限邻域像素的插值还会引起梯度传播不一致，影响优化稳定性。

Method: GAIN为基于变分自编码器的框架，将流形几何嵌入空间变换与图像重建：不局限于用固定空间邻域像素估计强度，而利用数据流形的局部切结构构造几何引导的强度近似；引入熵正则项引导空间变换参数估计，促进更自适应的插值；并提出卷积归一化策略，约束非零激活幅值、提升训练中梯度稳定性。

Result: 在具有挑战性的图像补全与分类基准上进行大量实验，GAIN相较于现有方法提升了预测精度，同时降低了计算开销。

Conclusion: 以流形几何替代传统邻域插值假设，可在空间变换与重建任务中兼顾精度与效率，为几何感知的图像补全提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Recovering missing visual information from incomplete or degraded images remains a challenging problem, particularly when spatial variations and complex image structures affect reconstruction accuracy. Although Spatial Transformer Networks (STNs) facilitate spatial feature alignment, their reliance on conventional linear or bilinear interpolation limits their ability to capture the underlying geometric characteristics of image data. Furthermore, interpolation based on a restricted set of neighbouring pixels can introduce inconsistencies in gradient propagation, potentially affecting optimisation stability. To address these limitations, we propose a Geometry-Aware Interpolation Network (GAIN), a variational autoencoder-based framework that incorporates manifold geometry into spatial transformation and image reconstruction. Rather than estimating pixel intensities solely from fixed spatial neighbours, GAIN exploits the local tangent structure of the data manifold to construct geometry-informed intensity approximations. An entropy-based regularisation mechanism further guides the estimation of spatial transformation parameters, promoting more adaptive interpolation. In addition, a convolutional normalisation strategy is introduced to regulate the magnitude of non-zero activations and improve gradient stability during training. Extensive experiments on challenging image completion and classification benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of GAIN in improving predictive accuracy while reducing computational cost compared with existing methods.

</details>


### [99] [Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24738)
*Wen Xue,Yong Liu,Xueheng Li,Si Wu,Yong Xu,Yipeng Sun,Yan Li,Simiu Gu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LayerEditor：将指令引导的图像编辑与可控可复用RGBA图层生成统一到一个框架，通过In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling与Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation实现保真编辑与图层分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量图像编辑需精确修改目标区域并保留无关区域。现有编辑模型输出扁平化图像，难以局部精细操作与图层复用；而分解方法通常将图层恢复与指令驱动编辑分开优化，二者割裂。

Method: 提出LayerEditor统一框架。核心为In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling：将编辑后画布与有序RGB-Alpha图层序列联合表征于单一token序列中，实现语义编辑与图层内容的显式控制。并提出Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation，在适配分层输出时将预训练模型的编辑先验迁移至编辑画布及由预测图层合成之图像。构建LayerEditor-100K配对数据集（含有序RGBA图层标注）及配套评测基准。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayerEditor在保持强编辑保真度的同时生成准确的RGBA图层，支持灵活的图层级操作与多层分解。

Conclusion: 该工作将指令编辑与可控图层生成统一，兼顾编辑保真与图层可复用性，并提供数据与基准支撑后续研究。

Abstract: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At its core, In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling jointly represents the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence, enabling semantic edits and explicit control over individual layer content. To retain the pretrained model's editing capability during adaptation to layered outputs, we propose Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation, which transfers its editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers. To support training and evaluation, we construct LayerEditor-100K, a large-scale paired image-editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations, and introduce dedicated benchmarks for layered editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayerEditor maintains strong editing fidelity while generating accurate RGBA layers, supporting both flexible layer-level manipulation and multi-layer decomposition.

</details>


### [100] [CorrFlow: Self-Correcting Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24750)
*Hangwei Zhang,Nathan Rouillé,Chuanxia Zheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CorrFlow 是一种自校正的流匹配（flow-matching）框架，通过一个轻量级 refiner 复用基础模型前向传播中的中间隐状态，对每步速度预测的残差进行校正，在不增加基础模型评估的前提下提升生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有流匹配模型通过迭代速度预测生成样本，但每次预测后并不利用产生该预测的中间表示进行回看与修正。作者希望在不增加基础模型计算开销的情况下，利用这些被浪费的信息来减小速度预测误差。

Method: 在 rectified-flow 插值下，一步干净预测的误差等于实际速度残差按噪声水平缩放，作者据此设计 refiner：从基础模型的干净预测、条件、噪声水平以及同一前向传播中的隐状态学习预测残差校正，并在每次采样更新前加到基础速度上，使后续预测基于校正后的状态。该方法无需额外基础模型评估，每步仅需一次轻量 refiner 评估。

Result: 理论分析给出了特征复用优于原始输入仿射预测器的条件，并证明在同等训练算力预算下，refiner 训练比继续训练基础模型能带来更大的残差风险下降。在类别条件图像生成、文本到视频生成和图像到视频生成任务上，相对各自基础模型均有稳定提升，包括视觉质量与物理一致性的改善。

Conclusion: 复用中间特征的自校正机制是一种低成本、可插拔的改进手段，可一致地提升流匹配模型的生成质量与物理一致性。

Abstract: Flow-matching models generate samples through iterative velocity predictions, but typically do not revisit these predictions using the intermediate representations that produced them. We introduce CorrFlow, a self-correcting flow-matching framework that reuses this information through a lightweight refiner. Under rectified-flow interpolation, the error of the one-step clean prediction equals the realized velocity residual scaled by the noise level. Motivated by this identity, the refiner learns to predict residual corrections from the base model's clean prediction, conditioning, noise level and hidden states from the same forward pass. The correction is added to the base velocity before each sampling update, so subsequent predictions are made from the corrected state. This requires no additional base-model evaluations and only one lightweight refiner evaluation per step. Our theoretical analyses establish conditions under which feature reuse outperforms raw-input affine predictors and refiner training achieves greater residual-risk reduction than continued base-model training under a matched training compute budget. Experiments on class-conditional image generation, text-to-video generation and image-to-video generation show consistent improvements over the corresponding base models, including gains in visual quality and physical consistency. Project Page: https://fogradio.github.io/corrflow-project

</details>


### [101] [CorrCLIPv2: Harnessing Unlabeled Images for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24757)
*Dengke Zhang,Fagui Liu,Quan Tang,C. L. Philip Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出免训练的面向对象开放词汇语义分割框架CorrCLIPv2，从patch相关性、特征表示与输出正则三方面解决CLIP分割中的类间噪声交互问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP具备强开放词汇识别能力，但其分割能力受类间patch噪声交互与上下文偏置影响，导致分割精度不足。

Method: 1) patch相关：用类无关掩码生成器显式解耦类间交互，并以自监督模型的空间连贯特征计算注意力以缓解掩码误差；2) 特征表示：设计细化机制同步增强空间细节与语义表征；3) 输出空间：在每个掩码内投票统一预测以提升空间一致性；4) 扩展：构建无标注图像的CorrCLIP增强特征记忆库，引入跨图像对象检索与多CLIP集成，聚合跨上下文语义一致对象特征以抑制上下文干扰。

Result: 在10个标准基准上取得新的SOTA，并在22个多域数据集上超越全监督开放词汇方法，额外计算开销极小。

Conclusion: 统一的三方面免训练框架结合跨图像检索可有效提升开放词汇分割的鲁棒性与精度，且无需额外训练成本。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation aims to classify pixels without being restricted to a fixed set of categories. Although Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) demonstrates remarkable potential for open-vocabulary recognition, its segmentation capability is impaired by noisy inter-class patch interactions. To this end, this work proposes a unified training-free object-centric framework, named CorrCLIPv2, from three complementary aspects of patch correlation, feature representation, and output regularization. Specifically, for patch correlation, we leverage class-agnostic mask generators to explicitly disentangle inter-class interactions. Moreover, we utilize spatially-coherent features from self-supervised models to compute attention scores to mitigate mask inaccuracies. Regarding feature representation, we devise a refinement mechanism to simultaneously strengthen spatial details and semantic representation. Within the output space, we unify predictions via voting in each mask to enhance spatial consistency. To mitigate contextual bias and enhance prediction accuracy of objects, we further extend the framework by incorporating a cross-image object retrieval paradigm, which incurs minimal computational overhead. We build a memory bank of CorrCLIP-enhanced features from unlabeled images and implement a regime of multi-CLIP ensemble. By aggregating semantically consistent object features across diverse contexts retrieved from the memory bank, CorrCLIPv2 mitigates context-induced interference and obtains more robust predictions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach establishes a new state-of-the-art on 10 standard benchmarks. Remarkably, it even surpasses fully supervised open-vocabulary methods across 22 multi-domain datasets. Code is available at: https://github.com/zdk258/CorrCLIP.

</details>


### [102] [Design Anything, Design at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24771)
*Xuchao Ren,Siyuan Feng,Jing Huang,Yanhua Yao,Jing Wang,Lingyu Alina Wang,Anan Chen,Hangjie Yuan,Tao Feng,Qiong Wu,Sai Ma*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Design Anything：一个基于图结构、将设计意图外化于模型之外的“意图-执行图”框架，用于长流程多产出物设计任务中保持设计意图一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态资源生成媒体产出时，智能体需在长程任务中保持与设计意图对齐；设计需遵循含目标、约束与交付物的 brief，且后续工作依赖先前决策。已有方法虽可跨任务复用设计经验，但同一项目内各产出物之间的一致性仍难保证，项目规模扩大时更甚。

Method: 1）图结构 harness，将设计意图保存在模型外部；2）通过“意图-执行图”把交付物绑定到产生它的工作流步骤；3）任务契约（task contract）保存约束与决策；4）被选中的设计作为后续生成的显式输入；5）确定性控制器依据绑定与执行记录校验输出类型与数量、识别未完成交付物并引导后续轮次。同时构建 DesignAnything-Bench：19 个设计域、228 个任务，含 38 个项目族，规模为 6、14、24 个产出物。

Result: 固定同一 LLM 条件下，DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High 与 GPT-5.6 Sol High 分别满足 brief 中 85.0% 与 92.5% 的事实性约束，较最强同模型基线提升 15.4% 与 14.4%；在 24 产出物任务上提升达 25.1% 与 23.0%。两种模型下，该方法在 19 个域中的 18 个域约束满足率领先或持平。盲评中专业设计师更偏好其完整交付物集合。

Conclusion: 将设计意图外显化并用图结构绑定执行过程，可有效缓解项目内跨产出物、跨领域、随规模增长的意图漂移问题，且不依赖模型本身能力提升，具有显著的约束满足与工程实用价值。

Abstract: As multimodal resources are transformed into media outputs, agentic AI is expected to stay aligned with design intent over long horizons. Designers follow briefs specifying goals, constraints, and deliverables, with later work building on earlier decisions. Recent work reuses design experience across tasks, yet alignment among artifacts within one project remains challenging. Agents therefore need to preserve and apply this intent across domains and as projects grow. We introduce Design Anything, a graph-based harness that preserves design intent outside the model and binds deliverables to the workflow steps that produce them through an intent-execution graph. A task contract retains constraints and decisions, selected designs become explicit inputs to later generations, and a deterministic controller uses bindings and execution records to check output types and counts, identify outstanding deliverables, and guide subsequent turns. We also introduce DesignAnything-Bench, with 228 tasks across 19 design domains, including 38 project families at scales of 6, 14, and 24 artifacts. With the LLM held fixed, Design Anything satisfies 85.0% and 92.5% of the brief's factual constraints with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash High and GPT-5.6 Sol High, respectively, exceeding the strongest same-model baselines by 15.4% and 14.4%. These gains reach 25.1% and 23.0% on 24-artifact tasks. Under each model, Design Anything leads or ties in constraint satisfaction in 18 of 19 domains. Professional designers also prefer its complete deliverable sets over those of same-model baselines in a blind evaluation.

</details>


### [103] [ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24783)
*Hamidreza Dastmalchi,Ali Cheraghian,Aijun An,Abdelwahed Khamis,Lars Petersson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ATLAS 通过学习式注意力适配，将 LVLM 各层、各头、各模态的原始注意力转化为目标中心的定位线索，再结合 SAM2 实现推理视频目标分割。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RVOS 需在整段视频中定位并分割自然语言指代的目标。LVLM 的注意力图隐含定位信息，但噪声大、分散且跨层/头/模态不一致；现有方法依赖手工注意力选择启发式或高成本注意力精炼，难以直接用于分割。

Method: 提出 ATLAS 注意力适配框架：将全部层、头、模态的注意力视为结构化特征，融合高分辨率帧级注意力（空间信息）与低分辨率视频级注意力（时序上下文）；用带时间注意力和 FiLM 调制的轻量 U-Net 融合生成粗分割热力图，再经 SAM2 在视频中传播。

Result: 在多个具有挑战性的指代与推理视频分割基准上，ATLAS 优于现有冻结骨干（frozen-backbone）方法。

Conclusion: 以学习方式替代手工启发式与昂贵精炼，可有效利用 LVLM 注意力实现 RVOS；代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. Code and models are available at \url{https://hamidreza-136.github.io/atlas/}.

</details>


### [104] [Video-Language Entailment for Video Similarity Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24786)
*Benedetta Liberatori,Lorenzo Vaquero,Elisa Ricci,Paolo Rota*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VICE（Video Caption Entailment），一种双分支框架，利用大型多模态模型通过视频-语言蕴含实现细粒度的概念级视频相似度估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LMM多以单视频目标训练，缺乏跨视频比较能力；已有工作侧重全局相似度，概念级相似度（如活动、位置）更困难，且尚无专门利用LMM显式求解该任务的方法。

Method: 双分支设计：每个分支联合处理一个视频与另一个视频的caption，通过视频-语言蕴含判断二者在特定概念上的对齐程度；融合两分支输出得到最终相似度分数，并生成文本化的推理说明。该设计复用模型原生的单视频理解能力，同时实现视频与文本间的细粒度比较推理。

Result: 在ConViS-Bench与StepDiff基准上，VICE优于同时处理两段视频的模型。

Conclusion: 单视频推理范式对概念级视频相似度估计具有潜力，为LMM跨视频理解提供了有效且可解释的方案。

Abstract: Comparing videos to assess their semantic similarity remains a challenging task for current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs), which are primarily trained with single-video objectives. While most prior works have focused on computing global similarity, recent studies have introduced the more challenging problem of concept-based similarity, which measures how similar two videos are with respect to specific concepts (e.g., activity, location). However, no dedicated approaches have yet leveraged LMMs to explicitly address this task. In this paper, we aim to fill this gap introducing Video Caption Entailment for video similarity estimation (VICE): a dual-branch design that leverages LMMs for cross-video reasoning. Each branch jointly processes one video and the caption of the other, measuring their alignment for a specific concept via video-language entailment. The outputs from both branches are fused to produce a final similarity score, along with a textual explanation of the model reasoning. This approach leverages the model's native single-video understanding while enabling fine-grained comparative reasoning between video and text. Experiments on ConViS-Bench and StepDiff show that VICE outperforms models that process both videos simultaneously, highlighting the promise of single-video reasoning for concept-based similarity estimation.

</details>


### [105] [UniAVC: Unified Audio-Video Creation via Progressive Training and Asymmetric Scheduling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24791)
*Kien T. Pham,Yuhao Liu,Chong Hou Choi,Zhenqi He,Yanghao Wang,Chenyang Lei,Rui Liu,Qifeng Chen,Long Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: UniAVC 通过"先单模态训练、后用配对数据学跨模态耦合"的两阶段策略，并结合模态解耦噪声调度与不对称任务监督，用单一权重集实现文本条件联合生成、双向跨模态生成与指令引导编辑。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 统一音视频创作需要单一模型同时具备文本条件联合合成、双向跨模态生成和指令引导编辑能力。但现有方法存在两个问题：一是过度依赖稀缺的配对语料（编辑配对更稀缺），把宝贵监督浪费在单模态数据即可教会的单支生成与编辑能力上，而非跨模态耦合；二是对两个模态使用同一噪声调度，忽视了信息密度差异（视频需长时间高噪声组织空间与运动结构，音频更稀疏可更早收敛）以及同步去噪导致"以一个模态为条件生成/编辑另一模态"这类不对称流程缺乏训练。

Method: 1) 分阶段训练：先在单模态数据集上把每个分支训练到具备完整生成与编辑能力，再将配对数据专门用于挖掘跨模态对应关系；2) 模态解耦调度器：在同一共享时间步下，各模态独立地扭曲（warp）自身噪声调度；3) 不对称配置监督：对含一个干净模态的子任务直接施加监督；4) 由此支持意图感知编辑（保持一模态不变、以其约束另一模态）与推理后自精炼（仅对不满意的一支在已接受支的约束下重新生成）；5) 单一权重、无需任务特定适配器。

Result: 单一权重集即可覆盖多种创作任务，无需任务特定适配器；解耦调度缓解统一调度带来的动力学折衷，不对称监督使单向条件生成/编辑与推理后自精炼成为可能。

Conclusion: UniAVC 证明：将单模态监督与配对监督分工、并以模态解耦噪声调度和不对称子任务监督替代锁步去噪，可在统一框架内高效实现音视频联合生成与跨模态编辑。

Abstract: Unified audio-video creation requires a single model capable of text-conditioned joint synthesis, bidirectional cross-modal generation, and instruction-guided editing across both modalities. Existing methods rely heavily on paired corpora, which are scarce for joint generation and even rarer for editing. Consequently, they are spent learning single-branch generative and editing capabilities that abundant unimodal data could readily teach, rather than on the cross-modal coupling. Furthermore, prevailing systems apply a single shared noise schedule to both modalities, neglecting two critical limitations. First, due to the significant discrepancy in information density, video requires prolonged high noise to organize spatial and motion structure, whereas the sparser audio signal can settle earlier during the synthesis process, the dynamics a uniform schedule might compromise. Second, lockstep denoising leaves asymmetric workflows, such as conditioning on one modality to synthesize or edit another, untrained. We present UniAVC, which addresses both obstacles. It first trains each branch on unimodal dataset to full generative and editing competence, and subsequently dedicates paired data to exploit cross-modal correspondence. Modality-decoupled schedulers meanwhile warp the noise schedule independently from a shared timestep, while subtasks with one clean modality directly supervise asymmetric configurations. These settings respectively enable intent-aware editing, which preserves one modality intact while enlisting it to constrain the other, and post-inference self-refinement, which regenerates only an unsatisfactory branch against an accepted one. UniAVC thus spans multiple creation tasks from a single set of weights without task-specific adapters.

</details>


### [106] [Directionally Factorized Illumination with Spherical Harmonic Rotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24811)
*Yimeng Dou,Adam M. Saunders,Andre T. S. Hucke,Michael E. Kim,Adam W. Anderson,Eric R. Tkaczyk,Bennett A. Landman,Daniel Moyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DaFISH，可将逐点发射颜色分解为表面反照率与球谐(SH)表示的光照因子，可插入任意NVS管线（如NeRF），实现对随相机移动的共同安装光源的建模，并在五场景上取得最佳PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实拍摄中常存在刚性固定在相机上的光源（闪光灯、水下航行器灯、内窥镜照明），相机移动时光照方向随视角变化；NeRF/高斯泼溅将这种位姿相关光照编码为表面颜色，导致外观不一致并难以恢复真实场景。

Method: DaFISH将逐点发射颜色分解为表面反照率与球谐表示的光照因子；训练时直接评估SH光照，实现反照率、光照与几何的稳定联合优化；基于SH到辐照度的闭式转换，训练管线从SH评估到体渲染全程可微；无需重训练即可解析地泛化到任意相机位姿。

Result: 在五个场景的留出帧上平均，DaFISH取得最佳PSNR 38.91 dB、SSIM 0.9613、LPIPS 0.0582，优于最强splatting基线与最接近的NeRF基线，并较先前方法在跨视角下更一致地恢复场景。

Conclusion: DaFISH以模块化方式解决了共安装光源引起的位姿相关光照问题，兼顾高保真重建与解析式位姿泛化，验证了SH光照分解在NVS管线中的有效性。

Abstract: Many real-world capture scenarios involve an active light source rigidly attached to the camera: camera flashes for dark-environment imaging, underwater vehicle lights, and endoscopic/laparoscopic medical procedures. As the camera moves, the co-mounted light moves with it, causing the illumination direction at each surface point to change across views. Neural rendering methods (NeRF, Gaussian Splatting) encode this pose-dependent illumination as surface coloration, producing appearance inconsistencies and making it harder to recover the underlying scene. We present \textbf{DaFISH}, which can be plugged into any novel-view synthesis (NVS) pipeline such as NeRF. It factorizes per-point emitted color into surface albedo and a spherical harmonic (SH)-represented illumination factor. During training, the SH illumination is evaluated directly, enabling stable joint optimization of albedo, lighting, and geometry. \textbf{DaFISH} provides analytical generalization of illumination to arbitrary camera poses without retraining. Building on the closed-form SH-to-irradiance conversion, the training pipeline is fully differentiable from SH evaluation through volume rendering. Averaged over the held-out frames of the five scenes, \textbf{DaFISH} attains the best mean PSNR (38.91\,dB), SSIM (0.9613), and LPIPS (0.0582) among all compared methods. It improves over the strongest splatting baseline as well as the closest NeRF-based baseline, while recovering the scene consistently across views compared to prior methods.

</details>


### [107] [SwitchSplat: Learning Discrete Object States from Casually Captured Scenes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24812)
*Yizheng Xie,Yalda Foroutan,George Shramko,Daniel Rebain,Shrisudhan Govindarajan,Andrea Tagliasacchi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SwitchSplat采用"静态基底+状态槽"分解的3DGS表示，将场景拆分为共享静态基底与每个可交互物体的二值状态槽，可微分配使状态几何从视频中自动学习，支持任意状态组合与视角渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有3DGS假设世界静态；日常随手拍摄中用户与环境交互（开门、拨动开关、移动物体）带来离散状态变化，现有框架无法建模。时间条件化动态方法（如4DGS）将"状态被观测的时间"与"场景处于何状态"混为一谈，只能重放已见序列，无法组合任意物体构型。

Method: 提出base+slot（基底+状态槽）分解：共享静态base捕获不变场景，每个slot独立存储某一可交互物体的两种二值状态（开/关）；Gaussian到slot的分配完全可微，无需人工标注即可从视频中发现各状态几何。推理时用户自由组合各slot状态并从任意视角渲染。

Result: 在新建的随手拍摄数据集上验证，SwitchSplat在新视角合成质量上优于静态与动态基线，并独有地支持渲染采集过程中从未出现过的状态组合。

Conclusion: SwitchSplat首次以3DGS表示建模离散可交互状态变化，实现可组合、可自由视角渲染的可交互场景重建，突破动态方法只能重放已见序列的局限。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting has made high-fidelity 3D reconstruction fast and accessible, yet existing representations assume a static world. This assumption breaks down in casual captures, where a user naturally interacts with the environment -- opening doors, toggling switches, or moving objects -- introducing discrete state changes that no current framework can model. Time-conditioned dynamic methods such as 4DGS conflate when a state was observed with what state the scene is in, limiting them to replaying seen sequences rather than composing arbitrary object configurations. We present SwitchSplat, the first 3DGS representation to address this gap via a base+slot decomposition: a shared static base captures the invariant scene, while each slot independently holds the two binary states (on/off) of one interactable object. Because the assignment of Gaussians to slots is fully differentiable, the model discovers the geometry of each state directly from video, without manual annotation. At inference, the user can freely combine slot states and render the resulting scene from any viewpoint. We validate SwitchSplat on a new casual-capture dataset and show that it outperforms static and dynamic baselines in novel-view synthesis quality, while uniquely supporting rendering of state combinations never seen during capture. Project page: https://switchsplat.github.io

</details>


### [108] [SL-Ground: Sentence-Level Grounding for Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24814)
*Yang-Syu Li,Cheng-Huan Yang,Chia-Yung Jui,Peggy Joy Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SL-Ground 将基于 grounding 的开放词汇检测中的 token 级打分改为句子级 grounding，直接编码完整类别描述并与目标查询匹配，显著提升细粒度开放词汇检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 grounding-based 开放词汇检测器将 object query 对齐到单个文本 token，再通过 token-to-class 聚合得到类别分数。这种 token 级打分设计与细粒度检测中"类别由完整组合式描述定义"的需求不匹配，成为细粒度 OVOD 的瓶颈。

Method: 提出 SL-Ground：将每个类别描述编码为完整的句子级表示，并直接用 object query 与这些句子级表示进行打分，替代碎片化的 token 级匹配。同时构建多粒度 Stanford Cars 基准（车辆类型、品牌、车型三级），用于评估不同标签粒度下的细粒度识别。

Result: 在最细的车型粒度上，SL-Ground 在匹配训练候选采样下将 AP 从 token 级变体的 14.5 提升至 70.6，全词表训练下达到 86.0，同时更好保留开放词汇能力并避免重复的 prompt 分块。在 FG-OVD 上亦取得对比方法中最佳平均 AP。

Conclusion: 句子级 grounding 是更适合细粒度 OVOD 的打分单元，为构建细粒度、基于 grounding 的开放词汇检测器提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors provide a widely used framework for text-conditioned localization, with a phrase-grounding formulation that aligns object queries to individual text tokens and recovers class scores through token-to-class aggregation. We observe that this token-level scoring design becomes a bottleneck for fine-grained open-vocabulary object detection, where the target category is defined by a complete compositional description rather than by isolated tokens. Based on this observation, we propose SL-Ground, a sentence-level grounding reformulation for grounding-based open-vocabulary detection. Instead of scoring queries against fragmented token evidence, SL-Ground encodes each category description as a complete sentence-level representation and directly scores object queries against these representations. To evaluate fine-grained recognition across label granularity, we construct a multi-granularity Stanford Cars benchmark spanning vehicle type, brand, and car model. At the finest car-model granularity, SL-Ground raises AP over the token-level variant from 14.5 to 70.6 under matched training candidate sampling and to 86.0 with full-vocabulary training, while better preserving open-vocabulary capability and avoiding repeated prompt chunking. Beyond Stanford Cars, SL-Ground also improves FG-OVD performance, achieving the best average AP among compared methods. These results show that sentence-level grounding provides a more suitable scoring unit for fine-grained OVOD and offers a practical path toward fine-grained grounding-based open-vocabulary detectors.

</details>


### [109] [VTF900: A 900-Subject Visible-Thermal Face Recognition Dataset and Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24832)
*Jacob Abaare,Bianca Ianetta,Cedric Nimpa Fondje,Shuowen Hu,Benjamin S. Riggan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出大规模可见光-热红外人脸识别基准VTF900（900个受试者，含表情、姿态、遮挡变化），支持1:1验证与1:N闭集识别的大库评估，并在其上对比CNN、ViT与域自适应方法的可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可见光-热红外人脸识别基准的图库规模小（约100个受试者），难以在部署规模下准确评估性能，也无法给出具有实际应用意义的识别指标。

Method: 构建VTF900配对图像基准（900个受试者），覆盖表情、姿态与遮挡变化，支持大规模验证与闭集识别，并聚焦跨光谱与跨数据集分析；在ARL-VTF上训练后，评测卷积基线、ViT及域自适应网络（如DPIT-ResNet50）等架构的规模化表现。

Result: 全图库规模（N=900）下，Transformer在正面条件下判别性强（ViT-B：97.68% AUC，51.10% TAR@1%FAR）；域自适应方法在非正面姿态下更稳健（DPIT-ResNet50：94.68% AUC，36.08% TAR@1%FAR）。小规模下的高AUC无法迁移到部署规模，姿态变化显著放大性能下降。

Conclusion: VTF900揭示了现有跨光谱人脸识别系统在规模化与姿态变化下的局限，为更严格的评估提供基准。

Abstract: Despite advancements in visible-thermal face recognition, where thermal probe (query) face images are matched against visible enrollment templates, existing benchmarks are currently limited by small gallery sizes (N $\approx$ 100 subjects). This limitation inhibits the ability to accurately evaluate visible-thermal facial recognition at scale and to report significant recognition performance metrics, which have better operational relevance. Therefore, we introduce VTF900, a large-scale visible-thermal face recognition benchmark with 900 subjects and paired imagery that includes expression, pose, and occlusion variations. VTF900 is designed to support large-scale (i.e., large gallery) evaluations across verification (1:1 matching) and closed-set identification (1:N matching) for visible-thermal face recognition. Furthermore, VTF900 specifically addresses the challenging combination of cross-spectral and cross-dataset analysis. In this paper, after training models on the ARL-VTF dataset, we provide benchmark analyses across convolutional (baseline), vision transformers, and domain-adaptive neural network architectures to assess how these methods scale. At full gallery scale (N = 900), transformer models achieve strong discriminative performance under frontal conditions (e.g., ViT-B: 97.68% AUC, 51.10% TAR@1%FAR), while domain-adaptive methods such as DPIT-ResNet50 demonstrate greater robustness under off-pose conditions (94.68%AUC, 36.08% TAR@1%FAR). Our results show that high AUC at small scale does not translate to reliable performance at deployment scale, and that pose variation significantly amplifies performance degradation. VTF900 exposes these limitations, enabling more rigorous evaluation of cross-spectral face recognition systems.

</details>


### [110] [PCHMR: Empowering and Benchmarking Human Mesh Recovery in Privacy-Constrained Real-World Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24841)
*Zeyu Cao,Qingxuan Wu,Zhiyang Dou,Rui Xu,Yuan Liu,Javier Fernandez-Marques,Nicholas D. Lane,Taku Komura,Wenping Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文构建隐私约束下的联邦人类网格恢复（HMR）基准，并用深度基础模型辅助的本地标注微调管线 DePoser 研究数据瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 HMR 模型在用户端微调需将含敏感人物图像的用户数据汇聚到中心服务器，存在严重隐私风险；需回答在隐私受限的真实场景下如何评估与改进 HMR。

Method: 在基准中用联邦学习及其安全聚合变体训练 SOTA HMR 模型（均不集中原始图像），覆盖多种客户端规模与数据异构设置，量化主流 HMR 骨干在去除集中式数据假设后的表现；并提出 DePoser——结合深度基础模型的本地标注与微调管线。

Result: 揭示常见 HMR 训练流程依赖集中式数据访问；在野外数据上，基于 DePoser 标注微调可提升个性化精度（以 DePoser 生成的伪真值衡量）。

Conclusion: 该基准为隐私受限 HMR 模型及其实地部署与评估提供支持，并展示了本地标注微调缓解数据瓶颈的潜力。

Abstract: Fine-tuning directly on user-side data is an effective way to improve the performance of widely adopted data-driven human mesh recovery (HMR) models. However, doing so for existing HMR methods often assumes aggregating user-side data from real-world HMR-deployed devices to a central training server, posing a significant privacy risk as sensitive human images are transmitted. How can human mesh recovery be evaluated and improved in privacy-constrained real-world settings? We study this question through a benchmark in which state-of-the-art HMR models are trained with federated learning and a secure-aggregation variant, neither of which centralizes raw images, and evaluated across a wide range of client-scale and data-heterogeneity settings. We document that common HMR training pipelines are built around centralized data access and quantify how representative HMR backbones behave when that assumption is removed. Furthermore, to study the data bottleneck of privacy-constrained HMR training, we propose DePoser, a local annotation and fine-tuning pipeline enhanced with depth foundation models, with which collaboratively trained HMR models can be locally tailored to the end user's distribution. On in-the-wild data, fine-tuning on DePoser annotations improves personalization accuracy, measured against DePoser-generated pseudo-ground truth. This benchmark aims to support future work on privacy-constrained HMR models and their real-world deployment and evaluation.
