The assessed capabilities include generating large quantities, performing deep reasoning, ensuring hard physical consistency, following complex rules and so on. The prompts are designed such that prompt alignment is visually verifiable (e.g., counting) instead of relying on subjectiveness (e.g., style). Based on this, we develop an automated evaluation framework which decomposes the prompt into easy and hard questions, and for most hard questions, draws help lines to ground evidence for accurate grading. We evaluate 20+ strong text-to-image models, including Nano Banana Pro, GPT-Image-2.5, Seedream-5.0 and so on. We report that even the best-performing T2I model (Nano Banana Pro) only achieves a strict score of 23.9 out of 100 and that coding models such as GPT-6 Astra have higher prompt alignment scores (but not as visually pleasing). We also derive insights in model evolution, alignment with Elo scores, and effectiveness of our grounding-based evaluation protocol. Code is available at https://github.com/GenOlympiad/GenOlympiad and the project page is at https://genolympiad.github.io/

</details>


### [285] [Manga2Animate: An Agentic Framework for Faithful Manga Animation with Script and Storyboard Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26851)
*Sheng-Wei Zhang,Hsi-An Chen,Yan-Ting Liou,Chih-Hsuan Chen,Shih-Chen Tseng,Yu-Lun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出多智能体框架 Manga2Animate，将漫画改编动画分解为剧本与分镜两种中间表示，并由创建代理与评审代理基于原漫画面板迭代精化，生成更忠实、跨镜头更一致的动画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有漫画改编动画方法存在两类缺陷：一类主要依赖文本获取漫画信息，丢失角色形象与画风；另一类直接将漫画页输入视频生成模型，误读漫画结构，导致剧情错误。目标是在保持忠实原著的前提下生成连贯动画。

Method: 多智能体框架，每个生成阶段均以原漫画为依据。任务分解为两个中间表示：动画剧本（animation script）与视觉分镜（visual storyboard）。每种表示由对应的 creator agent 生成，并由配对的 reviewer agent 对照原漫画面板进行审核；引入表示特定的选择机制与双层反馈（dual-level feedback），在合成最终动画前逐步精化两种表示。

Result: 大量实验与用户研究表明，Manga2Animate 相比最先进方法生成的动画更忠实于原漫画，且镜头间一致性更高。

Conclusion: 以原漫画为锚点的多智能体分解与审校式精化流程能有效提升漫画改编动画的忠实度与跨镜头一致性，为漫画到动画的生成提供了可行的结构化方案。

Abstract: Adapting existing manga into coherent animation that stays faithful to the source is a valuable yet challenging task. Existing methods either access the manga mainly through text, losing its characters and art style, or feed manga pages directly into video generation models, which misinterpret the manga's structure and produce incorrect storylines. In this paper, we propose Manga2Animate, a multi-agent framework that grounds every stage of generation in the source manga. We decompose the task into two intermediate representations, an animation script and a visual storyboard. Each representation is produced by a creator agent and reviewed against the source panels by a paired reviewer agent. We tailor representation-specific selection and dual-level feedback to progressively refine both before synthesizing the final animation. Extensive experiments and a user study demonstrate that Manga2Animate produces animations more faithful to the source manga and more consistent across shots than state-of-the-art approaches. Project page: https://annchenn.github.io/Manga2Animate/

</details>


### [286] [InfiniDream: Open-Ended Photorealistic 3D Worlds Through Procedural Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26853)
*Yi-Chuan Huang,Hao-Jen Chien,Zheng-Hui Huang,Yu-Lun Liu,Kaipeng Zhang,Zhixiang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: InfiniDream 提出一个 VLM 驱动的开放式程序化 3D 世界生成框架，通过符号约束资产生成复用现有程序化算法生成新颖可编辑资产，并结合语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格放置实现文本到大规模 3D 世界的端到端生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 程序化生成在可控性、可编辑性与多样性上优于静态网格，但 VLM 代码生成产的 3D 资产较为简单，高质量程序化系统需大量人工开发；现有 VLM 引导方法受限于预定义工厂与 API，难以创造新资产类型。

Method: 包含两部分：(1) 符号约束资产生成（Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation），借助已有程序化算法生成新颖、照片级真实且可编辑、具备种子多样性的资产；(2) 端到端文本到世界管线，将语义场景规划与确定性视锥引导网格放置（Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement）结合，实现精确物体放置、程序化填充与动画的大规模 3D 世界构建。

Result: 在 100 个物体生成与 20 个场景生成任务上评测，四项感知指标均有提升；多样性分析、消融实验与人类偏好评估进一步验证框架有效性。

Conclusion: InfiniDream 突破了预定义 API 的限制，实现开放式、可编辑、多样化的程序化 3D 资产与世界生成，为 VLM 驱动的程序化内容生成提供可行路径。

Abstract: Procedural generation plays a key role in synthetic data creation and game development, offering greater controllability, editability, and diversity than static mesh representations. However, VLM-based code generation often produces relatively simple 3D assets, while sophisticated photorealistic procedural systems require extensive manual development. Existing VLM-guided procedural methods remain largely constrained by predefined factories and APIs, limiting their ability to create novel asset types. We introduce InfiniDream, a VLM-driven framework for open-ended procedural 3D world generation. First, we propose Symbolically Constrained Asset Generation, which leverages existing procedural algorithms to create novel, photorealistic assets while preserving editability and seed-based diversity. Second, we develop an end-to-end text-to-world pipeline that combines semantic scene planning with Deterministic Frustum-Guided Grid Placement to construct large-scale 3D worlds with precise object placement, procedural population, and animation. Extensive evaluations on 100 object and 20 scene generation tasks demonstrate improvements across four perceptual metrics. Diversity analysis, ablation studies, and human preference evaluations further validate the effectiveness of our framework. Project page: https://yichuanh.github.io/infinidream-page/

</details>


### [287] [Ropedia W0: Scaling Loco-Manipulation World Models across Embodiments with Human Experience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26855)
*Tianqi Liu,Hanfei Zhao,Qifeng Liang,Hui En Pang,Jiarui Xu,Sayang Mu,Penghao Qiu,YingSheng Zhang,Jun Wang,Ziang Cao,Mingze Sun,Yukang Cao,Fangzhou Hong,Zhaoxi Chen,Ziwei Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Ropedia W0——首个跨越人类与多种机器人形态的自我中心“移动-操作”（loco-manipulation）世界基础模型，配套 Xp-Data 数据与 Xp-Teleop 基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型难以同时建模移动与操作，且受异构动作空间与多模态监督不足所限，缺乏跨形态（人类与机器人）统一建模的能力。

Method: 构建含1万小时人类自我中心数据与3千小时机器人数据的 Xp-Data，统一多模态标注与质量控制；提出统一运动学表示：以相机位姿编码移动、以投影骨架编码操作，机器人骨架由形态相关正运动学结合大量人工关键点标注与校正得到；并发布基于高质量灵巧人形遥操作数据的长时程基准 Xp-Teleop。

Result: 在五个跨形态基准（DreamDojo、Ψ0、ω-HOME、Xp-Teleop、AgiBot）及留出的人类自我中心视频上取得 SOTA，覆盖零样本推断、少样本与全量后训练；扩大人类预训练数据同时提升人类与机器人评测表现；蒸馏后支持实时、分钟级长时程 rollout，可实现 VR 实时交互。

Conclusion: 该模型在策略评估、基于模型的规划与世界-动作建模等应用中展现价值，验证了跨形态统一世界模型对具身决策的实用性。

Abstract: World models enable embodied agents to anticipate action consequences, yet jointly modeling locomotion and manipulation across diverse embodiments remains challenging due to heterogeneous action spaces and limited multimodal supervision. We present Ropedia W0, the first egocentric loco-manipulation world foundation model spanning humans and robots with diverse embodiments. We curate Xp-Data, comprising 10k hours of egocentric human data and 3k hours of robot data with unified multimodal annotations and systematic quality control. A unified kinematic representation encodes locomotion through camera poses and manipulation through projected skeletons, with robot skeletons combining embodiment-specific forward kinematics with extensive manual keypoint annotation and correction. We also introduce Xp-Teleop, a long-horizon loco-manipulation benchmark based on high-quality dexterous humanoid teleoperation data. Evaluations demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across five cross-embodiment benchmarks (DreamDojo, $Ψ_0$, $ω$-HOME, Xp-Teleop, and AgiBot) and on held-out human egocentric video, from zero-shot inference to few-shot and full-data post-training. Scaling human pre-training data improves performance on both human and robot evaluations. After distillation, our model supports real-time, minute-long rollouts, enabling live VR interaction. Applications in policy evaluation, model-based planning, and world-action modeling further demonstrate the model's utility for embodied decision-making.

</details>


### [288] [Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26856)
*Shiao Xie,Siyu Chen,Jianwei Lv,Xiandong Li,Yujin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出“特权修正污染”问题，并首创视觉可归因的在线策略自蒸馏范式，用视觉归因门控（VAG）实现证据一致的token级监督。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态RLVR只提供任务级监督，难以定位视觉推理中的错误token；OPSD虽提供稠密token级修正，但其修正可能混入语言先验、回答风格或特权视图本身带来的非视觉偏移，直接蒸馏会强化错误更新。

Method: 形式化定义特权修正污染：当某token级修正的更新方向无法一致归因于特权视觉证据时即为污染。提出VAG：以验证器导出的优势作为优化锚，通过对比“有证据”与“证据退化”两种教师视图，检验每个特权修正的方向一致性，仅接纳被视觉对比方向性支持的修正，抑制不一致残差。

Result: 在六个视觉推理基准上，VAG一致优于GRPO与OPSD类方法，取得新的平均性能SOTA。

Conclusion: 将任务级RLVR与经视觉证据校验的token级特权修正结合，可在保留视觉接地指导的同时过滤污染信号，验证了证据一致性门控对多模态强化学习监督细化的有效性。

Abstract: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

</details>


### [289] [VideoMaMa++: Temporally Consistent Video Matting via Preserve-and-Refine Token](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26857)
*Sangbeom Lim,Seoung Wug Oh,Heeji Yoon,Seungryong Kim,Joon-Young Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出掩码引导的视频扩散抠像框架：RGB与掩码双token流+全时空自注意力，并用preserve/refine可学习token实现滑窗推理，跨chunk边界保持一致并抑制长视频误差累积。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散式视频抠像受限于算力只能处理6–24帧的短chunk，普通视频需分多个chunk独立处理；各chunk仅依赖粗掩码引导，导致边界处闪烁、透明度不连续，缺乏跨chunk时序一致性。

Method: 1) RGB与掩码条件作为独立token流，通过完整时空自注意力交互，自适应融合精细RGB纹理与粗掩码布局，替代固定通道拼接融合；2) 引入一对可学习嵌入preserve token与refine token作为逐帧条件接口，支持滑窗推理，使已生成的alpha matte跨chunk传播以获得局部时序一致性；3) 每个chunk额外引入全局共享参考锚点，防止长序列误差累积，无需额外训练。

Result: 在标准视频抠像基准与真实长视频上，细粒度精度与时序一致性均优于既有扩散式方法，并在长视频上唯一实现跨chunk边界的一致性保持。

Conclusion: 通过token流解耦条件融合与滑窗式matte传播机制，可在不增加训练成本的前提下突破扩散骨干的chunk长度限制，实现长视频一致的高质量抠像。

Abstract: Diffusion-based video matting has recently emerged as a leading approach, leveraging video diffusion priors from internet-scale pretraining to achieve strong zero-shot generalization from limited synthetic data. However, the heavy compute of these diffusion backbones limits inference to a short chunk of just 6 to 24 frames, so even ordinary videos span multiple chunks. Because each chunk is matted independently from coarse mask guidance, existing methods fail to maintain consistency across chunk boundaries, producing flickering edges and discontinuous transparency. We address this with a mask-guided diffusion-matting framework built on two ideas. The RGB and mask conditioning are represented as separate token streams that interact through full spatio-temporal self-attention, letting the model adaptively combine fine RGB texture with coarse mask layout rather than committing to a fixed channel-wise fusion. On top of this, we propose a novel pair of learnable embeddings, the preserve token and the refine token, that act as a per-frame conditioning interface and enable a sliding-window inference scheme in which already-generated mattes are propagated across chunk boundaries for local temporal consistency, complemented by a globally shared reference anchor at every chunk to prevent error accumulation in long sequences without any additional training. Across standard video matting benchmarks and in-the-wild long footage, our framework outperforms prior diffusion-based methods in both fine-detail accuracy and temporal consistency, and uniquely maintains consistency across chunk boundaries on long videos.

</details>


<div id='cs.CL'></div>

# cs.CL [[Back]](#toc)

### [290] [Modeling Human Behavior in the Prisoner's Dilemma with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23860)
*Raina Gao,Tristan Raffo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究用5个开源LLM在有无记忆、对手固定或打乱的重复囚徒困境中模拟人类合作行为，结果显示所有模型均偏离人类合作率，普遍过度合作，说明开源LLM尚不能可靠替代人类被试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 囚徒困境是研究合作行为的经典框架，但人类行为常偏离完全理性预测；已有LLM研究至少缺失记忆机制、开源模型可访问性或与实证人类数据对比三者之一，本研究弥补这一空白。

Method: 采用标准化提示框架，选取TII Falcon 7B Instruct、Google Gemma 7B、Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct、Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct、Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct五个开源模型，设置两类试次：固定对手（双方均有记忆）与打乱对手（有记忆且被告知对手每轮更换的智能体与无记忆智能体交互）；统计100轮及每10轮增量的合作率，并与Montero-Porras等(2022)的人类数据对比。

Result: 两种框架下所有LLM的合作率均与人类不同；开源模型总体过度合作，打乱对手情境尤为明显（人类平均合作率28.5%，部分模型超过80%）；Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct表现出确定性倾向，Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct波动更大并曾短暂接近人类水平。

Conclusion: LLM具备作为行为模拟代理的潜力，并提供了两种交互环境下的基准，但当前开源模型尚不能可靠替代人类被试。

Abstract: The Prisoner's Dilemma has long served as a foundational framework for studying human decision-making and cooperative outcomes across social scenarios, yet human behavior consistently deviates from predictions of fully rational economic theory. Previous works have studied human and LLM outcomes in the Prisoner's Dilemma; however, these studies have lacked at least one key feature: a memory component for LLM agents, accessible open-source models, or comparison against empirical human data. This project investigates whether open-source LLMs, TII Falcon 7B Instruct, Google Gemma 7B, Meta Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, Microsoft Phi Mini MoE Instruct, and Qwen 2.5 7B Instruct, can model human cooperation patterns in repeated Prisoner's Dilemma games, while examining how an LLM's knowledge that its opponent will be shuffled affects its decisions. Using a standardized prompting framework, we simulated interactions in two trial types: a fixed-partner setting where both agents retain memory, and a shuffled-partner setting where a memory-enabled agent, informed that its opponent changes across rounds, interacts with a memoryless agent. For each trial, we measured cooperation rates over 100 rounds and 10-round increments and compared them to human data from Montero-Porras et al. (2022). Under both frameworks, all LLMs differed from the human cooperation rate. Open-source LLMs generally over-cooperated relative to humans, particularly in the shuffled framework, where human cooperation averaged 28.5% while several models exceeded 80%. Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct showed deterministic tendencies, while Phi-mini-MoE-Instruct displayed greater variability and briefly approximated human rates. These findings suggest that LLMs have potential as behavioral simulation agents and provide a benchmark across two interaction environments, although open-source models are not yet reliable substitutes for human participants.

</details>


### [291] [Composable Parametric Demographic Injection for Values Survey Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23867)
*Xinyuan Cao,Qingyi Pan,Bangde Du,Yujia Zhou,Hexi Wang,Weihang Su,Yiqun Liu,Yueyue Wu,Min Zhang,Qingyao Ai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: PARADE 提出用可复用、可组合的 LoRA 模块表示人口属性取值，实现 LLM 模拟受访者的细粒度人口分布对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 被用作计算社会科学中的模拟受访者，但难以准确复现特定人群的异质回答分布。人口提示法对提示设计敏感且增加推理开销；参数化方法难以高效复用人口信息，泛化到未见属性组合受限。

Method: 将任务通用问卷能力与人口特定取值偏移解耦：共享 Task LoRA + 属性级 Demographic LoRA，每个属性取值对应一个可复用可组合的 LoRA 模块，并引入组合校准以缓解参数干扰；推理时按需重组模块构建目标人群模型。

Result: 在 World Values Survey 与 SocioBench、三个骨干模型上的实验表明，PARADE 在保持有竞争力预测性能的同时实现较强的人群级分布对齐，相较最强基线 KL 散度最多降低 52.8%。

Conclusion: 模块化参数注入可高效编码并泛化人口属性信息，支持未见组合的人群建模，为计算社会科学中的 LLM 模拟受访者提供可组合方案。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as simulated respondents in computational social science, yet accurately reproducing population-specific heterogeneous response distributions remains challenging. Existing methods such as demographic prompting are sensitive to prompt design and increase inference overhead, while parameter-based methods struggle to reuse demographic information efficiently, limiting generalization to unseen combinations. In this regard, we propose PARADE, a composable PARAmetric DEmographic injection framework that represents each demographic attribute value with a reusable and composable LoRA module. Specifically, PARADE separates task-common survey capability from demographic-specific value shifts via a shared Task LoRA and attribute-level Demographic LoRAs, with composition calibration to reduce parameter interference. At inference time, target population models can be constructed on demand by recombining the relevant modules, including demographic combinations not observed during training. Extensive experiments on the World Values Survey and SocioBench across three backbone models show that PARADE achieves strong population-level distribution alignment while maintaining competitive predictive performance, reducing KL divergence by up to 52.8% relative to the strongest baseline.

</details>


### [292] [Translating in style: An open-weight alternative to GPT-4 for culturally aligned machine translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23868)
*Thomas Rietman,Hadi Mohammadi,Robert A. Bagheri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文检验开源翻译专用模型Hunyuan-MT-7B能否替代RASTA框架中的GPT-4，发现其整体未达GPT-4水平，但差距集中于正式度维度，在亲密度和中文方向已具竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器翻译常保留语义却抹平语言风格，在译入非西方语言时尤为严重。现有RASTA框架通过检索增强实现风格对齐，但依赖GPT-4这一闭源专有模型，限制了可及性与可复现性，因此需探究开源权重的翻译专用模型能否作为替代方案。

Method: 以Hunyuan-MT-7B为基础，构建三个变体：基座模型、LoRA监督微调模型、GRPO策略引导模型；在正式度、礼貌度、亲密度三个风格维度与十二个有向语言对上评测，采用基于相关性的指标𝒜衡量风格对齐程度。

Result: 微调未能可靠提升风格对齐，三个变体在总体统计上无显著差异。开源骨干整体不及RASTA-GPT-4，但差距主要集中在正式度维度；在亲密度和中文翻译方向上差距基本消失，开源模型在部分单个语言对上持平或超过GPT-4。

Conclusion: 基于开源模型构建的可及性RASTA流程在部分子问题上已具备可行性，为摆脱闭源依赖提供了实证依据，但正式度等维度仍是短板。

Abstract: Machine translation systems often preserve meaning but systematically flatten linguistic style, a failure that is most acute when translating into non-Western languages. The RASTA framework of Havaldar et al. (2025a) addresses this through retrieval-augmented stylistic alignment, but relies on GPT-4, a closed, proprietary model. We investigate whether an open-weight translation specialist, Hunyuan-MT-7B, can serve as an open-weight alternative. We evaluate three variants of the model, the base model, a LoRA supervised fine-tune, and a GRPO-steered policy. We do this across three style dimensions (formality, politeness, and intimacy) and twelve directed language pairs, measuring style alignment with the correlation-based metric $\mathcal{A}$. We find that fine-tuning does not reliably improve alignment: the three variants are statistically indistinguishable in aggregate. The open backbone does not match RASTA-GPT-4 overall, but the shortfall is concentrated in formality and largely closes for intimacy and Chinese directions, where the open model matches or surpasses GPT-4 on individual pairs. An accessible RASTA pipeline built on an open model is thus already viable for parts of the problem.

</details>


### [293] [The Window Is in the Reasoning: When LLM Agents Decide to Follow Prompt Injections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24048)
*Haoxuan Jia,Yang Liu,Bin Chong,Yingguang Yang,Yancheng Chen,Jiayu Liang,Qian Li,Hanning Lu,Kefu Xu,Hao Zheng,Chongyang Zhang,Yulin Huang,Jianshen Zhang,Yongzhi Qi,Yunuo Lin,Hao Peng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文用分支式多次采样（branching rollouts）检验"智能体是否遵循注入在读取注入时即已定论"这一假设，发现该结论只在部分模型/配置下成立，且推理（thinking）会把相当一部分结果方差后移到读取之后。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 运行时监控器（在智能体行动前拦截劫持）与"每任务单次运行打分"的基准测试，共同依赖一个未经检验的假设：智能体是否遵循提示注入，在它读到注入的那一刻就已确定。作者要检验该假设是否成立，以及"读取时已确定的比例"是否随模型与推理配置变化。

Method: 分支式 rollout：将一条轨迹精确重放到智能体读到注入的那一步，然后对该步之后的部分多次重采样，从而把结果方差分解为"读取时已固定（状态间方差）"与"读取后才决定（状态内方差）"两部分；在 AgentDojo 四个套件上测试，比较 Qwen3（关闭/开启 thinking），跨三种攻击模板、两种成功判定标签；并从推理前缀重采样以考察决策形成过程；同时评测零样本 CoT 监控器与"前瞻式"监控器（判断模拟的下一步动作）。

Result: Qwen3 关闭 thinking 时结果基本在读取时已定（0.91 的方差位于状态之间）；开启 thinking 后该比例降至 0.62（下降的 95% CI 为 [-0.38, -0.22]），且三种攻击模板、两种成功标签方向一致。thinking 对攻击成功率的影响因模型而异：降低 Qwen3 的 ASR，却提高另外两个模型的 ASR。从推理前缀重采样显示决策随推理逐步形成。基于较弱模型的零样本 CoT 监控器漏掉了大量"早已决定"的部分，较强监控器与前瞻式监控器则接近前缀所能确定的上限。

Conclusion: "读取时固定的比例"是模型本身的属性，可由同一测量揭示；thinking 使结果在注入读取后仍有显著可塑性，因此监控器设计需考虑决策形成的时间结构。此外，thinking 智能体的单次运行标签与重跑结果的差异最高达 35%，基准测试需对每任务重复多次运行。

Abstract: LLM agents that read untrusted content can be hijacked by prompt injections. Runtime monitors that try to catch a hijack before the agent acts, and benchmarks that score each task with a single run, share an assumption: whether an agent follows an injection is settled when the injection is read. We test this assumption with branching rollouts that replay an episode exactly up to the step at which the agent reads an injection and then resample the rest of the episode many times, splitting the outcome variance into a part fixed at read time and a part decided afterwards. Across four AgentDojo suites, a Qwen3 agent without thinking is largely decided at read time (0.91 of the outcome variance lies between states); with thinking on, this share drops to 0.62 (95% CI of the drop [-0.38, -0.22]), in the same direction for three attack templates and two success labels. How much is fixed at read time is a property of the model that the same measurement reveals, and thinking lowers the attack success rate of Qwen3 but raises it for two other models. Resampling from reasoning prefixes shows that the decision forms gradually as the agent reasons. Zero-shot chain-of-thought monitors built on cheaper models miss much of what is already decided, whereas stronger monitors, and a lookahead monitor that judges simulated next actions, come close to what the prefix determines. Finally, single-run labels of thinking agents disagree with a rerun up to 35% of the time, so benchmarks need repeated runs per task.

</details>


### [294] [Discuss More, Comment Less: Boosting Automated Research via Multi-Perspective Collaborative Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24050)
*Junkai Zhou,Jiajia Wu,Zhaoyi Zhang,Shiting Guan,Chuanguang Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将论文评审建模为同行评审机制的计算模型，提出圆桌评审（RoundtableReview）多智能体审议框架，提升自动研究流程中的论文质量与评审可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动写作日趋普及，自动评审成为论文生成与质量控制的关键环节；但现有方法依赖单模型反馈或简单聚合，未显式建模真实同行评审中的专家责任分工与集体审议，导致交叉质询不足、决策可靠性受限。

Method: 把论文结构化为八个语义槽位；协调六位学术与产业界审稿人，赋予互补视角、检索来源与专门职责；流程包括独立评估、交叉质询、圆桌审议、动态加权投票与主席综合，产出有据可溯的反馈。

Result: 在两个自动研究骨干模型上实验，论文质量均获提升；在自动评测与人工评测中优于基线，且所需评语数量更少。

Conclusion: 显式建模审稿分工与集体审议的多智能体机制可有效改善自动评审的交叉检验能力与决策可靠性，为自动研究闭环的质量控制提供可行范式。

Abstract: As automated research is increasingly adopted for writing papers, automated review has become a critical link between paper generation and quality control. However, existing methods largely rely on single-model feedback or simple review aggregation, failing to explicitly model expert responsibilities or collective deliberation in actual peer reviews, which limits effective cross-examination and reliable decision-making. Therefore, we formulate paper review as a computational modeling problem of peer review mechanisms and propose RoundtableReview, a deliberative multi-agent framework for enhancing automated research. RoundtableReview structures each paper into eight semantic slots and coordinates six academic and industry reviewers with complementary perspectives, retrieval sources, and specialized responsibilities. Through independent assessment, cross-examination, roundtable deliberation, dynamically weighted voting, and chair synthesis, the framework generates evidence-based and traceable feedback. Experiments on two automated research backbones show that the method improves paper quality in both backbones and outperforms baselines in automatic and human evaluations with fewer comments.

</details>


### [295] [OR-License: Evaluating LLM Agents as Real-World Operations Research Practitioners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24087)
*Peisong Wang,Feixue Liu,Yize Meng,Bowen Liu,Ruoyu Chen,Gaoyang Dai,Xing He,Aiqian Li,Fengchi Yuan,Aochuan Chen,Chenyi Zi,Yuhan Li,Hongchuan Zeng,Yimo Yan,Nuo Chen,Jie Fu,Zuo-Jun Max Shen,Yong-Hong KUO,Jia Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出端到端基准 OR-License（31 个真实的付费运筹咨询任务，总金额 368 万美元）与客户模拟器 ORSim，衡量 LLM 智能体能否直接从原始客户材料产出专家级运筹方案；最强配置严格可行率 88.39%、DAQ 0.87（专家为 1.00），无一模型追平专家整体质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运筹基准多以自洽描述或预定义优化任务为起点，回避了"原始商业材料→专业可交付方案"的翻译过程，无法反映真实咨询场景的能力要求。作者希望回答：LLM 智能体能否在没有专家预先建模的情况下，直接从原始客户材料交付专家级运筹方案。

Method: 构建 OR-License 端到端基准：10 个工业场景、31 个实例，源自总价 368 万美元的付费运筹项目，去标识化后保留原始需求、输入数据、交付格式与信息边界。引入 ORSim 受控客户模拟器，仅披露业务事实而不提供运筹专业知识，用于研究信息获取过程。隐藏评测校验可行性，并与基准构建前已被客户接受的原始专家解比较目标质量。提出 DAQ（Deployment-Adjusted Quality）指标，跨实例平均专家相对质量，不可行交付记 0。评测 11 个前沿 LLM（配编码智能体框架）。

Result: 若干模型在条件目标质量上超过专家参考解，但无一在 DAQ 上追平专家（参考值 1）。最强主配置 Claude Code 达 88.39% 严格可行率、DAQ 0.87。客户信息获取的需求超越"澄清"，延伸至方案开发与验证阶段，且部分后段环节的确认问题解决比例更高。轨迹分析定位到建模（formulation）与实现（implementation）两类失败；在可评估任务上，按任务均衡的研究链完成率仅 24%–45%。

Conclusion: 可靠的长程智能体需要持续消解信息缺口、忠实的问题建模，以及有证据链的自我改进；可行性缺口而非单纯解质量是当前主要瓶颈。

Abstract: Can large language model (LLM) agents deliver expert-level operations research (OR) solutions directly from original client materials, without prior expert reformulation? Existing OR benchmarks typically begin with self-contained descriptions or predefined optimization tasks, underrepresenting the translation of original business materials into professionally validated solutions. We introduce OR-License, an end-to-end benchmark of 31 instances across 10 industrial scenarios from paid OR engagements totaling USD 3.68 million. It preserves original requirements, input data, deliverable formats, and information boundaries after de-identification. To study information acquisition, we introduce ORSim, a controlled client simulator that discloses business facts without supplying OR expertise. Hidden evaluation checks feasibility and compares objective quality against original expert solutions accepted by clients before benchmark construction. Deployment-Adjusted Quality (DAQ) averages expert-relative quality across instances, assigning zero to infeasible deliveries. Across 11 frontier LLMs using coding-agent harnesses, several exceed the expert reference in conditional objective quality, but none matches its DAQ; the strongest primary Claude Code configuration achieves 88.39% strict feasibility and a DAQ of 0.87 against the expert reference of 1. Client information acquisition extends beyond clarification into solution development and validation, with some later stages showing higher confirmed issue-resolution proportions. Trajectory analysis identifies formulation and implementation failures, while task-equalized research-chain completion rates range from 24% to 45% across models on evaluable tasks. These findings motivate sustained information-gap resolution, faithful problem formulation, and evidence-linked self-improvement for reliable long-horizon agents.

</details>


### [296] [Do LMs Know What Variables Do? Interpreting Code Representations via Variable Roles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24118)
*Célian Vasson,Daniil Ognev,Kentaro Inui,Benjamin Heinzerling*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文用Sajaniemi变量角色分类学，定义了11种角色的静态标注规则并构建126,926个五语言代码文件语料，系统检验大模型能否恢复变量角色区分、SAE如何保留这些区分、以及相关方向能否用于生成控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变量角色（累积、遍历、保留最优候选等）是代码中反复出现的行为模式，但尚不清楚大模型内部是否编码了这类区分、稀疏自编码器（SAE）是否保留它们，以及这些方向是否可用于可控生成。作者希望用一个独立定义的角色分类学建立可测量的基准。

Method: 基于Sajaniemi独立定义的11种变量角色分类学，制定静态标注规则；构建跨五种语言、126,926个自然代码文件的语料；在五个模型-SAE系统上比较残差探针、单个SAE特征、词法基线和SAE特征组合；通过中性目标重命名、LLM审阅的角色改变性源码编辑、配对排序与固定阈值假阳性分析，以及生成时干预（含测试通过与否）来分别评估可恢复性、SAE保真度与保正确性控制。

Result: 残差探针优于单个SAE特征和词法基线，中性重命名后仅有适度性能下降；组合SAE特征可弥补大部分单特征差距，但在SAE重构上的探针面对LLM审阅的角色改变性编辑更不敏感；配对排序准确率高，但固定阈值下假阳性频繁；生成干预常改变角色标注却损害正确性，在通过测试的改动中相对随机对照无显著总体优势。

Conclusion: 该基准将角色相关可恢复性、SAE保真度与保正确性控制三者分离评估，表明角色信息可从模型与SAE中部分恢复，但可靠且不损害正确性的生成控制仍未被证实。

Abstract: Variable roles describe recurring behaviors such as accumulation, traversal, and retaining the best candidate encountered. We use Sajaniemi's independently defined taxonomy to study which role distinctions can be recovered from large language models, how sparse autoencoders (SAEs) retain those distinctions, and whether associated directions support control of generation. We introduce static annotation rules for all eleven roles and a corpus of 126,926 natural-code files across five languages. Across five model-SAE systems, residual probes outperform individual SAE features and tested lexical baselines, with modest losses after neutral target renaming. Combining SAE features closes much of the single-feature gap, but probes on SAE reconstructions are less sensitive to role-changing edits reviewed by LLMs. High paired ranking accuracy coexists with frequent false positives at fixed thresholds. During generation, interventions often change role annotations at the cost of correctness; changes accompanied by passing tests show no clear aggregate advantage over random controls. The benchmark separates role-related recoverability, SAE fidelity, and correctness-preserving control through matched prediction, source edits, and generation interventions.

</details>


### [297] [Prefix-Tuning for Arbitrary Output Sequences on Pretrained Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24123)
*Peter Cho-Ho Lam,Ziyi Wang,Zirui Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文从理论上完整回答了 prefix-tuning 的表达能力问题：对任意输入输出对 (x,y)，当且仅当 y 位于预训练 Transformer 的值域内时，存在前缀 S 使模型在 S⊕x 后生成 y，且该前缀可通过求解多个线性方程组显式构造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prefix-tuning 在实践中有效，但其前缀表示的表达能力缺乏理论刻画，"是否存在前缀能引导模型生成任意目标输出"这一问题悬而未决。作者希望给出该问题的完整理论回答，并说明前缀可控性的边界条件。

Method: 将自回归 Transformer 的生成过程按 token 逐步展开，把"前缀诱导目标输出"的条件转化为对注意力与前馈层中前缀键值（KV）表示的约束；构造性地将问题归约为求解多个线性方程组，从而显式给出前缀 S 的解析构造。同时对模型架构仅作较一般的假设（不依赖具体层数或特定结构），并分析该可解性条件在何时失效。

Result: 证明了：若目标输出 y 处于预训练 Transformer 的值域（range）内，则满足条件的前缀 S 存在且可由线性方程组显式解出；反之，该假设是必要的——当 y 不在值域内时前缀可能不存在。由此得到对原问题的充要答案。在 GPT-2 与 Qwen3-4B 上的实验表明，所构造的前缀对模型输出具有强控制能力。

Conclusion: 前缀的可控表达力被精确刻画为"值域内可达"：prefix-tuning 的极限由预训练模型自身可达输出集合决定，而非前缀形式所限。研究方法为构造性、结论在较一般架构假设下成立，兼具理论完备性与实践可验证性。

Abstract: Prefix-tuning is a parameter-efficient fine-tuning method for large language models (LLMs) that steers model outputs by prepending task-specific prefix representations to the input sequence. Despite its practical success, the theoretical understanding of the expressiveness of prefixes remains incomplete. In particular, the following question remains open: Given a pretrained autoregressive Transformer, for any input-output sequence pair $(\mathtt{x},\mathtt{y})$, does there always exist a prefix $\mathcal{S}$ such that prepending $\mathcal{S}$ to $\mathtt{x}$ induces the model to generate the target output $\mathtt{y}$? In this work, we prove that under the assumption that $\mathtt{y}$ is in the range of the pretrained Transformer, such a prefix $\mathcal{S}$ exists and can be explicitly computed by solving multiple linear systems. We further show that this assumption is necessary, in the sense that such a prefix may not exist when the assumption fails, thereby providing a complete answer to the above question. Our analysis is constructive and the obtained theoretical results hold under fairly general assumptions on model architecture. Extensive experiments on GPT-2 and Qwen3-4B demonstrate that our algorithm produces prefixes with strong control over model outputs.

</details>


### [298] [Preservation and loss of algorithmic structure in experimental diffusion of joint-action norms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24150)
*Dhara Yu,Bill D. Thompson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过大规模实验性规范扩散与程序合成分析，发现社会互动规范的程序算法在传播早期会经历结构性简化，而互动修复机制可抵消这一压力，从而保留复杂算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 日常社会互动规范（共享空间、轮流、排队等）为大型社会提供结构化协作程序，但其隐含"联合计划"的底层算法如何在人群中扩散演化尚不清楚，尤其是结构复杂性所受的选择压力来源与机制。

Method: 在人类被试中开展大规模实验性社会规范扩散研究，借助程序合成技术刻画独立人群中参与者所发展的互动程序；追踪被继承程序的传递、简化与丢失，并检验不同规范变体携带者互动时的错配效应与互动修复机会的作用。

Result: 被继承的程序在传播中出现结构性简化，并在持有不同联合行动规范变体的参与者互动中被丢失；然而互动修复的机会抵消了这一选择压力，使复杂算法在错配情况下仍得以保留。

Conclusion: 互动性推理介导了程序性规范文化演化过程中对结构复杂性的选择压力，揭示了规范扩散中复杂性维持与退化的机制。

Abstract: Everyday norms of social interaction - e.g. norms of sharing space, taking turns, or queuing - are essential to large societies, offering structured procedures for common interactions. However, it remains unclear how the underlying algorithms of these implicit joint plans evolve as they diffuse through populations. Here we show that this process of diffusion can select against complex algorithms in the earliest stages. We conducted a large-scale study of experimental diffusion of novel social norms among human participants, leveraging advances in program synthesis to characterize the procedures people developed in independent populations. Inherited procedures became structurally simplified and lost during interactions between participants who inherited different variants of joint-action norms; however, opportunities for interactive repair offset this pressure, preserving complex algorithms despite misalignment. These results demonstrate that interactive reasoning mediates selective pressures on structural complexity during cultural evolution of procedural norms.

</details>


### [299] [CoDA: A Human-LM Collaborative Codebook Development Assistant for Domain-Specific Text Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24157)
*Jaspreet Ranjit,Swaminathan Chellappa,Augusto Rivas Costante,Chandan Manjunath,Laura Onasch-Vera,Hailey Winetrobe Nadel,Eric Rice,Swabha Swayamdipta*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CoDA是一个开源的人机协同"编码手册"(codebook)开发助手，通过让领域专家审阅模型错误预测并反馈来迭代生成标注指南，在两个真实场景中达到与专家手册相当的下游性能，将开发时间从数周缩短至两小时、所需人工标注样本减少5倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LM标注系统多聚焦下游分类性能，并默认已存在高质量标注指南（codebook）；而实际上，尤其对需要专家知识的概念，编码手册的构建耗时且困难。

Method: CoDA与领域专家协作迭代开发codebook：针对性地审阅语言模型的错误预测，并将专家反馈逐步融入演进中的编码手册。

Result: 在两个案例（从无家可归者个案管理记录中抽取健康指标；对社交媒体野生动物贩卖帖做情感分类）上，CoDA生成的codebook下游性能与专家codebook相当；开发时间从数周降至两小时，人工标注样本减少5倍。规模化应用后识别出2410条含健康讨论或转介的个案记录及10196条表达负面情绪的社交媒体帖子。

Conclusion: 通过加速编码手册开发，CoDA帮助从业者利用语言模型从非结构化文本中规模化提取领域洞察。

Abstract: We present CoDA, an open-source human-LM collaborative codebook development assistant that helps domain experts develop annotation guidelines for annotating new variables in unstructured text with language models. Existing language model annotation systems primarily focus on downstream classification performance, while assuming the availability of high-quality annotation guidelines, or codebooks. In practice, developing these codebooks is time-consuming and challenging, particularly for concepts that require expert knowledge. CoDA addresses this gap by collaborating with domain experts to iteratively develop codebooks through targeted review of incorrect language model predictions and incorporating expert feedback into the evolving codebook. We demonstrate CoDA on two real-world case studies: extracting health indicators from homelessness case management notes and classifying sentiment of wildlife trafficking posts on social media. Across both domains, CoDA produces codebooks that achieve downstream classification performance comparable to expert codebooks while reducing codebook development time from several weeks to two hours and requiring 5X fewer manually annotated examples. Applying CoDA to generate annotations at scale, we identified 2,410 case notes that contained health discussions or referrals and 10,196 social media posts expressing negative sentiment that may warrant investigation for potential wildlife trafficking. By accelerating codebook development, CoDA helps practitioners use language models to extract domain-specific insights from unstructured text at scale.

</details>


### [300] [Pronouncing Hard Words: Phoneme Adaptation of a Pretrained Conversational Text to Speech Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24164)
*Yashish M. Siriwardena,Dinesh K. Gnanasekaran,Tanmay Laud,Shinji Watanabe,Subhabrata Mukherjee,Shanil Puri*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将预训练对话式TTS模型通过音素可控性改造（ARPAbet词表扩展+音素增强SFT+免训练推理期声学偏置），在7500条临床药名发音评测上将严格正确率从54.6%提升至90.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式TTS（流式、上下文条件化）自然且富有表现力，但对罕见且词表快速增长的信任关键实体（如药名）发音缺乏显式控制；这些实体出现频率过低，任何预训练/中训练/后训练都难以覆盖。

Method: 在不进行预训练/中训练的前提下改造预训练对话式TTS：1）ARPAbet音素词表扩展；2）持续的、音素增强的有监督微调（SFT）；3）免训练的推理期声学偏置步骤。

Result: 在7500条临床药名发音评测上，Gemini严格判定的正确率由54.6%（无音素增强）提升至90.7%，在自动指标上优于所有对话式与无状态TTS基线；因训练各阶段均未见过药名，整个评测为域外，增益反映学到的发音能力而非记忆。盲测随机人评中，成人听者对本文模型84%片段判为正确，最强基线为82%，分层子集上置信区间重叠。在全部250对匹配片段上，Gemini与人类多数标签一致率84.8%（κ=0.57）。

Conclusion: 通过词表扩展、音素增强SFT与推理期声学偏置，可在零预/中训练条件下为对话式TTS赋予细粒度音素可控性，显著改善罕见实体的发音正确性；但自动指标的大幅提升与人类听感收益之间存在明显落差（84% vs 82%），提示评估协议与感知质量仍需进一步对齐。

Abstract: Voice agents built as cascaded automatic speech recognition (ASR)->large language model (LLM)-> text-to-speech (TTS) pipelines increasingly rely on conversational TTS: streaming, context conditioned models that adapt delivery to dialogue history. Such models are natural and expressive but offer little explicit control over how rare, trust-critical drug names are pronounced, because these entities are too infrequent, and their vocabulary too fast-growing, to be covered by any amount of pre-, mid-, or post-training. We retrofit phoneme controllability onto a pretrained conversational TTS model without any pre/mid-training, using an ARPAbet vocabulary exten-sion, continued phoneme-augmented supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and a training-free inference-time acoustic-biasing step. On a 7,500 clip clinical drug-pronunciation evaluation, our model raises strict Gemini-judged correctness from 54.6% (no phoneme augmentation) to 90.7%, outperforming every conversational and stateless TTS baseline on the automatic metric. Because no training stage sees a drug name, the entire evaluation is out-of-domain, so the gains reflect learned pronunciation rather than memorization. In a blinded, randomized human study, adult listeners judge 84% of our clips correct, versus 82% for the strongest baseline, with overlapping confidence intervals on a stratified subset. Across all 250 matched clips, Gemini agrees with the human majority on 84.8% of binary labels (k{appa}=0.57).

</details>


### [301] [Prosodic Structure as a Critical Component in Phonemic Language Modelling at BabyLM Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24172)
*Bill K. S. Ku,Janet B. Pierrehumbert*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在BabyLM规模下比较正字法基线与三个逐级丰富音系信息的音素流训练条件，发现带韵律边界标注的音素流在语义组织任务上表现最佳，且音素模型可与正字法基线竞争。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童在识字前即从连续、韵律结构化的语音中习得语言，而几乎所有语言模型都在正字法文本上训练。作者延续既往音素BabyLM训练工作，追问：提供婴儿所利用的韵律估计能否在BabyLM规模上提升音素语言建模。

Method: 以BERT MLM在10M与100M词两个规模上训练：一个正字法基线，外加构成"音系丰富度阶梯"的三个条件。为评估小数据情形下既有指标的生态效度，构建词汇判断任务与两个语义组织任务；并采用三音素音位配列控制与伪对数似然打分进行检验。

Result: 新词汇判断任务更好地区分词形相似度、词元熟悉度与词汇性；三音素配列控制与PLL打分显示这些分数反映的是音位配列熟悉度而非词性——所有模型在对抗性倒置条件下接近或低于随机水平，说明此类先前结果部分属人为假象。语义任务上，带韵律标注的音素流在两个规模下均给出最强的分类学组织；带边界结构的音素模型与正字法基线具竞争力。

Conclusion: 韵律结构是类比婴儿学习的小数据机制下音素语言建模的关键组成部分；既有基于音位配列的"词性"结论需谨慎重审。

Abstract: Human children learn language from continuous, prosodically structured speech long before they can read, yet almost all language models train on orthographic text. Building on previous phonemic BabyLM training (Goriely et al., 2024; arXiv:2410.22906), we ask whether supplying an estimate of the prosody infants exploit improves phonemic language modelling at BabyLM scale. We compare an orthographic baseline to three conditions forming a ladder of phonological richness. All conditions are trained as BERT MLMs at 10M and 100M words. Addressing the ecological validity of existing metrics in the small-data regime, we build a lexical decision task and two semantic organisation tasks. Our new lexical decision task offers improved insights into the distinction between wordlikeness, token familiarity, and lexicality as factors. Triphone phonotactic control and pseudo-log-likelihood scoring shows that these scores reflect phonotactic familiarity rather than wordhood: every model sits near or below chance on an adversarial inverted condition, revealing prior results of this kind as partly artefactual. On our new semantic tasks, a prosodically annotated phoneme stream gives the strongest taxonomic organisation at both the 10M and 100M word scales. Phonemic models with boundary structure are competitive with the orthographic baseline. These findings suggest that prosodic structure is a key component of phonemic language modelling in the small-data regime most analogous to infant learning.

</details>


### [302] [Multi-author style detection with stylistic embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24184)
*Man-Ling Sung,Chak Fai Li,Damianos Karakos,Fred Bernardin,Brian Ulicny*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文研究多作者写作风格变化检测，提出跨域迁移学习：用作者验证任务微调 Mistral-7B 嵌入，并与 DeBERTa 嵌入融合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标域内直接使用现成 LLM 或仅做域内监督微调，无法得到有效的风格特征，故需引入跨域迁移。

Method: 跨域迁移学习，基于为作者验证（authorship verification）微调的 LLM 嵌入；微调 Mistral-7B 嵌入模型，并与 PAN-25 多作者写作风格分析挑战中 SOTA 系统所用的 DeBERTa 对比，进一步将两种嵌入组合使用。

Result: DeBERTa 与 Mistral 在不同用户生成文本场景下各有优势；融合两种嵌入后风格变化检测效果进一步提升。

Conclusion: 跨域微调的 LLM 嵌入与 DeBERTa 具有互补性，嵌入融合可有效提升多作者风格变化检测性能。

Abstract: We investigate the use of Large Language Models (LLMs) in multi-author style change detection. Using off-the-shelf LLMs or supervised fine-tuning solely within the target domain fails to yield effective features; for this reason, we propose cross-domain transfer learning with LLM-based embeddings fine-tuned for authorship verification. We fine-tune Mistral-7B embedding model and compare it with DeBERTa, used in the state-of-the-art (SOTA) systems in PAN-25 multi-author writing style analysis challenge. Results show that DeBERTa and Mistral excel in different user-generated text scenarios. We exploit this diversity by combining both embeddings, leading to more effective style change detection.

</details>


### [303] [Reasoning with Context Management and External Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24187)
*Man-Ling Sung,William Hartmann,Jiangying Zhou*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: RCMEM通过外部记忆扩展推理模型的上下文管理，在不增加模型上下文负担的前提下保留推理所需信息，显著降低重复中间步骤的计算时间并提升复杂问题表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理模型依赖上下文内记忆维护推理过程状态，复杂问题需要更大上下文窗口与记忆容量；在无缓存情况下进行上下文管理容易丢弃对推理有用的信息。

Method: 提出RCMEM方法，在上下文管理之外增加外部记忆模块，用于存储额外信息，避免为推理模型加载额外上下文。

Result: 在需要反复计算中间步骤的问题上显著减少计算时间；在复杂问题上取得更优性能。实验覆盖若干数学问题，模型规模为0.4至25百万参数，并使用GPT-2。

Conclusion: 外部记忆是缓解上下文窗口压力、兼顾效率与性能的有效手段，但实验规模较小、任务局限于数学题，泛化能力有待进一步验证。

Abstract: Reasoning models maintain information about the status of their reasoning process through in-context memory. Complex problems require larger context windows and memory requirements. In this scenario, context management without caching risks discarding useful information for reasoning. We propose RCMEM, an approach that extends context management with an external memory to maintain additional information without burdening the reasoning model with additional context. RCMEM significantly reduces computation time on problems that require repeated computation of intermediate steps, while achieving better performance on complex problems. We demonstrate our approach on a few mathematics problems using model sizes ranging from 0.4 to 25 million parameters, and GPT-2.

</details>


### [304] [Language Models are Lazy Poets: Creative Mode Collapse at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24223)
*Jacob A. Matthews,Sil Hamilton*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在15种诗体、248个主题标签、16个开源模型上生成超110万首诗，发现LLM诗歌词汇与押韵能力充足但严重未被利用，表现为"懒惰诗人"式的模式坍缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对齐后的LLM虽能完成创作任务，但输出高度自我相似（模式坍缩）；针对特定文本体裁的大规模系统性调查仍然缺乏，诗歌领域尤其空白。

Method: 构建大规模生成实验：覆盖15种诗歌形式、248个主题标签与16个开源权重模型，共生成超过110万首诗，形成迄今最大的LLM生成诗歌语料库；在此基础上分析词汇多样性、开篇短语与押韵的使用分布，并跨模型、跨诗体比较词汇同质化程度及押韵词表与模型规模的关系。

Result: 在百万级规模下，LLM的诗歌词汇量与押韵能力相当可观，但严重未被充分利用：模型过度依赖少量词汇、开篇短语和韵脚。词汇同质化在不同模型与不同诗体间存在差异，且可观测到的押韵词表与模型规模相关。

Conclusion: LLM是"懒惰的诗人"——具备丰富诗歌库存却低效调用，模式坍缩在诗歌体裁中显著且具有结构性与模型依赖性；该工作提供了迄今最大规模的LLM诗歌语料，为量化与缓解模式坍缩奠定基础。

Abstract: While aligned large language models (LLMs) can successfully complete many creative tasks, their outputs tend to be highly self-similar. Though solutions to this problem of "mode collapse" have been proposed, comprehensive large-scale surveys of the phenomenon in specific textual genres are still lacking. We address this gap through an extensive treatment of LLM mode collapse in poetry. Across 15 poetic forms, 248 subject matter tags, and 16 open-weight models, we generate over 1.1 million poems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the largest corpus of LLM-generated poetry to date. At million-poem scale, we find that LLM poetic vocabularies and rhyming abilities are substantial, but severely underutilized. In other words, LLMs are "lazy" poets: despite possessing large poetic inventories, LLMs over-rely on a small number of words, opening phrases, and rhymes. Further, we find that lexical homogenization differs across models and poetic forms, noting observed rhyming vocabulary is correlated with model size.

</details>


### [305] [Analyzing Repetition and Interference Effects in Memory-Constrained User Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24232)
*Cara Su-Yi Leong,Nicholas Tomlin,Tal Linzen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文评估受限记忆的用户模拟器是否对人类信息保持的两个影响因素——事实重复与竞争信息干扰——敏感；结果显示部分模拟器在总体准确率及效应幅度上接近人类，但无模型在具体问题上匹配人类准确率，人类是"记错"、模型是"遗忘"，错误模式不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户模拟器可用于规模化地评估和训练AI系统与人类交互，因此需要检验其与人类行为的对齐程度（behavioral parity），尤其需确认模拟器是否复现已知影响人类信息保持的因素。

Method: 对具有记忆约束的用户模拟器进行行为评估，测量其是否对事实重复（repetition）与竞争信息干扰（interference）这两个影响人类信息保持的因素敏感，并与人类表现进行对比分析。

Result: 部分模拟器达到类人的总体准确率，并复现了重复效应与干扰效应的大小；但没有模拟器在特定问题上的准确率与人类一致——人类表现为错误记忆（misremember），模型表现为信息丢失（forget），二者错误模式不同。

Conclusion: 当前记忆受限用户模拟器仅在对齐聚合层面统计效应上与人类相似，却在个体问题层面的错误模式上偏离人类；作者将该数据发布为挑战性基准（challenge benchmark）以推动后续用户模拟器研究。

Abstract: User simulators can help evaluate and train AI systems to interact with humans at scale. To do so, evaluation of user simulators must measure behavioral parity with people. We evaluate whether memory-constrained user simulators are sensitive to two factors known to affect human information retention: repetition of a fact and interference from competing information. We find that some simulators achieve human-like overall accuracy, and replicate the magnitude of repetition and interference effects, but none match people's accuracy on particular questions: while humans misremember facts, models forget them, leading to different error patterns. We release this data as a challenge benchmark for future work on user simulators.

</details>


### [306] [Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24236)
*Wen-Zhi Li,Sainyam Galhotra,Claire Cardie*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文从有限样本学习动态角度分析了RLVR压缩推理多样性的机制，并提出TAR（Targeted Adaptive Replay）框架，通过自适应回放基座模型的多样正确解，在保持推理性能的同时缓解多样性丧失与正确解遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR能提升大模型推理能力，但常导致推理行为多样性下降。作者希望揭示该现象的成因（有限on-policy采样动态），并在不牺牲性能的前提下保留基座策略中已有的多样正确推理模式。

Method: 将多样性丧失归因于有限样本学习动态：有限的on-policy rollout会逐步抑制语义不同但奖励相同的推理模式，且一旦某模式欠采样便难以恢复。据此提出TAR：构建基座模型多样解的紧凑记忆库，并设计自适应机制，仅在存储行为于RLVR过程中被抑制时才选择性回放。

Result: 在六个数学推理基准和两个Qwen2.5模型规模上，TAR在推理性能与多样性保持的平衡上优于现有保多样性后训练方法，并显著减少对基座模型正确解的遗忘。

Conclusion: RLVR的多样性退化可由有限样本采样动态解释；有针对性地回放基座模型的多样正确解是缓解该问题的有效手段，TAR提供了性能与多样性兼顾的可行方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model solutions. Code is available at https://github.com/wenzhilics/tar.

</details>


### [307] [Encoder-Free Multimodal LLMs Learn Implicit Encoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24239)
*David Harwath,Desh Raj,Xavier Velez,Sandra Arcos-Holzinger,Willie Jeng,Karen Livescu,Leibny Paola Garcia-Perera,Sanjeev Khudanpur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文实证分析两种无编码器的多模态大模型（Gemma-4 12B、Inkling-Small），发现其早期层充当"隐式编码器"，对音频/视觉输入的编码基本不受跨模态上下文影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期出现不使用模态专用编码器、而是将原始样本窗口/像素/频谱特征直接送入语言模型的多模态LLM，但其内部机制尚不清楚：这些模型的早期层是否承担了专用编码器的功能值得探究。

Method: 对两个无编码器多模态LLM进行实证分析：(1) 检验早期层对音频、视觉输入的编码是否对跨模态上下文保持不变性；(2) 比较多模态推理中"各模态独立编码至早期各层"与"从第一层起联合编码"的准确率；(3) 用逐层探针（layer-wise probing）分析隐式编码器捕获的关键信息。

Result: 早期层确实起到"隐式编码器"作用，其音频/视觉编码对跨模态上下文基本不变；在推理任务中，独立编码与从第一层联合编码准确率相当；逐层探针显示隐式编码器捕获的信息与若干主流编码器模型行为相似。

Conclusion: 无编码器多模态LLM的早期层可有效替代专用模态编码器，为理解并简化多模态架构提供了实证依据。

Abstract: We empirically analyze two recently proposed encoder-free multimodal LLMs, Gemma-4 12B and Inkling-Small. Unlike previous multimodal LLMs, these models do not use modality-specific encoders to extract tokenized embeddings representing audio and image input; instead, they directly feed windows of samples, pixels, or spectral features to the Transformer language model. We analyze whether the early layers of these models learn to function similarly to dedicated audio and visual encoders. We find that these early layers do in fact act as ``implicit encoders,'' encoding audio and visual inputs in a way that is largely invariant to their cross-modal context. Furthermore, when performing multimodal reasoning tasks, we show that independently encoding the modalities throughout these early model layers achieves the same accuracy as jointly encoding them from the first layer onwards. Finally, we use layer-wise probing to analyze the salient information captured by the implicit encoders and find their behavior to be similar to several popular encoder models.

</details>


### [308] [Can This LLM Annotate My Data? Estimating Zero-Shot LLM Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24250)
*Tong Lin,Grant Schoenebeck,Sabina Tomkins*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 通过构建两大任务族、共461个文本分类数据集，发现可在一定程度上预测LLM标注性能，且内部对数概率比自报告置信度的语言化表达更具预测力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多用于数据标注，性能时好时坏；已有研究揭示了其机遇与缺陷，但一个关键问题未解：能否预测LLM在新数据集上的标注表现。

Method: 构建两个任务族，由此诱导出461个文本分类数据集，并对比不同可用于预测性能的信号，重点检验LLM对自置信度的语言化表达与内部对数概率。

Result: 实验表明LLM标注性能在一定程度上是可预测的；与强调置信度语言化有效性的其他工作相反，内部对数概率是最具预测力的信号。

Conclusion: LLM在新数据集上的标注表现具备一定可预测性，且应优先采用内部对数概率而非语言化置信度作为预测依据。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in annotation tasks with varying success. While several studies have demonstrated the opportunities and shortcomings of LLMs for annotation, a critical question remains unanswered: is it possible to predict how well they will perform on a new dataset? To answer this and related questions, we construct two task families which induce 461 text classification datasets. We find that it is possible to predict LLM performance - to a certain degree - and that contrary to other work which highlights the usefulness of LLM verbalizations of self-confidence, internal log-probabilities are the most predictive signal.

</details>


### [309] [SLA-LENS: From Classroom Transcripts to CSLA-Informed and Evidence-Linked L2 Interaction Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24259)
*Nemika Tyagi,Olga Kellert,Phanos Kareen,Nelvin Licona-Guevara*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出SLA-LENS，一个端到端LLM辅助框架，将课堂转录文本转为结构化教学法标注并生成证据关联的描述性分析，应用于40份L2西班牙语在线课堂转录（逾21,000句级实例），评估专有与开源权重LLM（含QLoRA适配）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习者出错后教师回应如何塑造下一话轮，需要在不同课堂间考察此类互动；但此类语境敏感的标注难以人工规模化。

Method: 基于互动主义二语习得理论设计标注模式，刻画学习者错误、教学功能及uptake/repair，兼顾说话者角色、会话语境与层级标签；用经专家审核的金标注、留出的银数据及对不同类型的标注错误敏感的多类指标，评估专有与开源权重LLM（含任务特定QLoRA适配）；并以确定性报告层生成可复现可视化。

Result: 在40份真实在线L2西班牙语课堂转录（超21,000句级实例）上完成框架应用与模型评估；报告层可生成参与度、反馈、学习者错误、uptake及时间互动模式的可复现可视化，并链接至支撑性转录证据。

Conclusion: 使这些互动模式可获取、可核查，SLA-LENS支持系统的课堂话语研究、教学反思与课程设计。

Abstract: What happens after a learner makes an error, and how does the instructor's response shape the next turn? Investigating these exchanges across classrooms requires context-sensitive annotation that is difficult to scale manually. We introduce SLA-LENS, an end-to-end LLM-assisted framework that connects classroom transcripts to structured pedagogical annotations and evidence-linked descriptive analytics. Grounded in interactionist Second Language Acquisition (SLA) theory, its annotation schema captures second language learner errors, pedagogical functions, and uptake or repair while accounting for speaker roles, conversational context, and hierarchical labels. We apply the framework to 40 authentic online L2 Spanish classroom transcripts comprising over 21,000 sentence-level instances. We evaluate proprietary and open-weight LLMs, including task-specific QLoRA adaptation, using expert-reviewed gold annotations, held-out silver data, and metrics sensitive to different types of annotation error. A deterministic reporting layer generates reproducible visualizations of participation, feedback, learner errors, uptake, and temporal interaction patterns, linked to supporting transcript evidence. By making these patterns accessible and inspectable, SLA-LENS supports systematic classroom discourse research, pedagogical reflection, and curriculum design.

</details>


### [310] [Best of Both Worlds: Fine-Tuned Small Models Complement LLMs for Cost and Performance Benefits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24260)
*Shivam Mathur,Sri Harish Popuri,Priya Krishnan Sundararajan,Kevin Horecka,Michael Mugo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文对比RoBERTa微调模型与现成GPT-3.5在16类调查文本分类上的性能、成本与时间，并提出批量提示（batch prompting）优化GPT-3.5推理，最终发现二者集成效果最佳（F1 97.5%），推理成本仅为单独GPT-3.5的4.4%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: BERT类模型需数千标注样本，GPT-X类大模型仅需每类1-5个示例，但两者的性能—成本—时间权衡尚未被充分研究，作者希望在真实文本分类任务上量化这些权衡。

Method: 将调查文本分为16类；对比训练式RoBERTa模型与现成（off-the-shelf）GPT-3.5；测量10,000条记录的推理耗时；为GPT-3.5探索batch prompting，实验变量包括批量大小与few-shot采样方式；并构建RoBERTa与GPT-3.5的集成模型。

Result: GPT-3.5预测10,000条需6小时，RoBERTa在T4 GPU上仅需12分钟；RoBERTa的F1为96%，GPT-3.5为83%；batch prompting最优批量大小为20（配合人工few-shot筛选），可将GPT-3.5推理成本降低约70%且不损害性能；集成模型F1达97.5%，推理成本仅为单独GPT-3.5的4.4%。

Conclusion: 微调小模型在性能与效率上显著优于现成大模型；batch prompting能大幅降低大模型推理成本；两者集成是兼顾性能与成本的最佳方案。

Abstract: BERT-based models require thousands of labeled samples to train. Larger models like GPT-X require only 1-5 examples per class. However, performance, cost and time tradeoffs of such models remain under-explored. In this work, we classify survey text data into 16 classes. We focus on experimental approaches and results on performance, cost, and time taken for this problem. We compare these parameters of a trained RoBERTa-based model, and an (off-the-shelf) GPT-3.5 model for text classification. Baseline experiments show that the time taken by GPT-3.5 for generating predictions on 10,000 records is 6 hours, whereas a RoBERTa-based model takes only 12 mins on a T4 GPU. To identify the best prompting approach for GPT-3.5, we explore batch prompting. We experiment with (1) batch-size, and (2) few-shot sampling. We find the best batch size is 20 with human few-shot curation. Experiments show the F1 score of a trained RoBERTa-based model (96%) is much higher than a GPT-3.5 model (83%). In case of GPT-3.5, batch prompting is beneficial in lowering inference costs by ~70%, without hindering task performance. We find the best approach is an ensemble of a RoBERTa-based and GPT-3.5 model (F1: 97.5%) incurring only 4.4% of inference cost compared to a standalone GPT-3.5.

</details>


### [311] [Modeling bilingual naming performance through laterally-connected SOMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24275)
*Divya Prabhakaran,Uli Grasemann,Erie Shivers,Marissa Russell-Meill,Swathi Kiran,Risto Miikkulainen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 将双语句法词汇模型BiLex引入兴奋性与抑制性侧连接以提升生物真实性，使其可解释反应时与语义类错误，并成功模拟西班牙语—英语双语者的波士顿命名测验表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统机器学习构建个体化认知计算模型常受训练数据不足限制；而更细致刻画神经与认知过程的替代架构更易拟合个体并提供机制性解释。已有BiLex模型缺乏生物真实性与对反应时、错误类型的解释能力。

Method: 在BiLex（共享语义系统与以自组织映射表示的语音语言系统）基础上加入兴奋性与抑制性侧连接以增强生物真实性；用西班牙语和英语模拟波士顿命名测验，并将模型表现与不同第一、第二语言史的双语者命名准确率和错误类型进行比较。

Result: 扩展后的模型能够解释反应时以及基于语义概念熟悉度、典型性和特异性的常见错误；模型表现近似于不同语言史西班牙语—英语双语者的命名准确率与错误类型分布。

Conclusion: 该建模路径捕捉了双语词汇通达中的语义层面过程，可对单个被试的语义认知进行建模；未来可作为建模语言障碍及治疗方案的基础。

Abstract: Computational models have explanatory power to understand cognition in individuals, but there is usually not enough training data to build such models with traditional machine learning. However, alternative architectures that model neural and cognitive processes in more detail can be more easily fit to individuals and can lead to mechanistic insights into human behavior. BiLex is such a computational model of the bilingual lexicon, containing a shared semantic system and phonetic language systems represented through self-organizing maps. In this study, BiLex was extended further into biological realism with excitatory and inhibitory lateral connections. This extension makes it possible to account for response times as well as common errors such as those based on semantic concept familiarity, typicality, and specificity. The Boston Naming Test was simulated in Spanish and English, and model performance approximated naming accuracy and error types in Spanish-English bilinguals with varying primary and secondary language histories. The results indicated that the approach captures semantic-level processes in bilingual lexical access, thus modeling the semantic cognition of individual subjects. In the future, such models may serve as a foundation for modeling impairments and treatment options.

</details>


### [312] [BanglaShield: A Script-Robust Safety Classifier and Benchmark for Bangla Native, Romanized, and Code-Mixed Prompts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24288)
*Mohsinul Kabir,Md. Tariquzzaman,Mohammad Rashidujjaman Rifat,Tharindu Ranasinghe,Nishat Raihan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: BanglaShield：涵盖孟加拉语原生、罗马化与代码混合三种书写形式的分级提示安全数据集（10,245条提示、四级分类）与紧凑微调编码器模型；揭示LLM与守护模型在非标准书写下安全性评估显著失效，而微调小模型大幅领先。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全分类器多在标准书写文本上构建与评估，但孟加拉语等低资源语言常以原生文字、拉丁字母罗马化以及与英语/印地语/乌尔都语混用等形式书写，导致安全分类在这些书写变体下可靠性未知、可能严重失效。

Method: 整合6个来源共10,245条孟加拉语提示，按Safe/Offensive/Harmful/Severe四级taxonomy标注，并将每条提示渲染为三种对齐书写形式（共享标签、group-aware划分），支持严格配对比较。在36,882条分类查询与24,318条判定回复上评测6个当代LLM（含孟加拉语专用模型）及3个多语种guard模型；同时训练紧凑的微调编码器BanglaShield作为对照方案。

Result: LLM分类器将47.0%的原生文字不安全提示误判为Safe，罗马化下升至63.4%；回复级安全准确率下降10.3个百分点。三个多语种guard模型放过30.3–57.3%的原生文字不安全提示。以模型自身分类作输入过滤仅降低约5个百分点的有害服从。BanglaShield在原生文字达87.8 macro-F1、罗马化84.4，较各形式最佳LLM高42.8–46.1分，参数量约为Gemma 4 31B的1/130。

Conclusion: 书写形式（文字脚本与代码混合）是孟加拉语LLM安全评估的关键失效维度，现有LLM与guard模型在此显著不可靠；轻量级领域微调编码器可远超大型通用模型，说明数据与任务对齐比规模更关键。论文公开语料、划分、判定结果与模型。

Abstract: Safety classifiers for large language models (LLMs) are typically built and evaluated on standard-script text, yet Bangla, like many lower-resource languages, is routinely written in native script, in Latin-script romanization, and code-mixed with English, Hindi, or Urdu. We introduce BanglaShield, a resource and model for graded prompt-safety classification across these written forms. We consolidate 10,245 Bangla prompts from six sources under a four-level taxonomy (Safe, Offensive, Harmful, Severe) and render each prompt in three aligned forms that share labels and a group-aware split, enabling strictly paired comparisons. Benchmarking six contemporary LLMs, including a Bangla-specialized one, on 36,882 classification queries and 24,318 judged responses, we find that LLM classifiers label 47.0% of unsafe native-script prompts as Safe, rising to 63.4% under romanization, while response-level safety accuracy drops by 10.3 points. Three multilingual guard models also pass 30.3-57.3% of unsafe native-script prompts. Using a model's own classification as an input filter reduces harmful compliance by only about five points. In contrast, BanglaShield, a compact fine-tuned encoder, reaches 87.8 macro-F1 on native-script and 84.4 on romanized prompts, outperforming the best LLM on each form by 42.8-46.1 points with ~130x fewer parameters than Gemma 4 31B. We release the corpus, splits, judgments, and model.

</details>


### [313] [Beyond Clean Accuracy: The Practical Challenges and Benefits of Pixel-Based Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24290)
*Haowen Tang,Wei Xia,Raoyuan Zhao,Hinrich Schütze,Yihong Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文系统考察了像素级语言模型的下游适配性：其微调需更长训练与更广标注覆盖、可靠性受延迟学习与学习率影响，但成功适配后在排版噪声与跨语言迁移上明显优于英文预训练文本模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 像素级语言模型不依赖固定子词词表处理渲染文本，在噪声与多语言输入上有潜力，但其实际价值取决于能否可靠地适配下游任务，这一关键问题尚未被系统回答。

Method: 从三个方面系统评估：微调行为（训练步数、标注数据覆盖度、延迟学习、学习率敏感性等），排版噪声下的鲁棒性，以及零样本跨语言迁移；并结合表示分析考察预训练像素表示中任务相关信息的可及性。

Result: 在所测设定下，像素级模型比文本模型需要更长训练与更广的标注数据覆盖，学习率依赖的失败与延迟学习使适配不够可靠；预训练像素表示中任务相关信息更难获取。但一旦成功适配，其在排版噪声下精度下降更小，并在两个跨语言基准上取得高于英文预训练文本模型的目标语言准确率，尽管干净英文性能较弱。

Conclusion: 以渲染替代分词降低了对损坏与陌生输入的敏感性，但把核心瓶颈转移到了下游适配，形成"鲁棒性提升—适配成本上升"的中心权衡。

Abstract: Pixel-based language models process rendered text without relying on a fixed subword vocabulary, offering a promising approach to noisy and multilingual inputs. However, their practical value depends on whether they can be reliably adapted to downstream tasks. To this end, we systematically examine this question through fine-tuning behavior, typographical robustness, and zero-shot crosslingual transfer. Under our tested settings, pixel-based models require longer training and broader labelled-data coverage than text-based models, while delayed learning and learning-rate-dependent failures make adaptation less reliable. Our analyses further suggest that task-relevant information is less readily accessible in pretrained pixel representations, placing greater demands on fine-tuning. Once successfully adapted, however, pixel-based models lose substantially less accuracy under typographical noise and achieve higher target-language accuracy than English-pretrained text-based counterparts on two crosslingual benchmarks, despite weaker clean English performance. Together, these findings reveal a central trade-off: replacing tokenization with rendering reduces sensitivity to corrupted and unfamiliar inputs, but shifts a central bottleneck to downstream adaptation.

</details>


### [314] [What Matters for NVFP4 Training? A Comparative Study of Low-Precision Pretraining Recipes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24343)
*Anjulie Agrusa,Andrei Panferov,Elizabeth Wei,Keith Wyss,Paul Gibbons,Erik Schultheis,Jinhang Choi,Frank Sun,Tijmen Blankevoort,Dan Alistarh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文在中等规模（8B稠密、30B-A3B MoE，训练至1T token）系统比较NVFP4训练配方，提出以无偏梯度估计为核心的最优配方，取得该规模下相对BF16损失差距最小的FP4训练结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FP4（NVFP4）训练可显著提升吞吐与能效，但现有配方多数仅在小模型、短token horizon上验证，缺乏在中等规模上"哪些成分是精度恢复所必需"的系统认识。

Method: 在中等规模（dense 8B与30B-A3B MoE，最多1T tokens）上对近期NVFP4配方做对照比较与消融；提出融合现有大规模稳定NVFP4训练原理的最终配方，采用比随机舍入量化误差更低的无偏梯度估计，并分析选择性高精度层与反向传播中各张量去偏收益差异。

Result: 在给定规模下相对BF16的loss gap为目前报道最强的FP4训练结果；消融表明：(i) 配方中每项技术均可测量地改善loss轨迹；(ii) 选择性高精度层是规模下恢复精度的必要条件；(iii) 反向中各张量从去偏中获益不均，其余张量仍有应用互补误差降低技术的空间。

Conclusion: NVFP4训练在中等规模可行且精度可恢复，但需依赖无偏梯度估计、选择性高精度层等关键成分；去偏技术的针对性应用（按张量分层）是进一步提升FP4训练效率与精度的方向。

Abstract: Training large language models directly in 4-bit floating-point (FP) formats promises substantial improvements in throughput and energy efficiency. While some recipe design choices have been validated at scale, many promising approaches remain untested beyond small models and short token horizons, leaving open the question of which trends will hold. We present a systematic comparison of recent NVFP4 recipes at medium model scale, evaluating dense 8B and 30B-A3B MoE models trained for up to 1T tokens, with a focus on which ingredients are necessary for accuracy recovery. We propose a final recipe grounded in the principles behind established stable NVFP4 training at scale, incorporating state-of-the-art techniques such as unbiased gradient estimation with lower quantization error than stochastic rounding. To the best of our knowledge, this is the strongest FP4 training result demonstrated at this scale to date in loss gap to BF16. Through ablation studies, we find that: (i) each technique in the optimized recipe measurably improves loss trajectory, (ii) selective high-precision layers are necessary for recovering accuracy at scale, (iii) not all tensors in the backward pass benefit equally from de-biasing, leaving room to apply complementary error-reduction techniques to the remaining tensors.

</details>


### [315] [FlashMap: Flow Map Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24365)
*Jeff Shen,Zhejian Zhou,Ryan Lee,Jonathan May,Shirley Ho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FlashMap：一种连续流（flow map）草稿模型，以目标模型隐状态为条件，单次前向生成整块 token 并建模块内依赖，在 Qwen3-8B 上优于同规模 DFlash 基线，平均加速比高 7%，最高 6.1× 无损加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码中，自回归草稿模型逐 token 生成，草稿阶段慢；DFlash 等块扩散草稿模型虽能单次生成整块，但各 token 独立预测，忽略块内 token 间依赖，损害草稿质量与接受率。

Method: 提出 FlashMap，将 flow map 语言模型作为草稿器，以目标模型的 hidden states 为条件输入，在一次前向传播中生成完整 token 块，同时通过连续流映射建模块内 token 依赖。

Result: 在 Qwen3-8B 上，FlashMap 在所有基准上均快于同规模 DFlash 基线，平均加速比提升 7%，最高实现 6.1× 无损加速。

Conclusion: 在保持单次前向并行生成效率的同时引入块内依赖建模，可在不损失输出质量的前提下显著提升投机解码的实际加速效果。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight drafter to propose a block of tokens that the target model verifies in one parallel pass. Autoregressive drafters generate this block one token at a time, whereas block diffusion drafters such as DFlash generate it in one pass, making drafting faster. However, these diffusion drafters predict each token independently, ignoring dependencies between tokens in the block. We introduce FlashMap, a continuous flow drafter that conditions a flow map language model on the target model's hidden states and generates the whole block in one forward pass while capturing inter-token dependencies. On Qwen3-8B, FlashMap is faster than a matched DFlash baseline on every benchmark, with 7% higher average speedup and up to 6.1x lossless acceleration.

</details>


### [316] [Ask Less, Ask Better: Allocating User Attention in Proactive LLM Agents with Interruption Budgets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24411)
*Xuanming Zhang,Amir H. Rezaeian,Miguel Ballesteros,Weiyi Sun,Werner Geyer,Lydia B. Chilton,Zhou Yu,Yassine Benajiba,Dan Roth*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出区分"问多少"与"问多好"的评估协议：用打断预算限制提问数量，用人验证的LLM评判器给出的"用户注意力成本"衡量提问质量，结果显示少问与问好是两个独立目标，主动型智能体评估应同时度量二者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体的澄清提问会消耗用户时间与精力，但现有评估仅以提问数量衡量负担，将必要提问与可避免提问等同对待，无法反映提问的感知努力程度与质量差异。

Method: 提出评估协议：设置打断预算（interruption budget）限制提问数量；引入用户注意力成本（user-attention cost），对难读或不值得问的问题额外计费，由经人类验证的LLM评判器打分。在8个LLM、4个客服领域上评测，并对比"对照用户先前回答记忆审查问题"的改进策略。

Result: 同等问题数下，人类标注者与成本判断在"哪段对话更费力"上一致率达75%。将提问限制为1–3个可使注意力成本降低36–73%，同时保留无限提问下86–94%的任务奖励。同一预算下，对照用户历史回答审查问题可再降13%成本，奖励损失很小且问题更有价值。同一注意力成本下，最高效模型从提问中获得的奖励是其他模型的两倍以上。

Conclusion: "少问"与"问好"是不同目标；对主动型智能体的评估应同时度量提问数量与提问质量（感知努力），而非仅计问题数。

Abstract: LLM agents can ask clarifying questions to complete tasks, but answering each question demands users' time and effort. Existing evaluations typically measure this burden by counting questions, treating necessary and avoidable questions equally. We propose an evaluation protocol that distinguishes how often agents ask from how well they ask. An interruption budget limits the number of questions, while a user-attention cost charges extra for questions that are hard to read or not worth asking, as rated by a human-validated LLM judge. Beyond question counts, this cost captures perceived effort: on conversation pairs with the same number of questions, human annotators agreed with the cost on which conversation required more effort 75% of the time. Across eight LLMs and four customer-service domains, limiting agents to one to three questions reduces user-attention cost by 36-73% while keeping 86-94% of the task reward they earn with unlimited questions. At the same budget, reviewing each question against the memory of users' earlier answers cuts attention cost by another 13% with little reward loss and yields more valuable questions. Models also differ sharply in how well they ask: at the same user-attention cost, the most efficient models gain more than twice as much reward from their questions as the others. These results show that asking less and asking better are distinct goals, and that evaluations of proactive agents should measure both.

</details>


### [317] [Toward a Universal Local Speech Feature Extractor Through Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24424)
*Jessica Yang,Marcelo Beramendi Caballero,Ju-Chieh Chou,Karen Livescu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文提出用蒸馏得到的两层通用特征提取器替代自监督语音模型中的CNN前端，在保留大部分下游性能的同时大幅降低计算量与推理时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督语音模型的前端CNN层计算开销大，且各模型间结构高度相似、功能上又接近简单的mel谱特征，因此作者假设该CNN前端可被一个简单、通用的模型所替代。

Method: 从单个或多个教师模型（HuBERT、data2vec、WavLM）蒸馏，学习一个两层特征提取器来替换原CNN前端；在SUPERB(-SG)基准任务上评估，并测试其迁移至未见模型（wav2vec 2.0）的能力。

Result: 该特征提取器基本保持了教师模型的下游性能，也可用于未见过的wav2vec 2.0；其MACs仅为原CNN的3%，整体推理运行时间减少超过20%。

Conclusion: CNN前端存在明显冗余，可被轻量且通用的蒸馏式特征提取器替代，从而在几乎不损失性能的前提下显著提升自监督语音模型的推理效率。

Abstract: Self-supervised speech models commonly consist of a set of convolutional neural network (CNN) layers used as a local feature extractor, followed by transformer layers. The CNN layers are computationally demanding, and are also similar across models and resemble the much simpler mel spectral features. We hypothesize that the CNN layers can be replaced by a simple, universal model. To test this hypothesis, we learn a two-layer feature extractor via distillation from one or more teacher models (HuBERT, data2vec, and WavLM). Experiments on SUPERB(-SG) benchmark tasks show that our model largely retains the performance of the teacher models and can also be used in an unseen model (wav2vec 2.0). Our feature extractor requires only 3% of the MACs of the CNNs, resulting in a $>$20% overall inference runtime reduction.

</details>


### [318] [When Opposite Premises Translate Identically: A Source-Conditioned Diagnostic for Multilingual Commonsense Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24428)
*Shuai Wang,Rui Hu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出“源对比”诊断来检验ACCORD中译前件是否保留英语源关系：反转英语极性、独立翻译两支、统计目标端完全相同的输出，并对每支与其自身源打分。结果显示自动翻译分无法认证反事实基准字段，且往返NLI与LaBSE的碰撞过滤能力差异显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言推理比较依赖翻译后的前件保留英语源中的关系；仅靠接受性判定的自动翻译分数虽能对源-目标对排序，却无法认证某字段是否可用于反事实基准。

Method: 对ACCORD前件做源对比诊断：反转英语极性并独立翻译两支，统计目标端完全相同的输出（碰撞），并对每支对照其自身源进行打分；实验覆盖71个匹配问题身份、两种包含项深度、五种目标语言、三个翻译检查点，并使用人工参考校准阈值，比较往返NLI与LaBSE的过滤效果。

Result: 斯瓦希里语在每个检查点的710对中有63、113、67个精确碰撞；在校准阈值下，往返NLI通过113个NLLB-3.3B碰撞中两支的3个，而LaBSE通过78个。每个碰撞至少证明一个翻译不忠实，但无法定位是哪一支。

Conclusion: 受控测量不能确立该筛选对自发翻译错误的准确率，也不能证明语言×跳数推理效应；研究缺乏母语等价标签与答案模型评估。

Abstract: Multilingual reasoning comparisons depend on translated premises preserving the relations in their English sources. Automatic translation scores can rank source-target pairs, but an acceptance decision alone cannot certify a counterfactual benchmark field. We test a source-contrast diagnostic for ACCORD premises: reverse the English polarity, translate both arms independently, count identical target outputs, and score each arm against its own source. Across 71 matched question identities at two containing-item depths, five target languages, and three translation checkpoints, Swahili has 63, 113, and 67 exact collisions among 710 pairs per checkpoint. At a human-reference-calibrated threshold, round-trip NLI passes both arms of 3 of the 113 NLLB-3.3B collisions, while LaBSE passes 78. Each collision proves at least one unfaithful translation, but does not identify its arm. These controlled measurements do not establish screening accuracy on spontaneous translation errors or a language-by-hop reasoning effect; the study has no native equivalence labels or answer-model evaluation.

</details>


### [319] [Which Long Documents Matter? A Controlled Study of Data Selection for Context Extension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24469)
*Junlong Jia,Jiang Zhou,Xing Wu,Chaochen Gao Tinghao Yu,Feng Zhang,Lilin Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在Qwen2.5-3B 128K、匹配6B-token持续训练预算下，随机采样自然长文档（random-long）优于repacking；同池内按LongPPL关键token密度选择文档可进一步增益，并提出truncLongPPL用截断前缀降低打分成本（2.28×加速），在多种模型与混合训练设置下稳定优于random-long且短上下文性能基本无损。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然长文档被广泛用于上下文扩展，但何种数据选择流水线有效尚不明确，缺乏在匹配预算下的受控对比。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-3B、128K上下文、6B-token持续训练预算的受控设置下比较random-long与repacking；在相同候选池内比较高LongPPL关键token密度的选择器与通用质量、LLM-judge选择器；提出truncLongPPL，在截断前缀上计算关键token密度以降低打分成本；并扩展到256K目标上下文及Qwen2.5-3B/Qwen3-8B/OLMo 3-7B的短长混合训练，最后经SFT验证。

Result: random-long在更长评测长度下优于repacking；高LongPPL关键token密度选择带来增益，而通用质量与LLM-judge选择器未见增益。truncLongPPL仅评前半参考跨度，性能接近全跨度且端到端打分加速2.28×。三个训练种子下其均值最高：验证HELMET较random-long高4.54分、留出RULER高3.28分，检索任务最稳定；256K目标下RULER平均高2.82分；三种模型短长混合训练中RULER平均增益1.47–7.31分，七任务短上下文均值与基线差距≤0.23分；SFT后LongBench v2高1.13–1.67分、MRCR高0.62–1.44分。

Conclusion: 基于LongPPL关键token密度的文档选择（尤以truncLongPPL的截断打分）是高效且可扩展的长上下文数据筛选方案，在长上下文能力上稳定优于random-long与repacking，同时基本保持短上下文性能。

Abstract: Natural long documents are widely used for context extension, but which selection pipelines are effective remains unclear. We conduct a controlled comparison on Qwen2.5-3B at 128K under matched 6B-token continued-training budgets. Random sampling of natural long documents (random-long) outperforms repacking at longer evaluation lengths. Within the same candidate pool, selecting documents with high LongPPL key-token density yields further gains, unlike the evaluated generic-quality and LLM-judge selectors. We introduce truncLongPPL to reduce scoring cost by computing key-token density over a truncated prefix. At 128K, scoring the first half of the reference span yields downstream performance close to full-span scoring with a measured $2.28\times$ end-to-end scoring speedup. Across three training seeds, truncLongPPL achieves the highest mean scores among evaluated pipelines, exceeding random-long by 4.54 points on validation HELMET and 3.28 on held-out RULER, with gains most consistent in retrieval. At a 256K target context, it gains 2.82 average RULER points over random-long on Qwen2.5-3B. In short/long mixed training across Qwen2.5-3B, Qwen3-8B, and OLMo~3-7B, it gains 1.47--7.31 average RULER points over random-long mixing, with seven-task short-context averages within 0.23 points of the corresponding baselines. After supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Qwen3-8B and OLMo~3-7B models trained with selected long documents outperform their random-long counterparts by 1.13--1.67 points on LongBench v2 and 0.62--1.44 points on MRCR.

</details>


### [320] [Ben-Misandry: A Bengali Dataset and Late-Fusion Transformer Framework for Detecting Anti-Male Gender Hate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24474)
*Md Mehedi Hasan Nipu,Chinmoy Mitra,Tarannum Ahmed Nowshin,Israt Moyeen Noumi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文构建了首个孟加拉语"厌男/贬男"（misandry）检测数据集 Ben-Misandry（5,000条GPT-4.1合成评论、六类分类体系），并用经典机器学习与Transformer两套流水线进行基准评测，最佳成绩为BanglaBERT与XLM-RoBERTa软投票晚融合的96.6%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 孟加拉语性别仇恨言论研究几乎只关注厌女（misogyny），反男性仇恨（misandry）完全空白，导致审核系统只能识别针对女性的攻击，形成系统性盲区。

Method: 发布Ben-Misandry数据集，含6个分类类别，其中"嘲讽男性情感脆弱"为现有厌女分类体系中无对应项的新类别；语料由GPT-4.1按分类体系受控合成，500条样本经4名人工复核抽查。评测采用两条流水线：经典流水线（7种分类器×4种文本表示）与Transformer流水线（BanglaBERT、XLM-RoBERTa及两种融合策略），并用Shapley解释验证决策边界。

Result: 最佳经典模型（字符级TF-IDF + 线性SVM）准确率91.8%；BanglaBERT与XLM-RoBERTa软最大输出平均的晚融合集成达96.6%准确率、宏平均ROC-AUC超过99%，名义上优于所有单模型与早融合（未做显著性检验）。Shapley解释复原了探索性分析中同样的类别判别性词汇。

Conclusion: 孟加拉语misandry检测在该合成语料上是可行且可度量的；该数据集作为初步公开资源发布，尚需在真实数据上验证，且未排除模型部分依赖合成生成痕迹的可能。

Abstract: Gender based hate speech research in Bengali has focused almost exclusively on misogyny, leaving anti male hate, or misandry, entirely unstudied for this language and creating a systematic blind spot in moderation systems trained to catch attacks on women but not on men. We introduce Ben-Misandry, the first Bengali misandry detection dataset: 5,000 comments across six taxonomy classes, including a novel category for mocking male emotional vulnerability with no direct analogue in existing misogyny taxonomies. The corpus is taxonomy-controlled synthetic data generated with GPT-4.1, spot-checked by four human reviewers on a 500-comment sample who confirmed the large majority of assigned labels; a full inter-annotator- agreement study is left to future work. We benchmark it with a classical pipeline (seven classifiers over four text representations) and a transformer pipeline (BanglaBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and two fusion strategies). The best classical model, a linear SVM over character-level TF-IDF, reaches 91.8% accuracy; a late fusion ensemble averaging BanglaBERT and XLM-RoBERTa softmax outputs reaches 96.6% accuracy and macro ROC-AUC above 99%, nominally ahead of every single model and early fusion, though we have not run significance testing to confirm these margins are meaningful. We relate this to classifier combination theory, under which averaging encoders with decorrelated errors is expected to reduce variance, and corroborate the decision boundary with Shapley explanations that recover the same class- discriminative vocabulary found in our exploratory analysis, while noting this cannot rule out the model partly keying on synthetic-generation artifacts. Our results indicate misandry detection in Bengali is feasible and measurable on this synthetic corpus, offered as an initial public resource pending validation on real-world data.

</details>


### [321] [Beyond Recall Saturation: Scaling Hard-Negative Reranker Training for Industrial Legal Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24478)
*Yunhan Li,Mingjie Xie,Zeyang Shi,Gengshen Wu,Min Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在大规模候选池下，嵌入召回收益递减，瓶颈转向重排器质量；采用「嵌入挖掘→自挖掘」两阶段难负样本训练流程的重排器在中文法律检索基准上取得更优权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业检索系统常靠扩大候选池或复杂训练流程提升质量，但作者发现候选池足够大时嵌入召回出现边际收益递减，因此需转而审视重排器质量；且在中文法律检索基准上，嵌入top-300虽已进入高召回区间，相关证据仍可能排在输出截断之外。

Method: 在统一的对齐检索协议下（先候选检索、后重排评估），比较多种重排器难负样本策略：嵌入挖掘、自挖掘与动态负样本变体；并验证该流程从0.6B到4B重排器的可扩展性。

Result: 在评估的分阶段配置中，嵌入→自挖掘流水线取得较优权衡，额外动态阶段并未在所有留出指标上带来提升；相对原生4B重排器，训练后的4B Stage2模型在STARD、CSAID及内部开发集上报指标提升，并在410条去标识化重构内部运营查询的延迟敏感离线偏好评估中，于72.4%的非平局比较中被偏好。

Conclusion: 为工业检索系统选择优化目标时，应分别评估检索阶段与重排阶段。

Abstract: Industrial retrieval systems often improve quality by enlarging embedding candidate pools or adopting complex training pipelines. We show that, under a sufficiently large but practical candidate pool, embedding recall exhibits diminishing returns, motivating a closer examination of reranker quality. On Chinese legal retrieval benchmarks, embedding top-300 reaches a high-recall operating region, while relevant evidence may still be ranked below the output cutoff.
