Conclusion: 实证测量提升情境相关性，仿真与数字孪生支持可扩展实验但带来验证难题；算法有效性取决于优化目标、数据特性与算力约束而非仅模型复杂度；预测精度比优化决策的网络级效应被更一致地评估。据此提出六模块EFOR清单以提升评估一致性、报告透明度与运营相关性。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly applied to 5G/6G network optimization, yet differences in empirical evidence, evaluation methods, and computational requirements complicate comparisons of reported performance. This scop ing review synthesizes 72 peer-reviewed journal studies pub lished between 2022 and 2026, selected through a PRISMA ScR-informed process from 893 records. The review examines empirical tools, AI/ML techniques, optimization domains, and operational readiness. Evidence classification identifies 37 studies (51.4%) using real-world or physical-testbed evidence only, 25 (34.7%) combining measured and simulated evidence, and 10 (13.9%) relying exclusively on synthetic or simulated data. Offline analysis was the most common evaluation setting, accounting for 45 studies (62.5%). Three principal findings emerge. First, empirical measurements improve contextual relevance, while simulation and digital twins support scalable experimentation but introduce validation challenges. Second, algorithmic effectiveness depends on the optimization objective, data characteristics, and computational constraints rather than model complexity alone. Third, predictive accuracy is more consistently evaluated than the network-level effects of optimization decisions. The review there fore introduces the six-module Evidence Fidelity and Operational Reporting (EFOR) checklist to improve evaluation consistency, reporting transparency, and operational relevance.

</details>


### [501] [Doppler-compensated Space-time Coding for MIMO PMCW Radar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26842)
*Gabriel Daniel,Hanqing Wu,Ashish Pandharipande,Geert Leus*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出多普勒补偿的空时编码（STC）MIMO PMCW雷达框架，在距离相关前分离发射信号，消除互相关项，分析并补偿多普勒引起的旁瓣与DOA鬼影。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MIMO PMCW雷达采用码分复用分离发射信号，但非理想自相关/互相关特性会抬高距离旁瓣、降低动态范围，制约其高动态范围优势的发挥。

Method: 1) 采用STC在距离相关之前完成发射信号分离，完美补偿下消除互相关项，允许各发射天线复用同一二进制序列；2) 解析刻画多普勒对STC解码的影响，指出逐码片与跨STC时隙的相位失真会抬升距离旁瓣并在DOA谱中产生鬼影分量；3) 先估计多普勒，再在快时间与STC时隙两维联合补偿后解码；4) 量化非理想多普勒估计下的残余STC泄漏；5) 通过依赖多普勒bin的补偿扩展到多运动目标场景。

Result: 理论分析与仿真表明距离旁瓣降低、DOA鬼影得到抑制，同时保持码序列设计的灵活性。

Conclusion: 所提多普勒补偿STC框架有效缓解了MIMO PMCW雷达相互相关非理想性带来的旁瓣与角度谱鬼影问题，兼顾动态范围与波形设计自由度。

Abstract: Phase modulated continuous wave (PMCW) radar is an attractive choice for automotive sensing due to its high dynamic range, interference robustness, and support for integrated communication and sensing. In multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) PMCW radar, code division multiplexing (CDM) separates transmit signals, but non-ideal auto- and cross-correlation properties increase range sidelobes and degrade dynamic range. This paper proposes a Doppler-compensated space-time coding (STC)-based MIMO PMCW radar framework that separates transmit signals before range correlation, eliminating cross-correlation terms under perfect compensation and allowing the same binary sequence to be used across transmit antennas. The Doppler influence on STC decoding is analytically characterized, showing that chip-wise and inter-STC-slot phase distortions increase range sidelobes and generate ghost components in the direction-of-arrival (DOA) spectrum. To mitigate these effects, Doppler is estimated first, followed by joint fast-time and STC-slot compensation before decoding. Residual STC leakage under imperfect Doppler estimation is quantified, and the processing is extended to multiple moving targets through Doppler-bin-dependent compensation. Theoretical analysis and simulation results demonstrate reduced range sidelobes and suppression of DOA ghosts, while maintaining flexibility in code sequence design.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [502] [Revealing Detailed Transport Mechanisms in Silicon Tunneling Diodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24088)
*Juan P. Mendez,Xujiao Gao,Sungjae Hong,Evan M. Anderson,Christopher R. Allemang,Shashank Misra*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文通过TCAD仿真结合4–440 K宽温区电学测量，系统解析了硅隧道二极管的输运机制，并提出引入费米-狄拉克统计改进的Schenk TAT模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 重掺杂半导体结中载流子输运的理解对低温电子学与陡峭斜率（steep-slope）隧穿器件至关重要，但现有模型在宽温区（尤其低温）下对TAT等机制的描述不够准确。

Method: 对硅隧道二极管进行大量TCAD仿真并与4–440 K电学测量对标；分解BTBT、TAT、SRH复合与雪崩产生的电流贡献；在Schenk TAT模型中引入费米-狄拉克统计以改善低温输运描述。

Result: 器件无负微分电导；正偏电流随温度强依赖而半对数斜率近乎恒定；高反偏下温度依赖性弱。正偏下低中压由耗尽区TAT主导，高压高温下SRH贡献增大；反偏下低压（尤其近室温及以上）由TAT主导，高压由BTBT主导。

Conclusion: 该工作全面揭示了硅隧道结中偏压与温度依赖的输运机制，并提供了一个在更宽工作条件下适用的改进TAT模型。

Abstract: Understanding carrier transport in heavily doped semiconductor junctions is essential for developing next-generation tunneling devices for cryogenic electronics and steep-slope technologies. In this work, we investigate the transport mechanisms in a silicon tunneling diode using extensive TCAD (Technology Computer Aided Design) simulations benchmarked against electrical measurements over a wide temperature range of 4 K to 440 K. The measured device characteristics show no negative differential conductance, strong temperature dependence of forward current with a nearly constant semi-logarithmic slope, and weak temperature dependence under high reverse bias. To identify the mechanisms underlying these characteristics, we investigate the contributions of band-to-band tunneling (BTBT), trap-assisted tunneling (TAT), Shockley-Read-Hall (SRH) recombination, and avalanche generation. We also enhance the Schenk TAT model by incorporating Fermi-Dirac statistics to accurately capture the transport behavior at lower temperatures. Under forward bias, TAT in the depletion region dominates the current at low-to-moderate voltages, whereas SRH becomes increasingly significant at higher voltages and temperatures. Under reverse bias, TAT dominates at low reverse voltages, particularly near and above room temperatures, whereas BTBT becomes predominant at high reverse bias, resulting in weak temperature dependence. This work provides a comprehensive understanding of the bias- and temperature-dependent transport mechanisms in silicon tunneling junctions and an enhanced TAT model suitable over a broader range of operating conditions.

</details>


### [503] [How Memristors Work: A Step-by-Step Guide to the CALM Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26273)
*Juan Bisquert*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出CALM最小模型，用三个要素统一解释卤化物钙钛矿、金属氧化物与纳流体通道忆阻器的多种动力学特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不同材料的忆阻器（卤化物钙钛矿、金属氧化物、纳流体通道）呈现出共同动力学特征，需要一个统一的、最小化的理论模型加以解释，并需要便于自学的教学材料。

Method: 采用教程式幻灯片讲解，构建"电导激活准线性忆阻器"(CALM)最小模型，仅含三个要素：两个电导态、整流函数x_eq(u)与特征时间tau(u)；配套练习（借助AI助手求解）、参考Python代码与支撑文本。

Result: 该模型可解释两个极限电导、依赖扫描速率的迟滞、正/反迟滞回线、大电容与负电容、阻抗谱中的感性环、以及脉冲串下的增强与抑制等现象；文本第4节以紧凑方式给出主要方程与图示，练习解答列于文末。

Conclusion: 单一CALM最小模型足以统一描述跨越多种材料体系的忆阻器动力学特征，为理解与教学提供简洁框架。

Abstract: Memristors made of very different materials, halide perovskites, metal oxides and nanofluidic channels, show a common set of dynamical features: two limiting conductances, hysteresis that depends on the scan rate, regular and inverted hysteresis loops, large and negative capacitances and inductive loops in impedance spectra, and potentiation and depression under pulse trains. This tutorial shows how a single minimal model, the conductance-activated quasi-linear memristor (CALM) model, explains all these features with three ingredients: the two conductance states, the rectification function x_eq (u) and the characteristic time tau(u). The tutorial is a slide presentation that the reader can follow alone, with exercises designed to be solved with the help of an AI assistant, reference Python code, and this support text. The text can also be read on its own: Section 4 gives a compact account of the content of the slides, with the main equations and figures, and the solutions to the exercises are given at the end.

</details>


### [504] [Leaky-Wave Antenna for Non-Invasive Continuous Glucose Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26317)
*Huan Wang,Han Xiao,Yi Zhang,Zhi Hua Ren,Yang Gao*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于漏波天线（LWA）的微波非侵入式连续血糖监测方法：利用LWA发射局域行波、在固定工作频率下通过相位测量估计葡萄糖浓度，离体与初步在体实验验证了可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非侵入式连续血糖监测需要能稳定、准确、实时量化葡萄糖引起介电变化的传感技术，现有手段在灵敏度与耦合效率上仍有不足。

Method: 采用漏波天线（LWA）通过受控能量泄漏增强与被测材料的电磁耦合，发射局域行波；在固定工作频率下测量S11相位来反演葡萄糖浓度；在生理介电常数范围（相对介电常数68–70）内评估线性度与相位灵敏度；开展胎牛血清-葡萄糖离体测试，并在两名受试者上进行初步在体实验。

Result: 离体测试在50–255 mg/L葡萄糖浓度区间内获得8.51°的总相移；在体实验中S11相位与参考血糖水平呈强相关（r=0.939和r=0.906）。

Conclusion: 结果表明该LWA传感机制在概念验证层面可跟踪动态血糖变化，具备实现实用化、连续、非侵入式血糖监测的潜力。

Abstract: Non-invasive continuous glucose monitoring requires sensing techniques capable of delivering stable, accurate, and real-time quantification of glucose-induced dielectric variations. This paper presents a microwave-based methodology that employs a leaky-wave antenna (LWA) to launch localized traveling electromagnetic waves and estimate glucose concentration through phase measurements at a fixed operating frequency. The LWA architecture enhances electromagnetic coupling with the material under test through controlled energy leakage, enabling strong linearity and high phase sensitivity within the physiological permittivity range (relative permittivity 68-70). In vitro measurements using fetal bovine serum-glucose samples demonstrate a total phase shift of 8.51 degree across glucose concentrations from 50 to 255 mg per liter. Preliminary in vivo experiments conducted on two human subjects show strong correlations between measured S11 phase and reference glucose levels (r=0.939 and r=0.906), confirming the potential of the LWA-based sensing mechanism to track dynamic glycemic variations in a proof-of-concept setting. These results highlight the potential of the proposed approach for practical, continuous, and non-invasive glucose monitoring.

</details>


### [505] [Resolving the Thermal Labyrinth inside 3D-IC Stacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26647)
*Xufei Guo,Yiyun He,Zirou Chen,Zifeng Huang,Runsheng Wang,Zhe Cheng*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文首次建立面向先进3D-IC的三维热表征方法学，通过时域与稳态热反射技术实现逐层热物性提取并构建位置相关热数据库，揭示互连与衬底热导率的协同演化对散热优化的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D-IC内部热通路长期缺乏对热物性空间分布的实验研究，制约了芯片内部热管理研究。

Method: 构建系统性工作流的三维热表征方法：采用时域与稳态热反射（TDTR/steady-state TR）提取Al走线、TSV、BEOL互连与HB焊盘热导率，并以低至0.2 μm步长对TSV与RDL Cu走线热导率分布进行映射与可视化；样品含2.2 μm直径TSV与约2 μm间距面对面混合键合。

Result: 混合键合结构热导率达9 W/m·K，表现出高效热输运；获得逐层热物性数据并构建位置相关热数据库，实现微米/亚微米尺度热导率分布成像。

Conclusion: 提出基于实验的热模型，指出互连与衬底热导率的协同演化对热设计与制造中的散热优化至关重要。

Abstract: The heat pathways in 3D-ICs have long been a labyrinth lacking experimental investigations into spatial distribution of thermal properties, severely limiting study of internal thermal management inside chips. For the first time, we established a methodology for 3D thermal characterizations of advanced 3D-ICs, implemented through a systematic workflow that enables layer-resolved thermal property extraction and the construction of a location-specific thermal database. We demonstrated its application to an advanced sample featuring 2.2-μm-diameter TSVs and ~2-μm-pitch face-to-face hybrid bonding (HB). Time-domain and steady-state thermoreflectance were used to extract the thermal conductivities (TCs) of Al traces, TSV, BEOL interconnects and HB pads, indicating HB structure enables efficient thermal transport with 9 W/m-K TC. Further, we mapped and visualized the TC distribution of TSV structures and RDL Cu wires with small step sizes down to 0.2 μm. Utilizing these results, we proposed an experiment-based thermal model to reveal that co-evolution of interconnect and substrate TCs is essential for thermal design and fabrication towards effective cooling optimization.

</details>


### [506] [Terabit-scale wavelength-multiplexed transmitter enabled by thin-film lithium tantalate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26674)
*Shivaprasad U. Hulyal,Dengyang Fang,Jiachen Cai,Xinru Ji,Alexander Kotz,Jiale Sun,Christian Koos,Tobias J. Kippenberg*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 基于薄膜钽酸锂（TFLT）单一材料平台，演示了集成合波/分波、独立调制与复用的单片发射机，实现8通道1.6 Tbit/s聚合线速率，并验证与共享光频梳兼容。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI系统面临日益严重的数据搬运瓶颈，需要在电功耗、激光器数量与光纤连接数不显著增加的前提下提升互连带宽；将光接口靠近计算芯片可降低电传输损耗，但要求光引擎兼具高通道容量、宽带调制与简单封装。波长复用虽缓解光纤预算压力，但在紧凑尺寸内集成共享多波长光源、密集波长路由与宽带调制仍具挑战。

Method: 利用薄膜钽酸锂的低双折射与本征Pockels效应，在同一材料平台上单片集成发射机：在单个光输入与输出之间对8个波长通道进行分离、独立调制与再合并，从而在通道数扩展时仍保持双光纤接口。

Result: 8通道测得聚合线速率1.6 Tbit/s；采用共享光频梳在4个通道上实现约0.58 Tbit/s的估计净数据率，验证了与通用多波长光源的兼容性。

Conclusion: 该架构可扩展为多波长复用引擎，为面向共封装光互连的10 Tbit/s级光接口提供路径，并凸显TFLT在单位封装边缘带宽上的优势。

Abstract: Artificial-intelligence systems face a growing data-movement bottleneck and require higher interconnect bandwidth without a proportional increase in electrical power consumption or the number of laser sources and fibre connections. Moving optical interfaces closer to computing chips reduces electrical transmission loss, while demanding optical engines that combine high channel capacity, broadband modulation and simple packaging. Although wavelength multiplexing relieves pressure on the fibre budget, integrating shared multi-wavelength sources with dense wavelength routing and broadband modulation in a compact format remains challenging. Here we demonstrate a monolithic transmitter that brings these functions together on a single material platform, enabled by the low birefringence and native Pockels response of thin-film lithium tantalate. The device separates, independently modulates and recombines eight wavelength channels between one optical input and output. This architecture retains a two-fibre interface as the channel count grows, directly addressing the packaging burden of parallel optical links. Measurements across the eight channels establish an aggregate line rate of 1.6 Tbit s$^{-1}$. Operation with a shared optical frequency comb achieves an estimated net data rate of 0.58 Tbit s$^{-1}$ across four channels, demonstrating compatibility with a common multi-wavelength source. Scaling this architecture into multiple wavelength-multiplexed engines offers a path towards 10 Tbit s$^{-1}$ optical interfaces with high bandwidth per unit package edge, positioning thin-film lithium tantalate for the next generation of co-packaged optical interconnects.

</details>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [507] [Who Plans, Who Edits? Verified, Cost-Aware Division of Labor for LLM-Driven Analog Layout Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24234)
*Xilai Dai,Saeed Mohammadi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文研究"语言模型智能体修复模拟版图"中模型分工与成本问题：在工具闭环验证下，廉价模型可执行计划但难以独立成功，无固定分工在所有任务上最省，据此提出贝叶斯学习控制器按角色选模型并决定升级顺序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 版图修复可由语言模型智能体在签核工具逐次校验下完成，但"由哪个模型规划、哪个模型执行编辑、成本如何"缺乏系统证据；不同任务的最优分配可能不同，需要自适应选择。

Method: 构建工具接地（tool-grounded）修复智能体：模型只选择有界版图算子，每次编辑后由签核工具重跑任务合约检查，不合格版图不被接受。在LVS、DRC及后版图修复上，用两厂商六个同档位模型对三个设计（生产级高压DAC、5V振荡器、SKY130 OTA）做182次盲测。提出学习控制器：由首次工具评估选择各角色模型与升级顺序，每次尝试后更新贝叶斯估计，规则与初始估计在测试前冻结。

Result: 廉价模型可执行但难独立成功（最便宜模型单独1/11，配旗舰规划者16/17，p<0.001）；廉价规划者失败更多；无固定分配在各任务上均最省。控制器在四个封存留出任务上修复7/8，与OpenAI旗舰单独持平；三个任务上每次修复花费为旗舰的15%–40%，但总体花费高8%。最便宜的中间档模型单独修复6/8，单次修复总花费最低，但在最难任务上失败。32个提取的DAC修复在每码处INL与人工引导LVS修复相差≤0.005 LSB。

Conclusion: 模型角色分工显著影响成功率与成本，固定分配不具普适最优；基于工具反馈的贝叶斯控制器可在接近旗舰成功率的同时大幅降低单项修复成本，且修复质量与人工引导方案等价。

Abstract: Language-model agents can repair analog layouts when sign-off tools check every edit, but which model should plan a repair, which should edit it, and at what cost remain open questions. In our tool-grounded repair agent, models only choose bounded layout operators; sign-off tools rerun each task's contract checks after every edit, so failing layouts are never accepted. On layout-versus-schematic (LVS), design-rule checking (DRC), and post-layout repairs of three designs (a production high-voltage digital-to-analog converter (DAC), a 5-V oscillator, and a SKY130 operational transconductance amplifier (OTA)) with six tier-matched models from two vendors, 182 blind runs show that cheap models execute plans but rarely succeed alone (the cheapest model: 1 of 11 runs alone, 16 of 17 under a flagship planner; p < 0.001), cheap planners fail more often, and no fixed assignment is cheapest on every task. We propose a learning controller that selects models for each role and the escalation order from the first tool evaluation and updates Bayesian estimates after every attempt. With rules and initial estimates frozen before testing, the controller fixed 7 of 8 episodes on four sealed held-out tasks, matching the OpenAI flagship alone, at 15-40% of the flagship's spend per fix on three tasks but 8% higher spend overall. The cheapest mid-tier model alone fixed 6 of 8 at the lowest overall spend per fix but missed the hardest task. All 32 extracted DAC repairs match the human-guided LVS repair's integral nonlinearity (INL) within 0.005 least significant bits (LSB) at every code.

</details>


### [508] [MAC units for a 2x2 int8 systolic array on Tiny Tapeout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24326)
*Danila Gorodecky*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 针对开源 2×2 int8 脉动阵列的 MAC 单元，提出两种替换方案：hybrid（按行采用不同算术结构）与 fused_eq（避免构建长进位链的累加），在 Tiny Tapeout/LibreLane 流程下分别实现面积与关键路径的优化，并通过穷举仿真、形式等价证明和原测试台验证正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MAC 单元是脉动阵列的核心，其逻辑面积和关键路径直接影响整体芯片的 PPA。作者希望在保持功能正确的前提下，通过改变 MAC 的算术结构来降低面积与延迟。

Method: 以 Tiny Tapeout（GF180 工艺）上已流片的开源 2×2 int8 脉动阵列 MAC 单元为基线，提出两种替换：1）hybrid——对阵列每一行使用不同的算术结构；2）fused_eq——不构建累加的长进位链。所有数据来自 GitHub Actions 中运行的标准 LibreLane 流程；正确性通过全部 2^24 输入的穷举仿真、形式等价证明及原测试台三重验证。

Result: hybrid 使单个 MAC 单元逻辑面积减少 4–6%，布局布线后整芯片面积减少 0.7–3.2%；fused_eq 使单个 MAC 单元关键路径缩短 20%，整芯片关键路径缩短 14%。

Conclusion: 通过结构层面的算术重构（行异构与进位链消除），可在不牺牲正确性的情况下有效改善 MAC 单元的硬件开销；但两种方案分别侧重面积与延迟，尚未实现二者的联合优化，且面积收益在芯片级别被显著摊薄（至 0.7–3.2%）。

Abstract: We take the multiply-accumulate (MAC) unit of an open-source 2$\times$2 int8 systolic array taped out on Tiny Tapeout (GF180 process) and propose two replacements. The first one, \emph{hybrid}, uses a different arithmetic structure for each row of the array. It reduces the logic area of one MAC unit by 4--6\% and of the whole chip by 0.7--3.2\% after place and route. The second one, \emph{fused\_eq}, never builds the long carry chain of the accumulation. It shortens the critical path by 20\% for one MAC unit and by 14\% for the whole chip. All numbers come from the standard Tiny Tapeout flow (LibreLane) run in GitHub Actions. Correctness is checked by exhaustive simulation of all $2^{24}$ inputs, a formal equivalence proof, and the original test bench.

</details>


### [509] [SpikeDuet: CPU-Accelerator Co-Execution of Sparse SNNs on Commodity MCUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24677)
*Muhammad Fahd Ibrahim Bhatti,Muhammad Ali Siddiqi*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 研究商品化MCU上的MVP（矩阵-向量处理器）能否加速脉冲神经网络（SNN）稀疏推理，并提出snnTorch到C的自动化部署流程，通过硬件校准的引擎选择、保函数的神经元重排序与CPU/MVP异步调度实现异构执行。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SNN产生稀疏事件活动，而商品MCU日益配备密集矩阵-向量加速器，其对稀疏推理的适用性尚不明确；需探究在优化的事件驱动Cortex-M33执行之外，片上MVP能否带来额外收益。

Method: 提出自动化snnTorch-to-C部署流程，包含三部分：(1) 基于硬件校准的引擎（CPU/MVP）选择；(2) 保函数的神经元重排序，将共激活神经元相邻放置以适配加速器、提升活动局部性；(3) 异步调度，重叠CPU与MVP计算。

Result: 在EFR32MG24物理硬件上，五种网络配置下异构执行相对优化的稀疏Cortex-M33实现获得1.27–1.87×加速、每次推理能耗降低11–34%；最小的Braille网络仍以CPU为最优。仅重排序即可将Braille-384的主隐层从CPU迁移至MVP，且该收益在异步执行下依然保持。

Conclusion: 活动局部性与CPU-MVP并发可共同提升商品MCU上的稀疏SNN推理性能；加速器对稀疏负载的价值取决于网络规模与活动分布，需按配置自适应选择引擎。

Abstract: Spiking neural networks (SNNs) expose sparse event activity, but commodity microcontrollers increasingly pair general-purpose processors with dense matrix-vector accelerators whose suitability for sparse inference is unclear. We investigate whether the on-chip Matrix Vector Processor (MVP) of the EFR32MG24 can accelerate SNN inference beyond optimized event-driven Cortex-M33 execution. Our automated snnTorch-to-C deployment flow combines hardware-calibrated engine selection, function-preserving neuron reordering that places co-active neurons adjacently for the accelerator, and asynchronous scheduling that overlaps CPU and MVP computation. On physical hardware, heterogeneous execution achieves 1.27--1.87$\times$ speedup and 11--34\% lower energy per inference than optimized sparse Cortex-M33 execution across five evaluated network configurations, while the smallest Braille network remains CPU-optimal. Reordering alone moves Braille-384's dominant hidden layer from the CPU to the MVP, and its benefit persists under asynchronous execution. These results show that activity locality and concurrency between CPU and MVP can jointly improve sparse SNN inference on commodity MCUs.

</details>


### [510] [Cryogenic Recharacterization of a Commercial 22 nm FD-SOI Foundry Standard-Cell Library](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25498)
*Mohamed Gharib,Rami Rasheedi,Salma Abdelzaher,Henry Shi,Mike Hammer,Llorenç Fanals-i-Batllori,Aldo Pena Perez,Antonino Miceli,Inna Partin-Vaisband*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文为商用22 nm FD-SOI标准单元库开发了低温（4 K）重表征流程，量化了体偏置对延迟、转换时间、电平转换器和静态功耗的影响，并在已流片32位ALU上验证了后布线签核性能提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将数字控制电路置于低温级可缓解量子处理器与室温电子学之间的布线带宽瓶颈，但商用代工厂标准单元库并未针对4 K工作环境进行表征，缺乏可用的低温时序与功耗模型。

Method: 基于商用低温紧凑器件模型，对22 nm FD-SOI代工厂标准单元库开展低温重表征，保留原单元电路、版图、逻辑功能与实现语义，并兼容室温下的综合、布局布线与签核流程；在0、±0.9 V、±1.8 V体偏置下对38,640个匹配的转换/负载点进行延迟量化；同时分析0.8/0.4 V电平转换器及跨电压域静态功耗；在已制造32位ALU的未修改提取物理数据库上做后布线分析。

Result: 相对全偏置，零偏置使上升/下降延迟中位数分别增加38.6倍和33.0倍，约90%的转换超出代工厂定义的最大转换时间包络；0.8 V→0.4 V电平转换器最差下降延迟由零偏置的30.6 ns降至±1.8 V的0.56 ns；0.4 V→0.8 V输出跨域中，无电平转换器直接驱动接收器在全偏置下每比特静态功耗为57.7 µW，采用电平转换后仅0.196 nW；32位ALU的寄存器到寄存器建立时间约束由零偏置的1.3 MHz提升至±0.9 V的37.9 MHz与±1.8 V的132.9 MHz。

Conclusion: 在保持商用EDA流程一致性的前提下，低温重表征流程可有效支撑4 K数字控制电路设计；体偏置是低温标准单元延迟与功耗的关键调节手段，对电平转换器与静态功耗尤为敏感，且能显著提升实际电路的时序性能。

Abstract: Wiring and bandwidth bottlenecks between a quantum processor and room-temperature electronics can be reduced by placing digital control at the cryogenic stage, but commercial foundry standard-cell libraries are not specified for operation at 4 K. A cryogenic recharacterization flow is therefore developed for a commercial 22 nm FD-SOI foundry standard-cell library using commercially available cryogenic compact-device models, while retaining the original cell circuits, layouts, logic functions, and implementation semantics and remaining compatible with the commercial synthesis, place-and-route, and signoff methodology used at room temperature. Body-bias dependence is quantified over 38,640 matched slew/load points at zero, +/-0.9 V, and +/-1.8 V body bias. Relative to full bias, zero-bias operation increases the median rising and falling delays by 38.6x and 33.0x, while approximately 90% of transitions exceed the foundry-defined maximum-transition envelope. The 0.8 V-to-0.4 V level shifter is even more sensitive to body bias: its worst-case falling delay decreases from 30.6 ns at zero bias to 0.56 ns at +/-1.8 V. For the outbound 0.4 V-to-0.8 V crossing, driving the 0.8 V receiver without a level shifter dissipates 57.7 uW of static power per bit at full bias, against 0.196 nW when level-shifted. In post-route analysis of the unchanged extracted physical database of a fabricated 32-bit ALU, the register-to-register setup boundary increases from 1.3 MHz at zero bias to 37.9 MHz at +/-0.9 V and 132.9 MHz at +/-1.8 V.

</details>


### [511] [Heuristic-Driven Resource Optimization for Decoupled Memory Channels on FPGAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25528)
*Arnab A. Purkayastha,Shobhit Aggarwal,Jay Tharwani*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种在LLVM静态分析框架上增加的"启发式精化层"，根据基线内存停顿与性能饱和的相关性优化OpenCL通道深度，避免通道深度过度配置导致性能下降，在保持峰值加速的同时显著提升资源效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DAE架构的OpenCL通道深度决定性能与硬件效率的平衡；传统静态分析工具为保证性能安全往往过度配置通道深度，造成大量资源闲置（resource stranding），亟需更精细、硬件感知的深度确定方法。

Method: 在原有面向自动生成DAE的LLVM静态分析框架上扩展一个硬件感知精化层；指出现有配置中存在的"性能反转悖论"（与基线内存停顿相关），并据此设计启发式精化层，利用基线停顿与性能饱和之间的相关性来优化OpenCL通道深度，定位最小峰值性能点。

Result: 框架在多个基准上成功识别最小峰值性能点；对高停顿、基于网格的kernel，最小通道深度即达峰值性能，深度增大反而导致最高61%的吞吐下降；在HotSpot用例中资源效率提升2.52倍，同时保持峰值执行加速比，优于保守的工具静态预测。

Conclusion: 基线内存停顿与性能饱和的相关性可作为通道深度调优的有效信号；所提精化层可在保持峰值性能的同时给出最精简的硬件配置，避免过度配置的性能陷阱，显著优于传统保守静态预测方法。

Abstract: Determining OpenCL channel depths for Decoupled Access-Execute (DAE) architectures in High-Level Synthesis (HLS) is critical for balancing performance and hardware efficiency. Conventional static analysis tools often over-provision these memory channels to ensure performance safety, leading to significant resource stranding. This paper presents an expansion of an LLVM-based static analysis framework, originally proposed for automated DAE generation, by introducing a hardware-aware refinement layer. We identify a counter-intuitive Performance Inversion Paradox linked to baseline memory stalls, where high-stall, grid-based kernels reach peak performance at minimal channel depths and suffer up to a 61% throughput degradation when depths are increased. We propose a Heuristic Refinement Layer that optimizes OpenCL channel depths based on this correlation between baseline stalls and performance saturation. Experimental results demonstrate that our expanded framework successfully identifies the Minimal Peak Performance point across various benchmarks. By avoiding the performance traps of standard over-provisioning, we achieve a 2.52x improvement in Resource Efficiency for an illustrative HotSpot application. This approach maintains peak execution speedup while ensuring the leanest possible hardware profile, outperforming conservative tool-based static predictions.

</details>


### [512] [MX-Like Tensor Core for LLM Inference with NPU Integration via Hardware-Software Co-Design Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26083)
*Zijun Zhao,Ruichu Ao,Stef Cuyckens,Marian Verhelst,Chao Fang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 针对MX/NVFP4类块缩放量化格式设计空间，开展HW-SW协同探索，证明缩放格式仅在激进FP4量化下起作用，并提出UE5M3格式在FP4场景实现更优精度-硬件折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MX、NVFP4等块缩放量化格式已广泛用于LLM推理，但其由共享scale、权重、激活格式组合构成的设计空间缺乏系统探索，跨空间的精度-硅成本联合权衡尚未刻画，NPU边缘端部署的Pareto最优配置仍未知。

Method: 三项创新：1）在类MX设计空间中定义并系统刻画完整8-bit scale格式族，结合非对称权重-激活精度联合评估；2）构建按格式专用的MAC数据通路模板，实现跨设计空间的公平硬件代价评估；3）开发自动化协同设计流程并集成到开源SNAX NPU平台，支撑联合HW-SW分析。

Result: 协同探索发现scale格式仅在激进FP4量化下才显著影响精度，并给出面向scale格式与非对称权重-激活精度的分场景设计准则；识别出UE5M3为FP4区间的有利精度-硬件折中，相较NVFP4类基线（无per-tensor scaling）困惑度退化最多降低25.3%，代价仅为+0.06%面积与+0.49%功耗。

Conclusion: 通过联合HW-SW协同设计系统性探索了MX类量化设计空间，揭示了scale格式的作用条件，并将UE5M3确定为FP4场景下高性价比的量化配置，为NPU边缘LLM部署提供设计指引。

Abstract: Block-scaled quantization formats such as OCP Microscaling (MX) and NVFP4 have been widely adopted as efficient data formats for LLM inference. However, the design space of these formats spanned by shared scale, weight, and activation format combinations has not been systematically explored, and the joint accuracy-silicon tradeoff across this space remains uncharacterized, leaving the true Pareto-optimal configurations for NPU-based edge LLM deployment an open question. To bridge this gap, we conduct a joint hardware-software (HW-SW) co-design exploration of the above underexplored MX-like design space with three innovations. 1) We define and systematically characterize the full 8-bit scale format family within the MX-like design space, jointly with asymmetric weight-activation precision, identifying configurations that outperform the MX and NVFP4-like (without per-tensor scaling, PTS) baselines. 2) We build a per-format specialized MAC datapath template that enables fair hardware cost evaluation across the space. 3) We develop an automated co-design flow, integrated into the open-source SNAX NPU platform, that enables joint HW-SW analysis across the design space. Overall, our co-design exploration reveals that scale format matters only under aggressive FP4 quantization, yielding a case-oriented design guideline for both scale format and asymmetric weight-activation precision. We further identify UE5M3 as a favorable accuracy-hardware tradeoff for the FP4 regime, reducing perplexity degradation by up to 25.3% relative to the NVFP4-like baseline, at a cost of only +0.06% area and +0.49% power overhead.

</details>


### [513] [A Hybrid GPU and Processing-Near-Memory Architecture with Shared DRAM for Efficient Prefill-Decode Disaggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26131)
*Sanghyeok Han,Inseong Choi,Byungkuk Yoon,Gyeonghwan Park,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: DuoPD 提出一种混合 PD 分离架构，将轻量级近存处理单元（PNM）集成到 HBM 逻辑裸片，通过共享 HBM 接口实现解码全流程在 PNM 上执行，使计算受限的预填充与访存受限的解码可低干扰并发，端到端吞吐最高提升 2.23x。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 推理中预填充为计算受限、解码为访存受限，二者同时执行会相互干扰；PD 分离又导致资源利用率不足——预填充浪费内存带宽，解码浪费计算资源。现有 GPU SM 空间划分方案受限于解码仍需大量 SM 才能饱和带宽，从而挤压预填充可用计算资源，存在固有权衡。

Method: 提出 DuoPD 混合 PD 分离架构：在 HBM 逻辑裸片上集成轻量级 PNM 单元；不同于依赖昂贵内部带宽扩展、仅卸载部分解码操作的既有 PIM/PNM 设计，DuoPD 借助与 GPU 共享的 HBM 接口进行带宽共享，实现解码全流程在 PNM 上运行。配套设计包括紧凑的 PNM 微架构、TSV 级带宽共享机制，以及面向 GPU-PNM 混合执行的层次化数据映射方案。

Result: 在服务器级 LLM 上的评测表明，DuoPD 相比传统 PD 分离方案实现最高 2.23x 的端到端吞吐提升。

Conclusion: 通过将解码迁移至近存单元并与 GPU 共享 HBM 带宽，DuoPD 有效缓解了预填充与解码之间的资源竞争，同时提升计算与内存利用率，为混合 PD 分离架构提供了可行且高效的实现路径。

Abstract: The growing adoption of large language models (LLMs) has significantly increased the compute and memory demands of inference serving. A key challenge arises from the mismatch between compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decoding: when executed together, the two phases interfere, while separating them via prefill-decode (PD) disaggregation leads to substantial resource underutilization. Specifically, prefill leaves memory bandwidth underutilized, whereas decoding underutilizes compute resources. Prior approaches, such as GPU Streaming Multiprocessor (SM) partitioning, attempt to improve utilization by spatially dividing GPU resources. However, these approaches remain fundamentally limited, as memory-bound decoding still requires a large number of SMs to saturate bandwidth, reducing the compute resources available for prefill and resulting in an inherent trade-off. To address this limitation, we propose DuoPD, a hybrid PD-disaggregation architecture that integrates lightweight Processing-Near-Memory (PNM) units into the HBM logic die. Unlike prior PIM/PNM designs that rely on costly internal bandwidth scaling and offload only partial decoding operations, DuoPD enables full decoding execution on PNM by leveraging bandwidth sharing with the GPU over a shared HBM interface. This allows compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decoding to execute concurrently with minimal interference, improving both compute and memory utilization. To realize this design, we develop a compact PNM microarchitecture, a TSV-level bandwidth sharing mechanism, and a hierarchical data mapping scheme tailored for hybrid GPU-PNM execution. Evaluations on server-scale LLMs demonstrate that DuoPD achieves up to 2.23x higher end-to-end throughput than conventional PD-disaggregation.

</details>


### [514] [E-Layout: Layout-Stage Logic Restructuring via RL-Optimized Equality-Saturated Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26432)
*Wenji Fang,Rongjian Liang,Yi-Chen Lu,Cunxi Yu,Chen Chen,Shang Liu,Chenhui Deng,Wenkai Li,Haoxing Ren,Zhiyao Xie*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出E-Layout，一个ML驱动的布局后（post-placement）版图重构框架，联合优化逻辑变换与物理实现，在9个设计上相较工业级商业物理设计流程平均TNS改善6%、WNS改善2%，面积还降低1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先进IC签核性能日益依赖真实物理条件下的版图阶段优化。现有"合成-布局融合"工作多是把估计的物理信息提前引入综合，其优化目标与真实版图阶段行为不完全相关；而版图阶段优化又被固定逻辑结构所限，主要靠缓冲与尺寸调整，从根本上压缩了真实物理条件下的优化空间。

Method: E-Layout包含三部分：(1) 用e-graph等式饱和（equality saturation）构建保持等价性的逻辑替代方案；(2) 用基于图检索增强生成（RAG）的模型将逻辑选择与物理实现耦合；(3) 在设计级时序反馈下用强化学习精化局部逻辑-物理决策；最终在多个子电路中选择时序收益最大且互不重叠的重构子电路集合构成优化电路。

Result: 在9个多样化设计上评估，相较业界领先的商业物理设计流程，平均TNS提升6%、WNS提升2%，同时面积降低1%。

Conclusion: 突破固定逻辑结构的版图阶段优化限制是可行且有效的；逻辑重构与物理实现的联合决策、叠加设计级时序反馈，可在不牺牲面积的前提下显著改善签核时序。

Abstract: Achieving high sign-off performance in advanced ICs increasingly depends on layout-stage optimization under realistic physical conditions. While recent efforts have moved toward synthesis-layout fusion, most existing works still focus on bringing estimated physical information earlier into synthesis, whose optimization does not fully correlate with real layout-stage behavior. Meanwhile, layout-stage optimization remains largely restricted to a fixed logic structure, relying mainly on buffering and sizing. This fundamentally constrains the optimization space under realistic physical conditions. To address this, we present E-Layout, an ML-driven framework for post-placement layout restructuring. E-Layout jointly optimizes logic transformation and physical implementation across multiple subcircuits under design-level timing feedback. This enables the selection of the most timing-beneficial set of disjoint restructured subcircuits to form the optimized circuit. Specifically, it first constructs equivalence-preserving logic alternatives via e-graph equality saturation, then couples logic selection with physical realization through a graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) model, and finally refines these local logic-physical decisions with reinforcement learning under design-level timing feedback. Evaluated on 9 diverse designs, it achieves on average 6% TNS improvement and 2% WNS improvement, while even reducing area by 1%, over an industry-leading commercial physical design flow.

</details>


### [515] [A 105 MS/s 4.18 nJ/inference 0.765 $\text{mm}^\text{2}$ Mixed-Signal Streaming ML Engine for Wireless Baseband in 12LP+ FinFET](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26552)
*Oscar Castañeda,Lavinia Recchioni,Sueda Taner,Thomas Burger,Jérémy Guichemerre,Christoph Studer*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: SIXPPAC是首个用于无线系统实时通感一体化(ISAC)的流式机器学习引擎，集成两路SAR ADC与数字二值权重六层神经网络，在12nm FinFET工艺下以4.18 nJ/推理实现105 MS/s的8位I/Q基带采样处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实时ISAC需要边采样边推理的低功耗流式处理能力，传统方案难以在片上同时完成模数转换与神经网络推断并与基带采样速率持续匹配。

Method: 集成两路SAR ADC与数字二值权重六层神经网络；0.765 mm²、12 nm FinFET、片上存储全部网络参数、0.8 V供电；采用AND门实现双极性内积以替代XNOR门。

Result: 在0.8 V下以105 MS/s持续处理8b I/Q基带样本，每推理4.18 nJ，能效0.42 POPS/W；并在三个示例应用上验证了通用性。

Conclusion: SIXPPAC证明了面向ISAC的流式二值神经网络引擎可在单芯片上兼顾高速采样与低功耗推理，具备多场景通用性。

Abstract: We present SIXPPAC, the first streaming machine-learning engine for real-time integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in wireless systems. SIXPPAC integrates two SAR ADCs and a digital binary-weight six-layer neural network (NN). The 0.765 mm$^\text{2}$ 12 nm FinFET engine stores all NN parameters on chip, enabling sustained 105 MS/s processing of 8b I/Q baseband samples at 0.8 V. By deploying bipolar inner products using AND instead of XNOR gates, SIXPPAC consumes 4.18 nJ/inference (0.42 POPS/W) at 0.8 V. We evaluate SIXPPAC on three example applications to demonstrate its versatility.

</details>


### [516] [Injection of Space Radiation Errors on Low-power NVM using Generative Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26724)
*Eleonora Giudici,Antonio Miele,Luca Mottola*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文为在低地球轨道运行的低功耗FRAM提出一种NVM误差模型：通过视觉分析发现位错误呈规则空间模式，用生成式深度学习自动学习并合成这些误差模式；初步验证中生成位翻转0.92与实际吻合、覆盖实际误差0.91，1万个生成模式的空间分布与实测的Wasserstein距离为0.073（约最大概率质量位移的7%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CubeSat在LEO任务中会遭受物理故障导致的存储器错误，但缺乏能反映真实在轨故障特征、可供应用级实验使用的误差模型。

Method: 卫星搭载商用低功耗FRAM芯片，按预定模式执行重复读写测试；将每个内存快照与参考位图比对以识别位错误；视觉分析发现错误值常呈规则空间分布，据此采用生成式深度学习技术自动学习空间模式并合成新的误差模式。

Result: 初步验证：生成位翻转中0.92与内存快照中的位翻转对应，模型覆盖观测位翻转的0.91；10,000个生成误差模式与实测数据空间分布的Wasserstein距离为0.073，即两分布差异约为其概率质量最大可能位移的7%。

Conclusion: 该生成式误差模型能复现FRAM在轨错误的空间模式，可用于一般应用级实验的错误注入与评估。

Abstract: We develop an error model for a Non-Volatile Memory (NVM) device that represents the effects of physical faults experienced in a CubeSat mission in Low Earth Orbit (LEO). The CubeSat carries an off-the-shelf low-power Ferroelectric RAM (FRAM) chip and runs repeated read/write tests according to a predefined pattern. We compare every memory snapshot received from the satellite with a reference bitmap to identify bit errors. We visually analyze erroneous values distributions in the memory snapshots and we understand that they are frequently distributed according to regular spatial patterns. We define a generative deep learning technique to automatically learn these spatial patterns and to synthetically generate additional error patterns mimicking the observed ones. The model is capable at producing memory errors for general application-level experimentation. Our preliminary validation indicates that when comparing the model output with the data we collect, 0.92 of the generated bit flips correspond to bit flips in the memory snapshots and the model captures 0.91 of the observed bit flips. A comparison of the spatial distribution of bit flips in 10,000 generated error patterns also provides a Wasserstein distance of 0.073, indicating that the two distributions differ by roughly 7% of the maximum possible displacement of their probability masses.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [517] [GardenBench: A lightweight, daily evaluation of LLM capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23866)
*Benedict Cummins-Mburu,Mariana Garcia Mejia,Oscar Heath,Sabrina Kreyzerman,Ellie Murray,Arusan Surendiran,Rohan Alexander*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出GardenBench基准，含11个测试套件，用轻量查询持续评估LLM日常任务表现及其日间变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准缺少对模型性能日间波动（如部署后模型变更、新版本发布带来的进步或退化）的记录，也忽视运行成本与耗时等面向普通用户的信息。

Method: 用多样化的轻量查询系统性地提示LLM，构建11个测试套件的基准，覆盖通用日常任务；记录准确率、运行成本与时间，追踪跨厂商与版本的差异及每日变化，并通过实时仪表盘公开结果。

Result: 可捕捉模型每日准确率变化，识别部署后模型替换或新模型发布引起的性能进步与退化，并实现跨厂商/版本的准确率与响应特性对比。

Conclusion: GardenBench是一个创新、轻量、低成本的面向消费者的基准，聚焦日常任务，补充并多样化现有LLM评测方法。

Abstract: We introduce GardenBench, a benchmark with 11 test suites that evaluate the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) across a range of tasks. By systematically prompting LLMs with various lightweight queries, we document day-to-day changes in model performance, including run costs and times, that other benchmarks miss. This allows us to compare the accuracy and features of responses across model providers and versions. We account for daily variations in model accuracy, capturing both model progress and degradation, for instance, when a model is changed post-deployment or when a new model is released. We base our evaluation on general-use tasks and make our results publicly accessible via a live dashboard, diversifying existing approaches to LLM testing. Our main contribution is an innovative, lightweight, and inexpensive benchmark, designed to be consumer-facing and for everyday tasks.

</details>


### [518] [Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23921)
*Ritvik Garimella,Biplav Srivastava,Amit Sheth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究用1000条需保持运算符优先级语义的算术表达式基准，对比7种方法（Python函数调用、REST、SOAP、MCP微服务、Groq云API直答、5个本地Ollama模型直答、5个本地LLM调用MCP工具的Agent系统），发现确定性方法100%准确且延迟可忽略，直接LLM最高92.9%准确率但延迟超函数调用22,000倍，最佳MCP Agent达99.9%准确率但延迟近1,000,000倍，据此提出按准确率与吞吐需求选型的架构决策框架（ADF）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic AI被广泛认为易于使用，但其相对本地计算、REST、SOAP、MCP等成熟方案的适用边界缺乏实证认知，尤其是在开发速度、性能与运营成本三个维度上；作者希望回答"何时Agent优于传统替代方案"，避免"以更多资源做更少事"的误区。

Method: 受控实验：构造1,000条算术表达式基准，要求保持运算符优先级语义；在同一任务上比较7类方法——原生Function Calling（Python库）、REST、SOAP、MCP三种微服务架构、Groq云API的LLM直接作答、5个本地部署Ollama模型直接作答、以及5个本地LLM通过MCP工具调用的Agent系统；以准确率与延迟为核心指标进行横向测量。

Result: 确定性方法准确率100%且延迟可忽略；LLM直接作答最高准确率92.9%，延迟超过原生函数调用的22,000倍；借助MCP工具的最佳Agent准确率达99.9%，但延迟接近基线的1,000,000倍。即工具调用可修复准确性，却以极端延迟开销为代价。

Conclusion: LLM/Agent方案不适合精确算术计算，应构建基于准确率与吞吐量需求的架构决策框架（ADF）；由于真实互动往往同时包含推理与语言任务，推荐按任务类型选择多种架构组合，而非一刀切的LLM方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. We ran this setup across a native Function Calling baseline (Python library), REST, SOAP and MCP microservice architectures, direct responses from large language models (LLMs) using a Groq cloud API and five locally deployed Ollama models, and agentic systems in which five local LLMs invoke MCP tools. The deterministic methods achieve 100% accuracy with negligible latency. Direct LLM evaluation achieves at most 92.9% accuracy at over 22,000x the latency of a native function call. With MCP tools, the best agent reaches 99.9% accuracy, but incurs nearly 1,000,000x the baseline latency. These results demonstrate that LLMs approaches are poorly suited for exact arithmetic evaluation and motivate an informed architectural decision framework (ADF) for choosing an architecture based on accuracy and throughput requirements. We recognize that an actual interaction with an agent may span both reasoning and linguistic tasks. Hence our recommendation is to explore multiple architectural choices (based on task type) rather than one-size-fits-all solution (LLMs).
  Code is available at - https://github.com/Ritvik-G/adf/

</details>


### [519] [A Controlled LLM Workflow for Evidence-Grounded Diagnosis of Risk Score Differences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23962)
*Hanqing Dou,Zijia Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种受控LLM工作流，结合相似历史交易检索、对比SHAP证据、基于参考案例的LLM推理与确定性校验，用于解释风险评分差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 风险评分差异的解释需要一致、有证据支撑且可追溯；单纯依赖LLM缺乏结构化引导，易产生不一致、缺乏依据的诊断。

Method: 受控LLM工作流：①参考案例检索（相似历史交易）；②对比式SHAP证据；③基于参考案例的LLM推理；④确定性验证（deterministic validation）环节。

Result: 在测试数据集上，与非结构化引导的同一LLM相比，该工作流生成的诊断更一致、更具证据基础、更可追溯。

Conclusion: 结构化、受控的工作流设计能有效提升LLM在风险评分差异解释任务中的可靠性与可审计性。

Abstract: We propose a controlled Large Language Model (LLM) workflow for explaining risk score differences using similar historical transactions. The workflow combines reference retrieval and contrastive SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) evidence with reference-based LLM reasoning and deterministic validation. Experiments on a test dataset show that the workflow produces more consistent, evidence-grounded and traceable diagnoses than the same LLM without structured workflow guidance.

</details>


### [520] [What Social Media Teaches Us About Accumulative AI Risks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24006)
*Dawei Li,Bohan Jiang,Huan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇立场论文，提出"轨迹忽视命题"（Trajectory Neglect Thesis）：当前AI安全讨论过度聚焦于显眼的灾难性事件，而忽视了AI在日常广泛使用中通过重复使用、反复决策与互连部署间反馈逐步累积的危害，并借鉴社交媒体研究的教训呼吁对累积性风险进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流AI安全讨论集中于存在性威胁与灾难性事件（如AI引发的核冲突、工程化生物疫情），这类叙事生动但片面。作者认为存在另一类由AI广泛日常使用而生成并累积的风险，需要一个框架来识别和评估它，以免因关注显性事件而系统性忽视隐性累积危害。

Method: 立场论文/概念论证。以社交媒体研究为类比来源（互惠性媒介效应、社会强化、个体易感性），将相关机制迁移到AI系统分析；以对话式AI为具体场景，考察其生成、语义推断与持久记忆如何收紧反馈回路；并以谄媚（sycophancy）、操纵与隐私损失为案例研究，说明风险如何相互作用并累积。

Result: 识别出四类累积机制：反复的 reassurance（安慰式回应）、选择性暴露、反复出现的决策偏差、不断增长的个人画像，它们可能逐步窄化视角、削弱独立判断或实现剥削性影响，而无需任何单一明确的有害事件。该比较旨在提出待检验机制，而非断言重复使用必然有害。

Conclusion: 呼吁评估使用与部署的累积模式、个体与社会层面的结果、严谨的因果推断，以及兼顾有用协助与用户知情选择的比例性防护措施。

Abstract: Prominent AI safety discussions emphasize existential threats and catastrophic events, such as AI-enabled nuclear conflict or engineered biological outbreaks. This position paper argues that there is another type of AI risk that arises and accumulates from the widespread use of AI. Drawing on lessons from social media, we argue that safety assessments must also address accumulative harms that develop through repeated use, recurring decisions, and feedback across interconnected deployments. Repeated reassurance, selective exposure, recurring decision biases, and growing personal profiles may gradually narrow perspectives, weaken independent judgment, or enable exploitative influence without a single clearly harmful event. We advance the Trajectory Neglect Thesis: a focus on vivid catastrophic events and identifiable incidents risks overlooking less visible harms that accumulate through the widespread daily use of AI. Social media research motivates this position by showing how reciprocal media effects, social reinforcement, and individual susceptibility shape outcomes beyond individual encounters. We examine how related mechanisms may operate in AI systems, using conversational AI as a concrete setting where generation, semantic inference, and persistent memory may tighten feedback loops. Sycophancy, manipulation, and privacy loss provide a case study of how these risks may interact and accumulate. This comparison identifies mechanisms to investigate rather than assuming that repeated AI use is harmful. We therefore call for evaluation of cumulative patterns of use and deployment, individual and societal outcomes, careful causal inference, and proportionate safeguards that preserve useful assistance and informed user choice.

</details>


### [521] [Beyond Explicit Intent: Discovering and Shaping Artistic Intent through Human-AI Co-Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24010)
*Renye Yan,Jialun Zhong,Jikang Cheng,Yi Gao,Yanzeng Li,Ling Liang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种超越显式意图表达的人机协同创作范式：通过扩展模型探索暴露多样视觉可能性，让艺术家在观察、比较与选择中识别潜在偏好，并将策展判断以不同学习强度融入强化学习，形成"探索—识别—塑造—再探索"的循环，使艺术意图被逐步发现、外化与塑造。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式AI创作交互假设创作者能预先明确表述意图并通过文本提示准确传达；但艺术意图常是模糊的、潜在的，甚至只有看到具体视觉可能性后才能被识别，这一鸿沟限制了共创体验。

Method: 1）扩展模型探索空间，向艺术家呈现多样视觉可能性；2）采集艺术家在观察、比较、选择中形成的策展判断；3）将偏好转化为对生成轨迹的差异化学习强度，集成进强化学习，使被识别的方向获得更强强化，模型逐步适配个体审美；4）构建"探索—识别—塑造—再探索"的持续闭环。通过三项用户研究分别考察潜在偏好发现、个性化偏好对齐及模糊难述创作意图的外化。

Result: 通过三项用户研究验证：支持潜在偏好的发现、实现个性化审美对齐，并促进模糊、难以言表创作意图的外化表达。

Conclusion: 艺术意图不必作为创作前提被预先给定，而可在人机交互中被渐进地发现与外化；以探索驱动偏好识别、以策展判断驱动强化学习对齐的范式，为生成式AI艺术共创提供了新路径。

Abstract: Generative AI is becoming an important medium for artistic creation, yet existing interactions often assume that creators can specify intentions in advance and accurately communicate them through text prompts. Artistic intentions, however, may be vague, latent, or recognizable only after seeing concrete visual possibilities. We propose a human-AI co-creation paradigm beyond explicit intent expression. By expanding model exploration, we expose artists to diverse visual possibilities, allowing them to identify previously unarticulated preferences through observation, comparison, and selection. We then integrate artists' curatorial judgments into reinforcement learning, assigning different learning strengths based on preferences over generation trajectories, so recognized directions are more strongly reinforced and the model gradually adapts to individual aesthetics. This creates a continuous "explore-identify-shape-re-explore" loop in which artistic intent is progressively discovered, externalized, and shaped. Through three user studies, we examine latent-preference discovery, personalized preference alignment, and the externalization of vague, difficult-to-express creative intentions.

</details>


### [522] [Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24024)
*Jian Yang,Peiling Liu,Songda Li,Yu Cao,Yuqing Feng,Lan Yu,Jiarong Pan,Jing Ye,Xinwen Huang,Chaochun Zou,Xudong Lu,Huilong Duan,Haomin Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FusionRare 是一个融合符号推理、深度学习、病例检索与大模型推理的多范式框架，在 2,528 例严格隔离病例上实现 SOTA 的罕见病优先级排序，并经随机交叉临床验证显示可提升诊断排名、医生信心并缩短确诊时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 罕见病影响全球约 3 亿人，诊断历程漫长，受临床稀缺性与医学知识碎片化制约。AI 诊断方法虽不断演进（符号方法→深度学习→LLM），但各范式均有结构性局限：符号方法受知识完整性约束，神经模型牺牲可解释性，LLM 系统易受数据泄漏等评估偏差影响。作者认为应调和这些正交范式的互补优势。

Method: 提出 FusionRare 统一多范式融合框架，集成四类组件：知识驱动的符号推理、深度学习的模式识别、基于病例的患者检索、基于 LLM 的启发式推断；通过统计元聚合与知识增强的智能体反思机制进行融合。评估采用 2,528 例严格隔离的临床病例，并设置严格的抗数据泄漏协议，与 DeepRare、GPT 5.5 等前沿 LLM、PhenoBrain 和 LIRICAL 等专用工具对比；另开展随机交叉的医生-AI 验证。

Result: 在 2,528 例隔离病例上达到最先进水平：仅表型诊断的宏平均 Recall@1 为 51%，表型-基因型联合分析为 79%，在抗泄漏协议下显著优于 DeepRare、GPT 5.5、PhenoBrain 与 LIRICAL。随机交叉临床验证显示：45% 的决策中真实诊断排名上升，62% 情况下医生信心提升，确诊时间缩短 21%。

Conclusion: 融合这些正交 AI 范式可显著增强诊断能力，弥合计算基准与临床可用可靠性之间的差距；该工作为在复杂、高风险且资源匮乏的医疗领域部署可信诊断 AI 提供了可复制的框架。

Abstract: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. These results represent decisive advantages over the advanced agentic system DeepRare, frontier LLMs including GPT 5.5, and specialized tools like PhenoBrain and LIRICAL under stringent anti-leakage protocols. A randomized, crossover clinician-AI validation demonstrated that FusionRare elevates the true diagnostic rank in 45% of decisions, improves physician confidence in 62%, and reduces time to diagnosis by 21%. These findings indicate that reconciling these orthogonal AI paradigms significantly enhances diagnostic capabilities, bridging the gap between computational benchmarks and actionable clinical reliability. More broadly, this work provides a replicable framework for deploying trustworthy diagnostic AI across complex, high-stakes, and underserved medical domains.

</details>


### [523] [LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24051)
*Savitha Sam Abraham,Marjan Alirezaie,Hossein Rahnama*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文将T2I生成评估建模为约束满足问题，提出逻辑框架形式化基准域（对象、属性、关系）及约束，评估4个SOTA模型在9类约束下的表现，并给出结合神经视觉检测与逻辑推理的评测方法LogicVal。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有T2I基准虽覆盖属性绑定、数量、空间推理、常识推理等能力，但缺乏统一的形式化逻辑规范来刻画生成图像需满足的约束，难以系统性地定位模型能力边界。

Method: 构建逻辑框架，形式化定义基准域（对象、属性、关系）与生成图像需满足的约束；在从单对象-属性到含逻辑算子（∀、∃、count、→）的多对象关系约束共9类约束上评估4个SOTA T2I模型；考察组合泛化与不可满足约束识别；提出LogicVal，将神经视觉检测与逻辑推理结合以判定约束满足性。

Result: 单对象约束最佳模型准确率98%，复杂条件多对象关系约束仅53%；组合泛化上，最佳模型从单约束84%降至多约束同时满足的20%；不可满足约束识别最佳仅23%；在CLEVR上LogicVal取得0.88–0.98的ROC-AUC，与人类判断高度一致。

Conclusion: 基于逻辑的评估能有效刻画T2I模型的能力与局限，揭示了简单约束与复杂逻辑约束之间的显著鸿沟，LogicVal为约束满足性评估提供了与人类判断对齐的自动化方法。

Abstract: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. We assess compositional generalisation, finding that the best-performing model`s accuracy drops from 84% on single-constraint prompts to 20% when satisfying multiple constraints simultaneously. Identifying unsatisfiable constraints is also challenging, with the best model correctly recognizing only 23% of such prompts. Building on this framework, we introduce \textbf{LogicVal}, an evaluation methodology that combines neural visual detection with logical reasoning to assess constraint satisfaction in generated images. On CLEVR, LogicVal achieves ROC-AUC scores ranging from 0.88 to 0.98, indicating strong alignment with human judgments. These findings underscore the value of logic-based evaluation for characterizing T2I model capabilities and limitations.

</details>


### [524] [World of SWECraft: Agent Collaboration at Scale via Simulated Software Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24061)
*Shannon Zejiang Shen,Yapei Chang,Qiyao Liang,Benjamin Newman,Jenny Liang,Rulin Shao,Ziqiao Ma,Junjie Oscar Yin,Yung-Sung Chuang,Weijia Shi,Yejin Choi,Luke Zettlemoyer,Pang Wei Koh,Mohit Iyyer,Tongshuang Wu,David Sontag*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Software World 框架，模拟多智能体在真实软件生态中的协作办公，并发现协作带来的性能提升随推理时计算量扩展，最佳模型可将下游效率提升最多31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体协作被视为扩展推理时计算的另一维度，但其有效性机制尚不清楚，缺乏可控、真实的实验平台来研究通信、所有权与资源分配等协作要素的作用。

Method: 构建 Software World 框架及其流水线，生成由不同主题、规模和依赖结构的真实相互依赖 Python 包组成的环境（software worlds）；智能体以提升软件效率为高层目标自主发现任务并协作维护包；通过隐藏依赖包的加速比进行集体评估，并可变地调控通信、所有权与资源分配。

Result: 在三个世界中运行模拟，覆盖8个模型、总计超过10,000小时智能体工作时长；性能提升随推理时计算量扩展，最佳模型使下游效率提升至多31%；多数智能体可通过协作发现有意义任务，但部分前沿模型会过早停止寻找改进、进展甚微。

Conclusion: 协作可作为扩展推理时计算的有效维度，Software World 为研究智能体协作机制提供了可控可复现平台，并已开源框架与运行轨迹。

Abstract: As teams of AI agents take on larger projects and long-standing open problems, agent collaboration offers another dimension for scaling inference-time compute. To understand what makes such collaboration effective and scalable, we develop Software World, a framework for simulating multi-agent coworking in realistic software ecosystems. It comes with a pipeline to create environments of real, interdependent Python packages of different topics, sizes, and dependency structures, which we call software worlds. In a simulation, agents maintain packages in the world with a high-level goal of improving software efficiency, and they are free to discover tasks to work on and collaborate with others. We evaluate agents' work in a world collectively by measuring speedup in hidden dependent packages. The framework allows us to study different elements of collaboration by varying communication, ownership, and resource allocation. We run simulations in three different worlds, totaling more than 10,000 hours of agent work across eight models. Overall, performance improvement scales with inference-time compute, with the best model improving downstream efficiency by up to 31%. We show that most agents can find meaningful tasks via collaboration, but some frontier models can prematurely stop looking for improvements and make little progress. We release the simulation framework and traces to support future studies of agent collaboration at https://szj.io/sw.

</details>


### [525] [Persistent Memory and Iterative Improvement in an LLM Agent for Chinese-Character Drawing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24090)
*Peilin Wu,Yi-Zhuang You*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文在汉字程序化绘制任务（668题、5种agent条件）上考察持久记忆对LLM agent解题的帮助及记忆设计的影响：自由笔记记忆使首次成功率提升4.6个百分点，自由笔记+可复用代码库提升2.8个百分点，二者总体无显著差异，但代码库在后期更难题目上有暗示性优势；事后比较显示给予目标特定结构监督时提升更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验从以往尝试中积累的持久记忆能否帮助LLM agent解决新问题，以及记忆的设计方式是否影响这种收益的性质与落点（即使平均收益有限）。

Method: 构建汉字程序化绘制基准，共668个题目，设置五种agent条件进行对照实验；比较两种记忆设计——自由形式笔记记忆、自由形式记忆结合可复用代码库——对首次尝试成功率的影响，并辅以对后期更难题目的事后分层分析，以及代码库agent在获得目标特定结构监督下的事后比较。

Result: 尽管记忆库规模显著增长，聚合收益仅属温和：自由笔记记忆首次成功率提升4.6个百分点，笔记+代码库组合提升2.8个百分点；两种设计总体差异不显著，代码库在后期更难题目上表现出暗示性优势；在privileged的目标特定结构监督下，代码库agent的改进幅度大得多。

Conclusion: 记忆设计可能决定积累经验在何处发挥作用，即便其平均收益温和；agent具备利用高信息量结构指导的能力，但逐题的特权信息无法界定仅凭经验本身可习得的收益边界，该问题仍待研究。

Abstract: Does persistent memory accumulated from previous attempts help an LLM agent solve new problems, and does memory design affect that benefit? We study programmatic Chinese-character drawing across five agent conditions attempting the same 668 items. Accumulated memory produces modest aggregate gains despite substantial growth in the memory stores: free-form notes improve first-attempt success by 4.6 percentage points, while a design combining free-form memory with reusable code improves it by 2.8 points. The two designs do not differ significantly overall, but the code bank shows a suggestive advantage on later, harder items. A separate post-hoc comparison finds a much larger improvement when the code-bank agent receives privileged, target-specific structural supervision. The agent can therefore exploit highly informative structural guidance, although the privileged per-item information does not establish what could have been learned from experience alone. These results suggest that memory design may affect where accumulated experience becomes useful, even when its average benefit is modest.

</details>


### [526] [A Generic On-Board AI Processing Chain for Earth Observation: From Application Development to Embedded Deployment and Mission-Level Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26340)
*Michel-Fran{\c c}ois Foulon,Liz Ramos Medina,Thomas Goudemant,Clotilde Szywala,Virgile Robles,Cl{é}ment Petitjean,Ad{è}le Hankache,Omar Hlimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一套通用的星载AI处理链，以野火分割为例，涵盖模型调优与int8量化并移植到AMD Versal VCK190、模块化切块-推理-拼接工作流实现从瓦片级到场景级、以及基于unikernel与云原生编排器ORCHIDE的星上执行，并进行端到端性能刻画。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对地观测卫星采集的数据量超过其下行能力，需在星上以AI提取信息、仅下传掩膜或检测结果等紧凑产品以实现数据缩减；但实际任务部署涉及整条处理链而非仅神经网络，因此需要面向完整链路的成熟化方案。

Method: 沿三条主线构建：①模型经光谱波段选择与输入归一化调优后量化为8位整数并移植至AMD Versal VCK190；②采用模块化tiler-inference-mosaicer工作流，跨应用复用，将瓦片级模型扩展到场景级输出；③每一步骤封装为unikernel，由云原生编排器ORCHIDE在星上编排；并以野火分割为主例，兼顾船舶检测与云分割。

Result: 量化移植后在板上保持了优异的分割性能；tiler-inference-mosaicer工作流可原样复用于不同应用并生成场景级掩膜或检测列表；在代表性测试台上完成了从目标平台独立执行到并行工作流编排执行的端到端表征。

Conclusion: 该方法超越单瓦片AI推理，通过覆盖从采集场景到任务级执行的完整处理链，提升星载AI部署的成熟度。

Abstract: Earth observation satellites acquire more data than they can downlink. Extracting information on board with artificial intelligence (AI) turns the satellite into a data-reduction stage that downlinks compact products, such as masks or detections, instead of full scenes; deploying it in a mission, however, involves the whole processing chain and not only the neural network. We present a generic on-board AI processing chain along three axes, with wildfire segmentation as the worked example among ship detection and cloud segmentation. (i) The AI model is tuned (spectral-band selection, input normalization), quantized to 8-bit integers (int8) and ported to an AMD Versal VCK190, with its excellent segmentation performance preserved on the board. (ii) A modular tiler-inference-mosaicer workflow, reused unchanged across applications, brings the tile-level model to scene level, turning a full acquisition into a scene-level mask or detection list. (iii) Each step is packaged as a unikernel and orchestrated on board by ORCHIDE, a cloud-native orchestrator. The chain is characterized end to end, from the standalone execution on the target to its execution under orchestration with parallel workflows on a representative test bench. Beyond AI inference on individual tiles, this approach aims at increasing the maturity of on-board AI deployment by addressing a complete processing chain, from the acquired scene to the mission-level execution.

</details>


### [527] [Cache2LoRA: Understanding and Improving Context Internalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24107)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Zhenyu Bi,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Cache2LoRA：用查询聚合冻结文档缓存中的证据再生成LoRA更新，在17个任务上macro F1达0.663（接近全文ICL的0.671），32K文档下解码吞吐为全文ICL的5.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有context-to-LoRA方法将文档编码为低秩参数更新以替代把原文留在解码上下文中，但其能否可靠保留事实、并在不同指令下支持作答尚不清楚；论文通过受控诊断分离出事实判别、目标保留与响应适配三个环节，发现竞争来源会干扰答案，且"恢复事实"并不意味着答案会遵循响应指令。

Method: 受控诊断实验分析现有方法中各环节的失效来源；提出Cache2LoRA：以查询为条件，从可复用的冻结文档缓存中聚合证据，再生成LoRA更新；可训练编码仅作用于查询与memory-token后缀，并采用多风格监督同时学习证据保留与答案表达；另与学习式KV变体及保留文档KV的混合方案进行对比。

Result: 目标-only构建与memory-state优化可在固定更新规模下提升事实恢复；17个任务上Cache2LoRA优于现有context-to-LoRA方法，macro F1 0.663，接近全文上下文ICL的0.671；32K文档、256 token输出、batch size 16时解码吞吐为全文ICL的5.9倍；在相同内存规模下，生成式LoRA在长且多样的干扰文本下比学习式KV更稳定地保持答案准确率，且与保留的文档KV结合更好，混合F1与EM更高。

Conclusion: context-to-LoRA的事实保留与指令遵循需分别优化；Cache2LoRA通过查询条件化的缓存证据聚合与多风格监督，在准确率、吞吐与内存效率上取得较优折中，并与KV缓存方案具有互补性。

Abstract: Context-to-LoRA methods encode documents as low-rank parameter updates, allowing language models to answer without retaining the source text in their decoding context. How reliably do these updates preserve facts and support their use under different instructions? Controlled diagnosis of existing context-to-LoRA methods separates fact discrimination, target retention, and response adaptation. Competing sources influence answers, while target-only construction and memory-state optimization improve recovery at fixed update size. Recovering facts also does not ensure that answers follow response instructions. We introduce Cache2LoRA, which uses each query to aggregate evidence from a reusable frozen document cache before generating LoRA updates. Trainable encoding operates only on the query and memory-token suffix, and multi-style supervision teaches both evidence preservation and answer expression. Across 17 tasks, Cache2LoRA improves on existing context-to-LoRA methods and achieves macro F1 of 0.663, approaching full-context in-context learning at 0.671. For 32K documents and 256-token outputs at batch size 16, its decoding throughput is 5.9$\times$ that of full-context ICL. At matched memory size, generated LoRA preserves answer accuracy more reliably than the learned-KV variant under long, diverse intervening text and combines more effectively with retained document KV, yielding higher hybrid F1 and EM.

</details>


### [528] [Joint, Decoupled, or Agent: When Each Multimodal Alignment Paradigm Wins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24108)
*Yi Fang,Gaurav Srivastava,Sirui Ding,Xuan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文比较了联合预训练编码器融合（JOINT）、独立预训练编码器融合（DECOUPLED）与冻结LLM智能体（AGENT）三种多模态范式，发现无单一范式在所有数据集-预算组合中占优，并提出基于目标任务的诊断级联路由方法，可在拟合候选系统前有效选择范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态信息整合存在多种技术路线：联合预训练编码器、下游训练/推理时融合、以及LLM智能体直接调用单模态读出。实践中缺乏关于各范式何时占优的系统性认识，因此需要量化比较并给出可操作的范式选择依据。

Method: 在5个领域、16个配对数据集、144个数据集-预算组合上比较三种范式：JOINT在冻结的联合预训练编码器上训练融合头；DECOUPLED在冻结的独立预训练编码器上训练融合头；AGENT向冻结LLM提供任务指令、标注示例、样本文本及监督式单模态读出。采用均值效用评估，并分析监督预算、任务格式与单模态5-NN精度（Spearman相关）对偏好的影响。进一步设计两步级联路由：先选AGENT或融合，再选JOINT或DECOUPLED，输入为几何特征、监督式表征诊断与文本-标签匹配等诊断信号加任务与预算元数据，并在留一组交叉验证下评估。

Result: 无范式全面占优：DECOUPLED赢54个组合，JOINT赢44个，AGENT赢46个（按均值效用）。ScienceQA、MELD、MetMeme随监督量增加从AGENT转向融合。JOINT在5个QA数据集中的4个上于所有预算均领先；单模态5-NN精度越高，相对偏好越转向DECOUPLED（8个分类数据集上ρ=-0.67）。两步级联在留一组评估中于71.4%的格子选中胜者（仅元数据路由为54.2%），平均相对后悔为0.028（对比0.057）；综合几何、监督表征诊断与文本-标签匹配优于任一单一信息源。

Conclusion: 范式优劣与监督预算、任务格式及单模态5-NN精度密切相关，不存在普适最优方案；利用目标任务诊断可在候选系统训练前预测范式偏好，实现低后悔的自动路由，为多模态系统设计提供实证与决策框架。

Abstract: Jointly pretrained multimodal encoders are a common way to combine modalities, while alternatives integrate their information during downstream training or inference. When does each approach win? We compare three paradigms, instantiated with public checkpoints, across 16 paired datasets in five domains and multiple training-label budgets. JOINT trains a fusion head on frozen, jointly pretrained encoders. DECOUPLED trains a fusion head on frozen, independently pretrained encoders. AGENT gives a frozen LLM task instructions, labelled examples, available sample text, and supervised unimodal readouts. No paradigm dominates the complete 144 dataset-budget combinations: DECOUPLED wins 54, JOINT 44, and AGENT 46 by mean utility. ScienceQA, MELD, and MetMeme shift from AGENT to fusion as supervision increases. Between the fusion paradigms, JOINT leads on four of five QA datasets across all evaluated budgets, while higher unimodal 5-NN accuracy is associated with a relative shift toward DECOUPLED across eight classification datasets (Spearman $ρ=-0.67$). We test whether representation and task diagnostics predict these preferences on held-out datasets before fitting their candidate systems. A two-step cascade combines these diagnostics with task and budget metadata to select AGENT or fusion, then JOINT or DECOUPLED. Under leave-one-group-out evaluation, it selects the winner in 71.4% of cells versus 54.2% for metadata-only routing, with mean relative regret 0.028 versus 0.057. Using geometry, supervised representation diagnostics, and text-label matching together yields higher accuracy and lower regret than using any one of these sources with metadata. These results connect paradigm preferences to supervision budget, task format, and unimodal 5-NN accuracy. Target-task diagnostics thus support selecting among the three paradigms before candidate fitting.

</details>


### [529] [A Conditional No-Hair Theorem for Transformers: How Language Models Forget Their Prompt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24133)
*Shuyang Xiang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究自回归 Transformer 生成 t 个 token 后对 prompt 的保留程度，发现 prompt 引起的隐藏状态差异按幂律 t^{-α} 衰减，训练模型遗忘快（α≈0.55–0.7），未训练模型遗忘慢（α≈0.2–0.5），并证明该偏移上界为 O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t)，提出“条件无毛定理”。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究自回归 Transformer 在生成后续 token 时对原始 prompt 信息的记忆/遗忘规律，量化 prompt 影响随生成长度的衰减速率及其理论机制。

Method: 构造两条不同 prompt 后接相同续写文本的对照实验，测其隐藏状态距离随 t 的衰减；理论分析有限深度 pre-LN softmax Transformer（有界注意力 logits，且 pre-norm 激活远离零），推导偏移界；并用可精确求解的线性 relay 模型验证紧致性与局部指数行为。

Result: 隐藏状态距离近似按 t^{-α} 幂律衰减；训练模型 α≈0.55–0.7，未训练模型 α≈0.2–0.5；理论上界为 O(P(log t)^{L-1}/t)；线性 relay 模型表明该界不可改进，并复现未训练网络中局部指数趋近 1 的现象；用 logit bias 抵消稀释会训练早期停止衰减、后期反转衰减。

Conclusion: prompt 对后续 token 的直接影响随上下文增长而被稀释，relay 机制仅引入对数因子，故其影响趋于消失——prompt 中能存续的属性（如语言）须由生成文本本身承载；稀释是所测遗忘现象的必要条件（未训练网络与可解模型显示其亦充分）。

Abstract: We ask how much an autoregressive transformer retains of its prompt after generating $t$ tokens. Consider two different prompts followed by the same continuation text, so that any difference in their hidden states comes from the prompt alone, and we find that the distance between their hidden states decays approximately as a power law $t^{-α}$, where $α=1$ is the rate at which a fixed prompt's share of uniform attention shrinks and smaller values mean longer memory. Trained models forget fast ($α\approx0.55$--$0.7$), untrained ones slowly ($α\approx0.2$--$0.5$). We prove that this offset is $O\big(P(\log t)^{L-1}/t\big)$ for a prompt of length $P$ and depth $L$. The bound holds for finite-depth pre-LN softmax transformers with bounded attention logits, under one additional condition: the pre-norm activations stay away from zero. The mechanism is geometric: the prompt's direct influence is diluted as the context grows, and \emph{relay} --- continuation tokens passing on what earlier tokens read from the prompt --- can only add logarithmic factors. This is what we call the \emph{conditional no-hair theorem}: given the text generated so far, the prompt's influence on the next token vanishes as $t$ grows, so any property of the prompt that survives, such as its language, must be carried by the text itself. An exactly solvable linear relay model shows that the bound cannot be improved and reproduces the rise of the local exponent towards $1$ seen in untrained networks. Cancelling the dilution with a logit bias stops the decay early in training and reverses it after, so dilution is necessary for the forgetting we measure; untrained networks and the solvable model show it is also sufficient.

</details>


### [530] [TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24161)
*Claudio Basile,Michael Voznesensky,Gunhyun Park,Ben Wilson,Parker Holloway,Zhanyong Wan,Vlad Belous,Manish Khanna,Paul Ganssle,Kevin Gleason,Andrew Dame,Brendan Folie,Bhavya Bahl,Haifeng Jin,Pedro Goncalves Mokarzel,Arian Arfaian,Luke Boyer,Chi Zhang,Yiling Yuan,Adam Mainz,Aditya Patel,Huangze Tang,Jay Gan,Lizzie Liang,Will Froom,Tushar Agarwal,Karlo Basioli,Theotime Combes,Emilio Cota,Minos Papadopoulos,Tudor Pipernea,Yarong Mu,Qi Zhou,Yaoshiang Ho,Aleksey Vlasenko,Alexander Brauckmann,Ziyin Huang,Jack Oh,Jerry Hsu,Tanvi Bajpai,Jialei Chen,Wenjun Gu,Chintan Shah,Chris Chan,Sayce Falk,Chris Jones,Rob Torres,Kat Ko,Lee Howes,Freya Azad,Andi Gavrilescu,Joe Pamer,Bill Jia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TorchTPU 是 Google 与 Meta 联合开源的 PyTorch 原生 TPU 后端，实现开箱即用的模型执行与无缝 TPU 迁移，并通过 eager 执行优化、torch.compile 集成与原生硬件加速提供业界竞争力的训推性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PyTorch 生态与 Google TPU 硬件之间存在使用壁垒：用户希望在不改动模型代码、不引入专有框架的前提下直接利用 TPU 算力，而既有方案在易用性与性能上难以兼顾，因此需要一个"原生且原则清晰"的后端来打通两者。

Method: 以开源协作方式构建 PyTorch 原生 TPU 后端，包含三项技术手段：eager 模式执行优化、与 torch.compile 的编译链路集成、以及对 TPU 硬件的原生加速支持。

Result: 实现模型开箱即用（out-of-the-box）运行与低成本的 TPU 迁移，并在推理与训练两类负载上达到业界有竞争力的性能水平。

Conclusion: 该工作表明 PyTorch 与 TPU 可以在保持原生日用体验的同时获得高性能，为跨框架—跨硬件的协同优化提供了可复用的工程范式。

Abstract: TorchTPU is an open-source collaboration between Google and Meta that introduces a native and principled PyTorch backend for Google TPUs. It enables seamless out-of-the-box model execution and TPU migration while delivering industry-competitive inference and training performance through eager execution optimizations, torch.compile integration, and native hardware acceleration.

</details>


### [531] [Self-Improving Video-to-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24177)
*Hyunwoo Ryu,Eric Ming Chen,Max Wilcoxson,Vincent Sitzmann*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mirror 是一种自监督方法，通过环境交互学习"视频→动作"的逆动力学映射，让具身智能体无需专家动作标注或手工奖励即可跟随视频生成模型给出的视觉规划并自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成模型可作为可扩展的视觉规划器，生成完成新任务的演示视频；但执行这些规划通常依赖在大量人工采集的"视频-动作"数据上训练的逆动力学模型，严重限制可扩展性。

Method: Mirror 不依赖先验动作数据或手工奖励：智能体尝试按视觉规划执行其最优猜测的动作，在环境中产生实际的"视频-动作"配对，再用这些配对训练视频到动作的映射，从而迭代自我提升，逐步更紧密地跟随视觉规划器。

Result: 在 Atari、OGBench 与 DeepMind Control 上优于领先的学习自观察方法（配学习到的视频规划），在使用 oracle 规划时接近专家水平；在 Minecraft BASALT 上优于可访问专家动作或手工任务知识的方法；在 Minecraft 生存中首次仅靠自我改进获得铁镐；在离线设定（有专家动作标签、无环境交互）下取得获取钻石的新 SOTA。

Conclusion: 结果表明，视频模型的进步可转化为更强的智能体能力，而无需相应地依赖手工奖励或大规模专家动作数据采集。

Abstract: Video generative models are an emerging tool for embodied agents: they can serve as scalable visual planners, generating videos that depict how to complete previously unseen tasks. However, executing these plans typically requires a video-to-action or "inverse dynamics" model trained on large, human-collected video-action datasets, severely limiting scalability. We introduce Mirror, a self-supervised approach that learns video-to-action mappings through environment interactions, without prior action data or hand-crafted rewards. Mirror learns by attempting to follow a visual plan by executing its best guess of the underlying actions in the environment. Mirror then trains on the resulting video-action pairs, incrementally self-improving and following the visual planner more closely. Across Atari, OGBench, and DeepMind Control, Mirror outperforms leading learning-from-observation methods with learned video plans, and achieves near-expert performance with oracle plans. On Minecraft BASALT, it outperforms methods with access to expert actions or hand-engineered task knowledge. In Minecraft survival, it is the first method to acquire an iron pickaxe through self-improvement alone, without rewards or expert action labels. In the offline setting, with expert action labels but no environment interaction, it sets a new state of the art in obtaining diamonds. Our results suggest that advances in video models can translate into increasingly capable agents without a corresponding need for hand-crafted rewards or large collections of expert action data.

</details>


### [532] [Agents' Last Doubt: Knowing When to Act and When to Step Back in Tool-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24194)
*Qisai Liu,Qingyue Jiao,Bangwei Guo,Wenxi Dai,Changyi Yang,Jiahe Liu,Dimitris N. Metaxas,Yiyu Shi,Zhanhong Jiang,Minghao Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建ToolSandbox首个反事实数据集（1,036个决策点、3,115个动作结果），训练运行时控制器SURE-Act，在冻结主干智能体上选择动作，离线效用提升0.0309，端到端Overall Score提升最高0.0575。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具使用型LLM智能体在不确定下需在自主行动、收集信息与人工升级之间权衡任务成功、交互成本与不可逆错误风险；但现有交互轨迹只记录已执行动作的结果，替代动作的后果不可观测，导致难以学习这类权衡。

Method: 在ToolSandbox中对每个决策点的每个合法动作逐一执行，按任务完成、交互成本与不可逆错误评估其下游结果，构建反事实数据集；据此训练SURE-Act控制器，在推理时为冻结的主干智能体选择动作，并采用排序学习（learning-to-rank）而非仅回归。

Result: 排序学习使离线动作选择效用较仅回归基线提升0.0309；与Qwen3-4B智能体结合，ToolSandbox Overall Score端到端提升最高0.0575；相较SAGE-Agent与Calibrate-Then-Act的适配决策规则分别高出0.1506与0.1438。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了ToolSandbox首个反事实数据集，并为工具使用型智能体在不确定性下的决策提供了可操作的洞见。

Abstract: Tool-using LLM agents repeatedly face decision points under uncertainty, choosing between autonomous action, additional information gathering, and human escalation. These decisions require balancing task success against interaction cost and the risk of irreversible errors. Learning to make these trade-offs is challenging because existing interaction trajectories record only the outcomes of actions taken, leaving the consequences of alternative actions unobserved. To address this gap, we construct a counterfactual dataset containing 3,115 action outcomes from 1,036 decision points in ToolSandbox. At each decision point, we execute each legal action and evaluate its downstream outcomes based on task completion, interaction cost, and irreversible errors. Using this dataset, we train SURE-Act, a controller that selects actions for a frozen backbone agent at inference time. Our experiments show that learning to rank alternative actions improves offline action-selection utility by 0.0309 over a regression-only baseline. We further show that adding SURE-Act enables end-to-end gains of up to 0.0575 in ToolSandbox's Overall Score with the Qwen3-4B agent. Moreover, SURE-Act outperforms adapted decision rules from SAGE-Agent and Calibrate-Then-Act by 0.1506 and 0.1438, respectively. This work establishes the first counterfactual dataset for ToolSandbox and provides actionable insights into decision-making under uncertainty for tool-using agents.

</details>


### [533] [Distillation, Self-Training, and the Fragility of Learned Chemical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24199)
*Anagha Aneesh,Sebastian Ibarraran,Frank Hu,Jason Liu,Grant Rotskoff*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 用前沿模型监督作为一次性引导，通过蒸馏推理轨迹加自训练，把近乎零准确率的小型开源模型转变为可用的正向反应预测器，并指出准确率不等于稳健推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小分子药物设计的自动化合成规划需要既准确又可被检视和适配的化学推理器；前沿语言模型在反应结果预测上仍不可靠且难以部署，小型开源模型则缺乏必要的领域推理能力。

Method: 提出Resonance模型：先蒸馏开源权重教师模型的推理轨迹，再从自身经过验证的输出中学习（自训练），把一个小型基座模型提升为有能力的反应预测器。

Result: 近乎零准确率的小基座模型变为有能力的预测器；更强的学生模型仅通过蒸馏即超越教师。但稳健性不足：小模型继承教师单遍推理风格，自训练主要强化其已能得出的答案，且在被质疑时轻易放弃正确答案。

Conclusion: 化学推理模型应在答案准确率之外，同时评估其推理过程的稳健性；前沿监督可作为开源模型的一次性引导手段。

Abstract: Automating synthesis planning for small-molecule drug design requires chemical reasoners that are accurate as well as open to inspection and adaptation, yet frontier language models remain unreliable at predicting reaction outcomes and difficult to deploy, while small open-weight models lack the necessary domain reasoning. We show that frontier supervision can serve as a one-time bootstrap for open models on forward reaction prediction. Our models, Resonance, distill an open-weight teacher's reasoning traces and then learn from their own verified outputs, turning a small base model with near-zero accuracy into a capable reaction predictor, while a stronger student surpasses its teacher through distillation alone. Accuracy, however, does not bring robust reasoning: the small student inherits its teacher's single-pass style, self-training mainly sharpens answers it could already reach, and it readily abandons correct answers under pushback, suggesting that chemical reasoning models should be evaluated on the robustness of their reasoning as well as on the accuracy of their answers.

</details>


### [534] [Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24229)
*Lei Jiang,Honghui Bao,Yue Zhou,Zhengyao Gu,Langzhou He,Natalie Parde*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LIFT是一种免训练数据选择器，仅利用部分推理轨迹（短前缀）计算PRCL分数来评估提示价值，在降低选择成本3.7–9.1倍的同时保持竞争力的RLVR下游性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR训练成本高，需要有选择性地挑选高价值训练样本。现有免训练选择方法依赖完整贪心rollout的隐状态来估计提示价值，但数据集中26%–32%的rollout在生成长度预算内无法终止，导致该方法的可用性和成本问题。

Method: 提出LIFT，核心是Partial Rollout Context Lift（PRCL）分数，受pointwise V-information启发，累加"以问题为条件的上下文"与"去除问题的空上下文"之间的token级对数似然比，从而可用短rollout前缀而非完整轨迹对提示打分。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B与DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B上，保留全rollout PRCL分数至少90%和95%的前缀分别只需完整rollout生成token量的26%和4.7%。相比SHIFT，LIFT将选择成本降低3.7–9.1倍，下游RLVR性能相当，并在六个设置中的三个取得六基准平均最高分。

Conclusion: 短前缀即可有效近似完整rollout的提示价值，LIFT为RLVR提供了一种低成本、免训练、且能规避rollout不终止问题的数据选择方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. This enables prompt scoring from a short rollout prefix rather than a complete trajectory. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, prefixes retaining at least 90\% and 95\% of the full-rollout PRCL score, respectively, require only 26\% and 4.7\% of the tokens generated by full rollouts. Compared with SHIFT, LIFT reduces selection cost by 3.7--9.1$\times$ while achieving competitive downstream RLVR performance, with the highest six-benchmark average in three of six settings.

</details>


### [535] [Probing Ambiguity: Adversarial Intent Resolution for Robust Text-to-SQL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24248)
*Youbing Yin,Xujun Peng,Muhammad S. Uddin,Erin Babinsky,Daben Liu,Anoop Kumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR) 多智能体框架，在无需任务特定训练的情况下主动探测并消解 Text-to-SQL 中的查询歧义，在 AMBROSIA 与 AmbiQT 基准上优于 SOTA 的 IntentRL。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Text-to-SQL 系统通常假设自然语言查询与 SQL 之间是一对一映射，但实际中许多查询本身存在歧义，可对应多个产生不同结果的合法解释；因此需要主动发现并消解这种意图歧义。

Method: AIR 是一个无需任务特定训练的多智能体框架：首先构造相互竞争的多种解释；通过 SQL 执行验证这些解释确实产生不同结果；再基于观察到的数据差异生成有针对性的澄清问题。

Result: 在仅提供 schema 上下文（不暴露完整数据库）的设置下，AMBROSIA 上 AIR 各项指标均超过 IntentRL（F1 0.679 vs. 0.618）；无完整数据库时 AIR 性能仅下降约 7%，而 IntentRL 下降约 20%。在因 schema 设计而非语言结构产生歧义的 AmbiQT 上，AIR 在两种上下文设置下均取得更高 F1，且无需任何基准特定适配。

Conclusion: AIR 在歧义查询基准上展现出强性能、高效率与跨基准可迁移性，并在更贴近生产的 schema-only 场景中显著优于强化学习 SOTA，说明显式的歧义探测与澄清机制可有效替代依赖训练的方法。

Abstract: Text-to-SQL systems typically assume a one-to-one mapping between natural-language queries and correct SQL translations. In practice, however, many queries are inherently ambiguous, admitting multiple valid interpretations that yield distinct outputs. We introduce Adversarial Intent Resolution (AIR), a multi-agent framework that actively probes and resolves such ambiguity without any task-specific training.
