ST formalizes under-thinking as a preference issue at switching points, forcing single-path continuations from identified points to yield high-quality reasoning. Then, ST performs thought-level preference optimization by treating the newly generated response as preferred and the original one as dis-preferred. Experiments across multiple models and datasets show that ST effectively reduces token consumption, achieving reductions of up to 63.8%, while maintaining strong reasoning accuracy. Further analysis suggests that ST helps models acquire a generalizable ability to reduce redundant switching across domains and languages. Code is available at https://github.com/MIRALab-USTC/SteadyThought.

</details>


### [604] [One Skill Takes Over: Clashing Agent Skills and a One-File Fix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25064)
*Parsa Razmara,Seyedarmin Azizi,Ardalan Aryashad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出 SkillClash 基准，研究当两个针对同一任务的 Agent Skills 同时进入上下文时模型的行为：多数情况下模型会"接管式"只遵循其中一个技能、丢弃另一个，而技能内的示范示例是主要原因；以同时遵循两技能的单个示例结尾可将接管率降至 1–15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agent Skills 是指导编码智能体完成单一任务的指令文件，用户可从不同作者处安装多个技能，同一任务的多个技能可能同时被激活。现有研究未回答：当两个同类技能文件同时进入上下文时，模型是合并兼容规则，还是只遵循其中一个而丢弃另一个。该问题直接关系到多技能组合使用的可靠性。

Method: 构建 SkillClash：包含 16 对"同一任务"的技能对，每条规则均由代码校验，并提供参考输出以标定可达最优结果。在 5 个家族、7 个模型（4B 开源模型至 Qwen3-235B、GPT-4.1）上测试三种条件：单独加载、与同类技能共同加载、以及各类干预（在两技能文件末尾各加一个同时遵循两技能的示例、显式指定优先级、显式要求同时应用两技能、由 Claude Opus 5.5 撰写的合并技能文件）。

Result: 单独加载时规则遵循率为 93–99%，与同类技能并置时降至 61–62%。多数输出呈现"接管"现象：仅某一技能要求的规则全部遵循，仅另一技能要求的规则全部丢弃。示范示例是驱动因素：若每个技能文件末尾加入一个同时遵循两技能的示例，6 个受测模型上的接管率降至 1–15%。指定技能优先级无法恢复被丢弃技能，要求同时应用两技能仅在两个强模型上部分恢复且交互规则仍失效。最强模型 Claude Opus 5.5 撰写的合并技能文件使全部 7 个模型对可达规则的遵循率达 96–99%，其增益主要来自其中唯一的示范示例，且该示例仅在其正确时才有效。

Conclusion: 同类技能并置时模型表现出强烈的"接管"失效模式，根源在于技能内的示范示例而非规则文本；通过提供正确且同时体现两技能规则的单一示例可显著缓解该问题。合并技能文件是高鲁棒性方案，但有效性与示例正确性强相关。代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Agent Skills are instruction files that tell a coding agent how to do one job. Users install skills from many authors, so two skills for the same job can be active at the same time. We ask what a model does when both skill files are in its context: does it combine their compatible rules, or follow one skill and drop the other? We build SkillClash, 16 pairs of same-job skills in which code checks every rule and a reference output shows the best result that can be reached. On seven models from five families, from 4B open models to Qwen3-235B and GPT-4.1, a skill's rules are followed 93 to 99% of the time when it is loaded alone and 61 to 62% when a same-job skill is loaded next to it. Most outputs show takeover: every rule that only one skill asks for is followed, and every rule that only the other skill asks for is dropped. The worked examples inside the skills drive this. When each skill file instead ends with one example that follows both skills, takeover falls to 1 to 15% on the six models we tested. Telling the model which skill has priority does not bring the dropped skill back, and telling it to apply both skills brings the dropped skill back only on the two strong models and leaves the interacting rules broken. One merged skill file written by the strongest model we used, Claude Opus 5.5, lets all seven models follow 96 to 99% of the achievable rules. Most of its gain over a plain list of both skills' rules comes from its one worked example, and such an example helps only when it is correct. Code and data: https://github.com/prazmara/skillclash

</details>


### [605] [DAGLoop: Aligning Method Design with Experimental Feedback in Automated AI Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25089)
*Dengyuxing Wang,Yonggang Zhang,Qianshu Cai,Huajiang Zheng,Jun Song,Yangqiu Song,Yike Guo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: DAGLoop 提出用"消融实验规格化"来评判 AI 研究智能体候选方法中的每个设计决策：将决策理由转写为可检验预期并配套定向实验，把消融规划建模为依赖 DAG，从而在结构化研究记忆中精确定位哪些决策有效、应保留或修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动化 AI 研究智能体仅依赖候选方法的整体评估结果来决定下一次修订，但候选方法往往由多个设计决策组合而成，整体指标无法揭示各决策是否产生预期效果、其前置条件是否满足、以及应保留或修改哪些决策，导致修订缺乏可归因的证据。

Method: 受机器学习中消融研究启发，提出 DAGLoop：(1) 将每个设计决策的理由转译为可检验的预期，并配套一个定向实验，形成"实验规格"以验证该预期在所需条件下是否成立；(2) 将消融规划表述为从候选方法设计中构建有向无环图（DAG），节点关联决策与测试，边编码依赖关系，从而明确每个实验需保留哪些决策，并在预期效果需多决策协同作用时支持联合测试；(3) 将结果与所测决策、预期、条件一并记录，构成结构化的研究记忆，用于指导智能体保留有实验支持的决策、修订未被支持的决策，以及在证据未决时规划后续实验。

Result: 在数十个研究任务上的实验表明，DAGLoop 在多种可执行的研究设定中均取得显著性能提升；论文公开了代码与评估脚本。

Conclusion: 通过逐个设计决策的定向消融与依赖建模，DAGLoop 使自动化研究智能体的迭代改进具备可归因性，验证了细粒度实验证据与结构化研究记忆对提升自动研究方法发现效果的有效性。

Abstract: Automated AI research agents aim to improve machine learning methods by iteratively proposing, implementing, and evaluating candidate methods. Existing work uses the outcome of each evaluation to determine how the next candidate should be revised for performance improvement. However, a candidate often combines multiple design decisions, and its overall outcome alone does not reveal which decisions produced their expected effects, whether their required conditions were satisfied, or which decisions should be retained or revised. Inspired by ablation studies in the machine learning community, we propose DAGLoop to test the expected effect of a design decision by comparing implementations with and without that decision while preserving the other decisions it requires. Specifically, DAGLoop translates each design decision's rationale into a testable expectation and pairs it with a targeted experiment, forming an experimental specification for assessing the expected effect under its required conditions. Using these specifications, we formulate ablation planning as the construction of a directed acyclic graph (DAG) from the candidate method's design: nodes associate decisions with tests, and edges encode dependencies. The DAG specifies which decisions each experiment must retain and supports joint tests when an expected effect requires several decisions to act together. Outcomes are recorded with the tested decisions, expectations, and conditions to form structured research memory. This memory guides the agent in retaining experimentally supported decisions, revising unsupported ones, and planning further experiments when the evidence is unresolved. Experiments on dozens of research tasks demonstrate substantial performance improvements achieved by DAGLoop across diverse executable research settings. Code and evaluation scripts are available at https://github.com/deng34567/DAGLoop.

</details>


### [606] [Toward Agentic Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Enterprise Retail Workflows over Heterogeneous Data Sources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25096)
*Jeonghwan Choi,Jibin Hwang,Hayoon Park,Hyeonjae Cheon,Hwanjun Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出面向企业零售工作流的组合式基准RetailBridge，以及零售感知的智能体RAG框架RetailRAG，并揭示多源证据链式衔接是主要瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 企业零售工作流需要智能体在异构来源（结构化产品/订单记录与无序的咨询、评论等非结构化文本）之间链式传递证据，而现有智能体RAG基准难以刻画这一挑战，缺乏受控的评测手段。

Method: 构建RetailBridge：基于人物设定（persona）驱动的模拟生成组合式问题，通过跨异构源链接实体与中间答案，要求智能体识别相关源、跨源携带证据并给出有依据的回答；同时提出RetailRAG框架，包含自动schema简令（auto-schema briefing）、源路由计划链（source-routed plan chaining）与诊断式计划修订（diagnostic plan revision）。

Result: RetailRAG在所有评测维度上稳定优于现有智能体RAG基线；在RetailBridge上以RetailRAG评测十个LLM主干，发现多源链式衔接是跨厂商、跨模型规模的主导瓶颈。

Conclusion: 可靠的零售智能体需要显式的跨源编排，而非仅依赖模型规模扩展；RetailBridge与RetailRAG可作为受控评测零售工作流的参考基准与参考系统，代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Enterprise retail workflows require agents to chain evidence across heterogeneous sources, from structured product and order records to unstructured inquiries and reviews, yet existing agentic RAG benchmarks rarely capture this challenge. To enable controlled evaluation of such workflows, we introduce RetailBridge, a compositional retail benchmark built from persona-driven simulations. Its questions are constructed by linking entities and intermediate answers across heterogeneous sources, requiring agents to identify the relevant sources, carry evidence between them, and produce a grounded answer. To systematically evaluate LLMs on these retail workflows, we develop RetailRAG, a retail-aware framework equipped with auto-schema briefing, source-routed plan chaining, and diagnostic plan revision. RetailRAG consistently outperforms existing agentic RAG baselines across all evaluation axes, serving as a strong reference system for assessing LLM agents on retail workflows. On RetailBridge, evaluating ten LLM backbones with RetailRAG reveals multi-source chaining as the dominant bottleneck across providers and model scales, suggesting that reliable retail agents require explicit cross-source orchestration rather than scaling alone. Code and data are publicly available at \url{https://github.com/DISL-Lab/RetailBridge}.

</details>


### [607] [Explore or Confirm? LLM Agents Misallocate Measurements Under Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25111)
*Abdul Karim,Matt Keon*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 Wellocate——一个带已知真值的模拟实验基准与强化学习环境，用于量化 AI 智能体在"探索新候选"与"复测确认候选"之间的预算分配行为，发现五种语言模型智能体双向失配，并诊断各自成因。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着模型推理成本下降，物理实验成为发现流程中缓慢且昂贵的一环；每次实验返回有噪声的读数，高值可能来自优质候选，也可能只是运气。在固定预算下，智能体必须在探索新候选与复测确认间做取舍，而这一能力此前缺乏可量化的测量手段。

Method: 构建 Wellocate 模拟测定实验：基于生成景观及两个真实蛋白数据集（GB1、PhoQ，经打乱处理以防模型凭记忆作答）。以五种语言模型作为最小智能体（无工具、无跨提示记忆），对照脚本化基线策略，测量其预算分配与最终选择质量；并做干预实验：提供未尝试候选列表、运行读数摘要、景观描述，以及在最终轮对头部候选复测。

Result: 智能体在两个方向均出现错配：三个模型过度确认，将大部分预算用于复测；在生成景观上一个模型确认不足、轻信单次读数。在生成景观上，所有模型的最终选择均劣于基础脚本策略。提供未尝试候选列表可降低复测比例，并在真实蛋白数据上使两个模型的选择显著改善；运行摘要或景观描述带来的变化不超过 5 个百分点。对确认不足者，仅在最终轮复测头部候选只能挽回约四分之一的损失。

Conclusion: 过度确认的根源在于可探索的新候选枯竭，而非信息不足；确认不足的损失无法靠末端补救，确认必须贯穿整个实验过程。作者将 Wellocate 作为带冻结划分与脚本基线的基准及 RL 环境开源，用于在真实实验前评估智能体的预算分配并训练更优策略。

Abstract: As model reasoning gets cheaper, the physical experiment becomes the slow and costly step in discovery. Each experiment returns a noisy reading: a high value can mean a good candidate or a lucky draw. With a fixed budget, an AI agent must keep choosing between exploring a new candidate and confirming a promising one by re-testing it. We measure that choice in Wellocate, a simulated assay campaign with known true values. It is built on a generated landscape and on two real protein datasets, GB1 and PhoQ, scrambled so no model can answer from memory. We test five language models as minimal agents, with no tools and no memory beyond the history in each prompt. They misallocate in both directions. Three over-confirm, spending most of the budget re-testing. On the generated landscape one under-confirms, trusting single readings, and there every model ends with a worse final pick than a basic scripted strategy. Each failure has its own cause. The over-confirmers run short of new candidates worth trying: a list of untried candidates cuts their re-testing and, on real protein data, makes two of them pick much better. A running summary of their readings or a description of the landscape changes it by at most five percentage points. For the under-confirmer, re-testing its top candidates in a final round, replayed on its own campaigns, recovers only about a quarter of what it loses by picking the wrong candidate. This suggests confirmation has to run through the whole campaign. We release Wellocate as a benchmark and reinforcement-learning environment with frozen splits and scripted baselines. With it, anyone can measure how an agent splits its budget before trusting it with real experiments, and train agents to split it better. Code, data and the environment are available at https://github.com/Xstendyl/wellocate.

</details>


### [608] [Spectral Adaptive Graph Transformer for Efficient and Scalable Traffic Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25140)
*Amirhossein Ghaffari,Susanna Pirttikangas,Ekaterina Gilman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出谱自适应图Transformer（SAGT）：空间算子为学习得到、有向、随交通状态条件化，代价对传感器数线性；并以稀疏路网图扩散分支补足局部传播，零初始化门控平衡二者；再用单位均值增益的频带注意力重加权各传感器短时周期性。在六个基准（170–1843传感器）上，单模型误差最优或与最强注意力模型相当，内存约四分之一，训练约快两倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 谱图卷积交通预测依赖拉普拉斯特征分解：立方时间复杂度、由路网固定、对称算子无法表达拥堵的有向传播；注意力Transformer虽消除这些限制，但逐层逐步生成稠密的传感器×传感器注意力图，使内存而非精度成为大规模路网的瓶颈。

Method: 提出谱自适应图Transformer：空间算子为学习而非由拉普拉斯导出，有向而非对称，以当前交通状态为条件而非静态，计算代价对传感器数线性；并用稀疏路网图扩散分支提供低秩算子无法表达的严格局部传播，零初始化门控学习二者平衡；空间混合前，单位均值增益的频带注意力模块按传感器身份与当前上下文重加权其短期周期性分量。

Result: 在覆盖170至1843个传感器的六个公开基准上、以三个随机种子评估：所提模型在其中一个基准上取得所有单端到端模型中的最低误差，其余基准上与当前最强注意力模型竞争力相当，同时内存约为其四分之一，训练约快两倍。

Conclusion: 以线性复杂度、有向且状态条件化的学习型空间算子替代特征分解与稠密注意力，配合局部扩散分支与频域注意力，可在保持或接近最先进精度的同时显著降低内存与训练开销，适用于大规模传感器路网。

Abstract: Traffic forecasting models based on spectral graph convolution offer an interpretable account of how information is mixed between sensors, but they rely on an eigendecomposition of the graph Laplacian. It costs cubic time, is fixed by the road network, and provides a symmetric operator that cannot represent the directed propagation of traffic congestion. Attention-based spatio-temporal transformers remove these limitations but generate a dense sensor-by-sensor attention map at each layer and time step, so memory, rather than accuracy, becomes the binding constraint on large networks. We introduce the spectral adaptive graph transformer, whose spatial operator is learned rather than derived from the Laplacian, directed rather than symmetric, and conditioned on the current traffic state rather than a static state, at a cost linear in the number of sensors. A sparse road graph diffusion branch provides the strictly local propagation that a low-rank operator cannot express, and a zero-initialized gate learns the balance between the two. Before spatial mixing, a unit-mean-gain frequency-bin attention module reweights each sensor's short-term periodicities according to its identity and current context. Across six public benchmarks spanning 170 to 1843 sensors, evaluated over three random seeds, the proposed model attains the lowest error of any single end-to-end model on one benchmark and remains competitive with the strongest current attention models on the others, while using about a quarter of their memory and training about twice as fast.

</details>


### [609] [Memory, Know Your PLACE: Governing Lifecycle State and Query-Time Eligibility in Persistent-Memory Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25179)
*Chen-Fang Hu,Hong-Han Shuai,Woan-Shiuan Chien*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 PLACE——一种因子化治理层，为持久记忆后端增加写侧状态认证与读侧授权，二者结合可在保持查询相关支持的同时实现最佳联合性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持久记忆使先前交互成为持久的智能体状态，但现有系统对"该状态是否仍然有效"以及"是否应影响后续查询"缺乏控制。作者认为可靠记忆必须同时治理状态的形成与查询时的影响。

Method: PLACE 是一个因子化治理层，解耦为两个机制：写侧的状态认证（state certification）与读侧的授权（authorization），叠加于记忆后端。在 Mem0 后端、Qwen2.5-3B 与 Qwen2.5-7B 上做因子化（factorial）评估，以隔离各机制的独立贡献。

Result: 写侧治理显著提升生命周期状态正确性；在状态正确的设定下，读侧治理消除了来自不合格记忆的可测因果泄漏；两者结合取得最强联合性能，同时保留与查询相关的支持信息。

Conclusion: 可靠的持久记忆需要对"被维护的状态"与"查询时的信息影响"同时施加显式控制。

Abstract: Persistent memory turns prior interactions into durable agent state, but existing systems provide limited control over whether that state remains valid and whether it should influence a later query. We argue that reliable memory requires governance over both state formation and query-time influence. We introduce PLACE, a factorized governance layer that adds write-side state certification and read-side authorization to a memory backend. A factorial evaluation on Mem0 with Qwen2.5-3B and Qwen2.5-7B isolates the contribution of each mechanism. Results show that write-side governance substantially improves lifecycle state correctness, while read-side governance eliminates measured causal leakage from ineligible memory in the state-correct setting. Their combination achieves the strongest joint performance while preserving query-relevant support. These findings show that reliable persistent memory requires explicit control over both maintained state and query-time information influence.

</details>


### [610] [Dialogue Generation for Conversational Recommendation Using User Search Interactions and Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25182)
*Minsung Hwang,Donggyu Yoon,Gowoon Hwang,Kwanghee Jang,Joyce Jiyoung Whang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SearCl 通过用户的搜索与点击行为自动生成对话式推荐对话：按查询会话切分交互、以搜索后所选内容作为推荐目标，用可配置概率状态机控制对话流程，并由 seeker 与 recommender 两个 LLM 智能体按轮级约束生成话语；recommender 额外获得由内容元数据构建的知识图谱。基于搜索点击数据生成 3,538 段对话、覆盖 1,731 个唯一目标项，在 LLM-as-a-judge 下质量评分高于现有基准，表明无需人工标注即可实现可控且知识接地的数据集构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模对话式推荐数据集通常依赖人工构建对话或人工标注，成本高、难以扩展。作者希望摆脱人工标注，利用真实用户搜索与点击行为自动、可控地构建带知识支撑的对话数据。

Method: SearCl 流程：将用户交互按查询会话（query session）切分，并从搜索查询之后被选择的内容中推导每个推荐目标；采用可配置的概率状态机控制对话流程；两个 LLM 智能体分别扮演 seeker 与 recommender，依据轮级（turn-level）约束生成话语；为支撑推荐，向 recommender 提供由对话中所用内容项的元数据构建的知识图谱，以刻画其属性与关系。

Result: 基于内容搜索与点击交互数据生成 3,538 段对话，覆盖 1,731 个唯一目标项；在 LLM-as-a-judge 评测协议下，所生成对话的质量得分高于现有基准的对话。

Conclusion: SearCl 能够在不依赖人工标注的情况下实现可控、知识接地的数据集构建，为对话式推荐数据的规模化生成提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large-scale conversational recommendation datasets typically require manual dialogue construction or annotation. We propose SearCl, which automatically generates conversational recommendation dialogues grounded in user search and click behaviors. SearCl segments user interactions into query sessions and derives each recommendation target from content selected after a search query. A configurable probabilistic state machine controls the dialogue flow, while two LLM agents acting as the seeker and recommender generate utterances according to turn-level constraints. To support recommendation, the recommender is provided with knowledge graphs constructed from metadata about the content items used in each dialogue, capturing their attributes and relationships. Using SearCl, we generate 3,538 dialogues from content search and click interaction data, covering 1,731 unique target items. Under an LLM-as-a-judge protocol, the resulting dialogues achieve higher quality scores than dialogues from existing benchmarks. These results demonstrate that SearCl enables controllable and knowledge-grounded dataset construction without human annotations.

</details>


### [611] [BrandEval: A Two-Track Multi-Agent Benchmark for Risk-Sensitive LLM Crisis Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25208)
*Haotian Gan,Weidong Tang,Hanbin Sun,Yi Luo,Xintian Li,Jiayong Wang,WanYue Li,Yudong Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 BrandEval——一个面向产品危机沟通的双轨基准，包含静态评测 BrandEval-Static 与基于多智能体沙盒 BrandPolis 的动态压力测试 BrandEval-Dynamic，并构建中文危机响应数据集 BrandSRD 及基于 Strategic Rationale 的参考策略智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有危机沟通领域的 LLM 基准大多是静态、单轮的，仅评判孤立回复，无法刻画公众反馈与竞争对手行为如何随时间重塑信任，因而缺乏对长时程、风险敏感型沟通能力的证据。

Method: 构建双轨基准：BrandEval-Static 评测利益相关者感知的战略分析能力；BrandEval-Dynamic 在受控多智能体沙盒 BrandPolis 中压力测试响应策略，沙盒包含消费者反馈、竞争对手响应与信任风险轨迹；同时构建中文危机响应数据集 BrandSRD，并以 Strategic Rationale (SR) 实例化参考策略智能体。

Result: 在闭源与开源模型上发现：静态战略质量具有信息量但不完整，与部分终态结果相关，却无法可靠预测波动性与延迟恢复；动态压力测试进一步暴露了在操纵性或依据薄弱策略下的尾部风险失效。

Conclusion: 危机沟通能力评估需从静态单轮判定转向长时程动态压力测试，静态战略质量不能替代动态风险刻画；代码与数据集将开源发布。

Abstract: Evaluating LLMs for crisis communication requires more than judging isolated responses, because public feedback and competitor actions can reshape trust over time. Existing benchmarks remain largely static and single-turn, offering limited evidence about long-horizon risk-sensitive communication. We introduce \textbf{BrandEval}, a two-track benchmark for product-crisis communication, focusing on public brand responses to product-related safety, quality, service, and trust incidents. BrandEval-Static evaluates stakeholder-aware strategic analysis, while BrandEval-Dynamic stress-tests response policies in \textbf{BrandPolis}, a controlled multi-agent sandbox with consumer feedback, competitor responses, and trust-risk trajectories. We also construct \textbf{BrandSRD}, a Chinese crisis-response dataset, and instantiate a reference Strategic Agent using \textbf{Strategic Rationale (SR)}. Across proprietary and open-source models, we find that static strategic quality is informative but incomplete: it aligns with some end-state outcomes but does not reliably predict volatility and delayed recovery; dynamic stress tests further expose tail-risk failures under manipulative or weakly grounded policies. The code and dataset will be available at https://github.com/htgan-ai/BrandEval.

</details>


### [612] [Bridging Concepts: Multi-Agent Reasoning over Scientific Concept Graphs for High-Impact Research Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25281)
*Donggyu Yoon,Minsung Hwang,Juneha Baek,Donghyuk Shin,Joyce Jiyoung Whang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出科学概念图（SCG）并研究高影响力概念对预测任务，构建CIKM/KDD/SIGIR基准数据集，提出多智能体框架MiroGraph，性能优于现有影响力预测与时间链路预测方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究社区中新主题常源于此前未关联概念的首次结合，因此需要预测当前未连接但未来连接后具有高影响力的概念对。

Method: 从论文文本中用LLM抽取细粒度概念作为节点、以共现关系为边构建科学概念图；构建含多种预测设定（包括训练中未见的 emerging concept）的基准数据集；提出MiroGraph多智能体框架：特征设计智能体从结构、语义、趋势三视角设计特征，三个LLM智能体在概念对的包围子图上计算特征值，分类器设计智能体据此构建分类器预测影响力标签。

Result: MiroGraph在影响力预测与时间链路预测等多类方法对比中表现更优。

Conclusion: 科学概念图上的多智能体推理可有效预测高影响力概念对，并支持新兴概念的泛化预测。

Abstract: Within a research community, new topics often emerge when previously unconnected concepts are first studied together. We construct scientific concept graphs (SCGs)--domain knowledge graphs whose nodes are fine-grained research concepts extracted from paper text by LLMs and whose edges capture their co-occurrence in papers--and study the task of forecasting high-impact concept pairs, i.e., discovering concept pairs that are currently unconnected but will have high impact when connected. To this end, we introduce new benchmark datasets constructed from CIKM, KDD, and SIGIR conference papers, with varied prediction settings, including impact forecasting for emerging concepts unseen during training. We propose MiroGraph, a Multi-agent reasoning framework with scientific concept Graphs, in which a feature designer agent designs predictive features for a given concept pair from structural, semantic, and trend perspectives, and then three LLM agents compute the actual feature values from the enclosing subgraph of the concept pair. Using these feature values, a classifier designer agent constructs a classifier that predicts the final impact labels. MiroGraph outperforms various impact forecasting and temporal link prediction methods.

</details>


### [613] [Aligning Language Models with Indigenous Community Cosmovision through Constitutional AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25298)
*Silvia Fernández-Sabido,Jorge Reyes-Magaña,Jesús Adrián Chay Tun,Jean Carlos Buenfil,Victor González Nahuat,Francisco Morales*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将语言模型与拉丁美洲原住民社区伦理原则对齐的系统：基于对五位原住民领袖与守护者的访谈构建含12条原则的文化宪法，在Qwen2.5-7B/1.5B-Instruct上实施两阶段Constitutional AI（SFT+DPO）流程，并部署带RAG的对话界面，使社区可持续注入知识，形成参与式对齐闭环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM主要在反映西方英语世界观的语料上训练，这种不对称并非中立：模型在回答领土、社区权威、人与自然关系等问题时，会以可能与使用系统的社区相异的假设为依据。作者希望建立一种面向全球南方的"认识论正义"价值对齐机制。

Method: （1）访谈五位原住民领袖与守护者，提炼以原住民宇宙观为基础、含12条原则的可操作文化宪法；（2）据此构建两阶段Constitutional AI流程：监督微调（SFT）+直接偏好优化（DPO），基座模型为Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct与Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，仅使用24组偏好对；（3）进行定性分析以区分两阶段贡献；（4）部署带检索增强生成（RAG）的对话界面，允许社区向知识库投喂内容。

Result: 仅用24组偏好对，改进幅度有限但在代际传承、语言审慎性、协商与同意三个维度上可被检测到。定性分析显示SFT阶段带来了对齐的主要转变，DPO则对特定类别进行细化。系统已部署于对话界面并可运行。

Conclusion: 该架构在功能上可行；在语料扩充与算力约束解决后，其效果可望实现质的扩展。该工作被视为全球南方价值对齐中认识论正义机制的首次迭代。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on corpora that reflect Western, anglophone worldviews. This asymmetry is not neutral: when a model answers questions about territory, community authority, or the relationship with nature, it does so from assumptions that may be alien to the communities using the system. This paper presents a system for aligning language models with the ethical principles of Indigenous communities in Latin America. Drawing on interviews with five Indigenous leaders and defenders, we built an operational cultural constitution grounded in an Indigenous cosmovision, with 12 principles. On this basis, we implemented a Constitutional AI (CAI) pipeline in two phases: supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO). The base models were Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. With only 24 preference pairs, improvements were modest but detectable in intergenerational transmission, linguistic caution, and consultation and consent. Qualitative analysis reveals that the SFT phase was responsible for the primary shift in alignment, while DPO refined specific categories. The system was deployed in a conversational interface with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) that allows communities to feed the knowledge base, turning alignment into a participatory cycle. We argue the architecture is functional and will scale qualitatively once the corpus is expanded and computing constraints are resolved. The work constitutes a first iteration of an epistemic justice mechanism for value alignment in the Global South.

</details>


### [614] [Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation for Agentic Knowledge Graph Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25384)
*Mingyuan Li,Yucheng Li,Xiaxia Wang,Gong Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR)，用仅训练期使用的 KG 状态结果模型估计相邻搜索状态间的奖励变化并转化为操作信用，再派生 token 级乘性权重，在不改变优势符号的前提下重分配 token 更新强度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic KGQA 中结果监督强化学习虽可从最终答案得到可验证结果奖励，但把整条 rollout 的结果级优势统一分配给所有策略生成 token，造成"轨迹—操作"错配：同一条轨迹内不同 KG 操作对搜索进程与最终答案的影响差异很大，却被同等对待。

Method: OACR 引入仅用于训练的 KG 状态结果模型，估计相邻 KG 搜索状态之间的结果奖励变化，将其转换为操作级信用，并进一步派生 token 级权重；这些乘性权重只缩放每个生成 token 的更新幅度，同时保持结果级优势的符号不变。

Result: 在三个基准上，OACR 的整体性能优于现有 KGQA 方法，且推理阶段的 LLM 调用次数与 token 消耗更少。

Conclusion: 以状态级结果变化为依据的细粒度信用重分配可缓解轨迹级优势的粗粒度问题，在提升 KGQA 效果的同时降低推理开销；结果模型仅训练期使用，不增加推理成本。

Abstract: Agentic knowledge graph question answering (KGQA) requires large language models (LLMs) to solve complex questions through multi-turn interactions with a knowledge graph (KG). Outcome-supervised reinforcement learning derives verifiable outcome rewards from final answers but uniformly assigns each rollout's outcome-level advantage to all policy-generated tokens, creating a trajectory-to-operation mismatch since KG operations within a rollout can have varying effects on the search process and final answer. To address this, we propose Outcome-Anchored Credit Reallocation (OACR), which employs a training-only KG-state outcome model to estimate outcome-reward changes between adjacent KG search states and converts them into operation credit, from which token-wise weights are derived. These multiplicative weights reallocate token-level update magnitudes while preserving the sign of the outcome-level advantage at every generated token. Across three benchmarks, OACR achieves stronger overall performance than existing KGQA methods while using fewer inference-time LLM calls and tokens.

</details>


### [615] [When Form Changes but Logic Doesn't: Building Logic-invariant LLMs through Logical Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25402)
*Xuyuan Liu,Xinshuai Dong,Elynn Chen,Yujun Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文检验LLM推理是否依赖逻辑结构还是表层语义线索，发现强模型在逻辑等价输入上预测不一致、对未见逻辑形式泛化差，并提出LoGIST框架，将输入映射为决策图并编码为逻辑嵌入以条件化推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在多种推理任务上表现优异，但不清楚其性能源于对底层逻辑结构的理解还是对浅层语义线索的依赖。逻辑等价输入下预测一致性（逻辑不变性）是判断是否真正理解逻辑结构的关键指标。

Method: 在精心构建的数据上进行系统评估，检验模型在逻辑等价输入上的预测一致性与对未见逻辑形式的泛化。提出LoGIST：将每个输入实例映射为决策图（捕捉逻辑结构的有向无环图），把该图编码为逻辑嵌入，用于条件化LLM的推理过程。

Result: 即使是强LLM也常常无法通过一致性检验：在逻辑等价输入上不能保持预测一致，且对未见逻辑形式泛化较差。LoGIST在多种训练设置下降低了逻辑等价下的不一致性，并提升了对未见逻辑形式的泛化。

Conclusion: 逻辑不变性可作为构建更稳健、更具泛化能力的LLM逻辑推理的有用目标；显式逻辑结构引导能有效缓解模型对表层语义线索的依赖。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether this performance reflects an understanding of underlying logical structure or a reliance on shallow semantic cues. A key indicator of such understanding is whether models treat logically equivalent inputs consistently, producing the same predictions despite differences in expression. Through systematic evaluation on curated data, we show that even strong LLMs often fail this test: they do not consistently preserve predictions across logically equivalent inputs and generalize poorly to unseen logical forms. To address this limitation, we propose LoGIcal STructure-guided reasoning (LoGIST), a framework that guides LLM reasoning with explicit logical structure. LoGIST maps each input instance to a decision diagram, a directed acyclic graph that captures the underlying logical structure, and encodes this graph into a logical embedding that conditions the LLM's reasoning process. Across multiple training settings, LoGIST reduces inconsistency under logical equivalence and improves generalization to unseen logical forms, suggesting that logical invariance is a useful target for building more robust and generalizable logical reasoning in LLMs.

</details>


### [616] [Stepwise Reasoning Verification: Don't Generate, Classify!](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25441)
*Yifei Shi,Michalis Korakakis,Rami Aly,Eric Chamoun,Lukasz Szpruch,Andreas Vlachos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文将逐步验证（stepwise verification）建模为自然语言推理任务，发现0.15B编码器分类器优于多数最大4B的生成式验证器，且在相同解码器主干上分类优于生成，约只需十分之一标注数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作集中于大型解码器模型，生成式与判别式验证器结果混杂，尚不清楚哪种范式更有效、大模型是否必要。

Method: 将逐步验证转为NLI：问题与部分解法前缀作为前提（premise），下一步推理作为假设（hypothesis），分类为蕴含/非蕴含；从而实现单步错误定位，并在不同模型规模与标注预算下直接比较编码器分类、解码器分类与解码器判别生成三种范式。在五个推理数据集上评测。

Result: 0.15B编码器分类器优于多数至多4B的生成式验证器；在相同解码器主干上，0.5B–4B范围内分类优于生成，在最强7B主干上二者持平，且分类约用十分之一的标注问题量即可达到可比性能。

Conclusion: 分类是参数与数据高效的逐步验证范式，强验证能力并不依赖大型生成式解码器。

Abstract: Verifying the reasoning of large language models is increasingly important as they are applied to complex mathematical and scientific problems. Existing work focuses on large decoder models and reports mixed results for generative and discriminative verifiers, leaving unclear which paradigm is more effective and whether large models are necessary. In this work, we cast stepwise verification as a natural language inference task: the problem and partial solution prefix form the premise, while the next reasoning step serves as the hypothesis to be classified as entailed or non-entailed. This formulation enables error localisation at individual reasoning steps and direct comparison of encoder classification, decoder classification, and decoder verdict generation across model scales and annotation budgets. Across five reasoning datasets, a 0.15B encoder classifier outperforms most generative verifiers with up to 4B parameters. On identical decoder backbones, classification outperforms generation from 0.5B to 4B parameters and matches it on the strongest 7B backbone---reaching comparable performance with roughly one tenth as many annotated problems. Our findings establish classification as a parameter- and data-efficient approach to stepwise verification and show that strong verification does not require large generative decoders.

</details>


### [617] [System X: An LLM Decision Model That Replies from Its Own KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25456)
*Syed Usama Khalid Bukhari,Syed Safwan Khalid,Muhammad Aamir*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 System X（及 v4）LLM 决策模型，在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中增加“文本回复”选项，并复用决策阶段 KV cache 继续生成，从而在不损害判定准确率的前提下显著改善校准并降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已部署的智能体不仅需要给出选项上的概率，还需要用自然语言回复；若另起一次生成，则需重复 prefill，带来额外延迟与不一致风险。

Method: 在 LLM-as-Jev 读出中加入文本回复选项，当该选项胜出或置信度低时，直接从决策的 KV cache 续写；以 LoRA 在 Reason-9k 与 Bitext 回复样本上微调 Qwen3-0.6B（v4 改用 Qwen3-1.7B、重平衡数据与教师改写回复目标）；并验证在 prompt cache 副本上打分与全序列打分的等价性。

Result: 0.6B：JevBench 准确率 55.4%→54.5%（p=0.87，无显著变化），ECE 0.292→0.169，Bitext 路由准确率 98.3%，M4 Pro 上延迟节省 15–37%，FP32 下回复逐 token 一致，打分偏差 ≤1.4e-6。System X+ 提升支持任务但 IFEval 由 55.5% 降至 45.0%。v4：JevBench 55.0%→61.0%（p=0.04），IFEval 无显著变化（p=0.71），延迟节省 17–39%；一名 LLM 评判者偏好 v4 回复（31:11，p=0.003），另一名不显著。

Conclusion: 缓存复用式“判定+回复”一体化可行，v4 兼顾准确率与效率；但状态冲突与无支撑回复细节仍是主要失效模式，且回复对比存在 prompt 与生成长度混杂，需多随机种子、人工评分与真实支持数据进一步验证。

Abstract: Decision models return probabilities over supplied options, but a deployed agent may also need to reply in words. The present study introduces System X, a large language model (LLM) decision model that adds a text-reply option to the LLM-as-Jev readout. When this option wins, or confidence is low, the same model continues from the decision's key-value (KV) cache, avoiding a repeated prompt prefill. Qwen3-0.6B has been fine-tuned with LoRA on Reason-9k and Bitext reply rows. JevBench accuracy shows no statistically significant change (55.4% to 54.5%, p=0.87), while expected calibration error falls from 0.292 to 0.169. Held-out Bitext routing accuracy reaches 98.3%. Cache reuse saves 15-37% of latency on an Apple M4 Pro, with token-identical replies in the FP32 demonstration cases. Scoring options on copies of the prompt cache matches full-sequence scoring to within 1.4e-6 in probability. Adding dialogue, industry and complaint data (System X+) improves support-task results but lowers IFEval accuracy from 55.5% to 45.0%. System X v4 uses Qwen3-1.7B, rebalanced data and teacher-rewritten reply targets. Against its base LLM, JevBench accuracy rises from 55.0% to 61.0% (p=0.04), with no statistically significant IFEval change (p=0.71). A matched latency test on unadapted Qwen3-1.7B saves 17-39%. One LLM judge prefers v4 replies to an unadapted 1.7B second call (31 to 11 pairs, p=0.003); the other's preference is not significant. These reply comparisons also differ in prompts and generation limits. State conflicts and unsupported reply details remain failure modes. Further studies with several seeds, human raters and real support data are recommended.

</details>


### [618] [On Reasoning Correctness Directions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25464)
*Munachiso Samuel Nwadike,Zayd M. K. Zuhri,Rifo Genadi,Abzal Nurgazy,Ali Mekky,Alham Fikri Aji,Zangir Iklassov,Kentaro Inui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ChainSearch算术推理任务并训练一个3M参数小模型，系统比较线性探针、均值激活差与直接优化三种方法寻找"推理正确性方向"；结果发现该方向可线性解码但不具因果可用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究模型内部是否存在关于"推理是否正确推进"的信息，以及这类信息能否被转化为可用于干预/引导（steering）的因果有用方向。现有线性表示假设常把"可线性解码"等同于"因果可控"，本文质疑这一默认前提在推理情境下是否成立。

Method: 构造ChainSearch任务：在Countdown基础上显式引入搜索与回溯过程，形成可控的算术推理场景；训练一个仅300万参数的模型，因其规模小便于精细分析；通过线性探针、均值激活差、直接优化三者在严格搜索流程中寻找内部推理正确性方向，并对所得方向做因果干预实验。

Result: 模型内部确实存在统计显著的正确性方向（可被线性解码），但在因果干预下，没有任何由上述方法得到的方向能稳定提升推理表现。

Conclusion: 在推理语境下，线性表示假设不足以识别因果可用的方向：可解码性不等于可引导性。代码已开源。

Abstract: We present experimental evidence suggesting that information about whether a model's reasoning is on the right track can be linearly decodable without defining a causally useful direction for steering. To study this, we introduce ChainSearch, a controlled arithmetic reasoning task that extends Countdown with explicit search and backtracking. We train a 3-million-parameter model to solve this task. Its compact size allows us to study internal model correctness directions in detail using linear probes, mean activation differences, and direct optimisation, as part of a rigorous search for internal reasoning-correctness directions. We find that while the model contains statistically significant internal directions of reasoning correctness, none of the resulting directions consistently improves reasoning under causal intervention. This calls into question whether the linear representation hypothesis is sufficient for identifying causally useful directions in the context of reasoning. Our code is made available together with this work.

</details>


### [619] [A failure of Imagination: VLMs fail to use visual representations for text, but self-distillation can help](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25470)
*Shashwat Singh,He He,Tal Linzen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文区分"弱多模态"与"强多模态"，通过形状计数任务发现VQA式对齐的VL模型在纯文本变体上并无优势，视觉对齐的文本嵌入也未携带更多视觉结构；作者提出将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏到文本嵌入的优化目标，可在无任务监督下提升纯文本任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VL模型通过VQA目标微调语言模型以关注视觉特征，但不清楚这种对齐是否改变了模型对文本本身的表征——尤其是那些若可视化会更易求解的文本任务（如以文字描述坐标的几何题）。作者希望检验跨模态迁移是否被充分利用。

Method: 提出弱多模态（能回答关于输入图像的问题）与强多模态（文本表征本身视觉对齐，从而提升具潜在视觉结构的纯文本任务）的区分；构建形状计数任务，配有等价的文本与图像规格（文本以线段坐标表示）；将指令微调Qwen-2.5与Mistral同其视觉对齐版本在文本变体上对比，并进行探针实验；最后给出将上下文视觉嵌入蒸馏进文本嵌入的优化目标。

Result: 多模态模型在文本变体上并不更好，尽管在图像版本上表现强；探针实验表明视觉对齐的解码器嵌入所携带的视觉结构并不多于纯文本对应模型；蒸馏目标在无显式任务监督下即可在文本变体上带来增益，且在比对齐时所见的更复杂样本上仍有效。

Conclusion: VQA式对齐未使文本表征获得强多模态能力，仍存在未被利用的跨模态迁移空间；显式将视觉嵌入蒸馏到文本嵌入是一种可行且具泛化性的改进方向。

Abstract: Vision-language (VL) models are typically built by fine-tuning a language model to attend to visual features in service of a Visual Question-Answering objective. We ask whether this alignment changes how language models represent text---especially on tasks where visualization would help, like geometry questions posed in words. We distinguish weak multimodality (the model can answer questions about an input image) from strong multimodality (the model's text representations themselves become vision-aligned, improving performance on text-only tasks with latent visual structure). To test for strong multimodality, we construct a task of shape-counting problems with paired equivalent text and image specifications. This task is trivial when the image is provided, but requires visualization when specified in text as line coordinates. We compare instruction-tuned Qwen-2.5 and Mistral models against their vision-aligned counterparts on the text variant of the task. We find that the multimodal models do no better in this setting, despite strong performance on the image version of the task. Probing experiments corroborate this: vision-aligned decoder embeddings carry no more visual structure than their text-only counterparts. Finally, we provide an optimization objective that distills in-context visual embeddings into text embeddings. This alignment induces gains on the text variant of the task without explicit task supervision, even on samples more complex than seen during alignment. This suggests that VQA-style alignment leaves available cross-modal transfer untapped.

</details>


### [620] [P(Yes): 15$\times$ Improvements via Test-Time Scaling of Decision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25474)
*Lev Stambler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 对冻结的决策模型施加无需训练的测试时搜索：让模型对完整候选答案的"正确性"回答"Yes"并读取其概率作为打分，再搜索得到更高分答案，单答案编辑与联合优化两种方式均在所有模型与测试集上提升准确率，逻辑谜题上的精确正确数提升尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 决策模型（如多选题、是非题）输出各选项概率，但通常只做一次前向推断；作者希望在不重新训练、不修改模型参数的前提下，挖掘模型自身已具备但未被解码策略利用的判断能力，尤其是需要整题所有空都答对的严格正确（exact correctness）场景。

Method: 将模型视为打分器：给定一个完整的候选答案，读取模型对"该答案是否正确"回答"Yes"的概率作为分数；随后在答案空间上做测试时搜索，包括每次只修改一个答案的局部编辑，以及同时改动多个答案的联合优化。该方法仅依赖模型输出的Yes/No概率，因此也可通过公共API对闭源模型实施。

Result: 搜索在所有尝试的模型与测试集上均提升准确率。在128道逻辑谜题上，Qwen3.8-27B的完全正确谜题数从2增至30（15倍），每空准确率从27.8%升至48.5%。在共同的47道谜题上，仅通过公共API访问的StartLux Instant、Perplexity Decider、Clef、JEV，其每空准确率提升4.0–13.0个百分点，三种搜索种子平均的完全正确谜题数分别由10→35、9→26、2→11、9→31.7。

Conclusion: 作者提出一种通用的、免训练的测试时搜索框架，把决策模型的Yes/No概率转化为可优化的目标函数，显著改善其答案正确性，且对仅提供API的黑盒模型同样有效，说明模型的自评概率可作为额外的推断信号被充分利用。

Abstract: Decision models answer typed questions, such as multiple-choice or yes/no questions, with a probability for each option. We add test-time search to frozen decision models, with no training: we show the model a complete proposed answer, read off its probability of saying "Yes" to the proposal's correctness, and search for answers that it rates higher. The search is done either by editing one answer at a time or by joint optimization, which changes several answers at once. Search raises accuracy for every model and test set we tried, and the gains are largest for exact correctness on logic puzzles, where every answer in a task must be right. On 128 such puzzles, it takes Qwen3.8-27B from 2 to 30 exactly correct puzzles ($15\times$) and its per-blank accuracy from 27.8% to 48.5%. On a shared set of 47 puzzles, searching over each model's own Yes/No score raises the per-blank accuracy of StartLux Instant, Perplexity Decider, Clef, and JEV, which we reach only through its public API, by 4.0 to 13.0 percentage points, and raises the number of puzzles they get exactly correct, out of 47 and averaged over three search seeds, from 10 to 35, 9 to 26, 2 to 11, and 9 to 31.7 respectively.

</details>


### [621] [From Proposal to Execution: Modeling Interaction Semantics in Shared Autonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25496)
*Shashank Shekhar,Laurent Jeanpierre,Abdel-Illah Mouaddib*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个"语义感知决策框架"，将候选动作的评估环节显式建模为独立的表征层，使交互语义可复用且兼容标准MDP规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多人-AI系统中，候选动作并不直接执行，而是先由另一个具有不同目标或决策模型的决策实体评估。标准决策论框架直接在状态-动作对上定义转移动态，把"评估"隐含吸收进转移模型，无法显式表达这种交互结构，也难以复用交互原则。

Method: 引入联合动作语言与解释函数，将每个联合动作与上下文映射为"语义结果"；由语义结果诱导转移与奖励动态，从而在标准动态之上增加一层显式的交互语义表征。语义结果作为组织交互原则的显式单元，可经应用特定的评估机制实例化，并在不同交互实例间复用。在共享人-AI自主性中实例化，覆盖建议、授权等交互模式。

Result: 提供一个结构化接口，可将上下文相关的评估与由此产生的执行动态分离指定，且无需修改底层规划算法；框架与标准MDP规划保持兼容，并示例说明交互上下文如何影响决策。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模交互语义层，可在不改变规划算法的前提下统一表达和复用多种人-AI交互模式，为标准MDP规划提供可扩展的语义接口。

Abstract: In many human-AI systems, candidate actions are not executed directly but are first evaluated by another decision-making entity under a potentially different objective or decision model. Standard decision-theoretic frameworks do not require this interaction to be represented explicitly, as they define transition dynamics directly over state-action pairs, allowing evaluation to be absorbed within the transition model. We introduce a semantics-aware decision framework in which a candidate action is proposed, evaluated under an interaction context, and then resolved into an executed outcome. We formalize this through a joint action language and an interpretation function that maps each joint action and context to a semantic outcome. Transition and reward dynamics are induced through these semantic outcomes, thereby introducing an explicit representational layer for \textit{interaction semantics}. Semantic outcomes provide explicit units for organizing interaction principles, which can be instantiated through application-specific evaluation mechanisms and reused across distinct interaction instances. This provides a structured interface for specifying context-dependent evaluation separately from the resulting execution dynamics, without requiring changes to the underlying planning algorithm. We instantiate the framework in shared human-AI autonomy, capturing interaction patterns such as advisory and authorization, and illustrating how interaction context influences decision making. The resulting formulation remains compatible with standard Markov decision process (MDP) planning.

</details>


### [622] [Assessing the AI Readiness of Construction Datasets: A Multidimensional Operational Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25499)
*Xiaoyu Hou,Bo Xiao,Abdolmajid Erfani,Ronghua Xu,Yu Cai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"建筑数据集AI就绪度框架"，含元数据完整性、数据质量与代表性、数据治理与可及性、AI可用性4个维度共30个属性，并对21个公开数据集进行了评估验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建筑领域AI应用快速增长，对可靠建模、评估与复用的数据集需求上升；但建筑数据集在文档、质量、治理与评估支持方面差异大，缺乏一致的AI就绪度评判标准。

Method: 构建4维度30属性的AI就绪度框架；采用属性级打分、适用性筛选，以及自动化与人工相结合的混合验证流程；在7类数据类型的21个公开数据集上实施评估。

Result: 整体就绪度得分0.720–0.964，均值0.879；自动建议与人工核验得分的吻合率为90.5%。

Conclusion: 该框架可对异构建筑数据集进行一致性评估，并识别其就绪度差距。

Abstract: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence (AI) applications in construction has increased the demand for datasets suitable for reliable model development, evaluation, and reuse. However, construction datasets vary widely in documentation, quality, governance, and evaluation support, and consistent criteria for assessing AI readiness remain limited. This study develops a Construction Dataset AI Readiness Framework with 30 attributes across four dimensions: Metadata Completeness, Data Quality and Representativeness, Data Governance and Accessibility, and AI Utility. The framework uses attribute-specific scoring, applicability screening, and automated and manual verification. It was evaluated using 21 publicly available datasets across seven data-type groups. Overall readiness scores ranged from 0.720 to 0.964, with a mean of 0.879. Hybrid verification achieved 90.5% agreement between automated suggestions and manually verified scores. The framework supports consistent assessment of heterogeneous construction datasets and identification of readiness gaps.

</details>


### [623] [Formal Raising: Embedding Verifiable Ethical Properties into the Development of AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25501)
*Rolf Drechsler,Christina Plump*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Formal Raising (FR)：将选定的道德价值表示为显式、机器可检验的属性，贯穿LLM的开发、评估与动作选择，并给出冲突消解与例外涌现的C语言推理框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受Turing“儿童机器”教育思想与近期model raising工作的启发，主张道德价值应从能力获取之初就与能力同步培养，而非仅靠事后对齐（post-hoc alignment）附加。

Method: 基于C语言实现推理框架：候选动作按优先化的伦理属性进行评估；按给定次序消解冲突；严格规则不可击败（non-defeasible）；欠定情形显式报告；例外不编码为特例而从备选方案比较中涌现。并提出受PSL启发的属性层，用于刻画状态与时序要求，讨论其与raising过程的集成。

Result: 给出覆盖生命、真实性、伤害、隐私、自主性与严格规则冲突的示例，说明该框架的冲突消解与例外涌现机制。

Conclusion: 道德价值可作为可检验属性嵌入模型发展全过程，为LLM的developmental（raising）路径提供形式化基础与可扩展的属性层设计。

Abstract: Alan Turing proposed constructing a ``child machine'' and educating it rather than directly programming an adult-like intelligent machine. Recent work on model raising revives this developmental view for Large Language Models by arguing that moral values should accompany capability acquisition from the beginning rather than be added only through post-hoc alignment. This paper proposes Formal Raising (FR): selected moral values are represented as explicit, machine-checkable properties that participate in development, evaluation, and action selection. We present a C-based reasoning framework in which candidate actions are evaluated against prioritized ethical properties. Conflicts are resolved w.r.t. a given order, strict rules are non-defeasible, and underdetermination is reported explicitly. Exceptions are not encoded as special cases but emerge from the comparison of alternatives. We provide examples that cover conflicts involving life, truthfulness, harm, privacy, autonomy, and strict rules. We outline a property layer inspired by a Property Specification Language (PSL) for state and temporal requirements and discuss its integration into a raising process.

</details>


### [624] [Bud ContextCompact 2.0: Context Compaction for Agent Success and Accuracy with Small Language Models and Constrained Context Windows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25516)
*Jithin VG,Ditto PS*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Bud ContextCompact 2.0 通过有损摘要替换早期对话轮次以扩展小模型的上下文可用空间，在 1.2B/9B 模型召回任务和 27B 模型的 SWE-bench Verified 端到端实验中都带来精度/解决率提升，但其收益依赖触发时机与时间预算，需权衡摘要延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮智能体的历史会超出模型上下文窗口，而在小语言模型和受限推理系统上窗口尤为有限。上下文压缩（compaction）虽可延续会话，但有损、需额外一次模型调用，且效果取决于触发时机，因此需系统评估其在何种条件下有益。

Method: 提出并评估内置于 Bud agent runtime 的压缩机制 Bud ContextCompact 2.0；在两类设置中测试：(1) 基于录制会话的召回问答，比较截断、完整 32K 历史与压缩到 16K 预算三种策略，覆盖 1.2B 与 9B 模型；(2) 27B 推理模型在 49K 窗口上端到端跑 100 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务（556 个分级会话），并做阈值/触发时机研究与时间预算分析。

Result: 召回任务：1.2B 模型准确率由 0.247（截断）、0.176（完整 32K）升至 0.335（p<0.001）；9B 模型由 0.515 升至 0.577（p=0.04）。SWE-bench：长会话解决率由 41% 升至 53%（+12.3 个点，95% CI +1.6–+23.0，McNemar p=0.043），短会话无变化，每个已解决任务少用 13% token 且总成本不变。无压缩时的主要失败并非历史溢出，而是推理轮次挤占了历史剩余空间。收益有边界：45 分钟会话预算下增益消失（摘要中位耗时 161 s）；仅当足够早触发、留出空间时才出现。

Conclusion: 压缩在等效模型与窗口下可跨硬件迁移精度收益（含 CPU 推理），但时间成本随硬件缩放，须纳入预算；8B 模型约十轮、5–8K token 后即提交、无需压缩。压缩应作为按触发时机与时间预算设计的机制，而非默认无条件启用。

Abstract: Agents that work for many turns outgrow the context window of the model that serves them, and on small language models (SLMs) and constrained inference systems that window is small. Context compaction replaces older turns with a summary so a session can continue, but it is lossy, costs a model call, and can help or hurt depending on when it runs. We describe Bud ContextCompact 2.0, the compaction built into the Bud agent runtime, and evaluate it in two settings. On recall questions over recorded agent sessions, compaction to a 16K budget raised a 1.2B-parameter model's accuracy to 0.335, from 0.247 with truncation and 0.176 with its full 32K history (p < 0.001), and raised a 9B model from 0.515 (truncation) to 0.577 (p = 0.04). On 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks run end to end by a 27B reasoning model on a 49K-token window (556 graded sessions), compaction raised the resolve rate on long sessions from 41% to 53% (+12.3 points, 95% CI +1.6 to +23.0, McNemar p = 0.043), left short sessions unchanged, and used 13% fewer tokens per solved task at equal total cost. The main failure without compaction was not the history overflowing but a reasoning turn exhausting the room the history left. The gain has limits: it vanished under a 45-minute session budget, because each summary took a median of 161 s, and in a threshold study it appeared only when compaction triggered early enough to leave room. An 8B model submitted after about ten turns at 5-8K tokens and never needed compaction. We argue that the accuracy results transfer across hardware, including CPU inference, for an equivalent model and window, while the time cost scales with the hardware and must be budgeted for.

</details>


### [625] [When Empathy Misses the Goal: A Benchmark for Goal Displacement in LLM Advice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25522)
*Dean Ariel,Guy Laban*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"目标置换"(goal displacement)概念，指对话LLM用维持人设的安抚性内容替代目标相关实质帮助，并构建GDB基准（230场景、9领域、18模型共4134条人工评分回复）进行测量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话LLM常以温暖安抚的语气回应，却未能推进用户明示的目标，这一失效模式缺乏概念界定与可复现的量化手段。

Method: 提出goal displacement概念；构建GDB基准：230个场景、9个领域、18个模型、4134条人工评分回复；采用"硬约束×情感困扰"的2×2分类法，区分陷阱型置换（不敢直面不可行目标或未将共情与实操指导结合）与反向置换（以未经请求的问题解决替代所请求的情感支持）；采用删除检验评分细则（去除纯支持性句子后是否仍有实质帮助）；以人类评分者信度校验，并用匹配的OLMo-2检查点做因子探针，与社交谄媚作区分。

Result: 独立评分者与作者评分在置换严重度上的加权κ=0.82；陷阱型置换率在0.0%–37.7%之间，与Chatbot Arena Elo强负相关（ρ=−0.706，n=15）；反向置换率高达41.9%，且在陷阱型置换极低的模型中仍显著存在；高复杂度低压力条件下谄媚率35.0%但置换率仅7.5%，两者关联很弱，支持其与社交谄媚的区分；OLMo-2监督微调后"共情＋约束"混合置换仍为52.3%，直接偏好优化后降至13.8%。

Conclusion: GDB提供了可复现的诊断工具，用于判断回复是否推进操作化定义的用户目标，可支撑模型比较、后训练评估与回归测试；数据集、标注与评分细则以CC-BY-4.0发布，评测代码以MIT发布。

Abstract: Conversational large language models can respond with warmth and reassurance while failing to advance the user's stated goal. We conceptualize this failure as $\textbf{goal displacement}$, the substitution of persona-maintenance content for goal-relevant substance. To measure it, we introduce $\textbf{GDB}$ (Goal Displacement Benchmark), comprising 230 scenarios across nine domains and $4{,}134$ human-scored responses from 18 models. A $2 \times 2$ taxonomy crosses hard constraints with emotional distress, distinguishing failures to confront infeasible goals or combine empathy with practical guidance from reverse displacement, where unsolicited problem-solving replaces requested emotional support. A deletion-test rubric assesses whether substantive help remains after purely supportive sentences are removed. Independent raters achieve weighted $κ= 0.82$ against author scores for displacement severity. Trap displacement ranges from $0.0\%$ to $37.7\%$ and is strongly negatively correlated with Chatbot Arena Elo ($ρ= -0.706$, $n = 15$). Reverse displacement reaches $41.9\%$, including substantial rates in models with negligible trap displacement. A factorial probe supports a distinction from social sycophancy. Human-scored responses in the high-complexity, low-pressure condition exhibit $35.0\%$ sycophancy but $7.5\%$ displacement, with little association between the constructs. Matched OLMo-2 checkpoints show that mixed empathy-with-constraints displacement remains at $52.3\%$ after supervised fine-tuning and falls to $13.8\%$ after direct preference optimization. GDB provides a reproducible diagnostic of whether responses advance the operationalized user goal, supporting model comparison, post-training evaluation, and regression testing. We release the dataset, annotations, and rubric under CC-BY-4.0 and the evaluation code under MIT.

</details>


### [626] [StopLoss: Teaching Agents to Predict Failure and Stop Early](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25525)
*Jiarong Liang,Xueguang Ma,Dongfu Jiang,Yuxuan Zhang,Ping Nie,Wenhu Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出轻量外部监控器StopLoss，用完整轨迹及其验证器结果训练，在单次前向中为最近工具步骤打分，并在成功运行上校准阈值以触发提前中止，实现低成本失败预测与早停节流。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编码代理会继续运行注定无法通过验证的任务，造成资源浪费；而让前沿大模型充当“监工”来判断是否失败，本身代价高昂。因此需要一个廉价、可独立部署的失败识别机制，使早停带来的节省超过其自身开销。

Method: 借鉴金融止损思想设计小型外部监控器：用最终结果标签标注轨迹中较早的局部窗口，微调语言模型对最近若干工具调用步骤做单次前向打分；在成功运行的分数分布上校准阈值，将分数转为中止决策，且不修改执行器本身。基于GPT系列SWE-rebench轨迹训练，在SWE-bench Verified与SWE-bench Pro子集、GPT与Claude执行器下评测，并与六个读取相同窗口的通用评判模型对比。

Result: 结果监督将失败预测从接近随机提升为首次检查即可用的信号；单次检查成本比所有被测评判模型低1–2个数量级；相对完成所有任务，Verified上保留求解的每任务成本降低4.5%且保留99%成功运行，成本更高的Pro子集最多降低31%，采用Qwen3-8B骨干时达48%；四种设置下其单位保留求解成本均低于所有评判策略。

Conclusion: 经结果监督训练的小型监控器可把失败识别成本压到足够低，使早停机制自身开销被节省抵消，验证了“廉价外部监控+提前中止”作为编码代理成本控制的可行性。

Abstract: Coding agents keep working on runs that will fail verification, and asking a frontier model to watch for this is expensive in its own right. We introduce StopLoss, a small external monitor that learns failure recognition from completed trajectories and their verifier outcomes. The name is inspired by the stop-loss order in finance: StopLoss ends a run early when the run is likely to fail, which saves resources. Final outcomes label earlier local windows, so a fine-tuned language model can score the most recent tool steps in a single forward pass, and a threshold calibrated on successful runs turns that score into an abort decision without changing the executor. Trained on GPT-family SWE-rebench trajectories and evaluated on SWE-bench Verified and a SWE-bench Pro subset with GPT and Claude executors, StopLoss is compared against six general-purpose judges reading identical windows. Outcome supervision lifts failure prediction from near chance to a useful signal at the first check, at one to two orders of magnitude lower cost per check than any tested judge. This translates into savings: relative to completing every task, StopLoss lowers cost per retained solve by 4.5\% on Verified while preserving 99\% of successful runs, and by up to 31\% on the costlier Pro subset, reaching 48\% with a Qwen3-8B backbone, and in all four settings its cost per retained solve is below that of every judge policy. Outcome-trained small monitors can make failure recognition cheap enough for early stopping to pay for itself.

</details>


### [627] [From Clinical Risk Prediction to Operational Decisions: An Uncertainty-Aware Framework for ICU Staffing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25530)
*Jiayan Yang,Ad Feelders,Arno Siebes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种不确定性感知的前瞻性排班框架，将ICU患者风险预测输出转化为受延迟与班次约束的排班决策，在MIMIC-IV上取得优于确定性/反应式基线的成本-短缺权衡，并在校准漂移下保持稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有EHR机器学习模型多止步于判别力指标（AUC等），缺乏将概率性临床风险系统转化为真实运营决策（班次刚性、招聘延迟）的方法，存在"预测—运营"转化断层。

Method: 不改动上游预测模型，构建"转化层"：显式建模动态预测不确定性，用CVaR刻画极端短缺暴露，将风险校准后的聚合需求信号嵌入小时级滚动时域排班策略，生成带延迟约束的人员配置决策；以MIMIC-IV真实轨迹为数据源，与确定性聚合和纯反应式基线对比，并做Pareto前沿分析与校准漂移压力测试。

Result: 相较确定性基线与反应式基线，框架实现更优的成本-短缺权衡；Pareto前沿揭示不确定性感知的需求构建如何随安全偏好改变资源配置；压力测试显示在校准漂移引起的系统性预测偏差下仍具运营稳健性。

Conclusion: 通过形式化预测到运营的转化层，提供了一条可解释、透明的路径，使概率性AI输出可安全融入高风险医疗运营系统；该层与上游模型解耦，具备可迁移性。

Abstract: Advances in electronic health records (EHR) and large-scale critical care databases have enabled the development of machine learning models for the early detection of patient deterioration. While these models often achieve strong predictive performance for outcomes such as sepsis and mortality, most studies evaluate them purely on discrimination metrics. This leaves a critical gap: how to systematically translate probabilistic clinical risk estimates into downstream operational decisions under real-world constraints, such as shift rigidity and hiring delays.
  This study proposes an uncertainty-aware anticipatory staffing framework that bridges short-term patient risk prediction and staff planning without altering the upstream predictive model. Instead of relying on naive deterministic aggregation or fixed safety buffers, the framework explicitly models dynamic predictive uncertainty and evaluates extreme shortage exposure using Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR). These aggregated, risk-calibrated demand signals are then embedded into an hourly rolling-horizon scheduling policy to generate delay-constrained staffing decisions.
  Evaluated on realistic trajectories from the MIMIC-IV database, the proposed framework demonstrates a favorable cost-shortage trade-off compared to deterministic and purely reactive baselines. Pareto frontier analysis illustrates how uncertainty-aware demand construction changes resource allocation under varying safety preferences, while stress testing confirms the framework's operational robustness even when subjected to systematic predictive bias in the form of calibration drift. By formalizing this translation layer, this work provides a principled, transparent pathway for safely integrating probabilistic AI outputs into high-stakes healthcare operational systems.

</details>


### [628] [Auditing Tool Traces in Agentic LLMs: Source Localization and Counterfactual Dependence Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25540)
*Junhao Liu,Tianxiao Li,Yongxian Wu,Ziheng Duan,Ren Li,Jing Zhang,Martin Renqiang Min*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出两阶段审计方法（PT2D + Token-Class Redaction），揭示agentic LLM在TCR-pMHC结合预测中的性能提升实为来源于工具结果中的标签捷径（如数据集标识符），而非真正的生物学推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic LLM被寄望通过整合外部证据为生物学重要问题提供准确且可解释的预测，但序列化工具结果中可能隐藏标签捷径（数据集标识符、模板伪影），造成缺乏生物学推理的"表面成功"。作者希望建立审计手段，在信任基准增益之前识别此类虚假推理。

Method: 提出两阶段审计框架。第一阶段PT2D（Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition）将标签预测性模式定位到单个工具结果上，避免在拼接的工具追踪中被信号稀释；第二阶段Token-Class Redaction通过反事实检验判断冻结的LLM是否依赖所定位的捷径。在TCR-pMHC结合预测任务上进行验证，并与无证据基线对比。

Result: 工具增强显著优于无证据基线，表面上说明LLM学会了利用科学证据；但审计推翻了这一解释：PT2D将最强信号定位到某一工具结果中的标识符，抹除这些标识符后性能降至随机水平。

Conclusion: 隐藏的标签捷径可伪装成科学推理或发现，因此在采信基准提升之前应进行源级审计，以区分真正的证据整合与虚假捷径利用。

Abstract: Agentic LLMs increasingly support scientific prediction by grounding decisions in external evidence. In biology, they promise accurate, interpretable predictions for important problems by integrating complex experimental and computational evidence. However, serialized tool results can contain hidden label shortcuts, such as dataset identifiers or template artifacts, that create apparent success without biological reasoning. To address this risk, we introduce a two-stage audit. Stage 1, Per-Tool TF-IDF Decomposition (PT2D), localizes label-predictive patterns to individual tool results while avoiding signal dilution in the concatenated tool trace. Stage 2, Token-Class Redaction, counterfactually tests whether the frozen LLM depends on the localized shortcut. We apply this audit to TCR-pMHC binding, where tool augmentation substantially outperforms a no-evidence baseline. At face value, this suggests that the LLM has learned to use scientific evidence. The audit overturns this interpretation: PT2D localizes the strongest signal to identifiers in one tool result, and redacting them reduces performance to chance. These findings show how hidden label shortcuts can masquerade as scientific reasoning or discovery, motivating source-level audits before benchmark gains are trusted.

</details>


### [629] [Editing as Language: Teaching LLM Agents a Grammar for Native Context Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25550)
*Yunlong Deng,Yan Li,Xing Hu,Yida Zhu,Sean Du,Weiyang Liu,Guangyi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Native Context Editing (NCE) 框架，用专用特殊 token 构成语法让 LLM agent 原生地编辑自身上下文，在四个长程 agent 基准上平均任务成功率提升 5.6/4.5 个百分点，token 用量分别降低 36%/15%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有上下文编辑方法依赖在特定外部 harness 环境中学习生成工具调用代码，与模型原生生成过程割裂，难以泛化到多样化的真实工作流。作者希望把上下文编辑内化为模型的原生能力。

Method: 将上下文编辑操作编码为专用特殊 token 组成的语法（grammar），使编辑动作可直接通过语言本身调用；在迭代构造的轨迹片段上训练，每条教师编辑以演化中的上下文为条件，从而把上下文编辑确立为原子化、内生的能力。

Result: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Verified、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro 四个长程基准上，LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse 平均成功率提升 5.6 个百分点，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 提升 4.5 个百分点；平均 token 消耗分别下降 36% 与 15%。

Conclusion: 将上下文编辑作为模型原生生成过程的内部机制（而非外部工具代码），可获得更好的跨工作流泛化性，并在长程推理与交互中同时提升成功率与 token 效率。

Abstract: A synopsis in novels folds a story into a few lines; a function in code gathers many steps with a single execution. Context editing is native to language itself. In this paper, we propose the Native Context Editing (NCE) framework, which gives language model agents a grammar for natively editing their own context. By encoding context-editing operations in a grammar of dedicated special tokens, we teach the agents to invoke edits through the language itself. We train agents on iteratively constructed trajectory segments, with each teacher edit conditioned on the evolving context. This establishes context editing as an atomic and inherent capability of LLM agents, enabling them to dynamically modify their context as they generate responses over long-horizon reasoning and interaction. Compared with context-editing methods that learn to generate tool-use code within specific external harness environments, our approach integrates context editing as an internal mechanism of the model's native generation process, enabling better generalization across diverse real-world workflows. On four long-horizon agentic benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Verified, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro), NCE improves the average task success rate over the base model by 5.6 percentage points for LongCat-Flash-Lite-Sparse and by 4.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, while reducing average token usage by 36% and 15%, respectively.

</details>


### [630] [Symbolic Constraint Agents: Mining Formal Tool-Call Constraints to Prevent Agent Errors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25552)
*Jinu Lee,Shraddha Barke*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 从 API 文档挖掘符号约束，并基于执行轨迹精炼，运行时用 SMT 求解器检查工具调用，违规时给出警告或自动修复，从而提升智能体任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号约束方法主要用于强制执行预定义的安全策略，而非刻画复杂工具环境中的工具依赖关系；作者希望探究约束能否从环境和观测中自动挖掘，以及是否能提升端到端任务性能。

Method: 提出 Symbolic Constraint Agents（SCA）框架：从 API 文档挖掘符号约束，利用执行轨迹对约束进行精炼，并在运行时用 SMT 求解器检查智能体的工具调用；检测到违规时触发自然语言警告，或当合法替换唯一确定时执行自动修复。

Result: 在 AppWorld 上，约束精炼使错误检测 F1 从 37.0 提升至 58.3（GPT-5.5 轨迹）、从 39.3 提升至 61.9（Qwen3.5-27B 轨迹）；运行时修复使 GPT-5.4-mini 在 40 次调用预算下任务成功率提升 5.4 点，在隐藏环境错误时提升 9.8 点，并在各模型上减少 59–87% 的失败调用；方法可迁移至 τ²-bench，最高提升 5.6 点。

Conclusion: 自动获取的符号约束能够提升工具调用的可靠性与任务完成率，尤其在失败代价高或难以诊断的场景中效果显著。

Abstract: Symbolic constraints (programmatic, deterministic checks for tool calls) enable deterministic verification of LLM agents' tool calls, but existing approaches primarily enforce predefined safety policies rather than tool dependencies in complex tool environments. We explore whether symbolic constraints can be mined from environments and observations beyond predefined policies, and whether they can improve end-to-end task performance. We present Symbolic Constraint Agents (SCA), a framework that mines symbolic constraints from API documentation, refines them against execution traces, and checks the agent's tool calls with an SMT solver at runtime. A violation triggers a natural-language warning or, when the valid replacement is uniquely determined, an automatic repair. On AppWorld, refinement raises error-detection F1 from 37.0 to 58.3 on GPT-5.5 traces and from 39.3 to 61.9 on Qwen3.5-27B traces. At runtime, repair raises GPT-5.4-mini's task success by 5.4 points under a 40-call budget and 9.8 points when environment errors are hidden, while removing 59--87\% of failed calls across models, and transfers to $τ^2$-bench with gains of up to 5.6 points. These findings show that automatically acquired symbolic constraints can improve tool-calling reliability and task completion, particularly when failures are costly or difficult to diagnose.

</details>


### [631] [Narrow Decision Models: A System-1 Architecture for Calibrated, Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25553)
*Carlos André Antunes,Aldry Albuquerque,Gabriel de Melo Schmith,Natã Batista,Pedro Oziel Escobar da Silva,Stefano Benko Rossi,Lingrid Dietrich Lorenz da Silva,Flávia Cristina da Costa,Thiago Bertotto,Luis Fernando Fausto*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出窄决策模型（NDM）：与System One模型接口相同，但针对单一组织训练、可本地部署、架构开放可测，以法院通信路由为案例，用前缀树序列化+块注意力掩码的双向编码器实现选项顺序无关和问题间独立的决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One模型（如TypeSafe的Jev）是通用型的：一套权重服务多种场景，仅通过请求适配领域。作者研究设计空间的另一端——针对单一组织的决策定制的小型、可自托管、架构开放且性质可被陈述与检验的决策模型，解决组织内部具体决策（如文书路由）的可靠性、可验证性与部署自主性问题。

Method: 架构将请求序列化为前缀树（状态→各问题→各选项），在带逻辑位置的块注意力掩码下运行双向编码器，使每个答案在构造上对选项顺序不变、且独立于其他问题。组织架构图上的路由被建模为带显式"none of these"选项的Choice决策组合。训练采用基于proper scoring rules的课程学习，并涵盖校准与弃答、由rubrics组合决策，以及在校验数据开启前接受或拒绝该机制的协议。

Result: 在公开与虚构数据上的最小验证显示：训练后模型的不变性在舍入误差内成立；小规模实例在未见过的组织架构图上路由，显著优于词法检索；同等算力下块架构损失低于成对cross-encoder。首个在真实法律文书上训练的实例，与生产环境中LLM分类器在91%的留出文档上判断一致。

Conclusion: NDM为组织级决策提供了一种可本地部署、架构透明、性质可验证的替代方案，在不变性、路由性能、算力效率及与生产LLM分类器的一致性上均得到初步验证，并配套了先于留出数据开放的机制接受/拒绝协议。

Abstract: System One models, introduced with TypeSafe's Jev, answer typed questions about a state with calibrated probabilities instead of generated text: choosing among options described in natural language (Choice), placing the state on an ordered scale (Score), or judging a yes/no statement (Noul). Jev is general-purpose: one set of weights, served as an API and adapted to a domain only through the request. We study the other end of the design space. A Narrow Decision Model (NDM) offers the same interface but is trained for the decisions of one organization, is small enough to run on its own infrastructure, and has an open architecture whose properties can be stated and tested. The state can be any text or structured record about which decisions are made; our running case is the routing of court communications. The architecture serializes a request as a prefix tree (the state, then each question, then each option) and runs a bidirectional encoder under a block attention mask with logical positions, so that each answer is, by construction, invariant to the order of its options and independent of the other questions asked. Routing through an organization chart is a composition of Choice decisions with an explicit "none of these" option. We describe training with proper scoring rules through a curriculum, calibration and abstention, decisions composed by rubrics, and a protocol that accepts or rejects the mechanism before held-out data is opened. A minimal validation on public and fictitious data shows that the invariances hold to rounding in a trained model, that a small instance routes on organization charts it has never seen well above lexical retrieval, and that, at equal compute, the block architecture reaches a lower loss than a pairwise cross-encoder. A first instance trained on real legal documents agrees with the LLM classifier in production on 91% of held-out documents.

</details>


### [632] [Learning Which Device to Call: Online Tool Grounding for LLM Agents in IoT](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25563)
*Yichen Liu,Xiaochong Jiang,Haoran Yu,Lifei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"在线工具接地"问题：在给定工具调用的情况下，为LLM智能体选择最合适的物理设备执行，并给出基于上下文赌博机与分层端点树的在线选择框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT为LLM智能体提供物理观测能力，但同一能力往往由多个设备提供，智能体计划中并未指定调用哪一个；现有工作只做工具检索与计划可行性检查，未学习哪个合格设备能返回有用观测。

Method: 将设备选择建模为上下文赌博机问题，结合自适应上下文划分与分层端点树，使执行反馈在相关请求与设备间复用；在满足设备能力、授权、电量储备与可用性约束下，平衡任务成功与服务成本；可选地用高斯奖励聚合保护个体反馈值。

Result: 理论上给出有限时域遗憾界，并在奖励独立于分配的固定指派下，证明所发布奖励统计量满足差分隐私。仿真装卸站负载实验中，该路由器相比最近设备、广告质量、UCB1与LinUCB选择，具有更高的单步成功率与更优的成本调整服务，同时模拟设备能耗与延迟更低。

Conclusion: 在线工具接地是将LLM规划落到物理端点的关键环节，基于上下文赌博机的学习式路由可同时提升成功率、成本效率与资源友好性。

Abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) gives large language model (LLM) agents access to physical observations, but one requested capability is usually offered by several devices, and the agent's plan does not say which one to call. Existing work retrieves relevant tools and checks plan feasibility, without learning which eligible device returns a useful observation. Unlike previous works, we study online tool grounding: binding an already specified tool call to one physical endpoint under service cost and device participation constraints. We propose a framework that learns which physical device should execute each agent-issued call. It formulates selection as a contextual bandit problem and combines adaptive context partitions with hierarchical endpoint trees, so that execution feedback is reused across related requests and devices. Selection balances task success against service cost while respecting device capability, authorization, battery reserves, and availability. Gaussian reward aggregation provides an optional mechanism for protecting individual feedback values. Theoretical results establish a finite-horizon regret bound and differential privacy for released reward statistics under fixed, reward-independent assignments. In a simulated loading-dock workload, the proposed router achieves higher step success and better cost-adjusted service, at lower simulated device energy and latency, than nearest-device, advertised-quality, UCB1, and LinUCB selection.

</details>


### [633] [Design and Cross-Domain Evaluation of an Agent Execution Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25568)
*Saurav Joshi,Manas Gupta,Ashwin Venkatesh Raman,Akshay Budhkar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一个将"原始目标—可修订计划—执行记录"三者分离的智能体执行框架（harness），由规划者、执行者、审查者三类角色协作，并用可复用的领域指令指导；在终端任务、临床问答、应用构建与科学问题等多场景评估其效果与成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用语言模型智能体完成复杂任务需要协调规划、执行与审查，使最终结果契合用户原始目标；现有方法缺乏对目标漂移、计划可修订性与执行轨迹的明确分离，也缺少对协调机制收益与代价的系统刻画。

Method: 构建多角色执行框架：规划者分派有边界的子任务，worker 产出结果与工件，reviewer 对照原始请求审查后再提交或请求补充工作；角色由可复用的领域专用指令引导，这些指令在构建过程中借助任务输入与执行轨迹迭代修订，且不使用官方评分反馈作为信号。

Result: Terminal-Bench 2.1 通过 89 个实例中的 83 个（93.26%）；HealthBench Professional 上 Fable 配置系统在 525 项任务上取得长度调整后的 rubric 得分 69.63；53 项配对比较中聚合得分比直接补全高 19.89 分，但任务级中位数变化为 −1.46 分，平均推理成本从每任务 $0.29 升至 $2.13。

Conclusion: 结合结果、延迟、指令修订记录与审查者决策的综合评估可澄清协调机制在何处促进任务完成、在何处引入性能回退以及以何种成本实现；聚合收益可能掩盖任务级的中位数下降，需以多维指标审视智能体框架。

Abstract: Completing complex tasks with language-model agents requires coordinating planning, execution, and review so the final result addresses the user's original objective. We present an agent execution harness that keeps the original objective separate from a revisable plan and an execution record. A planner assigns scoped tasks, workers produce outputs and artifacts, and a reviewer examines results against the original request before submitting or requesting additional work. Reusable domain-specific instructions guide these roles and are refined during construction using task inputs and execution trajectories, without official grading feedback. We evaluate complete harness configurations across terminal tasks, clinical responses, application building, and scientific questions. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, the harness passes 83 of 89 instances (93.26%); on HealthBench Professional, a Fable-configured system achieves a length-adjusted rubric score of 69.63 across 525 tasks. In a 53-task paired HealthBench comparison, the Fable-configured harness achieves an aggregate score 19.89 points higher than direct completion, despite a $-1.46$-point median task-level change; mean inference cost rises from \$0.29 to \$2.13 per task. We combine these outcomes with latency, documented instruction revisions, and reviewer decisions. Evaluating outcomes alongside execution trajectories and resource use clarifies how coordination supports task completion, where it introduces regressions, and at what cost.

</details>


### [634] [The Forward/Inverse Duality of Controlled Emergence:A Computational Design Program from Explanation to Engineering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25630)
*Hao Li,Minghui Ren,Shaowen Lu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"受控涌现"统一研究纲领，将智能系统在释放适应性与防止失控之间的张力重构为正向与逆向两个对偶问题，以增广五元组为形式对象，用可控性、可复现性、形式化程度三个可测坐标刻画"工程化"，并给出三个可检验工作假设与一条可行性判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大量简单单元的局部交互产生宏观能力，此类系统部署于现实时须约束其行为，设计者因此陷入"释放适应性"与"防止失控"的两难，且缺乏形式化工具予以化解。

Method: 以增广五元组作为正逆两端共享的形式对象：正向问题由局部规则解释宏观行为，逆向问题由目标求可控规则与读出机制；将"工程"分解为可控性、可复现性、形式化程度三个独立可测坐标；在此基础上提出三个可检验工作假设（临界规模；约束与适应性的协作与权衡；最小约束）及一条可行性判据，把逆向设计由无约束优化降为区间检查。

Result: 给出可操作的研究纲领与判据体系；所附小规模试点实验仅用于验证研究协议的可执行性，不构成对工作假设的统计检验。

Conclusion: 该纲领以显式失效边界为前提，不追求完全控制，并始终保留系统自组织空间；该设计语言可推广至多智能体人工智能、工业互联网与应急响应系统等同时面对涌现与可控性的领域。

Abstract: The macroscopic capabilities of intelligent systems arise from the local interactions of many simple units. When such systems are deployed in the real world, their behaviour must nevertheless be constrained, leaving designers caught between releasing adaptability and preventing loss of control, yet without formal tools to resolve the dilemma. This paper proposes a unified research program for controlled emergence that restates this tension as a pair of dual problems: the forward problem explains macroscopic behaviour from local rules, and the inverse problem solves for controllable rules and readout mechanisms from a desired target. We take an augmented quintuple as the formal object shared by both ends, and decompose ``engineering'' into three independently measurable coordinates: controllability, reproducibility, and degree of formalizability. On this basis we give three testable working hypotheses (critical scale; the cooperation and trade-off between constraint and adaptability; minimal constraint) and one feasibility criterion, which reduce inverse design from unconstrained optimization to interval checking. The program takes explicit failure boundaries as its premise, does not pursue complete control, and always preserves the system's room for self-organization. The reduced pilot experiment attached to this paper serves only to verify the executability of the research protocol and does not constitute a statistical test of the working hypotheses. This design language generalizes to multi-agent artificial intelligence, the industrial internet, and emergency response systems, all of which must confront emergence and controllability at once.

</details>


### [635] [Think, Compress, Answer: Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Grounding via Reasoning Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25640)
*Jinbae Seo,Hyeongjun Kwon,Jiyoung Lee,Hyunsung Jang,Namkoo Ha,Jungin Park,Kwanghoon Sohn*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Think-Compress-Answer (TCA) 强化学习框架，将多模态定位分解为自由推理、目标感知上下文压缩、基于压缩上下文的答案生成三阶段，用多阶段 GRPO 与渐进奖励优化，在六个基准上取得显著零样本提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩展推理虽提升了 MLLM 的组合与关系推理能力，但多模态定位要求推理最终收敛到支持精确定位的目标特定紧凑表示。推理轨迹变长后易扩散为宽泛场景叙述与边缘关系细节，稀释定位所需的感知证据，导致预测模糊或错误。

Method: 受信息瓶颈原理启发，将多模态定位拆为三阶段：自由形式推理→目标感知上下文压缩→以压缩上下文为条件的答案生成。采用多阶段 Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)，配合渐进式奖励：建立结构化输出协议、在保留目标相关信息的前提下最小化推理特有信息、直接提升定位精度。

Result: 在六个多模态定位基准上，TCA 取得显著的零样本性能提升。

Conclusion: 分阶段设计使 MLLM 既保留扩展推理的收益，又将推理蒸馏为定位所需的最小上下文，验证了推理压缩的有效性。

Abstract: Extended reasoning has substantially improved multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on tasks requiring compositional and relational inference. However, multimodal grounding imposes a distinct requirement: reasoning must ultimately converge on a target-specific compact representation that supports precise localization. As reasoning trajectories grow longer, they often expand into broad scene narratives and peripheral relational details, which can dilute grounded perceptual evidence and lead to ambiguous or incorrect predictions. Motivated by the information bottleneck principle, we propose Think-Compress-Answer (TCA), a reinforcement learning framework that decomposes multimodal grounding into three phases: free-form reasoning, target-aware context compression, and answer generation conditioned on the compressed context. TCA is optimized through a multi-stage Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with progressive rewards that establish the structured output protocol, minimize reasoning-specific information while preserving target-relevant content, and directly improve localization accuracy. This staged design enables MLLMs to retain the benefits of extended reasoning while distilling it into the minimal context required for grounding. Experiments across six multimodal grounding benchmarks show that TCA attains substantial zero-shot performance gains, demonstrating the effectiveness of reasoning compression.

</details>


### [636] [Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners: Adaptive Loop Halting on the Hypersphere](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25646)
*Arber Zela,Artavazd Maranjyan,Pol Puigdemont,David Berghaus,Valentyn Boreiko,Volkan Cevher*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出球面不动点推理器（SFPRM），把循环Transformer的不动点求解搬到归一化Transformer的单位超球面上，使输入注入、阻尼与停机均成为测地操作，从而天然有界并解耦系数，并在多个高难推理任务上超越FPRM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环（权重共享）Transformer 通过为更难输入分配更多迭代次数实现自适应计算，FPRM 用带阻尼的不动点求解器实现这一目标，但其在无界欧氏残差空间中运行，且重缩放与相对范数停机准则相互耦合，带来数值与理论上的不便。

Method: 在归一化Transformer（nGPT）的单位超球面上执行同样的不动点迭代：将输入注入、阻尼与停机准则改写为测地（球面几何）操作，构造上保证有界性并消除系数耦合；理论分析给出不动点存在性、显式步长条件下的局部收敛性以及强注入下的全局收敛性。

Result: 在 Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard 与 Mini-ARC 上分别取得 96.6%、87.9%、59.1% 的测试准确率，优于 FPRM 及其他基线，且测试时算力分配更有效；收敛后的几何具有可解释性，token 与输入之间的夹角能刻画谜题结构并预测正确性。

Conclusion: 将循环推理的不动点求解约束在单位超球面上，可同时获得有界性、简化的超参数结构与可证明的收敛性，并在困难推理任务上带来精度与算力效率的双重提升，且收敛几何提供了可解释信号。

Abstract: Looped (weight-tied) transformers enable adaptive computation by allocating more iterations to harder inputs. Fixed-Point Reasoners (FPRM) achieve this with a damped fixed-point solver, but operate in an unbounded Euclidean residual space with coupled rescaling and relative-norm halting. We introduce Spherical Fixed-Point Reasoners (SFPRM), which perform the same computation on the unit hypersphere of normalized transformers (nGPT). Input injection, damping, and halting become geodesic operations, yielding boundedness by construction and eliminating coefficient coupling. We prove fixed-point existence, local convergence under an explicit step-size condition, and global convergence under strong injection. On Sudoku-Extreme, Maze-Hard, and Mini-ARC, SFPRM achieves 96.6%, 87.9%, and 59.1% test accuracy, respectively, outperforming FPRM and other baselines while allocating test-time compute more effectively. Its converged geometry is also interpretable: token-input angles capture puzzle structure and predict correctness.

</details>


### [637] [HyperTaxa: Multiscale Genome Representations for Generalized Microbial Taxonomic Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25673)
*Akash Rao,Sushim Gupta,Vishalini Ramnath,Akhilesh Ramachandran,Sathyanarayanan Aakur*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: HyperTaxa是一个面向开放集微生物分类推断的分类学对齐表征学习框架，将全基因组编码为多尺度高光谱k-mer转移场，并通过两阶段Node2Vec-to-MDS过程对齐到分类学语义空间，从而支持零样本、广义零样本及属到种级联预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新测序物种快速增长且参考数据库覆盖不完整，使可靠的微生物分类推断面临挑战。基于比对和数据库驱动的工具虽仍是参考支撑鉴定的必备手段，但其设计初衷并非针对"训练集中不存在该物种"的学习式推断，缺乏开放集泛化能力。

Method: 提出HyperTaxa框架：(1) 将全基因组编码为多尺度高光谱k-mer转移场表征；(2) 采用两阶段Node2Vec-to-MDS流程，将表征对齐至由分类学衍生的语义空间，兼顾局部图结构与全局层级距离保持；(3) 基于该空间支持零样本推断、广义零样本推断以及属→种的级联预测。

Result: 在基准评测和大规模不相交物种评测中，HyperTaxa相较伪图像（pseudo-image）与Transformer图基线提升了分类预测性能，且在高分类阶元上增益最显著。消融实验表明，多尺度转移编码与分类学感知对齐是泛化性能的关键贡献因素。

Conclusion: HyperTaxa可作为参考覆盖不完整与开放集不确定性条件下微生物鉴定的分类学感知表征与候选生成框架，与现有比对/数据库驱动工具形成互补。

Abstract: Reliable microbial taxonomic inference is challenged by the rapid growth of newly sequenced organisms and incomplete reference coverage. While alignment- and database-driven tools remain essential for reference-backed identification, they are not designed for learned inference over species absent from genome-level training. We introduce HyperTaxa, a taxonomy-aligned representation learning framework for open-set microbial taxonomic inference. HyperTaxa encodes whole genomes as multiscale hyperspectral k-mer transition fields and aligns these representations to a taxonomy-derived semantic space using a two-stage Node2Vec-to-MDS procedure that combines local graph structure with global hierarchical distance preservation. The resulting space supports zero-shot inference over species excluded from genome-level training but represented in the taxonomy, generalized zero-shot inference over seen and unseen species, and cascaded genus-to-species prediction. Across benchmark and large-scale disjoint-species evaluations, HyperTaxa improves taxonomic prediction over pseudo-image and transformer-graph baselines, with the strongest gains at higher taxonomic ranks.
