### [673] [OrderGPT: Generation Order as a Learnable Modeling Choice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25949)
*Chenhe Yang,Yuhuan Lyu,Tianyang Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OrderGPT 提出可学习的任务级生成顺序：利用任意顺序 GPT 在随机揭示前缀下的注意力模式构建互依赖图，经谱教师导出连续生成优先级，再由 OrderMLP 端到端学习并在训练中逐步切换到该顺序、随后冻结用于自回归训练与生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散数据生成存在两个极端范式：GPT 式左到右（L2R）自回归与掩码扩散式任意顺序自回归，二者只是"生成顺序"这一单一轴的两端。对缺乏自然遍历顺序的结构化离散领域（如人体姿态、表格数据），两种极端都非最优，而中间选项——单一且良好适配的顺序——尚未被充分探索。

Method: 1) 基于 Any-Order GPT：从随机采样的 reveal prefixes 预测变量，观察到骨干网络中反复出现的注意力模式可作为模型相关的预测依赖信号；2) 将该信号聚合为互依赖图，用谱教师（spectral teacher）导出连续生成优先级；3) 在 GPT 骨干中集成轻量 OrderMLP，从注意力预测这些优先级，把顺序学习纳入单次训练；4) 训练逐步转向学到的顺序，之后冻结该顺序用于后续自回归训练与生成。无需规范顺序监督。

Result: 跨模态一致有效：语言上自适应地恢复到接近 L2R 的依赖结构；人体姿态上学到解剖学上有组织的因子分解；表格数据上发现的因子分解使统计与语义相关字段相邻；同时在所有领域中提升下游建模指标。

Conclusion: 生成顺序是可学习的设计维度，而非只能在两极端中二选一；注意力导出的互依赖图结合谱教师可无监督地给出任务适配的生成顺序，并在多模态下带来性能提升。代码已开源。

Abstract: Generative modeling of discrete data has two popular paradigms: autoregressive models such as GPT, which factorize a sequence in a left-to-right (L2R) order, and masked diffusion models, which are essentially any-order autoregressive modeling. Rather than competing methods, these are the two extreme points of a single axis -- the generation order. For structured discrete domains without a natural traversal, both extremes may be suboptimal, yet the intermediate choice -- a single well-adapted order -- remains largely unexplored. We introduce OrderGPT, which builds on Any-Order GPT to learn a task-level generation order without canonical-order supervision. Our key observation is that predicting variables from randomly sampled reveal prefixes produces recurring attention patterns in the backbone that provide a model-dependent signal of predictive dependencies. We aggregate this signal into a reciprocal dependency graph and use a spectral teacher to derive continuous generation priorities. A lightweight OrderMLP integrated into the GPT backbone learns to predict these priorities from attention, incorporating order learning into the architecture within a single training run. Training gradually shifts toward the learned order, which is then frozen for subsequent autoregressive training and generation. The same mechanism adapts across modalities: adaptively it recovers near-L2R dependency structure in language, learns anatomically organized factorizations on human pose, and discovers a factorization on tabular data that places statistically and semantically related fields nearby, while improving downstream modeling metrics across all domains. The code is available at https://github.com/Chenhe-yang/OrderGPT/.

</details>


### [674] [CXBench: A Benchmark for Process-Compliant LLM Agents in Regulated Customer-Experience Workflows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25954)
*Boxi Yu,Yuzhong Zhang,Zhenfeng Su,Linfu Xi,Yinghan Yao,Shitao Chen,Yang Cao,Liting Lin,Lionel Briand,Emir Muñoz*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 cxbench 基准，将"结果合规"与"过程合规"分离评估，覆盖六个受监管客服场景；发现现有评估大量接受"结果正确但过程违规"的轨迹，定义并量化了 false-pass 现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工具型语言智能体越来越多地执行受监管的客服工作流，此时仅达到正确最终状态并不充分：智能体还必须履行信息披露、获取用户同意并遵循规定流程。现有工具智能体基准大多只评分最终业务状态，因而会接受"结果正确但过程不合规"的轨迹，掩盖了合规性缺陷。

Method: 构建 cxbench：六个受监管领域，每个任务由客户请求、基于工具的环境与显式过程要求组成；用"规则卡"将引用的监管义务映射到可观测的轨迹证据；采用混合评分器——对顺序与权限类要求做确定性检查，对语义类要求用 LLM 评判；并将"结果通过但过程检查失败"的样本定义为 false-pass。

Result: 在 7 个模型、120 个任务上，840 条保留执行轨迹中 55.5% 为 false-pass，占全部结果通过运行的 80.1%；仅 13.8% 同时通过结果与过程检查。纳入过程评估会改变模型排序，并揭示仅按结果评分所隐藏的差异。

Conclusion: 仅以最终状态评分的基准系统性高估了工具型智能体的合规能力；分离结果与过程评估是必要且可行的，cxbench 通过轨迹关联的判定标准使这些失败可被检视与定位。

Abstract: Tool-using language agents increasingly perform regulated customer-service workflows, where a correct final state is insufficient: agents must also provide disclosures, obtain consent, and follow required procedures. Existing tool-agent benchmarks largely score final business states, accepting trajectories that reach correct outcomes through non-compliant processes.
  We introduce cxbench, a benchmark that evaluates outcome and process compliance separately across six regulated domains. Each task combines a customer request, a tool-based environment, and explicit process requirements. Rule cards link cited regulatory obligations to observable trace evidence. A hybrid grader combines deterministic checks for ordering and authority with an LLM judge for semantic requirements. We define a false-pass as an outcome-pass run that fails process checks.
  Across seven models and 120 tasks, 55.5% of the 840 retained executions are false-passes, representing 80.1% of outcome-passing runs; only 13.8% pass both checks. Process-inclusive evaluation changes the observed model ordering and exposes differences hidden by outcome-only scoring. cxbench makes these failures inspectable through trace-linked criteria.

</details>


### [675] [Productive State-Space Exploration for Multi-turn RL in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25957)
*Mohammed Haroon Dupty,Yong Liang Goh,Song Guo,Wee Sun Lee*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一种基于条件状态空间探索的框架，用"观测重复即惩罚"的内在奖励来缓解多轮长时程环境中LLM智能体的无效动作与行为循环问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多轮长时程环境下RL训练的LLM智能体存在动作选择低效、陷入高置信度但无产出的行为、重复执行无效动作或进入动作循环的问题。作者观察到这些行为常违反环境前置条件，反映出智能体内部状态表征与环境动态之间的失配；同时高置信度的重复动作导致无进展的循环行为。因此需要更具产出性、任务对齐的探索以增进对环境动态的理解。

Method: 受内在好奇心驱动探索启发，提出条件状态空间探索框架，在任务完成与内在信息寻求之间取得平衡。具体做法是设计一种内在奖励，对"观测结果与先前状态记忆重复"的动作施加惩罚，从而抑制冗余行为并鼓励状态空间覆盖，且不依赖通用信息论度量。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法显著改善了多轮环境中的策略学习，减少了无效动作与重复循环行为。

Conclusion: 通过基于观测重复惩罚的内在奖励实现任务对齐的探索，可有效缓解LLM智能体在多轮长时程环境中的探索低效与行为循环问题。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) for Large Language Model (LLM) agents in multi-turn, long-horizon environments remains challenging due to inefficient action selection and repetitive behavioral patterns. In particular, agents often become trapped in high-confidence yet unproductive behaviors, repeatedly executing invalid actions or entering action loops that hinder task completion. We observe that these frequently violate environment preconditions, revealing a mismatch between the agent's representation of the internal state and the dynamics of the underlying environment. In addition, repetitive high-confidence actions lead to cyclical behaviors that provide little to no progress towards the goal. We argue that addressing these challenges requires more productive task-aligned exploration to improve the agent's understanding of environment dynamics. Motivated by intrinsic curiosity-driven exploration, we propose a conditional state-space exploration framework that balances task completion with intrinsic information-seeking behavior. Specifically, we introduce an intrinsic reward that penalizes actions whose observation duplicates prior state memory. This provides the benefit of reducing redundant behaviors and encouraging state-space coverage without relying on a general information-theoretic measure. Strong experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves policy learning in multi-turn environments, mitigating invalid actions and repetitive loops.

</details>


### [676] [EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25959)
*X. Feng,J. Tang,Z. Lin,L. Chen,S. Shao,Q. Lu,K. Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文提出开放世界具身智能体（EWA）研究方向，发布200K+样本的EmbodiedWorld-200K数据集，并提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理进行交互式RL后训练的方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身智能研究多局限于单一场景的特定任务，难以迁移到新环境，开放世界通用具身智能体尚未被充分探索；同时真实交互环境构建成本过高，纯离线数据训练难以泛化到分布外场景。

Method: 1）定义EmbodiedWorld-200K数据集，涵盖多样场景，提供从底层相机运动轨迹到高层语义指令的多层级标注，并给出统一评测划分与任务指标；2）以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，在其中对EWA进行交互式强化学习后训练。

Result: 在EmbodiedWorld-200K上预训练显著提升EWA的开放世界具身规划能力；在世界模型内进行RL后训练后，在分布外场景上取得明显增益。

Conclusion: 多层级大规模数据集与“视频世界模型+交互式RL”训练范式可有效推进开放世界通用具身智能体研究，且数据集、基线权重与代码已开源。

Abstract: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

</details>


### [677] [ABACUS: Program-Guided Multistep Reasoning over Frozen Judgment Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25963)
*Yuhao Wang,Zelin Zang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 \method 框架，用生成式教师离线构建判断模式与组合程序，冻结的判断模型在线解局部语义问题，程序组合其决策；实例 Kev 在 3 个 BBH 任务上九个程序全通过开发集 450 次执行，留出 600 题上达 99.67% macro 准确率且相对 Qwen 有 8.43 倍在线加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 判断模型只能对有限候选做局部语义打分，无法直接完成多步推理；作者希望在不改变模型参数的前提下，用可复用的程序把局部判断组合成强多步推理能力，并区分人与教师在设计投入上的三种分配方式。

Method: \method 框架：生成式教师离线设计判断模式（judgment schema）与组合程序（composition program），并通过共享接口支持构造；在线阶段由冻结的判断模型回答局部语义问题，保存的程序将决策组合为最终答案。以 Kev 实例化，在 3 个 BIG-Bench Hard 任务上构造九个独立程序（150 个开发输入，450 次执行）；另做部署研究，经开发集参考一致性精炼后冻结三个程序，在 600 道留出题上评估，并与直接 Kev、仅答最终答案的 Qwen3.5-4B 及 Qwen 无约束回答策略对比。

Result: 九个独立程序在开发集 150 输入、450 次执行上全部求解成功；留出 600 题上宏平均准确率 99.67%，直接 Kev 为 64.00%，仅答最终答案的 Qwen3.5-4B 为 68.80%；与 Qwen 无约束回答策略精度相当（99.07%）但在线速度提升 8.43 倍（0.255 s vs. 2.150 s/题）。

Conclusion: 可复用程序能在保持判断模型参数冻结的条件下显著扩展其推理能力，证明了"离线程序合成 + 在线局部判断"范式的有效性；但结论基于 3 个选定 BBH 任务与较小规模留出集，泛化性与任务覆盖面仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Judgment models answer semantic questions by scoring a finite set of candidate outcomes. Can reusable programs turn these local decisions into powerful multistep reasoning? We introduce \method, a framework that jointly constructs judgment schemas and composition programs for frozen judgment models. A generative teacher designs the procedure offline; the judgment model resolves local semantic questions online, and the saved program composes its decisions into an answer. We study three allocations of design effort between humans and the teacher, focusing on construction through a shared interface. We instantiate the framework with Kev. On three selected BIG-Bench Hard tasks, nine independently constructed programs solve all 450 executions of 150 development inputs. A separate deployment study freezes three programs after development-set reference-agreement refinement and evaluates them on 600 held-out questions. These programs achieve near-perfect 99.67\% macro accuracy, versus 64.00\% for direct Kev and 68.80\% for final-answer-only Qwen3.5-4B. They attain comparable observed accuracy to Qwen's unrestricted response policy (99.07\%) with an \textbf{8.43-fold online speedup}: 0.255 versus 2.150 seconds per question. These results show how reusable programs can substantially expand the reasoning capability of a compact judgment model while keeping its parameters fixed.

</details>


### [678] [GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25970)
*Xinyue Peng,Zhenlin Liang,Meng Cai,Hua Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GLOBE：一种无需训练的在线早退算法，通过语义轨迹几何形状判定何时终止思维链。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链推理在正确答案已可达后仍持续生成冗余步骤，增加推理成本，且可能用错误步骤覆盖正确的中间结果。

Method: 将每个完成的推理片段嵌入为单位球面上的点，读取语义轨迹形状；先执行试验阶段：在独立分支生成简短试探答案，以置信度阈值校验通过则停止主流程；若继续，则轨迹阶段在路径反复反向、净进展极小时终止生成。

Result: 在数学推理、工具调用、智能体记忆等五个基准、两个模型上，输出token减少49.7%，端到端墙钟时间（E2E）减少51.0%，五任务平均准确率80.58%，与完整CoT相当。

Conclusion: 基于几何轨迹的在线早退可在几乎不损失精度的情况下显著降低CoT推理成本，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.

</details>


### [679] [On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25977)
*Kamenan N'Gadi,Martin Laviale,C{é}dric Pradalier,J{é}r{é}my Fix*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 构建ResNet-18硅藻图像分类基线，通过温度缩放校准置信度并用于选择性分类分离，在不牺牲分类学完整性的前提下减少专家复核工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 硅藻显微图像自动识别是淡水生物监测的基础，但物种多样性高、类别严重不平衡，导致可靠分类困难；同时模型存在过度自信，需在保证稀有物种指标的前提下降低专家负担。

Method: 在759类硅藻数据集上训练ResNet-18基线；采用后验温度缩放(T=2.12)校准概率；以校准概率构建三分流/拒识框架(阈值τ=0.934)实现选择性分类；并用torch-uncertainty框架支撑实验。

Result: 初始模型ECE为0.117(过度自信)，温度缩放后ECE降至0.055；在66.2%覆盖率下保持Selective Macro-F1达99.01%；定性分析显示系统作为智能过滤器，稳定将稀有类群(如AAMB、AASI)与形态模糊样本交由专家复核。

Conclusion: 简单的后验校准技术即可使自动硅藻识别更实用、稳健，选择性分类在减少专家工作量的同时保留对生态评估关键的稀有物种指标；代码与环境已匿名开源以支持可复现性。

Abstract: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.

</details>


### [680] [GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25978)
*Suxing Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 GraphEvoResearcher：一种免训练协议，将自反思元奖励提升到显式推理图上（节点为中间结论/证据，边为 support/contradict/depends_on），用图感知元奖励决定修正、回溯或停止，并在证据分支收敛时早停。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多跳 QA 的免训练"生成→批判→修订"自反思协议在线性 token 流上工作：修订无法定位不可靠的具体步骤，早停也无法利用结构收敛信息。

Method: 将 EvoResearcher 的自反思元奖励迁移到显式推理图：图感知元奖励融合正确性、效率、反思性、多样性及四个结构信号（连通性、无环性、分支覆盖率、路径收敛度），据此在修正/回溯/停止间决策；并采用图收敛早停，当证据分支汇聚到单一结论时终止。成本约束在约 2 步 / 4.5–5 节点。

Result: 在 DeepSeek 上于 GSM8K、MATH、BBH（各 n=50）分别达到 98%、92%、82%，均为基线最高；最难集合增益最大（MATH 较单次 +24pp，较扁平反思 +12pp）。

Conclusion: 推理图的结构信号在单步推理最不可靠的场景中价值最大，说明结构化的步骤级可定位性与收敛判据能有效提升多跳推理的准确率与成本效率。

Abstract: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.

</details>


### [681] [ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25980)
*Yicheng Wang,Wentao Tan,Yidan Huang,Yifei Liu,Qiong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClueFlow 通过构建 Source-State-Final 归因链，将长程搜索中的浏览器动作、研究状态更新与最终答案关联，用该归因指导 SFT 监督选择与 Turn-PPO 信用分配，在多个搜索基准上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法虽维护研究状态以引导探索或给出轮级进度信号，但很少将这些信号建立在显式、可追溯的状态变化之上，监督与信用分配的可靠性不足。

Method: 构建 Source-State-Final 归因链，连接获取证据的浏览器动作、Evidence/Candidate 更新及被其支持的最终答案；搜索中记录类型化状态变化与潜在支持动作，执行后做 gold 条件语义验证与来源溯源。该归因用于：(1) SFT 阶段仅对具原始交互上下文的被归因决策进行监督；(2) Turn-PPO 中沿归因链为基于结果的轮级优势补充信用；(3) 转移级验证从最终答案错误但含 gold 一致状态变化的轨迹中回收监督信号。

Result: 在两个 Qwen 主干、四个覆盖实时网页与固定语料设定的搜索基准上，SFT 稳定增益、PPO 进一步提升；Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 在 BrowseComp 达 60.0%、BrowseComp-Plus 达 72.0%。受控实验中，归因引导 SFT 以约 30% 训练 token 达到全轮精确上下文 SFT 的效果；归因引导 PPO 比仅结果 PPO 高 4.1 个百分点。

Conclusion: 状态转移归因可为长程搜索智能体提供高效监督与有效信用分配。

Abstract: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.

</details>


### [682] [Map-Distribution Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Agent Pathfinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25991)
*Fumimaro Suzuki,Keisuke Okumura*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种元层面的混合专家（MoE）方法用于基于学习的多智能体路径规划（MAPF）：以多个针对不同地图分布训练的高性能专家为基础，学习一个路由器按智能体局部情境选择性融合专家输出，并结合监督与强化学习微调验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有MAPF研究主要聚焦单一/个体策略设计，较少从"元层面"整合多个专精于不同地图分布的策略；作者希望利用专家分工与路由器自适应融合提升策略容量与泛化性，服务于仓储物流等可扩展集体自动化问题。

Method: 构建MoE元架构：预训练若干紧凑但高性能的地理/地图分布专家，学习一个基于智能体局部观测的路由器实现输出选择性融合；以图神经网络策略与作者新提出的递归动作token精炼模型（recursive action-token refinement model）两种骨干实例化，并对专家进行监督学习与强化学习微调。

Result: 实验表明MoE整体优于预训练单体策略，并超过现有领先方法；但经适当训练、参数量对齐的单体模型（monolithic models）仍优于MoE，说明地图分布型MoE在MAPF中的作用具有微妙性。

Conclusion: MoE能以元层面方式有效提升MAPF策略表现，但参数匹配的单体模型在充分训练下可取得更优结果，因此MoE并非默认更优选择，其价值取决于专家专精程度、路由器设计与训练配置；为后续MAPF架构选择提供了审慎的经验证据。

Abstract: Designing capable neural policies for multi-agent pathfinding (MAPF), which map local observations to action distributions, represents an important challenge in multi-agent learning, with practical relevance to scalable collective automation problems such as warehouse logistics. In contrast to prior studies focusing primarily on individual policy design, this study explores a meta-level Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approach to learning-based MAPF. Specifically, given a collection of compact yet high-performing experts specialised for different map distributions, our architecture learns a router that selectively fuses their outputs according to each agent's local situation. We instantiate and validate this MoE approach with a commonly used graph neural network-based policy as well as a newly developed recursive action-token refinement model. Combined with supervised and reinforcement learning fine-tuning of the experts, our experiments show that MoE generally improves upon the pretrained policy and outperforms existing leading methods. At the same time, our findings reveal that appropriately trained, parameter-matched monolithic models still outperform MoE, highlighting a nuanced role for map-distribution MoE for MAPF.

</details>


### [683] [Procedural Memory for Language Agents: A Neurosymbolic Perspective on Explicit Goal Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25996)
*Jonathan Leung,Zhiqi Shen,Deheng Ye*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文主张大模型长程任务不可靠的根源在于缺乏显式的"程序性记忆"，提出以目标导向图（Goal-Oriented Graphs）作为可检查的符号化表示来编码目标与前置依赖，并讨论其构建、挑战及与神经推理的融合原则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型在需要程序性推理的长程任务上仍不可靠。作者认为关键原因是缺少显式的程序性记忆，即关于"任务如何完成"的可访问、可修改的知识，并将其与语义记忆、情景记忆区分开来。

Method: 提出用目标导向图作为程序性记忆的表示形式：以符号结构编码目标及其前置依赖关系，使结构可被检查（inspectable）。文章围绕三个方面展开论述：图的构建方法、所面临的挑战、以及与神经推理模块结合的原则。

Result: 摘要未给出实验或定量结果，属于立场/展望型论述，主要产出为概念框架与设计原则。

Conclusion: 将显式符号化的目标—依赖图与神经网络推理相结合，可能是弥补大模型长程程序性推理短板的有前景方向；关键在于保证该结构的可构建性与可修改性。

Abstract: Large language models remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks requiring procedural reasoning. We argue that a key cause is the absence of explicit procedural memory: accessible, modifiable knowledge of how tasks are accomplished, distinct from semantic and episodic memory. Goal-Oriented Graphs offer such a representation, encoding goals and prerequisite dependencies as inspectable symbolic structure. We examine their construction, the challenges they pose, and principles for integrating them with neural reasoning.

</details>


### [684] [TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002)
*Chenghao Liu,Wei Fan,Jindong Han,Dongjie Wang,Aniket Mahanti,Pengyang Wang,Hao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出时间序列System 1模型TimesJev，通过保留关键频率模式的压缩表示解决原始时间序列与嵌入空间不兼容问题，在13个数据集上推理时间减少62.9%、性能提升超62%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于思维链的LLM时间序列推理需消耗数千token，推理延迟高；而System 1类模型（如Jev）可即时决策，但原始时间序列（常含数千数值点）与其嵌入空间不兼容，损害推理性能。

Method: 形式化时间序列推理的System 1充分性，导出降维目标：由衡量压缩核心信息损失的充分性散度与量化模型对最优预测不兼容性的可实现性散度组成；用带门控机制的时间序列压缩学习充分性，再将所选表示与嵌入空间对齐以实现可实现性。

Result: 13个数据集实验表明，TimesJev相较推理模型性能提升超62%，平均推理时间比其微调版本少62.9%。

Conclusion: 尽早探索并提出时间序列System 1模型TimesJev，验证以压缩表示替代长思维链推理可兼顾效率与性能。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently shown strong potential for time series reasoning, while models that reason over time series are usually with long chains of thought. However, this process often consumes thousands of tokens, directly leading to substantial latency during inference. In contrast, System 1 models such as Jev make decisions instantly and can naturally be an alternative, but raw time series are not compatible with the embedding space of these models, thus hindering the reasoning performance, especially when input series contain thousands of numeric points. In this paper, we make a very early attempt to propose a time series System 1 model, namely TimesJev. Specifically, we first formalize System 1 sufficiency in time series reasoning, which motivates a compressed representation for time series with key frequency patterns preserved. To construct this representation, we derive a dimension reduction objective that combines (i) a sufficiency divergence that measures the core information lost during compression, and (ii) a realizability divergence that quantifies the incompatibility of the System 1 model to the optimal prediction given this representation. We optimize this objective by learning time series compression with a gating mechanism for sufficiency, and then aligning the selected representation with the embedding space for realizability. Finally, experiments on 13 datasets demonstrate that TimesJev outperforms reasoning models by over 62% with 62.9% less inference time than their fine-tuned versions on average.

</details>


### [685] [Understanding When Reflective Prompt and Skill Optimization Helps on Locally Served Reasoning Models: A Two-Model Study of GEPA and SkillOpt](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26020)
*Andrea Giummarra,Carmelo Baglieri,Antonio Di Maria,Andrea Farruggio,Michele Piatto,Giovanni Micale*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在DeepSeek V4 Flash与Qwen3.8-27B两个目标上复现GEPA/SkillOpt等反思式文本空间优化器：增益高度依赖任务与方法，且验证集增益可能在留出集上反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GEPA、SkillOpt等反思式文本空间优化器此前在前沿及中等规模模型上报告了大幅增益，但其可复现性、跨服务配置的稳定性以及增益来源尚不清楚，需要系统检验。

Method: 在两个reasoning-native的目标服务配置（DeepSeek V4 Flash经由DwarfStar、Qwen3.8-27B经由LM Studio）上，对同一批留出任务测试四种条件：最小基线、GEPA提示、SkillOpt技能、人工工程提示；HotpotQA每条件n=500，MATH-500每条件n=250。主实验为冻结协议下的Qwen v2重跑，并保留早期Qwen运行作为服务敏感性证据。

Result: Qwen v2重跑中GEPA选中HotpotQA种子并精确复现基线，而SkillOpt的验证增益在留出集上反转为性能下降。MATH-500上GEPA将精确匹配从0.828提升至0.904，延迟下降但token消耗上升；DeepSeek同样在MATH-500上GEPA效果最强（0.852→0.908）。两个目标上GEPA增益均集中于MATH-500，两优化器均未改善HotpotQA基线。

Conclusion: 文本空间优化器的效果是任务与方法依赖的，验证增益可能不泛化到留出集。将模型的文本余量与其观测效应分解为内容/推理、答案实现/评测对齐、服务完成/可靠性三个维度更具信息量；跨基准模式提示优化更受益于低歧义、可行动的评测信号。

Abstract: Reflective text-space optimizers such as GEPA and SkillOpt have reported large gains on frontier and mid-size models. We test replication across two reasoning-native target-serving configurations: DeepSeek V4 Flash through DwarfStar and Qwen3.8-27B through LM Studio. For each target, we evaluate the same held-out tasks and four conditions - minimal baseline, GEPA prompt, SkillOpt skill, and manually engineered prompt - on HotpotQA (n=500 per condition) and MATH-500 (n=250). In the primary Qwen v2 rerun under the same frozen protocol, GEPA selects the HotpotQA seed and exactly reproduces baseline behavior, whereas SkillOpt's validation gain reverses into held-out degradation. On MATH-500, GEPA raises exact match from 0.828 to 0.904 while reducing latency but increasing token consumption, so lower response time does not imply lower token cost. DeepSeek likewise shows its strongest GEPA effect on MATH-500 (0.852 to 0.908). Across both targets, GEPA's strongest gains occur on MATH-500, while neither optimizer improves the HotpotQA baseline. Optimization is therefore task- and method-dependent, and validation gains may reverse on held-out evaluation. An earlier Qwen run is retained as serving-sensitivity evidence. These results suggest that textual headroom for a model-task pair and the observed effect of a text-space optimizer are more informative when decomposed into content/reasoning, answer-realization/evaluator alignment, and serving-completion/reliability. The cross-benchmark pattern further suggests that optimization may benefit from low-ambiguity, actionable evaluation signals.

</details>


### [686] [AuDQ: Auditable Data Quality through Agentic Rule Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26031)
*Jacopo Biggiogera,Nicolas Colombo,Krati Saxena,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"本体驱动、仓库原生"的数据质量层愿景：规则作为一等公民工件，可版本化、与治理文本溯源关联、并通过不可变执行轨迹重放；并实现其智能体规则发现核心（全自主 Full-Agentic 与引导式 Guided 两种模式）及人在回路审查界面，在金融与零售两个真实工业数据集上初步验证全自主"分治式"智能体规则发现的质量与多样性可与人类专家规则相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高风险表格流水线依赖分散、静态的质量检查，难以演进，也难以对照政策意图进行审计。受监管领域对可追溯性与问责性的期望在 LLM 时代自动化背景下进一步升高，现有做法无法满足。

Method: 提出本体驱动、仓库原生的数据质量层愿景：规则作为一等工件，具备版本管理、与治理文本的溯源链接、以及不可变执行轨迹可重放。作为验证该愿景的第一步，给出智能体规则发现核心的具体实现，含两种规则获取模式（Full-Agentic 与 Guided）和人在回路（HITL）审查界面；并定义评估框架，采用全自主分治式（divide-and-conquer）智能体规则发现开展实验。

Result: 在金融与零售两个真实工业数据集上进行实验，初步结果表明全自主分治式智能体规则发现在规则质量与多样性上可与人类专家制定的规则相媲美（preliminary results）。

Conclusion: 初步验证了智能体规则发现作为本体驱动、仓库原生数据质量层的可行核心组件；该工作定位为迈向完整愿景的第一步，后续需进一步扩展至完整质量层与更充分评估。

Abstract: High-stakes tabular pipelines rely on scattered, static quality checks that are hard to evolve and audit against policy intent. Regulated domains particularly suffer as the LLM-era automation raises expectations for traceability and accountability. We propose a vision for an ontology-grounded, repository-native data quality layer in which rules are first-class artifacts: versioned, provenance-linked to governance texts, and re-playable through immutable execution traces. As a first step toward validating this vision, we present a concrete implementation of its agentic rule-discovery core with two rule acquisition modes (Full-Agentic and Guided) and a human-in-the-loop (HITL) review interface. We define an evaluation framework and run experiments addressing whether our fully autonomous, divide-and-conquer agentic rule discovery produces rules of the same quality and diversity as those specified by a human expert, reporting preliminary results on two real world industry datasets in the finance and retail domains.

</details>


### [687] [Decision4Rec: A Jev-Inspired Framework of Decision Models on Knowledge and Active Graphs for Multi-Agent Recommender Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26035)
*Marco Polignano,Het Darshan Mehta,Pasquale Lops,Ernesto William De Luca,Giovanni Semeraro*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Decision4Rec：面向推荐的开源模块化框架，让决策模型（返回选项概率而非生成文本）服务于推荐；在稀疏Amazon目录上NDCG@10较最佳基线提升25–36%，稠密Steam上基本持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有决策模型（如商业Jev）按选项返回概率而非生成文本，但缺乏将其用于推荐的开放、模块化框架；本文旨在建立该框架并评估决策模型的推荐价值。

Method: 知识图谱将各推荐场景日志写成定义刻度上的短陈述（如"sold: top 10%"）；agent池提候选，残差排序器保留前30；决策模型经统一类型化问题接口读取候选，并与排序器分数融合；仅用三个场景真实选择训练一次，任意符合该接口的模型均可接入（商业Jev、开源Kev及自训Kev）。

Result: 4B决策模型在三个稀疏Amazon目录上NDCG@10超最佳训练基线25–36%（其中一目录未参与训练），稠密Steam基本持平；增益主要来自候选池，且在训练推荐器存在时来自agent对候选的认知而非新候选；27B在四域中三域较0.8B提升5–6%；0.8B开源模型在15个设置中11个胜过Jev且从不更差；MovieLens-1M未见稠密域提升5–7%。

Conclusion: 决策模型可通过统一接口有效增强推荐，开源实现具竞争力且优于商业模型；代码、配置与模型已开源。

Abstract: Decision models, such as the commercial Jev, are language models that return one probability for each option of a question instead of generating text. We present Decision4Rec, an open and modular framework that makes decision models useful for recommendation. A knowledge graph writes the logs of each recommendation scenario as short statements on a defined scale, such as "sold: top 10%". A pool of agents, proposes candidates, and a residual ranker keeps the best 30. A decision model, trained once on real choices of three scenarios, reads them through one interface of typed questions, and a fusion step combines its answers with the score of the ranker. Any model with this interface can be used, and we run the commercial Jev, the released open Kev and Kev models trained by us on recommendation requests. The framework with a trained 4B decision model is 25 to 36% above the best trained baseline in NDCG@10 in three sparse Amazon catalogues, one of them never used to train the decision model, and almost tie with baselines on the dense Steam dataset. Most of the gain comes from the pool, and with a trained recommender it comes from what the agents know about its candidates rather than from new candidates. The 27B decision model adds to the pool 5 to 6% above the 0.8B model in three of four domains. A trained 0.8B open model beats the released Jev in eleven of fifteen settings and is never worse. On MovieLens-1M, a dense domain never seen in training, the gain is 5 to 7%. Code, configurations and trained models are available at https://github.com/marcopoli/decision4rec and https://huggingface.co/m-polignano.

</details>


### [688] [FinSafeGuard: A Quality-Driven Synthetic Dataset for Financial AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26066)
*Joseph Thomas Thacil,Reetu Raj Harsh,Krati Saxena,Bhaskarjit Sarmah,Stefano Pasquali*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出从63.2万场景规格分类法生成1430万条质量过滤合成训练样本的四阶段流水线，含预生成参数研究、条件自动进化、双层语义去重与LLM评判过滤，并在银行/保险/金融服务三域验证去重与批大小优化规律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据稀缺领域训练专用AI系统时，大规模生成高质量合成数据仍是基本挑战，特别是合成数据的质量、多样性与真实性问题。

Method: 四阶段流水线：(1)预生成研究，通过递减收益分析确定最优生成参数；(2)条件自动进化机制，在生成过程中修复低多样性批次；(3)双层语义去重架构，结合词法与嵌入方法；(4)LLM-as-Judge质量评估，基于行为正确性与元组保真度过滤样本。

Result: 三域（银行、保险、金融服务）去重率为9.9%–40.6%，输出生成模式冗余最高；批大小优化揭示模式特定的多样性饱和阈值。流水线将2640万原始样本降至1430万：合并降20.9%、语义去重降18.7%、质量过滤降15.9%。

Conclusion: 提供了一个可复现、具备严格质量控制、面向特定领域的合成数据生成框架。

Abstract: Generating high-quality synthetic datasets at scale remains a fundamental challenge for training specialized AI systems in data-scarce domains. We present a comprehensive methodology that produces 14.3 million quality-filtered synthetic training examples from a structured taxonomy of 632,000 scenario specifications. Our four-stage pipeline ad- dresses critical challenges in synthetic data quality, diversity, and realism through: (1) systematic pre-generation research establishing optimal generation parameters via diminishing returns analysis, (2) conditional auto evolution mechanisms that remediate low-diversity batches during generation, (3) a two-layer semantic deduplication architecture combining lexical and embedding-based methods, and (4) LLM-as-Judge quality evaluation filtering samples based on behavioral correctness and tuple fidelity. Empirical analysis across three domains (Banking, Insurance, Financial Services) demonstrates domain-specific deduplication patterns ranging from 9.9% to 40.6%, with output generation modes exhibiting highest redundancy. Our batch size optimization reveals mode-specific diversity saturation thresholds, enabling principled allocation strategies. The complete pipeline reduces 26.4M raw samples to 14.3M high-confidence examples through merge (20.9% reduction), semantic deduplication (18.7% reduction), and quality-based filtering (15.9% reduction), providing a reproducible framework for domain-specific synthetic data generation with rigorous quality control.

</details>


### [689] [CUA-Lite: An Open Platform for Computer Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26071)
*Zhanhui Zhou,Weichen Zhang,Haoran Liu,Lingjie Chen,Tianneng Shi,Kevin Lin,Zhengyuan Yang,Lijuan Wang,Dawn Song*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CUA-Lite 是一个面向计算机使用智能体（CUA）的开源开发平台，通过统一环境接口、统一监督数据格式和共享模型 harness 三项标准化抽象，整合 12 个基准、3 万余可验证任务与 14 个模型族，支撑评测、RL 与 SFT 共用同一基础设施。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CUA 领域的环境、数据集与模型资源高度分散，缺乏统一标准导致资源难以集成与扩展，且评测、强化学习与监督微调各行其道、无法共享同一套基础设施。

Method: 提出三项标准化抽象：(1) 统一环境接口，集成桌面、浏览器、移动端 12 个基准，并提供低成本、免虚拟机的轻量沙箱以复刻 OSWorld 桌面环境，共 3 万余可验证任务；(2) 统一监督数据格式，将主流 CUA 数据集（GUI 定位、理解到完整 rollout）转换至该格式，并补充前沿 CUA 在可验证环境上的新 rollout；(3) 跨评测、RL、SFT 共享的模型 harness，每个模型一个、共覆盖 14 个模型族，既可让模型在环境中执行生成 rollout 供评测与 RL 使用，也可将存储的监督数据渲染为该模型自身的训练格式用于 SFT。

Result: 发布集成基准上的参考分数；实验表明，通过同一 harness 进行 RL 和 SFT 均可提升开源权重模型的表现。

Conclusion: 平台的数据集、代码与模型均已开源，并向社区开放贡献，为 CUA 的开发、评测与训练提供统一可扩展的基础设施。

Abstract: Open resources for computer use agents (CUAs) -- environments, datasets, and models -- remain scattered: without a standard, these resources cannot be integrated and scaled; additionally, evaluation, RL, and SFT cannot share one infrastructure. We present CUA-Lite, an open platform for developing CUAs, built around three standardized abstractions: (1) Unified environment interface, under which we integrate 12 benchmarks across desktop, browser, and mobile, plus lightweight VM-free sandboxes that replicate OSWorld's desktop at much lower cost, providing over 30,000 verifiable tasks. (2) Unified supervised data format, into which we convert the major public CUA datasets, from GUI grounding and understanding to full rollouts, and record our fresh rollouts from frontier CUAs on these verifiable environments. (3) Model harnesses shared across evaluation, RL, and SFT, one per model and implemented for 14 model families. Each harness runs its model in these computer environments, producing the rollouts that evaluation and RL consume, or renders stored supervised data into the model's own training format for SFT. We release reference scores across the integrated benchmarks, and show that RL and SFT through the same harness improve open-weight models. We release our dataset, code, and models, and the platform is open to contributions.

</details>


### [690] [From Code to Playable Systems: CEGame-Bench for Long-Horizon Game Creation Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26098)
*Zixuan Dong,Yanghai Wang,Hanyan Bian,Jiaxi Tao,Junze Li,Jiadong Wang,Xinyu Che,Lin Liu,Baoyun Peng,Xiaodong Wang,Jiaheng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 CEGame-Bench，首个跨五个生产级引擎（Defold、Godot、Roblox Studio、Unity、Unreal）的长程完整游戏创作基准，揭示智能体"产物可构建但不可玩"的差距，并发布 Game Completion Boost 技能提升基于执行的得分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有游戏创作智能体多仅在单一引擎或单提示浏览器小游戏上评测，"成功构建"并不保证"可启动、可通关、可回到存档世界"，即缺乏对完整可玩游戏的长程、跨引擎评测手段。

Method: 从空项目与设计文档出发（文档兼作契约），智能体在平均至多 295 步、65M token 的长程运行中构建游戏；隐藏评测器仅通过真实输入游玩判定是否接受；在四种脚手架下测评，并对比工程师用编码智能体构建的参考实现；同时分析引擎间排名一致性（Kendall's tau）与释放 Game Completion Boost 智能体技能（需求驱动的试玩与修复）。

Result: 智能体在集成点得分较高，但玩法得分多不足一半，仅 16% 运行抵达结局；参考实现接近满分，表明差距在智能体而非基准。不同引擎对配置排名不一致（Kendall's tau 0.14–0.62），同一游戏在 Unity 与 Unreal 上得分通常更高（其游玩前检查更多）。Game Completion Boost 使三个模型的执行型得分提升 14.1–24.3 分。

Conclusion: 完整游戏创作存在显著"从产物到可玩"的缺口，需以真实游玩为验收标准；跨引擎评测不可互相替代，而需求驱动的自动化试玩与修复技能可有效缩小该差距。

Abstract: A game ships when a player can launch it, finish it, and return to a saved world, none of which a successful build guarantees, yet game-creation agents are mostly tested on one engine or on one-prompt browser games. We present CEGame-Bench, the first long-horizon benchmark for complete-game creation across five production engines: Defold, Godot, Roblox Studio, Unity, and Unreal Engine. Agents build each game from an empty project and a design document in runs averaging up to 295 steps and 65M tokens; the document doubles as a contract, and a hidden evaluator accepts a game only by real-input play. Under four scaffolds, agents earn most integration points but usually under half the gameplay points, and their games reach the ending in only 16% of runs, while references built by engineers with coding agents score near the maximum, which places this artifact-to-play gap in the agents. No two engines rank configurations alike (Kendall's tau 0.14-0.62), and the same game usually scores higher on Unity and Unreal Engine, which check more before play. We release Game Completion Boost, an agent skill for requirement-driven playtesting and repair that raises the execution-based score of three models by 14.1-24.3 points.

</details>


### [691] [Reliable Before Profitable: QuantHarness for Governing Financial Strategy Development with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26101)
*Jiasheng Mao,Jiacheng Liu,Hengwei Ye,Zheng Tian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出QuantHarness双层agent harness（金融专用Workflow + Harness Core边界约束）与FinRelBench基准，从trajectory层面评估金融策略开发可靠性，任务成功率90.72%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM agent能把自然语言金融研究请求转为可执行、可回测的策略，但"运行成功"不等于"正确"：可能实现了错误的规则、使用了决策时点不可得的信息（前视偏差），或掩盖了修复与候选选择如何改变策略。这些失败贯穿开发全过程，因此仅凭最终代码与性能指标无法证明对请求的忠实性及开发过程的有效性。作者主张在trajectory层面保证可靠性：系统须控制中间输出如何成为下游状态，并保留为终局结果辩护所需的证据。

Method: 提出QuantHarness，两层agent harness：①金融专用Workflow，对specification（需求规约）、data grounding（数据接地）、construction（策略构建）、testing、review五阶段进行结构化编排；②Harness Core，施加阶段特定的信息、动作与承诺（commitment）边界，约束中间产物向状态的转化。同时构建FinRelBench基准，以执行成功率、需求满足度、运行时证据三维度评估策略开发可靠性，并设计受控压力测试与证据检索/决策重放实验。

Result: QuantHarness任务成功率达90.72%，优于对比系统的74.23%–84.54%。受控压力测试表明其边界机制能拦截定向违规；结构化运行记录提升了证据检索效果，并在所评估协议下支持决策重放。

Conclusion: 金融策略开发可靠性的关键不在最终产物，而在trajectory级的流程约束与证据保全；显式阶段边界可有效抑制信息泄漏与过程不可追溯问题，为可信金融agent提供可审计的开发范式。

Abstract: LLM agents can turn natural-language financial research requests into executable and backtested strategies, but a successful run may still implement the wrong rule, use information unavailable at decision time, or obscure how repairs and candidate selection changed the strategy. Because these failures arise throughout development, final code and performance metrics alone are insufficient to establish either fidelity to the request or the validity of the development process. We therefore address the reliability of financial strategy development at the trajectory level: the system must control how intermediate outputs become downstream state and preserve the evidence needed to justify the terminal outcome. We introduce QuantHarness, a two-layer agent harness in which a finance-specific Workflow structures specification, data grounding, construction, testing, and review, while Harness Core enforces stage-specific information, action, and commitment boundaries. We also introduce FinRelBench, a benchmark that evaluates strategy-development reliability through execution success, requirement satisfaction, and runtime evidence. QuantHarness achieves the highest Task Success at 90.72\%, compared with 74.23\%--84.54\% for the comparison systems. Controlled stress tests show that its boundaries contain targeted violations, while structured run records improve evidence retrieval and support decision replay under the evaluated protocol.

</details>


### [692] [MoveBench: A Rubric-Based Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models in Sports and Health Coaching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26185)
*Yitong Li,Jiang Bian,Jingling Wang,Pan Ding,Chengying Gu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出MoveBench——首个面向运动与健康指导领域的大模型综合评测基准，融合选择题与开放式问答，并结合强调安全性、科学性与训练逻辑的结构化评分细则，对15个LLM进行大规模评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在运动与健康领域应用风险高，但缺乏领域专用评测基准；现有通用基准（MMLU、HELM）侧重广谱知识与推理，无法覆盖运动安全、生理适宜性、个性化及可执行指导质量等关键需求，错误建议可能造成身体伤害。

Method: 构建MoveBench：整合异构任务格式（多选题MCQ与开放式问答OpenQA），基于真实用户场景设计，并配套结构化评分细则（rubric），重点考察安全合规、科学有效性与训练逻辑；在809道题、5,012条细则级标准上对15个多样化LLM进行大规模评测。

Result: 模型表现差异显著，尤其在安全意识、结构化训练方案设计与个性化能力方面表现不一，揭示出“知”与“行”之间的关键鸿沟（knowing-doing gap）。

Conclusion: 为运动与健康领域LLM应用确立基础评测标准，并提供可复现框架，推动安全、可靠、情境感知的AI指导系统发展；资源已开源。

Abstract: Despite rapid advances in large language models (LLMs), their deployment in the sports and health domain remains high-risk due to the absence of domain-specific evaluation benchmarks. Existing general-purpose benchmarks (e.g., MMLU and HELM) primarily assess broad knowledge and reasoning capabilities, but fail to capture critical domain requirements such as exercise safety, physiological appropriateness, personalization, and actionable coaching quality. This gap is particularly concerning in fitness and health applications, where incorrect or unsafe recommendations can lead to physical harm. To address this limitation, we introduce MoveBench, the first comprehensive benchmarking framework specifically designed for evaluating LLMs in sports and health coaching. The proposed benchmark integrates heterogeneous task formats, including multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and open-ended question answering (OpenQA), grounded in real-world user scenarios and paired with structured rubrics emphasizing safety compliance, scientific validity, and training logic. Through large-scale evaluation of 15 diverse LLMs on 809 questions with 5,012 rubric-level criteria, our results reveal substantial performance variability, particularly in safety awareness, structured program design, and personalization capability, highlighting a critical gap between knowing and doing. Our work establishes a foundational evaluation standard for sports and health LLM applications and provides a reproducible framework for advancing safe, reliable, and context-aware AI-driven coaching systems. Open resources are available at https://github.com/SatoSakula/MoveBench.

</details>


### [693] [On Counting Graphs for Modal Logic with Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26187)
*Avijeet Ghosh,François Schwarzentruber*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究图神经网络正向分类（等价于满足给定计数模态逻辑公式）的树与图的计数问题的理论计算复杂度，并研究收敛性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图神经网络与计数模态逻辑在表达能力上等价，但"被GNN正向分类的结构究竟有多少、计数问题本身有多难、相关过程的收敛性如何"这一理论层面尚未厘清，本文旨在给出复杂度刻画。

Method: 将GNN正分类视为等价于满足计数模态逻辑（modal logic with counting）公式，对树、图等结构上的计数问题作计算复杂度分析，并辅以收敛性分析。

Result: 摘要未给出具体结果，仅说明建立了GNN正分类计数问题的复杂度刻画并研究了收敛性。

Conclusion: GNN正分类与计数模态逻辑公式可判定性之间存在统一视角，其计数问题具有明确的复杂度地位，且相关过程具收敛性质。

Abstract: In this paper, we study the theoretical computational complexity of counting trees and graphs that are classified positively by a graph neural networks, or said equivalently that satisfy a given formula of modal logic with counting. We also study convergence.

</details>


### [694] [LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26211)
*Anastasiia Kucherenko,Francois Brouchoud,Dimitri Percia David,Andrei Kucharavy*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 小参数端侧LLM在合法法律任务中，用户自然添加的权威身份前缀（如"我是律师"）会使拒答率较无前缀基线上升2–20倍，即出现"过度拒答"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律行业出于保密需求倾向使用本地部署的小型开源LLM处理摘要、翻译、改写等日常任务；按常规提示词建议，用户会自然声明自己的职业身份。作者关注这一无害习惯是否带来隐性代价——通过不对称的求助可及性引入偏见。

Method: 在四个现代小型开源权重LLM上，对良性的法律领域提示进行评测，对比无前缀基线、权威型身份前缀（如"我为某国最高法院工作"、"我是辩护律师"）以及已知的角色扮演越狱前缀三种条件下的拒答率。

Result: 权威型前缀使拒答率相对无前缀基线系统性上升2–20倍；而越狱式角色扮演前缀的效应不一致，在部分模型中拒答急剧增加，在另一些模型中几乎无变化。

Conclusion: 小型可本地部署LLM在真实机构用户可能自然引入的上下文框定下表现不稳定，存在选择性拒答带来的偏见风险，需进一步研究以尽量减少偏见产生的机会。

Abstract: Confidentiality requirements increasingly push legal professionals toward small, on-device LLMs that keep case data in-house, used for everyday tasks such as summarization, translation, and reformulation. Following standard prompting guidance, a user naturally states their role (``I am a lawyer...''). We show that this innocuous habit has an unexpected cost: such authority framing can make the model selectively refuse legitimate requests, introducing bias through uneven access to assistance. We evaluate four modern small open-weight LLMs on benign legal-domain prompts to measure this over-refusal.
  Surprisingly, we find that authority-style prefixes (''I am legal counsel working for a national supreme court'', ''I'm a defense lawyer'') systematically increase refusal rates by 2--20x over the no-prefix baseline, while a known role-play jailbreak prefix shows mixed effects, sharply increasing refusals in some models and barely shifting them in others. The finding suggests that small on-prem deployable LLMs are unstable under contextual framings that a real institutional user might naturally introduce, and further investigation is essential to minimize opportunities for bias.

</details>


### [695] [Fairness or Fallacy? Mapping the Landscape of AI Bias in Disease Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26215)
*Ghulam Mudassir,Hameed Ullah Khan,Ahmad Sami Al-Shamayleh,Muhammad Faizan Khan,Muhammad Muqtasid,Moamin Abughazala,Adnan Akhunzada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于医疗疾病检测中AI偏见识别与缓解方法的系统性综述，从64,389篇文献中筛选出2015–2026年的23篇研究，按输入数据类型、模型架构和偏见类型进行分类总结，并指出研究空白。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗数据复杂度与诊断影像体量增长，使AI在疾病检测中的计算需求既带来机遇也带来挑战；现有方法虽从模型类型、输入数据性质、人群特征等方面考虑临床诊断，但AI偏见问题尚需系统梳理，以指导公平性研究。

Method: 系统性文献综述：设定2015–2026年时间窗口，从七个数字图书馆检索64,389篇文献，最终纳入23篇相关研究；按输入数据类型、模型架构以及偏见类型（算法偏见、人口统计偏见、模型偏见、部署偏见）对解决方案进行区分与归类。

Result: 归纳出所选最新研究在疾病检测中偏见识别与缓解的技术现状，并揭示AI相关偏见研究中的显著空白，为后续研究提供方向。

Conclusion: 通过优先关注可解释性、数据多样性、算法设计公平性以及对患者群体的公平可及性，可更有效地利用医疗资源并缓解医疗诊断中的AI偏见。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has several transformative effects on healthcare, like to facilitate clinicians in disease detection and to manage patient care with enhanced precision. Due to the increasing complexity of medical data and the growing volume of diagnostic images, the substantial computational power needed to process such information creates both opportunities and challenges. To accomplish this objective, numerous methodologies have been proposed to integrate AI into disease detection systems. All these methodologies consider different aspects of clinical diagnosis, considering key parameters such as the type of AI model employed, the nature of input data, and the population demographics being analysed. In this paper, we review different state-of-the-art techniques which have been proposed for various areas of disease detection, specifically focusing on bias identification and mitigation. The proposed solutions are distinguished based on the type of input data they utilize, the architecture of model, and type of bias (algorithmic bias, demographic bias, model bias, and deployment bias). The time frame chosen to filter out relevant studies is between 2015 and 2026. Eventually, we review 23 related articles out of 64,389 analyzed from seven different digital libraries. The obtained results guide us to reach a conclusion with respect to state-of-the-art selected studies. Furthermore, these results reveal significant research gaps that can assist researchers in addressing AI-related bias in medical diagnosis. By prioritizing explainability, data diversity, and fairness in algorithmic design, as well as equitable access for affected patient populations, they can utilize available healthcare resources more effectively.

</details>


### [696] [Towards More Granular Reasoning: Mapping the DSA Transparency Database Taxonomy to Platform Terms and Conditions Using Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26226)
*Alyson Ranucci,Eline Leijten,David Graus*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将31个指定在线服务的条款与条件（447份政策文档）映射到DSA透明度数据库的17个高层属性类别，用few-shot GPT-4.1分类器检验该分类体系对合同规则的描述能力。结果显示类别适用性随服务类型剧烈变化，且子类规范间存在显著重叠，作者据此认为"兜底式报送"部分源于数据库模式设计，并建议按服务类型差异化、增加由平台治理语言归纳出的强制属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DSA第24(5)条要求平台就每项内容审核决定提交理由说明（SoR）至DSA透明度数据库，并按17个高层属性类别标注主要理由。然而超过99.8%的说明引用的是平台自身条款与条件而非法律条款，使该数据库实质上是合同执行的记录，且依赖兜底报送。此前尚无研究检验这些类别是否真正能描述合同规则，本文填补这一空白。

Method: 构建31个指定在线服务的条款与条件语料（447份政策文档），采用few-shot GPT-4.1分类器将T&C规则映射至DSA-TDB的高层类别体系；分析聚焦规则在分类体系中的表征（representation），而非实际执行（enforcement）；随后按服务类型统计类别适用比例并考察子类规范间的重叠。

Result: (1) 高层类别适用性随服务类型差异显著：unsafe products占电商类分配的17.5%，但在成人平台仅0.2%；negative effects on civic discourse在Meta系服务内达9.9%，却在成人平台、Booking.com与Wikipedia中完全缺失。(2) 子类规范之间存在明显重叠，使单条决定难以归入唯一高层类别。

Conclusion: 兜底式报送在相当程度上可能是DSA-TDB模式与属性设计的产物，而非纯粹的报送行为问题。建议采用按服务类型差异化的模式，并纳入更多由平台治理语言归纳得出的强制属性。

Abstract: Article 24(5) of the Digital Services Act (DSA) requires providers of online platforms to submit every content moderation decision they make, with a corresponding Statement of Reasons (SoR), to the DSA Transparency Database (DSA-TDB). Such decisions are classified against seventeen high-level attribute categories that categorize the primary reason for the moderation decision. Because over 99.8% of statements cite a violation of the provider's own terms and conditions rather than a legal provision, the database is overwhelmingly a record of contractual enforcement using catch-all reporting; however, whether its categories actually describe those contractual rules well has not been examined. In this paper, we map the terms and conditions (T&C) of 31 designated online services against the DSA-TDB's high-level category taxonomy using a few-shot GPT-4.1 classifier over 447 policy documents. The analysis concerns how T&C rules are represented in the taxonomy, not how they are enforced. Two findings emerge. First, high-level category applicability varies sharply by service type: unsafe products account for 17.5% of e-commerce assignments and 0.2% of adult-platform assignments, and negative effects on civic discourse reaches 9.9% within the Meta family but is absent from adult platforms, Booking.com, and Wikipedia. Second, the categories have notable overlap among sub-category specifications, which makes assigning a single high-level category to a decision difficult. We argue that catch-all reporting is plausibly in part a consequence of the DSA-TDB's schema and attribute design, and recommend a schema that is differentiated by service type with more mandatory attributes derived inductively from platform governance language.

</details>


### [697] [CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26239)
*Jiang Sutong,Zhao Peng,Wu Xuan,Wang Yan,Wang Jiaqi,Zhang Rui,Jiang Yuan,Zhou You,Wang Di*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: CoRS 将图编码与可行性状态解耦，以区间级图复用+逐步可行性更新实现FJSP神经求解器的推理加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有FJSP神经求解器在每个"工序-机器"决策后都刷新图表示并更新可行性，其中图编码开销远大于可行性检查；而实际上每步只需保证可行性精确，图编码可低频刷新，故存在可摊销的冗余计算。

Method: 提出双时间尺度设计：区间级图表示在多次连续决策间复用，逐步可行性状态在每次动作后更新；配套保可行性的复合区间解码方案，含动态约束跟踪与边界状态同步；并引入增强静态特征作为补偿机制以缓解区间复用导致的表示陈旧。

Result: 在合成数据与多个公开FJSP基准上，CoRS显著降低推理时间，同时保持有竞争力的解质量，在严格墙钟预算与低延迟场景下取得良好速度-质量权衡。

Conclusion: 通过解耦图编码与可行性维护，可在不并行化动作生成、不放松约束的前提下摊销编码成本，为低延迟FJSP神经求解提供有效路径。

Abstract: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

</details>


### [698] [Machina Pauliana: A neuro-symbolic approach to the actio pauliana in Dutch insolvency law](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26241)
*Daan Boven,Gregor Behnke,David Graus*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出《荷兰破产法》第42条（actio pauliana）的神经符号模型：符号核心用Catala以文学化风格编写并与法条保持对齐，开放质地术语作为布尔输入由神经子程序通过类案推理（基于荷兰民事判决）解决，另由神经例程将自然语言事实结构化为布尔值与日期输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律条款适用既需要结构化的规则推理，又需要对判例法中形成的开放质地术语保持敏感；第42条同时具备这两方面需求，而现有方法难以兼顾规则可读性、法条对齐与开放术语的经验性判断。

Method: (1) 符号核心：Catala语言、literate编程风格，通过结对编程开发，保持成文法与形式化一致；开放质地术语表示为布尔输入，由神经组件与符号求解器耦合。(2) 神经例程：将案件自然语言事实结构化为布尔与日期输入。(3) 神经子程序：通过基于荷兰民事判决的类案推理解决开放术语；检索管线按待解决问题的要求进行过滤，并沿案件程序链扩展。(4) 对判决进行分段与标注。

Result: 分段与标注在100份人工标注金标准判决上取得高精确率与高召回率；在10个手工标注案件上，神经符号模型对多数要件处理合理，但在"知情要件"（knowledge requirement）上表现不佳；检索深度未显示明确的量化效应，但检索到的判决为先前判例法提供了显式依据。

Conclusion: 将Catala符号形式化与神经类案推理相结合的神经符号架构，能够在保持法条对齐的同时处理开放质地术语，具有可解释的判例依据；主要瓶颈在于知情要件的判定，检索深度的影响尚不明确，需进一步研究。

Abstract: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.

</details>


### [699] [Beyond Static Leaderboards: Capability-Focused Evaluation with Structural Diversity for Time Series Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26251)
*Hongyin Zhang,Mingyi Xiang,Rongzhao Chen,Yankai Wang,Jialin Qiao,Xiangdong Huang,Xiaoou Ding,Chen Wang,Zhongyi Pei,Jianmin Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出可刷新的评测扩展框架CaFE，在原始基准数据上引入结构多样性与多维能力画像，使时序基础模型评测能稳定反映真实泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 静态公开基准的测试分布固定且狭窄，反复复用易导致针对基准的调优，使成绩反映对固定测试集的适配而非真实预测泛化能力；同时单一聚合分数无法刻画模型在不同时间结构与输入关系下的能力差异。

Method: CaFE首先对原始基准做分布画像，定义八种刻画时间结构的结构特征（SFs）；针对每个SF按其结构支撑对原始数据重采样，剔除分布边缘样本，并通过改变SF显著性增强保留样本，生成具有不同结构剖面的样本；在过滤分布外样本同时保持多样性的前提下得到刷新评测集；随后用常规预测误差指标与干预响应指标评估TSFM，为每个模型给出各特征维度的能力画像及端点精度。

Result: 在GIFT-Eval与FEV-Mini20上的实验表明，CaFE评测结果稳定，能揭示被单一聚合分数掩盖的各特征维度强弱；在按结构条件筛选的真实数据上，由CaFE选出的模型优于按聚合排行榜选出的模型。

Conclusion: CaFE将模型选择条件化到所关注的结构响应上，实现可刷新、多维、面向能力的时间序列基础模型评测，弥补静态基准与单一聚合分数的不足。

Abstract: Static public benchmarks for time series foundation models (TSFMs) typically have fixed and narrow test distributions. Their repeated reuse encourages benchmark-specific tuning, making reported performance reflect adaptation to the fixed test set rather than genuine forecasting generalization. In addition, a single aggregate score cannot fully characterize model capabilities across distinct temporal structures and input relationships. We propose CaFE (Capability-Focused Evaluation), a refreshable evaluation extension grounded in original benchmark data that enriches static benchmarks with structural diversity and enriches single-score black-box evaluation with multi-dimensional, capability-oriented assessment. CaFE first profiles the original benchmark and defines eight Structural Features (SFs) that characterize its temporal structure. For each SF, it resamples the original data according to its structural support, removes edge-of-distribution samples, and augments the retained samples by varying the SF's salience, producing samples with different structural profiles. After filtering out out-of-distribution samples while preserving diversity, CaFE yields a refreshed evaluation set. TSFMs are then evaluated on this set using both conventional forecast-error metrics and intervention-response metrics, giving each model a per-feature capability profile alongside endpoint accuracy. Experiments on GIFT-Eval and FEV-Mini20 show that CaFE yields stable evaluation results and reveals per-feature strengths and weaknesses that a single aggregate score hides. Moreover, on genuine data filtered by structural condition, models selected by CaFE outperform those chosen by the aggregate leaderboard. CaFE therefore makes model selection conditional on the structural response of interest.

</details>


### [700] [LOCU: Lowdin-Orthogonalized Constraint Updates for Multi-Constraint Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26256)
*Joonyoung Lim,Younghwan Yoo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出LOCU方法，将对称Löwdin正交化应用于奖励与约束的自然梯度，解决CMDP多约束优化中约束梯度交互导致的数值不稳定问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）的多约束策略优化中，约束梯度之间的交互常产生病态的更新方向，导致数值上脆弱的步长，并在约束修正中出现非预期的抵消或冗余重叠。

Method: 在Fisher-Rao度量下对奖励与约束的自然梯度施加对称Löwdin正交化；结合Fisher几何筛选与近共线压缩，得到紧凑的约简空间，使信赖域退化为欧氏球，并以低维active-set求解对称地处理约束；对不可行迭代点，在同一约简形式下构造Pareto下降方向，以保持已满足约束的局部可行性。

Result: 实验表明LOCU在高约束耦合、狭窄可行域及不可行初始点条件下均保持稳定，并可泛化到不同的代价critic架构。

Conclusion: LOCU通过几何正交化与约简空间重构，有效缓解多约束交互带来的数值不稳定性，为CMDP多约束策略优化提供了稳定且可泛化的求解框架。

Abstract: We investigate multi-constraint policy optimization in constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs), where interactions among constraint gradients often yield ill-conditioned update directions, causing numerically fragile steps and unintended cancellation or redundant overlap in constraint corrections. To address this, we propose LOCU, which mitigates numerical instability arising from constraint interactions by applying symmetric Lowdin orthogonalization to the natural gradients of the reward and constraints under the Fisher-Rao metric. Combined with Fisher-geometric screening and near-collinear compression, LOCU yields a compact reduced space in which the trust region becomes a Euclidean ball and constraints are handled symmetrically through a low-dimensional active-set solve. For infeasible iterates, LOCU constructs a Pareto-descent direction which preserves the local feasibility of satisfied constraints within the same reduced formulation. Experiments show that LOCU remains stable under high constraint coupling, narrow feasible regions, and infeasible starts, and generalizes across different cost critic architectures.

</details>


### [701] [REFLEX: RNA Ensemble Generation via Flexibility-Calibrated Stochastic Bridge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26261)
*Wanli Ma,Tianmeng Hu,Ke Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出REFLEX——基于SE(3)异方差随机桥的序列条件RNA主链坐标系系综生成器，用实验B因子校准逐残基桥宽度，推理时仅需序列即可生成多构象系综，在多构象RNA基准上取得最佳覆盖精度-召回权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RNA通过多个实验观测到的构象状态行使功能，核心挑战是在不牺牲结构保真度的前提下捕捉系综多样性：样本容易塌缩到平均化的代表结构，或漂移到缺乏支撑的构象区域。

Method: 构建序列条件的SE(3)主链坐标系系综生成器，采用异方差随机桥：训练时用实验B因子校准逐残基的桥宽度，在保持约束区域更尖锐的同时，以残基特异尺度通过局部扰动邻域暴露每个观测构象；再用学得的柔性条件引导桥场网络，从校准后的含噪状态恢复目标构象特异坐标系。推理阶段仅需输入序列，无需MSA子采样启发式。

Result: 在多构象RNA基准上，REFLEX在各评估阈值下对系综覆盖取得最佳的精度-召回权衡；恢复应力消融表明，在更强扰动下目标坐标系恢复能力有所提升。

Conclusion: 以B因子校准的柔性条件随机桥为机制，可在无需MSA的纯序列推理下生成兼具多样性与结构保真度的RNA构象系综。

Abstract: RNA molecules often function through multiple experimentally observed conformational states. A central challenge is to capture ensemble diversity without sacrificing structural fidelity: samples may collapse toward averaged representative structures or drift into unsupported conformational regions. We introduce REFLEX (RNA Ensemble generation calibrated by FLEXibility), a sequence-conditioned generator for RNA backbone-frame ensembles based on a heteroscedastic stochastic bridge on SE(3). During training, experimental B-factors calibrate residue-wise bridge widths, exposing each observed conformer through local perturbation neighborhoods with residue-specific scales while keeping constrained regions sharper. A learned flexibility condition guides the bridge-field network to recover target conformer-specific frames from these calibrated noisy states. At inference, REFLEX uses only the input sequence, requiring no MSA-subsampling heuristics. On a multi-conformer RNA benchmark, REFLEX achieves the best precision-recall trade-off for ensemble coverage across evaluation thresholds, while recovery-stress ablations indicate gains in target-frame recovery under stronger perturbations.

</details>


### [702] [The Scheduler Is a Hidden Retriever: How Asynchrony Shapes Evidence Acquisition in Search Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26310)
*Ruiyang Ren,Yuhao Wang,Yinan Zhang,Chunyan Miao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 并行推理下证据到达的时序会导致路径依赖；提出CEA，按子问题证据完整即释放局部推理、共享搜索与完成顺序解耦，实现决策/获取/答案的联合不变性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体通过并行推理与异步信息获取解决复杂任务，导致"先看到什么"取决于到达顺序；即便初始证据完全相同，交付时序仍会改变获取决策，把临时的可见性差异转化为持久的获取差异，损害可复现性与公平性。

Method: 在两个模型族、三个基准上做受控重放；给出获取后悔界及匹配构造，说明固定早到达数下的不变性可能限制已获证据的利用；提出Confluent Evidence Acquisition（CEA）：子问题证据完整即释放其局部推理，共享搜索的分配与完成顺序无关；在固定计划与稳定条件响应律下证明决策、获取与答案的联合不变性；并做消融：将固定分配替换为争用下的first-ready分配。

Result: 获取分歧最高超出同序重复变异24个百分点；该依赖在初始证据全部到达后仍持续并贯穿第二次搜索。CEA（仅问题级计划）将获取分歧压缩至重复变异1.0个百分点以内，准确率与完整输入对照相当，较early commitment提升最高12.6个百分点；first-ready分配在争用下使获取分歧回升21.6个百分点，而局部查询目标分歧仍接近重复变异；计时比较显示CEA比等待全部初始证据的同程序更早决策、响应更快。

Conclusion: 证据交付时序是并行智能体中的一阶混淆变量，可产生持久路径依赖；以"按证据完整性释放、分配与顺序无关"为原则的CEA在保持准确率的同时消除该分歧、提升时延表现，调度策略需与不变性设计配套。

Abstract: Language-model agents increasingly solve complex tasks through parallel reasoning and asynchronous information gathering. Controlled replay across two model families and three benchmarks shows that delivery timing redirects search decisions made before all results arrive, despite identical initial evidence. Acquisition disagreement reaches up to 24 percentage points above same-order repeat variation. This dependence persists after all initial evidence arrives and through a second search, turning temporary differences in what agents have seen into lasting differences in what they acquire. An acquisition-regret bound with a matching construction shows that invariance at a fixed early arrival count can limit the use of evidence already received. We introduce Confluent Evidence Acquisition (CEA), which instead releases local reasoning when each subquestion's evidence is complete and allocates shared search independently of completion order. For a fixed plan and stable conditional response law, we prove joint invariance of decisions, acquisitions, and answers. With question-only plans across three benchmarks, CEA brings acquisition disagreement to within 1.0 percentage point of repeat variation and achieves accuracy comparable to complete-input controls, improving over early commitment by up to 12.6 percentage points. Replacing CEA's fixed allocation with first-ready allocation under contention adds 21.6 percentage points of acquisition disagreement, while local query-target disagreement remains near repeat variation. Timed comparisons show that CEA reaches decisions earlier and responds faster than the same program waiting for all initial evidence.

</details>


### [703] [Selective Transfer through Sequence Distillation: From Benchmark Knowledge to Backdoor Behaviour](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26311)
*Jonibek Mansurov,Sholpan Bolatzhanova,Filbert Aurelian Tjiaranta,Vallerie Alexandara Putra,Alham Fikri Aji*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 知识蒸馏具有"选择性"：教师模型的基准知识可通过全部四种蒸馏通道传递给学生（即使只用无自然语言的数字序列），而拒绝型后门则很难通过序列蒸馏传递，仅logit蒸馏可显著传递（最高85.5%触发拒绝）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识蒸馏被广泛用于能力迁移，但近期工作表明它也会无意迁移教师的隐藏属性。本文探究不同隐藏属性在相同蒸馏通道下是否以相同方式存活，即蒸馏对属性的传递是否具有选择性及选择依据。

Method: 对比两类教师隐藏属性：基准关联知识与拒绝型后门。在四种蒸馏通道下训练学生模型，包括仅用教师生成的、不含自然语言或领域内容的数字序列进行序列蒸馏，以及基于logit的蒸馏，并比较各通道下属性的迁移程度。

Result: 基准知识在全部四种通道下均成功迁移，即便学生仅见纯数字序列。后门则相反：后门教师触发拒绝近乎完美，但序列蒸馏学生几乎不继承；logit蒸馏迁移显著，学生未见任何后门样本仍达最高85.5%触发拒绝率。

Conclusion: 蒸馏属性迁移是选择性的，其选择标准不在于学生所见数据，而在于教师属性本身的结构性特征；这对蒸馏中的安全泄露风险评估具有启示。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation is widely used to transfer capabilities from teacher models to student models, but recent work shows that it can also transfer unintended teacher properties. We study whether different hidden teacher properties survive the same distillation channels. Specifically, we compare two properties: benchmark-associated knowledge and refusal backdoors, and show that distillation treats them very differently. Teachers fine-tuned on benchmark data successfully pass that knowledge to students through all four distillation channels we test, including when students are trained only on teacher-generated number sequences containing no natural language or domain content whatsoever. Refusal backdoors tell the opposite story: backdoored teachers achieve near-perfect triggered refusal, yet sequence-distilled students inherit essentially none of this behaviour. Logit-based distillation transfers it substantially, reaching up to 85.5\% triggered refusal in students that saw zero backdoor examples. Distillation is therefore selective, and the selection criterion is not what data the student sees, but what structure the teacher's property has. The code is available at https://github.com/MJonibek/kd-leakage.

</details>


### [704] [StrucChunk: Structure-Aware Retrieval for Legal Document RAG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26313)
*Surya Deep Singh,Ashutosh Tripathi,Gaurav Deep Singh*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: StrucChunk：将法律文件视为条款DAG进行结构感知切块，保留条款边界与交叉引用，结合BM25与BGE-M3的稠密-稀疏混合检索（RRF融合），在五个语料、三大法系、两种语言上显著超过基线，Char-Recall@8与Recall@5大幅提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG可让LLM输出基于领域知识，但法律文档难以处理：标准切块会割裂层级论证结构，通用embedding难以同时满足精确引证匹配与语义理解需求。

Method: 将文档建模为条款有向无环图（DAG），保留条款边界，在嵌入前解析交叉引用；采用BM25与BGE-M3的混合稠密-稀疏检索，并用Reciprocal Rank Fusion（RRF）融合。在五个语料、三大法系、两种语言上评估。

Result: 边界精度达100%（CrPC上递归切分为7.7%）；保留97.6%的文档交叉引用（基线0%）；GDPR上以少40.3%的块数达到相同章节覆盖。LegalBench-RAG（6,858查询-段落对）Char-Recall@8为48.18% vs 最优基线23.59%（+104%），超已发表SOTA +83%。CrPC/CPC各501查询Recall@5由0.557→0.804（+44.4%）、0.158→0.259（+64.6%），切块贡献88%/73%。GDPR 501查询Recall@5=0.868，R@1提升+59%。NitiBench-CCL（3,730泰语查询）HR@5=0.856 vs 0.594（+44.1%），交叉引用增强在引用类查询上+2.3%。

Conclusion: 章节边界对齐是跨语言的主导影响因素，交叉引用增强带来额外增益。开源实现、五个法律语料的5,256条评估查询、标注方法及切块质量指标。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can ground LLM outputs in domain-specific knowledge, but legal documents are hard: standard chunking fragments hierarchical argument structure, and generic embeddings struggle with both precise citation matching and semantic understanding. We propose StrucChunk (Structure Aware Chunking) with hybrid dense-sparse retrieval for hierarchically structured legal documents. It treats documents as directed acyclic graphs of provisions, preserves clause boundaries, resolves cross-references before embedding, and combines BM25 with BGE-M3 via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. We evaluate on five corpora, three legal traditions and two languages. StrucChunk reaches 100% boundary precision (vs. 7.7% for recursive splitting on CrPC), preserves 97.6% of documented cross-references (vs. 0%), and matches section coverage with 40.3% fewer chunks on GDPR. On LegalBench-RAG (6,858 query-passage pairs), it achieves Char-Recall@8 of 48.18% vs. 23.59% for the best baseline (+104%), surpassing the published state of the art by +83%. On 501 queries each for CrPC and CPC (Indian law), Recall@5 improves from 0.557 to 0.804 (+44.4%) and from 0.158 to 0.259 (+64.6%); chunking accounts for 88% and 73% of the gain. On 501 GDPR queries, Recall@5 is 0.868 with R@1 improving +59%. On NitiBench-CCL (3,730 Thai financial law queries), HR@5 is 0.856 vs. 0.594 for naive chunking (+44.1%), showing that section-boundary alignment is the dominant factor across languages, and cross-reference augmentation adds +2.3% on cross-reference queries. We release the implementation, 5,256 evaluation queries across five legal corpora, annotation methodology and chunking quality metrics. Code: github.com/SinghSuryaDeep/legal-rag-strucchunk-1

</details>


### [705] [The Control Layer Behind Rule-Following Agents Trading Across Market Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26324)
*Saad Naja,Nasser Odtallah,Jake Van-Praag,Sarah May*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 研究检验四个AI交易代理是否遵守策略与风控规则，发现纪律普遍较高但与盈利无关，并据此提出以纪律作为资本配置入场测试的评估工具包。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类交易纪律常失效，而AI代理在被赋予自主权或资金前，缺乏能区分"运气"与"遵守规则"的证据与评估方法，因此需要先验证AI代理的规则遵循度。

Method: 对2026年2月12日至8月27日、同一资产与执行条件下的2,627个平仓头寸进行分析；多数以实时价格模拟并计0.09%往返费用，18%为Hyperliquid真实订单。每笔头寸须声明策略、止损与目标，单代理最多五个未平仓头寸。通过交易日志重跑测试（需公开交易快照），并做市场状态（regime）测试（需Bitcoin价格与regime标签）；第3.5节规定止损越界容忍度。

Result: 组合扣除费用后净盈利；四个代理规则遵循度均高，包括不盈利的那个。盈利性取决于胜率相对盈亏平衡胜率的高低。97.5%的毛亏损被控制在声明止损内，典型亏损在声明价位平仓；24次运行中23次遵守头寸上限，日志记录了一次例外的规模与时长。经过29%市场回撤与恢复，损失被控制住。同一实时数据在不同指定策略下产生不同结果。

Conclusion: 纪律在四个代理中均得以维持，但纪律与盈利并不等价；交易层面结果不等于账户层面收益或持久优势的证明。纪律应作为向AI代理配置资本的入场测试，而非唯一测试。

Abstract: Trading discipline often fails people. Our study tested whether four AI trading agents followed their strategies and risk rules. Offering traders the evidence and an agent evaluation toolkit to separate luck from following the rules, before giving agents meaningful autonomy or capital. Our study analysed 2,627 closed positions from 12 February to 27 August 2026 across the same asset universe and execution conditions. Most positions were simulated against live prices with a 0.09% round-trip fee; 18% involved real Hyperliquid orders. Each position declared a strategy, stop and target, with a limit of five open positions per agent. The fleet finished net positive after fees. Rule adherence was high across all four agents, including the unprofitable one. Profitability tracked how often agents won relative to their break-even win rates. Institutional-style controls ran by default and contained losses through a 29% market drawdown and recovery, with documented exceptions. The discipline held for all four agents. Agents kept 97.5% of gross loss within declared stops, and typical losses closed at declared levels. Declared risk remained stable after losses and broadly stable across calm and volatile months. Twenty-three of 24 runs respected the position limit; logs identify the exception's size and duration. The same live data produced different results across assigned strategies. The trade-log tests can be rerun from the published trade snapshot; regime tests also require the published Bitcoin prices and regime labels. Section 3.5 specifies the stop-breach tolerance. These trade-level results are not account-level returns or proof of a lasting edge. Our study provides an evaluation toolkit to help traders distinguish rule-following from luck before committing capital. For anyone considering allocating capital to agents to trade, discipline should be the entry test, not the only test.

</details>


### [706] [VibeTraining-Bench: Data-Trainer-Harness Co-Design for Iterative System Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26342)
*Ruotian Peng,Yuanyi Ren,Shuaiqi Liu,Xin Guo,Fang Zhu,Yangyi Huang,Yue Wu,Zheng Wang,Yandong Wen,Zhihang Fu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 VibeTraining-Bench 基准，用于评估研究型智能体能否在固定资源预算下跨组件协同设计（数据、训练器、推理框架）以实现递归自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）要求智能体能诊断系统瓶颈并协同优化训练与推理，但缺乏统一的评测平台来量化这种"跨组件协同设计"能力。

Method: 构建覆盖终端操作、软件工程、多轮工具调用、数学推理等任务的基准；研究型智能体从相同初始系统与固定预算出发，依据验证反馈迭代改进数据、训练器和推理框架，并提交最终系统在测试集评估；通过测试数据隔离、研究与评测容器分离、研究网络受限三项措施防止奖励黑客。

Result: 前沿研究型智能体可显著提升目标系统性能，例如 GPT-6-Astra 在 SWE-bench Verified 上将目标系统从 32.9% 提升至 53.7%，接近人工开发的 instruct 模型（55.4%）；但其协同设计与迭代累积增益能力仍有提升空间。

Conclusion: VibeTraining-Bench 可作为推进 RSI 研究的统一平台，深化对智能体系统跨组件优化的理解；代码与数据已开源。

Abstract: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) requires agents to diagnose system bottlenecks and coordinate improvements across training and inference. We refer to the agents' capability to jointly optimize training data, the trainer, and the inference harness as cross-component co-design. We introduce VibeTraining-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating this capability across tasks spanning terminal operation, software engineering, multi-turn tool use, and mathematical reasoning. Within each task, research agents start from an identical initial agent system under a fixed resource budget. Guided by validation feedback, they iteratively refine data, trainers, and inference harnesses, then select and submit a final agent system for evaluation on the test set. To prevent reward hacking, we enforce three safeguards: test data isolation, separate research and grading containers, and network restrictions for research agents. Our evaluation results show that frontier research agents substantially improve target agent systems. For example, on SWE-bench Verified, GPT-6-Astra raises the target agent system's performance from 32.9% to 53.7%, comparable to the human-developed instruct model's 55.4%. However, there is still room to improve their ability to co-design and iteratively refine data, trainer, and harness to achieve cumulative performance gains. We hope that VibeTraining-Bench will serve as a unified platform for advancing RSI, deepening our understanding of cross-component optimization for agent systems. Code and data are available at https://github.com/D2I-ai/VibeTrainingBench.

</details>


### [707] [CARRS: A Constraint-Aware, Real-Time Routing System for Emergency Vehicles in Urban Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26346)
*Vincent Sello,Timothy Adeliyi,Ridewaan Hanslo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出CARRS架构，将A*、Dijkstra、双向A*等经典寻路算法与约束满足问题（CSP）方法融合，面向应急车辆在动态城市交通中的实时路径优化，实验证明其可在35秒内生成最优路径、增量重路由低于20秒、约束遵守率超90%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 警车、消防车、救护车等应急车辆需以最短时间抵达生命攸关事件现场，但城市交通的动态性易造成严重延误；传统民用导航系统无法同时兼顾实时交通变化与车辆特定约束，导致路径规划不充分。

Method: 采用设计科学研究方法（DSRM）为研究框架、原型开发为迭代过程，构建统一的CARRS软件架构，将A*、Dijkstra、双向A*等经典寻路算法与约束满足问题方法相融合；以OpenStreetMap主要都市路网数据结合模拟动态交通场景进行实证评估，考察路径最优性、约束遵守度、重路由响应性及可扩展性潜力。

Result: 系统可在35秒内为运营相关子图生成最优路径；增量重路由响应时间低于20秒；车辆特定约束遵守率超过90%，表明该架构满足实时动态路由需求。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了连接AI驱动优化与软件工程运营合规性的路由平台，是迈向动态城市环境下自适应应急车辆协调的实用化变革性一步。

Abstract: Emergency vehicles such as police vehicles, fire engines, and ambulances require a stable and efficient route optimization to reach life-critical events in the shortest times possible. However, the dynamic nature of urban traffic makes this ideal scenario much more challenging, causing critical life-threatening delays. Traditional civilian navigation systems cannot account for real-time traffic changes alongside vehicle-specific constraints, creating inadequate routing scenarios. This research presents the Constraint-Aware Real-Time Routing System (CARRS), a unified software architecture tailored for emergency coordination. The CARRS architecture is engineered to fuse together classical pathfinding algorithms such as A*, Dijkstra, and Bidirectional A*, with Constraint Satisfaction Problem methodologies. The Design Science Research Methodology is the research framework, and prototyping is the iterative process. The artifact was empirically evaluated using OpenStreetMap data for major metropolitan road networks, combined with simulated dynamic traffic scenarios.
