Method: 以组合泛化为视角，构建 AnyGoal 基准：基于常用世界模型环境生成目标偏移（goal-shifted）任务变体，并配套开源库。每个任务保证单个状态因子与动作均落在训练支持集内，只是其组合在专家轨迹中欠出现。随后在多个环境与多个世界模型族上评估，从动力学误差与表征质量两方面，结合不同交互范式与评价指标进行解剖式分析。

Result: 当前各类世界模型在这些重组情形下一致表现出失败；通过跨模型族、交互范式和评价指标的对比，定位了泛化成功与失败的环节（动力学预测 vs. 表征/表示）。

Conclusion: 该框架、基准与分析为评估"可泛化到新规划任务的世界模型"提供了可复用的评测基础，并指出组合泛化是当前世界模型的关键短板。

Abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

</details>


### [741] [Train An Imaginative Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26845)
*Jiaxin Ge,Junyi Zhang,Tianning Chai,Hanjun Yoo,Chenyang Wang,Xiuyu Li,Weijia Shi,XuDong Wang,Sewon Min,Luke Zettlemoyer,Trevor Darrell,Haiwen Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Agima 训练智能体在行动前先"想象"：单一 omni 模型提出动作、生成未来图像并在想象中推演，再决定真实执行，SFT+agentic RL 两阶段训练后可泛化到更难场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sokoban 等环境中看似合理的一步推箱可能使谜题不可解，而真实环境反馈稀疏、动作不可逆，因此智能体需在执行前预判后果。

Method: Agima 训练单一 omni 模型统一策略与世界建模：先用 SFT 让模型预测动作及其结果图像，实现前向思考与反事实分支；再用 agentic RL 教其基于想象未来进行推理与规划，可模拟动作序列、探索备选方案并比较多种未来。

Result: 在 Maze2D、Sokoban、Pacman、PushT 四类环境上均泛化到训练未见的更难设置。仅用 SFT 在双箱 Sokoban 训练，面对四箱谜题且每五步才观测一次真实棋盘时，Agima 成功率达 40%，而仅动作规划器仅 2%。RL 后涌现新行为：习得 SFT 阶段未见的新统一格式、仅在必要时前向思考、在关键决策点更频繁分支。

Conclusion: 能描绘行动后果的智能体可学会何时何地向前展望，即学会规划；想象—推演—决策的统一框架在稀疏反馈与不可逆动作场景下有效。

Abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.

</details>


<div id='physics.optics'></div>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [742] [Microcomb spectral fingerprinting enables parts-per-trillion methane detection with low humidity cross-sensitivity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24338)
*Shiyan Cao,Yinchao Xu,Judith Su*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种集成微梳传感架构，在同一超高Q值二氧化硅微谐振腔内融合共振增强倏逝波传感与多波长分子指纹识别，实现亚ppb级气体检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统光频梳多作为外部光源探测样品，依赖较长的物理作用路径，难以兼顾紧凑性与高灵敏度；同时单条光学共振提供的传感信息维度有限。

Method: 使气态分析物直接与微谐振腔内循环光的倏逝场相互作用，利用微梳整体光谱响应中跨多条梳齿的分布式响应构建多维分子指纹，而非依赖单一共振。

Result: 以甲烷为模型分析物，估计检测限达178 ppt；对氨、一氧化碳、己烷及相对湿度高达90%的水蒸气光谱响应极小。增加梳齿数量可系统性提升分析物判别能力。

Conclusion: 以超高Q微谐振腔中的共振光循环替代长物理相互作用路径，将紧凑型光学传感推进至ppt量级，并利用分布式光谱信息实现化学识别。

Abstract: Optical frequency combs have transformed molecular spectroscopy by enabling broadband, high-resolution analysis, yet they are conventionally used as light sources to interrogate external samples. Here, we introduce an integrated microcomb sensing architecture that unifies resonantly enhanced evanescent sensing with multiwavelength molecular fingerprinting in a single ultrahigh-quality-factor silica microresonator. Gaseous analytes interact directly with the evanescent field of light recirculating within the resonator, enhancing sensitivity while encoding analyte-induced perturbations across the microcomb's collective spectral response. Rather than relying on a single optical resonance, we exploit distributed responses across multiple comb lines to generate multidimensional molecular fingerprints. Adding more comb lines systematically improves analyte discrimination, showing that the microcomb provides sensing information beyond what individual spectral channels offer. Using methane as a model analyte, we achieve an estimated detection limit of 178 parts per trillion, with minimal spectral responses to ammonia, carbon monoxide, hexane, and water vapor at relative humidities up to 90%. By replacing physically long interaction paths with resonant light recirculation in an ultrahigh-Q microresonator, this architecture brings compact optical sensing into the parts-per-trillion regime while exploiting distributed spectral information for chemical identification.

</details>


### [743] [Freeform gradient-index media reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24393)
*V. Chávez-Islas,F. H. Maldonado-Villamizar,E. Espíndola-Ramos,S. Chávez-Cerda,J. E. Gómez-Correa*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种无需几何对称性、近轴近似或等折射率面先验知识的三维逐点GRIN介质重构方法，通过局部折射的逆应用实现自由曲面GRIN重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GRIN重构方法依赖几何对称性与射线守恒量，无法推广到自由曲面介质，需要不依赖对称性的重构途径。

Method: 将折射过程逆向局部应用，在三维空间逐点确定折射率分布，使指定射线轨迹得以实现；方法不要求对称性、近轴近似或已知等折射率面，且易于实现。

Result: 用两种界面几何进行重构，表明同一指定轨迹函数可对应不同的折射率分布，说明界面选择构成光学设计的额外自由度，受局部折射条件与重叠重构区域相容性约束。

Conclusion: 逐点逆折射法为自由曲面GRIN介质提供简单通用的重构工具，界面几何可作为额外设计自由度。

Abstract: Reconstructing a gradient-index (GRIN) medium consists of determining a spatial refractive index distribution that produces a prescribed ray trajectory, an inverse problem in geometrical optics. Previous approaches have used geometrical symmetries and conserved ray quantities to address this inverse problem. Extending reconstruction to freeform media requires approaches that do not rely on these symmetries. Here, we present a three-dimensional point-wise method for reconstructing freeform GRIN media through the inverse application of local refraction. The method does not require geometrical symmetry, paraxial approximations, or prior knowledge of the iso-indicial surfaces, and is straightforward to implement. Reconstruction using two interface geometries demonstrates that different refractive index distributions can be obtained from the same prescribed trajectory function. The choice of interfaces thus provides an additional degree of freedom for optical design, subject to local refraction conditions and compatibility between overlapping reconstructed regions.

</details>


### [744] [Charge-Selective Displacement of Spatiotemporal Optical Vortices at a Spatially Uniform Time Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24713)
*Chao Mei,Peilong Yang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在空间均匀、面内各向同性的时间边界上，时空光涡旋的横向位移随拓扑电荷反号，但转换权重与电荷无关；径向谱滤波与涡旋相位耦合，且对相反电荷保持相同的转换谱强度。窄标量高斯谱下位移遵循谱权重的对数斜率且平均横向动量为零。有限抽运GaAs波导中，提取过程的不等衰减额外引起角偏转，Maxwell–Drude模拟给出探测器滤波前约±42 mrad。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究时空光涡旋（STOV）在时间边界上的转换与横向位移的电荷依赖性，以及谱滤波和波导中提取效应对位移/偏转的影响，并区分传播诱导漂移与位置偏移。

Method: 解析分析空间均匀、面内各向同性时间边界下STOV的横向位移与转换权重；研究径向谱滤波与涡旋相位的耦合；采用窄标量高斯谱分析位移与谱权重对数斜率的关系；在有限抽运GaAs波导中考虑提取过程的不等衰减；并用独立的Maxwell–Drude模拟检验提取诱导响应，结合多平面质心轨迹计算。

Result: 横向位移随拓扑电荷反号而转换权重与电荷无关；相反电荷的转换谱强度相同；窄高斯谱下位移服从谱权重对数斜率且平均横向动量为零；GaAs波导中提取阶段的不等衰减引入角偏转，模拟给出探测器滤波前约±42 mrad的偏转；多平面质心轨迹可分离传播诱导漂移与位置偏移。

Conclusion: 时间边界处STOV横向位移的电荷反号特性源于涡旋相位与谱滤波的耦合，而非转换权重差异；实际波导中提取诱导的不等衰减会叠加角偏转，需借助多平面质心分析加以区分。

Abstract: At a spatially uniform, in-plane-isotropic time boundary, the transverse displacement of a spatiotemporal optical vortex changes sign with its topological charge, despite a charge-independent conversion weight. Radial spectral filtering couples to the vortex phase while preserving identical converted spectral intensities for opposite charges. For a narrow scalar Gaussian spectrum, the displacement follows the logarithmic slope of the spectral weight and occurs with zero mean transverse momentum. In a finite pumped GaAs waveguide, unequal attenuation during extraction adds angular deflection. Independent Maxwell--Drude simulations test this extraction-induced response and give $\pm42$~mrad before detector filtering. Calculated centroid traces at multiple planes separate propagation-induced drift from position offsets.

</details>


### [745] [Realization of valley-controlled orbital angular momentum via inter-orbital coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24714)
*Wenxia Xu,Ziteng Wang,Yihan Wang,Qinggang Shang,Liqin Tang,Jingjun Xu,Hrvoje Buljan,Daohong Song,Zhigang Chen*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在破缺反演对称性的光子蜂窝晶格中实验观测到谷控制的轨道角动量(OAM)态，呈现为实空间手性涡旋阵列；s-p与s-d轨道耦合分别产生l=±1与l=±2的OAM态，其涡旋手性由K/K'谷自由度确定性决定，理论揭示局域涡旋-手性对称性使谷自由度与实空间涡旋手性直接对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OAM是理解固体与人工晶格中新奇现象的基本自由度，但在晶格体系中OAM的产生与调控仍具挑战性，亟需可实验实现的生成与确定性控制方案。

Method: 构建由s轨道与高轨道子晶格组成的破缺反演对称光子蜂窝晶格；在K或K'谷选择性激发无初始OAM的s轨道模式，经由近邻格点间的轨道间耦合生成高轨道OAM模式；结合理论分析局域涡旋-手性对称性对谷依赖涡旋手性选择的约束。

Result: 实验观测到实空间手性涡旋阵列形式的谷控制OAM态：s-p耦合产生拓扑荷l=+1或−1，s-d耦合产生l=+2或−2；拓扑荷符号由谷自由度决定，从而可对整片阵列的涡旋手性实现确定性调控。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了通过轨道物理工程化手性涡旋阵列的通用平台，为在光子体系及更广领域中探索轨道与拓扑介导的物理现象提供了途径。

Abstract: Orbital angular momentum (OAM) represents a fundamental degree of freedom (DoF) for understanding novel phenomena in solids and synthetic lattices. However, the generation and control of OAM in lattice systems remain challenging. Here, we experimentally observe valley-controlled OAM states in inversion-symmetry-broken photonic honeycomb lattices consisting of s- and higher-orbital sublattices. These OAM states manifest as chiral vortex arrays in real space. By selectively exciting s-orbital modes carrying no initial OAM at either the K or K' valley, we observe higher-orbital OAM modes generated via inter-orbital coupling in neighboring sites. Specifically, s-p orbital coupling generates OAM states with topological charge l=+1 or l=-1, while s-d orbital coupling yields higher-charge OAM states with l=+2 or l=-2. The sign of the topological charge is determined by the valley DoF, enabling deterministic control of vortex chirality across the entire array. Our theory further reveals that a local vortex-chirality symmetry enforces the valley-dependent selection of vortex chirality at the K and K' valleys, establishing a direct connection between the valley DoF and real-space vortex chirality. These results establish a versatile platform for engineering chiral vortex arrays via orbital physics and exploring orbital- and topology-mediated phenomena in photonic systems and beyond.

</details>


### [746] [Boosting fluorescence and polarization with nanophotonics for single-molecule chiral sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24746)
*Ershad Mohammadi,T. V. Raziman,Alberto G. Curto*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于高折射率介质纳米光子学的互易性分析框架，同时增强荧光强度与偏振，实现手性传感，为单分子手性检测提供可行路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 圆二色性依赖吸收，低浓度下吸收趋零导致灵敏度受限；荧光方法虽可达单分子极限，但受弱荧光信号与低偏振对比度制约。因此需同时提升荧光与偏振以突破手性检测灵敏度瓶颈。

Method: 利用高折射率介质纳米光子学，建立手性偶极发射体与纳米天线耦合的互易性解析框架，揭示圆偏振荧光增强的不同贡献与权衡，并据此设计非手性介质纳米结构。

Result: 定制的无手性介质纳米结构实现荧光强度约1000倍增强、偏振约10倍提升；并表明在纳米结构角向发射模式中考虑外禀偏振效应对可靠对映体区分不可或缺。

Conclusion: 该方案为单分子手性传感开辟了现实可行的路径。

Abstract: Detecting chirality is essential in chemistry and biomedicine. Circular dichroism identifies chiral molecules through their differential absorption of circularly polarized light. However, its sensitivity is limited by vanishing absorption at low concentrations. Fluorescence-based methods have already enabled other optical techniques to reach the single-molecule limit and could, in principle, also extend chiral detection to reach this sensitivity regime. They are marred, however, by the combination of weak fluorescence signals and low polarization contrast. To overcome these limitations, we leverage high-index dielectric nanophotonics to simultaneously enhance both fluorescence and polarization for chiral sensing. We propose a reciprocity-based analytical framework for a chiral dipolar emitter coupled to a nanoantenna and reveal the different contributions and trade-offs governing the enhancement of circularly polarized fluorescence. Guided by this insight, we tailor achiral dielectric nanostructures to reach a 1000-fold enhancement of fluorescence intensity together with a 10-fold increase in polarization. Crucially, we show that accounting for extrinsic polarization effects in the angular emission patterns of nanophotonic structures is indispensable for reliable enantiomer discrimination. Our approach opens a realistic path for single-molecule chiral sensing.

</details>


### [747] [Dynamic Hotspot Migration and Self-Induced Resonances in Ultrafast Laser-Irradiated Silicon Thin Films](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25079)
*George D. Tsibidis,Yi Wang,Emmanuel Stratakis*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 飞秒激光辐照硅薄膜中，载流子诱导折射率调制与自致Fabry-Pérot共振的相互作用决定了能量空间分布；研究揭示三种特征激发区域及非线性热点迁移效应，并阐明高能量密度下由共振介导吸收向等离子体屏蔽的转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厘清飞秒激光在硅薄膜内部能量沉积的空间分布机制，为激光纳米制造中的深度分辨改性提供物理基础，服务界面分离与三维集成光子器件制造。

Method: 针对100、230、350 nm三种厚度的绝缘体上硅（SOI）构型开展数值分析，考察自由载流子引起的折射率调制与薄膜内自致Fabry-Pérot驻波共振的耦合作用。

Result: 识别出界面局域、双节点与多节点三类特征激发区域；观察到非线性热点迁移效应——折射率瞬态降低使内部驻波拉伸，强度波腹在脉冲期间向膜体内部移动；高能量密度下等离子体诱导消光抑制内反射，吸收机制由共振介导吸收转变为等离子体屏蔽。

Conclusion: 该工作建立薄膜内飞秒激光能量深度分布的物理图景，具备表面图案化与亚表面深度分辨改性并行的双重能力，可应用于激光辅助界面分离及三维集成光子学制造。

Abstract: The spatial distribution of energy in silicon thin films under femtosecond laser irradiation is demonstrated to be influenced by the interaction between carrier-induced refractive index modulation and self-induced Fabry-Pérot resonances. We resolve three characteristic excitation regions such as interface-localized, binodal and multi-nodal regimes considering the analysis of silicon-on-insulator (SOI) configurations across thicknesses of 100, 230, and 350 nm. We report a nonlinear hotspot migration effect where the transient reduction of the refractive index stretches the internal standing wave, translating intensity antinodes toward the film volume during the pulse. Numerical results demonstrate that at higher fluences, plasma-induced extinction suppresses internal reflections, triggering a transition from resonance-mediated absorption to plasma shielding. These findings establish a physical basis for depth-resolved modification in laser nanomanufacturing, providing a dual-capacity for simultaneous surface patterning and depth-resolved subsurface modification with direct applications in laser-assisted interfacial separation and 3D integrated photonic fabrication.

</details>


### [748] [Superradiant temporal transition radiation of a relativistic electron beam](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25165)
*Ariel Nause,Avraham Gover*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析"时间边界"引发的辐射——时间渡越辐射(t-TR)：相对论电子束穿过硅片孔径,飞秒激光将硅切换为电子-空穴等离子体,束缚场成为新介质中的初始条件并向等离子体频率发射。波矢守恒、频率不守恒,发射落在束自身场不占据的谱段;各电子同相贡献,能量按N²标度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 均匀运动电荷携带不辐射的束缚场,空间边界可释放其一部分(渡越辐射);作者欲探讨"时间边界"这一对偶情形能否同样释放束缚场,并获得常规束流场无法覆盖的可用谱段与可单片探测的强辐射。

Method: 建立解析模型:推导时间边界处的场能转换、辐射振幅与频率线型,计入等离子体载流子碰撞损耗;并用FDTD数值计算,以现有6.5 MeV光阴极注入器参数为参考算例验证标度律。

Result: 解析模型与FDTD结果一致。参考算例预测THz波段宽带t-TR发射,中心频率靠近等离子体频率,可通过激光通量在一个倍频程内选择,强度由束电荷控制,单发即可探测。

Conclusion: 时间边界可作为产生可调谐、相干增强(N²)THz辐射的新机制;文中给出实验观测的可行性考量(见补充材料)。

Abstract: A charge in uniform motion carries a bound field that does not radiate. Transition radiation releases part of it at a boundary in space. We propose and analyze the case of radiation emission due to a boundary in time: a relativistic electron bunch passes through an aperture in a semiconductor (silicon) wafer, and while its bound field occupies the wafer, a femtosecond laser switches the semiconductor into an electron-hole plasma. The field is a valid solution of the old medium and not of the new one, so it is handed to the plasma as an initial condition for radiation emission at the plasma frequency. Because in temporal transition radiation (t-TR) the wavevector is conserved, and the frequency is not, the emission can appear in a spectral band that the bunch's own field does not populate. Every electron contributes in phase to the initial condition at the switching moment, so the emitted energy scales as $N^2$. We derive the field energy conversion at the temporal boundary and the resultant measurable amplitude and frequency line-shape of the radiation taking into consideration plasma carriers collisional loss. The simplified analytical model of the process and its scaling laws are confirmed by use of FDTD numerical computations for a reference case based on the parameters of an existing 6.5 MeV photoinjector accelerator. For this case we predict wideband t-TR radiation emission at THz frequencies, where the emission center frequency, near the plasma frequency, is selectable across an octave, set by the laser fluence, and the intensity is governed by the beam charge. The predicted radiative energy is detectable in a single shot. The experimental considerations for observing it are given in a Supplement.

</details>


### [749] [Design and synthesis of laser inscribed flexible Bragg gratings containing silicon oxynitride-doped silicon thin film for authentication applications with the insights from X-Ray Absorption Spectroscopy and Quantum Mechanical Calculations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25382)
*Ali Karatutlu,Timuçin Emre Tabaru,Umut Taylan,Zehra Gizem Mutlay,Doğukan Hazar Özbey,Okan Uslu,Hamid-Reza Bahari,Esra Kendir Tekgül,Andriy Budnyk,İremnur Duru,Mustafa Fatih Genisel,Zeynep Reyhan Öztürk,Taylan Gorkan,Engin Durgun,Bülend Ortaç*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文在低于100°C的低温下于柔性衬底上合成氧氮化硅掺杂硅（SiON-doped Si），制备多光谱布拉格光栅（BG），用于保护超快激光刻写的微信息，并通过软X射线吸收谱与DFT/粒子群优化计算揭示其结构特性与形成机理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SOI是硅光子学（含PIC）的主流材料体系，但需要新的材料平台实现折射率精确调控与光敏性；同时，先进应用需要能在柔性衬底、低温（<100°C）条件下制备的光子器件，以兼容热敏感衬底并保护超快激光刻写的微信息。

Method: 在柔性衬底上低温（<100°C）合成氧氮化硅掺杂硅并制备布拉格光栅；利用软X射线吸收谱在Si L边、O K边和N K边表征其独特结构；结合量子力学计算给出SiON掺杂Si的潜在形成机理，并采用粒子群优化与密度泛函理论（DFT）预测块体Si3N4-xOx的晶体结构；对光栅的多光谱反射行为进行数值与实验验证。

Result: 该材料可实现折射率在2.1–2.5范围内的精确调控，并具备不同波长下的光敏性；所制布拉格光栅在紫外至近红外（UV–NIR）区呈现多光谱反射行为，数值与实验均证明其可保护超快激光刻写的微信息；软X射线吸收谱与理论计算给出了材料结构与形成机理的解释。

Conclusion: 氧氮化硅掺杂硅可在柔性衬底上低温制备，兼具可调折射率、光敏性与多光谱反射特性，为硅光子学提供新材料平台，并在超快激光微信息保护等方面具有应用潜力；其结构机理可由实验谱学与第一性原理计算共同阐明。

Abstract: Silicon-on-insulator is mostly the main driving material system for the field of silicon photonics, including PICs, due to high index contrast and compatibility with current semiconductor manufacturing processes [1]. A recent example is silicon oxynitride-doped silicon [2] discovered recently by our group, offering to set a new position for the fields of silicon photonics with a precise control of refractive index from 2.1 to 2.5 together with the photosensitivity property at different wavelengths. In this study, we demonstrate that the synthesis of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon can be performed on a flexible substrate for the fabrication of Bragg gratings (BG) at low temperatures below 100 degrees Celsius that are emerging for advanced applications. Their use in preserving ultra-fast lasers inscribed micro-information has been demonstrated numerically and experimentally due to its multispectral reflection behaviour from the ultraviolet (UV) to the near-infrared (NIR) regions. The unique structural characteristics of silicon oxynitride-doped silicon were studied at the Si L, O K and N K edges using soft X-ray absorption studies. The quantum mechanical calculations provide the potential formation mechanism of SiON-doped Si, whereas the crystal structure prediction for bulk Si3N4-xOx was conducted using the particle swarm optimization method in combination with density functional theory (DFT).

</details>


### [750] [All-Dielectric Tight-Binding Photonics via a Band-Gap Vacuum](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25655)
*Aodong Li,Jing Li,Tao Xiao,Biye Xie*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 将光子谐振器嵌入光子禁带真空(BgV)，实现忠实的紧束缚光子晶格，并实验实现BBH模型、演示可设计真空对耦合与拓扑相的控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子真空无能隙，空气中谐振器具有辐射尾部，导致非预期的长程耦合，使真实紧束缚哈密顿量难以实现。

Method: 以光子晶体禁带充当光子的"真空"(BgV)，使每个共振模式指数局域化，由设计的短程耦合定义晶格哈密顿量；在全介质光子晶体中实验实现BBH模型并以微波测量分辨角态共振及其轨道；通过改变BgV色散与Bloch模式调控相对耦合与闭环干涉；结合全波计算与提取模型。

Result: 实验观测到BBH角态共振及其轨道；均匀改变BgV（谐振器固定）可使二维SSH晶格的量子化极化翻转，并将零通量晶格转变为π通量晶格；数值实现空间群R-3m与C2/c的三维pyrochlore和hyperhoneycomb晶格，后者为具有拓扑鼓面表面态的nodal-loop半金属。

Conclusion: BgV可作为二维与三维全介质紧束缚光子学的可设计真空，为拓扑光子晶格的构建与调控提供新范式。

Abstract: Tight-binding photonics bridges condensed-matter physics and optics, providing a powerful framework for engineering band structures and topological phases with light. For photons, however, the vacuum is gapless, so resonators in air carry radiative tails that produce spurious long-range couplings. Here we embed resonators in a photonic band-gap vacuum (BgV), a photonic crystal whose band gap plays for photons the role vacuum plays for bound electrons. The BgV localizes each resonance exponentially, so designed short-range couplings define the lattice Hamiltonian. We thereby experimentally realize a faithful Benalcazar-Bernevig-Hughes Hamiltonian in an all-dielectric photonic crystal, resolving corner resonances and their orbitals in microwave measurements. Unlike the vacuum surrounding electrons, the BgV is itself designable, controlling relative couplings and closed-loop interference through its band dispersion and Bloch modes. Full-wave calculations and extracted models show that uniformly modifying the BgV, with all resonators fixed, switches the quantized polarization of a two-dimensional Su-Schrieffer-Heeger lattice and converts a zero-flux lattice into a $π$-flux one. We also numerically realize three-dimensional pyrochlore and hyperhoneycomb lattices with space groups $R\bar{3}m$ and $C2/c$, the latter a nodal-loop semimetal with topological drumhead surface states. These results establish the BgV as a designable vacuum for all-dielectric tight-binding photonics in two and three dimensions.

</details>


### [751] [High-Efficiency Silicon-Lithium Niobate Grating Coupler enabled by Fully-Etched Subwavelength Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25839)
*Jing Wang,Yang Liu,Shitong Su,Weiwen Zou*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种全刻蚀结构的硅-铌酸锂(Si-LN)光栅耦合器，利用亚波长结构调控耦合强度提升方向性，结合伴随法逆向设计，在Z和Y晶向上实验测得耦合效率分别为-3.3 dB和-3.9 dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Si-LN光子集成回路需要高效、可快速原型的器件与光纤耦合方案，同时需应对铌酸锂的双折射特性。

Method: 采用全刻蚀结构，通过亚波长结构工程化耦合强度以提高方向性；同时采用基于伴随法的逆向设计实现光子电路与光纤的高效耦合；针对LN双折射，分别沿晶体Z向和Y向对TE模进行优化与制备，器件仅需单步硅刻蚀完成。

Result: 沿Z向和Y向实测耦合效率分别为-3.3 dB与-3.9 dB；3-dB带宽均大于54 nm；两方向在50 nm范围内背向反射抑制至-15 dB以下。

Conclusion: 该Si-LN光栅耦合器仅通过单步硅刻蚀实现，为Si-LN光子集成回路的快速器件原型验证提供了实用方案。

Abstract: A new approach of silicon-lithium niobate (Si-LN) grating couplers (GCs) with a fully-etched structure is proposed. The coupling strength is engineered through subwavelength structures, allowing improved directionality. The adjoint-based inverse design method is simultaneously adopted to achieve efficient coupling between photonic circuits and fibers. Considering the birefringence of LN, the proposed Si-LN GCs are optimized and fabricated for TE mode along the crystallographic Z and Y directions. The experimentally measured coupling efficiencies are -3.3 dB and -3.9 dB along the crystallographic Z and Y directions, respectively. The measured 3-dB bandwidths are broader than 54 nm and the back reflections can be suppressed down to -15 dB over 50 nm for both directions. The proposed Si-LN GCs are realized by only single-step Si etching, offering a practical solution for fast device prototyping in Si-LN photonic integrated circuits.

</details>


### [752] [LIDAR with Optically Amplified Thermal Light](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26082)
*Darren Ming Zhi Koh,Peng Kian Tan,Christian Kurtsiefer*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该工作证明热光经光放大后归一化二阶相干函数 g^(2)(τ) 保持不变，并利用放大的热光实现 1.3 km 外建筑的光栅扫描 LIDAR，深度分辨率达 2 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 热光的强度涨落（光子聚束）可作为熵源或时间相关光源，但其低谱密度限制了其在 LIDAR 等实际应用中的使用；光放大提升亮度是潜在解决途径，但需确认放大是否破坏其相干统计特性。

Method: 对热光源进行光放大，测量并比较放大前后归一化二阶相干函数 g^(2)(τ)；随后以放大热光为光源，对 1.3 km 处建筑实施 LIDAR 光栅扫描测距。

Result: 放大后热光的 g^(2)(τ) 保持不变；基于放大热光的 LIDAR 完成 1.3 km 距离建筑的光栅扫描成像，深度分辨率为 2 cm。

Conclusion: 光放大可在提升热光亮度与谱密度的同时保留其二阶相干统计特性，使热光可实用化于远距离、高深度分辨的相关光 LIDAR 应用。

Abstract: Thermal light exhibits intensity fluctuations or photon bunching that has been used as a source of entropy or temporally correlated light. However, its low spectral density limits its use in practical applications like LIDAR. One method of remedying this is optical amplification to boost its brightness. In this paper, we show that the normalized second order coherence function $g^{(2)}(τ)$ of a thermal light source is preserved after amplification. We then use amplified thermal light to demonstrate a LIDAR raster scan of a building at 1.3 km with a depth resolution of 2 cm.

</details>


### [753] [Study of non-uniformity-induced structured spectrum in a tapered optical fiber through stimulated four-wave mixing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26282)
*Minjae Hong,Nicolas Y. Joly*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 利用宽带种子光激发受激四波混频，产生的梳状光谱与锥形光纤整体轮廓直接关联，可实现亚微米锥形光纤直径的无损评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 锥形光纤具有可调色散和小模场面积带来的高非线性，适用于非线性与量子光学；但相位匹配的四波混频强烈依赖色散，使锥径成为关键参数，而亚微米锥区的精确直径难以确定。

Method: 以宽带光谱作为种子注入，观察受激四波混频生成的梳状光谱；并建立基于联合谱振幅（joint-spectral amplitude）的模型，将沿光纤长度累积的相位纳入描述。

Result: 受激四波混频产生的梳状光谱与锥形光纤的整体轮廓直接对应，为亚微米锥区的非破坏性表征提供了可能；模型能再现该光谱特征。

Conclusion: 基于宽带种子受激四波混频的光谱特征可作为锥形光纤剖面（锥径分布）的无损探测手段。

Abstract: Tapered optical fibers offer tunable dispersion and a small mode area, yielding high nonlinearity, which makes them ideal for nonlinear and quantum optics. Because phase-matched four-wave mixing strongly depends on dispersion, the taper diameter becomes a key parameter. For sub-micrometer tapers, identifying the exact diameter is challenging. Here, we show that when seeding with a broad spectrum, stimulated four-wave mixing yields a comb-like spectrum that is directly linked to the overall taper profile opening possibility for non-destructive evaluation of sub-micron taper. Our model based on joint-spectral amplitude includes the phase accumulated over the fiber length.

</details>


### [754] [Optical vortex bullets with large angular momenta](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26289)
*José R. Salgueiro,Carlos F. Sánchez,Boris A. Malomed,Ángel Paredes,Humberto Michinel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文研究携带高阶轨道角动量的三维时空涡旋光孤子（环形光弹），用数值方法求解三维非线性薛定谔方程并系统分析其存在性、结构与稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索在异常群速度色散和横向局域高斯折射率分布下，如何利用工程化折射率结构支撑并稳定携带大轨道角动量的时空涡旋光弹，为高阶OAM光弹的存在条件与稳定性边界提供依据。

Method: 在重参数化的Kerr介质（异常GVD）中数值求解三维非线性薛定谔方程，构造拓扑电荷1≤ℓ≤4的稳态涡旋光弹，考察其对传播常数、导引势深度与宽度及ℓ的依赖；以Vakhitov-Kolokolov（VK）判据判断稳定性，并辅以直接（含时）数值模拟检验鲁棒性。

Result: 随ℓ增大需更强或更宽的波导势才能满足VK判据支撑局域态；VK合规与不合规分支由退化的Townes分支分隔；导引势显著抑制坍缩并延长传播距离，但鲁棒性最终受方位角不稳定性限制，且ℓ越大不稳定性增长越强。

Conclusion: 工程化折射率分布可显著扩大时空涡旋光弹的稳定域，并为支撑大轨道角动量光弹提供设计准则；同时方位角不稳定性仍是高阶涡旋光弹的最终限制因素。

Abstract: We investigate three-dimensional spatiotemporal optical vortex solitons (light bullets with a toroidal shape) carrying higher-order orbital angular momentum in Kerr media with anomalous group-velocity dispersion and a transversely localized Gaussian profile of the linear refractive index. Stationary vortex bullets with topological charges (winding numbers) $1\leq \ell \leq 4$ are obtained as numerical solutions of the three-dimensional nonlinear Schrödinger equation, and their existence, structure and stability are systematically analyzed. In terms of atomic Bose-Einstein condensates, these solutions represent matter-wave solitons with embedded vorticity. We examine the dependence of the solution families on the propagation constant, the depth and width of the guiding profile, and $\ell $. It is found that the increase of $\ell $ requires one to use a stronger or wider waveguiding potential to sustain localized states satisfying the Vakhitov-Kolokolov (VK) stability criterion. VK-complying and non-complying branches of vortex-soliton families are separated by a degenerate Townes branch. Direct simulations reveal that, although the guiding profile substantially suppresses the collapse and extends the propagation distance of vortex bullets, their robustness is ultimately limited by azimuthal instabilities, whose growth is enhanced for values of $\ell $. These results demonstrate that engineered refractive-index landscapes significantly enlarge the stability domain of spatiotemporal vortex bullets and provide guidelines for supporting optical bullets carrying large orbital angular momenta.

</details>


### [755] [Self-Oscillating Photonic Frequency Comb for Sub-THz Local Oscillator Generation in Earth Observation Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26372)
*Dimitrios Kastritsis,Ioannis Stratakis,Stavros Iezekiel*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出并数值研究一种可重构自振荡微波光子本振架构，利用级联马赫-曾德尔与相位调制在光电反馈环路中生成光频梳，经10 GHz带通滤波器与3 MHz双腔布拉格光栅环谐振器联合选线，再与同源激光参考光外差拍频，数值验证了183与229 GHz本振生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球观测任务依赖微波与亚太赫兹辐射测量反演大气温湿与云参数，183与229 GHz频段尤为关键；该频段本振需低相位噪声、高频稳定度并满足严格SWaP约束。传统介质谐振振荡器加级联倍频方案需为不同频段配置专用链路，硬件复杂且倍频会恶化相位噪声。

Method: 在光电反馈环路中采用级联马赫-曾德尔调制器与相位调制器产生高阶分量增强的光频梳；先用约10 GHz带宽带通滤波器粗选目标谱区，再用约3 MHz带宽的双腔布拉格光栅环谐振器（BGRR）完成精细梳线选择；选中梳线与源自同一激光的光学参考合束后经光电探测，通过光外差产生毫米波/亚太赫兹信号；通过调节OEO电滤波器振荡频率并选择对应梳阶实现频率重构。

Result: 数值仿真给出183 GHz与229 GHz本振生成结果，表明同一底层架构经电滤波器调谐与梳阶选择即可覆盖多个本振频率。

Conclusion: 可重构自振荡微波光子架构可在满足SWaP约束下为地球观测接收机提供多频段低相噪本振生成方案，避免倍频带来的相位噪声恶化与多套专用链路，具备频率可重构性。

Abstract: Earth observation missions rely on microwave and sub-terahertz radiometry for retrieving atmospheric parameters such as temperature, humidity, and cloud properties, with the 183- and 229-GHz spectral regions being particularly relevant. Local-oscillator (LO) generation at these frequencies requires low phase noise and high frequency stability while meeting stringent size, weight, and power (SWaP) constraints. Conventional architectures employ dielectric resonator oscillators followed by cascaded frequency-multiplication stages, requiring dedicated generation chains for different frequency bands and increasing hardware complexity. Furthermore, frequency multiplication degrades the phase noise of the generated signal. This work proposes and numerically investigates a reconfigurable self-oscillating microwave photonic architecture for LO generation in Earth observation receivers. Cascaded Mach-Zehnder and phase modulation within an optoelectronic feedback loop generate an optical frequency comb with enhanced higher-order components. A combination of optical filters is used to select the required comb line. First, a conventional bandpass filter with a bandwidth of approximately 10 GHz isolates the spectral region containing the desired component, after which a narrowband dual cavity Bragg grating ring resonator (BGRR) with a bandwidth of approximately 3 MHz provides the final line selection. The selected comb line is then combined with an optical reference derived from the same laser and photodetected to generate the desired millimeter-wave or sub-terahertz signal through optical heterodyning. Numerical simulations are presented for 183- and 229-GHz generation, demonstrating the ability of the same underlying architecture to address multiple LO frequencies by tuning the OEO electrical filter to the appropriate oscillation frequency and selecting the corresponding comb order.

</details>


### [756] [Parameter-efficient neural computing with programmable photonic meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26429)
*Artem Popov,Stanislav Straupe,Mikhail Saygin*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出基于可编程光子网格的神经网络参数高效表示：电子端紧凑参数决定干涉仪相位，光学干涉生成稠密高秩变换，在端到端训练与语言模型微调中匹配或优于强压缩张量列/砖块层及数字适配器，且可训练参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内存容量与带宽已成为神经网络计算的主要瓶颈，需要参数高效的表示来降低模型存储与数据搬运。已有的张量网络方法虽能压缩网络，但其结构化算子与面向稠密线性代数的常规处理器匹配不佳；光子实现又通常需针对特定分解定制光路架构。

Method: 以可编程光子网格为核心：由紧凑的电子参数确定各干涉仪相位，通过光学干涉产生稠密、一般为高秩的变换。参数化保留在电子域，因此可在不改动光路的前提下改变参数维度与结构。

Result: 端到端训练数值实验表明，该光子层匹配或优于强压缩的张量列层与brickwork层，且往往可训练参数更少；在语言模型的参数高效微调中相较成熟数字适配器亦具优势。

Conclusion: 该方案以较少可训练状态降低持久内存需求，并有望减少数据搬运与带宽压力，为参数高效神经网络提供了一条与硬件解耦的光子实现路径。

Abstract: Memory capacity and bandwidth are becoming major constraints in neural-network computing, motivating parameter-efficient representations that reduce model storage and data movement. Tensor-network methods already enable substantial compression of neural networks, but their structured operations are often poorly matched to conventional processors optimized for dense linear algebra. Such representations can be implemented in photonic hardware, although this typically requires optical architectures tailored to a particular factorization. Here we propose a different approach based on programmable photonic meshes. Compact electronic parameters determine the interferometer phases, while optical interference produces a dense, generally high-rank transformation. Since the parameterization remains electronic, its dimensionality and structure can be changed without modifying the optical circuit. Numerical experiments in end-to-end training demonstrate that the proposed photonic layers match or outperform strongly compressed tensor-train and brickwork layers, often with fewer trainable parameters. Experiments in parameter-efficient fine-tuning of a language model also show advantages over established digital adapters. The reduced trainable state lowers persistent memory requirements and offers the potential to reduce data movement and bandwidth demands.

</details>


### [757] [Spatiotemporal spherical Gaussian pulses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26476)
*A. Konzel,R. Almeida,J. Vieira,J. P. Palastro*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文提出一类具有球面时空结构的电磁高斯模式，其在反常色散介质中传播时保持形式不变，角向分布由球谐函数给出且量子化轴可任意选取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在色散介质中，脉冲的时空耦合与横向/纵向轨道角动量（OAM）混合行为缺乏统一且传播不变的解析模式描述，需要构造能同时刻画时空聚焦压缩与任意角向结构的模式族。

Method: 通过一系列幺正变换，将色散傍轴波动方程映射为具有三维各向同性谐振子势的薛定谔方程；由此构造角向为球谐函数、量子化轴可自由选择的电磁高斯模式，并将其推广到同时聚焦与压缩的啁啾脉冲解的任意角向叠加。

Result: 所得模式支持纵向与横向分量由量子化轴取向决定的时空OAM构型，叠加形式推广了经典啁啾脉冲同时聚焦压缩的解；幺正变换还给出混合纵/横OAM的守恒算符。

Conclusion: 该工作为反常色散介质中的时空OAM操控与守恒律分析提供了统一的解析框架。

Abstract: We describe a class of electromagnetic Gaussian modes with spherical spatiotemporal structure that remains invariant during propagation through anomalously dispersive media. The angular profile of the modes is given by spherical harmonics, whose quantization axis can be freely chosen. As a result, the modes support spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum (OAM) configurations with longitudinal and transverse components set by the orientation of the quantization axis. Superpositions of these modes generalize the familiar solution of a chirped pulse that simultaneously focuses and compresses to arbitrary angular structure. The modes are derived through a series of unitary transformations that map the dispersive paraxial wave equation onto a Schrödinger equation with a 3D isotropic harmonic potential. These transformations facilitate the identification of conserved operators for mixed longitudinal and transverse OAM.

</details>


### [758] [Single-Mode Laser Arrays with Size-Invariant Loss Discrimination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26578)
*Wenwen Liu,Shuang Zhang*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该文在稀疏星形网络中揭示了一种耗散选择机制，通过引入辅助耗散耦合，使系统具备精确的星-拉普拉斯对称性，从而把一个目标本征态从所有损耗通道中隔离出来（暗态），在保持各主节点等幅的同时形成与阵列规模无关的、持久的模态损耗间隙，抑制多模竞争，实现可扩展的高功率单超模激光阵列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统耦合振子晶格与激光阵列在扩大有源体积时，不可避免地出现模式频谱拥挤与空间均匀性退化，长期阻碍高功率单模运转。作者希望打破"模态选择性与阵列尺寸相互制约"这一固有瓶颈。

Method: 构建由中心枢纽与N个外围谐振器组成的稀疏星形网络，在主节点之间设计耗散型辅助耦合，使系统获得精确的星-拉普拉斯对称性；利用该对称性构造对所有损耗通道免疫、且在各主节点上等幅的目标暗本征态，其余竞争本征态因破坏该对称性而被导向辅助损耗通道，形成持续且与尺寸无关的模态损耗间隙；并用实际微环谐振腔仿真验证色散条件下的鲁棒性，并指出只要满足系统奇异点条件即可推广至任意阵列。

Result: 解析与数值结果表明：目标本征态在全部主节点上保持等幅且不受损耗通道影响；竞争模态被迫承受辅助损耗，形成稳定的、不随N增大的模态损耗间隙；微环仿真证实该暗态隔离在电磁色散下依然稳健；在满足奇异点条件时机制可扩展至任意阵列拓扑。

Conclusion: 利用图拓扑（星-拉普拉斯对称性）而非增益竞争来规避多模竞争，为可扩展的高功率单超模激光阵列提供了通用设计路径，也为耦合非厄米系统中的稳健态选择提供了新范式。

Abstract: In conventional coupled oscillator lattices and laser arrays, expanding the active volume inevitably causes spectral crowding and degrades spatial uniformity, posing a long-standing barrier to high-power single-mode operation. We uncover a dissipative selection mechanism in sparse star networks that decouples modal selectivity from lattice size constraints. By engineering dissipative auxiliary couplings between a central hub and N peripheral resonators, the system establishes an exact star-Laplacian symmetry. This enforces a target eigenstate that is immune to all lossy channels while maintaining equal amplitude across all main nodes. All competing eigenstates break this symmetry, driving the auxiliary loss and opening a persistent, size-independent modal loss gap that prevents multi-mode competition. Realistic microring simulations validate the robustness of this dark-state isolation under electromagnetic dispersion and mechanism extension to arbitrary arrays is allowed when meets the system's exceptional point. By exploiting graph topology to bypass multi-mode competition, this work establishes a general route toward scalable high-power single-supermode laser arrays and robust state selection in coupled non-Hermitian systems.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [759] [Web Agent Agentic Reinforcement Learning Decision Model Under Multi-Cost and Failure Risk](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23857)
*Qianli Ma,Limengxi Yue,Shuyang Xu,Yanpei Shi,Hongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种受约束的智能体强化学习模型，将请求次数、时延、失败惩罚构成多维代价向量，结合拉格朗日对偶预算约束与CVaR尾部风险控制，在完成率、成本与风险间取得自适应平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实网页环境中智能体受请求预算、时延、反爬限制与失败风险约束，仅优化任务成功率的策略易出现"高成功高成本"或"低风险但保守失败"等不可用现象，缺乏对成本与风险的显式建模。

Method: 构建统一长期决策框架，将页面访问、搜索请求与外部API调用统一为带代价的动作；以累计请求数、总时延、失败惩罚构成多维代价向量，通过拉格朗日对偶更新实现预算合规；引入CVaR风险项抑制对高失败概率路径的过度探索。

Result: 在30–70个站点/页面模板、800–1500个端到端任务（信息抽取、比价、表单提交、跨页导航），交互序列20–120步、工具规模30–200上评测：同等完成率下C-PS降低22%–31%，高失败惩罚下失败率降低18%–26%；固定预算下完成率提升10%–16%。

Conclusion: 约束建模对网页智能体的实际部署具有必要性与有效性，兼顾完成率、成本与风险的统一优化可显著改善可用性。

Abstract: Intelligent agent interactions in real-world web environments are commonly constrained by request budgets, time delays, anti-crawling restrictions, and operational failure risks. Strategies solely optimizing task success rates often exhibit unusable phenomena such as "high success but high cost" or "low risk but conservative failure." This paper proposes a constrained agentic reinforcement learning model for web agents, unifying page access, search requests, and external API calls into a unified long-term decision-making framework with associated costs. It simultaneously incorporates cost budget constraints and tail risk control into the optimization objective: constructing a multidimensional cost vector comprising cumulative request count, total latency, and failure penalties to achieve budget compliance via Lagrange dual updates, while employing a CVaR risk term to suppress excessive exploration of high-failure-probability paths, thereby achieving an adaptive balance among "completion rate, cost, and risk."
  Experiments were conducted across 30-70 site/page templates and 800-1,500 end-to-end web tasks, including information extraction, price comparison, form submission, and cross-page navigation. Interaction sequences spanned 20-120 steps with tool scales of 30-200. Performance was benchmarked against unconstrained RL, budget-constrained RL, and rule-based/scripted web agents, quantifying task completion rates, cost-per-success, failure rates, and policy stability.
  Results demonstrate that at equivalent completion rates, our method reduces C-PS by 22%-31% and lowers failure rates by 18%-26% under high failure penalties. Under fixed budgets, task completion rates increase by 10%-16%, highlighting the necessity and effectiveness of constraint modeling for practical web agent deployment.

</details>


### [760] [PolyGraph: Plan-Buffered CUDA Graphs for Adaptive Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23861)
*Junchao Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PolyGraph 用"计划缓冲区"机制让自定义 Triton 内核只捕获一张最大网格的 CUDA Graph，并在每次重放前把当前激活形状（28 字节）写入 GPU 显存，内核跳过该形状之外的 tile，从而用单图替代多张形状专用图，无需填充或在线捕获。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应投机解码会在相邻解码步之间改变活跃批大小 B 与草稿长度 d，导致验证宽度 M = B·d 动态变化；而 CUDA Graph 只能重放固定的启动配置。这使得服务系统必须在三种劣势方案中取舍：预先捕获大量形状图、在服务路径上在线捕获新形状、或将每步填充到最大草稿长度（引入无效负载与延迟）。

Method: 提出 PolyGraph 计划缓冲区机制：仅捕获一张最大网格的图；每次重放前将活跃形状写入 GPU 显存（仅 28 字节传输）；内核读取该形状并跳过超出的 tile；图拓扑、内存分配、布局、指针与启动网格保持固定。基于自定义 Triton 内核实现 trace 驱动原型，并在单张 NVIDIA H800 上以 Qwen2.5-3B 维度评测，另设固定草稿长度的 MaxPad 对照组以隔离填充浪费的影响。

Result: 在 H800 上，PolyGraph 将 64 张形状专用图合并为 1 张；观测步延迟与预热基线持平（P50 17.7 vs 17.8 ms）；预服务图构建时间从 3,915 ms 降至 93 ms。固定草稿对照显示：零填充浪费时相对 MaxPad 的 P99 差异可忽略，而在 100% 填充浪费时 P99 降低 18.7%，说明收益源于避免填充负载。

Conclusion: PolyGraph 建立了一种面向自定义内核的有界工作形状机制，而非可上线的生产服务系统；实验限于单张 GPU 上的合成 trace，尚需真实负载与多 GPU 环境验证。

Abstract: Adaptive speculative decoding changes the active batch size B and draft length d from one decode step to the next, whereas a CUDA Graph replays a fixed launch configuration. The resulting verification width M = B d forces serving systems to pre-capture many shapes, capture new ones on the serving path, or pad every step to the largest draft. We present PolyGraph, a plan-buffer mechanism for custom Triton kernels that avoids this choice. PolyGraph captures one maximum-grid graph and writes the active shape to GPU memory before each replay. Kernels skip tiles beyond that shape, while graph topology, allocations, layouts, pointers, and launch grids remain fixed; the update transfers only 28 bytes. On one NVIDIA H800, a trace-driven prototype with Qwen2.5-3B dimensions replaces 64 shape-specific graphs with one, matches the warmed baseline in observed step latency (17.7 vs. 17.8 ms P50), and reduces measured pre-serving graph-build time from 3,915 to 93 ms. Fixed-draft controls show that the benefit comes from avoiding padded payload: the P99 difference from MaxPad is negligible at zero padding waste but reaches an 18.7% reduction at 100% waste. Our evidence establishes a bounded work-shape mechanism for custom kernels, not a production serving system, and is limited to synthetic traces on one GPU.

</details>


### [761] [Forecasting Patient Trajectories from the Electronic Health Records with Action-Conditioned World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23862)
*Simon A. Lee,Jiahang Hank Sha,Soomin Chung,Kai Akamatsu,Eran Halperin,Jeffrey N. Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 EHR WM——一种面向电子健康记录（EHR）的预测式世界模型，将患者历史表征为“动作条件”的潜变量轨迹：显式分离患者状态与临床动作，并用状态-动作条件的转移算子学习其演化。核心是状态相关的线性化预测器，可传播潜状态的局部变化，支持时间分辨预测、多步 rollout 与动作条件仿真。实验表明生成轨迹保留了下游预测信号、时间结构与亚组统计关系；自由 rollout 解码回临床特征空间后仍优于/匹配任务对齐的预测基线；在二分类与时间到事件任务上以约小 30 倍参数量取得竞争性（任务相关）性能；扰动动作序列可引起轨迹相应变化，体现动作敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有临床事件建模多依赖自回归 token 预测，缺乏对“患者状态”与“临床干预（动作）”的显式区分，也难以进行时间分辨预测、多步推演与反事实/动作条件仿真。作者希望为纵向 EHR 提供一种显式、时间索引的患者演化表征框架，检验世界模型能否作为补充范式。因此动机是：以世界模型替代/补充纯序列预测，显式建模状态-动作动力学，并在小参数规模下保持预测有效性。

Method: (1) 表征分解：将潜空间分为患者状态与观测到的临床动作，学习状态-动作条件转移算子刻画其演化；(2) 核心模块为状态相关的线性化预测器（state-dependent linearization predictor），在潜空间传播状态的局部变化，从而实现时间分辨预测、多步 rollout 与动作条件仿真；(3) 评估协议：检验生成潜轨迹是否保留下游预测信号、时间结构及亚组层面统计关系；(4) 将自由运行（free-running）rollout 解码回原始临床特征空间，与任务匹配的预测基线比较未来临床测量；(5) 在二分类与时间到事件任务上与显著更大的 EHR 基础模型对比参数效率；(6) 通过扰动观测动作序列检验动作敏感性。

Result: 生成的潜轨迹保留了编码器表征中的下游预测信号、时间结构与亚组级统计关系；解码后的自由 rollout 在原始临床特征空间中相比任务匹配基线仍具预测信息，说明所学动力学不只是潜空间一致性；在二分类与时间到事件任务上，EHR WM 以约小 30 倍的参数量取得与大型 EHR 基础模型竞争性的（任务相关的）性能；扰动动作序列会引发生成轨迹的对应变化，验证了动力学对动作的敏感性。

Conclusion: EHR WM 表明世界模型可作为学习纵向 EHR 中显式、时间索引患者演化表征的补充框架：通过分离状态与动作、以线性化转移算子建模局部动力学，在极小参数预算下实现时间分辨预测、多步推演与动作条件仿真，并保持下游效用与动作敏感性；其性能具有任务依赖性，提示其更适合作为与序列预测互补的建模范式。

Abstract: We introduce a predictive world model for electronic health records (EHR) that represents patient histories as action conditioned latent trajectories. Rather than modeling clinical events solely through autoregressive token prediction, our framework explicitly separates patient states from observed clinical actions and learns their evolution through a state and action conditioned transition operator. At its core is a state dependent linearization predictor that propagates local changes in latent patient state, enabling time resolved prediction, multi step rollout, and action conditioned simulation. Empirically, we show that generated latent trajectories preserve downstream predictive signal, temporal structure, and subgroup level statistical relationships present in encoder derived representations. We further decode free running rollouts into the original clinical feature space and evaluate future clinical measurements against observed values using task matched forecasting baselines, demonstrating that the learned dynamics retain predictive information beyond latent space agreement. Across binary classification and time to event tasks, EHR WM achieves competitive, though task dependent, performance relative to substantially larger EHR foundation models while using a 30x smaller parameter footprint. Finally, perturbing observed action sequences produces corresponding changes in generated trajectories, demonstrating the action sensitivity of the learned dynamics. Together, these results support world modeling as a complementary framework for learning explicit, time indexed representations of patient evolution from longitudinal EHR.

</details>


### [762] [SAGE-CP: When Marginal Coverage Hides Route-Conditional Failures in Adaptive VLM Ensembles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23864)
*Mushir Akhtar,M. Tanveer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SAGE-CP 通过对路由器产生的各条运行路径分别做 Mondrian split conformal 校准，使自适应 VLM 集成在保持计算节省的同时获得逐路径的覆盖保证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应 VLM 集成（简单图像提前退出、困难图像升级）若只用单一 conformal 阈值，虽能保证边际覆盖，却在单条计算路径上严重失效：若某路径占比为 π，边际 1-α 覆盖下其条件覆盖可低至 max{0, 1-α/π}。

Method: 在开发集上学习路由器并冻结所有路由选择，再对早退与升级两类输出分数分别校准，即 SAGE-CP：对路由器形成的运营分组应用 Mondrian split conformal prediction，在可交换性假设下实现各路径内的有限样本覆盖。

Result: 10 个基准、4 个冻结 VLM、5 组对齐划分上，全局校准与 SAGE-CP 均达到 0.900 边际覆盖（目标 0.90），但路径行为差异显著：最差路径平均覆盖由 0.623 升至 0.887，路径覆盖差距由 0.324 降至 0.025，源调用同为每图 1.177 次；平均预测集由 1.893 增至 2.212，仍小于全集成（2.486）且源调用少 70.6%。6 种固定查询比例下路径级可靠性稳定；更细的退出深度分组显示稀有路径需更多校准数据。5 个数据集上批一延迟降低 58.8–63.4%，GPU 总能耗降低 55.7–57.5%。

Conclusion: 路由负责计算节省，路径分层校准将覆盖保证附着于路由器实际产生的运行路径；代价是预测集略有增大及稀有路径的校准数据需求。

Abstract: Adaptive VLM ensembles save computation by stopping early on easy images and escalating harder ones. Although a single conformal threshold can make the final predictor marginally valid, it can still fail severely along individual computational routes. We characterize this failure precisely: if a route has prevalence pi, marginal 1-alpha coverage allows its conditional coverage to fall to max{0, 1-alpha/pi}. To address this mismatch, we learn the router on development data, freeze all routing choices, and calibrate the returned score separately for early exits and escalated inputs. We call this pipeline SAGE-CP. Its calibration step applies Mondrian split conformal prediction to the operational groups created by the router. Under exchangeability, the resulting prediction sets achieve finite-sample coverage within each route. Across 10 benchmarks, 4 frozen VLMs, and 5 aligned splits, both global calibration and SAGE-CP achieve 0.900 marginal coverage at a 0.90 target, but their route behavior differs substantially. SAGE-CP raises mean worst-route coverage from 0.623 to 0.887 and reduces the mean route-coverage gap from 0.324 to 0.025, using the same routed scores and 1.177 source calls per image. The stronger guarantee increases the mean prediction-set size from 1.893 to 2.212; nevertheless, the sets remain smaller than those of the full ensemble (2.486) while requiring 70.6 percent fewer source calls. The route-level reliability persists across 6 fixed query fractions, while finer exit-depth groups demonstrate the need for additional calibration data on rare routes. Across 5 datasets, SAGE-CP also reduces measured batch-one latency by 58.8 to 63.4 percent and gross GPU energy by 55.7 to 57.5 percent relative to full inference. Thus, routing provides computational savings, while route-stratified calibration attaches coverage guarantees to the operational paths created by the router.

</details>


### [763] [Announced Breaks Separate Conformal Reliability from Frequency Calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23917)
*Karl Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: An announced boundary reveals the partition before the first affected outcome, and a reset there serves one of two audits. The per-time audit reads conformal reliability, the expected distance of the threshold's coverage from nominal at miscoverage 0.1. The frequency audit reads frequency calibration, whether a closed window's error rate matched it. The reset rule, the post-boundary empirical quantile, attains the minimax per-time rate for independent scores. On bounded scores a recursion reset at the boundary attains a frequency gap of order one over the count when its floor adds a bounded total. At the 50th forecast after a large synthetic break, the reset rule's per-time gap stands below that of five adaptive methods, four from their authors' code, with every paired band below zero. After an electricity market reform, on 68 unseen scores, the band stands below zero against two, includes zero against two, adaptive conformal inference among them, and is a point at zero against one. After monetary policy decisions its pointwise band stands above zero against all five on 10 of the first 34 days. Of 9 announced boundaries one clears the smallest coverage difference its window detects, where every method's per-time gap at the 50th forecast exceeds the nominal miscoverage. Over the first 50 forecasts the reset recursion leads the frequency audit after every synthetic break.

</details>


### [764] [Zero-Shot Tabular Learning via Hypergraph Reasoning with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23923)
*Geon Lee,Kyungho Kim,Dongwon Choi,Juyeon Kim,Shinhwan Kang,Kijung Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TABHGR+，利用 LLM 生成规则为表格行打弱标签并构建超图分组，通过超图标签传播去噪，以常数级 LLM 调用实现高效零样本表格学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的零样本表格方法采用逐行提示（row-wise prompting），推理成本高，且未充分利用行间依赖关系。

Method: 基于列描述与任务描述，用 LLM 生成规则为所有行分配弱标签；再借助这些规则将语义相关的行分组构建超图，进行超图标签传播以修正噪声弱标签；并进一步为超边分配标签自适应权重以优化传播效果。

Result: LLM 调用次数与数据集规模无关（常数级），显著降低推理成本，同时分类准确率优于零样本及强少样本基线。

Conclusion: 将 LLM 规则生成与超图标签传播结合，可在零样本表格任务中以低推理成本取得更优性能。

Abstract: Tabular data are prevalent across diverse domains such as healthcare and finance. Zero-shot tabular learning aims to make predictions without labeled data. However, existing LLM-based approaches rely on row-wise prompting, resulting in high inference cost and limited use of inter-row dependencies. In this work, we propose TABHGR+, an efficient relation-aware zero-shot framework for tabular data that leverages LLM-generated rules to label and group rows. Specifically, based on column and task descriptions, we use LLMs to generate rules that assign weak labels to all rows. To refine these noisy weak labels, we construct a hypergraph by grouping semantically related rows using LLM-generated rules and perform hypergraph-based label propagation. Lastly, we further enhance the LLM-generated hypergraph for propagation, which is potentially sub-optimal, by assigning label-adaptive weights to hyperedges. By requiring only a constant number of LLM calls independent of dataset size, TABHGR+ substantially reduces inference cost while achieving higher classification accuracy than zero-shot and strong few-shot baselines.

</details>


### [765] [Improving Fake Profile Detection Through Multimodal Learning and Research-Guided Feature Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23926)
*Jean Claude Hirwa,Jamiu Dahunsi,Candide Giramata,Lowami Uwimana,Thierry Henry Ishimwe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在TwiBot-22的3万用户子样本上融合文本(XLM-RoBERTa)、视觉(CLIP)与账号元数据检测虚假账号，发现元数据本身已高度可预测，多模态融合增益边际且多不显著，图模型表现更差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虚假账号持续危害在线平台，但尚不清楚多模态学习相较强元数据基线或图方法是否带来实质提升，因此需要系统比较不同信号与模型的实际贡献。

Method: 基于TwiBot-22基准的30,000用户子样本，构建多模态框架：预训练文本嵌入(XLM-RoBERTa)、视觉嵌入(CLIP)结合关注者数、发帖频率、账号年龄等结构化账号特征；用CatBoost评估多种模态组合，并对比Relational Graph Convolutional Network(R-GCN)。

Result: 仅用元数据即具有很高预测力；多模态融合带来的提升边际且大多在统计上不显著；在子采样图条件下，R-GCN等图模型的性能低于经典模型。

Conclusion: 在实际约束下，特征质量与元数据丰富度比融合复杂度更重要；多模态融合与图方法的额外复杂性与计算成本未必换来相应收益。

Abstract: Fake accounts continue to undermine online platforms, yet it remains unclear whether multimodal learning offers meaningful improvements over strong metadata baselines or graph-based approaches. In this work, we study bot detection by integrating textual, visual, and account metadata signals on the TwiBot-22 benchmark using a subsample of 30,000 users. We propose a multimodal framework combining pretrained textual (XLM-RoBERTa) and visual (CLIP) embeddings with structured account-level features such as follower counts, posting frequency, and account age, and evaluate multiple modality combinations using CatBoost alongside a Relational Graph Convolutional Network (R-GCN). Results show that metadata alone is highly predictive, while multimodal fusion yields only marginal and largely statistically insignificant gains. The graph-based model underperforms classical variants under the subsampled graph conditions of this study. Overall, our findings suggest that under practical constraints, feature quality and metadata richness matter more than fusion complexity.

</details>


### [766] [Client-Aware Security Adaptive Early Exit Vision Transformers for Heterogeneous Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24036)
*Sahar Refaei Ghalibafan,Samira Nazari,Christian Herglotz,Maksim Jenihhin,Mahdi Taheri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究联邦学习中的本地早退ViT推理，提出客户端特定基阈值加输入级动态阈值调整的门控策略，并配合仅聚合更新参数的聚合与安全感知路由，在CIFAR-10/ImageNet-1K/CIFAR-100上实现显著深度节省且精度优于异构FL基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中各客户端的数据难度与算力预算差异显著，而单一全局接受阈值无法适配这种异构性，导致早退推理在部分客户端过早或过晚退出，浪费算力或损失精度。

Method: 针对本地早退ViT：用标签熵与浅层退出置信度计算客户端特定基阈值，替代单一全局阈值；再依据预测熵、置信度、top-2类别间隔和退出深度对每个输入动态调整阈值；聚合阶段只纳入实际更新了某参数的客户端；并提出安全感知与鲁棒性感知的路由机制。

Result: 安全感知路由在CIFAR-10达88.70%精度、节省32.0%深度；ImageNet-1K top-1为73.7%、节省30%。六客户端非IID CIFAR-100上全深度精度72.28%，高于四个异构FL基线的68.20–71.80%；鲁棒性感知路由达70.01%且节省32.55%深度。

Conclusion: 客户端自适应阈值与输入级动态门控可有效缓解FL中的数据与算力异构性，在保持或提升精度的同时显著降低推理深度，且参数级聚合与感知路由增强了实用性与鲁棒性。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) trains a shared model across data-owning clients without centralizing raw data, but client data difficulty and compute budgets can differ. We study local early-exit Vision Transformer (ViT) inference, where an intermediate classifier may return a prediction before the final Transformer stage. The proposed method replaces one global acceptance threshold with a client-specific base threshold from label entropy and shallow-exit confidence, then adjusts each input using predictive entropy, confidence, top-two class margin, and exit depth. Aggregation uses only clients that updated a parameter. Security-aware routing reaches 88.70% CIFAR-10 accuracy with 32.0% depth saving and 73.7% ImageNet-1K top-1 accuracy with 30\% saving. On matched six-client non-IID CIFAR-100, full-depth accuracy is 72.28% versus 68.20--71.80% for four heterogeneous-FL baselines; robustness-aware routing reaches 70.01% with 32.55% saving.

</details>


### [767] [miniTE: Diagnosing and Bridging the Execution Gap in Native NVFP4 Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23928)
*Zhen Li,Mingfa Feng,Yiming Zhang,Yang Yu,Changhai Zhou,Pengxiang Li,Dongkuan Wu,Congkai Xie,Hongxia Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 miniTE 框架，通过执行诊断、跨引擎数值对齐与原生 W4A4 GEMM，实现 LLM 强化学习中稳定的原生 NVFP4 低比特训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在分离的训练与采样引擎上使用原生 NVFP4 加速 LLM 强化学习时，仅对齐模型权重与数值格式不足以保证策略评估一致性，跨引擎数值执行差异导致学习不稳定；同时原生低比特实现的工程开销较高，阻碍了其收益落地。

Method: miniTE 是轻量级框架，包含三部分：执行诊断（定位数值不一致来源）、跨引擎数值对齐（在不修改 RL 目标的前提下提升数值执行一致性）、高效原生 W4A4（4-bit 权重与激活）GEMM 计算。

Result: 在 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上的长程 RL 实验显示训练稳定，基准性能接近 BF16，评估质量优于朴素 Transformer Engine NVFP4；单台 NVIDIA B300 GPU 节点上优化后的 learner 达 33,540 tokens/s，完整 learner 更新吞吐分别为 BF16 的 1.39 倍与 TE NVFP4 的 1.47 倍。

Conclusion: 跨引擎数值执行一致性是原生低比特 RL 稳定的关键；miniTE 在不改动 RL 目标的情况下兼顾稳定性与吞吐收益，并开源框架、kernel、诊断工具与训练配置以降低原生低比特 RL 的使用门槛。

Abstract: Native NVFP4 promises to accelerate reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs), but achieving stable learning across separate training and sampling engines remains challenging. We show that matching model weights and numerical formats is insufficient to ensure consistent policy evaluation, highlighting the importance of cross-engine numerical execution. We introduce miniTE, a lightweight framework that combines execution diagnostics, cross-engine numerical alignment, and efficient native W4A4 (4-bit weights and activations) GEMM computation for LLM RL. It improves numerical execution consistency without modifying the RL objective, while reducing implementation overhead to realize the benefits of native low-bit computation. Long-horizon RL experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B demonstrate stable training and benchmark performance close to BF16, outperforming naive Transformer Engine (TE) NVFP4 in evaluation quality. On single NVIDIA B300 GPU node, the optimized learner reaches 33,540 tokens/s, yielding 1.39x and 1.47x the throughput of BF16 and TE NVFP4, respectively, for complete learner updates. We released the framework, kernels, diagnostics, and training configurations to make native low-bit RL easier.

</details>


### [768] [Learn the Interface, Not the Implementation: Output Representation Dominates Training Regime in LLM-Based RTL Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25881)
*Siddharth Patel,Vikram Singh,Siddharth Savyasachi Malu,Rohit Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在SECDED ECC包装器任务上固定任务/数据/形式化验证oracle，独立变化训练范式与输出表示：表示是主导因素（配置化表示零样本0.83，原始RTL≤0.17），且原始RTL在32位以上受输出长度上限约束而不可行；小模型+验证生成器可显著降低推理能耗。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前LLM生成RTL的研究主要聚焦于训练方式（微调、继续预训练、基于验证器的强化学习），作者认为这是"二阶问题"，真正的一阶问题在于输出表示（学习接口而非实现）。

Method: 在有界且可形式化定义的任务（生成SECDED ECC存储器包装器）上，固定任务、数据与正确性oracle，正交地改变两个维度：(1) 7种训练设置；(2) 4种输出表示层级（从完全展开的扁平Verilog到由确定性生成器展开的8字段配置）。采用形式等价性验证在约一千万个设计点的空间上判定正确性，而非手写测试平台的采样。

Result: 表示主导正确率：接近原始RTL的各类表示通过率≤0.17，而配置表示零训练即达0.83；模型输出配置后各训练范式通过率在0.89–1.00。原始RTL存在硬性输出长度上限：512位设计需44,237个扁平Verilog token，而配置仅需69个token，故32位以上原始生成不可行。少于5千万参数的自训练模型配合验证生成器达到0.89形式等价，而320亿参数微调模型为1.00，但后者每次正确设计的推理能耗高约1600倍；推理能耗亦主导摊销后的训练能耗。

Conclusion: 应学习接口而非实现：将生成目标改为紧凑的配置接口并由确定性生成器展开，可同时提升正确率、突破输出长度瓶颈并大幅降低推理能耗，其收益远超训练范式的选择。

Abstract: Large-language-model register-transfer-level (RTL) generation has concentrated on how to train the model: fine-tuning, continued pre-training, and reinforcement learning from a verifier. We argue this is the second-order question. On a bounded, formally specifiable task of generating single-error-correcting, double-error-detecting (SECDED) ECC memory wrappers, we hold the task, data, and correctness oracle fixed and vary two axes independently: the training regime (seven settings) and the output representation (four levels, from fully expanded flat Verilog to an eight-field configuration expanded by a deterministic generator). Because a reference generator exists, correctness is decided by formal equivalence over a design space of approximately ten million points, rather than sampled from a hand-written testbench. Two results follow. First, representation dominates: every representation close to raw RTL reaches a pass rate of at most 0.17, while the configuration reaches 0.83 with no training at all. Once the model emits the configuration, every training regime achieves a pass rate between 0.89 and 1.00. Second, raw RTL hits a hard output-length limit: a 512-bit design requires 44,237 tokens of flat Verilog compared with just 69 tokens for the configuration. Consequently, raw generation becomes infeasible above 32-bit data words rather than merely inaccurate. A model trained from scratch with fewer than 50 million parameters, combined with the verified generator, achieves 0.89 formal equivalence, compared with 1.00 for a 32-billion-parameter fine-tuned model, while using approximately 1600 times less inference energy per correct design. Inference energy also dominates amortized training energy. The lesson is to learn the interface, not the implementation.

</details>


### [769] [Organizing LLM Inference for Aggregate Predictions from Behavioral Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23934)
*Varun Gupta,Vijay Kamble*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 用LLM模拟用户群体时，个体会话预测与摘要预测的最优选择取决于产品是否被放在同一prompt中比较：单独评估时逐会话预测更优，联合评估时"比较式摘要"最优，并在15个设置中的12个取得最高Spearman相关，且推理成本远低于逐会话方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究如何用LLM把个体行为历史组合起来，预测采取特定动作（电商转化）的用户比例；作者希望在不做任务特定训练的前提下，从浏览会话预测产品级转化率，并厘清两个各含偏差-方差权衡的设计选择。

Method: 变化两个设计维度：(1) 推理前先对产品会话做摘要 vs. 逐会话预测后再平均；(2) 单产品逐一评估 vs. 多产品同prompt联合评估（可引入"什么是典型"的比较信息，但预测会依赖共现产品而增加噪声）。在5个LLM、2个数据集上系统评估，并用贝叶斯模型解释第二个权衡：当prompt输入更能揭示产品间差异时，比较带来的收益更大；另用四类比较上下文验证。

Result: 单独评估时逐会话预测优于摘要预测，联合评估时摘要反超；比较式摘要（comparative summaries）在15个设置中有12个取得与真实转化率最高的Spearman相关，且无其他方法显著更优。比较对摘要方法的提升远大于对会话预测的提升，抵消了行为细节优势。比较式摘要推理成本仅为会话方法的一小部分；对每个结果取最佳模型时，其相关达到在数千标注产品上训练的最佳监督基线的66–89%。

Conclusion: 联合评估中的"比较"效应对摘要方法帮助极大，可克服行为细节带来的优势，因此比较式摘要在准确性与成本上兼优，是预测群体转化率的实用方案，并能在无任务训练的情况下接近监督基线的相关水平。

Abstract: When using a large language model (LLM) to simulate a user population, how should we combine individual behavioral histories to predict the fraction of users who take a particular action? We study this question in e-commerce, predicting observed product-level conversion rates from browsing sessions without task-specific model training. We vary two design choices, each involving a bias-variance tradeoff. Summarizing a product's sessions before inference reduces cost but can discard predictive detail, adding bias, whereas predicting outcomes for individual sessions and averaging afterward preserves that detail but requires many calls to reduce variance. Evaluating products together in one prompt can help the model infer what is typical in the setting, reducing bias, but also makes each prediction depend on which other products appear alongside it, adding noise. We evaluate both choices across five LLMs and two datasets. Our main finding is that predictions from individual sessions outperform predictions from summaries when products are evaluated separately, but summaries lead when products are evaluated together. Comparative summaries achieve the highest Spearman correlation with observed rates in 12 of 15 settings, with no alternative significantly better. Comparison thus helps summaries far more than session predictions, overcoming the advantage of behavioral detail. We interpret this difference through a Bayesian model of the second tradeoff, which suggests that comparison helps more when the inputs in a prompt reveal more about differences across products, consistent with our results for four types of comparative context. Comparative summaries also incur a small fraction of the inference cost of the session methods. With the best model for each outcome, they attain 66-89% of the correlation of the best supervised benchmark trained on thousands of labeled products.

</details>


### [770] [Factorization-Guided Training and Inference for Diffusion-Drafted Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23935)
*Jiakun Fan,Min Xiao,Qiang Wang,Neiwen Ling,Zhichao Liu,Zhihao Jia,Dimitrios S. Nikolopoulos,Zijun Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DScout 通过训练与推理两侧的双重因子化设计来提升扩散 drafter 的投机解码吞吐：训练侧将位置级损失分解为 inclusion、weighting 与 prediction loss 以对齐前缀接受；推理侧将吞吐分解为 MAT / 每轮延迟之比以指导配置选择。在六个基准上对 Qwen3-4B/8B 分别取得 3.84×、4.14× 平均加速，较 SOTA 基线提升 9.1% 与 7.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散 drafter 虽能并行生成候选，但“更大提案容量”或“更高 MAT”并不必然带来更高吞吐：验证只接受连续前缀，早期拒绝会使后续正确预测失效，从而限制 MAT 收益；同时 MAT 提升也可能被每轮延迟增加所抵消。因此需要重新审视训练监督与推理配置的目标。

Method: 训练：将位置级损失因子化为 inclusion、weighting、prediction 三项，据此设计并组合 mixed-horizon training、intra-block unmasking 与 acceptance-weighted loss，使监督信号与前缀接受机制对齐。推理：将吞吐因子化为 MAT 与每轮延迟之比，用于选择 target-conditioning depth、drafter depth 与推理 block size，针对每个负载确定高吞吐配置。

Result: 六个基准上，Qwen3-4B 与 Qwen3-8B 分别取得 3.84× 和 4.14× 的平均加速；相较 SOTA 基线的平均加速比分别提升 9.1% 与 7.1%。跨模型与并发设置下，推理配置策略在 DScout 固定配置基础上额外带来最高 9.75% 的平均加速。

Conclusion: 吞吐优化应以“前缀接受”与“MAT/延迟比”为目标，而非单纯追求 MAT 或提案容量；训练与推理的因子化协同设计可有效转化为端到端加速，且自适应的推理配置带来额外收益。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference through parallel verification of tokens proposed by a drafter. Diffusion drafters further parallelize proposal generation, but greater proposal capacity or higher mean accepted tokens (MAT) need not yield higher throughput. Because verification accepts only a consecutive prefix, early rejections can render later correct predictions ineffective, limiting MAT gains, while even higher MAT may not improve throughput if per-round latency increases. We introduce DScout, which uses two complementary factorizations to guide diffusion drafter training and inference for higher throughput. For training, DScout factorizes position-wise loss into inclusion, weighting, and prediction loss. This guides the design and combination of mixed-horizon training, intra-block unmasking, and acceptance-weighted loss to align supervision with prefix acceptance and improve MAT. For inference, DScout factorizes throughput as the ratio of MAT to per-round latency, guiding target-conditioning depth, drafter depth, and inference block size selection to identify a high-throughput configuration for each workload. Across six benchmarks, DScout achieves $3.84\times$ and $4.14\times$ mean speedups over autoregressive decoding on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, respectively, improving mean speedup over the state-of-the-art baseline by 9.1% and 7.1%. Across models and concurrency settings, our inference configuration policy provides up to 9.75% additional mean speedup over DScout's fixed configuration.

</details>


### [771] [Beyond Prediction: A Component-Level Study of Concept Recovery in In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23936)
*Xufeng Liu,Fang Wan,Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出组件级概念恢复框架，将概念分解为定义性组件并用受控结构干预评估，发现模型常在预测准确率很高时概念恢复却很差，联合监督可显著改善恢复且不损预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL评估只在整体概念层面考察恢复情况，难以定位哪些组件被恢复，也无法区分模型能力局限与演示本身歧义，因此需要更细粒度、更具诊断性的评估视角。

Method: 将概念分解为定义性组件，在可识别演示下采用受控结构干预，同时评估组件级与整体概念恢复；在四种指令微调LLM、三种组合形式上开展实验，并测试组件组合、冗余约束扰动及恢复与隐式预测联合监督的效果。

Result: 模型常在高预测准确率下出现较差整体概念恢复，并系统性过度指定相关属性与层级约束；单一结构组件通常不足以实现整体恢复，而联合指定互补组件（尤其相关属性及其层级约束）可显著提升恢复；但该提升脆弱，单条合理却非必要的层级约束即可显著破坏恢复；恢复与隐式预测联合监督在保持预测性能的同时显著提升恢复，且该能力可跨组合形式迁移。

Conclusion: 组件级分析相较整体视角能更诊断性地揭示模型从演示中真正恢复了什么，并表明联合监督是提升概念恢复的有效途径。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables language models to make accurate predictions from demonstrations, but prediction success alone does not reveal the extent to which the underlying concept has been recovered. Existing evaluations typically assess recovery at the level of the whole concept, making it difficult to identify which components are recovered and to separate model limitations from ambiguity in the demonstrations. We introduce a component-level framework for concept recovery that decomposes concepts into their defining components and uses controlled structural interventions to evaluate both component-level and whole-concept recovery under identifiable demonstrations. Across four instruction-tuned LLMs and three composition forms, we find that models often achieve high prediction accuracy despite poor whole-concept recovery, with systematic over-specification of relevant attributes and level constraints. Individual structural components are generally insufficient for whole-concept recovery, whereas jointly specifying complementary components, particularly relevant attributes and their level constraints, substantially improves recovery. However, this improvement is fragile: a single plausible but unnecessary level constraint can substantially disrupt recovery. Finally, joint supervision of recovery and implicit prediction substantially improves recovery while preserving prediction performance, with the learned capability transferring across composition forms. Overall, our component-level analysis provides a more diagnostic view of what models recover from demonstrations than the existing holistic view.

</details>


### [772] [SECURE-AI: Multi-Signal Uncertainty Quantification for Trustworthy Acoustic Cough Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23937)
*Sejal Solkhan,Feiya Xiang,Mayur Sanap,Geet Khatri,Edgar Lobaton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SECURE-AI多信号不确定性量化框架，包裹冻结的MobileNetV3咳嗽分类器，用MC Dropout、温度缩放与嵌入空间马氏距离联合判断预测可否信任；结果显示概率空间方法单独无效，马氏距离最强（AUROC 0.86/0.82），可用于同时抑制误报与漏报，并强调阈值不可迁移、应以AUROC为主要指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 咳嗽检测模型在精选基准上精度高，但在真实部署中会因语音、环境噪声及分布外音频"静默失败"并产生高置信度误判；健康监测场景下，自信的错误预测比无答案更糟，因此需要知道何时不该信任模型输出，并需要可部署于低成本硬件的可靠评估方案。

Method: 构建SECURE-AI多信号不确定性量化框架，包裹冻结的MobileNetV3咳嗽分类器，融合三类信号：Monte Carlo Dropout（概率空间）、温度缩放（校准）与嵌入空间马氏距离；在Coswara数据集的12,161条留出记录上评估，比较各信号的区分能力，并以阈值无关的AUROC为主要度量，同时给出错误分类学分析与树莓派（30–90美元）部署验证。

Result: 概率空间方法单独不足：MC Dropout对错误预测给出的不确定性反而低于正确预测，温度缩放改善校准但不改善区分度。嵌入空间马氏距离最强：区分真阳性与假阳性均值44.7 vs 63.4，Cohen's d=0.94，AUROC 0.86；在预测为非咳嗽中区分假阴性与真阴性，AUROC 0.82。选取的描述性工作点上，保留90%真阳性可去除约三分之二假阳性，精度由59.9%升至约80%。但阈值不可迁移：验证集F1 82%在测试集降至34%。错误分类学显示失败具系统性，多数假阳性与语音相关。流程可在30–90美元树莓派上运行。

Conclusion: 仅靠概率校准不足以保证可靠的咳嗽检测；嵌入空间距离是更有效、且能同时提示误报与漏报的信任判据。由于拒绝阈值跨数据划分不可迁移，应以阈值无关AUROC作为主要报告指标，并辅以系统性错误分析。

Abstract: Acoustic models for cough detection achieve high accuracy on curated benchmarks but fail silently in deployment, where speech, environmental noise, and audio unlike the training data induce confident misclassifications. In health monitoring, a confidently wrong prediction is worse than no answer at all. We present SECURE-AI (Self-aware Estimation of Cough Uncertainty for Reliable Evaluation of AI), a multi-signal uncertainty quantification framework that wraps a frozen MobileNetV3 cough classifier and estimates when its predictions should not be trusted, combining Monte Carlo Dropout, Temperature Scaling, and Mahalanobis distance in the embedding space. On a held-out split of 12,161 Coswara recordings, the probability-space methods are individually insufficient: Monte Carlo Dropout assigns lower uncertainty to incorrect than to correct predictions, and temperature scaling improves calibration but not discrimination. The strongest signal is embedding-space distance: Mahalanobis distance separates true positives from false positives (means 44.7 versus 63.4; Cohen's $d = 0.94$; AUROC 0.86) and, among predicted non-coughs, false negatives from true negatives (AUROC 0.82), so the same signal can flag both false alarms and missed coughs. At a descriptive operating point selected from labeled test data, retaining 90 percent of true-positive detections removes about two-thirds of false positives and raises precision from 59.9 to roughly 80 percent. A rejection threshold tuned on one split does not transfer to another (validation F1 of 82 percent falls to 34 percent on test), so we report threshold-independent AUROC as the main measure. An error taxonomy shows that failures are systematic, with most false positives related to speech. The pipeline runs on Raspberry Pi hardware costing 30 to 90 US dollars. Probabilistic calibration alone is thus inadequate for reliable cough detection.

</details>


### [773] [Pack and Extract: An Effective Graph-Based Approach for Feature Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23938)
*Faisal N. Abu-Khzam,Joseph R. Barr,Cynthia Chaaya,Nadim Obeid,Peter Shaw*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对高维分子生物学数据中特征选择的问题，改进了基于独立支配集（IDS）的特征选择方法：偏好多样性更强的特征，并将独立支配集推广为节点装填（node packing）模型，作为特征选择流程的中间步骤；在五个遗传数据集上相较现有方法在预测精度和特征集稳定性上均有明显提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分子生物学数据（如单细胞实验中的基因、其他组学数据）常包含数千个特征，标准预测模型在此类高维场景下表现不佳：倾向于保留大量特征，且难以充分处理特征间的相关性。基于独立支配集（IDS）的组合式特征选择虽有潜力，但可能因计算复杂度过高而被忽视，作者希望对其进行改进并重新推广。

Method: 提出对基于 IDS 的特征选择的改进，包含两点：(i) 偏好具有更高多样性的特征；(ii) 将独立支配集概念推广为节点装填（node packing）模型。所得形式化表述作为特征选择过程中的一个中间步骤使用。

Result: 在五个遗传数据集上进行评估并与现有方法对比，实验结果显示相较传统模型在预测准确率上有显著提升，同时所选特征集的稳定性增强。

Conclusion: 将 IDS 特征选择改进为偏好多样性特征并推广至节点装填模型，可在高维遗传数据上有效改善预测精度与特征选择稳定性，表明该类组合式方法值得进一步关注。

Abstract: Many molecular biology data sets contain thousands of features, such as genes in single-cell experiments or other omics data. Standard predictive models often perform poorly in such settings, as they tend to retain a large number of features and fail to adequately handle correlations among them. Combinatorial approaches, such as feature selection based on the Independent Dominating Set (IDS) model, have shown promising results, but appear to have been largely overlooked, possibly due to their high computational complexity. In this paper, we propose an improvement to IDS-based feature selection that (i) favors features exhibiting greater diversity and (ii) generalizes the notion of independent dominating set to a node packing model. The resulting formulation is used as an intermediate step within the feature selection process. We evaluate our approach on five genetic data sets and compare the results with those obtained using existing methods. Our experimental results demonstrate notable improvements in predictive accuracy over traditional models, as well as increased stability of the selected feature sets.

</details>


### [774] [PeekKV: The First Content Token Already Knows Which Heads Matter](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23939)
*Minyoung Go,Yongjun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PeekKV 通过“预填充后单 token 窥视”联合估计头组重要性得分与 token 重要性得分，无训练、无离线剖析地实现非均匀 KV cache 压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KV cache 随上下文长度线性增长，是 LLM 服务的主要显存瓶颈。现有按注意力头非均匀压缩的方法要么依赖离线剖析固定重要头，要么用 prefill 阶段注意力信号选头，导致跨工作负载精度波动大。作者发现原因在于活跃头在 prefill→decode 之间发生迁移，而 decode 阶段（过滤格式 token 后）活跃头组成在内容 token 间稳定。

Method: 提出 PeekKV：在 prefill 之后立即观察一个内容 token（one-token peek），据此同时获得头组得分与 token 重要性得分；按组得分比例将 KV cache 预算分配给各头组，并在每组预算内仅保留得分最高的 token。无需离线剖析或训练，可直接泛化到未见负载与新模型。

Result: 在四个公开基准上，超过一半的逐模型对比中取得最高精度；在 RULER 与 LongBench 上最接近全缓存精度。Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 上，RULER 16K 上下文、10% 预算下保留 95.7% 全缓存精度；LongBench 1.5% 预算下保留 95.9%。

Conclusion: 动态、轻量的在线头组重要性估计可有效缓解头重要性漂移问题，在极低预算下实现近无损的 KV cache 压缩，且具备良好的通用性与部署便利性。

Abstract: The size of the KV cache grows linearly with context length, making it a major memory bottleneck in LLM serving. Motivated by recent progress in identifying the functional roles of attention heads, a growing body of work compresses the KV cache non-uniformly across heads. Existing methods either fix the important heads via offline profiling or select them using attention signals from the prefill stage. In both cases, however, accuracy fluctuates substantially across workloads. While investigating the cause of this instability, we find that the active heads shift between the prefill and decode stages even within a single input. Along the decode path, by contrast, the activehead composition remains stable across content tokens once format tokens are filtered out. Based on this observation, we propose PeekKV. PeekKV observes a single content token immediately after prefill - a one-token peek - to jointly obtain head-group scores and token-importance scores. Guided by these scores, PeekKV allocates KV cache budgets to head groups in proportion to their group scores and retains only the top-scoring tokens within each budget. PeekKV requires no offline profiling or training and thus applies directly to unseen workloads and new models. Across four public benchmarks, PeekKV achieves the highest accuracy in more than half of the per-model comparisons against state-of-the-art methods, and stays closest to the full-cache accuracy on RULER and LongBench. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, PeekKV retains 95.7% of the full-cache accuracy at a 10% memory budget on RULER with 16K contexts and 95.9% at a 1.5% budget on LongBench.

</details>


### [775] [Fast Construction of Inner Sphere Trees Using Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23940)
*Jianneng Huang,Wenjia Rao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 ML-IST：将内球树（IST）的叶球生成重构为单次集合预测问题，用神经网络从多通道体素预测内切球候选，配合可微覆盖反馈与轻量几何投影保证有效性，在单GPU上比单核CPU构造提速2.0–2.6倍，并集成到Jolt与Bullet，在alpha-puzzle基准达55.89 FPS，优于传统IST、GImpact与凸分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂非凸物体的碰撞检测是物理仿真、VR与机器人中的瓶颈。内球树能高效回答邻近与穿透查询，但其叶球构造采用贪婪策略、串行且计算昂贵，既阻碍大规模预处理，也限制运行时使用。目标是加速叶球生成并保持几何有效性。

Method: 将叶球生成表述为单次集合预测：网络从多通道体素几何中直接预测固定数量的内切球候选；引入可微的覆盖度反馈来修正粗预测并在更细尺度上填补残余空隙；最后用轻量几何投影强制球体有效（内切性/合法性）。整体流程避免逐球贪婪的串行搜索。

Result: 在测试集上平均：单GPU实现相对单核CPU构造，目标球数64–512时平均叶生成时间缩短2.0–2.6倍；复杂模型上呈现多尺度球分布，贴合主体积与细长特征。集成至Jolt Physics与Bullet，在alpha-puzzle基准达55.89 FPS，在传统IST、GImpact、凸分解中最高。

Conclusion: 结果表明学习式叶球生成可作为快速、运行时构建细节碰撞表示的实际可用组件，兼顾构造效率与表示质量。

Abstract: Collision detection for complex non-convex objects is a bottleneck in physics simulation, virtual reality, and robotics. Inner sphere trees (ISTs) answer proximity and penetration queries efficiently, but their greedy leaf-sphere construction is sequential and computationally expensive, which limits both large-scale preprocessing and runtime use. In this work, we present ML-IST, a machine-learning-based method that reformulates leaf-sphere generation as a single-shot set-prediction problem: a network predicts a fixed set of inscribed sphere candidates from multichannel voxel geometry, differentiable coverage feedback corrects the coarse prediction and fills residual gaps at finer scales, and a lightweight geometric projection enforces validity.
