Averaged over the test set, a single-GPU implementation of ML-IST reduces mean leaf-generation time by a factor of $2.0$--$2.6$ over single-core CPU construction across target capacities of 64--512 spheres, and qualitative results on complex models show multiscale sphere distributions that follow principal volumes and slender features. We further integrate ML-IST into the Jolt Physics and Bullet engines; in an alpha-puzzle benchmark it reaches 55.89~FPS, the highest among the compared representations (conventional IST, GImpact, and convex decomposition). These results support learned leaf generation as a practical component for fast, runtime construction of detailed collision representations.

</details>


### [776] [A Group-Aware Comparative Study of Classical Machine Learning and Deep Learning Methods for Sensor-Based Human Activity Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23941)
*Wahyu Pebrianto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究在UCI-HAR与KU-HAR两个公开数据集上，对4种经典机器学习与4种深度学习模型进行受控对比，考察传感器模态（ACC、GYRO、ACC+GYRO）与数据划分策略（受试者分组 vs 随机划分）对HAR性能的影响，以Macro-F1为主指标。结果表明深度学习并未稳定优于经典方法：UCI-HAR上略优，KU-HAR上LightGBM达0.857，高于最佳深度学习模型的0.828；ACC+GYRO组合整体最优；随机划分会显著高估性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HAR文献报告的性能易受传感器模态、数据集特性与数据划分策略影响，缺乏在统一协议下的受控比较，导致不同研究间结论难以横向对比，也容易因随机划分造成数据泄漏而高估模型能力。

Method: 在两个公开数据集（UCI-HAR、KU-HAR）上对比4种经典机器学习与4种深度学习模型；设置ACC、GYRO、ACC+GYRO三种模态；经典模型使用手工统计特征，深度学习模型直接处理原始传感器序列；主评估采用五折StratifiedGroupKFold，按受试者分组以避免训练/测试折间群体重叠；以Macro-F1为主要指标，并额外比较随机划分与分组划分的差异。

Result: 深度学习未稳定优于经典机器学习：UCI-HAR上深度学习模型Macro-F1略高；KU-HAR上LightGBM为0.857，高于表现最佳的深度学习模型0.828。ACC+GYRO组合在两个数据集上总体优于单一模态。评估协议影响显著：CNNBiLSTMAttn在ACC+GYRO下，随机划分相比分组评估使Macro-F1在UCI-HAR上提高0.033、在KU-HAR上提高0.093。

Conclusion: 评估传感器HAR系统时，模型族、传感器模态、数据集特性与群体感知（group-aware）评估协议均对结论有实质影响；随机划分会因受试者信息泄漏而系统性高估性能，未来研究应采用受试者分组交叉验证并明确报告模态配置。

Abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using wearable or smartphone inertial sensors is commonly evaluated with both classical machine learning and deep learning methods. However, reported performance can be strongly affected by sensor modality, dataset characteristics, and data-splitting strategy. This study presents a controlled comparative evaluation of four classical machine learning models and four deep learning models on two public HAR datasets, UCI-HAR and KU-HAR. Three sensor modalities were considered: accelerometer (ACC), gyroscope (GYRO), and their combination (ACC+GYRO). Classical machine learning models used handcrafted statistical features, while deep learning models operated directly on raw sensor sequences. The primary evaluation employed five-fold StratifiedGroupKFold cross-validation, with subject- or participant-level grouping to prevent group overlap between training and test folds. Macro-F1 was used as the primary performance metric. The results show that deep learning did not consistently outperform classical machine learning. On UCI-HAR, the evaluated deep learning models achieved slightly higher macro-F1 values, whereas on KU-HAR, LightGBM achieved 0.857 compared with 0.828 for the highest-performing evaluated deep learning model. Regarding sensor modality, the combined ACC+GYRO configuration generally outperformed ACC or GYRO alone on both datasets. The evaluation protocol also had a substantial effect: for CNNBiLSTMAttn with ACC+GYRO, random splitting increased macro-F1 by 0.033 on UCI-HAR and 0.093 on KU-HAR compared with grouped evaluation. These findings highlight the importance of model family, sensor modality, dataset characteristics, and group-aware evaluation when assessing sensor-based HAR systems.

</details>


### [777] [ReTTT: Reflection-Driven Test-Time Training via Experience-Based Parametric Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23942)
*Kangcong Li,Hangfan Zhang,Shuyue Hu,Shengji Tang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReTTT 让 LLM 智能体在多轮任务执行中反思交互反馈、在显式记忆中维护"教训"，并通过在 episode 内更新局部 LoRA 适配器（骨干冻结）实现经验驱动的自我适应，且适配后的模型同时负责后续动作与反思。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体在多轮任务执行中通过动作、观测与环境反馈积累了大量任务相关信息，可用于改进后续决策；但单个交互的学习价值依赖于其上下文与后续反馈，因而难以从中提取可靠、可行动的"教训"，也难以随任务推进不断修订。现有方法（如基于轨迹的 test-time training）在经验提炼与动态修正上存在不足。

Method: 提出 ReTTT：1）智能体对交互反馈进行反思，将生成的"教训"存入显式记忆；2）基于这些教训在 episode 内进行 test-time training，更新 episode-local LoRA 适配器，骨干模型保持冻结；3）适配后的模型同时执行后续动作与反思，从而将策略适配与未来学习经验的构建耦合起来，实现教训的持续修订。

Result: 在 ALFWorld、ScienceWorld、SWE-bench Lite 三个基准、两个模型家族共六种"模型–基准"设置上，ReTTT 全部优于基于轨迹的 test-time training，任务成功率最高提升 12.14 个百分点；冻结反思（frozen-reflection）对比实验显示，对反思策略进行适配带来 7.14 个百分点的增益；轨迹分析表明适配后的反思能从失败尝试中提炼出更具任务特异性的指导。

Conclusion: 结果表明，"学会反思自身行为"可显著提升智能体在长时序任务上的表现，验证了将经验驱动的策略适配与反思能力共同学习这一思路的有效性。

Abstract: LLM agents accumulate valuable task-specific information through their actions, observations, and environmental feedback during multi-turn task execution. When effectively used, this information can help agents refine subsequent decisions and improve task performance. However, the learning value of an interaction depends on its context and subsequent feedback, making it challenging to extract reliable, actionable lessons and revise them as the task unfolds. In this paper, we introduce ReTTT, which enables experience-driven self-adaptation through test-time training on lessons constructed and continually revised within an episode. ReTTT lets the agent reflect on interaction feedback, maintain the resulting lessons in an explicit memory, and learn from them by updating an episode-local LoRA adapter while keeping the backbone frozen. The adapted model then performs both subsequent actions and reflection, coupling policy adaptation with the construction of future learning experience. We evaluate ReTTT on ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and SWE-bench Lite using two model families. ReTTT outperforms trajectory-based test-time training across all six model--benchmark settings, improving task success by up to 12.14 percentage points. A frozen-reflection comparison further shows a 7.14-point benefit from adapting the reflection policy, while trajectory analysis illustrates how adapted reflection derives more task-specific guidance from failed attempts. These findings suggest that learning to reflect on its own behavior can boost agents' performance on long-horizon tasks.

</details>


### [778] [How Data Scales in Agentic Reinforcement Learning: Laws and Synthesis Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23946)
*Bowei He,Yankai Chen,Xiaokun Zhang,Changjiang Han,Ye Yuan,Chong Li,Xue Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将智能体强化学习的数据从“token数量”这一标量抽象扩展为任务、环境、轨迹三轴结构，拟合各轴缩放律，并用其指导合成预算分配，提出类似Chinchilla的计算最优配方。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练缩放律仅用一维token数刻画数据，而智能体RL的合成流水线分别以极不同成本独立生成任务、环境与轨迹，使数据成为结构化设计空间。由此产生预训练从未面对的问题：给定合成预算，应扩展哪一轴？

Method: ①将智能体数据分解为任务、环境、轨迹三个基数轴及奖励密度控制变量，在数学+代码、SWE、Web、UI/工具应用等域及不同规模与家族LLM上拟合逐轴缩放关系（PPO与GRPO）；将环境多样性进一步拆为世界多样性与环境结构多样性。②以拟合律作为统一标尺为合成方法定价，用逐轴折扣因子刻画其效率，并识别合成/真实临界比例。③将预算分配形式化为约束优化，推导Chinchilla式计算最优配方并在留出规模上验证。

Result: 在所有测试的模型规模、模型家族、领域与RL算法下，缩放指数排序一致为环境>任务>轨迹；环境多样性优势主要来自世界多样性，环境结构多样性仅与任务多样性相当。临界合成/真实比例在不同轴间相差一个数量级。按该配方分配预算相比主流的“扩展轨迹”做法可获得最高1.7倍计算效率。

Conclusion: 智能体RL的数据应按结构化轴分别建模与定价，环境轴（尤其世界多样性）是优先扩展方向；基于逐轴缩放律与合成方法折扣的约束优化可给出可迁移的计算最优预算配方。

Abstract: Pretraining scaling laws treat training data as a one-dimensional quantity: a token count. Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) inherits this scalar abstraction, but modern synthesis pipelines now generate \textit{tasks}, \textit{environments}, and \textit{trajectories} independently and at very different costs, turning data into a structured design space. This raises a question pretraining never had to answer: given a synthesis budget, \textit{which axis} should be scaled? We address this question end-to-end with three tightly coupled contributions. First, we decompose agentic data into three cardinality axes (task, environment, trajectory), plus a reward-density control variable, and fit per-axis scaling relations on different large language models (LLMs) across math+code, SWE, web, and UI/tool application domains. Across all model sizes, model families, domains, and RL algorithms (PPO and GRPO) we measured, the scaling exponents order as environment $>$ task $>$ trajectory. When environment diversity is decomposed into world and environment-structure diversity, its advantage is mainly driven by the former, while the latter is just comparable to the task diversity. Second, we use the fitted laws as a common ruler to price synthesis methods, capturing each method's efficiency as a per-axis discount factor and identifying critical synthetic-to-real ratios at which collapse begins; these ratios differ by an order of magnitude across axes. Third, we cast budget allocation as a constrained optimization under our laws and discounts, deriving a Chinchilla-style compute-optimal recipe and validating it at held-out scale. The empirical results demonstrate that following the recipe yields up to $1.7\times$ compute efficiency over the dominant ``scale-the-trajectories'' practice.

</details>


### [779] [Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23948)
*David McShannon,Nicholas Dietrich*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出利用冻结的PINN单次评估、无需重训练即可从残差中最小二乘估计编码参数，并用归一化残差ρ量化其可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PINN以最小化方程残差为训练目标，低训练损失并不能指示方程中某系数是否被错误指定，因此需评估仅凭已训练网络能推断出关于所编码参数的何种信息。

Method: 当残差对参数线性（A−νB）时，用最小二乘估计ν̂=AᵀB/BᵀB，由冻结网络单次评估得到，无需重训练或参考数据；以归一化残差ρ衡量网络满足自身方程的程度，并采用块自助法标准误构造单模型检验；在36个对流-扩散网络、Burgers方程及Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos方程上进行验证。

Result: 恢复误差与ρ呈对数-对数相关0.72，三个方程的经验指数0.63–1.20可分解为1/2加可测的角向项；Burgers方程中该检验在300个正确设定模型上误报3个（1%），在实用预算下检出全部2%错设，收敛后检出三分之二的1%错设；对CCF自相似爆破率（同时进入架构），仅恢复约一半错设，但ρ近似二次增长并区分0.2%误差；当速率同时进入方程与架构时，2%以内的误差在现有精度下未被检出；实用预算下错设模型原始损失可能更低，而ρ不受此缩放效应影响。

Conclusion: 冻结网络的单次评估结合ρ可对编码参数的正确性提供可量化的诊断，ρ比原始损失更稳健；但参数同时进入方程与架构时检测能力显著下降。

Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to minimize the residual of a prescribed equation, so a low training loss does not indicate whether a coefficient in that equation was specified incorrectly. This study evaluates what can be inferred about the encoded parameter from the trained network alone. When the residual is linear in the parameter, written as $A - νB$, the least-squares estimate $\hatν = A^{\top}B/B^{\top}B$ is obtained from a single evaluation of the frozen network, without retraining or reference data. Its accuracy depends on how closely the network satisfies its own equation, quantified by a normalized residual $ρ$. Recovery error is associated with $ρ$ (log-log correlation 0.72 across 36 convection-diffusion networks), and empirical exponents of 0.63 to 1.20 across three equations decompose into one half plus a measurable angular term. For Burgers' equation, a single-model test based on a block-bootstrap standard error flagged 3 of 300 correctly specified networks (observed false-alarm rate 1%), all 2% misspecifications at a practical budget, and two thirds of 1% misspecifications after convergence. For the self-similar blowup rate of the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation, where the rate also enters the architecture, the estimator recovers about half of the misspecification, whereas $ρ$ increases approximately quadratically and distinguishes a 0.2% error. When the incorrect rate enters both the equation and the architecture, errors of up to 2% were not detected at the precision reached. At practical budgets, the raw loss can be lower for the misspecified model, a scaling effect that $ρ$ does not share.

</details>


### [780] [DS-Net: A Dynamic Split Network for Edge-Cloud Collaborative Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23949)
*Xinyun Zhang,Li Wang,Lei Jin,Lianming Xu,Zhu Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出动态分割网络DS-Net，在单一模型内实现多分割点灵活切换，并用分层补偿机制缓解动态分割与高压缩导致的特征分布偏移和任务信息损失，显著降低存储与切换开销并提升协同推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边云协同推理方法通过在边缘设备与云服务器之间切分DNN模型实现推理，但当通信条件或设备变化时，需为不同分割点加载不同模型，导致切换时间长、边缘侧存储开销大。

Method: 设计动态切换框架，使单一模型内可在多个分割点间灵活选择，从而降低存储、内存与切换开销；提出分层补偿机制：局部对齐在每个分割点校准解码后的特征分布，任务特定的全局补偿在全局层面恢复任务相关信息；并将基于样本复杂度与运行时资源状况的样本自适应全局补偿选择融入分割点选择。

Result: 内存开销降低74.6%，切换延迟达毫秒级；在Nano平台10 Mbps带宽约束下，于COCO数据集上比SOTA协同方法准确率高1.2%，延迟降低42.5%，吞吐量提升1.8倍。

Conclusion: DS-Net通过单模型多分割点动态切换与分层补偿机制，有效解决了多分割点场景下的存储与切换开销问题，并在精度、延迟和吞吐上全面优于现有协同推理方法。

Abstract: Collaborative inference serves as a critical methodology in edge intelligence. Existing collaborative inference methods operate by splitting the deep neural network (DNN) model between edge devices and cloud servers. However, these methods need to load different models for multiple split points when the communication or device changes, thus resulting in long switching times and substantial storage overhead on the edge side. To address this issue, we propose a Dynamic Split Network (DS-Net), which not only enables efficient split point switching but also enhances the collaborative speed and accuracy across various scenarios. Specifically, we design a dynamic switching framework that enables flexible selection among multiple split points within a single model, thereby reducing storage, memory, and switching overhead. To mitigate the feature distribution shifts and task-relevant information loss caused by dynamic splitting and high-ratio compression, we further propose a hierarchical compensation mechanism. Local alignment calibrates the decoded feature distribution at each split point, while task-specific global compensation restores task-relevant information at the global level. In addition, we incorporate sample-adaptive global compensation selection into split-point selection based on sample complexity and runtime resource conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that DS-Net reduces memory overhead by 74.6% and achieves millisecond-level switching latency. Moreover, under a 10 Mbps bandwidth constraint on the Nano platform, DS-Net outperforms state-of-the-art collaborative methods by achieving 1.2% higher accuracy on the COCO dataset, reducing latency by 42.5%, and improving throughput by a factor of 1.8$\times$.

</details>


### [781] [Compaction-Aware Reinforcement Learning For Ascend Triton Kernel Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23950)
*Chuansai Zhou,Yanlin Liu,Bingning Huang,Shidi Xi,Chao Huang,Boxing Chen,Mingming Zhu,Guanghuan Fang,Ben Feng,Zongzuo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATRL是一种面向长程内核生成的训练后方法，将GRPO改造为压缩感知的分段级目标，配合轻量智能体执行框架与Ascend知识库，在Ascend硬件上于NPUKernelBench和KernelBench上全面超过GRPO等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用LLM智能体自动生成高性能内核能提升开发效率，但存在两大障碍：(1) 多轮与环境交互虽能提升生成质量，但上下文持续累积会迅速超过模型有效上下文窗口；(2) GRPO训练长程任务依赖终局结果评估，奖励稀疏，难以进行步级信用分配。

Method: 提出ATRL（Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning）后训练方法：将GRPO改进为压缩感知（compaction-aware）、分段级（segment-level）的优化目标，用于长程内核生成；并设计轻量智能体执行框架，提供编译、正确性、性能剖析的级联反馈；同时在智能体强化学习训练与评估中注入Ascend专用知识库，以弥补基座模型欠缺的平台知识。

Result: 在Ascend硬件上运行NPUKernelBench与KernelBench的评测显示，ATRL在正确性和加速比两方面均持续优于所有基线（包括GRPO）。

Conclusion: 通过上下文压缩感知的分段级强化学习目标、级联反馈的智能体框架与领域知识注入，可有效缓解长程内核生成中的上下文溢出与奖励稀疏问题，实现优于标准GRPO的内核生成性能。

Abstract: Automatically generating high-performance kernels with LLM-based agents promises substantial gains in development efficiency, but two obstacles remain. First, while increasing multi-turn interaction with execution environments is crucial for refining generation quality, continuous context accumulation rapidly exceeds the model's effective context window. Second, training long-horizon tasks via GRPO inherently incurs sparse rewards due to its reliance on terminal outcome evaluation, severely hindering step-level credit assignment; To address these obstacles, we propose ATRL (Ascend Triton Reinforcement Learning), a post-training method that refines GRPO into a compaction-aware, segment-level objective for long-horizon kernel generation. We also design a lightweight agent harness providing cascaded compilation, correctness, and profiling feedback, alongside an Ascend-specific knowledge base injected during agentic RL training and evaluation to compensate for the base model's missing platform expertise. Evaluations on NPUKernelBench and KernelBench, both executed on Ascend hardware, show that ATRL consistently surpasses all baselines, including GRPO, in both correctness and speedup.

</details>


### [782] [LatLM: Line-Parallel Language Models with Deferred Commitment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23951)
*Shaorong Zhang,Shiyuan Li,Longxuan Yu,Greg Ver Steeg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: LatLM将"提交时序"变为自适应解码选择：在二维网格上逐轮给前沿token打分，仅提交高置信候选、推迟未就绪者，从而在保持并行的同时缓解固定调度导致的过早提交与级联推理错误。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行并行语言模型（如LCLM）采用跨行固定的提交调度，但文本内部依赖强度不一，固定调度无法暂缓前置条件未算出的行，导致过早提交和级联推理错误。

Method: 提出Lattice Language Model（LatLM）：文本置于二维晶格中，每轮对合格前沿token打分；策略提交高置信候选，对未就绪者延迟提交以获得更长上下文；一次前向传播通过二维因果掩码监督整条采样轨迹；附加式（append-only）缓存保留精确状态。

Result: 在482M参数下：（1）顺序解码时，LatLM在留出文本上匹配同数据与同容量的自回归模型；自适应并行解码在独立行任务上以25–41%的解码轮数达到接近自回归的精度。（2）跨行依赖使LCLM固定调度失效时，延迟提交显著提升精度并保留可行处的并行性；混合依赖链上LatLM达96.5%精度，LCLM为78.5%，且解码轮数不足自回归基线的一半。

Conclusion: 将提交调度作为自适应解码时决策，可在不牺牲生成质量的前提下实现并行加速，并在依赖复杂的文本上优于固定调度的行并行方案。

Abstract: Line-parallel language models advance multiple lines concurrently for substantial speedups. However, frameworks like the Line-Coupled Language Model (LCLM) enforce a fixed commitment schedule across lines. Because dependencies vary within text, a fixed schedule cannot hold back a line whose prerequisites remain uncomputed, forcing premature commitments and cascading reasoning errors. To address this limitation, we introduce the Lattice Language Model (LatLM), making commitment schedules an adaptive decoding-time choice. Text occupies a 2D lattice where eligible frontier tokens are scored each round; a policy commits confident candidates while deferring unready ones for extended context. One forward pass supervises entire sampled trajectories via 2D causal masking, while an append-only cache retains exact states. At 482M parameters, we establish two findings. (1) LatLM matches a data- and capacity-matched autoregressive model on held-out text when decoded sequentially, while its adaptive parallel decoder achieves near-autoregressive accuracy on independent-line tasks using 25--41% as many decoding rounds. (2) When cross-line dependencies cause LCLM's fixed schedule to fail, deferred commitment substantially improves accuracy while retaining parallelism where dependencies permit. On mixed dependency chains, LatLM achieves 96.5% accuracy versus LCLM's 78.5%, using fewer than half the decoding rounds of the autoregressive baseline.

</details>


### [783] [DISCERN: Identifiable Disease Evidence for Generalizable Medical Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23952)
*Xiaoguang Zhu,Pengyi Jiang,Juncen Guo,Jingyi Wu,Lianlong Sun,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究临床多模态模型中的"入组捷径"（enrollment shortcut）问题：模型会学到跨模态共享的入组相关信号，导致在新队列上失效。作者提出潜结构因果模型刻画数据生成，证明在给定偏移族下可识别一个最小选择统计量并通过对其条件化消除入组依赖证据，进而提出DISCERN模型，在合成与真实跨库实验中显著提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床多模态模型中存在跨模态共享的入组捷径，使模型在新队列（不同选择与测量机制）上泛化失败。需要在不可观测疾病状态标签、也无法恢复完整因果模型的条件下，识别与入组无关的疾病证据。

Method: 构建潜结构因果模型：疾病状态与背景因素经共享机制生成生理信号，队列差异源于选择与测量。固定采集条件下，在常见高斯坐标中，利用跨队列状态对齐与自然参数变化识别最小选择统计量；对其条件化得到可识别的参考后验。基于此提出DISCERN：信息格编码器+潜状态模型+结局头联合训练，保留跨模态交互信息。

Result: 在已知潜坐标的反转合成入组实验中，条件化使状态AUROC从0.043升至0.883、从0.265升至0.825，而随机条件化无效；eICU与MIMIC-IV跨库死亡率实验较匹配的ERM基线AUROC分别提升0.036与0.035。

Conclusion: 对最小选择统计量条件化可去除入组依赖证据，得到可识别的参考后验；状态依赖交互携带单模态后验不可见的证据，支持联合、保信息的表示；学习坐标诊断可区分"状态信息保留"与"估计器所需坐标的可识别性"。

Abstract: Clinical multimodal models can learn enrollment shortcuts shared across modalities and fail on new cohorts. We model these data through a latent structural causal model: disease state and background factors generate physiology through shared mechanisms, while cohorts differ in selection and measurement. Holding acquisition fixed, we identify conditional disease evidence without observing disease-state labels or recovering the full causal model. In common Gaussian coordinates, cross-cohort state alignment and natural-parameter changes identify a minimal selection statistic; conditioning on it removes enrollment-dependent evidence and yields an identifiable reference posterior within the specified shift family. State-dependent interactions can carry evidence invisible to individual-modality posteriors, motivating joint, information-preserving representations. DISCERN combines an information-lattice encoder, a latent-state model, and an outcome head through joint training. Under reversed synthetic enrollment on known latent coordinates, conditioning raises state AUROC from 0.043 to 0.883 and from 0.265 to 0.825, while random conditioning does not. Exploratory cross-database mortality experiments between eICU and MIMIC-IV improve AUROC over matched empirical risk minimization by 0.036 and 0.035. Learned-coordinate diagnostics distinguish preservation of state information from identification of the coordinates required by the estimator.

</details>


### [784] [Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23955)
*Charalampos Davalas,Georgios Levantinos,Anastasios Dimitriou,Nikolaos Papanikolaou,Georgios Th. Papadopoulos,Dimitrios Michail*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的多域自监督学习框架，结合物理感知目标（掩码强度重建+可微Voigt峰型稀疏解码器+去噪目标），从异质拉曼光谱数据中学习可迁移表征，并在线性探针、注意力探针、端到端微调与从零训练四种评估范式下验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拉曼光谱产生大量难以用传统监督学习利用的无标注数据；现有方法缺乏跨生物、化学、法医、材料等异质数据域的通用、可迁移表征学习手段，且表征质量的常规评估方式可能低估编码器潜力。

Method: 构建多域自监督预训练框架：以MAE为主体，预训练目标融合三类约束——(1) 掩码强度重建；(2) 物理感知的稀疏Voigt峰型解码器，通过可微的峰中心、峰宽、峰幅建模谱峰结构；(3) 去噪目标以提升对光谱扰动的鲁棒性。下游评估涵盖物质分类、组分识别、浓度估计与光谱去噪，采用线性探针、注意力探针、端到端微调和从零训练四种范式。

Result: 自监督预训练在标注数据有限的困难任务上收益最大；注意力探针从冻结表征中挖掘的信息显著多于线性探针，说明常规线性评估可能低估表征质量；预训练收益随编码器容量增大而更明显。

Conclusion: 物理感知的多域自监督预训练能够提升拉曼光谱多类任务中的标签效率、鲁棒性与跨域迁移性，并为表征评估方式的选择提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

</details>


### [785] [UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23960)
*Chengying Tu,Hengyu Zhao,Shuaikang Xue,Zhongming Qu,Jihao Zhou,Xinle Lin,Junshao Guo,Zixuan Fu,Qiang Ma,Jie Zhou,Chaojun Xiao,Hongfei Yan,Yudong Wang,Xu Han,Zhiyuan Liu,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出UltraData-Code分层数据管理体系（L0-L3四层数据状态），以算法相关筛选与小数据池精细化处理替代单纯语料扩张，在1B模型持续预训练中显著提升代码能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量公开代码数据获取日益困难，代码生成能力提升不能再依赖语料规模扩张，需要对更小的数据池施加更精准的分层处理，以匹配不同训练目标。

Method: 构建四级递进数据状态：L0保留仓库原始数据与溯源信息以便再处理；L1做可扩展过滤、规范化与近似去重，服务广泛预训练；L2用语言自适应的相关性信号与质量约束筛选高质量算法相关文件，得约400B tokens（11种语言），用于聚焦式持续预训练；L3将筛选实现转为结构化编程题，得约150B tokens，用于任务导向的中训练或SFT。以1B模型、10B tokens持续预训练做受控实验。

Result: L2相对L1在EvalPlus上pass@1提升7.80pp、MultiPL-E上提升5.13pp；将一半L2训练token替换为L3后，两基准再分别提升8.42pp和8.07pp；训练预算扩至100B tokens时增益进一步扩大。

Conclusion: 分层数据管理能有效以更小数据池获得更优代码能力，任务导向的合成数据与算法筛选具有互补收益且随训练规模增益递增；已开源数据集与分类器以支持后续研究。

Abstract: Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.

</details>


### [786] [SPADE-KD: Peer-to-Peer Collaborative Learning under Heterogeneous Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24013)
*Harikrishna Kuttivelil,Katia Obraczka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPADE-KD 是一个完全去中心化的模型蒸馏框架，通过自适应蒸馏与效用驱动的对等节点选择，在模型架构与数据分布双重异构环境下实现面向个性化的协同学习，性能优于朴素去中心化蒸馏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对等协同学习可消除中心聚合器的单点故障与瓶颈，但现有方法存在三类局限：(1) 参数平均要求客户端模型架构同构；(2) 基于知识蒸馏的方法依赖共享公开数据或集中式控制设施；(3) 普遍假设"一刀切"地联合训练单一全局最优解，而客户端底层数据分布差异可能导致全局最优解对部分客户端并非局部最优。因此需要一种在架构异构与数据异构下均可行、且面向个性化的去中心化协同学习方案。

Method: 提出 SPADE-KD，全去中心化模型蒸馏框架，包含两个机制：1) 自适应蒸馏——以传入模型相对本地模型在本方数据上的任务损失优势来调制每次模型迁移的强度，性能优势越大则蒸馏越激进；2) 效用驱动的对等节点选择——利用自适应蒸馏所得损失信息的效用来排序潜在伙伴，聚焦于可测量地提升本地模型的交换，抑制低效用传输。

Result: 在联邦分类任务上，SPADE-KD 相比朴素去中心化蒸馏取得更低损失与更快收敛，且两个组件协同使用时优于各自独立使用。

Conclusion: SPADE-KD 表明，在模型架构与数据分布异构的去中心化环境中，以效用为导向的自适应蒸馏与节点选择能够有效支持个性化协同学习，无需中心节点或共享数据，且组件间具有正向协同效应。

Abstract: Peer-to-peer collaborative learning is an emerging distributed deep learning paradigm that eliminates the need for a central aggregator and disseminator, avoiding the single-point-of-failure and bottleneck issues they can bring. Many such approaches use parameter averaging, requiring clients to have homogeneous model architectures, whereas others use knowledge distillation as an alternative while leaning on shared public data or centralized control infrastructure. Many of these approaches also make a one-size-fits-all assumption, i.e., jointly training a single, globally optimal solution for all clients, when in reality, clients' underlying data distributions might differ such that a globally optimal solution may not be locally optimal for all clients. To enable collaborative learning in environments with both model architecture and data distribution heterogeneity, we present SPADE-KD -- a fully decentralized model distillation framework that optimizes collaboration towards personalized rather than global performance. SPADE-KD leverages two mechanisms -- adaptive distillation and utility-driven peer selection. Adaptive distillation modulates the strength of each incoming model transfer by the performance advantage of the incoming model compared to the native model measured by their task losses, such that a client will distill more aggressively from incoming models that outperform it on its own local data. Utility-driven peer selection uses the loss-informed utility derived from adaptive distillation to rank prospective partners, focusing on exchanges that measurably improve the local model while suppressing low-utility transfers. Using federated classification tasks, we demonstrate that SPADE-KD consistent outperforms naive decentralized distillation with lower loss and faster convergence and that its individual components are more effective together than independently.

</details>


### [787] [TWIN-MoE: Two-stage Intra-Expert Imputation Network for Incomplete Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24014)
*Liang Nathan Zheng,Jiyuan Liu,Wenhao Liang,Wei Emma Zhang,Weitong Chen,Lin Yue*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出TWIN，一个两阶段的专家内插补（intra-expert imputation）框架，用于处理缺失模态问题。第一阶段在编码器嵌入空间生成上下文条件估计并用FIFO队列统计做径向软裁剪；第二阶段在MoE之后聚合同一样本内的专家条件已观测表示。理论分析表明路由诱导的专家条件邻域若比全局空间更紧致，则最坏情况重建界更紧。在四个基准上取得SOTA且参数更少。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MoE方法处理缺失模态存在两类缺陷：按缺失模式分配专用专家（随模态数增长规模扩展性差），或从多专家表示插补缺失模态（需昂贵的检索机制）。作者希望在不增加专家数量、不依赖检索的前提下获得更紧的插补误差界。

Method: 先理论证明路由会诱导专家条件表示邻域，并推导由局部特征离散度控制插补误差的界；当这些邻域比全局表示空间更紧致时，专家内聚合的最坏情况重建界优于无约束全局聚合。据此设计两阶段框架TWIN：(1) 预插补——在编码器嵌入空间生成上下文条件估计，并利用观测FIFO队列维护的模态特定统计量做径向软裁剪，使预插补模态落于目标模态空间的经验校准区域；(2) 后插补——在MoE之后，聚合同一样本内专家条件的已观测表示以精化缺失表示。

Result: 在四个缺失模态基准上，覆盖自然、随机与非对称丢弃协议，TWIN达到state-of-the-art性能，同时参数量显著少于竞争的基于MoE的插补方法。

Conclusion: 路由诱导的局部紧致性为专家内插补提供了理论依据，TWIN以两阶段设计（校准的预插补+专家内后插补）在性能与参数效率上同时占优，避免了专家规模膨胀与昂贵检索。

Abstract: Recent Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) approaches address missing modalities either by routing each missingness pattern to a dedicated expert, which scales poorly as the number of modalities grows, or by imputing the missing modality from representations contributed by multiple experts, which requires a costly retrieval mechanism. We show that routing induces expert-conditioned representation neighborhoods and derive an imputation-error bound controlled by their local feature dispersion. When these expert-conditioned neighborhoods are more compact than the global representation space, intra-expert aggregation admits a tighter worst-case reconstruction bound than unconstrained global aggregation. Guided by this analysis, we propose TWIN, a two-stage intra-expert imputation framework. Pre-imputation generates a context-conditioned estimate in the encoder embedding space and radially soft-clips it using modality-specific statistics maintained in an observed FIFO queue, this ensures that the pre-imputed modality stays in empirically calibrated region of the target modality space. Post-imputation refines the missing representation after MoE by aggregating expert-conditioned observed representations within the same sample. Across four missing-modality benchmarks under natural, random, and asymmetric dropout protocols, TWIN achieves state-of-the-art performance while using substantially fewer parameters than competing MoE-based imputation methods.

</details>


### [788] [Dynamical Kernel Attention: Estimating the Present from a Record of the Past](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24026)
*Peter Racioppo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA)，用随机动力学下潜状态(隐状态)的稳健估计来推导注意力权重，从而刻画过去状态对当前保留的信息量；保持并行结构与标准注意力计算代价，含理论保证，实验待补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准自注意力仅按相似度比较token，未考虑过去状态在时间演化中“存活”到当下的程度，因此无法区分证据强弱、也缺乏丢弃旧token时的误差保障。

Method: 将注意力建模为对服从随机动力学的潜在状态的稳健估计；由状态向平衡态衰减的性质推导注意力权重，使旧状态携带的关于当前的信息量随时间消失，从而限制单个head可获取的总证据；结构上保持与标准注意力一致的并行形式与计算开销。

Result: 理论上给出：注意力证据总量随衰减而被限定；与单纯recency偏置不同，DKA可在相关证据弱时“弃权”(abstain)；丢弃旧token时有界误差保证。本文为模型与理论版本，尚无实证结果。

Conclusion: DKA为注意力提供了信息存活视角的概率/动力学解释，在保持标准注意力效率的同时给出弃权与截断误差的理论保障；经验评估留待后续版本验证。

Abstract: Standard self-attention compares tokens by similarity but does not account for how much of a past state survives to the present. We introduce Dynamical Kernel Attention (DKA), which derives attention from robust estimation of a latent state evolving under stochastic dynamics. As a past state decays toward equilibrium under the dynamics, the information it carries about the present vanishes, bounding the total evidence a head can draw. Unlike recency biases, DKA can abstain when relevant evidence is weak and guarantees a bounded error when old tokens are discarded. DKA preserves the parallel structure and computational cost of standard attention. We present the model and its theory; empirical evaluation is deferred to a subsequent version.

</details>


### [789] [Do Knowledge and Reasoning Oriented Benchmarks Induce Stable Representation Signatures in LLMs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24029)
*Parsa Rahimi,Azim Dehghani Amirabad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究在5个7B–31B模型上检验"知识/推理"标签是否对应可复用的内部签名：以任务为推断单元、跨任务置换标签并重选层与流，原始探针虽能恢复MMLU八对八划分（macro-F1 0.78–0.81），但文本基线几乎同等预测，激活优势仅0.017–0.070且不显著；词法校正后显著性消失，最优位点随任务面板与选择规则变化，两条基座训练轨迹也无共同方向。结论：在所测灵敏度下未识别出可迁移的知识/推理签名。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部签名有望支撑监控、自适应计算与机制分析，但基准提示可能仅在表层可分而无共享的计算差异；因此需检验预设的知识/推理标签是否定义了一个可复用的内部签名，并给出可被未来工作复用的检验流程。

Method: 以"任务"而非提示为推断单元：推断探针留出完整任务；在任务间置换标签以打破标签-文本关联；对每个置换重新选择最佳层与残差流。在5个当代7B–31B模型上，比较激活探针与同配置的提示文本基线，并进行词法校正、位点稳定性分析及两条已发布基座训练轨迹的方向一致性检查。

Result: 原始探针在全部5个模型中恢复出MMLU的八对八主题划分（macro-F1 0.78–0.81），但仅凭提示文本的预测几乎同等好：相同探针配置下激活带来的优势仅0.017–0.070 macro-F1且不显著。在预设0.01水平上，词法校正后显著性被消除，而校正后的状态仍能识别个体主题；所选位点随任务面板与选择规则变化；两条基座训练轨迹之间无共同方向。

Conclusion: 这些汇集的逐层度量虽能恢复任务标签，但在所测灵敏度下未识别出可迁移的知识/推理内部签名（不排除中等效应）。其价值在于提供一套由序列化检验构成的协议，供未来的内部监控与干预研究逐项通过。

Abstract: Internal signatures could support monitoring, adaptive computation, and mechanistic analysis, but benchmark prompts can be separable without any shared computational distinction. We test whether a prespecified knowledge/reasoning label defines a reusable internal signature in five contemporary 7B to 31B models. We treat the \textbf{task} as the unit of inference probes hold out complete tasks, labels are permuted across tasks, and the best layer and stream are reselected for every permutation. Raw probes recover an eight-versus-eight-subject MMLU partition in all five models (macro-F1 $0.78$--$0.81$), but prompt text predicts it nearly as well: under an identical probe configuration, the activation advantage is only $0.017$--$0.070$ macro-F1 and is not significant. At the prespecified $0.01$ level, lexical adjustment removes significance while the adjusted states still identify individual subjects, and the selected site changes across task panels and selection rules. Additionally, two released base-training trajectories show no common direction. These pooled layerwise measures recover the task label but identify no transferable knowledge/reasoning signature at the tested sensitivity, which cannot exclude moderate effects. The resulting protocol gives future internal monitors and intervention studies a sequence of tests to pass. Project page: \url{https://parsa-ra.github.io/lmbehave/}.

</details>


### [790] [Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking: Retrieval-Weighted Credit Assignment for Reinforcement Learning from Delayed Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24032)
*Prathap Selvakumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking (VCBM)，在两个场景中把信用集中分配到决定episode回报的决策点：低维全观测延迟奖励任务中精确还原因果结构并显著加快收敛；语言智能体AppWorld中结合结构启发式与情景记忆检索、与LOOP优势混合，在计算受限下提升任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于单一轨迹级回报训练的RL智能体存在信用分配问题：奖励在决策后多步才到达时，所有动作获得相同信号，与因果责任无关。作者希望将信用集中到真正决定回报的决策点上。

Method: VCBM的两个实例化：(1) 全观测低维MDP（延迟奖励手表维修任务）：统计式地发现智能体因果可控的状态分量，并直接估计每个决策点的动作值，与真值和RUDDER（LSTM基线）对比；(2) 部分观测的语言场景：AppWorld中用LOOP训练LLM智能体，因果发现不可行时以结构启发式（改变状态的工具调用）替代，信用通过情景记忆检索分配并与LOOP优势混合。

Result: (1) VCBM在20个种子上平均1,532.3个episode达到95.07%正确决策率，RUDDER收敛更慢且波动更大（平均3,327.1个episode；p<0.001）；所有种子中发现的因果结构与真值完全一致。(2) 相同Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/LoRA/FSDP2配置下200次迭代：VCBM混合LOOP任务成功率0.354 vs 0.458，降低最终步最大重要性权重，提升token效率，仅KL略逊于LOOP。

Conclusion: 手表维修结果支持"对因果相关步骤加权比无差别基线或学习式回报重分配网络更具样本效率"；AppWorld结果受2-GPU预算限制、每臂仅一个种子，属于更难的自然语言规模下的计算受限演示，而非统计性验证。

Abstract: RL agents trained on a single trajectory-level return face a credit-assignment problem: when a reward arrives many steps after the decision that caused it, every action gets the same signal regardless of causal responsibility. This paper studies Visual Causal-chain Bookmarking (VCBM), which concentrates credit on the decision points that determine an episode's return, via two instantiations. The first targets a fully observed, low-dimensional MDP (a delayed-reward watch-repair task), where VCBM statistically discovers which state components the agent causally controls and estimates per-decision-point action values directly, evaluated against ground truth and RUDDER, an LSTM-based baseline. VCBM converges to 95.07% correct decisions in a mean of 1,532.3 episodes across 20 seeds, versus RUDDER's slower, more variable convergence (mean 3,327.1 episodes; p<0.001); VCBM's discovered causal structure exactly matches ground truth in all seeds. The second targets a partially observed, language-based setting: an LLM agent trained with Leave-One-Out PPO (LOOP) in AppWorld, where causal discovery is intractable and a structural heuristic (state-mutating tool calls) substitutes for it, with credit distributed via retrieval over episodic memory and blended with LOOP's advantage. Over 200 iterations on identical Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct/LoRA/FSDP2 configurations, VCBM-blended LOOP improves task success over plain LOOP (0.354 vs. 0.458), reduces final-step max importance weight, and improves token efficiency, with a small KL exception favouring LOOP. The watch-repair result supports the claim that weighting causally relevant steps is more sample-efficient than an undifferentiated baseline or a learned return-redistribution network; the AppWorld result, limited to one seed per arm by a 2-GPU budget, is a compute-limited demonstration at a harder, natural-language scale, not a statistical confirmation.

</details>


### [791] [What Remains Without Test Labels? Re-evaluating a Graph-Level Anomaly Detection Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24045)
*Yujie Lu,Da Yan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文审计UB-GOLD及其余14个GLAD代码库，发现测试标签被用于模型选择（检查点/超参数），会系统性高估图级异常检测性能；建议以无标签选择结果作为主比较并释放逐次运行输出以便验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图级异常检测器仅在正常图上训练，但已有基准（UB-GOLD及其后续复用工作）可能在模型选择中使用了测试标签，从而威胁"无标签检测"结论的可信度；作者因此系统检验这些结果是否成立。

Method: 审计UB-GOLD与14个GLAD代码库的模型选择流程；在UB-GOLD的划分上以"使用/不使用测试标签"两套选择规则重跑21个检测器；进行置换分析（无可真正更优检查点时选择噪声测试评估最优值）；对比测试标签调参与默认超参数；并用已知结构性变化（如保尺寸的组成变化）做敏感性测试。

Result: UB-GOLD共享训练循环用测试标签选检查点，14个代码库中8个用测试标签选检查点或超参数，UB-GOLD核基线还与错位标签比较。九个数据集上，按测试AUROC选检查点使12个UB-GOLD检测器相对最终检查点平均提升5.12 AUROC点[3.97,6.24]，相对留出正常图提升4.13[3.32,4.79]；纯噪声置换分析也能获得超过最终检查点增益一半的"提升"；测试标签调参再增1.53点[0.64,2.42]。采用调参+无标签选检查点后，最强两个检测器仍保持领先，但其下排名较不稳定。8个检测器中有6个在样本外漏检graphlet计数可识别的保尺寸组成变化。

Conclusion: 现有图级异常检测基准的领先幅度部分源于测试标签泄漏，结论稳健性有限。建议将无测试标签选择的結果作为主要比较，并公开逐次运行输出以支持无需重训的验证。

Abstract: Graph-level anomaly detectors are trained only on normal graphs, yet benchmarks may use test labels for model selection. We examine whether UB-GOLD results reused by later papers support label-free detection. We audit UB-GOLD and 14 GLAD code bases, re-run 21 detectors on UB-GOLD's folds under selection rules with and without test labels, and evaluate sensitivity to known structural changes. Test labels select checkpoints in UB-GOLD's shared training loop and checkpoints or hyperparameters in 8 of the 14 code bases. UB-GOLD also evaluates its kernel baselines against misaligned labels. Across nine datasets, selecting checkpoints by test AUROC adds an average of 5.12 AUROC points [3.97, 6.24] for the 12 UB-GOLD detectors relative to the final checkpoint and 4.13 [3.32, 4.79] relative to held-out normal graphs. In a post hoc permutation analysis with no truly better checkpoint, picking the best of noisy test evaluations still yields a gain more than half as large as the one observed against the final checkpoint. Configurations tuned on test labels score a further 1.53 points [0.64, 2.42] above repository defaults, a gap that mixes the value of test labels with that of tuning itself. With tuned hyperparameters and label-free checkpoint selection, the two strongest detectors retain their lead, while comparisons below them are less stable. Six of eight detectors evaluated out of sample miss size-preserving composition changes that graphlet counts detect. We recommend reporting results selected without test labels as the main comparisons and release per-run outputs that allow verification without retraining.

</details>


### [792] [Alliance of Stochastic Routing and Reinforcement Fusion for Multi-Model Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24054)
*Selim Furkan Tekin,Ling Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: VL-Scout 提出统一的视觉-语言框架，用贝叶斯不确定性先验、KL 正则化策略梯度路由与回合式强化融合策略（GRPO/RLVR）来解决多模态模型路由中的探索不足与过早收敛问题，在四个多模态基准上稳定优于11个基线并缓解策略崩溃。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态场景下系统需在多模型间选择与组合以回答查询；标准强化学习路由因奖励噪声大、探索不足，易过早收敛到次优模型（premature policy collapse），且缺乏对模型质量认知不确定性的建模。

Method: 三层设计：(1) 上下文相关的 Dirichlet 信念模型，对模型质量维持认知不确定性，依据观测奖励与上下文证据在线更新，提供 Thompson 式探索并作为正则先验；(2) 路由策略以 KL 正则的 REINFORCE 目标训练，通过最大化奖励加权证据下界（ELBO）实现，策略充当摊销后验、Dirichlet 信念充当先验，结合贝叶斯先验、策略梯度与序贯决策进行结构化探索与自适应推理；(3) 融合策略以 GRPO 或 RLVR 训练，在中间模型理据上决定 CONTINUE 或 ANSWER，并以生成输出终止。

Result: 在 MMMU、MMMU-Pro、OKVQA、RealWorldQA 四个多模态基准上，与11个代表性路由与策略优化基线对比，方法取得一致性能提升，同时降低过早策略崩溃的发生。

Conclusion: 将不确定性感知先验与摊销式策略学习、序贯融合相结合，对离散动作空间下稳健且高效的模型选择具有关键作用。

Abstract: This paper studies dynamic model routing under uncertainty in multimodal settings, where a system must select and potentially compose multiple models to answer a query. Standard reinforcement learning approaches for routing often suffer from premature convergence to suboptimal models due to noisy rewards and insufficient exploration. We propose a unified vision-language framework (VL-Scout) for efficient multimodal and multi-step reasoning with turn-based reinforcement fusion. First, VL-Scout combines Bayesian priors, policy gradient optimization, and sequential decision-making to enable structured exploration and adaptive inference. A context-dependent Dirichlet belief model allows for epistemic uncertainty over model quality and is updated online based on observed rewards and context-specific evidence, enabling Thompson-style exploration while serving as a prior for regularization. Second, a routing policy is trained via a KL-regularized REINFORCE objective by maximizing a reward-weighted evidence lower bound, where the policy acts as an amortized posterior, and the Dirichlet belief serves as a prior. Third, we introduce a fusion policy trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) or Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), which operates over intermediate model rationales and selects between two actions: CONTINUE or ANSWER, terminating with a generated output. We evaluate VL-Scout on four representative multi-modal benchmarks (MMMU, MMMU-Pro, OKVQA, and RealWorldQA), compared against 11 representative routing and policy optimization baselines. Our method provides consistent performance improvements while reducing premature policy collapse. These results highlight the importance of integrating uncertainty-aware priors with both amortized policy learning and sequential fusion for robust and efficient model selection in discrete action spaces

</details>


### [793] [GLOW: General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's Method](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24085)
*Matt Higger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出GLOW方法，用Ward层次聚类构建嵌套区域并以置换检验控制FWER，实现对已知范围效应的整体检测，但存在PPV偏低与白噪声下统计功效不足的代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于区域分析会稀释/拆分不恰好填满一个图谱区域的效应；体素分析（簇范围阈值、TFCE）逐体素拟合GLM并聚合相邻显著体素，但相邻体素可能共享统计量而不共享GLM，逐体素统计量无法识别这一情况。

Method: GLOW以贪婪最小化GLM误差构建嵌套区域层级（可证明为Ward聚类的特例）；采用最大统计量Westfall-Young置换检验对所有区域控制族错误率；显著性传播至效应的嵌套片段及包含它的区域；最后通过剪枝步骤寻求完整、纯粹的效应范围。

Result: 在HCP扩散图像与白噪声中植入已知范围、不同强度的合成效应：剪枝带来"完整性"，GLOW在57%的HCP试次中将空间一致的效应返回为单一区域（最佳基线35%），基线虽恢复相当体积但多为碎片。代价是PPV：GLOW灵敏度更高（最多+0.29），但区域常超出效应范围，主因是层级中无区域能孤立该效应而非剪枝。HCP上弱效应时平均Dice较最佳基线+0.059，强效应时−0.005。白噪声上GLOW Dice落后最多0.61：层级包含效应但置换检验未能认证。运行时间随体素数量近似线性增长，全HCP体积约为体素级方法的4.5倍。

Conclusion: GLOW在效应完整性与灵敏度上有优势，但PPV损失可能源于残差空间独立的假设；白噪声下检验功效受限，计算开销显著高于体素级方法。

Abstract: Neuroimaging seeks brain regions whose imaging features correlate with variables of interest (e.g., diagnosis, age), usually via the General Linear Model (GLM). Region-Based Analysis dilutes or splits any effect that does not fill exactly one atlas region. Voxel-Based Analysis, with Cluster Extent Thresholding and Threshold-Free Cluster Enhancement built on it, fits a GLM per voxel and groups adjacent significant voxels. But neighboring voxels can share a statistic without sharing a GLM, which a per-voxel statistic cannot detect.
  GLOW (General Linear Models Optimized with Ward's method) instead builds a hierarchy of nested regions by greedily minimizing GLM error (provably a special case of Ward's clustering). Maximum-statistic (Westfall-Young) permutation controls family-wise error over all regions. Significance spreads to an effect's nested fragments and the regions containing it; a final pruning step seeks whole, pure effect extents.
  We plant synthetic effects of known extent and varying strength in Human Connectome Project (HCP) diffusion images and in white noise. Pruning delivers wholeness: GLOW returns a spatially consistent effect as one region on 57% of HCP trials, the best baseline on 35%; baselines recover comparable volume, but in many pure pieces. The cost is positive predictive value (PPV): GLOW is more sensitive (by up to 0.29), but its regions overrun the effect, mostly because no hierarchy region isolates it, not because of pruning. On HCP, GLOW's mean Dice gains 0.059 over the best baseline at weaker effects and gives back 0.005 at stronger ones.
  On white noise, GLOW trails by up to 0.61 Dice: its hierarchy holds the effect, but its permutation test does not certify it. Runtime grows roughly linearly with voxel count, about 4.5 times the voxel-wise methods' on the full HCP volume. The PPV loss may trace to the assumption of spatially independent residuals.

</details>


### [794] [Looped GNNs Beyond Fixed Depth: Graph Size Generalization and Parameter-Efficient Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24112)
*Zhiyang Wang,Zhishang Luo,Yusu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出looped GNN框架，通过学习局部更新规则并在超出训练深度上重复应用，实现从小图到大图的尺寸泛化，并引入Loop-Freeze-Steer (LFS) 冻结预训练处理器仅学习小型控制器进行适配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从小图泛化到大图所需的计算可能超出训练时神经模型的深度；许多目标任务具有共同的局部迭代计算性质，其有效依赖半径随图规模增长，固定深度模型存在信息传递范围的理论上限。

Method: 将参数共享的架构称为looped GNN，划分六种方案以区分深度扩展、微调与"冻结-引导"适配的效果；理论上刻画固定深度信息极限及准确迭代复用克服该极限的充分条件；提出LFS：冻结预训练处理器，学习小型控制器引导其重复应用，可训练参数远少于全量微调，并给出有限样本分析以说明适配能提升大图性能的充分条件。

Result: 理论分析建立了固定深度信息极限及迭代复用有效的充分条件，以及适配改进大图性能的有限样本充分条件；在合成任务与芯片布局（chip placement）实验中评估了深度扩展和适配效果，验证了LFS在精度与可训练参数之间的权衡优势。

Conclusion: 通过GNN预训练学习局部更新规则并在更大图上重复应用，可作为尺寸泛化的有效手段；LFS以极少可训练参数实现优于未适配复用的性能，在精度—参数效率权衡上具有优势。

Abstract: Generalizing from small graphs to larger ones can require computation beyond the depth of a neural model used during training. We study target tasks that admit a common local iterative computation and whose effective dependency radius grows with graph size. The central idea is to learn a local update rule through GNN pretraining, then repeatedly apply the same learned processor beyond the training depth to extend information reach on larger graphs without retraining. Calling such parameter-shared architecture a \emph{looped GNN}, we categorize six schemes for looped GNNs to separate the effects of depth extension, fine-tuning, and freeze-and-steer adaptation. Our analysis establishes fixed-depth information limits and sufficient conditions under which accurate iterative reuse overcomes them. To improve beyond unadapted reuse, we introduce \emph{Loop-Freeze-Steer} (LFS), which freezes the pretrained processor and learns a small controller to steer its repeated application, using much fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning. Our finite-sample analysis gives sufficient conditions for adaptation to improve performance on larger graphs. Experiments on synthetic tasks and chip placement evaluate depth extension and adaptation, highlighting LFS's accuracy--trainable-parameter trade-off for size generalization.

</details>


### [795] [Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control for Stable Counterfactual Estimation under Donor Redundancy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24113)
*Yanlin Zhang,Sungyong Chung,Alireza Talebpour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出图正则化合成控制（Graph-SC），通过在预处理匹配目标中加入图拉普拉斯惩罚，缓解大而高相关供体池导致的多解、权重不稳定与难解释问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典合成控制法需对未处理供体单元加权以匹配处理单元的处理前结果。近年应用中供体池庞大、高度相关且处理前历史较短，会产生大量近乎等价的解，导致供体权重不稳定且难以解释。

Method: Graph-SC 为凸估计器：在经典处理前匹配目标上叠加图拉普拉斯惩罚，图结构编码供体轨迹间相似性，促使结构相关供体获得连贯权重；理论刻画图正则带来的偏差-方差权衡，并用加速近端梯度法给出高效收敛保证。

Result: 在供体冗余的受控模拟、加州第99号提案基准以及Waymo开放运动数据集上的观察性反事实分析中，Graph-SC 提升了权重稳定性、降低了对冗余供体池的敏感性，并相对经典与正则化合成控制基线保持有竞争力的处理前后精度。

Conclusion: 图正则化的价值不在于普遍提升精度，而在于作为从预处理拟合相当的近等价合成控制中挑选稳定且可解释反事实的原则性机制。

Abstract: Synthetic control methods estimate counterfactual outcomes by weighting untreated donor units to match a treated unit before treatment. In recent applications, however, the donor pool can be large, highly correlated, and short in pre-treatment history, yielding many near-equivalent solutions with unstable and difficult-to-interpret donor weights. We propose Graph-Regularized Synthetic Control (Graph-SC), a convex estimator that augments the classical pre-treatment matching objective with a graph Laplacian penalty. The graph encodes similarity among donor trajectories, encouraging coherent weights over structurally related donors while preserving the transparency of synthetic controls. We provide theoretical results characterizing the bias-variance tradeoff induced by graph regularization and establish efficient convergence guarantees with an accelerated proximal gradient method. Across a controlled simulation under donor redundancy, the California Proposition 99 benchmark, and observational counterfactual analyses on the Waymo Open Motion Dataset, Graph-SC improves weight stability, reduces sensitivity to redundant donor pools, and maintains competitive pre- and post-treatment accuracy relative to classical and regularized synthetic control baselines. Our results suggest that graph regularization is most valuable not as a universal accuracy booster, but as a principled mechanism for selecting stable and interpretable counterfactuals from near-equivalent synthetic controls with comparable pre-treatment fit.

</details>


### [796] [On the Selectivity of Generative Models in Structure-Based Drug Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24124)
*Ella Miray Rajaonson,Jungyoon Lee,William Chau,Alan Aspuru-Guzik,Benjamin Sanchez-Lengeling,Dominique Beaini,Kirill Neklyudov,Marta Skreta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SELECTBENCH，一个用于评估生成式结构药物设计（SBDD）模型选择性的综合基准，包含三类贴近真实场景的评测任务与一套选择性量化指标，并对九个代表性SBDD模型进行系统评测，发现即便专门针对选择性训练的模型也只能实现有限的脱靶判别能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计既能选择性结合靶蛋白、又避免与其他蛋白产生非预期相互作用的小分子药物，对降低临床损耗中的副作用至关重要。尽管深度学习推动了SBDD的快速发展，但受限于训练数据不足与脱靶相互作用未知，多数生成模型仍只优化对单一靶点的结合，忽视选择性，且缺乏统一评估手段。

Method: 构建SELECTBENCH基准，提供三种反映真实药物发现场景的评测任务：基于文献的案例研究、药物开发中使用的安全性筛选面板、以及大规模结构基础评测集；并引入一套量化选择性的指标，对九个代表性SBDD模型（含显式为选择性训练的方法与广泛使用的推理时引导技术）进行系统评估。

Result: 即使经选择性训练的模型也仅获得有限的脱靶判别能力，推理时引导带来的增益有限，说明方法层面仍有较大改进空间。

Conclusion: SELECTBENCH既刻画了当前生成式SBDD在选择性问题上的现状，也提供了一个开放、可扩展的平台以加速相关研究进展，代码已公开。

Abstract: Designing small-molecule drugs that selectively bind to a target protein while avoiding unintended interactions with other proteins is essential for reducing side effects that contribute substantially to clinical attrition. Although structure-based drug design (SBDD) has advanced rapidly with deep learning, most generative models still optimize binding to a single target and disregard selectivity due to limited training data and unknown off-target interactions. Motivated by this gap, we introduce SELECTBENCH, a comprehensive benchmark assessing the selectivity of generative SBDD models. SELECTBENCH provides three curated evaluation tasks reflecting different real-world drug discovery scenarios: literature-based case studies, safety screening panels used in pharmaceutical development, and large-scale structure-based evaluation sets. We further introduce a suite of metrics to quantify selectivity and conduct a systematic evaluation of nine representative SBDD models, including methods explicitly trained for selectivity and widely-used inference-time guidance techniques. Our results show that even selectivity-trained models achieve only modest off-target discrimination and inference-time guidance provides limited gains, underscoring the need for method improvement. SELECTBENCH provides both a characterization of where current generative SBDD stands on selectivity and an open, extensible platform to accelerate progress. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/lovetaro/selectbench.

</details>


### [797] [Data-Driven Resource Aggregation for Scalable Digital Twin and Simulation Model Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24126)
*Yucheng Wu,Alp Akcay*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于逆强化学习的资源选择与聚合方法，从生产事件日志中学习资源的行为价值表征，将功能贡献相似的资源聚合，以简化数字孪生仿真建模，在显著降低模型复杂度的同时保持性能精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业数字化加速使数字孪生广泛应用，但现代制造系统高度动态、频繁重构，人工建模与更新困难。已有的事件日志自动生成仿真模型方法若对每个资源做全粒度建模，会导致不必要的复杂度和计算开销。

Method: 利用逆强化学习思想，从生产事件日志中学习资源的行为价值表征，据此识别并聚合功能贡献相似的资源，实现资源的自动选择与聚合以简化仿真建模。

Result: 在制造系统实验中，以吞吐量和系统时间为性能指标，结果表明当目标是大幅降低复杂度并保持性能精度时，基于价值的资源聚合表现良好。

Conclusion: 基于逆强化学习价值表征的资源聚合能够有效简化数字孪生仿真模型，在复杂度与性能精度之间取得良好权衡。

Abstract: As industrial digitization accelerates, the use of digital twins has become widespread. However, modern manufacturing systems are highly dynamic and frequently reconfigured, making manual model development and updates increasingly difficult. Recent research on automated simulation model generation shows that historical data such as event logs can yield simulation models automatically. However, modeling every resource at full granularity leads to unnecessary complexity and computational cost. We propose a method for automatically selecting and aggregating resources to simplify simulation modeling. Our method uses ideas from inverse reinforcement learning to learn behavioral value representations of resources from production event logs. This process identifies and aggregates resources with similar functional contributions. Experiments on manufacturing systems, using throughput and system time as performance measures, demonstrate that value-based resource aggregation performs well when the goal is to substantially reduce complexity while preserving performance accuracy.

</details>


### [798] [Inside the Loop: A Mechanistic Study of Weight-Tied Transformers on Depth-Bound Algorithmic Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24135)
*Magnus Sesodia,Juil Sock,Philip Torr,Christian Schroeder de Witt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer在每一迭代中逐步推进算法的中间步骤，形成可适应迭代预算的"阶梯"计算；在相同有效深度下，其表现优于未共享权重的Transformer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决多步顺序算法任务通常需要增加Transformer深度（增加参数）或延长思维链（增加推理计算）。循环Transformer通过复用同一组层多次迭代来提升有效深度而不增加参数或token，但每次迭代实际计算什么、循环是否只是模拟更深的非绑定堆叠，仍不清楚。

Method: 研究有向置换遍历任务：模型从起始节点走H跳并报告到达节点，每个中间跳都有已知真值。对比循环Transformer与同等有效深度的非绑定（untied）Transformer，并通过探针与残差流干预，分析中间节点的表示如何随迭代或层数出现。

Result: 存在一个求解所需的最小有效深度；超过该阈值后，权重绑定程度成为决定因素。四层块迭代八次的循环Transformer在所有随机种子下均能求解该任务，而同等有效深度、相同训练方式的非绑定Transformer从未成功，仅在更低学习率或对中间层监督时才成功。探针与干预表明：循环模型逐步经过中间节点，形成随迭代预算自适应的阶梯；非绑定模型在低学习率下仅在最后几层才显露出这些中间节点。

Conclusion: 循环Transformer可被视为迭代式程序学习器，将迭代分配给算法的连续步骤，从而解决同等有效深度、相同训练的非绑定模型无法解决的任务。

Abstract: Solving algorithmic tasks with many sequential steps typically requires scaling up transformer depth or chain-of-thought length, incurring unfavorable parameter and inference-compute costs, respectively. Looped transformers, which reuse one block of layers across many iterations, are poised to address this, since they scale effective depth without adding parameters or tokens. Yet, it remains unclear what each iteration is actually computing, or whether the loop merely simulates a deeper untied stack. Here, we study directed permutation traversal, in which a model follows $H$ hops from a starting node and reports the node it reaches, so every intermediate hop has a known ground truth. We find that a minimum effective depth is necessary to solve the task, beyond which the degree of weight tying becomes the determining factor. For instance, a looped transformer with a four-layer block iterated eight times solves the task in every seed, while an identically-trained untied transformer of the same effective depth never does, succeeding only with a lower learning rate or supervision of its intermediate layers. Probing and intervening on the residual stream, we find that the looped model advances through the intermediate nodes gradually, forming a staircase that adapts to its iteration budget, whereas the untied model, at that lower rate, exposes them only in its final layers. Taken together, our results recast looped transformers as iterative program learners, which allocate their iterations to successive steps of the algorithm and solve tasks that identically-trained untied models of the same effective depth do not. Code is available at https://github.com/magnus-sesodia/insidetheloop.

</details>


### [799] [Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machines as Unsupervised Encoders for Biomechanical Movement Sequences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24829)
*Wafi Sharif,Nicholas LaHaye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将循环时序受限玻尔兹曼机（RTRBM）改造为无监督编码器，把运动数据窗口映射为定长嵌入并接入SIT-FUSE分割流程，验证了其可用性，但循环结构的增益证据混杂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物力学运动记录是连续高维时间序列，无标注分析需要能表达运动随时间演化的表征；但多数无监督表征学习流程逐帧独立处理、丢弃时序结构，而能建模时序的能量模型很少被适配到生物力学信号上。

Method: 实现RTRBM作为无监督编码器：适配连续值信号、堆叠为深层架构、集成进SIT-FUSE分割管线；在模拟肌肉骨骼伸展任务和两个真实步态数据集上，用聚类、重建和未见受试者的步行速度分类进行评估，并与非循环、非概率基线（含去掉循环连接的对照）比较。

Result: 对嵌入聚类可在无标签条件下恢复与趋近目标进度相关的运动结构并能迁移到未见片段；步态数据上嵌入在非线性探针下优于PCA和自编码器基线；但去掉循环连接在伸展任务上无显著损失，且简单的逐通道汇总统计在步行速度分类上至少与嵌入持平。

Conclusion: 该模型是SIT-FUSE的可运行且经验证的编码器，但循环结构带来收益的证据混杂，且所学嵌入在步态数据上未超越简单统计量。

Abstract: Biomechanical movement recordings are continuous, high-dimensional time series, and analyzing them without manually labeling them requires representations that capture how movements evolve over time. Most unsupervised representation-learning pipelines, however, treat each observation frame independently and discard this temporal structure, while energy-based models that could capture it have not extensively been adapted to biomechanical signals. So, this paper implements the Recurrent Temporal Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RTRBM), a recurrent energy-based model, into an unsupervised encoder that maps windows of movement data to fixed-length embeddings, and tests what its recurrent structure contributes. We adapt the model to continuous-valued signals, stack it into a deep architecture, and integrate it into the SIT-FUSE segmentation pipeline. We evaluate the embeddings on simulated musculoskeletal reaching and on two real gait datasets, using clustering, reconstruction, and walking-speed classification of unseen subjects, and compare them against non-recurrent and non-probabilistic baselines, including a control that removes the recurrent connection. Clustering the embeddings recovers movement structure tied to progress toward the target without any labels, which also transfers to unseen episodes. On gait data, the embeddings outperform PCA and autoencoder baselines under a nonlinear probe. However, removing the recurrent connection does not yield a measurable loss on the reaching task, and simple per-channel summary statistics classify walking speed at least as well as the embeddings. The model is therefore a working, verified encoder for SIT-FUSE, while the evidence for a benefit of recurrence is mixed, and the learned embeddings did not outperform simple summary statistics on gait.

</details>


### [800] [Continual Test-Time Learning with Evolution Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24137)
*Guangya Hao,Yiting Duan,Longyan Tan,Yunbo Long,Hao Wu,Ge Zheng,Alexandra Brintrup,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出进化策略强化学习ESRL：用一群扰动策略而非被训练策略自身生成自监督信号，实现无外部监督的持续测试时学习，显著提升准确率并缓解灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM在开放环境中需持续适应新任务与分布，但缺乏外部监督。现有持续学习方法依赖标签、示范或奖励信号，代价高且常不可得；测试时适应虽去除该依赖，却从被更新的单一策略中提取自监督，策略漂移即导致学习信号漂移，引发策略崩溃、推理退化与灾难性遗忘。

Method: ESRL在参数空间对锚点策略施加扰动，构造邻近策略种群；每条策略采样一条轨迹，将各自答案聚合为无标签的组内相对学习信号，用于训练中心学生策略。锚点在每个块内固定，并在块边界由学生刷新，使种群始终围绕稳定且最新的策略中心，从而在学生学习过程中持续提供多样、可靠的自监督。

Result: 在数学推理、通用知识与医学领域的单任务测试时适应中，ESRL相较基座模型平均准确率最高提升31.7%，相较最强测试时适应基线提升16.6%；在持续学习中显著减少灾难性遗忘，并取得最优的最终性能。

Conclusion: 以种群而非单策略作为自监督来源，可稳定测试时强化学习的信号质量，是无外部监督下持续适应LLM的有效框架。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate in open-ended environments, where they are expected to continually adapt to evolving tasks and distributions, often without access to external supervision. Existing continual learning approaches rely on external supervision, such as labeled data, demonstrations, or reward signals, which can be costly or unavailable in practice. Test-time adaptation removes this dependence by learning from self-generated supervision, but existing methods derive that supervision from the single policy being updated, so once the policy drifts, its own learning signal drifts with it, leading to policy collapse, degraded reasoning, and catastrophic forgetting. In this paper, we propose \textbf{Evolution Strategy Reinforcement Learning (ESRL)}, a continual test-time learning framework that draws its self-generated supervision from a population of policies instead of the single policy being trained. ESRL perturbs an anchor policy in parameter space to form a population of nearby policies, samples one trajectory from each, and aggregates their answers into label-free group-relative learning signals for the central student. The anchor is held fixed within each block and refreshed from the student at block boundaries, so the population stays centered on a stable yet current policy and continues to supply diverse and reliable supervision as the student moves. In single-task test-time adaptation across mathematical reasoning, general knowledge, and medical domains, ESRL improves average accuracy by up to 31.7% relative to the base model and 16.6% relative to the strongest test-time adaptation baseline. Notably, ESRL substantially reduces catastrophic forgetting and achieves the strongest final performance in continual learning.

</details>


### [801] [NeuroAct: Advancing EEG Analysis and Decoding via Dual-Loop Autonomous Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25211)
*Wei Xiong,Jiangtong Li,Han Zhao,Linxiao Yang,Jie Li,Changjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双环自主研究智能体框架 NeuroAct，用于 EEG 分析与解码，通过内环假设检验与外环经验蒸馏实现证据引导的研究与跨任务经验复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 固定流程与奖励驱动的搜索无法显式刻画信号结构、表征、预测器行为与训练动态对性能和泛化差距的贡献，导致干预选择不确定。

Method: 双环自主研究框架：内环中研究、开发、评审三种角色基于信号结构、表征、预测器行为与训练动态的证据检验假设、选择分析或干预，并依据性能、稳定性与成本反馈迭代候选；外环将结果蒸馏为带任务与模型条件的可检验建议，并在后续任务上验证与修订；覆盖 EEG 基础模型、任务专用预测器与模型组合。

Result: 四个设定均提升：A 设定宏平均 80.88 对比 BrainAgent 63.13（+17.75）；B 设定 EEGPT 平衡准确率提升 7.34 点，HBN 的 r 由 0.6894 升至 0.7362；C 设定 ADFTD 平衡准确率提升 16.33 点；D 设定 Workload 由 79.69% 升至 85.02%；经验复用使 BCIC-IV-2a 由 34.66% 升至 50.81%，同时 LLM token 减少 64.02%。

Conclusion: NeuroAct 支持证据引导的 EEG 研究，并可通过跨任务经验复用持续提升性能与效率。

Abstract: EEG analysis and decoding underpin brain-computer interfaces, cognitive assessment, and sleep monitoring. Fixed pipelines and reward-driven search do not explicitly determine how signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics contribute to performance or generalization gaps, leaving intervention choice underdetermined. We introduce NeuroAct, an autonomous research agent framework for EEG analysis and decoding. NeuroAct implements dual-loop autonomous research across EEG foundation models, task-specific predictors, and model combinations. In an inner loop, research, development, and review roles use evidence on signal structure, representations, predictor behavior, and training dynamics to test hypotheses, select analyses or interventions, and refine candidates using performance, stability, and cost feedback. An outer loop distills outcomes into conditional, testable recommendations with task and model conditions, then validates and revises them on subsequent tasks.We evaluate four settings: (A) EEG General Analysis, (B) Cross-task Model Optimization, (C) Single-task Open Research, and (D) Collaborative Prediction. In Setting A, NeuroAct's 80.88 macro-average exceeds BrainAgent's 63.13 by 17.75 points. In Setting B, NeuroAct raises EEGPT's mean balanced accuracy (BA) by 7.34 points and HBN Pearson's (r) from 0.6894 to 0.7362; in Setting C, it improves ADFTD BA by 16.33 points; and in Setting D, it raises Workload BA from 79.69% to 85.02%. Experience reuse raises BCIC-IV-2a BA from 34.66% to 50.81% while reducing LLM tokens by 64.02%, indicating recommendations improve cross-task performance. NeuroAct enables evidence-guided EEG research improved by cross-task experience.

</details>


### [802] [Budgeted Bayesian Bandits for Future Utilization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24156)
*Sudipto Guha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究"探索有硬预算且先于利用"的多臂老虎机变体，证明现有1/3与4/27近似算法的分析是紧的，并给出0.43近似的新算法；在可交换有界奖励、非消失机制下进一步给出趋近 1-e^{-1}≈0.63 的算法，且相对自然LP松弛渐近紧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典多臂老虎机刻画探索与利用的权衡；本文关注探索受硬预算约束、且探索阶段必须先于利用阶段的变体。已有工作给出1/3近似（Guha–Munagala，拉格朗日对偶）和4/27近似（Ma，针对更一般模型的原LP松弛），但这些保证的真实紧性尚不清楚，且近似比有待改进。

Method: 1) 构造实例证明Guha–Munagala与Ma两算法的分析是紧的，即使其松弛渐近精确；2) 提出不同的高效算法以获得更好近似；3) 针对有界、可交换的奖励观测，在非消失机制下设计高效算法，并利用线性规划松弛进行分析；4) 该技术同时给出用于停止序贯模型评估的证书（certificates）。

Result: 证明了既有1/3与4/27近似分析均为紧的；新算法达到0.43近似；在可交换有界奖励的非消失机制下，近似比趋近 1-e^{-1}≈0.63，且该结果对自然LP松弛渐近紧；并导出停止序贯模型评估的证书。

Conclusion: 探索预算先行的老虎机变体中，现有近似保证已无改进空间（分析紧），但通过新的算法设计与LP松弛分析可将近似比从1/3提升至0.43，并在可交换奖励结构下逼近理论上限1-e^{-1}；附带产出可用于序贯模型评估提前停止的证书。

Abstract: The multi-armed bandit problem models the trade-off between exploration and exploitation. In this paper, we study the variant where exploration has a hard budget and precedes exploitation. Prior guarantees include a 1/3 approximation by Guha and Munagala using Lagrangian duality, and a 4/27 approximation by Ma against a primal linear programming relaxation for a more general model. We show that the analyses of both algorithms are tight, even when their relaxations are asymptotically exact. We provide a different efficient algorithm that achieves a 0.43 approximation. We then provide an efficient algorithm whose guarantee approaches 1-e^{-1} approx 0.63 for bounded exchangeable reward observations in a non-vanishing regime, which is asymptotically tight against natural linear programming relaxations. The technique also gives certificates for stopping sequential model evaluation.

</details>


### [803] [Bombadil: A Foundation Model for Plant Electrophysiology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26597)
*James Kirk,Piotr Bednarski,Filip Twardy,Justin Mast,Lee von Kraus*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Bombadil——首个植物电生理基础模型，在来自100个物种、10种环境的超400万小时无标签电信号上预训练，可跨物种、跨环境追踪7项植物胁迫生理指标，并能在训练中无标注的物种与胁迫类型上泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 植物可通过电信号在体内传递生理状态信息，但已有机器学习模型均为单任务训练，无法跨任务、物种或环境迁移，难以在农业、林业、园艺及消费级植物养护所涉及的广泛物种与环境间扩展。

Method: 采用与动物电生理类似的差分细胞外电极对插入信号传导组织记录电信号；构建基础模型Bombadil，在无标签条件下对超400万小时、覆盖100个物种与10类环境（实验室、温室、商业果园、天然林）的电信号进行自监督预训练，学习植物电信号的通用基本特征，再据同一信号刻画7项胁迫生理指标。

Result: Bombadil从电信号中成功追踪7项植物胁迫生理指标，并在训练阶段无标签的物种和胁迫类型上同样有效，体现出跨物种、跨环境的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 植物电生理基础模型具备跨任务、跨物种、跨环境的可迁移性，为植物状态监测提供了可规模化的统一范式，有望支撑农业、林业与园艺等多场景应用。

Abstract: Living plants, like animals, use electrical signals to carry information about their physiological state across their body, from roots to branches. These signals can be recorded, as they are in animals, from a pair of differential extracellular electrodes inserted into signal-conducting tissue. While machine-learning models have been trained to predict specific plant stress states from these signals, each of these models has been trained for only a single task and none have been designed to transfer across tasks, species, or environments. These approaches do not allow easy scaling across the wide range of species and environments that are relevant to agriculture, forestry, and horticulture for both commercial and consumer plant care.
  Here we present Bombadil, a foundation model for plant electrophysiology, pretrained without labels on over 4 million hours of electrical signals recorded from 100 plant species in ten distinct environments, including laboratories, greenhouses, commercial orchards, and natural forests. In this way, Bombadil is able to learn the fundamental features of plant electrical signals across a wide array of species and environments. Then, from those same electrical signals, Bombadil tracks changes in seven physiological indicators of plant stress, even among species and stressors with no labels in training.

</details>


### [804] [Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24166)
*Adria Binte Habib,Ibne Farabi Shihab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在平稳β-混合流上给出显式依赖感知的投票间隔（voting-margin）泛化证书，并区分混合惩罚与谱浓度两类界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 训练误差消失后加权投票的泛化需要间隔界解释，但相依观测要求把依赖模型与失效预算显式保留，而非用"有效样本量"作形式替换。

Method: 对有限基类，结合平稳β-混合过程的独立分块Rademacher理论与截断margin损失得到一致投票margin证书，惩罚项由独立块数与耦合预算4(μ-1)β(a)决定；给出黑箱迁移定理，将i.i.d. margin保证迁移到等距子序列仅加性β-混合失效概率；对独立于平稳有限状态可逆Markov流的固定投票，用谱浓度得√(t_rel/n)速率，并以sticky-refresh构造证明该指数不可改进；未知依赖尺度时用batch-means Student-t区间。

Result: 块数大时学习投票证书非空；双时间尺度构造下batch-means区间比最坏情形区间窄8.1倍且名义覆盖0.945；强相依下block-bootstrap与batch-means欠覆盖而证书仍有效；UCI HAR真实有序数据上依赖无关证书覆盖0.95，朴素区间仅0.38。

Conclusion: 有效样本量为n/τ_int(g)且τ_int(g)≤2t_rel-1，常数依赖具体统计量而非最坏情形t_rel；依赖惩罚应显式由混合块数与耦合预算刻画。

Abstract: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $β$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(μ-1)β(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $β$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. The constant is statistic-specific: the effective sample size is $n/τ_{int}(g)$, with $τ_{int}(g) \le 2t_{rel}-1$. When the dependence scale is unknown, a batch-means Student-t interval is valid up to an explicit remainder vanishing in the number of batches, with width governed by $τ_{int}(g)$ rather than the worst-case $t_{rel}$. Experiments show: the learned-vote certificate is nonvacuous once the block count is large; a two-timescale construction gives a batch-means interval 8.1x narrower than the worst-case interval at nominal coverage (0.945); block-bootstrap and batch-means intervals undercover under strong dependence while the certificate stays valid; and on real, ordered UCI HAR sensor data the dependence-agnostic certificate reaches 0.95 coverage where naive intervals reach only 0.38.

</details>


### [805] [Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree for Inference-time Search Under Sparse Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24185)
*Binglin Ji,Anindya Sarkar,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT)采样器，通过解耦子节点生成与父节点依赖，提升树采样器的路径空间多样性与探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 树式采样器可规避SMC类框架中逐步奖励与梯度依赖带来的系统性偏差，但现有树采样器依赖DDPM式学习转移，使轨迹中相邻状态高度耦合，限制父子特征分异，导致目标边缘分布覆盖受限、稀疏奖励下探索不足。

Method: BSIT将子节点生成与显式父节点依赖解耦，在子节点采样时扩展自由度（bootstrap式随机插值），鼓励多样化轨迹展开，从而拓宽路径空间多样性；且不增加额外函数评估或奖励反馈。

Result: 理论上表明BSIT的改进探索加速收敛至目标分布，并获得比DDPM式转移采样器更广的分布覆盖；在稀有物种发现与目标对齐分子生成等任务上，搜索效率优于基线。

Conclusion: BSIT以简单有效的方式解决了树采样器探索受限问题，为稀疏奖励下的稀有目标搜索提供了高效基础，且无额外计算代价。

Abstract: Tree-based samplers offer a compelling alternative for scalable inference-time search, bypassing the per-step reward and gradient dependencies that introduce systematic bias into SMC-style frameworks. Despite this advantage, contemporary tree samplers fail to achieve broad exploration. Their reliance on learned, DDPM-like transitions inherently couples neighbor states in a trajectory, thereby restricting child-parent feature divergence in the tree sampler. Consequently, these samplers suffer from restricted coverage of the target marginal distribution, severely hindering the exploration critical for efficient search under sparse reward. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a simple yet effective Bootstrap Stochastic Interpolant Tree (BSIT) sampler that decouples child node generation from explicit parent dependencies. By expanding the degrees of freedom during child node sampling, BSIT encourages diverse trajectory rollouts and unlocks broader path-space diversity-the exact catalyst needed for efficient exploration. Crucially, we show that BSIT's improved exploration accelerates convergence to the target distribution while achieving broader distributional coverage than samplers that rely on DDPM-like transitions for child-node generation, all without incurring additional function evaluations or reward feedback, thereby providing a highly efficient basis for rare target search. Extensive experiments across diverse search settings, including rare-species discovery and target-aligned molecule generation tasks, demonstrate BSIT's superior search efficiency over the baselines.

</details>


### [806] [On Reparameterizing the Score Function](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24188)
*Mohammad Hossein Amani,Leonardo Bocchieri,Maxime Peyrard,Clément Hongler,Robert West*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出历史重参数化（HR）策略梯度：将score函数中冻结的前缀替换为可微/松弛的历史，使下游对数概率梯度沿轨迹反传；并给出带闭式系数的最优HR（OHR）中心化控制变量估计器，以最小化梯度方差迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归序列模型的标准策略梯度对每个token的log概率求导时固定条件历史，丢弃了早期决策影响后续条件分布的信息；在稀疏奖励下导致信用分配瓶颈。

Method: 用可微重参数化或松弛的历史替换score函数中的冻结前缀，使下游log概率梯度反向传播至生成轨迹，得到history-pathwise项（直接加入一般有偏）；据此推导OHR——中心化控制变量估计器，其系数闭式、在总体层面最小化梯度方差迹。离散token下比较嵌入级松弛与straight-through Gumbel-Softmax。

Result: 方差缩减取决于策略动态的时间结构：随机或弱结构策略获益有限，而具学习到的序列依赖的策略产生有信息量的history-pathwise修正。离散token上嵌入级松弛带来随horizon增长而扩大的显著方差缩减，而straight-through Gumbel-Softmax诊断中基本无收益。在Gaussian线性马尔可夫模型、带循环策略的稀疏奖励T-maze、以及小规模TSP的自回归Transformer上验证有效。

Conclusion: 通过在score函数中重参数化历史并采用最优中心化控制变量，可有效缓解稀疏奖励下的信用分配瓶颈并显著降低梯度方差；方法有效性依赖策略的时序结构与离散松弛方式的选择。

Abstract: Policy gradients for autoregressive sequence models differentiate each token's log-probability while holding the conditioning history fixed. This discards information about how earlier decisions shape later conditional distributions, creating a credit-assignment bottleneck when rewards are sparse. We introduce History-Reparameterized (HR) policy gradients, which replace the frozen prefix in the score function with a differentiable reparameterized or relaxed history, allowing gradients of downstream log-probabilities to propagate backward through the generated trajectory. The resulting history-pathwise term is generally biased when added directly, so we derive Optimal HR (OHR), a centered control-variate estimator with a closed-form coefficient that minimizes the trace of the gradient variance at the population level. The variance reduction is governed by temporal structure in the policy dynamics: random or weakly structured policies provide little benefit, while policies with learned sequential dependencies yield informative history-pathwise corrections. For discrete tokens, the choice of relaxation is crucial: embedding-level relaxation yields substantial variance reduction that grows with horizon, whereas straight-through Gumbel-Softmax yields essentially none in our diagnostics. We validate the method on a Gaussian linear Markov model, a sparse-reward T-maze with a recurrent policy, and an autoregressive Transformer model for small Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) instances.

</details>


### [807] [Hidden Trajectories Don't Lie: Correcting Corruption Drift for Test-Time Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24220)
*Amirhossein Sabour,Amir Khasahmadi,Mengliu Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Drift-TTA：通过在冻结主干上加零初始化低秩适配器，将受损输入的隐层轨迹对齐到干净输入的轨迹，实现测试时自适应，并在 CIFAR-100-C 上显著提升精度与降低 ECE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TTA 方法多依赖最终层权重表示或输出概率分布信号，信息有限；作者转而研究深层网络中按顺序产生的中间表示序列（隐层轨迹），并观察到随损坏程度加重，干净与受损轨迹的可分性增强，提示其可作为有效自适应信号。

Method: 在冻结主干上添加零初始化低秩适配器，训练其将受损隐层轨迹对齐至较干净输入的轨迹；提供源依赖（用干净目标训练）与无源（用不同严重度受损图像学习）两种变体；在线 TTA 时冻结主干与适配器，仅更新标量门控以控制自适应强度；并将轨迹对齐建模为高斯观测模型下的 MAP 推断，推导基于 KL 的迁移界，用离线残差误差、残差维度及离线/测试损坏分布差异刻画测试时轨迹错配。

Result: 在 CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C 上以监督 ViT 与 CLIP 模型评估。CIFAR-100-C 严重度 5 下，无源在线方法较无 TTA 分别提升 13.3 个百分点（ViT-B/16，达 74.9%）与 11.6 个百分点（CLIP ViT-B/16，达 47.4%）；ECE 由基线 18.00%（ViT）与 14.70%（CLIP）降至 9.53% 与 5.77%。

Conclusion: 隐层轨迹对齐为离线校正与轻量在线测试时自适应均提供了有效信号，且理论分析与多数据集实验共同支撑其有效性。

Abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pretrained models to distribution shifts encountered during deployment. However, most existing methods rely on the weight representations of the final layer or signals derived from the model's output probability distribution. We study hidden trajectories: the ordered sequence of intermediate representations produced across a deep neural network. We observe that clean and corrupted trajectories become more separable as corruption severity increases. We introduce Drift-TTA, which adds zero-initialized low-rank adapters to a frozen backbone and trains them to align corrupted hidden trajectories with those from cleaner inputs. The approach supports two variants: a source-dependent version trained with clean targets, and a source-free setting that learns from corrupted images at different severities. We develop an online TTA approach that freezes the backbone and adapters while updating a scalar gate to control adaptation strength. We further cast trajectory alignment as MAP inference under a Gaussian observation model and derive a KL-based transfer bound characterizing test-time trajectory misalignment in terms of offline residual error, residual dimensionality, and distribution shift between offline and test corruptions. We evaluate Drift-TTA on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, and ImageNet-C using supervised ViTs and CLIP models. On CIFAR-100-C at severity 5, our source-free online approach improves accuracy over no TTA by 13.3 percentage points with ViT-B/16 and 11.6 percentage points with CLIP ViT-B/16, reaching 74.9% and 47.4%, respectively. Under the same setting, prior TTA baselines yield ECEs of 18.00% for ViT and 14.70% for CLIP, while our approach reduces them to 9.53% and 5.77%, respectively. These results demonstrate that hidden trajectory alignment provides an effective signal for both offline correction and lightweight online test-time adaptation.

</details>


### [808] [Dynamic Neural Optimal Transport for Subset Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24258)
*Austin J. Brockmeier,Bilal Riaz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出双网络动态神经最优传输框架，在目标分布仅部分相关时学习源到目标子分布的映射，终端分布受密度比约束 [0,c]。


<details>
