  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源分布只对应目标总体的一部分，全目标分布匹配会引入无关成分；需要在目标支撑内选取合适子分布并限制任何区域的强调强度。

Method: 两个神经网络：其一参数化时间依赖势函数，其空间梯度定义速度场，终端值施加密度比约束；其二参数化源分布与所学终端分布之间的插值。与既有需固定终端分布的方法不同，本文在目标支撑内学习终端分布。

Result: 在正-无标签学习、非配对域翻译与轨迹推断三类任务上验证，存在有意义的源-目标对齐，但直接分布匹配不适用（目标含额外或无关成分）。

Conclusion: 通过约束密度比并端到端学习终端分布，框架可实现选择性部分匹配，适用于目标含冗余成分的传输场景。

Abstract: We study optimal transport between distributions when only a subset of the target population is relevant to the source. The goal is to map the source distribution to a reweighted target distribution whose density ratio with respect to the full target lies in $[0, c]$. This constraint enables the transported distribution to select an appropriate target subpopulation while limiting how strongly any region of the target can be emphasized. We propose a dynamic neural optimal transport framework for this setting using two neural networks. The first parameterizes a time-dependent potential whose spatial gradient defines the velocity field and whose terminal value enforces the density-ratio constraint. The second parameterizes an interpolation between the source distribution and the learned terminal distribution. Unlike prior neural dynamic optimal transport methods, which typically assume a fixed terminal distribution, our formulation learns the terminal distribution within the support of the target. We demonstrate the method on positive-unlabeled learning, unpaired domain translation, and trajectory inference, where meaningful alignments exist between source and target distributions, but direct distribution matching is inappropriate because the target contains additional or irrelevant components

</details>


### [809] [Dataset Inference for Data Provenance and Privacy Auditing in Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24278)
*Dariush Wahdany,Jesse Cresswell,Naiqing Guan,Atiyeh Ashari Ghomi,Franziska Boenisch,Adam Dziedzic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个面向表格基础模型（TFM）的数据集推断方法，通过组合多种黑盒信号判断某数据集是否被用于预训练，ROC-AUC最高达0.99。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TFM常以黑盒API形式部署，并在大规模真实表格数据集上预训练，私有或专有数据可能被纳入预训练语料，但目前缺乏判断某表格数据集是否参与TFM训练的专门方法，存在隐私泄露与专有数据滥用风险。

Method: 在输入操纵条件下，从黑盒TFM系统性地采集并分析多种候选信号；发现单一信号证据微弱，遂将多个互补信号组合，构建数据集级成员推断框架。

Result: 在多个基于真实表格数据训练的先进TFM上成功推断数据集成员归属，ROC-AUC依模型不同最高可达0.99；并分析预训练数据构成、模型容量及真实与合成数据使用等因素对识别效果的影响。

Conclusion: 该方法可作为实用的审计工具，用于检测TFM中的隐私泄露及专有数据集使用情况。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are increasingly deployed through black-box APIs and trained on large collections of real-world tabular datasets. As this training paradigm becomes more widely adopted, private or proprietary datasets may be incorporated into pre-training corpora, yet there are currently no dedicated methods for determining whether a given tabular dataset was used to train a TFM. As a solution, we introduce the first dataset inference method for TFMs, aiming to infer whether a suspect dataset was part of a model's pre-training data. We systematically analyze a broad collection of candidate signals that can be observed from a black-box TFM via input manipulation and find that individual signals provide only weak evidence of training data membership. However, by combining multiple complementary signals, we can infer dataset membership for several state-of-the-art TFMs trained on real tabular data, achieving up to 0.99 ROCAUC dependent on the TFM. We then study factors that influence dataset identification, including pre-training data composition, model capacity, and the use of real vs. synthetic data. Our results show that our dataset inference method is a practical auditing tool for detecting privacy leakage and the use of proprietary datasets in TFMs.

</details>


### [810] [An important Bottleneck in LLM Optimizers: Principle-Level Local Optima](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24291)
*Nian Ran,Tianhe Jia,Zhengyang Mu,Yue Wang,Sebastian Brulin,Markus Olhofer,Mauricio A. Alvarez,Yang Liu,Richard Allmendinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究反馈驱动LLM优化器中"原则级搜索坍缩"现象：优化器的搜索被限制在狭窄的设计原则集合内，尽管仍能生成不同候选并获得小幅改进。作者构建跨分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择、GPU内核优化的诊断基准，提出决策树协议检测坍缩，并发现多样性注入收益有限、参考原则干预效果不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反馈驱动LLM优化器广泛用于进化搜索、贝叶斯优化、启发式设计与科学发现，但快速初期增益后常出现长时间平台期，即使剩余大量评估预算。作者希望界定并量化这一现象的本质——搜索在"原则层面"而非候选层面的坍缩，因为候选层面的多样性可能掩盖原则层面的受限搜索。

Method: 构建覆盖三个问题域（分子优化、网络哨兵节点选择、GPU内核优化）的诊断基准；提出基于决策树的判定协议，综合三项证据：原则收窄、性能长时间平台、与可达参考解之间的差距；随后检验两类干预：(1) 多样性注入（提高温度t、多LLM、网络搜索）；(2) 参考原则干预。

Result: 在三个问题域共161次可评估运行中，78.3%获得坍缩支持，其中55.3%为强支持。在65次分子优化运行中，即使采用多样性注入，仍有73.8%获支持、53.8%为强支持，说明多样性注入收益有限且不一致。参考原则干预可改善部分运行，但收益随模型与任务变化，获得更优原则并不保证其被有效使用。

Conclusion: 原则级搜索坍缩是反馈驱动LLM优化器的普遍且严重问题，且被候选层面的表面多样性所掩盖。研究强调需要在优化过程中进行在线坍缩检测，并设计更好的机制来生成与维持替代性设计原则；所提基准与诊断协议为未来优化器的原则级坍缩评估提供了基础。

Abstract: Feedback-driven LLM optimizers are increasingly used for evolutionary search, Bayesian optimization, heuristic design, and scientific discovery. Yet rapid initial gains often give way to prolonged plateaus despite substantial remaining evaluation budgets. We investigate \emph{principle-level search collapse}, where an optimizer's search becomes confined to a narrow set of design principles, even though it may continue to generate distinct candidates and achieve small improvements. We assemble a diagnostic benchmark spanning molecular optimization, network sentinel-node selection, and GPU-kernel optimization, and introduce a decision-tree protocol combining principle narrowing, prolonged performance plateaus, and gaps to attainable reference solutions. Across 161 assessable runs on the three problem domains, 78.3\% receive support for collapse, including 55.3\% with strong support. Candidate-level variation can nevertheless conceal restricted search at the principle level. We then test \emph{diversity injection}, a common response to search stagnation, such as higher t, multiple LLMs, and web search, and show that it provides limited and inconsistent benefits: among 65 molecular runs, still 73.8\% and 53.8\% receive support and strong support respectively. We finally test reference-principle interventions and find that they improve some runs, but their benefits vary across models and tasks: access to a better principle does not guarantee its effective use. Our benchmark and diagnostic protocol provide a basis for evaluating future optimizers on principle-level collapse. Our findings highlight the need for online collapse detection and better mechanisms for generating and maintaining alternative principles during optimization.

</details>


### [811] [Inducing Fourier Geometry: A Smoothness Prior Imposes Approximate Translation Equivariance in Multimodal Stellar Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24292)
*Ilay Kamai,Alex M. Bronstein,Hagai B. Perets*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种图-Laplacian平滑先验，利用已知连续参数空间在表示中"诱导"出对称性结构（而非依赖精确对称）；在六个天文巡天的多模态恒星表示上诱导出Toeplitz Gram结构与正弦模态，并提升下游线性探测性能与标签效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习到的表示常因数据中的对称性而含有几何结构，但当对称性只是近似的（非精确）时，该结构难以自然涌现。作者希望探讨：是否可以用一个已知的连续参数空间主动诱导这种结构，而不预先指定表示几何。

Method: 引入图-Laplacian平滑性先验，惩罚表示在物理参数空间图上的局部剧烈变化，但不指定具体表示几何；在连续极限下该先验选择Laplacian特征函数，从而预测与平移对称相关的类傅里叶几何。应用于覆盖六个天文巡天的多模态恒星表示，并检验精确对称预言（平稳性、量化、渐近速率）及下游线性探测表现。

Result: 沿恒星参数诱导出Toeplitz Gram结构与正弦模态，包括本征表示缺乏该几何的模态；模态特有残差保留了施加坐标之外的结构。精确对称预言中，可恢复的翘曲坐标下的平稳性成立，而假定精确量化或渐近速率的诊断不成立。先验还提升了线性探测性能与标签效率。

Conclusion: 当存在有意义的连续参数空间时，其局部几何可作为数据驱动的先验，诱导表示几何；这提供了一种通用策略，且并不要求对称性精确成立。

Abstract: Learned representations often contain geometric structure induced by symmetries in the underlying data. We ask whether a known continuous parameter space can instead be used to \emph{induce} such structure when the corresponding symmetry is only approximate. We introduce a graph-Laplacian smoothness prior that encourages representations to vary smoothly over a physical parameter space without specifying a representation geometry; in the continuum limit it selects Laplacian eigenfunctions and therefore predicts the Fourier-like geometry associated with translation symmetry. On multimodal stellar representations spanning six astronomical surveys, the prior induces Toeplitz Gram structure and sinusoidal modes along stellar parameters, including in modalities whose native representations lack this geometry, while modality-specific residuals preserve structure outside the imposed coordinates. Of the exact-symmetry predictions, stationarity in a recoverable warped coordinate survives; diagnostics assuming exact quantization or asymptotic rates do not. The prior also improves downstream linear-probe performance and label efficiency, suggesting a general strategy: where a meaningful continuous parameter space exists, its local geometry can serve as a data-informed prior.

</details>


### [812] [Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24293)
*Sho Sonoda,Luca Galimberti,Yuanchao Xu,Isao Ishikawa,Masahiro Ikeda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将脊波变换（ridgelet transform）推广到可分无穷维 Hilbert 空间上的连续映射，用方向空间上齐次混合的高斯权重替代 Lebesgue 测度，建立 Plancherel 恒等式与重构公式，从而给出算子学习网络的存在性之外的构造性逼近：对多项式增长的非多项式激活（含 ReLU）得到紧集上的一致逼近，并通过系数测度的 Monte Carlo 采样得到宽度 N 下与维数无关的 O(N^{-1/2}) 误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算子学习的万能逼近结果多为存在性证明（化归为有限维网络或 Stone–Weierstrass 型稠密性），只能说明逼近元存在，却几乎不揭示参数如何依赖目标函数，缺乏构造性与显式系数表达。

Method: 将脊波变换（与 Fourier、Radon、小波变换相关的积分变换）推广至可分无穷维 Hilbert 空间上的连续映射；因无穷维不存在 Lebesgue 测度，改用高斯权重并在方向空间取齐次混合。由此导出 Plancherel 恒等式与含框架算子、权重诱导修正项的重构公式，并对每个容许分析滤波器为每个目标赋予显式系数测度；再通过对系数进行 Monte Carlo 采样构造有限宽网络。

Result: 对紧集上一致逼近，覆盖所有多项式增长的非多项式连续激活（含 ReLU）；对全局 Lipschitz 激活及具有限变差与二阶矩的系数，有限宽网络的误差为与维数无关的 O(N^{-1/2})（N 为宽度）。给出 Gaussian 目标与 neural-operator 层等显式实例；并附 Lean 4 形式化以机器验证证明，与手稿的对应关系记录于 https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-operator-ridgelet/ 。

Conclusion: 通过脊波变换的无穷维构造性推广，作者把算子学习的万能逼近从"存在性"推进到"显式系数+可采样有限宽网络+维数无关收敛率"，并以形式化证明增强可靠性，为函数空间上的网络逼近提供了构造性理论框架。

Abstract: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. From these representations we obtain uniform approximation on compact sets for all continuous non-polynomial activations of polynomial growth, including ReLU, and, by Monte Carlo sampling of the coefficient, finite-width networks with a dimension-free $O(N^{-1/2})$ error in the width $N$ for globally Lipschitz activations and coefficients with finite variation and second moments. Explicit examples include Gaussian targets and neural-operator layers. A companion Lean~4 formalization provides machine-checked proofs, with its correspondence to the manuscript documented at https://shosonoda.github.io/lean-operator-ridgelet/ .

</details>


### [813] [Predicting CVSS and CWE from CVE Descriptions with Fine-Tuned Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24297)
*Tara Dixit,Jessie Dong,Summer Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于漏洞文本描述预测CVSS v3.1向量八个基础分量、基础评分、严重性等级与CWE的多任务CVE富化方案，微调Phi-3.5-mini在2024年全量测试集上达到严重性69.9%、CWE 70.9%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026年4月后NIST仅对高优先级CVE进行富化标注，大量新发布漏洞缺少安全团队用于补丁分诊的CVSS向量、严重性等级与CWE标签，形成标注缺口。

Method: 仅使用2022—2023年发布的CVE训练以避免近重复描述泄漏；以漏洞文本为唯一输入，预测CVSS v3.1八个基础分量、基础评分、严重性等级和CWE，评分可由预测向量经CVSS公式计算；采用LoRA在单块Apple M5 Pro上微调38亿参数的Phi-3.5-mini（2.5小时），并与TF-IDF逻辑回归基线对比，采用零排除配对bootstrap区间做显著性检验。

Result: 在2024年36,325条可用CVE上，微调模型严重性准确率69.9%、CWE 70.9%，向量完全匹配率48.8%，各项指标较TF-IDF逻辑回归高2.8—4.7个百分点；零样本基线严重性仅20.8%，其自报评分与自身向量一致率仅3.4%；由预测向量推导评分可将TF-IDF的critical类召回从50.7%提升至73.3%且无额外成本；两系统误差互补，至少一个系统严重性判断正确的比例达75.8%。

Conclusion: 小型微调模型可在低成本算力下有效填补CVE富化缺口，从预测向量推导评分优于直接预测评分，模型与TF-IDF的误差互补性支持集成式分诊流程。

Abstract: Until April 2026, the National Vulnerability Database labeled nearly every published Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) entry with a Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) v3.1 vector, a severity tier, and a Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) weakness type. Now, NIST enriches only the high priority CVEs, leaving many newly published vulnerabilities unlabelled with the classifiers that security teams use for patch triage. In CVE enrichment, we predict the eight base components of CVSS v3.1 vector, base score, severity tier, and CWE from the vulnerability's textual description alone. To prevent leakage between near-duplicate descriptions, all systems are trained only on CVEs published in 2022 and 2023. Results are evaluated on all 36,325 usable 2024 CVEs in the pinned NVD snapshot. All scores are either directly predicted, or calculated from predicted vectors using the CVSS formula. A fine-tuned 3.8B-parameter model Phi-3.5-mini, trained with LoRA in 2.5 hours on a single Apple M5 Pro chip, achieves 69.9% accuracy on severity and 70.9% on CWE. It matches the official vector exactly for 48.8% of test CVEs, outperforming TF-IDF logistic regression by 2.8 to 4.7 points on all accuracy metrics based on zero-exclusion paired bootstrap intervals. When we evaluate the base model with a zero-shot prompt, it achieves 20.8% accuracy on severity in a sample of 2,000 CVEs. In this same sample, its stated scores match its own vector precisely for only 3.4% of CVEs. However, deriving scores from predicted vectors boosts the critical recall of TF-IDF logistic regression from 50.7% to 73.3% with no additional cost. And since the errors of the fine-tuned model and TF-IDF affect different CVEs, at least one system matches the correct severity tier for 75.8% of test CVEs.

</details>


### [814] [Torch-DPhys: A Torch-Native, MOOSE-Compatible Framework for Differentiable Physics Simulation and Hybrid Machine Learning Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24301)
*Akzhol Almukhametov,Yang Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Torch-DPhys——一个基于PyTorch的可微物理仿真与物理-机器学习混合框架，实现MOOSE热工水力模块与SAM的建模概念，支持CPU/GPU、稀疏直接求解与灵敏度计算，并在弹性、回路瞬态、熔盐快堆及反演/控制应用中验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核工程中的热工水力仿真与机器学习/优化耦合时，缺乏原生可微、可与深度学习生态一致的工具；现有参考代码（MOOSE/SAM）不易提供梯度信息，制约了基于梯度的推断、控制与耦合物理-机器学习建模。

Method: 用PyTorch实现原生张量残差，支持CPU/GPU执行、选定数值kernel编译和稀疏直接线性求解；灵敏度通过微分已执行数值操作或收敛残差方程的离散伴随获得；验证采用解析解、参考代码对比和导数校验。

Result: 验证涵盖平面应变弹性、单/双回路热工水力瞬态及轴对称熔盐快堆；与SAM-Lite对比，200个自适应时间步内最大归一化场偏差为1.13×10⁻⁵；瞬态灵敏度用切线线性与固定时间表有限差分评估；残差伴随参数辨识从无噪合成MOOSE观测中恢复泵扬程与加热功率，相对误差低于0.06%；三回路电厂演示通过求解器在环训练预测控制器。

Conclusion: Torch-DPhys为核工程中基于梯度的推断、控制与耦合物理-机器学习模型提供了可微仿真基础，并在测试的离散实现间表现出良好一致性。

Abstract: We present Torch-DPhys, a Torch-native framework implemented in PyTorch for differentiable physics simulation and hybrid physics-machine learning. It implements selected thermal-hydraulic modeling concepts and discretizations from MOOSE's Thermal Hydraulics Module and the System Analysis Module (SAM), with a preliminary extension to continuum mechanics. Native tensor residuals support CPU and GPU execution, compilation of selected numerical kernels, and sparse direct linear solves. Sensitivities are obtained by differentiating executed numerical operations or through discrete adjoints of converged residual equations. Verification combines analytical solutions, reference-code comparisons, and derivative checks. Demonstrations cover plane-strain elasticity, one- and two-loop thermal-hydraulic transients, and an axisymmetric molten-salt fast reactor. For the reactor, comparison with SAM-Lite gives a maximum normalized field discrepancy of 1.13 x 10^-5 over 200 adaptive time steps, demonstrating agreement between the tested discrete implementations. Selected transient sensitivities are assessed using tangent-linear calculations and finite differences on fixed time schedules. Two applications illustrate the framework's connection between simulation and optimization. A residual-adjoint parameter-identification calculation recovers nominal pump head and heating power with relative errors below 0.06% from noiseless synthetic MOOSE observations. A separate three-loop plant demonstration uses solver-in-the-loop training of a predictive controller by differentiating trajectory-level objectives through the thermal-hydraulic simulation. These examples illustrate a foundation for gradient-based inference, control, and coupled physics-machine learning models in nuclear engineering.

</details>


### [815] [Muon Operates Beyond the Edge of Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24305)
*Niko Covic,Baraq Lipshitz,Alexander Padula,Stefan Visnjic*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文用锐度（sharpness）视角研究 Muon 优化器，首次提供经验证据表明平坦极小值假设同样适用于 Muon；并推导其隐式预条件子以分析稳定性边界行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平坦极小值假设（Flat Minima Hypothesis）与基于锐度的稳定性理论（如 Adaptive Edge of Stability）此前主要在 SGD、Adam、RMSprop 等优化器上验证，而 Muon（基于矩阵正交化的优化器）是否遵循相同规律尚不清楚，其稳定性边界也不明确。

Method: 在 CIFAR-10 上进行实验，测量锐度与泛化差距的相关性；推导 Muon 的隐式预条件子（implicit preconditioner），并将其行为与对角预条件的自适应优化器（Adam、RMSprop）的经典锐度阈值进行对比分析。

Result: 在每个优化器内部，锐度与泛化差距强相关（Pearson r = 0.45–0.69，p ≤ 10⁻⁴），表明该假设对 Muon 与 Adam、SGD 一样成立；但 Muon 运行在超过对角预条件优化器所服从的经典 Adaptive Edge of Stability 阈值之上，却仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: Muon 与对角自适应方法处于根本不同的机制区间；Muon 的精确稳定性边界仍是一个开放问题，代码已公开。

Abstract: We study the Muon optimizer using sharpness and provide the first empirical evidence that the Flat Minima Hypothesis also applies to Muon. Further, we derive Muon's implicit preconditioner to analyze its potential Edge of Stability behavior. Experiments on CIFAR-10 show sharpness strongly correlates with generalization gap within each optimizer (Pearson $r = 0.45$-$0.69$, $p \leq 10^{-4}$), confirming the hypothesis holds for Muon similarly to Adam and SGD. However, Muon operates above the classical sharpness-based Adaptive Edge of Stability threshold that bounds diagonally-preconditioned optimizers like Adam and RMSprop, yet remains stable. Our findings suggest Muon operates in a fundamentally different regime than diagonally-adaptive methods. Defining the exact stability boundary for Muon remains an open question. All code is available at https://github.com/NikoCovic/DL-project.

</details>


### [816] [Learning Administrative Boundary-Aware Location Encoders via Reverse Geocoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24306)
*Lakshay Sharma,Alex Marin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个以反向地理编码文本为自监督信号的行政边界感知位置编码器学习方法，可即插即用提升现有编码器，并提出定制架构RevGeoRQ。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置编码器用连续或自然观测数据（影像、气候变量、物种分布）预训练，未显式建模行政区划边界与地名，而二者对现实地理现象影响显著。

Method: 以反向地理编码（reverse-geocoded）文本作为自监督训练信号，方法可嫁接于已有位置编码器架构；进一步设计适配该监督的RevGeoRQ架构，利用残差量化语义ID表示地理位置。

Result: 在多个现有编码器上一致提升下游性能；RevGeoRQ带来额外增益，并在多项下游任务上超越当代位置编码器。

Conclusion: 人类可解释的反向地理编码字符串与残差量化语义ID提供了比现有方法更具可解释性的地理位置表示；代码与权重即将发布。

Abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

</details>


### [817] [Latent State Utilization in Probabilistic Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24315)
*Zilei Shao,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文用互信息分析概率电路（PC）中所学到的依赖关系如何随隐状态规模变化，并以HCLT在ImageNet32上的实验揭示依赖增长缓慢、远低于上界与数据估计，进而提出以早期后验集中度与状态偏好稳定性的测量指导初始化与结构选择，提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在PC中加入隐状态可提升表示能力，但对似然的提升有限（diminishing gains）。作者希望理解隐状态究竟被学习过程如何利用，以及依赖表示是否随隐状态数量有效增长。

Method: 以互信息为工具度量训练后PC所表示的依赖随隐状态规模的变化；在ImageNet32上训练Hidden Chow-Liu Trees（HCLT），并测量每个样本对各隐状态的偏好强度以及状态在数据集上的使用广度，跟踪训练过程中的动态。

Result: 所学依赖随隐状态增加增长缓慢，且明显低于隐状态上界与数据中依赖的估计；训练轨迹显示早期后验快速集中，随后样本相关的状态偏好逐步稳定。基于早期测量可指导HCLT与HMM的初始化选择以及HCLT的树结构选择，在测试的各隐状态规模上均改善最终性能。

Conclusion: 增加隐状态并不自动带来等量的依赖表示能力；通过跟踪隐状态利用度的早期指标，可获得实用的初始化与结构选择策略，从而提升PC类模型的最终性能。

Abstract: Probabilistic circuits (PCs) are generative models that support efficient probabilistic inference. Adding latent states to a PC increases its representational capacity, but yields diminishing gains in likelihood. We use mutual information to examine how the dependence represented by a trained PC changes with latent size. Experiments with Hidden Chow-Liu Trees (HCLTs) on ImageNet32 show that learned dependence grows slowly and remains well below both the latent-state upper bound and estimates of dependence in the data. To understand how learning uses these states, we examine how strongly each sample favors particular latent states and how broadly states are used across the dataset. Tracking these measurements during HCLT training distinguishes rapid early posterior concentration from the more gradual stabilization of sample-dependent state preferences. Early measurements also guide initialization selection in HCLTs and hidden Markov models (HMMs), as well as tree selection in HCLTs. The resulting choices improve the ultimate performance across the tested latent sizes, providing a practical benefit from our study of latent-state utilization.

</details>


### [818] [Morpheus-2.0: Multiscale Probabilistic Forecasting with Dual-Axis Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24321)
*Aakriti,Manoj Cherukumalli,Prathamesh Patil,Leonidas Tsepenekas,Amit Varshney,Penghang Liu,Elizabeth Fons,Vamsi Potluru*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出编码器-only 通用时间序列基础模型 Morpheus-2.0，将目标与协变量置于统一可变时间网格，用逐层并行的双轴注意力+门控+轴感知旋转编码统一跨变量与跨时间关系；训练时随机采样预测长度，单一权重覆盖多horizon；多尺度版本按序列加权多个时间分辨率。在 GIFT-Eval 上以81M参数取得0.685相对MASE，多尺度版取得0.646相对MASE与0.455相对CRPS，两项指标均为已发表系统最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用预测器需同时服务schema、预测horizon与时间分辨率各异的任务：目标与协变量数量随数据集变化，horizon跨越数量级，采样率从秒到年。现有时间序列基础模型仅部分应对：孤立处理单条序列，或将两种网格关系分置于不同模块，且在训练前固定horizon与分辨率。

Method: Morpheus-2.0 为紧凑型encoder-only模型：(1) 将目标与协变量表示在单一variable-time grid上；(2) dual-axis attention在每层并行执行两种关系——同一时间步上的跨变量注意力与单变量内的跨时间注意力，并由学习到的逐层gate加权两者；(3) axis-aware rotary encoding保留两类网格坐标；(4) 训练时采样预测长度，使一套权重覆盖短至长期horizon且不增加推理成本；(5) Multiscale扩展同时建模多个时间分辨率，并按被预测序列进行加权。

Result: 在跨多领域与多频率的GIFT-Eval上，两模型给出互补工作点：Morpheus-2.0以81M参数达到0.685相对MASE；更大的Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale达到0.646相对MASE与0.455相对CRPS，两项指标均为所有已发表系统中的最低值。

Conclusion: 统一variable-time grid上的轴并行注意力与逐层门控、配合轴感知旋转编码、训练期horizon采样与多分辨率加权，可在紧凑参数规模下实现跨schema、跨horizon、跨分辨率的单一通用预测器，并在GIFT-Eval上刷新相对MASE与相对CRPS最优记录。

Abstract: A universal forecaster is trained once and applied everywhere, so it must serve tasks whose schemas, forecast horizons, and temporal resolutions all differ. The number of targets and covariates changes from dataset to dataset, horizons vary by orders of magnitude, and sampling rates range from seconds to years. Existing time-series foundation models address these only in part, since they isolate each series or visit the two grid relations in separate blocks, and they fix the horizon and resolution before training begins. We introduce Morpheus-2.0, a compact encoder-only foundation model that represents targets and covariates on a single variable-time grid. Its dual-axis attention runs both relations side by side in every layer, one across variables at a timestep and one across time within a variable; a learned gate weights the two per layer, and an axis-aware rotary encoding preserves both grid coordinates. The forecast length is sampled during training, so one set of weights spans short to long horizons at no additional inference cost. Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale extends the model to several temporal resolutions at once, weighting them according to the series being forecast. Across GIFT-Eval, which spans several domains and frequencies, the two models give complementary operating points: Morpheus-2.0 attains 0.685 relative MASE with 81M parameters, while the larger Morpheus-2.0 Multiscale attains 0.646 relative MASE and 0.455 relative CRPS, the lowest of any published system on both metrics.

</details>


### [819] [PAC Learning with Query Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24332)
*Chase Hutton,Adam Melrod,Han Shao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带查询反馈的可实现多分类PAC学习，提出"查询维度"D这一组合参数，它刻画假设类结构与查询区分标签能力，并给出样本复杂度上下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在查询反馈学习场景中，每次训练样本仅返回一个二值响应（真实标签是否属于某个查询子集），信息极为有限，需要理解可用的查询族与假设类结构如何共同决定可学习性与样本复杂度。

Method: 引入查询维度（query dimension）这一组合参数，它同时捕获假设类结构与查询族区分标签的能力；在小样本（singleton）查询下退化为bandit DS维度的推广。基于该参数推导样本复杂度的下界Ω(D/ε)与上界Õ(D²/ε)。

Result: 得到下界Ω(D/ε)与上界Õ(D²/ε)（隐藏标签数与失败概率的对数多项式因子）；当查询能将任意候选集近乎均分为两半时，上界改进为Õ(D/ε)，从而在对数因子意义下实现刻画。

Conclusion: 查询维度给出了查询反馈多分类PAC学习的统一复杂度刻画：一般情形下上界与下界相差至多一个D因子，而在可均分查询的有利情形下上下界匹配（至多对数因子），推广并细化了bandit DS维度理论。

Abstract: We study realizable multiclass PAC learning with query feedback, where each training example provides a single binary response indicating whether its true label belongs to a chosen subset from a fixed query family. Our main contribution is the query dimension, a combinatorial parameter that captures both the structure of the hypothesis class and the ability of the available queries to distinguish labels. This parameter generalizes the bandit DS dimension, which it recovers under singleton queries. We establish a sample-complexity lower bound of $Ω(D/\varepsilon)$ and an upper bound of $\widetilde{O}(D^2/\varepsilon)$, suppressing factors polylogarithmic in the number of labels and the failure probability. When the available queries can split every candidate set into two parts of comparable size, we improve the upper bound to $\widetilde{O}(D/\varepsilon)$, yielding a characterization up to logarithmic factors.

</details>


### [820] [Power-Law Correlations Without Apparent Temperature-Tuned Criticality in Fixed-Tree Hierarchical Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24334)
*Marcel Kühn,Bernd Rosenow*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在受控的层级树语法中研究温度采样对长程互信息的影响，发现互信息始终呈幂律包络，未观察到有序相平台或向指数衰减的交叉。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 采样温度会显著改变自回归生成，但温度引起长程相关变化究竟是真实相变还是统计量的平滑变化尚不清楚。作者希望在剥离训练、近似误差与神经架构的受控环境中，厘清层级结构本身能产生哪些温度效应。

Method: 构建固定层级树上的有限深度概率上下文无关文法，用信念传播计算精确的下一词条件分布，再以softmax温度重标定后进行自回归采样；测量token间两点互信息随间隔的变化，并给出到树上Ising模型的近似映射。

Result: 在所测温度与文法集合下，互信息均可由幂律包络良好描述；温度改变相关幅度与拟合指数，但在可达系统尺寸内未出现有序相特征的长程平台，也未出现向短程指数衰减的明显交叉。Ising映射解释了树距离上的指数衰减如何在token距离上表现为幂律，从而使幂律无需调至特殊解码温度即可持续存在。

Conclusion: 该受控基线表明，长程幂律相关可由层级结构单独产生，因而在解释实际语言模型的温度效应时须谨慎归因于相变；训练、近似误差与架构的影响应在此基线上另行叠加研究。

Abstract: Sampling temperature can substantially reshape autoregressive generation, but it is unclear when temperature changes in long-range correlations reflect a genuine phase transition rather than a smooth change in statistics. We study this question in a controlled analogue of temperature sampling: a finite-depth probabilistic context-free grammar on a fixed hierarchical tree, where exact next-token conditionals are computed by belief propagation and then rescaled by a softmax temperature before autoregressive sampling. We measure two-point mutual information between tokens as a function of separation. Across the tested temperatures and grammar ensembles, mutual information remains well described by a power-law envelope. Temperature changes the correlation magnitude and fitted exponent, but within the accessible system sizes we find no long-distance plateau characteristic of an ordered phase and no clear crossover to short-range exponential decay. An approximate mapping to an Ising model on a tree explains how exponential decay in tree distance becomes a power law in token distance, allowing power laws to persist without tuning to a special decoding temperature. This controlled baseline clarifies which temperature effects can arise from hierarchical structure alone, before adding training, approximation error, or neural architecture.

</details>


### [821] [Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24336)
*Noga Alon,Steve Hanneke,Shay Moran,Tom Waknine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文解决了实值函数类一致收敛的尖锐样本复杂度问题：在最优尺度（误差 γ+ε）下，达到与二值类相同的 O(d/ε²) 样本量，其中 d 为尺度 γ 下的 fat-shattering 维数，从而同时实现最优尺度与最优样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二值函数类的 VC 定理刻画了一致收敛，其最坏情况样本复杂度为 Θ(d/ε²)。实值函数对应的组合参数是依赖近似尺度 γ 的 fat-shattering 维数，理想目标是达到误差 γ+ε 且样本量仍为 O(d/ε²)。已有结果只能做到"最优尺度"或"最优样本复杂度"之一，无法兼得，本文旨在弥合这一差距。

Method: 提出三项可独立使用的工具：(1) 带 margin 的 ε-net——允许网只与每个目标集的略微扩大版本相交，该松弛在自然几何场景下可给出与环境维度无关的界；(2) 改进的覆盖界——将 Haussler 覆盖引理推广到 partial concept classes，并据此在最优尺度下得到实值函数类的 ℓ2 覆盖；(3) 通过"对齐"各层覆盖，使相邻近似彼此逐渐靠近，从而在最优尺度下获得 chaining 界。

Result: 在最优尺度（误差 γ+ε）下得到尖锐的样本复杂度上界 O(d/ε²)，与二值类的样本界相匹配，其中 d 为尺度 γ 处的 fat-shattering 维数，首次同时实现最优尺度与最优样本复杂度。

Conclusion: 实值函数类的一致收敛可以在最优尺度下达到与二值类相同的样本复杂度，fat-shattering 维数足以刻画这一问题；所提出的 margin ε-net、partial concept class 覆盖引理与对齐式 chaining 是具有独立价值的通用技术工具。

Abstract: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $γ$. The challenge is to achieve error $γ+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $γ$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. Along the way, we use several tools that may be of independent interest. The first concerns $\varepsilon$-nets with margin. A classical $\varepsilon$-net intersects every set of mass at least $\varepsilon$ in a prescribed family; we allow the net to intersect a slightly enlarged version of each such set. Remarkably, this relaxation permits bounds independent of the ambient dimension in natural geometric settings. Second, we derive improved covering bounds in both discrete and real-valued settings: we extend Haussler's covering lemma to partial concept classes and use this extension to obtain $\ell_2$ covers at the optimal scale for real-valued function classes. Third, we obtain a chaining bound at the optimal scale by aligning the covers so that successive approximations become increasingly close to one another.

</details>


### [822] [The Certification Exponent: Instance-Optimal Sequential Certification of Policy Improvement from History Dependent Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24345)
*Rui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究策略认证的最优样本复杂度：在记录策略已知但与历史相关时，从记录轨迹中构造“新策略更优”证书所需的最小期望episode数由指数$K^\star$刻画，下界为$\log(1/\delta)/K^\star$，并提出达到该速率一阶最优的plug-in Kelly认证器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部署新策略替换旧策略前，需要基于日志轨迹给出其更优的证书。已有方法缺乏对“证书所需episode数”的根本性刻画，尤其在记录策略已知但历史依赖、要求在一致于日志的每个环境中错误概率均低于$\delta$的强保证设定下，缺乏最优速率与可判定性分析。

Method: 定义指数$K^\star$为从记录分布到“记录动作概率相同但目标未改善”的最小KL散度；用反向归纳计算覆盖率，判定$K^\star=0$（不可认证）、有限速率或$\infty$（常数episode可认证）三种情形；通过凸对偶导出最优证书对重要性加权优势下注、同时对记录动作下公平赌注的结构，并据此构造plug-in Kelly认证器与面向大规模树的cushion认证器。

Result: 证明任何可靠认证器期望episode数不少于$\log(1/\delta)/K^\star$，且当$0<K^\star<\infty$时plug-in Kelly在$\delta\to0$下一阶达到该速率；实验中介停止时间为下界的1.13–1.43倍（memory）、1.13–1.51倍（Tiger, $H\le5$）、1.17–1.64倍（随机树），而最佳标量下注基线需1.7–4.1倍，仅少数浅随机树上双重稳健下注快至多18%。

Conclusion: 认证样本复杂度的本质由$K^\star$决定：off-policy估计器的选择不改变$K^\star$，双重稳健控制变量仅作为对冲而非估计器；覆盖率上界解释了记忆诅咒，结构假设可按指数单位定价，为策略认证提供了理论最优的速率框架与实用算法。

Abstract: Before a new policy replaces a deployed one, we often want a certificate, computed from logged episodes, that it is better. We ask how many episodes such a certificate needs when the logging policy is known but history-dependent, and the error probability must stay below $δ$ in every environment consistent with the logs. The answer is an exponent $K^\star$: the smallest KL divergence from the logged law to a law with the same logged action probabilities under which the target does not improve. No sound certifier stops in fewer than $\log(1/δ)/K^\star$ expected episodes, at any $δ$, and whenever $0<K^\star<\infty$ a plug-in Kelly certifier attains this rate to first order as $δ\to0$. Coverage, computed by one backward induction, decides whether certification is impossible ($K^\star=0$), possible at a finite rate, or possible in a constant number of episodes ($K^\star=\infty$). By convex duality, the optimal certificate bets on the importance-weighted advantage and also places fair bets on the logged actions, so doubly robust control variates act as hedges rather than estimators. As a consequence, no choice of off-policy estimator changes $K^\star$, a coverage ceiling explains the curse of memory, and structural assumptions can be priced in exponent units. A cushion certifier extends the approach to trees too large to enumerate. In experiments the plug-in's median stopping time is 1.13-1.43x the lower bound on memory tasks, 1.13-1.51x on Tiger ($H\le5$) and 1.17-1.64x on random trees. The best scalar betting baselines need up to 2.65x (memory) and 4.1x (Tiger) the plug-in's episodes; only on a few shallow random trees is a doubly robust bet faster, by at most 18%.

</details>


### [823] [Measuring the Task Value of Precision Upgrades in Closed-Loop Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24346)
*Sicheng Lyu,Xinyu Wang,Yu Gu,Lei Ding,Ziyang Song,Xiao-Wen Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 低精度智能体可在选定决策处调用全精度(BF16)模型作为回退，但插入的BF16动作既可能挽救失败任务，也可能破坏成功任务。作者主张以“挽救数−破坏数”的带符号任务收益、针对实际执行的干预方式、并对照同精度参照来评估回退价值。实验在tau2-bench上用Qwen3智能体（模拟4-bit权重）通过配对分支分离“替换动作”“接管后续执行”与两者兼具三种效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式精度路由器以端到端成功率为判据选择回退位置，但单个BF16动作的插入对任务结果可能双向影响（救活失败任务或破坏成功任务），仅凭成功率无法反映真实净收益，故需建立更严谨的评价口径。

Method: 在恢复的状态处运行配对分支，交叉“当前动作由哪个模型提供”与“后续由哪个模型继续”，从而分离三类效应：(1)仅替换单个动作；(2)接管后续执行；(3)两者兼具。在tau2-bench上用Qwen3智能体与模拟4-bit权重进行实验，并设置两类同精度参照：用另一4-bit检查点替换动作，以及在工具调用不变的情况下重排工具参数键顺序。另测试冻结的不确定性触发与随机选择的对比。

Result: 在两模型工具使用存在分歧处替换首个动作会改变大量任务结果，但挽救与破坏几乎相互抵消，且在留出的telecom任务上仅替换动作的估计为负。同时替换动作与后续执行，仅在5个探索性更低比特压力设置中的2个取得正净增益。同比特宽度参照同样改变结果：用第二个4-bit检查点替换动作所改变的结果数量与用BF16替换相当；重排工具参数键顺序在工具调用完全相同的情况下也改变了结果。在公共状态上，BF16动作相对该检查点的额外价值仍未确定。冻结不确定性触发找到的结果变化多于随机选择，但净收益仍在随机选择区间内。

Conclusion: 回退评估应采用“预期后续执行下的带符号任务收益”，并以同精度参照为基准，在将收益归因于更高比特精度之前先行验证；否则易高估全精度回退的价值。

Abstract: A low-precision agent can call its full-precision (BF16) model at selected decisions as a fallback. A learned precision router chooses where to call it from the disagreement between the two models and is judged by end-to-end success. An inserted BF16 action, however, can rescue a failing task or damage a succeeding one. We argue that a fallback's value is the number of tasks it saves minus the number it spoils, measured for the intervention that will actually run. From restored states, we run paired branches that cross which model supplies the current action with which model continues, separating replacement of one action, takeover of later execution, and both. On Qwen3 agents with simulated 4-bit weights in tau2-bench, replacing the first action where the two models differed in tool use changed many task outcomes, but rescues and damages nearly cancelled, and on held-out telecom tasks the action-only estimate was negative. Replacing both the action and the continuation had a positive net gain in two of five exploratory lower-bit stress settings. Two references changed outcomes at fixed bit width: replacing an action with that of a second 4-bit checkpoint changed about as many outcomes as replacing it with the BF16 action, and reordering tool-argument keys changed outcomes while the executed tool call stayed identical. At common states, the additional value of the BF16 action over that checkpoint remained unresolved. A frozen uncertainty trigger found more outcome changes than random selection, while its net benefit stayed within the range of random selection. We recommend evaluating each fallback by its signed task benefit under the intended continuation, against same-precision references, before attributing gains to more bits.

</details>


### [824] [Exact Risk Certificates for Pairwise-Judged Reranking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24347)
*Xinyu Wang,Jingrui Tian,Sicheng Lyu,Yu Gu,Ziyang Song,Xiao-Wen Chang,Lei Ding*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究成对相关性判定对nDCG分子与理想排序分母的耦合约束，刻画用固定提案替换排序时的精确最坏损失，并给出阈值验证与带证据的收益界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对判定同时影响nDCG的损失分子与理想排序分母，现有方法未精确分离这种分母耦合效应，也缺乏可审计的最坏情形保证。

Method: 刻画固定提案替换排序的精确最坏损失；证明二元增益即可达到该界并提供可检视的见证；将阈值验证归约为至多K+1个最大闭包问题；设计"曝光-流量"消融实验隔离分母耦合，并引入预测性门控与证书机制。

Result: 在共享判定轨迹下，预算32时精确验证每TREC-DL开发查询节省2.34次比较、每确认查询节省1.98次；节省效应可迁移至BEIR与第二个提案方；预测性门控获得更高部署收益，证书给出可接受比较下仍允许的最坏增益。

Conclusion: 成对判定下的nDCG最坏损失可精确刻画并高效验证，分母耦合是评估节省的核心来源；验证证书可在保证可靠性的同时显著降低判定成本。

Abstract: Pairwise relevance judgments constrain both the loss numerator and the ideal-ranking denominator of nDCG. We characterize the exact worst-case loss of replacing a ranking with a fixed proposal. Binary gains attain this loss and provide an inspectable witness. Threshold verification reduces to at most $K+1$ maximum-closure problems. Our exposure-flow ablation isolates denominator coupling: on shared judge trajectories, exact verification saves 2.34 comparisons per TREC-DL development query and 1.98 per confirmation query at a budget of 32. Savings transfer to BEIR and a second proposer. Predictive gates achieve higher deployment gains, while certificates expose the worst gains still permitted by accepted comparisons.

</details>


### [825] [Revisiting Smoothed Online Learning: Competitive Ratio, Dynamic Regret with Switching Cost, and Best of Both Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24370)
*Lijun Zhang,Linzhe He,Wei Jiang,Shiyin Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视平滑在线学习（smoothed online learning），针对命中成本与切换成本之和的竞争比、带切换成本的动态遗憾以及best-of-both-worlds保证，提出改进的算法与匹配的下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有平滑在线学习算法的竞争比、动态遗憾界不够优，且部分保证依赖有界梯度假设；作者希望缩小与下界的差距，去掉有界梯度假设，并同时获得最优动态遗憾与best-of-both-worlds保证。

Method: 1) 对α-多面体函数（ℓ2切换成本）证明仅最小化命中成本即达max(1,2/α)竞争比；2) 对λ-二次增长函数（平方ℓ2切换成本）证明1+4/λ竞争比；3) 对凸λ-二次增长命中成本，采用命中成本与平方ℓ2切换成本的加权和求解，得1+2/√λ竞争比；4) 提出Smoothed Ader（SAder）及lookahead版本；5) 在lookahead设定下提出UDNP以聚合两个专家。

Result: 多面体情形竞争比max(1,2/α)对该朴素算法是紧的，并给出α≥1的匹配下界；SAder在标准OCO中达到最优O(√(T(1+P_T)))率，其lookahead版本去除有界梯度假设并有匹配下界证明最优性；UDNP的额外累计成本相对第一个专家至多O(1)、相对第二个专家至多O(√(T log T))，在无有界梯度下实现best-of-both-worlds。

Conclusion: 通过更精细的分析与算法设计，平滑在线学习在竞争比、动态遗憾及best-of-both-worlds方面均可显著改进并达到（或逼近）下界最优；朴素的最小化命中成本策略已具备强竞争性，加权策略与lookahead机制可进一步去除有界梯度假设。

Abstract: We revisit smoothed online learning and develop algorithms with improved competitive ratios, optimal dynamic regret with switching cost, and best-of-both-worlds guarantees. Surprisingly, minimizing the hitting cost alone is $\max(1,\frac{2}α)$-competitive for $α$-polyhedral functions under the $\ell_2$-norm switching cost and $1+\frac{4}λ$-competitive for $λ$-quadratic growth functions under the squared $\ell_2$-norm switching cost, significantly improving existing guarantees. The polyhedral bound is tight for this naive algorithm, and we establish a matching lower bound for $α\geq1$. For convex $λ$-quadratic growth hitting costs, minimizing a suitably weighted sum of hitting and squared $\ell_2$-norm switching costs yields a competitive ratio of $1+\frac{2}{\sqrtλ}$. For dynamic regret with the $\ell_2$-norm switching cost, we develop Smoothed Ader (SAder), which achieves the optimal $O(\sqrt{T(1+P_T)})$ rate in the standard online convex optimization setting, where $P_T$ is the comparator's path-length. Its lookahead version removes the bounded-gradient assumption, and a matching lower bound establishes optimality in this setting. Finally, for convex hitting costs on a bounded convex domain, we develop UDNP to aggregate any two experts in the lookahead setting under both switching costs. Its additional cumulative cost is at most $O(1)$ relative to the first expert and $O(\sqrt{T\log T})$ relative to the second, yielding best-of-both-worlds guarantees without bounded gradients.

</details>


### [826] [Cross-Dimension and Cross-Modality Relational Tensor Representation Learning for Multimodal Health Data Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24419)
*Jiawei Guo,Meng Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出关系张量表示（RTR）统一框架，联合学习维度特定张量表示及跨维度、跨模态关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态健康数据源于异构临床来源，为数据驱动决策提供机会，但需有效建模模态内部与模态之间的复杂依赖关系。

Method: 引入可学习的关系桥接矩阵，在保持张量各维度与各模态结构身份的同时维持关系信息；并通过结构化融合机制将因子级与关系级信息整合为紧凑表示用于下游预测。

Result: 在模拟数据及两个多模态神经生理数据集（情绪识别与脑活动分类）上，RTR 一致优于代表性张量学习、多模态融合及 Transformer 基线。

Conclusion: 显式建模跨维度与跨模态关系对从异构多模态张量数据中学习信息性表示具有重要价值；源代码计划开源以支持可复现性与后续研究。

Abstract: Multimodal health data integrate information from heterogeneous clinical sources, creating substantial opportunities for data-driven decision support. Realizing these opportunities, however, requires effectively modeling complex dependencies that arise both within individual modalities and across modalities. This paper proposes Relational Tensor Representation (RTR), a unified framework that jointly learns dimension-specific tensor representations and cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships. RTR introduces learnable relational bridge matrices that maintain relational information while preserving the structural identities of tensor dimensions and modalities. A structured fusion mechanism further integrates factor-level and relationship-level information into compact representations for downstream prediction. Experiments on simulated data and two multimodal neurophysiological datasets, covering emotion recognition and brain activity classification, demonstrate that RTR consistently outperforms representative tensor learning, multimodal fusion, and Transformer-based baselines. These results highlight the value of explicitly modeling cross-dimensional and cross-modality relationships for learning informative representations from heterogeneous multimodal tensor data. The source code is planned for public release to support reproducibility and future research.

</details>


### [827] [Transport What Shares the Conduction Pathway: Normal-Anchored SPD Geometric Transport for Source-Free Patient Adaptation of Holter and Patch ECG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24430)
*JinKook Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT)，用每段记录前5分钟无标签的正常心拍锚点估计闭式SPD全等映射，仅校正正常与室上性原型，解决源无关域适应在类不平衡真实ECG上失效的问题，在Icentia11k上心律失常宏F1由34.5%提升至48.7%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ECG心拍分类器在新患者与新设备上精度下降；现有源无关自适应(如AdaBN、Tent、T3A)假设目标批次类平衡，而真实记录的无标签前缀中87.9–98.6%为正常心拍，导致原型偏移与伪标签偏差，适应失效。

Method: NAGT(GA_NS)：从每段记录前5分钟的无标签片段中提取正常心拍锚点，闭式求解对称正定(SPD)全等映射，并将其仅作用于正常与室上性原型，室性与融合原型保持冻结；引入速率不变的RR头(relA)；阈值偏移与决策规则仅在MIT-BIH上设定，冻结模型后在Icentia11k上按预注册协议一次性评估；无需反向传播。

Result: 493名患者、973段记录、3,615,388个心拍：J=½(S-F1+V-F1) 为48.7%[95%CI 42.1–54.7]，无适应为34.5%(ΔJ=+14.1pp[+8.6,+19.3])；非AF亚组59.8% vs 43.9%；经Holm校正优于全部五个对照方法；历史划分的75例测试亚组(分析73例)增益不显著(+6.1pp[-8.5,+23.4])；每段记录适应中位耗时5.8ms。

Conclusion: 以类先验极不平衡的现实约束为出发点，正常锚点+SPD几何传输可在无源、无反向传播条件下显著提升跨域ECG心律失常检测，且计算开销极低；但在小样本亚组上增益未达显著，需更大规模验证其泛化性与统计稳健性。

Abstract: Electrocardiogram (ECG) beat classifiers lose accuracy on new patients and devices, and source-free adaptation methods that assume class-balanced target batches fail on real recordings, whose label-free prefix is 87.9--98.6% normal beats. We propose Normal-Anchored Geometric Transport (NAGT, GA_NS), which estimates a closed-form symmetric positive-definite congruence map from label-free normal anchors in the first 5 min of each recording and applies it only to the normal and supraventricular prototypes, keeping the ventricular and fusion prototypes fixed. The score offsets and decision rules were set on MIT-BIH only; the rate-invariant RR head (relA) was adopted after the development databases (INCART, SVDB) had been opened; the frozen model was then evaluated once on Icentia11k chest-patch recordings under a pre-registered protocol. In 493 patients (973 recordings, 3,615,388 evaluated beats), NAGT reached an arrhythmia macro-$F_1$ $J = \frac{1}{2}(\text{S-}F_1 + \text{V-}F_1) = 48.7\%$ [95% CI 42.1, 54.7] versus 34.5% without adaptation ($ΔJ = +14.1$ [+8.6, +19.3] pp; 59.8% versus 43.9% in non-AF) and outperformed all five Holm-adjusted comparators, including AdaBN, Tent and T3A. In the 75-patient test subgroup of the historical split (73 analyzed), the gain was not significant (+6.1 [-8.5, +23.4] pp). Adaptation takes a median of 5.8 ms per record without back-propagation.

</details>


### [828] [Transformers as Adaptive Kernel Learners across Tasks for In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24441)
*Zhaiming Shen,Alexander Cloninger,Rongjie Lai,Wenjing Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文论证Transformer可视为自适应各向异性核学习器：在低秩线性与多指标非线性回归中，学到的注意力得分逼近oracle核，并给出浅宽Transformer实现oracle核估计器的显式构造与泛化误差框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论工作把注意力机制与核方法相联系以解释上下文学习（ICL），但通常假设核函数固定；而实际中查询矩阵与键矩阵是训练得到的，使注意力具备自适应核方法的能力，这一自适应性质缺乏理论与数值刻画。

Method: 研究低秩线性回归与多指标非线性回归下的ICL；通过数值模拟检验学到的注意力得分与相应函数类的oracle核的相似性；建立将Transformer与各类函数类的oracle核估计器相联系的通用框架，并利用宽而浅的Transformer结构给出oracle核估计器的显式构造性实现，分析ICL的泛化误差，刻画查询token与上下文token的交互如何完成预测。

Result: 数值实验显示学到的注意力得分与oracle核高度接近；理论给出各函数类oracle核估计器在浅宽Transformer中的显式构造，并由此得到ICL泛化误差分析。

Conclusion: 注意力机制能够在线性与非线性设定下自适应地适配各向异性核，为ICL的核视角提供了数值与理论证据，补充了既有将核函数视为固定的研究。

Abstract: Transformers have emerged as a dominant architecture in modern machine learning, with in-context learning (ICL) enabling models to adapt to new tasks by conditioning on prompts, without any parameter updates. To understand the attention mechanism in transformer blocks, a growing line of theoretical work interprets ICL through the lens of classical statistical estimators. Recent works have established a connection between the attention mechanism and kernel methods, while the kernel function is usually assumed to be fixed. In practice, the query and key matrices in the attention mechanism are trained, which allows the attention mechanism to serve as an adaptive kernel method. In this work, we demonstrate that transformers can act as adaptive anisotropic kernel learners. Specifically, we study ICL for low-rank linear and multi-index nonlinear regressions, and conduct numerical simulations to show that the learned attention scores closely resemble the oracle kernels for these function classes. We then develop a general framework to analyze the generalization error of ICL by connecting transformers to the oracle kernel estimator for each function class. Our theory gives an explicit and constructive implementation of the oracle kernel estimators for these function classes using a wide and shallow transformer architecture, illustrating how the prediction is carried out by the interaction between the query token and the context tokens. Our work complements existing studies by providing numerical and theoretical evidence of how the attention mechanism adapts to anisotropic kernels in both linear and nonlinear settings.

</details>


### [829] [Near-Optimal Regret for Semi-Bandit Learning of Monotone Stochastic Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24446)
*Zhengjia Zhuo,Viswanath Nagarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究未知分布下单调随机优化问题的最优策略学习，提出在半赌博反馈下的通用算法，将后悔界提升至 O~(√(nkT))（弱单调）与 O~(√(nT))（强单调），较先前结果改进 √n 倍，并达到理论下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的随机优化问题（如先知不等式、潘多拉魔盒、串行测试、随机背包、随机匹配）通常假设真实分布已知，而实际中分布未知，需要在学习过程中同时优化策略。已有的学习算法后悔界存在额外 √n 的差距，且缺乏适用于一大类“单调”问题的统一框架。

Method: 在每期执行一个策略并仅观察到被选中随机变量的样本（半赌博反馈）。针对一大类“单调”随机问题设计通用学习算法；核心技术是用 Hellinger 距离来度量真实分布与学习分布之间的“误差”，并利用依赖随机变量间 Hellinger 距离的常数因子链式法则进行误差传播与分解。

Result: 对弱单调问题获得 O~(√(nkT)) 后悔，对强单调问题获得 O~(√(nT)) 后悔，其中 T 为轮数、n 为随机变量数、k 为单个随机变量最大支撑集大小。相比此前界改进 √n 倍，且 n 与 T 的依赖已达到多臂赌博机 Ω(√(nT)) 下界所决定的最优性。

Conclusion: 该工作为一大类单调随机优化问题提供了统一且近似最优的策略学习算法，其 Hellinger 距离与链式法则的分析工具具有通用性，可作为处理半赌博反馈下依赖随机变量学习的有效范式。

Abstract: We consider the task of learning an (approximately) optimal policy for stochastic optimization problems where the true distributions are unknown. In each period, the algorithm plays a policy for the stochastic problem and observes semi-bandit feedback, i.e., it only receives new samples from the random variables that were selected by the policy. We obtain an algorithm that works for a large class of ``monotone'' stochastic problems, including prophet inequality, Pandora's box, series testing, stochastic knapsack and stochastic matching. We obtain $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nkT})$ regret for ``weakly'' monotone problems and $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{nT})$ regret for ``strongly'' monotone problems, where $T$ is the number of periods, $n$ is the problem dimension (number of random variables) and $k$ is the maximum support size of any random variable. This improves over previous regret bounds by a $\sqrt{n}$ factor. In fact, our dependence on $n$ and $T$ is the best-possible due the $Ω(\sqrt{nT})$ lower bound for multi-armed-bandits. Our main technique is the use of Hellinger distance in bounding the ``error'' between the true and learned distributions, and the use of a constant-factor chain rule for the Hellinger distance of dependent random variables.

</details>


### [830] [Generative Retrieval for Reverse Target Fishing with a Proteome-Scale Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24458)
*Zhichao Deng,Haichuan Tan,Xin Hong,Huaizhi Wang,Tao Huang,Bowen Gao,Yanyan Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出将反向靶点垂钓（reverse target fishing）重构为生成式检索任务，并给出生成模型GenFish与蛋白质组规模基准ProTargetBench，在三大全目录检索指标上均优于判别式与非神经基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反向靶点垂钓（由查询分子识别蛋白靶点）对药物发现与再利用至关重要。现有判别式方法沿用虚拟筛选范式，面临关联稀疏、长尾分布以及非随机缺失（MNAR）测量问题：把未记录配对当作负样本会压制真实靶点。

Method: 1）将任务重述为生成式检索；2）用残差向量量化（RVQ）把冻结的蛋白语言模型特征转换为共享语义标识符（码序列）；3）GenFish 以分子指纹为条件，自回归建模当前码依赖查询与前序码，按标识符似然对蛋白排序，无需显式将未记录配对标为负；4）构建 ProTargetBench：覆盖20,431个UniProt审阅人类蛋白，融合精选生物活性证据，区分实验失活与未测量关联，同时支持测定面板判别与全目录召回。

Result: 在198个留出分子上，GenFish在全部三项全目录检索指标上平均表现高于4个判别式神经基线和3个非神经基线（含配体方法）；受控"正样本隐藏"实验显示，定向移除假负竞争比匹配随机掩码更能提升对比检索，且在同等不完整监督下GenFish仍更强；Pfam比对表明语义标识符捕获了有生物学意义的蛋白关系。

Conclusion: 生成式检索是在不完整生物活性记录下开展反向靶点垂钓的合理范式。

Abstract: Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. Covering 20,431 UniProt-reviewed human proteins, it integrates curated bioactivity evidence and distinguishes experimental inactivity from unmeasured associations. On 198 held-out molecules, GenFish achieves higher mean performance across all three full-catalogue retrieval metrics than four discriminative neural baselines and three non-neural baselines, including ligand-based methods. A controlled positive-hiding experiment shows that targeted removal of false-negative competition improves contrastive retrieval beyond matched random masking; GenFish remains stronger under the same incomplete supervision. Pfam alignment indicates that the semantic identifiers capture biologically meaningful relationships among proteins. These results establish generative retrieval as a principled paradigm for reverse target fishing under incomplete bioactivity records.

</details>


### [831] [Measuring Empowerment from Offline Data for Intrinsically Motivated Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24461)
*Ishir Garg,Vivek Myers,Qiyang Li,Catherine Ji,Benjamin Eysenbach,Sergey Levine*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出首个仅从无标签先验数据、无需环境交互即可估计empowerment的方法，通过联合学习最大化empowerment的策略及其折现状态占据度量，并用于提升在线目标条件强化学习中的探索效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体任务（如机器人、编程）中已有大量无标签先验数据，常见做法是先离线训练策略再做在线rollout改进。现有工作多关注如何利用离线与在线数据做策略提取，却很少研究如何用先验数据在在线阶段高效探索。此前用empowerment（智能体可实现的未来状态数量）来形式化探索需求，但现有empowerment估计方法都依赖在线环境rollout。

Method: 联合学习一个最大化empowerment的策略与其折现状态占据度量（discounted state-occupancy measure），从而可从任意未知策略生成的无标签轨迹上训练empowerment估计器，全程无需环境交互。

Result: 所提估计器在定性上给出符合直觉的empowerment度量；预训练的估计器可用于改善在线目标条件强化学习（goal-conditioned RL）中的探索。

Conclusion: 离线估计empowerment可行且无需环境交互，可作为先验知识提升在线目标条件强化学习的探索效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Large, unlabeled datasets of prior experience have become increasingly available for agentic tasks in domains such as robotics and coding. A common recipe for these tasks is to train a policy using the prior data, and then further improve it with online rollouts. But while much work has studied how to use both the offline and online data for policy extraction, far less work has been done to understand how the prior data can be used to efficiently \textit{explore} during the online learning phase. Previous work has attempted to formalize this idea by defining the \textit{empowerment}, a measure of how many future states an agent can realize; states with higher empowerment require more exploration as there are more futures to explore. However, existing methods for estimating empowerment require online policy rollouts in the environment. We propose the first method for estimating empowerment from unlabeled prior data, without any environment interaction. By jointly learning an empowerment-maximizing policy together with its discounted state-occupancy measure, our estimator can be trained on unlabeled trajectories generated from any unknown policy. We demonstrate that our empowerment estimator qualitatively gives intuitive empowerment measures and show that the pretrained estimator can be used to improve exploration in the online goal-conditioned reinforcement learning setting. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/ishirgarg/offline-empowerment}.

</details>


### [832] [VBO-MI: A Differentiable Black-Box Optimization Framework via Variational Mutual Information Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24491)
*Farhad Mirkarimi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 VBO-MI：一种完全基于梯度的贝叶斯优化框架，不依赖高斯先验或变分后验族，用 actor-critic 实现端到端优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向仅可通过带噪评估访问的昂贵黑箱函数优化。现有 GP 方法计算复杂度随观测数呈三次增长，BNN 方法依赖昂贵后验采样（如 HMC）及高维下的内层采集函数优化，故需更高效的替代方案。

Method: VBO-MI 不做高斯先验或 f 的变分后验族假设；内部采用 actor-critic：action-net 在输入空间导航，variational critic 估计用于探索的代理信息信号；并设计基于 replay buffer 的轻量代理模型从观测数据近似目标，使每次迭代仅需一批真实函数查询，从而实现端到端梯度流。作者给出训练目标收敛、代理估计器收敛及近优解存在性的理论分析。

Result: 在高维合成函数及 Rover 轨迹规划优化、Lunar Lander、Pest Control 等真实任务上评测，VBO-MI 的优化性能与各类基线持平或更优。

Conclusion: VBO-MI 以纯梯度驱动、无先验/后验族假设、低查询预算的方式实现了有效的高维黑箱优化，具备理论保证与实证优势。

Abstract: Many real-world tasks require optimizing expensive black-box functions accessible only through noisy evaluations, a setting commonly addressed with Bayesian optimization. While Gaussian processes(GPs) and Bayesian neural networks have driven significant progress, GP-based methods scale cubically with observations, and BNN-based approaches remain burdened by expensive posterior sampling such as Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, and inner-loop acquisition optimization in high-dimensional setting. In this work, we propose VBO-MI, a fully gradient-based BO framework that requires no assumptions on a Gaussian prior or a variational posterior family over $f$. While our framework uses gradient-based updates to train the internal action and information-estimation networks, it treats the objective function $f$ as a strict black box, requiring only zeroth-order evaluations. To enable end-to-end gradient flow, we employ an actor-critic architecture consisting of an action-net to navigate the input space and a variational critic to estimate a surrogate information signal for exploration. Additionally, we design a lightweight surrogate that approximates the objective from observed data using a replay buffer, which reduces the total required real function queries to one batch per iteration. We provide theoretical analysis for our framework, establishing convergence of its training objective and surrogate estimator, and showing, that near-optimal solutions exist. We evaluate our method on a diverse suite of benchmarks, including high-dimensional synthetic function and complex real-world tasks such as Rover Trajectory planning optimization, the Lunar Lander, and Pest Control problems. Our experiments demonstrate that VBO-MI provides the same or superior optimization performance over the various baselines.

</details>


### [833] [CoTs remain monitorable when being unfaithful requires computation: Replicating and Extending the Necessity Effect Across Eleven Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24495)
*Arav Dhoot,Yixiong Hao,Zephaniah Roe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文跨6个模型家族11个模型复现了Emmons et al.(2025)的代理任务，发现"CoT必要性效应"可泛化：简单线索普遍被遵循，而复杂线索的隐蔽遵循在各模型上退化为接近无提示基线；并将研究扩展到5类线索、3个难度级别，发现CoT必要性与不忠实性的关系因任务和模型而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作表明CoT内容不总忠实反映推理过程；Emmons et al.(2025)发现模型可在不披露的情况下遵循问题提示，但仅基于Gemini模型且数据与代码闭源，缺乏可复现性与跨模型验证。

Method: 在六个模型家族的十一个模型上复现其代理任务（proxy task），比较简单线索与复杂线索下的提示遵循率与无提示基线；进一步将研究扩展到五类线索家族（其中四类为新增）与三个难度级别，测量CoT必要性（CoT-necessity）与不忠实性（unfaithfulness）。

Result: 必要性效应具有泛化性：所有模型在简单线索下均高于无提示基线，而多数模型对复杂线索的隐蔽遵循回落到接近基线水平；CoT必要性与不忠实性之间的关系具有任务与模型特异性；对某些提示类型，即使提示可在单次前向传播中解码，模型仍常将提示遵循行为言语化。

Conclusion: 结果支持"当不安全行为需要非平凡计算时，CoT监控是有效的"这一主张，同时表明CoT不忠实性的性质对模型与实验设置高度敏感。

Abstract: While a LLM's chain of thought (CoT) is a promising approach to interpreting model outputs, prior work shows CoT's content does not always accurately reflect the reasoning process. Emmons et al. (2025) finds that models can follow a question hint without revealing so in its chain of thought, but when the hint is sufficiently complex the computation is forced into the CoT. This claim, however, has only been tested on Gemini models, and the datasets and code is closed source. We replicate their proxy task across eleven models from six families and find the necessity effect generalizes. Every model follows simple cues above a no-hint baseline, while concealed complex-cue following falls back near baseline for most models. We also extend the study from Emmons et al. (2025) to measure CoT-necessity and unfaithfulness across five cue families (four of them new) and three difficulty levels. The relationship between when CoT is necessary and unfaithfulness is task-specific and model-specific. For some hint types, models often verbalize their hint-following behavior even when the hint can be decoded in a single forward pass. These results support the case for CoT monitoring when unsafe behavior requires non-trivial computation, and that properties of CoT unfaithfulness are sensitive to model and setting.

</details>


### [834] [TideKV: Delayed KV Eviction via Layer-Wise Chunked Prefill for Memory-Efficient Long-Context LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24499)
*Yu Wang,Zhu Wang,Ning Hu,Yifan Guo,Xiu Ma,Bin Guo,Zhiwen Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TideKV：按层（layer-major）延迟驱逐的GPU上KV缓存构建架构，在各Transformer层内处理全部prompt块、仅保留当前层全prompt KV，并在层末驱逐，从而降低prefill峰值内存而不损失缓存质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文LLM推理受限于prompt prefill阶段的峰值内存。现有KV缓存压缩主要降低解码内存，但通常需全prompt prefill以保留全局上下文，构建峰值仍高；在线chunk级驱逐虽更早降内存，却在每层尚未见完整prompt前就做选择，可能损害缓存构建与解码质量。

Method: 提出TideKV：GPU上缓存构建架构，采用layer-major延迟驱逐调度——在每个Transformer层内处理所有prompt chunk，仅为活跃层保留全prompt KV，并在层结束时执行驱逐。该调度既保证选择时具备全prompt视野，又减少激活与临时内存占用。

Result: 在多个计算平台实验：保持所评估压缩方法的推理质量与最终缓存大小。A100上64K时构建期瞬态内存降低83.89%；RTX 4090上64K时TTFT仅增加1.06%，并支持128K prefill；Jetson上完成128K，而对照的post-prefill压缩在两个资源受限平台均OOM。

Conclusion: 延迟至层末驱逐可在不牺牲缓存效用的前提下显著扩展可行上下文长度。

Abstract: Long-context large language model (LLM) inference is important for modern intelligent applications but remains constrained by peak memory during prompt prefill. Existing KV cache compression reduces decoding memory but typically requires full-prompt prefill to preserve global context, retaining a high construction peak. Online chunk-level eviction lowers memory earlier but selects before each layer has observed the complete prompt, potentially degrading cache construction and decoding. We present TideKV, an on-GPU cache-construction architecture using layer-major delayed eviction. TideKV processes all prompt chunks within each Transformer layer, retains full-prompt KV only for the active layer, and evicts at layer end. This schedule preserves full-prompt-aware selection while reducing activation and temporary memory. Experiments across multiple computing platforms show that TideKV preserves the inference quality and final cache size of the evaluated compression methods. At 64K on A100, it reduces the construction-time transient footprint by 83.89%. On RTX 4090, it increases time to first token by only 1.06% at 64K and enables 128K prefill. TideKV also completes 128K on Jetson, whereas matched post-prefill compression runs out of memory on both resource-constrained platforms. These results show that delayed layer-end eviction substantially expands feasible context lengths without sacrificing cache utility.

</details>


### [835] [HiPPO Functional Memory: Coordinate-Queryable Attention for Irregular Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24501)
*Zhaodong Guo,Haoyun Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 HiPPO-FM，一种函数记忆注意力算子，将不规则时间序列历史编译为可复用、可坐标寻址的状态，通过固定秩函数空间写入观测并以匹配的函数几何实现直接的坐标求值，在重建、表征学习、外推与事件序列预测上均优于强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有不规则时间序列模型通常保留依赖观测的表征，每次任意坐标的时序查询都需重复解析，计算冗余且难以复用；缺乏对任意坐标直接求值的统一机制。

Method: 将观测写入固定秩函数空间，避免存储按观测索引的 token 或潜轨迹；采用核平滑的 HiPPO 坐标与基于 Gram 的读出构成共享的写/读机制；在压缩前使用观测支撑自注意力以获得内容相关表征；刻画诱导的有限维查询空间，并推导将函数几何近似误差与学习记忆失配分离的误差分解。

Result: 在连续坐标重建、不规则表征学习、真实世界外推和事件序列预测四类任务上稳定提升强基线：Spiral 重建精度高，20 个 UEA 数据集上具竞争力，真实外推改进，多个不规则事件基准结果领先；编码后紧凑函数状态可跨不同查询集复用而无需重处理历史。

Conclusion: HiPPO-FM 以坐标可寻址的函数记忆统一了写入与读取，实现了对任意时序坐标的高效直接求值与状态复用，兼顾表达力与计算效率，并提供理论误差分析支撑。

Abstract: Irregular time series require models to answer temporal queries at arbitrary coordinates, yet existing approaches typically retain observation-dependent representations that must be repeatedly resolved for each query. We introduce HiPPO Functional Memory (HiPPO-FM), a functional-memory attention operator that compiles an irregular history into a reusable coordinate-addressable state. Instead of storing observation-indexed tokens or latent trajectories, HiPPO-FM writes observations into a fixed-rank functional space and performs direct coordinate evaluation through matched functional geometry. Kernel-smoothed HiPPO coordinates and Gram-based readout define a shared write/read mechanism, while observed-support self-attention enables content-dependent representations before compression. We characterize the induced finite-dimensional query space and derive an error decomposition separating functional geometry approximation from learned-memory mismatch. Across continuous-coordinate reconstruction, irregular representation learning, real-world extrapolation, and event-sequence prediction, HiPPO-FM consistently improves strong irregular time-series baselines, achieving strong reconstruction accuracy on Spiral, competitive performance across 20 UEA datasets, improved real-world extrapolation, and superior results on several irregular event benchmarks. After encoding, the compact functional state can be reused across different query sets without reprocessing the observation history.

</details>


### [836] [BEM: Learning Bregman Divergences for Concept Erasure in Flow Matching Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24508)
*Mohamed-Hicham Leghettas,Markus Püschel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BEM：首个通过双层优化学习Bregman散度损失的流匹配概念擦除方法，在FLUX/SD3上对血腥暴力等概念擦除更彻底，但保留能力有好有坏。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对FLUX、SD3等流匹配模型的概念擦除方法，均在欧氏损失下将模型微调至引导教师的velocity场；但平方距离只是Bregman散度族中的一员，而Bregman散度恰恰是流匹配能恢复正确速度场的损失族，不同散度对"擦除什么、保留什么"的影响各异。作者希望利用这一自由度实现更优的擦除—保留权衡。

Method: 提出BEM（Bregman erasure matching）：在流匹配框架下用Bregman散度替代欧氏损失，并通过双层优化（bi-level optimization）学习该散度，使微调后的模型在未见提示词上遗忘目标概念，同时保持无关生成不变。

Result: 在GEM评测协议下，BEM在多数设置中擦除效果优于GEM：血腥暴力不安全率由53.9%降至14.4%，裸露场景FID由8.64降至6.64；但保留性能在部分概念上得以维持，在另一些概念上有所退化。

Conclusion: Bregman散度族为流匹配概念擦除提供了比欧氏损失更灵活的优化目标，双层学习散度可显著提升擦除强度，但擦除与保留的平衡仍未完全解决，保留能力的退化是后续需改进的方向。

Abstract: Concept erasure removes harmful, private, or copyrighted concepts from text-to-image models while preserving their other abilities. Leading models such as FLUX and Stable Diffusion 3 are trained with flow matching, and erasure methods for them fine-tune the model toward a guided teacher's velocities under a Euclidean loss. Yet the squared distance is only one member of a larger family: Bregman divergences are exactly the losses under which flow matching recovers the correct velocity field, and each member shapes differently what is erased and what is preserved. We introduce BEM (Bregman erasure matching), which is, to our knowledge, the first to learn this divergence through bi-level optimization, so that the fine-tuned model forgets the concept on unseen prompts while its unrelated generations stay unchanged. In the experiments we target the suppression of nudity, violence, real identities, and copyrighted characters. Under the evaluation protocol of GEM, BEM removes more of the concept than GEM on most settings, cutting the unsafe rate on bloody gore from 53.9% to 14.4% and the FID on nudity from 8.64 to 6.64, while retention holds on some concepts and degrades on others.

</details>


### [837] [What "Form'' of Uncertainty Does Conformal Prediction Quantify?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24510)
*Soroush H. Zargarbashi,Mohammad Sadegh Akhondzadeh,Rebekka Burkholz,Aleksandar Bojchevski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文揭示了全量CP与split CP之间预测集大小差异与贝叶斯后验方差（认知不确定性）的联系，并指出该差异可分解为两个相反效应，进而提出将模型"formability"（经后验方差估计）作为认知不确定性的量化工具，实验上达到与SOTA相当的水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Conformal prediction（CP）是事后校准方法，能给出具有无分布覆盖保证的预测集，且预测集大小常被视为不确定性的度量。但预测集大小究竟反映何种不确定性、其来源如何，缺乏理论刻画。作者希望厘清CP预测集大小与模型认知不确定性（贝叶斯后验方差）之间的联系，并据此获得更本质的不确定性量化手段。

Method: 建立理论分析：证明full CP与split CP之间预测集大小之差与贝叶斯后验方差（模型认知不确定性）直接相关；将该差异分解为两个相反效应——(1) 利用额外校准点训练带来的模型精度提升从而使集合变小；(2) 模型在测试点对每个可能标签的"formability"效应。理论上指出后者随更强模型或更多校准数据而消失（符合认知不确定性的已知性质）。基于此，作者剥离预测集的量化效应，直接通过估计后验方差、以模型formability本身来量化认知不确定性，并进行实证评估。

Result: 理论分析表明集合大小差异与后验方差直接关联，且formability效应在模型更强或校准数据更多时趋于消失。实证评估显示，所提基于formability/后验方差的不确定性量化方法在许多设置下与当前SOTA表现相当（on par）。

Conclusion: CP预测集大小差异可作为认知不确定性的有用信号；去除预测集量化效应后，模型formability本身即是一种有效的认知不确定性度量，性能与SOTA相当，为CP与贝叶斯不确定性之间架起了理论桥梁。

Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) is a post-hoc calibration method that returns prediction sets with distribution-free coverage guarantees, and the size of the output set is often interpreted as a notion of uncertainty. We show that the difference in set size between full and split CP is directly connected to Bayesian posterior variance, which is the epistemic uncertainty of the model. Essentially, this difference in set size is an aggregation of two opposite effects: (1) better model accuracy and therefore smaller set size achieved by training over extra calibration points, and (2) the "formability" of the model at test point towards every possible label. The latter effect vanishes with stronger models or more calibration data (as epistemic uncertainty is known for that behavior). It turns out that the model's formability itself (without the quantization effect of prediction sets, and through estimating the posterior variance) is a useful tool to quantify the epistemic uncertainty. In our empirical evaluation it performs on par with the state of the art in many setups.

</details>


### [838] [TopoCompile: Molecular Generation with Exact Global Count Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24511)
*Xiang Wu,Rong-Hua Li,Quanqing Xu,Kangfei Zhao,Guoren Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TopoCompile 将自回归组件树生成器与动态规划编译器结合，通过约束解码在推理时精确满足全局计数约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全局计数约束（分子大小、元素组成、环含量）只指定统计目标而不指定具体结构；属性条件生成器只能朝目标引导，无法保证精确满足。

Method: 以完整环系统和单个原子为组件构建分子树，使受支持的计数在组件上可加；每步由自回归 Transformer 对组件与连接动作打分，同时用动态规划编译器屏蔽无法满足目标的动作；在固定组件词表与类型化连接规则下，约束解码保证受支持的非负、组件可加整数计数被精确满足；推理时应用即插即用，无需重训练。

Result: 四个基准上，Common 与 Rare 四计数目标组均达 100% 精确-有效产率，而各数据集最强基线在 Rare 目标上不超过 44.9%；无条件生成中四个数据集的有效性或 V.U.N. 均为对比方法最高。

Conclusion: 将符号化计数编译（动态规划）与神经自回归生成耦合，可在保证精确计数约束的同时保持生成质量，并支持同一模型灵活切换目标。

Abstract: Molecular generation designs novel molecules with desired structures and properties. Global count constraints specify molecular size, elemental composition, and ring content without prescribing detailed structure. Property-conditioned generators steer generation toward such targets but do not guarantee exact satisfaction. We introduce TopoCompile, which combines an autoregressive component-tree generator with a dynamic-programming compiler for supported component-additive integer counts. TopoCompile represents molecules as trees of intact ring systems and individual atoms, making each supported count additive over components. At each step, an autoregressive Transformer scores component and attachment actions, while the compiler masks actions with no target-satisfying completion. Within the fixed component vocabulary and typed attachment rules, constrained decoding guarantees exact equality for supported non-negative, component-additive integer counts. Applied at inference time, these checks let the same trained generator support different targets and count combinations without retraining. Across four benchmarks, TopoCompile achieves 100% Exact-valid yield for Common and Rare four-count target groups; the strongest baseline within each dataset reaches 44.9% or less on Rare targets. In unconditional generation, it achieves the highest validity or valid-unique-novel (V.U.N.) among the compared methods across all four benchmark datasets.

</details>


### [839] [ProbePO: Sparse Probes, Redistributed Credit for Critic-Free LLM Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24515)
*Diyi Hu,Ruizhong Qiu,Lin Qiu,Hanghang Tong,Hanqing Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 ProbePO，将细粒度信用分配建模为"预算受限的测量"问题：用无奖励的不确定性分数挑选部分解状态，在受限续写预算下估计其期望验证器奖励，并将 GRPO 的轨迹级优势在 token 间重分配（保持每条轨迹的 token 级优势均值不变），续写仅作为测量而不改变策略更新数据。在 3 个模型（DeepSeekMath、Qwen 系列，1.5B–7B）× 6 个基准上，18 组比较中 16 组取得最高准确率；相比 VinePPO 在 DeepSeekMath-7B 上六项基准全面更高且端到端训练时间减少 76%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）只给整条推理轨迹一个终局奖励，掩盖了各个推理步骤对结果的贡献。GRPO 将组归一化优势广播到每个响应 token，粒度过粗；而稠密辅助 rollout 或分支树方法虽更细粒度，却会引入额外数据、改变用于策略更新的分布。作者因此关注一个此前被忽略的中间问题：在有限 rollout 预算下，应评估哪些部分解，以及如何用其价值估计改进信用分配。

Method: 1）将细粒度信用分配形式化为预算约束下的测量问题；2）ProbePO 使用无奖励（reward-free）的不确定性分数从轨迹中选择部分解状态作为探针点；3）在受限续写预算下对这些状态进行续写并以验证器奖励估计其期望价值；4）将 GRPO 的轨迹级优势在 token 维度上重分配而非替换，并保持每条轨迹的 token 级优势均值不变，从而保证策略更新的无偏性；5）探针续写只用于价值测量，不进入策略更新的训练数据。

Result: 在 DeepSeekMath 与 Qwen 系列共 3 个模型（1.5B–7B）上，于 18 组模型-基准比较中 16 组取得四种方法中的最高准确率，并稳定优于 GRPO。与稠密探测方法 VinePPO 相比，在 DeepSeekMath-7B 上六项基准全部更高，且端到端训练时间减少 76%。

Conclusion: 细粒度信用分配不必以牺牲数据分布一致性或大幅增加计算为代价；将探针续写限定为"测量"、并以均值保持方式重分配轨迹级优势，可在有限预算下获得更准确的 token 级信用，同时显著提升训练效率，为 RLVR 中的过程级信用分配提供了低成本、可插拔的改进方案。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns one terminal reward to an entire reasoning trajectory, obscuring how individual reasoning steps contributed to the outcome. GRPO broadcasts a group-normalized advantage to every response token, while finer-grained approaches often rely on dense auxiliary rollouts or branching schemes that can also alter the data used for policy updates. We cast the missing middle as budgeted measurement: with a limited rollout budget, which partial solutions should be evaluated, and how should their value estimates refine credit? ProbePO selects partial-solution states with a reward-free uncertainty score and estimates their expected verifier rewards under a capped continuation budget. ProbePO redistributes, rather than replaces, GRPO's trajectory-level advantage across tokens while preserving each trajectory's mean token-level advantage; probe continuations serve only as measurements. Across three DeepSeekMath and Qwen-family models spanning 1.5B-7B parameters, ProbePO consistently outperforms GRPO and achieves the highest accuracy among the four evaluated methods in 16 of 18 model-benchmark comparisons. Against dense-probing VinePPO on DeepSeekMath-7B, ProbePO achieves higher accuracy on all six benchmarks with 76% less end-to-end training time.

</details>


### [840] [Structured Latent Dynamics for Long-Horizon Embodied World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24534)
*Kevin Chen,Yu-Wei Zhan,Haoran Liang,Sen Cui,Changshui Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HWM，将世界模型隐状态表示为"广义坐标+动量"的相位空间，用耗散哈密顿动力学推演未来隐状态，提升长时程预测稳定性与下游任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式具身世界模型用无约束转移模块学习隐动力学，递归滚动预测时易逐渐偏离连贯的物理演化，长时程可靠性不足；作者探究显式结构化隐状态演化能否提升想象轨迹的稳定性与实用性。

Method: HWM把骨干网络隐变量映射到学习得到的相位空间（广义坐标与动量），通过耗散哈密顿动力学前向传播，再经可学习逆接口映射回原隐表示；该形式可即插即用地嵌入现有世界模型架构而不改动感知/解码模块，并采用多步转移监督使结构化滚动对齐真实观测诱导的隐轨迹。

Result: 受控仿真中速度、加速度与加加速度估计更准，长时程能量漂移显著降低；在三类具身世界模型设置下验证：Ctrl-World单臂多视角、EVAC双臂单视角、Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B任务导向单臂预测。RoboCasa上Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B任务成功率相对提升2.7%；AgiBot World真实轨迹上，Ctrl-World的nDTW提升9.7%，EVAC的Logic提升8.4%。

Conclusion: 显式结构化（哈密顿相位空间）隐动力学是提升世界模型长时程预测稳定性与下游效用的有效且通用的手段，具备架构无关、易集成的特点。

Abstract: Reliable long-horizon prediction remains a central challenge for embodied world models. Although recent generative models can synthesize visually plausible action-conditioned futures, their latent dynamics are typically learned through unconstrained transition modules, which may gradually deviate from coherent physical evolution as predictions are recursively rolled forward. We investigate whether explicitly structuring latent state evolution can improve the stability and utility of such imagined trajectories. To this end, we introduce HWM, a structured dynamics framework that represents backbone latents in a learned phase space consisting of generalized coordinates and momenta. Future states are propagated through dissipative Hamiltonian dynamics and mapped back to the original latent representation through a learnable inverse interface. The resulting formulation can be integrated into existing world-model architectures without redesigning their perception or decoding components, while multi-step transition supervision encourages the structured rollout to remain aligned with the latent trajectories induced by real observations. Controlled simulation experiments show that HWM produces more accurate estimates of velocity, acceleration, and jerk and substantially reduces long-horizon energy drift relative to unstructured latent dynamics. We further evaluate the approach across three distinct embodied world-model settings, covering single-arm multi-view prediction with Ctrl-World, dual-arm single-view prediction with EVAC, and task-oriented single-arm prediction with Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B. On RoboCasa, incorporating HWM into Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B yields a 2.7% relative improvement in task success. On real-world AgiBot World trajectories, it improves nDTW by 9.7% with Ctrl-World and Logic by 8.4% with EVAC.

</details>


### [841] [From Score to Diagnosis: Search-Independent Post-Diagnosis for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24535)
*Qian Li,Yuxiao Hu,Juncheng Liu,Yanhao Jia,Yuntian Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种与搜索过程解耦、可跨不同符号回归求解器共享的反馈机制 PostDiag，通过 patch 级特征刻画候选骨架的局部行为，量化“表达力风险”与“稳定性风险”，在诊断风险平面上决定保留/修复/简化/重写，并由 LLM 编辑器执行诊断引导的干预，再经轻量适配器回传求解器。实验表明其在多种 LLM 基与 GP 基 SR 求解器上一致提升精度并加速收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号回归求解器搜索机制各异，但大多依赖信息量极低的标量适应度，无法说明骨架为何失败、应如何修改。近期方法的增强反馈与自身搜索过程紧密耦合，难以在不同 SR 求解器间复用。因此作者追问：能否设计一种共享的反馈机制，使面临同一瓶颈的多样求解器共同受益。

Method: 提出 PostDiag，一种搜索无关的反馈机制。核心包括：Patch-wise Feature Profiling (PFP)，用水平、趋势、粗糙度的 patch 级特征捕获局部行为；基于 PFP 比较拟合候选与观测，量化 Skeleton Expressiveness Risk；通过 bootstrap 重拟合后行为变异性度量 Skeleton Stability Risk；Diagnostic Risk Plane (DRP) 融合两类风险，判定骨架应保留、修复、简化还是重写，并由 patch 级差异提供干预证据；随后由 LLM 编辑器执行诊断引导的干预，验证后的修订通过轻量适配器返回原求解器。

Result: 在多种基于 LLM 与基于 GP 的 SR 求解器上进行实验，PostDiag 一致提升准确率并加速收敛。

Conclusion: 标量适应度是符号回归的共性瓶颈，而反馈机制可以设计为搜索无关、可共享的组件；以局部行为诊断为核心的 PostDiag 能作为通用插件有效增强异构 SR 求解器的性能。

Abstract: Symbolic regression (SR) solvers employ diverse search mechanisms, yet most rely on the same low-information scalar fitness. Such scores provide little guidance on why a skeleton fails or how it should be revised. Recent methods develop new methods to address this bottleneck. Their enhanced feedback mechanisms are tightly coupled to their search processes and are difficult to reuse across diverse SR solvers. Instead, we ask whether a shared feedback mechanism can further improve diverse solvers facing the same bottleneck. To this end, we propose PostDiag, a search-independent feedback mechanism, which can be shared to different SR solvers. PostDiag introduces Patch-wise Feature Profiling (PFP) to capture local behavior through patch-wise features of level, trend, and roughness. Based on PFP, PostDiag quantifies Skeleton Expressiveness Risk by comparing the fitted candidate with the observations, and Skeleton Stability Risk by measuring variability of behavior after bootstrap refitting. The Diagnostic Risk Plane (DRP) combines two risks to determine whether a skeleton should be preserved, repaired, simplified, or rewritten, while the patch-wise discrepancies provide evidence for the intervention. An LLM editor then performs the diagnosis-guided intervention, and the validated revision is returned to the original solver through a lightweight adapter. Experiments across multiple LLM-based and GP-based SR solvers show that PostDiag consistently improves accuracy and accelerates convergence.

</details>


### [842] [A Multi-Step Inertial ADMM Algorithm for Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24536)
*Hao Li,Qingsong Wang,Xihong Yan,Chengcheng Yan,Deren Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多步惯性ADMM算法MiFedADMM，用于联邦学习，利用服务器端多历史迭代构造高阶外推加速收敛，单步变体具O(1/K)收敛率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习可建模为分布式学习问题，ADMM是常用求解方法，但实际性能受通信开销大与系统异构性制约，需要加速收敛、提升效率。

Method: 基于ADMM框架，在服务器端每次聚合后利用多个历史迭代点构造更高阶的外推项（多步惯性/惯性加速），形成MiFedADMM算法。

Result: 在温和假设下给出单步变体的收敛性结论，并推导出O(1/K)的收敛速率；在合成与真实数据集上的数值实验验证了方法的有效性与相较现有方法的性能提升。

Conclusion: 多步惯性ADMM可有效加速联邦学习中的ADMM训练并改善收敛表现，是一种有理论与实验支撑的方案。
