Abstract: Federated learning has recently emerged as an important paradigm for large-scale distributed model training, which can be naturally formulated as a class of distributed learning problems. The alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) is a widely used approach for solving such problems. However, its practical performance is often hindered by significant communication overhead and system heterogeneity. In this paper, we propose a multi-step inertial ADMM algorithm, called MiFedADMM, for federated learning. The proposed method leverages multiple historical iterates on the server side to construct a higher-order extrapolation after each aggregation to accelerate the convergence behavior. Under mild assumptions, we establish convergence results for the single-step variant of the proposed method and derive an O(1/K) convergence rate. Numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and improved performance of the proposed method compared with existing approaches.

</details>


### [843] [Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping via Second-Order Loss Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24540)
*Ahad Bin Islam Shoeb,Jamal Uddin Tanvin,Kamrul Hasan,Alve Reduan,Imtiaz Ahmed*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: TG-IES为IES的二阶损失差分判据提供理论分析，并由此推导噪声校准的"掌握阈值"与实例剔除的条件稳定性界，实现免人工调参的实例级早停。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IES通过跳过损失已稳定样本的反向传播来降低训练计算，但其使用的二阶损失差分判据缺乏理论依据，阈值也依赖人工设定。

Method: 在显式假设下分析二阶差分判据，推导噪声校准的掌握阈值与实例剔除的条件稳定性界；证明在特定信噪比区间内二阶差分相较一阶、三阶差分具有更优的偏差-方差权衡，且其信号包含梯度漂移与曲率项；用训练过程统计量自动确定停止阈值与耐心参数。

Result: CIFAR-10/100上主要卷积设置节省53–58%反向传播实例，精度损失0.1–0.9个百分点；ResNet-18/CIFAR-10达35.7% FLOP归一化节省；迁移至ViT-Tiny时节省较少且有适度精度代价。

Conclusion: 为二阶实例级早停提供理论基础，表明理论引导的校准可在所研究的假设与实验设置下显著降低训练计算。

Abstract: Instance-dependent early stopping (IES) reduces training computation by skipping backpropagation for examples whose losses have stabilized, but the second-order loss-difference criterion used by IES lacks a theoretical justification. We develop Theory-Guided Instance-Dependent Early Stopping (TG-IES), which analyzes this criterion under explicit assumptions and derives a noise-calibrated mastery threshold and a conditional stability bound for instance exclusion. We show that second-order differencing has a favorable bias-variance trade-off over first- and third-order differences in a specific signal-to-noise regime, and that its signal contains both gradient-drift and curvature terms. TG-IES derives its stopping threshold and patience from training-run statistics rather than using the manually selected threshold of IES. Across CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, TG-IES saves 53-58% of backpropagation instances in its main convolutional settings while keeping accuracy within 0.1-0.9 percentage points of full training; in the primary ResNet-18/CIFAR-10 setting, this corresponds to 35.7% FLOP-normalized savings. The method also transfers to ViT-Tiny, where it achieves smaller savings and incurs a modest accuracy cost. These results provide a theoretical basis for second-order instance-dependent early stopping and show that theory-guided calibration can substantially reduce training computation under the assumptions and experimental settings studied.

</details>


### [844] [No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24562)
*Davide Maran,Marcello Restelli,Francesco Emanuele Stradi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究序贯做市（sequential market making）中在买卖双方估值未知情形下最大化收益的问题，通过遗憾最小化给出两种信息反馈下的算法，并证明库存约束与遗憾之间的基本权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 做市商通过设定买卖报价维持交易效率，但在序贯交易中需在 T 轮内保持库存平衡、低风险，同时买方与卖方估值未知，如何在有限信息下最大化收益并控制遗憾与库存是核心挑战。

Method: 将问题建模为遗憾最小化：情形一仅观测交易成功/失败，设计算法使遗憾与库存界均为 O(T^{2/3})；情形二在失败交易可获得完整订单簿数据时，将遗憾与库存界改进为 O(√T)；并通过下界证明第轮库存限制越紧，最小遗憾严格越高。

Result: 仅反馈成功/失败时，遗憾与库存界与 T^{2/3} 成正比；具备失败交易完整订单簿信息时，两者改进至 √T 量级；并给出库存—遗憾权衡的下界。

Conclusion: 更丰富的反馈信息可显著降低遗憾与库存代价，而逐轮库存约束与遗憾之间存在不可避免的基本权衡。

Abstract: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.

</details>


### [845] [Representations Have Trajectories: Characterizing Temporal Representation Dynamics in Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24571)
*Shivaprasad B. Gowda,Sparsh Mittal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 大规模实证追踪训练全过程表征几何，发现网络呈现三种反复出现的几何轨迹（持续高秩、坍缩—恢复、持续低秩），并将“破坏性表征坍缩”（DRC）刻画为坍缩至秩一且不可恢复的病态机制；几何轨迹与优化结果的关系依赖于配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 既有工作表明深度网络存在隐式低秩简单性偏置，但多只在收敛点观察。作者由此提出三个问题：低秩简单性偏置在优化过程中的时间性后果是什么；表征几何在训练全程（而非仅收敛时）如何演化；不同架构是否表现出不同的几何优化行为。

Method: 开展大规模实证研究，在训练全程持续追踪表征几何（秩等指标），按轨迹形态对训练过程分类，并在受控设置与真实世界模型上比较几何轨迹与优化结果的关联。

Result: 网络遵循三类反复出现的几何轨迹：持续高秩、坍缩—恢复、持续低秩。识别出DRC病态区域：表征坍缩至秩一并无法恢复，造成表征能力的持续性损失。在受控设置中，坍缩—恢复始终与成功优化相关；但在真实模型上，几何轨迹与优化结果的关联依赖于配置。

Conclusion: 表征几何在训练中动态演化而非静态属性，为理解深度网络如何学习提供了新视角；几何轨迹不能简单作为优化成败的普适指标，需结合配置分析。

Abstract: Recent work has shown that deep neural networks exhibit an implicit low-rank simplicity bias. In this paper, we investigate the questions that naturally arise from this observation. What are the temporal consequences of low-rank simplicity bias during optimization? How does representation geometry evolve throughout optimization rather than only at convergence? Do different neural architectures exhibit distinct geometric optimization behaviors? To answer these questions, we conduct a large-scale empirical study tracking representational geometry throughout training. We find that neural networks follow three recurring geometric trajectories: persistent high-rank, collapse-and-recovery, and persistent low-rank. We further identify Destructive Representation Collapse (DRC) as a pathological regime in which representations collapse to rank-one and fail to recover, leading to a sustained loss of representational capacity. While collapse-and-recovery is consistently associated with successful optimization in controlled settings, experiments on real-world models show that the relationship between geometric trajectories and optimization outcomes is configuration dependent. Overall, our findings suggest that representation geometry evolves dynamically during training and provide a new perspective on how deep neural networks learn.

</details>


### [846] [DeliMF: Gated Cross-Attention Fusion of Structured Time Series and Clinical Text for Early Intensive Care Delirium Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24585)
*Yibo Yang,Zerui Huang,Haomiao Yang,Zixia Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DeliMF 提出一种多模态框架，将 ICU 结构化时序数据与时间戳放射报告文本通过门控交叉注意力融合，用于入院首日谵妄的早期预测；门控权重按患者学习，无文本时自动退化为纯结构化模型，在 MIMIC-IV 队列上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ICU 谵妄发生率高，并与住院时间延长、持续性认知下降和高死亡率相关；若能预测入院首日内的谵妄发生，可为临床干预争取窗口。现有最优预测器仅依赖生命体征、实验室值和用药等结构化 EHR 数据，忽略了同一时间窗内蕴含数值无法编码信息的自由文本临床记录。

Method: 提出 DeliMF：结构化信号由时序 Transformer 编码，带时间戳的放射报告由临床文本编码器编码，二者经门控交叉注意力模块融合；门控学习逐患者的文本权重，患者无记录时门控关闭，模型按构造退化为纯结构化形式，从而对文本缺失具有内在鲁棒性。在仅含新发谵妄病例的 MIMIC-IV 队列上进行评估，并辅以消融实验与案例研究。

Result: 相比基线，DeliMF 取得显著提升，在携带临床文本的患者上提升尤为明显，而在无文本患者上性能不降。消融实验证实多模态融合与门控交叉注意力的贡献；案例研究表明融合文本流可挽回仅凭结构化数据漏判的谵妄病例。

Conclusion: DeliMF 表明充分利用被忽视的临床文本可提升 ICU 早期预测性能，有助于谵妄的早期识别与及时干预，作者期望其推动该方向的进一步研究。

Abstract: Delirium affects a large fraction of intensive care unit (ICU) patients and foreshadows longer stays, lasting cognitive decline, and higher mortality. Flagging the patients who will become delirious within the first day of admission would give clinicians a window to intervene. Yet state-of-the-art predictors rely only on the structured electronic health record (EHR) of vital signs, laboratory values, and medications, while overlooking the free-text clinical notes written in the same window, which carry information the numbers cannot encode. To this end, we present DeliMF, a multimodal framework that fuses the structured time series with clinical text. It encodes the structured signals with a temporal Transformer and the time-stamped radiology reports with a clinical text encoder, and fuses the two through a gated cross-attention module. The gate learns a per-patient weight on the text; when a patient has no note the gate closes and DeliMF reduces to its structured-only form, giving robustness to missing text by construction. On an incident-only MIMIC-IV cohort, DeliMF improves significantly over the baselines, particularly on patients who carry clinical text, while losing nothing on those without. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of multimodal fusion and gated cross-attention, and a case study further shows that fusing clinical text with the structured stream recovers delirium cases that the structured data alone misses. We hope DeliMF encourages early ICU prediction to make fuller use of the overlooked clinical text and contributes to the early identification and timely intervention of delirium.

</details>


### [847] [AdamPM: Memory-Efficient LLM Optimization via Moment Pooling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24598)
*Xiaowei Ji,Lishan Xu,Jianing An,Jie Luo,Wenjun Wu,Lei Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AdamPM，通过沿行/列维度对相邻动量元素分组并用共享均值表示，将二阶动量内存降至1/s，继承Adam超参且易集成，在预训练、微调与多模态任务上保持性能与速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Adam因优化性能与训练稳定性广泛用于LLM训练，但其逐元素的一阶、二阶矩估计带来显著内存开销；现有内存高效优化器多引入额外计算开销或需额外调参，故Adam仍是LLM预训练的主流可靠选择。

Method: AdamPM将相邻动量条目沿行或列维度分组，每组用单一共享均值表示；系统考察一阶与二阶矩的池化，确定二阶矩池化为有效设计；组大小为s时二阶矩内存降至1/s。方法继承Adam超参设置，可直接集成到现有Adam实现中。

Result: 在语言模型预训练、微调和多模态学习上的大量实验表明，AdamPM在显著降低优化器状态内存的同时保持模型性能与训练速度。

Conclusion: AdamPM是一种简单、内存高效且易于部署的Adam变体，无需额外调参即可减少优化器状态内存而不损失性能，适合大规模LLM训练场景。

Abstract: Adam is widely used for training large language models (LLMs) owing to its strong optimization performance and training stability, but its element-wise estimation for the first and second moments incur substantial memory overhead. Although numerous memory-efficient optimizers have been proposed, many incur additional computational overhead or require additional tuning of hyperparameters. Consequently, Adam remains a dominant and reliable choice for LLM pre-training. We propose AdamPM (Adam with Pooled Moments), a simple and memory-efficient variant of Adam that groups adjacent moment entries along the row or column dimension and represents each group by a single shared mean. AdamPM can well inherit Adam's hyperparameter settings and is readily integrated into existing Adam optimizer implementations, with less memory overhead. We systematically investigate pooling of both first and second moment estimates and identify second moment pooling as the effective design. With a group size of $s$, AdamPM reduces second moment memory to $1/s$ of the original requirement. Extensive experiments on language model pretraining, fine-tuning and multimodal learning demonstrate that AdamPM maintains model performance and training speed while substantially reducing optimizer-state memory. Our code is available at \url{https://github.com/jixiaowei95/AdamPM}.

</details>


### [848] [TCMScience: An Autonomous Scientist for Traditional Chinese Medicine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24601)
*Yanlan Kang,Ruiqi Liu,Xinpei Gu,Tzu-Yi Lei,Shuai Xu,Xukun Zhang,William Cheng-Chung Chu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TCMScience——分离语言模型提案与执行/发布权限的中医药科研知识发现智能体，通过可信内核、科学编译器与声明支撑契约，实现跨异构资源的受控推理与差错拦截。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 中医药研究需连接经典文本、药材实体、分子实验、计算预测与临床研究，各类证据之间存在推断边界；自主研究智能体需在协调异构资源分析的同时保持这些边界，避免越界推断与错误结论发布。

Method: 架构由可信内核、科学编译器与claim-support契约组成：LLM提案被编译为带类型的操作，执行受显式权限约束，候选发现在发布前需经来源溯源、研究设计与声明范围三重校验。资源侧构建117个公共源连接器（444个类型化操作、29个领域）、150个原生工具（12个领域）及包含136个数据库、76个数据集规范、84,294条方剂来源记录的中医药数据枢纽；并进行葛根芩连汤网络药理学分析与121个构造错误输出的治理消融实验。

Result: 葛根芩连汤分析中，将全蛋白组背景替换为实测蛋白背景后，显著通路数由66降为0；纳入失活筛选记录后识别出9条通路，其中药物代谢信号被保留为机制假说。治理消融中，无治理释放121个错误，仅领域层释放57个，仅内核释放7个，双层结合为0，且10个合规对照全部保留。

Conclusion: 分层治理对已知失效模式形成互补控制，显式证据契约可实质改变智能体被允许报告的结论，为高异质证据体系下的可信自主科研提供架构范式。

Abstract: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) research connects classical texts, medicinal entities, molecular assays, computational predictions, and clinical studies. An autonomous research agent must preserve the inferential boundaries between these evidence types while coordinating analysis across heterogeneous resources. We introduce TCMScience, a scientific knowledge-discovery agent that separates language-model proposals from execution and release authority. Its architecture combines a trusted kernel, a scientific compiler, and claim-support contracts: plans are compiled into typed operations, execution is bounded by explicit permissions, and candidate findings are checked against source provenance, study design, and claim scope before release. The full capability registry contains 117 public-source connectors with 444 typed operations across 29 domains and 150 native tools across 12 domains; the TCM data hub catalogs 136 databases, 76 dataset specifications, and 84,294 formula-source records. These resources support model-independent workflows through browser and local execution interfaces. In a network-pharmacology analysis of Gegen Qinlian Tang, replacing the whole-proteome background with the assayed-protein background changed the number of significant pathways from 66 to zero; incorporating inactive screening records identified nine pathways, including drug-metabolism signals retained as mechanistic hypotheses. A governance ablation over 121 constructed erroneous outputs spanning 26 classes released 121 errors without governance, 57 with the domain layer, seven with the kernel, and zero with both layers. All 10 compliant controls were retained. These results establish complementary control of known failure modes and show how explicit evidence contracts change the conclusions an agent is permitted to report.

</details>


### [849] [How Much Do Activation Monitors Benefit from Original Model Computations?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24613)
*James Oldfield,Shawn Im,Jay J Culligan,Philip Torr,Sharon Li,Adel Bibi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究激活监控器（activation monitors）的效能有多少依赖于对原始行为生成轨迹的访问：在以受控方式改变记录文本/聊天格式后，原生训练监控器相对非原生监控器仅有"温和但一致"的优势（最高约0.014 AUROC），但该优势在标签随改写而变化的样本上尤为显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 监控模型内部激活被视为保障AI系统的重要手段，因激活可能比输入输出更易暴露不良行为迹象；但近期研究开始质疑"激活提供了观察模型行为的独特窗口"这一前提。作者希望量化：激活监控器的成功在多大程度上源于对原始行为生成计算的访问，而非简单的表面信息泄漏。

Method: 固定目标模型与监控架构，构造在计算上下文上存在差异的轨迹（改变精确文本、聊天格式等），对训练与评测轨迹做受控扰动；在2个反事实监控任务、最多4个模型上比较原生（native）训练监控器与非原生监控器的预测表现，并与使用简单特权信息（答案logit margin）的基线对比。

Result: 无需原始行为生成轨迹即可恢复大部分性能；原生训练监控器仍保持温和且一致的优势，最高超出最强控制组约0.014 AUROC；原生访问训练出的监控器在"改写后行为标签发生变化"的原始样本上有明显提升；该视角还能揭示基于答案logit margin的基线方法的局限。

Conclusion: 总体上原生监控访问的优势幅度不大，但这提示评估设计的重要性：需要能够识别原始模型计算在何时、何处提供额外预测价值，而非仅报告聚合性能。

Abstract: One powerful way to safeguard AI systems is to monitor their internal computations--where signs of undesirable behavior might be more easily detectable than from models' inputs and outputs alone. However, recent studies begin to question the premise that activations provide a unique window into model behavior. In this paper, we study how much of activation monitors' success depends on access to the original behavior-generating computations. Within a fixed choice of target model and monitoring architecture, we compare how well monitors trained and evaluated on trajectories that differ in computational context can predict the behavior of the original execution, after the transcript is changed in a controlled manner (e.g., its exact text, or chat formatting). We first find that much performance can be recovered without access to the original behavior-generating trace (in up to 4 models across 2 counterfactual monitoring tasks), but a mild yet consistent advantage to native-trained monitors remains, outperforming strongest controls by up to 0.014 AUROC. Interestingly, we find monitors trained with native access have notable uplift on original examples whose behavioral label changes under paraphrasing. We further find this a useful lens to expose limitations of baselines that use simple forms of privileged information (i.e., answer logit margins). While our results show the advantage of native monitor access is modest in aggregate, they highlight the importance of evaluations that identify if and when original model computations provide additional predictive value.

</details>


### [850] [Uncovering Semantic Hierarchies in Text-Attributed Graphs via Variational EM-based LLM-GNN Synergy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24624)
*Yunhui Liu,Xudong Jin,Qizhuo Xie,Chunhui Zhao,Xiao Luo,Tao Zheng,Bin Chong,Tieke He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SHiFT，在EM框架下结合LLM的推理能力与GNN的结构表示能力，为文本属性图学习显式语义层次树，兼顾表示质量与可读的分类体系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类知识本质上是层次化的，但现有文本属性图上的表示学习多在平坦语义空间中运行，忽略了真实数据固有的粗到细粒度信息。

Method: 在EM范式中融合LLM与GNN。E步将LLM作为专家分类学家诱导显式语义树，并用轻量级的Mapping & Diagnosis策略，仅在检测到异常时以"外科式"更新层次结构，降低推理开销；M步从聚类划分、拓扑骨架与语义概念三个互补视角使GNN编码器对齐该层次结构。理论分析表明SHiFT可解释为广义变分EM算法。

Result: 大量实验显示SHiFT取得最先进性能，并能挖掘出高质量、人类可读的分类体系。

Conclusion: 将LLM的层次归纳能力与GNN的结构表示能力在EM框架下统一，是提升文本属性图表示学习的有效途径，且可解释为广义变分EM。

Abstract: While hierarchical structures are intrinsic to organizing human knowledge, current representation learning on text-attributed graphs predominantly operates on flat semantic spaces, overlooking the rich coarse-to-fine granularity inherent in real-world data. To bridge this gap, we propose SHiFT, which synergizes the reasoning power of LLMs with the structural representation capability of GNNs within an Expectation-Maximization (EM) paradigm. In the E-step, we harness LLMs as expert taxonomists to induce an explicit semantic tree, introducing a lightweight Mapping & Diagnosis strategy that reduces inference costs by surgically updating the hierarchy only when anomalies are detected. In the M-step, we align the GNN encoder with this induced hierarchy from complementary perspectives, including clustering partition, topological skeleton, and semantic concepts. Theoretical analysis interprets SHiFT as a generalized Variational EM algorithm. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SHiFT not only achieves state-of-the-art performance but also uncovers high-quality, human-readable taxonomies. Our code can be found at https://github.com/Cloudy1225/SHiFT.

</details>


### [851] [EdgeKernelBench: Unified LLM-Driven Kernel Generation for Edge Backends](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24648)
*Yuhua Zheng,Xueyi Chen,Xinze Zou,Xin Li,Haoji Hu,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出EdgeKernelBench（统一IR部署框架+分层边缘工作负载基准）和LEKA（分层边缘内核智能体），系统研究LLM在异构边缘后端的内核生成，揭示功能正确≠性能提升，并通过分层IR优化显著提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作表明LLM能在服务器GPU上生成高性能内核，但边缘部署面临硬件异构、软件栈碎片化、资源预算紧张等独特挑战；跨多样边缘后端的LLM内核生成尚未被系统研究。

Method: 构建EdgeKernelBench：以统一IR捕获可复用的计算、调度与内存决策，通过编译器接口对接各目标后端，并以TVM为参考编译器在异构边缘后端验证；基准覆盖从单算子到紧凑模型图逐步扩大的程序范围。在此基础上提出LEKA智能体，通过分层IR组织优化流程。

Result: 单次生成尝试下最佳模型达64.5% Correct@1，但仅25.5% Fast@1.0；在智能体评估子集上，LEKA达43.5% Fast@1.0，直接生成为13.0%，Claude Code为26.1%（后两者与LEKA使用相同基础模型与优化预算）。

Conclusion: 功能正确性不能稳定转化为性能增益；EdgeKernelBench与LEKA共同支持跨边缘后端的LLM生成内核统一评估与分层优化。

Abstract: Recent works show that LLMs can generate kernels with strong performance on server GPUs. Edge deployment presents distinct challenges because the hardware is heterogeneous, the software stacks are fragmented, and the resource budgets are tight. LLM kernel generation across diverse edge backends has yet to be studied systematically. We introduce EdgeKernelBench, which combines a unified IR deployment framework with a hierarchical benchmark for edge workloads. The unified IR captures reusable computation, scheduling, and memory decisions and connects to each target backend through a compiler interface. The benchmark spans progressively larger program scopes, from individual operators to compact model graphs, across representative edge application domains. We instantiate the design with TVM as a reference compiler and validate it across heterogeneous edge backends. With a single generation attempt, the best model achieves 64.5% Correct@1 but only 25.5% Fast@1.0. This gap shows that functional correctness does not consistently translate into performance gains. We therefore introduce the Layered Edge Kernel Agent (LEKA), which organizes optimization through a layered IR. On the agent evaluation subset, LEKA achieves 43.5% Fast@1.0, compared with 13.0% for direct generation and 26.1% for Claude Code. LEKA and Claude Code use the same base model and optimization budget. Together, EdgeKernelBench and LEKA support unified evaluation and layered optimization of kernels generated by LLMs across edge backends.

</details>


### [852] [Contrastive Adversarial Training for Robust Graph Neural Networks under Label Poisoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24685)
*Manshika Charvi Bissessur,Melis Ilayda Bal,Michael Muehlebach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 CoLAT，一种面向图节点分类的对比式对抗训练框架。它用结构感知的对比学习检测器识别“标签-结构不一致”的高风险节点，并据此引导对抗性标签翻转训练，从而在标签投毒攻击下提升鲁棒性并隐式清洗部分错误标签。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GNN 在图上的消息传递会使少量被投毒的标签错误扩散，而现有防御主要针对随机标签噪声，依赖鲁棒损失或启发式数据清洗，难以区分对抗性投毒样本与天然困难样本，因此标签投毒防御研究不足。

Method: CoLAT（Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training）：构建结构感知的检测模型，利用对比学习embedding度量标签与图结构的一致性，筛选高风险节点；在交替优化中针对这些节点执行对抗性标签翻转，实现结构感知的对抗训练，并隐式地进行标签净化。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上，CoLAT 在不同投毒强度下均稳定优于现有防御方法，且能高效扩展至大规模图。

Conclusion: 将对比表征用于对抗样本筛选而非仅做表征学习，是提升图节点分类抗标签投毒能力的有效途径，兼顾检测、训练与标签清洗。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are effective for modeling relational data but are vulnerable to label poisoning, where a small number of corrupted training labels can propagate errors across the graph via message passing. Despite this risk, defenses against label poisoning remain underexplored: existing methods are primarily designed for label noise and often rely on robust losses or heuristic data cleaning that fail to distinguish adversarial poisoning from naturally hard examples. In this paper, we propose CoLAT (Contrastive Label-flipping for Adversarial Training), a novel contrastive adversarial training framework tailored for robust node classification on graphs. The core of our approach is a structure-aware detection model that uses contrastive learning to identify label-structure inconsistencies. Unlike prior contrastive methods that focus on representation learning, CoLAT leverages contrastive embeddings to select high-risk nodes that guide adversarial label-flipping during training. This alternating optimization not only performs structure-aware adversarial training but also implicitly sanitizes some corrupted labels, improving robustness against diverse attacks from the literature. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CoLAT consistently outperforms existing defenses under various poisoning intensities while scaling efficiently to large graphs.

</details>


### [853] [Native Probability Outputs for Clinical Triage: An Evaluation of Calibration and Decision Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24692)
*Liang You,Zhiyin Zhou,Dawei Tang,Chuchu Wu,Jingzhuo Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究评估决策模型Jev在患者分诊中能否同时给出恰当的就医建议并识别信息不足；Jev的多分类概率误差（Brier 0.610）最低，但宏观F1仅列第四，且信息充分性判断存在漏问与过度追问的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向患者的分诊任务既需要给出恰当的照护建议，也需要判断所给信息是否充分。作者希望检验一个输出预定义动作概率的决策模型（Jev）能否同时支撑这两类判断，并与通用语言模型及输入无关基线进行对比。

Method: 使用CARE-Bench，取439个公开案例的925个决策点，将Jev与四个通用语言模型及三个输入无关基线对比，指标包括macro-F1与多分类Brier分数（含案例自助法95%区间）；另在453段HealthBench对话上重复Brier评估，并单独考察“信息是否充分”的询问对澄清召回的影响。

Result: 公开测试子集上，Jev的macro-F1为0.461，在五个模型中排第四；但多分类Brier最低（0.610），较均匀预测改善18.7%（案例自助法95%区间4.9%–31.1%）。二元Brier上Noul优于Choice（0.215 vs 0.276）。HealthBench上Jev的Brier同样最低（0.299），但所测为不同的紧急转诊判断。单独询问信息充分性可提高召回，却带来大量不必要的澄清指派。

Conclusion: Jev在四动作任务中实现了更低的概率误差，但伴随澄清需求的漏判；显式询问信息充分性会在召回与过度澄清之间形成权衡。因此，概率化决策模型在分诊中需同时报告校准性与澄清行为两类指标，单看分类F1不足以反映实际安全性与可用性。

Abstract: Patient-facing triage requires an appropriate care recommendation and recognition of when information is insufficient. We evaluate whether Jev, a decision model that returns probabilities over predefined actions, supports both judgments. Using CARE-Bench, we compare Jev with four general-purpose language models and three input-independent baselines across 925 decision points from 439 public cases. On the public test subset, Jev ranks fourth of five models by macro-F1 (0.461) but has the lowest observed multiclass Brier score (0.610), an 18.7\% improvement over uniform prediction (case-bootstrap 95\% interval, 4.9--31.1\%). Noul has lower binary Brier than Choice (0.215 versus 0.276). A evaluation of 453 HealthBench conversations again gives Jev the lowest observed Brier score (0.299), but measures a distinct emergency-referral judgment. Jev combines lower probability error with missed clarification needs in the four-action task. Asking about information sufficiency separately increases recall but also produces frequent unnecessary clarification assignments.

</details>


### [854] [Tensor Network Datamodels for Training Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24721)
*Farzaneh Heidari,Md Rifat Arefin,Louis Jaburi,Guillaume Rabusseau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出张量网络数据模型（TNDM），用低秩张量网络刻画训练单元间的非加性联合效应，比线性数据模型更准确地预测训练集子集对模型行为的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性数据模型对每个训练单元赋予固定贡献，无法表达多个训练单元组合产生的非加性交互效应，而现实中训练数据效应常依赖训练组之间的组合。

Method: 用低秩张量网络（CP、TT 等分解）学习从训练数据子集到在该子集上训练所得结果的映射，在保持表示紧凑的同时建模多训练单元交互；并证明互补性与冗余性训练组可诱导出具有紧凑低秩表示的高阶子集函数。单个拟合后的 TNDM 可复用于多种问题：预测删除数据的影响、度量单元重要性、识别单元间交互、选择有用子集。

Result: 在含强交互的受控任务及分类、推理微调设置上评估：受控推理任务中 TNDM 以约一半的训练子集观测数超越所有基线；TNDM-TT 在观测约 0.0061% 的全部可能子集后，相对线性数据模型降低预测 NMSE 达 89%；事实关联微调中单个 TNDM-CP 将留出 R² 从 0.579 提升至 0.668。

Conclusion: 紧凑低秩模型能在训练数据效应依赖训练组组合时显著提升预测精度，TNDM 是可复用、多用途的训练数据影响建模框架。

Abstract: Datamodels predict how a model's behavior changes when different parts of its training data are included or removed. However, linear datamodels assign fixed contributions to training units and cannot represent non-additive joint effects. We introduce Tensor Network Datamodels (TNDMs), which use low-rank tensor networks to model dependencies among training units while keeping the representation compact. TNDMs learn a map from subsets of the training data to the outcome of training on those subsets, allowing them to represent interactions among several training units. We prove that complementary and redundant training groups can induce high-degree subset functions with compact low-rank representations. A single fitted TNDM can then be used for several training data questions, including predicting the effect of removing data, measuring the importance of individual training units, identifying interactions between training units, and selecting useful subsets of the training data. We evaluate TNDMs on controlled tasks designed to contain strong interactions, as well as standard fine-tuning settings for classification and reasoning. On a controlled reasoning task, TNDMs outperform every baseline while observing only half as many training subsets, and TNDM-TT reduces prediction NMSE by $89\%$ relative to the linear datamodel after observing approximately $0.0061\%$ of all possible training subsets. In factual-association fine-tuning, a single TNDM-CP raises held-out $\mathrm{R}^2$ from $0.579$ to $0.668$ over the linear datamodel. These results demonstrate that compact low-rank models improve prediction when training data effects depend on combinations of training groups.

</details>


### [855] [fxBench: Evaluating and Understanding Formula Suggestions in Spreadsheets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24729)
*Sanket Mhatre,Sumit Gulwani,Vu Le,Yasharth Bajpai,Gust Verbruggen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出首个基于真实电子表格的公开公式建议基准 fxBench（503 个众包标注任务，源自 Sheetpedia），并将公式建议问题分解为四项能力（收集上下文、理解上下文、理解意图、写出公式），系统评估现有与新增方法以定位瓶颈。最佳配置仅达 58.8% 正确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电子表格公式建议已被 Excel、Google Sheets 等主流软件采用，可显著提升效率，但需在每次键入 "=" 时低延迟、低成本地给出正确公式，且不打断编辑流程。然而目前缺少针对真实电子表格公式建议的公开基准，阻碍了系统性研究与瓶颈分析。

Method: (1) 构建 fxBench：基于 Sheetpedia 手工整理 503 个公式建议任务；(2) 将问题拆解为四项能力：收集上下文、理解上下文、理解意图、写出公式；(3) 标注描述意图的单元格以确定不同上下文选择策略的理论性能上限；(4) 在多种上下文表示（含低 token 数、高理论覆盖率的稠密格式）下评测大小模型；(5) 微调较小语言模型以学习理解稠密格式；(6) 对失败模式做定量与定性分析。

Result: 稠密上下文表示可在低 token 开销下实现较高理论覆盖率，且较小模型经微调后可学会理解该格式；但对失败模式的定量与定性分析显示，公式生成能力仍是主要瓶颈，最佳配置的公式建议正确率仅为 58.8%，说明该任务仍具显著挑战。

Conclusion: fxBench 填补了真实电子表格公式建议公开基准的空白，并通过能力分解与理论上限分析揭示了上下文表示与模型规模的作用及公式写作环节的瓶颈，为后续研究指明了方向。

Abstract: Spreadsheets are among the most widely used tools for computations, and formulas are their core building blocks. Besides agentic spreadsheet tools, proactive formula suggestions enable significant productivity gains and are now available in popular spreadsheet software (Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets). Such suggestions pose interesting challenges: the right context must be collected and represented for a machine learning model, which must then be able to write a correct formula, in a way that is fast and cheap enough to trigger on every = (or subsequent keystrokes for auto-completion) without taking users out of their editing flow. Surprisingly, there is no public benchmark for formula suggestions on real spreadsheets. In this paper, we therefore (1) introduce fxBench as a manually curated benchmark of 503 formula suggestion tasks based on Sheetpedia, (2) break down the formula suggestion problem into four capabilities (gather context, understand context, understand intent, write formula) that a formula suggestion system requires, and (3) evaluate existing and new approaches to understand bottlenecks in these capabilities that pose interesting research directions. Specifically, we annotate each benchmark with the cells that describe intent to determine the theoretical performance limit of a given context selection strategy, we evaluate performance of small and large models on different representations of context, including a dense format with high theoretical coverage at low token counts, and we fine-tune smaller language models to show that we can learn to understand such dense formats. Additionally, we perform quantitative and qualitative analysis on failure modes to understand bottlenecks in the formula writing capability; the best configuration only achieved 58.8% correct suggestions.

</details>


### [856] [How Does Muon Work in Private Deep Learning? Scalable Differentially Private Training via Orthogonalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24736)
*Alexander Gaponov,Grigory Malinovsky,Egor Shulgin,Peter Richtarik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DP-Muon：在 LMO 视角下分析 Muon 的正交化更新，证明逐样本裁剪的主要效应是可被 LMO 忽略的梯度正向缩放，仅剩受中心化梯度方差控制的小方向残差；在固定噪声下得到 O(K^{-1/4}) 收敛率，在固定 (ε,δ) 预算下无需有界梯度即获得 DP-SGD 的 (√d/(nε))^{1/2} 隐私-效用界，并给出超参数规律与实验对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Muon 等正交化更新在经验性能与可扩展性上表现优异，但其在差分隐私下的行为尚不清楚；需要一种既高效又具备形式化隐私保证的优化器。

Method: 通过线性最小化 oracle（LMO）视角分析 Muon 的正交化更新，构造 DP-Muon（逐样本裁剪 + 噪声 + 正交化更新的私有化变体），并理论刻画裁剪效应与收敛/隐私-效用权衡，同时实证研究隐私条件下学习率、动量与批大小的最优取值。

Result: 理论上：裁剪的主导效应是对梯度的正向缩放，LMO 对其不敏感，只有由中心化梯度方差控制的小方向残差进入优化误差；固定噪声尺度下以 O(K^{-1/4})（忽略对数因子）收敛到依赖裁剪的邻域，固定 (ε,δ) 预算下达到 DP-SGD 的 (√d/(nε))^{1/2} 隐私-效用界且不假设有界梯度。实证上：图像分类中 DP-Muon 与 DP-SGD、DP-Adam 持平或更优；语言建模中最优优化器依赖批大小，小批时 DP-Muon 最佳，接近隐私最优批大小时 DP-Adam 最佳。

Conclusion: DP-Muon 为正交化更新提供了可分析的隐私化框架，说明了裁剪在 LMO 视角下的良性作用，并揭示隐私约束会改变最优超参数选择，最优优化器在不同任务与批大小下并非唯一。

Abstract: Training deep neural networks requires optimizers that balance computational efficiency with formal data privacy. While orthogonalized update rules, such as the recently introduced Muon optimizer, have shown strong empirical performance and scalability, their behavior under Differential Privacy (DP) is not yet understood. In this paper, we propose DP-Muon, a differentially private variant of the Muon optimizer. By analyzing Muon's orthogonalized updates through the lens of a Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO), we show that the leading effect of per-example clipping is a positive rescaling of the gradient, to which the LMO is blind, so that only a small directional residual controlled by the centered gradient variance enters the optimization error. This yields an $\mathcal O(K^{-1/4})$ convergence rate, up to logarithmic factors, to a clipping-dependent neighborhood at a fixed noise scale and, with noise calibrated to a fixed $(\varepsilon,δ)$ budget, the standard $(\sqrt d/(n\varepsilon))^{1/2}$ privacy--utility bound of DP-SGD, without assuming bounded gradients. Furthermore, we investigate the hyperparameter landscape of DP-Muon and document how the optimal learning rate, momentum, and batch size change under privacy. Empirically, on image classification DP-Muon matches or improves on DP-SGD and DP-Adam, whereas on language modeling the best optimizer depends on the batch size, with DP-Muon best at small batches and DP-Adam best near the privacy-optimal batch size.

</details>


### [857] [Gaussian Process Bandits with Paired Auxiliary Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24737)
*Weibo Huang,Qing Feng,Ruihao Zhu,Cheng Hua*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出AI-GPB方法，利用预先可得的低成本辅助数据与在线配对观测之间的误差相关性实现方差缩减，在无需辅助均值近似目标函数的条件下获得GP置信界与遗憾界，实验优于GP-UCB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯优化用于昂贵黑箱优化时，观测噪声会降低每次评估的信息量并拖慢后验学习。标准BO只依赖优化过程中获得的昂贵结果，而许多场景中事前已存在低成本辅助数据，这部分信息未被利用。

Method: Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB)：将离线估计的辅助均值与从配对在线观测中学习到的修正系数相结合；关键在于利用配对观测误差之间的相关性做方差缩减，而不要求辅助均值逼近目标函数本身。理论部分建立有限样本GP置信界与遗憾保证，对Matérn核给出显式的累积遗憾与简单遗憾速率。

Result: 在不同地形与维度的连续BO基准上，相对vanilla GP-UCB一致降低累积遗憾与简单遗憾；即使配对误差相关性仅为中等强度、且辅助均值由含噪离线数据估计，优势依然成立。

Conclusion: 辅助数据可通过误差相关性而非数值近似的方式有效服务于BO方差缩减，AI-GPB兼具理论保证与实证增益，为融合低成本先验信息提供了稳健框架。

Abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) is widely used for expensive black-box optimization, yet observation noise makes each evaluation less informative and slows posterior learning. Standard BO learns from costly outcomes gathered during optimization. In many applications, however, low-cost auxiliary data are available beforehand. We introduce Auxiliary-Informed Gaussian Process Bandit (AI-GPB), a variance-reduction method that combines an offline estimate of the auxiliary mean with a correction coefficient learned from paired online observations. Notably, it exploits correlation between paired observation errors without requiring the auxiliary mean to approximate the objective. We establish finite-sample GP confidence bounds and regret guarantees, including explicit cumulative and simple regret rates for Matérn kernels. Numerical experiments across continuous BO benchmarks with varied landscapes and dimensions show consistent reductions in cumulative and simple regret relative to vanilla GP-UCB, even when within-pair correlation is moderate and the auxiliary mean is estimated from noisy offline data.

</details>


### [858] [From Overparameterised Expressions to Parsimonious Models: Fisher-Geometric Pruning for Symbolic Regression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24753)
*Veronica Guidetti,Luca La Rocca,Fabrício Olivetti de França,Gabriel Kronberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出Fisher-Geometric pruning（FGP），一种作用于已拟合模型的事后剪枝框架，结合局部信息几何与参数边界兼容性检验来简化GPSR表达式，在保持甚至提升泛化精度的同时显著降低结构复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GPSR常产生过大的表达式，含休眠分支与拟合采样噪声的精细代数配置；现有复杂度控制策略（多目标规模-精度搜索、嵌入适应度的信息准则）仅作用于模型搜索过程中的句法表示，缺少对已拟合模型的事后约简手段。

Method: FGP在最大似然解处结合局部信息几何与可解释参数边界的显式兼容性检验；通过参数方向分类体系区分局部敏感性与靠近可约简边界的方向，处理不可辨识方向及零约束、渐近极限、带符号参数辨识等约简；候选约简经符号收缩与重拟合实现，仅当交叉验证预测风险在预设容差内才被接受。

Result: 在受控诊断问题与GPSR生成的Pareto前沿上评估，FGP均显著降低结构复杂度，同时保持并常提升样本外精度；与竞争剪枝策略及消融实验对比显示，几何筛选、边界兼容性与预测验证的结合带来最一致的简约性与泛化性联合增益。

Conclusion: FGP作为事后模型约简框架可与现有复杂度控制技术互补，通过几何筛选、边界兼容性检验和预测验证三者的结合，在简约性与泛化能力上取得稳定且一致的联合提升。

Abstract: Genetic programming symbolic regression (GPSR) often returns expressions that are larger than necessary, with dormant branches and finely tuned algebraic configurations that fit sampling noise. Existing complexity-control strategies, such as multi-objective size-accuracy search or information criteria embedded in the fitness function, act on syntactic representations during model search. We introduce Fisher-Geometric pruning (FGP), a post-hoc model-reduction framework that acts on fitted models and can complement these techniques.
  FGP combines local information geometry at the maximum-likelihood solution with explicit compatibility tests for interpretable parametric boundaries. A taxonomy of parametric directions separates local sensitivity from proximity to reducible boundaries, enabling the treatment of unidentifiable directions and reductions through zero constraints, asymptotic limits, and signed parameter identifications. Candidate reductions are realised by symbolic contraction and refitting, then accepted only when their cross-validated predictive risk remains within a prescribed tolerance.
  We evaluate FGP on controlled diagnostic problems and Pareto fronts generated by GPSR. Across both settings, FGP substantially reduces structural complexity while preserving, and often improving, out-of-sample accuracy. Comparisons with competing pruning strategies and ablations show that, by combining geometric screening, boundary compatibility, and predictive validation, FGP yields the most consistent joint gains in parsimony and generalisation.

</details>


### [859] [Paired-Outcome Learning for Selective Spacecraft Attitude Capture under Torque Limits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24763)
*Donghe Chen,Jia Deng,Zehao Jia,Lin Cheng,Shengping Gong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出“基线相对学习”框架与配对结果方法，在力矩受限姿态捕获中按上下文选择性加速机动：相对分支基线降低积分姿态误差4.67%，17项改善、31项持平、无回退。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 力矩受限下制动能力不确定，机动速度需自适应；加速可降低平均跟踪误差却会恶化个别机动，故问题应建模为对现有控制器的选择性修改（基线相对学习），而非整体替换。

Method: 配对结果方法含三机制：具物理可解释性的不同速度包络延续策略；任务失败与成功配对跟踪增益分离预测；基于上下文的拒绝机制（保留原基线）。完整配对仿真在同参数与测量种子下提供标签，训练/验证/校准按上下文隔离。Basilisk实验中108个开发上下文、324次标注rollout、48个测试上下文共624个评估回合。

Result: 选择性控制器相对分支基线降低总积分姿态误差4.67%，17改善、31完全持平、无观察到回退；始终使用快速策略降4.81%但恶化11例。增益集中于主轴、近轴、制动边界及特定噪声/漂移机动，一般耦合情形保留基线。消融显示分支承诺、主动查询、分数相减均无额外总体收益。

Conclusion: 证据支持平均改进与个体回退之间存在受限的经验性权衡，但未建立闭环安全保证。

Abstract: Torque-limited spacecraft attitude capture requires adapting the maneuver speed to uncertain braking authority. Faster settings can reduce average tracking error while worsening individual maneuvers, making selective modification of an existing controller a baseline-relative learning problem. A paired-outcome method combines three mechanisms: physically interpretable continuation policies with different speed envelopes, separate prediction of task failure and successful-pair tracking gains, and context-dependent rejection that executes the unchanged baseline. Complete paired simulations provide labels under common plant parameters and measurement seeds; training, validation, and calibration are separated by context. Basilisk experiments use 108 development contexts, 324 labeling rollouts, and 624 evaluation episodes across 48 test contexts, including disclosed post-freeze diagnostics. The selective controller reduces aggregate integrated attitude error by 4.67% relative to the branch baseline, with 17 improvements, 31 exact ties, and no observed regressions. Always using the fast alternative achieves a 4.81% reduction but worsens 11 cases. Gains occur in principal-axis, near-axis, braking-boundary, and selected noise/drift maneuvers; general coupled cases retain the baseline. Ablations show no additional aggregate benefit from branch commitment, active querying, or score subtraction. The evidence supports a restricted empirical trade-off between average improvement and individual regression, without establishing a closed-loop safety guarantee.

</details>


### [860] [Global Convergence in Deep Networks via the Second Law of Thermodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24775)
*Matan Tsipory,Ofir Gaash,Itamar Harel,Nathan Srebro,Daniel Soudry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究带 L2 正则的各向同性噪声连续时间 Langevin 动力学（CLD）训练有限宽度过参数化前馈网络，借助受热力学第二定律启发的测度变换不等式与初始 NTK 最小特征值的紧下界，证明注入噪声可在不将参数束缚于初始化邻域的情况下保持 NTK 稳定性，从而给出期望训练损失的显式非渐近上界及宽度与噪声温度条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有有限宽度过参数化网络的标准参数化收敛分析通常假设参数始终接近初始化，且忽略噪声作用；但经验上随机性可改善优化与泛化。作者希望弥合这一理论与实际之间的差距。

Method: 针对平滑激活的前馈网络，分析带 L2 正则、各向同性噪声的连续时间 Langevin 动力学。引入受热力学第二定律启发的测度变换（change-of-measure）不等式，以在时变参数分布下控制训练动力学性质；并结合初始 NTK 最小特征值的加强下界进行分析。

Result: 证明注入噪声能以高概率保持 NTK 稳定性，且无需将权重限制在初始化的小邻域内；由此导出期望训练损失的非渐近上界，并给出保证收敛到有限损失下界的宽度与噪声温度显式条件。实验显示网络 Jacobian 会偏离初始化，即离开常用的 lazy regime。

Conclusion: 噪声在有限宽度过参数化网络训练中具有建设性作用：可在不发生参数漂移受限的前提下维持 NTK 稳定并保证收敛到有限损失下界，且实际动力学可脱离 lazy regime，拓展了超越初始化邻域假设的收敛分析框架。

Abstract: Existing convergence analyses of finite-width overparameterized deep neural networks under standard parameterization often rely on parameters remaining close to their initialization and typically neglect the role of noise, despite empirical evidence that stochasticity can improve optimization and generalization. To bridge this gap, we study $L_2$-regularized continuous-time Langevin dynamics (CLD) with isotropic noise, for training feedforward networks with smooth activations. We introduce a change-of-measure inequality, inspired by the second law of thermodynamics, that enables control of key properties of the training dynamics under the time-evolving parameter distribution. Leveraging a sharpened lower bound on the minimum eigenvalue of the Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) at initialization, we show that injected noise helps preserve NTK stability with high probability without confining the weights to a small neighborhood of their initialization. As a result, we derive a non-asymptotic upper bound on the expected training loss. Our analysis yields explicit conditions on width and noise temperature that guarantee convergence to a finite loss floor. Finally, we experimentally show the network Jacobian can change from initialization, departing the commonly analyzed lazy regime.

</details>


### [861] [Process-Aware Event Log Augmentation for Process Prediction under Labeled Data Scarcity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24777)
*Sjoerd van Straten,Alessandro Padella,Marwan Hassani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SiamSA-PPM，一个结合孪生学习与基于统计的数据增强的自监督预测式流程监控框架，在缺乏标注数据的情况下实现有竞争力的预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习的预测式流程监控（PPM）方法受限于标注数据稀缺以及真实事件日志变异性低的问题，难以学习到泛化性强的表示。

Method: SiamSA-PPM将孪生（Siamese）学习与有统计依据的数据增强相结合，采用新的变换方法，利用控制流语义和频繁行为模式生成真实且语义有效的轨迹变体，从而在无标注监督下学习可泛化的前缀表示；并在真实事件日志上进行大量实验及充分的超参数调优。

Result: 在下一活动预测与最终结果预测任务上，SiamSA-PPM相较最先进基线取得有竞争力或更优的预测性能，验证了流程感知数据增强的价值。

Conclusion: 流程感知的自监督增强可有效缓解标注稀缺问题，提升PPM模型表示学习与预测表现，并已开源实现。

Abstract: Predictive Process Monitoring (PPM) forecasts future events of ongoing business processes based on event logs. However, deep learning PPM approaches are often limited by labeled data scarcity and the low variability of real-world logs. To address this, we introduce SiamSA-PPM, a self-supervised framework combining Siamese learning with statistically grounded data augmentation. It employs novel transformation methods that leverage control-flow semantics and frequent behavioral patterns to generate realistic, semantically valid trace variants, learning generalizable prefix representations without labeled supervision. Extensive experiments on real-world event logs with a wide range of variability, incorporating exhaustive hyperparameter tuning, demonstrate the value of this process-aware augmentation. Compared to state-of-the-art baselines, SiamSA-PPM achieves competitive or superior predictive performance in both next activity and final outcome prediction tasks. An open source implementation of our method is publicly available under https://github.com/SvStraten/SiamSA-PPM-Extension..

</details>


### [862] [First-Order LoRA Training with Phone NPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24816)
*Xu Zheng,Wei Cheng,Zhuomin Chen,Dongkuan Xu,Mo Sha,Jingchao Ni,Dongsheng Luo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出在手机NPU上执行LoRA训练中全部三次冻结权重乘积的系统，训练图/适配器/优化器留在CPU，实现端侧高效微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧LoRA微调可避免上传隐私数据，但每个一阶训练步仍需在forward、激活重计算和输入梯度计算中与冻结基座权重相乘。手机NPU已驻留这些权重用于推理，但其推理接口不支持输入梯度计算，故需设计可行方案。

Method: 将三次冻结权重乘积全部放到NPU执行，CPU保留训练图、适配器与优化器；输入梯度核复用驻留权重块与前向反量化器，避免转置权重拷贝并保证前后向使用同一有效权重；按梯度敏感度选择精度，并对FP16输出施加逐行范围保护；运行时融合剩余CPU算子、重叠NPU执行与适配器计算，并支持可恢复执行与热节流调控。

Result: 在两个Qualcomm Snapdragon平台、Qwen与Llama家族四个LLM上评估；工作负载含夜间个性化（手机端标注）与公开LaMP-2基准；对比优化CPU训练器、手机GPU训练器、仅前向训练及GPU训练参考。

Conclusion: 该系统通过NPU承载冻结权重乘积，在端侧实现完整LoRA训练流程，并借助精度选择、算子融合与调度机制保证梯度可用与长时间后台训练可行。

Abstract: On-device fine-tuning lets a large language model (LLM) learn from its user's private data without uploading it. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) reduces the trainable parameters, but each first-order training step still multiplies by the frozen base-model weights during the forward pass, activation recomputation, and input-gradient computation. A phone's neural processing unit (NPU) already holds these weights for inference; using it for training also requires computing input gradients, which its inference interface does not support. We present a system that runs all three frozen-weight products on the NPU while keeping the training graph, adapters, and optimizer on the CPU. Its input-gradient kernels reuse the resident weight tiles and the forward dequantizer, avoiding a transposed weight copy and ensuring forward and backward use the same effective weights. To preserve usable gradients, the system selects precision by gradient sensitivity and applies a per-row range guard for half-precision (FP16) outputs. Its runtime fuses the remaining CPU operators and overlaps NPU execution with adapter computation, while resumable execution and thermal pacing let training proceed as a background job. We evaluate it on two Qualcomm Snapdragon platforms using four LLMs from the Qwen and Llama families. Our workloads cover nightly personalization with labels supplied on the phone and the public LaMP-2 benchmark; comparisons include an optimized CPU trainer, a phone-GPU trainer, forward-only training, and GPU-trained references.

</details>


### [863] [Pair-Aware Optimization: Coordinating Exploration and Refinement for Jailbreaking LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24823)
*Juanyang Xu,Zheng Wang,Xingyu Zhao,Siddartha Khastgir,Andi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究大语言模型（LLM）智能体越狱攻击中零阶（ZO）与一阶（FO）优化的互补性与顺序问题，提出ZO-FO混合框架及Pair-aware优化策略，并在随机生成视角下采用一致性随机解码，实验表明混合优化优于单一优化器且优化顺序显著影响性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于优化的越狱攻击主要分为利用梯度信息的一阶方法和依赖函数值反馈的零阶方法，但二者的互补性及优化顺序尚未被充分探索；同时，智能体的随机生成特性使同一对抗输入可诱发多样推理轨迹与行为，单次贪婪输出难以刻画。

Method: 系统性对比四种策略（纯ZO、纯FO、ZO→FO、FO→ZO）；构建ZO-FO框架，用ZO优化探索对抗前缀、用FO优化精炼对应后缀；引入Pair-aware优化，保留多个前缀候选、条件性地精炼其后缀并在生成的“前缀-后缀对”间选择；在优化与评估阶段均采用一致的随机解码。

Result: 在恶意指令与恶意环境两类基准上，混合优化相比单一优化器方法提升了攻击有效性；优化顺序对性能有显著影响。

Conclusion: ZO与FO优化具有互补性，混合优化的效果依赖合理的优化顺序与配对式协调机制，随机解码的一致性是评估智能体越狱的必要设定。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are vulnerable to adversarial inputs that induce attacker-specified malicious behaviors, commonly referred to as jailbreaking. Existing optimization-based jailbreak attacks primarily employ first-order (FO) methods that leverage gradient information or zeroth-order (ZO) methods that rely on function-value feedback. However, their complementarity and optimization ordering remain underexplored. We systematically investigate four strategies: pure ZO, pure FO, ZO->FO, and FO->ZO, and develop a ZO-FO framework that explores adversarial prefixes through ZO optimization and refines their corresponding suffixes through FO optimization. To coordinate the two processes, we introduce Pair-aware optimization, which retains multiple prefix candidates, conditionally refines their suffixes and selects among the resulting prefix-suffix pairs. We further investigate agent jailbreaking from a more general stochastic-generation perspective, where the same adversarial input can induce diverse reasoning trajectories and actions that a single greedy output cannot capture. Accordingly, we adopt consistent stochastic decoding during both optimization and evaluation. Experiments across malicious-instruction and malicious-environment benchmarks demonstrate that hybrid optimization improves attack effectiveness over single-optimizer methods, while optimization order substantially influences performance.

</details>


### [864] [Compose the Horizon: Parameter-Shared Blockwise Forecasting under a Sequential-Compute Trade-off](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24826)
*Zeyan Li,Weiheng Li,Shengda Zhuo,Libing Chen,Min Chen,Yin Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出递归函数分解（RFD），用参数共享的紧凑算子顺序复用输出连续未来块，以存储参数换取串行计算，在长时程预测中以极少参数取得更优误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多数长时程预测器一次性输出完整未来。作者探究能否用紧凑的共享算子反复输出来预测连续未来块，实现"以存储换计算"的分解式预测。

Method: RFD将时程映射分解为三个参数共享的块预测：各块占据不相交的未来区间并拼接（而非趋势/季节/残差加和），且每块输出并入滚动上下文以条件化下一次应用。采用三随机种子受控实验做消融，并在冻结长上下文设置下与十类强基线比较。

Result: 移除前向反馈在全部四个数据集上均造成退化，而阻断其梯度几乎无影响，说明有用信号来自演化的预测状态本身；重复应用共享算子有稳定增益但弱于加宽算子。模型仅0.08–0.46M参数，但高通道数下串行逐通道执行比迭代基线更慢且更耗内存。在24个评估单元中23个测试误差更低（RFD用512/720步上下文，基线用96步，属跨协议比较）。

Conclusion: 参数共享的顺序块递推可作为一种高参数效率的长时程预测范式，但其优势依赖于前向反馈状态而非梯度传播；代价是推理速度与内存开销，且比较为跨协议，需谨慎解读。

Abstract: Most long-horizon forecasters emit the complete future in one pass. We ask whether a compact operator can instead be reused to emit contiguous future blocks, trading stored parameters for sequential computation. Recursive Functional Decomposition (RFD) factorizes the horizon mapping into three parameter-shared block predictions. The blocks occupy disjoint future intervals and are concatenated, not added as trend, seasonal, or residual components, and each emitted block joins the rolling context that conditions the next application. In controlled three-seed experiments, removing forward feedback hurts all four evaluated datasets while stopping gradients through it changes little, so the useful signal is the evolving forecast state itself; reapplying the shared operator helps consistently, but by less than widening it. The model uses 0.08--0.46M parameters, yet its sequential channel-wise execution is slower and more memory-intensive than an iterative baseline at high channel count. In a frozen long-context evaluation against ten strong baseline families, RFD records lower test error in 23 of 24 cells; the comparison is cross-protocol, with RFD using 512/720-step context and the baselines using 96.

</details>


### [865] [A Statistical Viewpoint on Adam, Shampoo and Muon](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24839)
*Tetiana Parshakova,Robert M. Gower,Paulo Orenstein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文从统计学视角重新审视随机优化器设计：将梯度建模为正态分布，主张用其协方差对随机梯度做白化（whitening），并给出基于正则化似然/极大后验估计的在线均值-方差估计框架。在该框架下，对角协方差近似导出与 Adam 高度相关的方法（MND），Kronecker 分解近似导出 MN（Shampoo/KL-Shampoo 变体）；将框架用于梯度方向而非完整梯度可复原 Muon，再结合白化得到 MN-Muon。实验表明 MND 在 Chinchilla 规模 GPT-2 类模型上优于 Distributed Shampoo 与 KL-Shampoo，MND-Muon 多数情形优于 Muon，但 NorMuon 表现与之相当甚至略优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有随机优化方法（Adam、Shampoo、Muon 等）多源于经验启发，缺乏统一的理论/统计学解释。作者希望建立一个统一的统计框架，把多种预条件方法与梯度白化联系起来，并据此系统性地推导新的优化器。

Method: 1) 用正态分布建模梯度，论证应使用协方差对随机梯度进行白化；2) 基于正则化似然（等价于 MAP 估计）提出在线估计梯度均值与方差的算法；3) 在同一框架内引入结构化协方差近似：对角近似（导出类 Adam 的 MND）与 Kronecker 因子分解近似（导出 MN，即 Shampoo/KL-Shampoo 变体）；4) 将框架应用于梯度方向而非完整梯度以复原 Muon，并与白化步骤结合得到 MN-Muon；5) 在对角实现下于 GPT-2 类模型、Chinchilla 规模（GPT-small/medium，FineWeb 数据）上进行实验对比。

Result: MND（MN 的对角实现）在稳定性、最终验证损失与耗时上均优于 Distributed Shampoo 和 KL-Shampoo；MND-Muon 在 24 组配对 GPT-small 运行中的 21 组优于 Muon，并在 GPT-medium 上取得更低的最佳验证损失，且在测试的 6 个学习率下均保持稳定。值得注意的是，NorMuon 与 MND-Muon 表现相当，并在 GPT-medium 及 GPT-small、batch 512 的 FineWeb 设置上取得略低的验证损失。

Conclusion: 统一的统计白化框架能够自然导出 Adam、Shampoo/KL-Shampoo 与 Muon 等已有方法，并提供新变体 MN、MND、MN-Muon。实验支持对角实现在效率与稳定性上的优势，但 NorMuon 的可比甚至略优表现表明所提方法并非全面占优，仍需进一步比较与消融。

Abstract: We provide new statistical insights into designing stochastic optimization methods. By modeling the gradient via a normal distribution, we argue that the stochastic gradient should be whitened using its covariance. We give an online method for estimating the mean and variance of the gradients based on regularized likelihood or, equivalently, through a maximum a posteriori estimate. We then show how to use structured approximations to the covariance within this same framework, which includes diagonal and Kronecker-factored approximations. The diagonal approximation results in a method that is very closely related to Adam and performs as well in practice. The Kronecker approximation results in the new MN method, which is a variant of Shampoo and KL-Shampoo. We also recover Muon by applying this same statistical framework to the gradient direction rather than the full gradient. By combining this with a whitening step, we arrive at MN-Muon, a novel preconditioned version of Muon. Our experiments on GPT-2-type models at Chinchilla scale indicate that MND, the diagonal implementation of MN, outperforms both the Distributed Shampoo and the KL-Shampoo implementations in terms of stability, final validation loss and time taken. MND-Muon, the diagonal implementation of MN-Muon, improves on Muon in 21 of 24 paired GPT-small runs and achieves a lower best validation loss on GPT-medium, where it remains stable over the six tested learning rates. However, we found that NorMuon was comparable to MND-Muon and achieved a slightly lower validation loss on GPT-medium and at GPT-small batch 512 on FineWeb.

</details>


### [866] [An Impossibility Result for ETF Target Geometry, and an Equinorm Remedy for Imbalanced Analytic Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24844)
*Berk Sezer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 融合解析持续学习(ACL)的精确闭式更新与Simplex ETF目标是无效的——融合结果等价于普通one-hot ACIL；Simplex ETF在类数上不嵌套，"渐进扩展ETF"会破坏ETF性质并引入灾难性遗忘(4倍)。将ETF的等角性与等范性分离并作用于分类器权重，等范后处理在长尾流上显著提升尾类与平均精度，而等角几何要么无效要么有害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ACL方法(如ACIL、GACL)通过Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury恒等式在冻结特征上实现无样本、精确的岭回归分类头更新；另一条线ProNC表明渐进扩展的Simplex ETF目标对标准持续分类器有益。作者据此检验"精确解析更新+ETF目标"融合是否能得到更好的闭式持续学习器。

Method: 理论上证明融合ETF目标与one-hot在解析岭回归头下等价（目标侧的尺度与角结构被吸收）；指出Simplex ETF在类数变化时不嵌套，字面"渐进扩展"会破坏ETF性质。进而将ETF的等角性与等范性拆解，分别施加于分类器权重（而非目标），利用权重侧不具备上述不变性；具体实现为对拟合权重进行等范后处理。

Result: 融合构造比经典ACIL头产生约4倍灾难性遗忘。等范后处理在5:1至100:1长尾区间恢复尾类与总体平均精度，例如CIFAR-100/ViT在100:1下尾类+32.0点、平均+16.0点，符号在两个骨干与两个数据集上一致；代价是近平衡流(<≈3:1)上CIFAR-100/ViT平均精度损失5.4点。等角几何在目标侧完全惰性，在权重侧反而有害，通常劣于普通one-hot。

Conclusion: 在解析持续学习中，神经坍缩几何真正有用的是权重侧的等范后处理，且随类不平衡加剧收益增大；等角性最好情况下是空操作，最坏情况会诱发灾难性遗忘。

Abstract: Analytic continual learning (ACL) methods such as ACIL and GACL fit a ridge-regression classifier head on frozen features via the Sherman-Morrison-Woodbury identity, achieving exemplar-free, exact updates. A separate line of work, Progressive Neural Collapse (ProNC), shows standard continual classifiers benefit from a progressively expanding Simplex Equiangular Tight Frame (ETF) target. It is natural to ask whether fusing the two ideas, exact analytic updates and ETF targets, would yield a better closed-form continual learner. We show this is not the case as the fusion turns out to be identical to plain one-hot ACIL. Further, Simplex ETFs are not nested across class counts, so the literal "progressively expand the ETF" construction stops yielding an ETF as new tasks arrive, and it introduces catastrophic forgetting ($4\times$ that of a classic ACIL head). We therefore separate an ETF's two defining properties, equiangularity and equinormality, and apply each on its own to the classifier weights rather than the targets, where the invariance above does not hold. Equinorm post-processing of the fitted weights recovers both tail-class and overall average accuracy across the long-tailed regime from 5:1 to 100:1 imbalance (e.g. +32.0 tail-accuracy points and +16.0 average-accuracy points at 100:1 on CIFAR-100/ViT), transferring in sign across two backbones and two datasets, at a mild cost of 5.4 average-accuracy points on CIFAR-100/ViT on near-balanced streams (below $\approx 3{:}1$). Equiangular geometry, by contrast, is exactly inert on the target side but actively harmful on the weight side, usually losing to plain one-hot. Hence, the generally useful part of Neural Collapse geometry in Analytic Continual Learning is equinorm post-processing of the weights, becoming more useful as class imbalance grows; and equiangularity is at best a no-op and induces catastrophic forgetting at worst.

</details>


### [867] [LLM-Based Evaluation Planning for Heterogeneous Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24855)
*Nian Ran,Sebastian Brulin,Markus Olhofer,Mauricio A. Álvarez,Richard Allmendinger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 REP-HO：用 LLM 替代规则式混合保真度选择，作为异构优化中的评估规划器；两变体在五种异构情境下均取得最佳平均排名，并展现自适应分配行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构优化中，优化器不仅要选候选解，还要在成本与保真度不同的条件下决定评估哪些目标与约束。现有 SOTA（如 MFE-NSGA-III）依赖人工设计的启发式规则与超参数，行为受预设规则主导，缺乏灵活性。

Method: REP-HO 以 LLM 作为推理式评估规划器，接收与启发式规划器相同的原始优化状态信息（代理模型预测、不确定性、评估成本、预算状态等）；在基础版本上引入自适应最近邻摘要增强每个决策。评估情境包括成本失衡、约束难度、代理保真度、预算水平与目标冲突。

Result: 基础版 REP-HO 与人工度量方法 MFE-NSGA-III 性能相当；加入最近邻摘要后结果更好且更稳定。五种情境中两变体之一均取得最佳平均排名，REP-HO(Deepseek) 全程位列第一或第二；规划器呈现自适应分配行为，如预算紧张时优先约束评估、代理可靠性变化时重新分配约束评估预算。

Conclusion: LLM 可作为异构优化的灵活评估规划器，为固定人工设计度量提供通用替代方案。

Abstract: Heterogeneous optimization problems require an optimizer to decide not only which candidate solutions to evaluate, but also which objectives and constraints should be evaluated under different costs and fidelities. Existing SOTA methods such as MFE-NSGA-III address this setting with manually designed selection metrics, but their behavior is largely determined by predefined heuristic rules and hyperparameters. In this work, we propose REP-HO, a reasoning-based evaluation planner that replaces the rule-based mixed-fidelity selection step with a large language model (LLM) planner. The LLM receives the same primitive optimization-state information as the heuristic planner, such as surrogate predictions, uncertainties, evaluation costs, and budget status. We first show that REP-HO achieves competitive performance compared to the human-designed metric-based method (MFE-NSGA-III). We then further enhance each decision with an adaptive nearest-neighbor summary, leading to better and more stable results. We evaluate REP-HO across five heterogeneous regimes covering cost imbalance, constraint difficulty, surrogate fidelity, budget level, and objective conflict. Across these regimes, one of the two variants obtains the best mean ranking score in every regime, REP-HO(Deepseek) is first or second throughout, and the planner shows adaptive allocation behavior, such as prioritizing constraint evaluations under tighter budgets and reallocating constraint evaluation budget when surrogate reliability changes. These results suggest that LLMs can serve as flexible evaluation planners for heterogeneous optimization, offering a general alternative to fixed hand-designed metrics.

</details>


### [868] [FlowMaker: From Tasks to Cost-Efficient Generative AI Workflow Deployments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24861)
*Dimitrios Liakopoulos,Prasoon Sinha,Neeraja J. Yadwadkar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FlowMaker 面向生成式 AI 工作流，在动态集群状态下联合选择工作流结构、模型分配与部署配置，通过约束引导、负载感知的剪枝算法实现快速在线决策，相比 Murakkab 等基线最高提升 10.14 倍 goodput、降低 2.77 倍成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统在优化工作流结构、模型选择与部署配置时各自为政或提前固定，在动态负载与资源约束下导致成本次优、goodput 偏低；同时已部署 LLM 的复用以降低本需求依赖于当前负载与资源可用性，必须在线完成，因而该选择问题具有强时间敏感性。

Method: 提出 FlowMaker，对外暴露任务级接口并替用户选择 workflow-variant（工作流、模型与部署配置的组合）；设计约束引导、负载感知的剪枝算法，在动态集群状态下快速在线联合探索候选组合。

Result: 相比包括 Murakkab 在内的 SOTA 基线，goodput 最高提升 10.14 倍，成本最高降低 2.77 倍。

Conclusion: 将工作流结构、模型分配与部署配置统一为联合优化对象并在线求解，是提升生成式 AI 工作流服务效率与成本效益的关键路径。

Abstract: Generative AI workflows execute user tasks by composing sequences of LLM calls, where each call performs a sub-task (e.g., summarization or translation), forming a workflow. Executing such workflows requires decisions over workflow structure, model assignments, and deployment configurations, which jointly determine latency, cost, and accuracy under dynamic workloads and resource constraints. Existing systems optimize these decisions in isolation or fix them early, leading to suboptimal cost and goodput. We make two key observations. First, efficient serving requires jointly exploring all combinations of workflows, model choices, and deployment configurations under dynamic cluster state. Second, reuse of deployed LLMs is critical for reducing cost, but must be performed on-the-fly, as reuse depends on current load and resource availability. Together, these make selecting a workflow-variant-a combination of workflow, models, and deployment configuration-a time-critical problem. We present FlowMaker, which exposes a task-level interface and selects workflow-variants on behalf of users. To realize this, we design a constraint-guided load-aware pruning algorithm for fast, on-the-fly decisions. FlowMaker improves goodput by up to 10.14$\times$ and reduces cost by up to 2.77$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art baselines, including Murakkab.

</details>


### [869] [RAFT: Redundancy-Aware Input Filtering for Temporal Graph Neural Network Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24875)
*Yue Dai,Sarah Zhou,Youtao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAFT是一个冗余感知的输入过滤框架，利用节点记忆变化识别TGNN训练中的冗余事件，在不损失精度的前提下减少训练输入与时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TGNN训练需处理的事件数量随图快速增长，且事件间因节点记忆更新形成依赖，限制并行并削弱算力收益。作者因此质疑：是否所有事件及其引入的依赖对学习都是必要的。

Method: 观察到涉及稳定节点记忆的预测目标损失更低、过滤与稳定记忆关联的历史事件可保持相似训练损失轨迹，据此以节点记忆变化识别输入冗余。RAFT在训练中跟踪记忆变化并驱动两个过滤器：root-event filter在训练前移除部分预测目标，support-event filter在采样时排除部分历史上下文，从而在下游准备与处理之前削减工作量。

Result: 在3种TGNN模型和5个数据集上，RAFT平均减少35.23%、最多97.11%的训练输入，记录训练时间最多减少52.56%，模型精度变化可忽略。

Conclusion: 节点记忆变化可作为有效的冗余信号，输入过滤能在保持精度的同时显著降低TGNN训练成本。

Abstract: Temporal graph neural networks (TGNNs) have shown strong performance on dynamic graph learning tasks by continuously updating node memories from evolving interactions (i.e., events) and leveraging these memories for downstream predictions. As graphs grow rapidly in modern applications, training requires processing an increasing number of events; meanwhile, each event can update node memories used by later events, creating dependencies that constrain parallel execution and limit the benefits of additional computing resources. These costs motivate an upstream question: Are all events, and the dependencies they introduce, necessary for learning? We investigate this question through two roles of temporal events: prediction targets and historical events sampled as inputs. We observe that targets involving stable node memories tend to exhibit lower prediction loss, while filtering historical events associated with stable memories can retain similar training-loss trajectories in several evaluated settings. Together, these observations suggest an opportunity to identify input redundancy through changes in node memories. Building on this opportunity, we propose RAFT, a redundancy-aware input-filtering framework for TGNN training. RAFT tracks memory changes during training and uses them to guide two filters: a root-event filter removes selected prediction targets before training, and a support-event filter excludes selected historical context during sampling. Filtering inputs before their downstream preparation and processing reduces the work they trigger. Across three TGNN models and five datasets, RAFT reduces training inputs by 35.23% on average and up to 97.11%, while reducing recorded training time by up to 52.56\% with negligible changes to model precisions.

</details>


### [870] [Sample-Efficient Reinforcement Learning with General Utilities via Neural Dual Critics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24880)
*Ankur Naskar,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向凹性RLGU目标的自然actor-critic方法，直接用神经网络critic学习策略梯度伪奖励，并用多层蒙特卡洛控制偏差，获得Õ(T^{-1/2})全局收敛与Õ(ε^{-2})样本复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 带general utilities的强化学习（RLGU）优化的是占用测度的非线性泛函，而传统方法需先估计占用测度再构造伪奖励，估计误差与偏差传播难以控制，且现有理论多局限于有限状态-动作空间或固定有限维回报向量。

Method: 针对具精确变分对偶表示的凹RLGU目标，设计自然actor-critic：不显式估计占用测度，而以神经critic直接学习状态-动作对上的伪奖励；critic用投影随机更新训练，多层蒙特卡洛聚合不同训练时域的输出以对数期望代价控制偏差；理论分析将条件actor偏差与估计量二阶矩分离，并显式计入对偶优化误差、critic逼近误差与神经线性化误差。

Result: 在策略迁移、对偶稳定与局部critic正则条件下，方法以Õ(T)期望环境转移与参考样本达到策略、critic类与有限宽度逼近误差之上的Õ(T^{-1/2})全局收敛；固定critic表示时，在逼近下界之上取得Õ(ε^{-2})样本复杂度，覆盖无限状态-动作空间及超出固定有限回报向量的占用效用。

Conclusion: 直接学习伪奖励的自然actor-critic为一般效用强化学习提供了带显式误差分解的可证明收敛框架，将样本复杂度扩展到无限状态-动作空间与更广的分离型占用效用类。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with general utilities optimizes nonlinear functionals of policy-induced occupancy measures. We develop a natural actor-critic method for concave RLGU objectives admitting an exact variational dual representation, with explicit constructions for a broad class of separable occupancy utilities. Rather than estimating the occupancy measure and then forming the policy-gradient pseudo-reward, our method learns this pseudo-reward directly as a function of the state-action pair using a neural critic. The critic is trained by projected stochastic updates, while multilevel Monte Carlo combines outputs across training horizons to control its bias at logarithmic expected cost. Our analysis separates conditional actor bias from estimator second moments and accounts explicitly for dual optimization, critic approximation, and neural linearization errors. Under policy-transfer, dual-stability, and local critic-regularity conditions, the method achieves $\widetilde{O}(T^{-1/2})$ global convergence above policy, critic-class, and finite-width approximation errors using $\widetilde{O}(T)$ expected environment transitions and reference samples. For a fixed critic representation, this yields $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-2})$ sampling complexity above the approximation floor, covering infinite state-action spaces and occupancy utilities beyond fixed finite vectors of returns.

</details>


### [871] [Distribution-Based Regularization for Reward Fine-Tuning Diffusion and Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24897)
*Romeo Passaro,Jeongjae Lee,Jong Chul Ye,Michael M. Bronstein,Yoshua Bengio,Alexander Tong,Danyal Rehman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DFR将KL正则目标从线性期望奖励推广到生成分布的凸泛函，其第一变分给出分布相关的逐样本有效奖励，直接约束分布漂移，在文生图微调中匹配KL基线峰值奖励并将多样性提升至多29%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散/流匹配模型的奖励微调易导致模式崩塌与分布漂移。现有方法用反向KL正则（实现为速度场上的ℓ2惩罚）来控制漂移，但它只是间接约束采样动力学，并未直接作用于生成分布本身。

Method: 提出DFR（Distributional Functional Rewards）：在任务奖励上附加一个依赖分布、逐样本的奖励项，显式作用于生成分布。形式上把KL正则目标从对模型分布线性的期望奖励推广为分布的凸泛函，并用该目标的第一变分定义有效的分布相关奖励，直接惩罚偏离预训练分布的行为。该框架为Fréchet距离、MMD、DreamSim多样性给出可加的逐样本奖励，并将若干近期提出的奖励作为特例。

Result: 在多种文生图微调任务中，DFR在相同或更低漂移下达到与KL调参基线相当的峰值奖励，同时将多样性提升至多29%。

Conclusion: 以分布凸泛函及其第一变分为核心的DFR提供了直接作用于生成分布的正则机制，统一并推广了现有的KL正则与多种分布型奖励，在奖励与多样性之间取得更优权衡。

Abstract: Reward fine-tuning is an effective way to adapt pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models to downstream objectives, but aggressive optimization often leads to mode collapse and distributional drift. Existing methods attempt to control this drift with reverse-KL regularization, implemented as an $\ell_2$ penalty on the velocity field; however, this functions by indirectly constraining sampling dynamics rather than directly acting on the generated distribution. To address this, we propose DFR (Distributional Functional Rewards), which augments the task reward with a distribution-dependent, per-sample reward that acts explicitly on the generated distribution. Formally, we generalize the KL-regularized objective from expected rewards, which are linear in the model's distribution, to convex functionals of it. The first variation of this objective defines an effective, distribution-dependent reward that directly penalizes deviation from the pretrained distribution. This formulation yields additive per-sample rewards for the Fréchet distance (FD), maximum mean discrepancy (MMD), and DreamSim diversity, recovering several recently proposed rewards as special cases. Across various text-to-image fine-tuning tasks, DFR matches the peak reward of KL-tuned baselines while increasing diversity by up to 29% at equal or lower drift.

</details>


### [872] [A Symmetry-Matching Approach to Blind-Spot Reduction in Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24908)
*Csaba Balogh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出扰动感知的 $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ 正则项，重定向 SAE 特征基，提升对语义区分输入的弱尾响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型在表征层面会把语义不同的输入当作可互换，形成标准 SAE 目标未针对的盲点；在临床剂量提取、法律条款解释、金融金额核验等安全关键场景中，此类失败会静默传播到下游决策。

Method: 将问题建模为特征基定向问题；借鉴代数检错理论的对称匹配视角，在 SAE 训练中加入可微的 $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ 正则项，惩罚指定扰动族内不均衡的扰动响应；采用冻结的多随机种子评估协议，并在 GPT-2、Gemma 2、Qwen 2.5 上对比 Standard SAE、JumpReLU、MDL 目标；辅以族几何控制、留出探针与零校准分离检验。

Result: $V$ 正则化同时提升相对与绝对下尾响应并降低响应画像不均衡，且通用文本重构无显著退化；JumpReLU 与 MDL 在相同协议下仍接近 Standard SAE 画像；族几何控制表明效果不能由模板重复或单一主导扰动族解释；分布外临床放射学最小对立对的零样本审计在各模型×族单元均出现相对弱尾提升，但与训练统计量并非完全秩一致，留出族审计也在未参与训练的族类上成立。

Conclusion: 扰动感知的 SAE 训练可将特征基重定向至安全相关输入变化，但下游判别性仍需作为独立的实证步骤加以验证。

Abstract: Language models can treat semantically distinct inputs as interchangeable at the representation level, creating blind spots that standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not target. In safety-critical settings such as clinical dosage extraction, legal clause interpretation, or financial amount verification, such failures can propagate silently into downstream decisions. We study this problem as one of feature-basis orientation. Building on a symmetry-matching view from algebraic error-detection theory, we add a differentiable $V_{\mathrm{Gini}}$ regularisation term to SAE training that penalises uneven perturbation response within a specified family. Across GPT-2, Gemma 2, and Qwen 2.5, a frozen multi-seed evaluation shows that $V$-regularisation raises both relative and absolute lower-tail responses while reducing response-profile imbalance, with no material general-text reconstruction degradation. JumpReLU and minimum description length (MDL) objectives remain close to the Standard SAE profile under the same protocol. Family-geometry controls show that the effect is not explained by template duplication or a single dominant perturbation family, and held-out probes plus null-calibrated separation tests evaluate how far the representation-level change carries to downstream discriminability. A zero-shot audit on out-of-distribution clinical radiology minimal pairs finds the relative weak-tail lift in all evaluated model-by-family cells, not perfectly rank-aligned with the trained statistic, and a held-out family audit finds it on family kinds never used in training. Together, the results show that perturbation-aware SAE training can reorient feature bases toward safety-relevant input changes while leaving downstream validation as a separate empirical step.

</details>


### [873] [Arctic-SWE: Revisiting the Long Horizon Agent Training by Modeling-System Co-Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24914)
*Boyi Liu,Yite Wang,Xinyu Lian,Fan Shu,Sida Li,Feng Yan,Mingjia Zhang,Yuxiong He,Zhewei Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Arctic-SWE 是一个完全异步的强化学习框架，通过模型-系统协同设计，用少量任务池上的过拟合作为测试床，整合了门控奖励、重要性权重控制、训练-推理引擎对齐和政策更新间状态一致四项既有组件，构建了一个可复现的强基线；在原始 R2E-Gym 数据上把 Qwen3.5-4B 训练到 SWE-bench Verified 62.0% pass@1，进一步筛选数据后 4B/9B 模型在 Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上均有显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程智能体训练（如软件工程）发展迅速，但强 RL 基线所需的配方与基础设施难以复现，导致新算法或数据带来的增益难以与"基线调参不足"区分开。论文希望建立一个有文档、可复现的强基线，作为研究更好算法、数据和环境的起点。

Method: 提出完全异步 RL 框架 Arctic-SWE，以"小任务池过拟合"为测试床，暴露早期奖励增益所掩盖的失败，并据此整合四项非新颖但关键的组件：门控奖励（gated reward）、重要性权重控制（importance-weight control）、训练与推理引擎对齐、政策更新间的状态一致（consistent state）。在原始 R2E-Gym 数据上不做算法或数据改动直接训练，并进一步对 R2E-Gym、SWE-rebench V2、Scale-SWE 进行筛选与精炼；通过受控对比分析数据筛选与测试强化各自的作用。

Result: 原始 R2E-Gym 数据上，Qwen3.5-4B 达到 SWE-bench Verified 62.0% pass@1，与依赖在线任务合成的 FrogNano（61.5%）相当，但训练 rollout 数约为其 1/6。使用精炼数据后，4B 模型在 Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2 上由 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% 提升至 65.0%/38.3%/59.7%；Qwen3.5-9B 由 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% 提升至 65.7%/39.6%/70.2%。受控对比表明数据筛选与测试强化均提升留出性能，但更强的测试会降低训练任务上的表观掌握度。

Conclusion: Arctic-SWE 表明，无需新算法，仅靠系统层面的协同设计即可建立强且可复现的异步智能体 RL 基线；该框架为研究更优算法、数据与环境提供了有文档的出发点。

Abstract: Long-horizon agent training, including software engineering, is advancing rapidly, but the recipe and infrastructure needed for a strong reinforcement-learning baseline remain difficult to reproduce. This makes gains from new algorithms or data hard to distinguish from improvements to an under-tuned baseline. We present Arctic-SWE, a fully asynchronous RL framework that establishes such a baseline through model-system co-design, using overfitting on a small task pool as the testbed. This testbed exposes failures that early reward gains conceal and guides the integration of established components: gated reward, importance-weight control, aligned training and inference engines, and consistent state across policy updates. No single component is new, yet together they form the missing foundation. On raw R2E-Gym data, without new algorithms or data work, Arctic-SWE trains Qwen3.5-4B to 62.0% pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified. This is comparable to concurrent FrogNano (61.5%), which relies on online task synthesis, after about one-sixth as many training rollouts. Building on this foundation, we further filter and refine R2E-Gym, SWE-rebench V2, and Scale-SWE. With this curated subset, the 4B model improves from 47.4%/25.0%/37.9% to 65.0%/38.3%/59.7% on SWE-bench Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2, and the recipe also improves Qwen3.5-9B from 56.2%/31.9%/48.8% to 65.7%/39.6%/70.2% on Verified/Pro-v1/Pro-v2. Controlled comparisons show that both curation and test strengthening improve held-out performance, although stronger tests reduce apparent training-task mastery. Arctic-SWE provides a documented starting point for studying better algorithms, data and environments for asynchronous agent RL.

</details>


### [874] [CARTA: Self-Supervised Reusable Transaction Embeddings via Heterogeneous Tokenization and Cross-Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24920)
*Shreyas K. Chandrahas,Jose Munoz,Satish Babu Bellapu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CARTA：一种面向支付交易的无标签自监督编码器，学习16维紧凑嵌入，冻结后复用于标签高效的欺诈检测与无监督风险分层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 支付欺诈标签获取成本高且跨任务不一致；商户名等高基数标识符使one-hot特征管线在大规模场景下不可行。因此需要一种无需标签、可复用的表示学习方法。

Method: CARTA采用类型特定的投影层，并为高基数标识符配备可学习的嵌入表；以token切除（token excision）和InfoNCE对比损失进行自监督训练，得到16维嵌入；冻结后用于线性探针和下游GBDT等任务，无需重训编码器。

Result: IEEE-CIS上，1%标签的线性探针优于100%标签的原始特征探针；IBM TabFormer（200万行）上，冻结嵌入的GBDT AUPRC为0.508，高于频率编码（0.411）与丢弃商户基线（0.022）；但全监督CatBoost更强。

Conclusion: CARTA提供了一种无标签、可复用的表示，可作为任务特定监督模型的补充，显著提升标签效率，但不替代全监督模型的最佳性能。

Abstract: Acquiring fraud labels for payment transactions is expensive and inconsistent across tasks, and high-cardinality identifiers such as merchant names make one-hot feature pipelines infeasible at scale. We present CARTA, a self-supervised encoder that learns a compact 16-dim embedding from raw transactions without labels; the frozen embedding is then reused for label-efficient fraud probing and exploratory unsupervised risk stratification without retraining the encoder. CARTA uses type-specific projections with learned embedding tables for high-cardinality identifiers, trained with token excision and InfoNCE contrastive loss. On IEEE-CIS, its linear probe at 1% of labels exceeds a raw-feature probe at 100%; on IBM TabFormer (2M rows), its frozen embedding reaches GBDT AUPRC 0.508, above frequency encoding (0.411) and the merchant-dropping baseline (0.022), though fully-supervised CatBoost is stronger. CARTA is a label-free, reusable representation that complements task-specific supervised models.

</details>


### [875] [TrustAgent-RFF: Agentic Diagnostic Planning for Reliable RF Fingerprinting under Domain Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24930)
*Chuan Liu,Tianya Zhao,Xuyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TrustAgent-RFF，一个在无目标域标签、冻结I/Q分类器条件下运行的预测级可靠性框架，通过射频证据采集、源域校准的信任估计与LLM规划器自适应诊断，将预测状态判为Accept/Reject/Defer。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RFF模型在源域条件下精度良好，但当接收机、距离、采集日期或环境变化时变得不可靠；且未见域上的错误预测往往仍具高softmax置信度，使单纯置信度阈值化不足以支撑可信部署。

Method: 对每个设备预测采集四类射频证据：反事实稳定性、原型一致性、采集域相似性、信号质量；由源域校准的信任估计器融合这些诊断量与分类器置信度、预测间隔及证据可用性指标；引入源域导出的下尾惩罚与跨模块交互，在诊断信号支持薄弱时降低信任；用LLM规划器依据证据、信任状态、动作代价与剩余预算自适应选择下一诊断动作；最后由确定性的源域校准决策层输出Accept/Reject/Defer。

Result: 在五个RFF数据集与多种分类器骨干上，源域到目标域平均精度下降38.7%，并证实大量目标域错误预测仍保持高置信度。

Conclusion: RFF的可靠性问题需在预测级、以证据驱动的信任机制处理；该框架无需目标域标签即可在冻结分类器上运行，并验证了高置信错误的存在，凸显得分校准与诊断式预测审查的必要性。

Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprinting (RFF) models can achieve accuracy under source domain conditions but become unreliable when the receiver, distance, collection day, or environment changes. Incorrect predictions in unseen domains may receive high softmax confidence, making confidence thresholding insufficient for trustworthy deployment. We propose TrustAgent-RFF, a prediction level reliability framework for RFF that operates with a frozen in-phase and quadrature (I/Q) classifier without target domain labels. For each device prediction, the framework acquires radio frequency evidence: counterfactual stability, prototype consistency, acquisition domain similarity, and signal quality. A source calibrated trust estimator combines these diagnostics with classifier confidence, prediction margin, and evidence availability indicators. Source derived lower tail penalties and cross module interactions reduce trust when diagnostic signals indicate weak support. A large language model (LLM) based planner adaptively selects the next diagnostic action based on evidence, trust state, action costs, and remaining budget. A deterministic source calibrated decision layer updates the prediction state as Accept, Reject, or Defer. Experiments across five RFF datasets and classifier backbones reveal an average source to target accuracy drop of 38.7% and show that many incorrect target domain predictions remain highly confident.

</details>


### [876] [MLFont: Machine Learning-Driven Font Subsetting and Range-Compact Unicode-Range Slicing for Low-Latency Web Typography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24937)
*Quan Wang,Yiran Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MLFont 提出机器学习与优化框架，从语料中学习网页字体分片策略，在大规模字符集字体上显著降低延迟与带宽并减少 CSS 分片数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CSS3 @font-face 的 unicode-range 可将字体切分为可下载分片，但仅适用于小字符集的启发式方法；LGC 与 CJK 字体含 2,297–30,759 个码点（WOFF2 158 KB–5.9 MB），启发式分区导致未用字形下载、高 HTTP RTT、CSS 膨胀或缺字回退。

Method: 三阶段：1) Zipf 高频层，隔离最高频码点；2) 潜在共现主题层，采用 Online Variational Bayes LDA 或带香农熵差损失与 Sinkhorn-Knopp 归一化的 DNN 主题模型；3) 模因式紧凑区间遗传算法，配合 Potts-Viterbi 动态规划与岛屿桥接，最小化主题差异与 CSS 碎片化。

Result: 在五款 Google Noto 字体（LGC、KR、JP、TC、SC）上，相较单文件投递 3G 单字形延迟降低 56.7%–75.3%，CJK 上较等分箱基线降低 46.1%–66.3% 且覆盖率 100%；CSS 区间数减少 17.9%–41.7%；20 个站点在模拟器与 Headless Chrome 中实现 1.56x–6.09x 冷缓存加速（CJK 带宽节省 65.4%–84.9%，LGC 44.7%），45/45 分片集完全一致。

Conclusion: 数据驱动的字体分片优于启发式与等分方案，在保证字符全覆盖的前提下兼顾延迟、带宽与 CSS 开销，并已在多脚本、多站点场景验证可复现。

Abstract: CSS3 @font-face rules with unicode-range descriptors partition web fonts into downloadable slices. While Latin fonts need ~20 KB in WOFF2, Pan-European (LGC) and East Asian (CJK) fonts contain 2,297-30,759 codepoints (158 KB-5.9 MB in WOFF2), where heuristic partitioning causes unused-glyph downloads, high HTTP RTT, CSS bloat, or missing-glyph fallbacks. We present MLFont, a machine learning and optimization framework that learns font slicing strategies from corpora via three stages: (1) a Zipfian High-Frequency Tier (most) isolating top-frequency codepoints; (2) a Latent Co-Occurrence Topic Tier using Online Variational Bayes LDA (Online LDA) or a Deep Neural Network Topic Model (DNNTM) with Shannon Entropy Difference Loss and Sinkhorn-Knopp normalization; and (3) a Memetic Range-Compact Genetic Algorithm (GA) with Potts-Viterbi dynamic programming and island bridging that minimizes topic discrepancy and CSS fragmentation.
