Conclusion: 通过随机门控引入受控部分可观测性可有效改善潜动力学表征与长时程预测，是一种即插即用、低成本的MBRL训练增强手段。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) has enabled sample-efficient learning of continuous control policies from high-dimensional observations through learned latent dynamics models. These models are typically trained with observation reconstruction objectives, which provide strong supervision but can bias representations toward visual fidelity leading to an undertrained prior and unreliable long-horizon predictions. We propose a stochastic gating mechanism that induces controlled partial observability during training by sampling a spatial binary mask from a Beta--Bernoulli random field and applying it to the raw observation. The gate probability is resampled at each time step, exposing the encoder to conditions ranging from near-total occlusion to near-full visibility. Integration of our method requires minimal architectural changes from existing dynamics models: the gated observation and the binary mask are channel-wise concatenated and passed to the encoder as a single augmented input, with no modifications to the broader training pipeline. We evaluate the proposed approach on a set of pixel-based continuous control tasks selected from the DeepMind Control Suite. Using model predictive control for evaluation, which relies solely on open-loop model rollouts, we show that stochastic gating improves planning performance and data efficiency across tasks. Further analysis demonstrates that performance is robust to the spatial scale of the mask, and a balanced observability during training outperforms configurations biased toward either sparser or denser observations.

</details>


### [946] [ATEST: Adaptive Resource-Aware Test-Time Scaling for LLM Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25519)
*Mobina Kashaniyan,Ali Jannesari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATEST 提出一种资源感知的测试时扩展（TTS）框架，联合考虑额外采样的期望收益与当前 GPU 能耗成本，在线自适应决定采样预算，在能耗预算内保持甚至提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 TTS 方法采用固定采样预算，忽略了两点：查询难度的差异，以及 GPU 竞争负载变化导致的推理能耗波动（同一次四样本查询能耗最高可增至 4.1 倍）。

Method: 提出 ATEST 框架。ATEST-Online（默认）无需离线标定：增量生成样本，估计多数投票答案的稳定性，监测实时 GPU 状态，并在线学习单步能耗成本以决定停止时机。ATEST-Calibrated 则用离线准确率与成本模型为每个查询选择预算，适用于负载稳定场景。

Result: 在 Phi-3-mini + A100（受控变化负载）上，于四个推理与问答数据集评测，并迁移至 L40S 与 Qwen2.5-3B。A100 上 ATEST-Online 在所有查询上均不超能耗预算，准确率最高或统计持平，且随负载升高减少采样。GSM8K 高负载下准确率 60.0%、无延迟提交，对比 Calibrated 的 44.0% 与 42.4% 延迟。消融显示在线成本学习是负载自适应的关键。含离线画像在内，Online 比 Calibrated 少用 42 倍 GPU 时间、48 倍能耗。

Conclusion: 在线控制以更高的尾部延迟和短任务上更低的吞吐为代价，换取变化负载下的鲁棒性；离线标定在稳定条件下仍具竞争力。

Abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) improves large language model (LLM) reasoning by sampling multiple answers, but fixed sampling budgets ignore both query difficulty and the changing energy cost of inference under GPU contention. We measure up to a 4.1-fold increase in energy for the same four-sample query as GPU load rises. We present ATEST, a resource-aware TTS framework that jointly considers the expected value of additional samples and their current GPU cost. ATEST-Online, its default mode, requires no offline calibration: it incrementally generates samples, estimates the stability of the plurality answer, monitors live GPU conditions, and learns step energy cost online to decide when to stop. ATEST-Calibrated instead selects a per-query budget using offline accuracy and cost models, favoring deployments with stable loads. We evaluate both modes on four reasoning and question-answering datasets using Phi-3-mini on an NVIDIA A100 under controlled varying load, and test transfer to an NVIDIA L40S and Qwen2.5-3B. Across the four A100 datasets, ATEST-Online answers every query without exceeding the energy budget, while achieving the highest or statistically tied accuracy and reducing sampling as load increases. On GSM8K at high load, it achieves 60.0% accuracy with no deferrals, versus 44.0% accuracy and 42.4% deferrals for ATEST-Calibrated. Ablations show that online cost learning drives adaptation to load. Including offline profiling, ATEST-Online uses 42 times less GPU time and 48 times less energy than ATEST-Calibrated for the evaluated workload. Online control trades higher tail latency and lower throughput on short tasks for robustness under varying load; offline calibration remains competitive under stable conditions.

</details>


### [947] [FracTS: Hierarchical and Autoregressive Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25523)
*Jiayu Li,Umair Afzal,Zilong Zhao,Milad Abdollahzadeh,Uzair Javaid,Biplab Sikdar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FracTS：将分形生成建模从2D图像迁移到1D序列，提出分层、由粗到细的自回归模型用于多变量时间序列生成，在五项数据集的边际分布、预测ML效用与相关性保持上优于七个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成时间序列在隐私保护共享、数据增强与压力测试中需求上升；而早期以自回归为主的生成方法存在样本多样性低、误差累积、难以建模长程依赖等问题。

Method: 受图像分形生成建模启发，将范式由2D适配到1D序列，学习多尺度表示：粗尺度刻画全局轨迹结构，细尺度刻画局部动态，同时保持时间序列的自回归性质。利用时间序列的结构化特性进行自动化或指定的时序特征处理，并提取描述实例的全局（静态）特征融入生成过程；设计天然处理多变量依赖、提升长程时序一致性且不依赖定长输入。

Result: 在五个数据集（两个条件、三个无条件）上与七个基线对比，FracTS在边际分布与预测ML效用上持续领先，无条件设置下相关性保持更优；相较最佳基线，预测ML效用平均提升100.0%（无条件）与75.0–81.0%（条件），相对误差基于数据集平均原始值计算。

Conclusion: 分层由粗到细的分形自回归框架可有效缓解自回归生成的低多样性与长程依赖建模问题，并通过时序结构与全局静态特征的引入提升生成质量；代码已开源。

Abstract: Time series are ubiquitous across different domains, and the growing use of synthetic data for privacy-preserving sharing, data augmentation, and stress testing makes time series generation increasingly important. Early generative approaches are predominantly autoregressive, which can suffer from low sample diversity, error accumulation, and difficulty modeling long-range dependencies. In this paper, we introduce FracTS, a hierarchical, coarse-to-fine autoregressive model for multivariate time series generation. Inspired by fractal generative modeling developed for images, FracTS adapts the paradigm from 2D to 1D sequences by learning a multi-scale representation that captures global trajectory structure at coarse scales and local dynamics at fine scales while following the autoregressive nature of time series. In contrast to unstructured images, time series are structured, allowing easy automated or designated temporal feature processing optimized for the model, and global (static) feature extraction describing the instances that generate the corresponding time series in the collection. We incorporate them in the generation process to further improve the generation quality. The design naturally handles multivariate dependencies and improves long-horizon temporal coherence without requiring fixed-length inputs. Experiments on five datasets (two conditional, three unconditional) conducted against seven baselines show that FracTS consistently outperforms baselines across marginal distribution and predictive ML utility, and correlation preservation in the unconditional setting. In particular, the predictive ML utility is averagely improved by 100.0% and 75.0-81.0% for unconditional and conditional time series datasets compared to the best baseline (relative error computed on dataset-averaged raw values). Code is available at: https://github.com/BetterdataLabs/fracts.

</details>


### [948] [Reinforcement learning on the EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment benchmark: diagnosing over-commitment and guiding MILP with learned policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25544)
*Maharani Devira Pramita,Aidan O'Sullivan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 首个在 EPRI AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment 竞赛 51 机 72 小时基准上研究强化学习求解机组组合（UC）的工作：将 RL 与 MILP 的差距主要归因于智能体自身的探索行为，通过模仿 MILP 解并保守微调把 PPO 拉近最优 2.6%，再用微调策略的高置信决策固定变量使 MILP 提速 3.8–8.5 倍（劣化仅 0.10–0.25%），并提出统一报告协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL 被视为机组组合的快速求解器，但独立智能体的成本远高于混合整数线性规划（MILP）；作者希望厘清这一差距的来源（尤其是探索机制），并探索 RL 策略是否能反过来加速精确求解器。

Method: 在 51 机、72 小时 EPRI 基准上系统评测 PPO 与动作分支 DQN（从零训练）、merit-order 规则与 MILP；分析独立采样决策导致"备用机组保险"式的过度开机；通过注入探索噪声、去掉奖励塑形项等消融验证归因；采用模仿 MILP 解 + 保守微调；最后固定微调策略的高置信决策为 MILP 变量，考察加速效果与劣化。

Result: 从零训练的 PPO/DQN 各配置下开机台数约为纯火电 MILP 最优的两倍、成本高 39–64%；merit-order 规则仅差 1.6–7%（计入失负荷惩罚为 10–24%）。模仿+微调使 PPO 距最优 2.6%，综合惩罚成本最优（约 5%）。固定高置信决策使 MILP 提速 3.8–8.5 倍，劣化 0.10–0.25%，最坏情况 1.1%（同等固定变量数的纯模仿策略为 8.9%）。仅调度方法与基准范围即可使报告的最优性比值偏移达 3.6% 与 9%。

Conclusion: RL 与 MILP 的性能差距主要源于智能体探索带来的过度开机，可通过模仿学习+保守微调消除；由此得到的策略更适合作为精确求解器的变量固定/加速组件，而非独立求解器。因评测口径影响显著，需采用统一的报告协议以保证可比性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly proposed as a fast solver for unit commitment (UC), but standalone agents remain far more expensive than mixed-integer linear programming (MILP). In the first study of RL on the 51-generator, 72-hour benchmark of the Electric Power Research Institute (EPRI) AI-ccelerating Unit Commitment competition, we trace this gap to the agents' own exploration, close most of it, and show that the resulting policy can accelerate an exact solver. In every configuration tested, Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) and an action-branching Deep Q-Network (DQN) trained from scratch committed about twice the units of a thermal-only MILP optimum, at 39-64% higher cost, whereas a merit-order rule came within 1.6-7% (10-24% when unserved energy is priced). When each unit's decision is sampled independently, spare units insure against random de-commitments. Consistent with this, injecting exploration noise during fine-tuning enlarged a lean policy's fleet, a reward without shaping terms did not remove the over-commitment, and under their training noise the agents outperformed the rule subjected to comparable noise. Imitating the MILP solutions and fine-tuning conservatively brought PPO within 2.6% of the optimum, and these policies had the lowest penalised cost of any evaluated (about 5%). Fixing the fine-tuned policy's confident decisions made the MILP 3.8-8.5 times faster within 0.10-0.25% of the best solution, with a smaller worst case than an imitation-only policy fixing as many variables (1.1% against 8.9%). Because dispatch method and benchmark scope alone shift the reported optimality ratio by up to 3.6% and 9%, we propose a reporting protocol.

</details>


### [949] [Beyond the record: evaluating probabilistic AI weather forecasts deep in the tail](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25545)
*Bastiaan Van Velthoven,Cas Decancq,Diego G. Miralles,Stijn Luca,Thomas Mortier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 比较四种概率AI气象模型与IFS-ENS在2022年超出历史纪录事件上的预报技巧：AI在高温/低温纪录上几乎全lead领先，高温优势随纪录深度增强，风场优势随深度和时效减弱；同时提示需区分尾部分技巧、实现极值表现与概率校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对确定性AI天气预报在训练域外（极端/破纪录事件）外推失败的报道，检验概率性AI集合是否同样失效，即能否在超出历史纪录的条件下保持预报技巧。

Method: 以1979–2021年ERA5月记录界定历史边界，用"纪录深度"（相对局地历史变率的超越幅度）刻画2022年新纪录；在1.5°分辨率、2–10天lead、陆地区域比较ArchesWeatherGen、U-Cast、WeatherNext2、GenCast-mini与物理IFS-ENS；采用两个proper score——纪录阈值加权CRPS与Brier score，同时计入漏报极值与虚警，并以ERA5及HRES-fc0作检验。

Result: 高温与低温纪录上AI模型在几乎所有lead与深度上优于IFS-ENS；高温优势随深度增强（部分因IFS-ENS高估深纪录），且在HRES-fc0检验下对更深纪录大体保持；风场优势随深度加深与lead延长而削弱。更优的尾部分数可与总体概率偏差（亏缺或盈余）并存，部分改进主要来自非超越样本；随观测子集更极端而增强的低估也可由结果选择效应产生，即便对理想条件均值预报亦然。

Conclusion: 原生概率AI集合在阈值超越局地纪录时仍保持（高温上扩大）相对IFS-ENS的优势，但所有优势随lead缩短；不应将确定性AI的外推失败推广至概率系统；建议采用区分比较性尾部分技巧、已实现极值表现与概率校准的通用检验规范。

Abstract: Can probabilistic artificial intelligence (AI) weather forecasts retain skill beyond their training domain? We compare four state-of-the-art AI models (ArchesWeatherGen, U-Cast, WeatherNext2 and GenCast-mini) with the physics-based IFS-ENS over land in 2022, at 1.5° resolution and lead times of 2--10 days. Monthly ERA5 records from 1979--2021 define common historical boundaries, and we characterize new records set in 2022 by their depth, i.e., the exceedance margin relative to local historical variability. Two proper scores, record-threshold weighted CRPS and Brier score, assess the magnitude and probability of record exceedances across all eligible cases, retaining both missed extremes and false alarms. Verified against ERA5, AI models outperform IFS-ENS for heat and cold records at almost every lead and depth. For heat, the advantage strengthens with depth, partly because IFS-ENS over-forecasts deep records, and largely persists for deeper records under HRES-fc0 verification. For wind, gains erode for deeper records and longer leads. Better tail scores can nevertheless coexist with aggregate probability deficits or surpluses, and some improvements arise chiefly on non-exceedances. Increasing underprediction on progressively more extreme observed subsets can also arise through outcome selection, even for an ideal conditional-mean forecast. These findings establish that native probabilistic AI ensembles retain, and for heat increase, their advantage over IFS-ENS as thresholds move beyond local records, although all advantages narrow with lead time. They caution against generalizing the extrapolation failure reported for deterministic AI forecasts to probabilistic systems, and motivate common verification conventions that separate comparative tail skill, performance on realized extremes, and probabilistic calibration.

</details>


### [950] [FTFM: Factorized Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25558)
*Josif Grabocka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出因子化表格基础模型（FTFM），用每行、每列各一个上下文潜变量来因子化计算，从而在保留单元格级表示的同时降低注意力的重复开销，在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等基准上取得有竞争力的分类性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有表格基础模型（TFM）存在权衡：保留单元格级表示（cell-level representation）的模型因需在行与列方向上反复做注意力计算而代价高昂；更快的模型则将每行压缩为固定嵌入，丢失了细粒度的单元格状态。

Method: 提出 Factorized Tabular Foundation Models（FTFM）：保留单元格表示，但通过每行一个上下文潜变量、每列一个上下文潜变量来因子化计算。单元格之间不再直接相互注意力，而是经由其所属行潜变量与列潜变量的交互来更新，从而减少重复注意力并保留特征特定信息。

Result: 在 TabArena、BeyondArena 等主要表格分类基准上，FTFM 取得了有竞争力的预测性能。

Conclusion: 以行/列潜变量为中介的因子化注意力可在保持单元格级细粒度状态的同时规避重计算，是缓解表格基础模型效率—表达力权衡的可行路径。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) are becoming a powerful alternative to conventional tabular learning, adapting to new datasets in context without task-specific training. Current architectures, however, face a trade-off: models that preserve cell-level representations are expensive because they repeatedly attend across rows and columns, while faster models collapse each row into a fixed embedding and lose this fine-grained state. We introduce Factorized Tabular Foundation Models (FTFM), which preserve cell representations while factorizing their computation through one contextual latent per row and one per column. Cells no longer attend to one another directly; instead, each cell is updated through the interaction of its row and column latents, reducing repeated attention while retaining feature-specific information. FTFM achieves competitive predictive performance in tabular classification on major benchmarks such as TabArena and BeyondArena.

</details>


### [951] [Benchmark for Structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation in Perovskite Photovoltaics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25575)
*Qiwei Han,Chi Zhou,Gaoxiang Yuan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出面向钙钛矿光伏的定量问答基准（755个答案由45,441条实测器件记录计算得出），并证明让LLM通过只读SQL查询结构化器件表可将准确率从文本检索的16-23%提升至约51%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型基准多以定性文本重叠或模型打分评估，缺乏经实验验证的定量真值；而材料实验学科（如钙钛矿光伏）的关键问题本质上是量化、需跨数十至数百篇文献聚合的，因此需要可对账的定量问答基准。

Method: 构建定量QA基准：755个ground-truth答案全部由45,441条实测器件记录直接计算（40,889条2021年前人工整理记录 + 4,552条2022-2026年文献抽取记录）。在25,662篇论文的158,274个段落上，用单张24GB GPU上的开放14B模型比较六种检索架构，并与"只读SQL执行于结构化器件表"的路径对照。

Result: 标准段落检索最高仅16-23%准确率（零样本为1.6-6.5%）；而配备只读SQL执行后，历史文献上达51.5%、前瞻文献上达50.8%，相对混合文本检索高出33.0±1.8个百分点。涉及极值、分布与带筛选记录计数的聚合类查询几乎无法仅靠文本检索解决。

Conclusion: 要使RAG胜任文献尺度的定量科学问答，系统化的表格/结构化数据抽取是运行层面的先决条件，而非可选增强；纯文本检索在聚合型定量查询上存在结构性瓶颈。

Abstract: While retrieval-augmented language models increasingly serve as literature assistants in the physical sciences, existing benchmarks evaluate them primarily on qualitative text overlap or through model-based scoring rather than against verified experimental ground truth. In experimental materials disciplines such as perovskite photovoltaics, however, the most critical inquiries are inherently quantitative and aggregate measurements across dozens or hundreds of papers. Here, we present a quantitative question-answering benchmark where all 755 ground-truth answers are computed directly from 45,441 measured device records (40,889 human-curated records through 2021 and 4,552 records extracted from 2022-2026 literature). Benchmarking six retrieval architectures over 158,274 passages from 25,662 papers using an open 14B model on a single 24 GB GPU, standard passage retrieval tops out at 16-23% accuracy (compared to 1.6-6.5% zero-shot). In contrast, equipping the language model with read-only SQL execution over the structured device table elevates accuracy to 51.5% on historical and 50.8% on prospective literature -- a 33.01.8 percentage-point advantage over hybrid text retrieval. Aggregate queries spanning extrema, distributions, and filtered record counts prove virtually unsolvable via text retrieval alone, demonstrating that systematic table extraction is an operational prerequisite for literature-scale quantitative inquiry.

</details>


### [952] [Finite Interaction Lens: Structured Precision Sharing for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25577)
*Nozomu Fujisawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出有限交互透镜（FIL），一种混合精度方法，在固定名义 BF16 预算下更精确地评估视觉语言模型中干预的交互效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 识别哪些视觉干预在视觉语言模型中相互作用，需要比较其联合效应与单独效应；所得四输出差分（four-output difference）可能小到被舍入误差掩盖。

Method: FIL 在每个选定的线性投影处，将每个候选输入分解为原生状态、两个单干预分量以及一个全维混合残差；以更高精度投影单干预分量，并在联合候选间复用相同的数值贡献，同时保留全部混合残差与非线性轨迹。作者推导了局部抵消恒等式（local cancellation identity）及误差经平滑非线性传播的条件界。

Result: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct 的一个 MLP 中，相对于"相同名义 BF16 乘积预算、更高精度单干预但每个联合候选独立投影"的对照，FIL 在 16 个合成族上将最终交互 MSE 降低 94.4%，在两批四图 COCO 研究中分别降低 99.85% 与 99.35%；每项 COCO 研究中绝对增益主要由一张图像贡献。在所有候选上使用多乘积 BF16 算术可在相近总查询时间下取得更低的总误差；单乘积 BF16 已在所测两项候选选择任务中复现参考选择。

Conclusion: 在开发输入上，FIL 在固定名义精度预算下提升了交互保真度；其实际价值取决于是否存在需要该额外保真度的任务。

Abstract: Identifying which visual interventions interact in a vision-language model requires comparing their joint and separate effects. The resulting four-output difference can be small enough for rounding error to obscure it. We introduce the Finite Interaction Lens (FIL), a mixed-precision method for evaluating finite intervention families. At each selected linear projection, FIL decomposes each candidate's input into a native state, two single-intervention components, and a full-dimensional mixed residual. It projects the single-intervention components at higher precision and reuses the same numerical contributions in the joint candidates, while retaining every mixed residual and nonlinear trajectory. We derive a local cancellation identity and a conditional bound on error propagation through a smooth nonlinearity. In one MLP of Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, FIL reduces final interaction MSE by 94.4% on 16 synthetic families and by 99.85% and 99.35% in two separate four-image COCO studies, relative to a control that has the same nominal BF16-product budget and higher-precision single interventions but projects each joint candidate independently. One image accounts for most of the absolute gain in each COCO study. Higher-accuracy multi-product BF16 arithmetic on all candidates gives lower aggregate error at similar total query times. Single-product BF16 already recovers the reference choices in both candidate-selection tasks we tested. On these development inputs, FIL improves interaction fidelity at a fixed nominal precision budget. Its practical value depends on a task that needs the extra fidelity.

</details>


### [953] [CVTA: Cross-Variable Temporal Attention for Multivariate Irregular Time Series Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25584)
*Ankitkumar Joshi,Milos Hauskrecht*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CVTA：面向不规则采样多变量时间序列的短期连续时间预测框架，基于变量条件嵌入与跨变量时序注意力，并可作辅助模块增强现有模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 不规则采样多变量时间序列存在观测异步、变量间异质性等问题，给预测带来显著挑战，现有方法难以同时兼顾短时精度、在线推理效率与可解释性。

Method: CVTA学习从紧凑且可解释的状态（汇总各变量近期时序动态）到预测函数的映射；使用Variable-Conditioned Embeddings将异构变量投影至变量专属隐空间；在该状态上施加时序注意力以捕获跨变量依赖；并通过动态元决策模型将CVTA作为辅助模块集成进现有先进预测模型。

Result: 在多个真实基准上取得较强短期预测精度，支持高效在线推理，作为辅助模块可提升现有预测模型性能，且学到的注意力模式与领域知识吻合良好。

Conclusion: CVTA为不规则采样多变量时序提供了一种兼顾精度、效率与可解释性的连续时间短时预测方案，并具备良好的可组合性与领域一致性。

Abstract: Irregularly sampled multivariate time series arise in many real-world domains such as healthcare, climate science, and large-scale monitoring systems. Characterized by asynchronous observations and heterogeneity across variables, such time series pose significant challenges for forecasting. In this work, we introduce Cross-Variable Temporal Attention (CVTA), a short-term, continuous-time forecasting framework that learns prediction functions from its compact, interpretable state summarizing recent temporal dynamics across variables. CVTA uses Variable-Conditioned Embeddings to project heterogeneous variables into variable-specific latent spaces, and applies temporal attention to capture cross-variable dependencies from this state. Furthermore, we demonstrate that CVTA can be integrated as an auxiliary module into existing state-of-the-art prediction models through a dynamic meta-decision model. Extensive experiments on multiple real-world benchmarks show that CVTA achieves strong short-term predictive accuracy, supports efficient online inference, improves existing prediction models when used as an auxiliary module, and learns attention patterns that align well with domain knowledge.

</details>


### [954] [Divergence based Ranked Preference Alignment for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25588)
*Rajdeep Haldar,Yue Xing,Qifan Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 f-RPO，将基于散度的对齐目标扩展到排序偏好反馈，恢复成对偏好为特例，并证明收敛时保持偏好序一致性；TV 与 reverse-KL 变体在 Qwen、Llama、Gemma（0.5B–8B）上优于排序对齐基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 对齐多依赖成对偏好反馈，而排序反馈在单次标注中可捕捉多条回答的更全面信息，但排序偏好对齐实践探索不足；同时已有工作将对齐目标解释为偏好分布间的散度估计，理论清晰且效果强，但尚未与排序反馈结合。

Method: 将基于散度的对齐目标推广到排序偏好，提出 f-RPO：以 f-散度为目标函数，对排序反馈进行优化，并设计上使成对偏好对齐成为其特例。

Result: 理论分析建立 rank-order consistency，证明 f-RPO 在收敛时保持潜在偏好序；实验表明 total-variation 与 reverse-KL 变体在 Qwen、Llama、Gemma（0.5B–8B）上的排序质量与生成质量均稳定优于排序对齐基线。

Conclusion: f-RPO 统一了散度式对齐与排序偏好优化两个视角，提供可解释的理论基础并在多模型规模上取得一致的实证优势。

Abstract: Alignment of large language models typically relies on pairwise preference feedback, though ranked feedback can capture more comprehensive information across multiple responses within a single annotation. However, ranked-preference alignment is underexplored in practice compared to simpler pairwise approaches, potentially resulting in suboptimal behavior. Concurrently, recent research has conceptualized large language model alignment objectives as divergence estimators between aligned (preferred) and unaligned (less-preferred) response distributions, resulting in a family of objectives with an interpretable theoretical foundation and strong empirical performance. This work unifies these perspectives by introducing $f$-RPO, a $f$-divergence objective for ranked preference optimization that extends divergence-based alignment to ranked feedback and recovers pairwise preference alignment as a special case. Our theoretical analysis establishes rank-order consistency, showing that $f$-RPO preserves the underlying preference ordering at convergence. Empirical results indicate that total-variation and reverse-KL variants of the proposed objective consistently outperform ranked-alignment baselines in both ranking and generation quality across Qwen, Llama, & Gemma models ranging from 0.5B to 8B parameters.

</details>


### [955] [Distributionally-Robust Policy Learning with Observational Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25591)
*Debmalya Mandal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究基于观测数据的分布鲁棒策略学习：在f-散度球内最大化最坏情况策略价值，提出交叉拟合双鲁棒估计+支持KL/χ²/CVaR模糊集的DRO求解器，并证明标准O(n^{-1/2})速率、双鲁棒性质及在margin条件下经样本分裂偏差校正后的快速速率O(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准策略学习只优化经验性能，当部署分布与训练分布不一致时会失效，因此需要分布鲁棒策略学习（DRO policy learning）。已有工作缺乏对DRO策略学习收敛速率（尤其快速速率）的精细理论分析，也未引入margin条件。

Method: 1) 以条件处理效应的交叉拟合（cross-fitting）双鲁棒得分构造估计量；2) 配套DRO求解器处理KL、χ²、CVaR三类模糊集；3) 由拉格朗日对偶导出样本分裂偏差校正算法；4) 理论分析：证明DRO regret的标准速率与双鲁棒性质，并在处理效应的Tsybakov型margin条件下导出快速速率。

Result: (i) 估计策略的DRO regret达标准Õ(n^{-1/2})速率，且具有双鲁棒性——结果模型或倾向模型任一被一致估计（即便为非参数慢速率）时速率仍成立；(ii) 样本分裂偏差校正估计量在margin参数α∈[0,∞)下达到Õ(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})，在Õ(1/√n)与Õ(1/n)间插值；(iii) 合成与半合成（校准至welfare-to-work项目）实验中，训练与测试分布不一致时分布鲁棒性相较经验福利最大化（EWM）有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将margin条件引入分布鲁棒策略学习分析，并首次在该设定下获得快速速率，同时给出双鲁棒性与可实现的DRO优化算法，实证验证了分布偏移下的收益。

Abstract: Policy learning from observational data is fundamental to applications ranging from personalized medicine to welfare-program targeting, but standard approaches optimize empirical performance and may fail when the deployment distribution differs from the training distribution. We study \emph{distributionally-robust policy learning}: given observational data, we seek a policy $π\in Π$ that maximizes the worst-case policy value over an $f$-divergence ball of radius $ρ$ around the data-generating distribution. We propose an estimator built on cross-fitted doubly-robust scores for the conditional treatment effect, paired with a DRO solver that handles \texttt{KL}, $χ^2$, and \texttt{CVaR} ambiguity sets. We establish two convergence guarantees. First, the estimated policy attains the standard $\widetilde{O}(n^{-1/2})$ rate on its DRO regret, and inherits the doubly-robust property -- the rate continues to hold whenever either the outcome model or the propensity model is consistently estimated, even at slow nonparametric rates. We then propose a sample-splitting bias-correction algorithm derived from the Lagrangian dual, and show that under a Tsybakov-style margin condition on the treatment-effect, the estimator attains a fast rate of $\widetilde{O}(n^{-(1+α)/(2+α)})$ , interpolating between $\widetilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/n)$ as the margin parameter $α$ ranges over $[0,\infty)$. To our knowledge, this is the first work to incorporate a margin condition into the analysis of distributionally-robust policy learning, and the first to obtain fast rates in this setting. Empirically, on synthetic and semi-synthetic experiments calibrated to a welfare-to-work program, distributional robustness yields meaningful improvements over empirical welfare maximization when training and test distributions differ.

</details>


### [956] [Text Dominance in Paralinguistic Conflict: Tracing Suppression Through Audio LLM Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25599)
*Ankur Banerjee,Vishnu Guntakala,Danity Pike,Advay Roongta,Kevin Yang,Ruizhe Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在六种音频LLM的文本-音频冲突条件下，文本主导率达0.78（排除讽刺为0.86）。探针表明说话人身份在语言模型输入端仍可线性解码，故失败并非感知层面；back-patching无效果（但其自身源任务复现也失败，n=300，故该零结果无信息量）；注意力敲除通过阻断中间token传导部分恢复音频依据输出，说明冲突信息经中间"中继"传播而非单一可切断的边。该效应仅在自由生成中出现，闭集选择题中不可见。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署于危机热线、客服等场景的音频LLM若仅依赖语音转写文本，价值有限，需真正利用韵律线索（情绪、说话人身份、讽刺）。作者旨在检验模型是否优先处理文本内容而忽视副语言线索，并追溯其机制。

Method: 在LISTEN式冲突条件下测试六种音频LLM的文本主导率；在最文本主导的筛选模型上进行线性探针分析说话人身份的可解码性；复现back-patching（含其源任务对照，n=300）；采用注意力敲除（attention knockout）区分阻断中间token传播路径与阻断答案位置与冲突主张的直接连接。

Result: 平均文本主导率0.78（排除讽刺0.86）；说话人身份在LM输入处仍以天花板水平线性可解码；back-patching无可测效应，且其源任务复现亦失败（n=300），故该零结果不具信息价值；阻断中间token传导可部分恢复音频依据输出，而阻断答案位置与冲突主张的直接连接无效；效应仅见于自由生成，闭集多项选择中不显现。

Conclusion: 音频LLM对副语言线索的失败源于下游利用而非感知；冲突主张的影响经中间中继传播，不存在单一可切断的边；依赖闭集选择题的基准可能系统性盲于此类干预。代码与数据已公开。

Abstract: Audio LLMs deployed in settings such as crisis hotlines and customer support are only useful beyond speech-to-text pipelines if they use acoustic cues rather than the transcript alone. We test whether they prioritise transcript content over paralinguistic cues (emotion, speaker identity, sarcasm) and trace the mechanism when they do. Across six audio LLMs under LISTEN-style conflict conditions, the mean text-dominance rate on mismatched text+audio items is 0.78 (0.86 excluding sarcasm). In the most text-dominant screened model, probing shows speaker identity remains linearly decodable at ceiling at the language model's input, so the failure is not perceptual. Back-patching, reported to repair lexical text dominance, has no measurable effect here; but it also fails on its own source task in our replication (n=300), so we treat its null as uninformative rather than as evidence of non-transfer. Attention knockout partially restores audio-grounded output by blocking the claim from propagating through intermediate tokens during open-ended generation, whereas blocking the answer position's direct connection to the conflicting claim has no effect. The claim's influence therefore travels through an intermediate relay rather than a single severable edge. The effect appears only in free-form generation and not in closed-set multiple choice, suggesting that benchmarks relying on that format may be systematically blind to interventions of this kind. Code and data are publicly available at https://github.com/AdvayRoongta/audio-llm-mech-interp.

</details>


### [957] [Adversarial Post-Training of Foundation Models for High-Frequency Trading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25604)
*Alexandre Bismuth,Kang Li,Aramis Marti-Shahandeh,Valentin Mohl,Jakob Foerster,Anisoara Calinescu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出对LOB基础模型进行Wasserstein GAN式的对抗式后训练：由在真实撮合引擎rollout上在线训练的critic，经进化策略在KL信赖域内更新rank-4 LoRA扰动，显著提升市场仿真真实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归LOB基础模型的交叉熵预训练既不能惩罚自由运行rollout中的误差累积，也不直接优化所期望的市场统计特性。

Method: 用Wasserstein GAN目标做后训练：critic在真实、不可微撮合引擎产生的rollout上在线训练；用进化策略在KL信赖域下对预训练生成器的rank-4 LoRA扰动进行更新；采用内存高效的EGGROLL变体提升效率。

Result: 在留出面板上，LOB-Bench真实度提升17.6%（WS-21）与17.0%（Mean-L1）；选择匹配的随机扰动与算力匹配的继续预训练对照均无提升。500条消息rollout的逐位置散度误差累积从3.1倍降至2.3倍。成本低于50M训练token、每seed 12 GPU小时，比48B token预训练预算低三个数量级。

Conclusion: 对抗式后训练是预训练不可替代的必要阶段；对critic输入、优化器、种群-rollout权衡及reward hacking的消融给出了实用设计准则。

Abstract: While autoregressive foundation models trained on limit order book (LOB) data show state-of-the-art performance for market simulation, pre-training with cross-entropy neither penalizes the compounding of sampling errors over free-running rollouts nor targets desired market properties. We introduce a post-training method for LOB foundation models using a Wasserstein generative adversarial network (GAN) objective. A critic, trained online on rollouts through the true, non-differentiable matching engine, guides updates from evolution strategies over rank-4 LoRA perturbations of the pre-trained generator, under a KL trust region. For efficiency, we use EGGROLL (Evolution Guided GeneRal Optimisation via Low-rank Learning), a memory-efficient variant of evolution strategies. On a held-out panel, adversarial post-training improves LOB-Bench realism by 17.6% (WS-21) and 17.0% (Mean-$L_1$), while selection-matched random-perturbation and compute-matched continued-pre-training controls yield no improvement. Post-training is thus a necessary stage that more pre-training does not replace. Per-position divergence measurements show that it slows error accumulation over 500-message rollouts from $3.1\times$ to $2.3\times$. Adversarial post-training is also inexpensive, requiring under 50M training tokens and 12 GPU-hours per seed, three orders of magnitude below the 48B-token pre-training budget. Ablations over critic inputs, optimizers, and the population-rollout trade-off, together with an analysis of reward hacking, yield practical design guidelines for adversarial post-training.

</details>


### [958] [PRISM: Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling to Enhance Solubility OOD Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25605)
*Xinyi Chen,Jiahuan Pang,Titus Chima,Paul Weng,Wendong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PRISM：将专家化学先验转化为关系型"教师"的无标签预训练框架，通过KL散度对齐距离邻域分布训练四个编码器，实现溶解度预测的分布外泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 溶解度预测需对未见溶质、溶剂及混合溶剂做OOD泛化，但监督方法受数据稀缺制约，现有自监督方法又不能显式学习化学有意义的关系信息。

Method: 提出PRISM无标签预训练框架，将专家定义的化学先验（疏水、静电、极化率、子结构效应）转化为关系型教师；训练四个编码器保留先验中的群体级关系信息，预训练中用KL散度匹配基于距离的邻域分布。

Result: 在scaffold、溶质、溶剂三类OOD设定下匹配或超越监督与自监督基线；混合溶剂OOD下冻结四个编码器并训练轻量融合-组成头，优于强基线且显著降低运行间波动；消融与对照实验确认增益源于PRISM注入的化学关系结构。

Conclusion: 将关系型先验转为自监督信号可有效缓解数据稀缺并提升OOD泛化，该策略可推广至其他具备化学或生物关系先验的领域。

Abstract: Solubility depends on intermolecular interactions between solutes and solvents, and is central to drug discovery, chemical and materials process engineering. Its prediction requires out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization to unseen solutes, solvents, and solvent mixtures, where supervised methods suffer from data scarcity, and existing self-supervised methods do not explicitly learn chemically meaningful relations. Learning chemically meaningful relational information without labels can alleviate data scarcity and improve OOD generalization, but remains challenging. We introduce Prior Relational Information for Self-supervised Modeling (PRISM) and apply it to solubility OOD generalization. PRISM is a label-free pretraining framework that converts expert-defined chemical priors into relational teachers. For solubility prediction, it trains four encoders to preserve the population-level relational information from priors capturing hydrophobic, electrostatic, polarizability, and substructural effects, using Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence to match distance-based neighborhood distributions during pretraining. Across scaffold, solute, and solvent OOD settings, PRISM matches or surpasses supervised and self-supervised baselines. Under mixed-solvent OOD, freezing the four PRISM encoders and training a lightweight fusion-and-composition head outperforms strong baselines and substantially reduces run-to-run variation. Ablations and control studies confirm that gains stem from chemically meaningful relational structures baked into the encoders by PRISM. We expect this strategy of turning relational priors into self-supervision signals to extend beyond solubility prediction to domains where chemically or biologically meaningful relational priors are available.

</details>


### [959] [Safety Offset Learning: When Benign Fine-Tuning Misaligns LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25611)
*Jesson Wang,Zhanhao Hu,Minghao Lin,Yuchen Wu,Aylin Caliskan,Mengyuan Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出微调安全风险的核心因素是监督所诱导的"行为转变"（从拒绝到服从），而非数据本身是否有害；良性数据只要制造足够大且不可通过表层捷径消解的"拒绝—答案"差异，就能泛化到有害请求上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有观点以训练数据的"有害性"刻画微调安全风险，认为有害数据微调危险、良性数据微调保持对齐。作者认为这忽略了更根本的因素：监督引发的行为边界迁移。有害微调与"降低安全的良性微调"本质上是同一"拒绝→服从"转变在不同数据分布上的学习。

Method: 构造良性样本：选取对齐模型初始倾向拒绝的良性输入，配以其原始无害回答，从而在"模型初始拒绝"与"被监督答案"之间制造差异（discrepancy）。在该设置下系统地操纵两个变量：差异幅度大小，以及该差异能否被表层捷径（surface-level shortcut）局部化消解。再据此构建 SAFEOFF 数据集——将良性指令改写以提高对齐模型的拒绝概率，并配对原始答案。

Result: 仅当差异足够大且无法通过表层捷径解决时，良性样本微调才会提升有害服从；在差异匹配的情况下，仅改变其是否"可局部化/被捷径消解"即可使有害服从率相差一个数量级；存在捷径时增大差异无效，差异很小时移除捷径也无效。在三个对齐 LLM 与三个安全基准上，SAFEOFF 在不含任何显式有害监督的情况下显著削弱安全对齐。

Conclusion: 微调后的安全性不仅取决于模型"看到什么数据"，还取决于监督移动了哪一条行为边界；良性数据同样可构成实质性安全风险，"拒绝→服从"转变可跨分布泛化至有害请求。

Abstract: Safety risks from fine-tuning are commonly characterized by the harmfulness of the training data:harmful fine-tuning is considered dangerous, while benign fine-tuning is often assumed to preservealignment. We argue that this view misses a more fundamental factor-the behavioral transition inducedby supervision. Harmful fine-tuning and safety-degrading benign fine-tuning can both be understoodas learning the same refusal-to-compliance transition, but on different data distributions. We studywhether such a transition learned on benign inputs can generalize to harmful requests. We constructbenign examples that an aligned model initially tends to refuse and pair them with their originalharmless responses, creating a discrepancy between the model's initial refusal and the supervisedanswer. Fine-tuning on these examples increases harmful compliance, but only when two conditionshold together: the discrepancy is large enough, and it cannot be resolved through a narrow surface-levelshortcut. With the induced discrepancy matched, varying only whether it is localized changes harmfulcompliance by an order of magnitude; raising the discrepancy does not help while a shortcut remainsavailable, and removing the shortcut does not help while the discrepancy is small. Building on thisobservation, we introduce SAFEOFF, a dataset of benign instructions rewritten to raise the alignedmodel's refusal likelihood and paired with their original answers. Across three aligned LLMs and threesafety benchmarks, SAFEOFF substantially weakens safety alignment despite containing no explicitharmful supervision, suggesting that fine-tuning safety depends not only on what data a model sees, butalso on which behavioral boundary the supervision moves.

</details>


### [960] [Curriculum Learning Teaches LLMs Long-Horizon Implicit Reasoning, Up To A Limit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25612)
*Jimson Huang,Maxwell Nickell,Ruowang Zhang,Abulhair Saparov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过课程学习（逐步增大词表规模与前瞻深度）微调，可将LLM隐式推理的深度显著外推，但进步遵循饱和指数规律，存在模型固有的最大前瞻上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM通过CoT外化推理步骤，但长程任务上仍出现性能断崖；隐式推理（单次前向内的"预搜索"）能力弱会导致错误路径并需回溯，而现有研究表明LLM隐式推理深度很浅且规模扩展无改善。作者希望探究课程学习能否扩展该深度。

Method: 在词表规模与前瞻步数（模型需预搜索的步数）逐步递增的合成样本上微调LLM，并在等计算量条件下与无课程训练对比；分析微调过程中的饱和曲线、模型规模效应、预训练vs从零训练、课程步长影响，并迁移到自然语言推理基准测试。

Result: 等计算量下，课程训练模型可达无课程训练失败的前瞻深度：Qwen3-0.6B在前瞻256问题上达98%准确率，无课程仅45%。进步随微调呈饱和指数，暗示存在可学习的内在前瞻上限；更大模型拟合上限更高，微调预训练模型远超从零训练，课程步长过大会停滞进展；合成数据获得的能力可迁移至自然语言，在11个基准上优于无课程模型。

Conclusion: 课程学习可有效扩展LLM隐式推理深度并迁移到真实推理任务，但受饱和上限约束，该上限随模型规模提升，说明隐式推理深度是可训练但可饱和的能力维度。

Abstract: LLMs "reason" by externalizing intermediate steps as tokens through chain-of-thought (CoT), yet even frontier reasoning models hit abrupt performance cliffs on long-horizon tasks. Implicit reasoning (reasoning within a single forward pass) is useful during CoT generation, as the model can "search ahead" to decide the correct next move without explicit search. Models with weak implicit reasoning are more likely to commit to wrong paths and must attempt to recover via backtracking, while models with strong implicit reasoning identify the correct proof strategy directly, shortening the CoT. However, prior work shows LLMs struggle to reason implicitly beyond shallow depths, with no relief from scale. We investigate whether curriculum learning can extend this depth by fine-tuning on examples with progressively increasing vocabulary size and lookahead (the number of steps a model must search ahead to identify the correct next move). At matched compute, curriculum-trained models achieve lookaheads where no-curriculum training fails. Qwen3-0.6B reaches 98% accuracy on problems with lookahead up to 256 with curriculum, compared to 45% without. However, progress slows as fine-tuning continues, following a saturating exponential that suggests a maximum intrinsic lookahead to which models can learn to reason implicitly. Larger models reach higher fitted ceilings, fine-tuning pretrained models far outpaces training from scratch, and curriculum step sizes that are too large stall progression. Finally, the capability acquired on synthetic data transfers to natural language reasoning, with curriculum-trained models outperforming models trained without curriculum at matched compute on 11 natural language reasoning benchmarks.

</details>


### [961] [Weighted State Souping for Efficient Long-Context Retrieval](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25621)
*William L. Tong,Aryo Lotfi,Emmanuel Abbe,Josh Susskind,Cengiz Pehlevan,Eran Malach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出加权状态汤（weighted state souping），为缓存的状态编码学习查询相关的组合权重，从而显著提升SSM在长且拥挤上下文下的建模与检索性能，并给出稀疏变体实现近常数编码成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 状态空间模型（SSM）具备快速推理与固定状态规模的优势，且已有"状态汤"（state souping）方法可将独立编码的文本块（文档、工具定义、记忆记录等）状态缓存并重组以廉价构建上下文。然而状态汤与原始SSM在长且拥挤的上下文上都会退化，限制了其在长时程场景中的可用性。

Method: 提出weighted state souping：为缓存状态学习查询相关的（query-dependent）组合权重，实现选择性的状态检索与组合；进一步设计高效的稀疏变体，使编码成本随上下文长度近似恒定。

Result: 在单跳与多跳文档问答、大海捞针检索（needle-in-a-haystack）、变量追踪和工具使用等任务上，长上下文性能大幅提升；稀疏变体在保持（有时甚至提升）性能的同时实现近常数编码开销。

Conclusion: 论文给出简洁的理论论证以说明souping有效的机制及其可能失效的条件，并定性讨论加权souping的优势；整体上，加权状态汤将可复用的上下文表示与选择性检索相结合，为面向大量文档、工具及其它结构化上下文（日益主导现代智能体工作负载）的语言建模提供高效方案。

Abstract: State space models (SSMs) combine fast inference and fixed state size with competitive language-modeling performance. Recently, state souping has been proposed as a procedure whereby an SSM independently encodes chunks of tokens like documents, tool definitions, or memory records. The resulting state encodings may be cached and recombined to cheaply construct a context for downstream queries. However, both state souping and vanilla SSMs deteriorate on long, crowded contexts, limiting their utility for long-horizon domains. To address this issue, we propose weighted state souping, a simple method that learns query-dependent weights for composing cached states. The resulting models improve long-context performance substantially across both single- and multi-hop document question answering, needle-in-a-haystack retrieval, variable tracking, and tool use. Our method can be further adapted into an efficient sparse variant, yielding near-constant encoding cost with respect to context length while preserving (and sometimes improving) performance. We also present simple theoretical arguments that illustrate why souping works and when it may fail, and discuss informally the advantages of weighted souping. Weighted state souping thus combines reusable context representations with selective retrieval, offering an efficient approach to language modeling over large collections of documents, tools, and other forms of structured context that increasingly dominate modern agentic workloads.

</details>


### [962] [Zephyrus-R1: Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Weather Reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25625)
*Fengfei Yu,Marshall Fisher,Isadora White,Sumanth Varambally,Yasaman Jafari,Shivam Yadav,Samuel M. Bartlett,Shawn Roj,Benjamin J. Moore,Michael D. Warner,Luyu Han,Zhirui Xia,Duncan Watson-Parris,Taylor Berg-Kirkpatrick,Yian Ma,Rose Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Zephyrus-R1：面向自然语言天气预报报告的智能体强化学习框架，通过气象学评分标准+双向主张蕴含的奖励设计、课程学习，以及气象专家标注对齐分析，显著提升小模型预报报告质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 强化学习在科学应用中很关键，但当输出无法用确定性地与标准答案比对时（如自然语言天气预报报告），RL训练十分困难。此类报告需将大气数据转化为对天气演变、灾害与不确定性的评估，存在大量合法输出，限制了确定性验证。

Method: 1) 奖励设计：融合气象学评分标准（rubric）与双向主张蕴含（bidirectional claim entailment），均以美国国家气象局参考报告为基准评判；2) 智能体式RL：在模拟工具调用环境中优化该奖励，使视觉-语言智能体先跨区域、跨预报时效收集并分析预报证据，再生成报告；3) 人工对齐分析：由三名气象学家标注，审计LLM评判器生成的主张标签；4) 课程学习：小模型先在可验证的天气分析问题上通过RL掌握工具使用与科学推理，再优化开放式报告奖励。

Result: 在Qwen3.5-4B上，六项评判指标平均分较基座模型提升26%，可比肩前沿开放权重模型；在Qwen3.8-27B上，平均分较基座提升13%，较Kimi-K3高6.7%，较GPT-5.6-Luna高2.7%。

Conclusion: Zephyrus-R1为难以确定性验证的科学文本生成任务提供了可实践的RL流水线范式，验证了奖励设计、课程学习与专家对齐审计对开放式科学报告生成的有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key method for training AI models in scientific applications, but RL remains difficult when outputs cannot easily be verified against a known ground-truth answer. Natural-language weather forecast reports are one such domain: they translate atmospheric data into assessments of weather evolution, hazards, and uncertainty for both the general public and key decision-makers. Unlike numerical weather-analysis questions, they admit many valid outputs, which limits deterministic verification. To address this, we develop Zephyrus-R1, a practical framework for RL on scientific weather forecast reporting. We focus on three key components of the agentic RL pipeline: reward design, curriculum learning, and an analysis of human-expert alignment. To encourage both report legibility and factual accuracy, we design a reward function that combines a meteorological rubric with bidirectional claim entailment, both evaluated against National Weather Service reference reports. Our framework optimizes this reward in a simulated tool-calling environment, enabling vision-language agents to gather and analyze forecast evidence across regions and lead times before producing a report. We use annotations from three meteorologists to audit the claim labels produced by our LLM judges. Finally, a curriculum helps small models first develop tool use and scientific reasoning through RL on verifiable weather-analysis questions, then optimize the open-ended report reward. After training Qwen3.5-4B with Zephyrus-R1, we improve the mean across six judge-metric scores by 26% over the base model and achieve results competitive with frontier open-weight models. For Qwen3.8-27B, we improve the same mean by 13% over the base model, by 6.7% over Kimi-K3, and by 2.7% over GPT-5.6-Luna.

</details>


### [963] [Conditional Average Treatment Effect Distillation for Hypothetical State-Intervention Targeting Under Budget Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25627)
*Vasundhara Acharya,Bülent Yener*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究在无历史决策记录的观察数据、预算约束（容量上限为不良状态观测量的70%）下，将灵活因果效应模型"蒸馏"为可解释的个体化干预规则；在PIMA肥胖/血糖与NHANES吸烟史实验中，蒸馏学生模型与教师模型效用差≤0.011、分配Jaccard相似度0.738–0.937；K-means与因果树策略亦具竞争力，预设配对比较经Holm校正后不显著。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化公共卫生靶向需兼顾异质性干预收益与资源约束下的可解释性：灵活因果效应模型难以落地操作，而粗粒度亚组政策又会损失个体化效应信息，因而需要一个能衔接二者的折中方案。

Method: 预设定因果结构信息的前处理协变量；以Causal Forest与Bayesian Causal Forest为教师估计CATE，用决策树与随机森林作为学生模型进行因果蒸馏；将个体化策略与K-means无监督亚组策略、以及叶节点数与聚类数匹配的监督因果树策略进行对比；在留出数据上用双重稳健估计、自助法不确定性与面向决策的师生保真度指标评估策略。

Result: 三个应用（PIMA肥胖、PIMA血糖、NHANES吸烟史）中，蒸馏学生与教师绝对效用差均在0.011以内，分配Jaccard相似度0.738–0.937；K-means与因果树策略亦具竞争力，点估计最优策略随应用而异；Holm校正后预设配对比较均不显著；部分师生配对在预算边界附近的分配一致性弱于全局保真度。

Conclusion: 结果支持用因果蒸馏将灵活效应模型转化为更简单的预算约束靶向规则；但观察性估计依赖因果识别假设，需纵向或前瞻性验证。

Abstract: Personalized public-health targeting must capture heterogeneous intervention benefits while remaining interpretable under resource constraints. Flexible causal-effect models can be hard to operationalize, while coarse subgroup policies may lose individualized effect information. We study budget-constrained hypothetical state interventions in observational data without a logged historical decision policy. For obesity, elevated glucose, and lifetime smoking-history states, causal-structure-informed pretreatment covariates are prespecified, with capacity capped at 70% of those observed in the adverse state. We evaluate causal distillation where Causal Forest and Bayesian Causal Forest teachers estimate conditional average treatment effects (CATEs), which decision tree and random forest students approximate. We compare individualized policies with unsupervised K-means subgroup policies and supervised causal-tree policies with leaf counts matched to K-means cluster counts. Observational policies are assessed on held-out data using a doubly robust estimator, bootstrap uncertainty, and decision-focused teacher-student fidelity measures. Across PIMA obesity and glucose and NHANES smoking-history experiments, each distilled student was within 0.011 absolute utility of its teacher, with allocation Jaccard similarities of 0.738-0.937. K-means and causal-tree policies were also competitive, with the highest point-estimate policy varying by application. Prespecified paired comparisons were nonsignificant after Holm adjustment, while near-budget-boundary agreement was less stable than global fidelity for some teacher-student pairs. Findings support causal distillation for translating flexible effect models into simpler budgeted targeting rules, although observational estimates depend on causal-identification assumptions and require longitudinal or prospective validation.

</details>


### [964] [OPDArena: Understanding Learning and Forgetting in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25651)
*Yuanze Xu,Tianzhu Ye,Hui Sun,Wenhui Wang,Li Dong,Furu Wei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 OPDArena 框架，系统比较 SFT、RLVR 与 OPD 三种后训练方法在五个预训练模型上的学习与遗忘表现，发现教师来源显著影响能力保持，且分布偏移（尤其 OOD）与遗忘更一致地正相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: On-policy 蒸馏（OPD）已广泛用于语言模型后训练，但教师监督如何塑造学生学习与遗忘的机制尚不清楚，缺乏跨方法与跨教师来源的系统性对比。

Method: 构建 OPDArena 统一对比框架，在 5 个预训练模型与多类教师来源下比较 SFT、RLVR 与 OPD；联合评估目标数学任务学习、通用能力保持以及预测分布变化（区分域内与域外），并通过控制变量的教师对比分析教师相对于学生预训练模型所提供的增量信息。

Result: 教师选择强烈影响能力保持：RLVR 训练教师的学生在提升目标任务的同时保留原有能力，而 SFT 训练教师的学生能力损失更大；跨方法来看，OOD 分布变化与遗忘的正相关比域内变化更一致。受控实验表明，教师经后训练获得的任务特定偏好使学生更新更集中于域内。

Conclusion: 教师来源是决定 OPD 学习-遗忘权衡的关键因素；OOD 分布偏移可作为遗忘的更可靠指示，其机理在于教师后训练习得的任务特定偏好使更新过度集中于域内。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) is increasingly used for language model post-training, yet how teacher supervision shapes learning and forgetting remains unclear. We present OPDArena, a framework comparing supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), and OPD across five pretrained models and diverse teacher sources. It jointly evaluates mathematical learning, general capability retention, and predictive distribution changes. Teacher choice strongly shapes retention: students of RLVR-trained teachers improve on the target task while retaining prior capabilities, whereas students of SFT-trained teachers incur greater capability loss. Across post-training methods, out-of-domain (OOD) distribution change shows a more consistent positive association with forgetting than in-domain change. To understand how teacher choice affects these changes, we examine the additional information teachers provide relative to the student's pretrained model. Controlled teacher comparisons show that the task-specific preferences teachers acquire through post-training make student updates more concentrated in-domain.

</details>


### [965] [A "feature ODE" describing the learning behavior of shallow MLPs on simple functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25652)
*Joseph Turnbull,Berkan Ottlik,Jamie Simon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究两层MLP在各向异性高斯数据上的梯度流训练动力学，提出一个"特征ODE"来刻画浅层网络的学�习动态，并发现训练低阶Hermite多项式与阶梯函数目标时，实际损失轨迹与该ODE大致吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两层MLP梯度流下的完整动力学求解在数学上极为困难，即便在最简单的设定下也缺乏解析刻画，因此作者寻求一种化简途径来近似描述学习动态。

Method: 针对各向异性高斯数据，构造一个直观上可描述浅层MLP学习动力学的"特征ODE"，并将其预测的损失轨迹与真实训练过程（目标为低阶Hermite多项式和阶梯函数）进行对比。

Result: 实验表明MLP训练过程的损失轨迹大致遵循该特征ODE的预测，这一吻合令人意外，因为该ODE的化简程度很大，且并非来自严格的逐级近似链条。

Conclusion: 作者对这一意外的吻合现象进行讨论，推测其可能原因及潜在用途。

Abstract: We study the gradient flow training dynamics of two-layer multi-layer perceptrons (MLPs) on anisotropic Gaussian data. Even in this simple setting, solving the dynamics in full is notoriously difficult, so we try something different. We propose a "feature ODE" that might be intuitively expected to describe the learning dynamics of a shallow MLP. We find that MLPs trained to learn simple target functions (low-order Hermite polynomials and staircase functions) actually roughly follow the loss trajectories from this feature ODE. This agreement is a surprise because of the size of the simplification and the fact that it does not come from a rigorous chain of approximations. We discuss this surprise and speculate on its reasons and uses.

</details>


### [966] [Can Metadata Fix the Gauge? Calibration Turns Sparse Multi-Source Learning from Sparse PCA into Sparse Mean Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25663)
*Yirong Xiang,Yibo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在源特定符号规范（sign gauge）的稀疏高斯多源模型中，仅凭"源标签"无法恢复一阶信号，而任务无关的相对校准元数据可通过同步对齐源，将问题从稀疏PCA转化为稀疏均值估计，从而带来统计与计算上的根本性分离。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源标签只说明样本来自哪个源，却不说明该源如何定向其坐标。在存在源特定符号规范的模型中，这种区别改变了学习问题的本质：不做校准的跨源合并会抵消均值信号，使带源标签的实验退化为稀疏PCA。论文因此要形式化"元数据价值"这一问题。

Method: 提出 AlignedMass 指标，量化元数据诱导的对齐所恢复的一阶信号量；分析源标签与有效校准分别能带来的 AlignedMass 规模；并在标准稀疏PCA硬度假设下给出计算层面的分离结论。实验包括验证预测标度的合成实验，以及受控的真实特征与物理传感器研究（考察符号抵消、单独获取的校准、跨任务复用）。

Result: 源标签仅能产生有限的 AlignedMass，而有效校准可产生与总样本量成正比的 AlignedMass。由此在微源（micro-source）情形下得到统计分离，且在标准稀疏PCA硬度假设下得到计算分离。合成实验验证了理论预测的标度规律，真实数据与传感器实验呈现符号抵消及校准获取、复用的相关现象。

Conclusion: 源标签本身不足以恢复一阶信号；具有相对规范的任务无关校准元数据才是关键，可将稀疏PCA类问题转化为稀疏均值问题。AlignedMass 为衡量元数据价值提供了定量框架，并揭示了统计与计算双重分离。

Abstract: Source labels tell us where a sample came from, but not how that source oriented its coordinates. In a sparse Gaussian multi-source model with source-specific sign gauges, that distinction changes the learning problem. Without calibration, pooling across sources erases the mean signal, and the source-labelled experiment reduces to sparse PCA. With task-independent relative-gauge metadata, synchronization aligns sources and the same observations become a sparse mean problem. We formalize the value of metadata through AlignedMass, which quantifies how much first-order signal a metadata-induced alignment restores. Source labels create only limited AlignedMass, whereas valid calibration can create AlignedMass proportional to the full sample size. This yields a statistical separation in micro-source regimes and, under standard sparse-PCA hardness assumptions, a computational separation as well. Synthetic experiments check the predicted scaling; controlled real-feature
  and physical sensor studies examine sign cancellation, separately
  acquired calibration, and reuse across tasks.

</details>


### [967] [LOOP: Recovery-Aligned Iterative Layer Pruning via On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25679)
*Liang Xu,Shufan Shen,Zhongni Hou,Yufei Zhang,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 LOOP，一种将逐层剪枝与恢复交替进行的多轮 on-policy 剪枝框架，缓解一次性剪枝导致的推理能力骤降，并利用恢复信号指导后续层选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层级别剪枝多采用一次性范式：先剪到目标规模再训练恢复。直接剪到目标规模会显著损害推理能力，使有限训练预算下的恢复更困难；同时层选择与恢复过程分离，恢复信息无法反哺选择。

Method: LOOP 在多个 shot 中交替执行剪枝与恢复：每个 shot 仅移除单层，随后进行短程 on-policy 蒸馏以抑制能力突变；并复用恢复阶段的 on-policy 轨迹与优化信号，联合评估剩余各层的推理贡献与恢复敏感度，实现恢复感知的层选择。

Result: 在多个基准上，跨不同模型规模与剪枝比例，LOOP 的平均准确率稳定优于一次性剪枝基线。

Conclusion: 将剪枝由一次性转为多轮、渐进且恢复感知的交替过程，可在保持稠密结构易部署的同时更有效地保留并恢复推理能力。

Abstract: Layer-level pruning is attractive for large language model (LLM) deployment as it reduces the model size while preserving a dense architecture that can be efficiently executed on standard hardware. Current methods typically follow a one-shot paradigm, which first removes selected layers to reach a target model size and then performs additional training to recover model capabilities. However, pruning directly to the target size can substantially degrade reasoning capabilities, making subsequent recovery more difficult under a limited training budget. Moreover, this paradigm separates layer selection from recovery, limiting the use of recovery information to guide selection and potentially hindering the recovery of reasoning capabilities. To address these limitations, we propose LOOP, a Layer-level Recovery-Oriented On-Policy Pruning framework that interleaves pruning and recovery across multiple shots. In each shot, LOOP removes a single layer and performs short on-policy distillation, mitigating the abrupt degradation in reasoning capabilities associated with one-shot pruning. To guide layer selection in subsequent shots, LOOP reuses on-policy trajectories and optimization signals from recovery to jointly assess each remaining layer's reasoning contribution and recovery sensitivity, thereby making layer selection recovery-aware. Evaluations on several benchmarks show that LOOP consistently outperforms one-shot baselines in average accuracy across different model scales and pruning ratios.

</details>


### [968] [MT-CC: Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Asymmetric Calibration Behavior in Class-Incremental Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25689)
*Sungjun Yun,Yonghee Choi,Dong-Jun Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出多组温度缩放的后验校准框架MT-CC，用于类增量学习中的持续校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类增量学习（CIL）研究主要追求精度，忽视置信度校准；温度缩放（TS）在静态校准中有效，但在数据分布随时间演化的持续场景中鲜有探索。CIL中存在非对称校准现象，即置信度变化速率与精度退化速率不一致，导致不同程度失准。

Method: 提出后验校准框架MT-CC：通过轻量级分组网络，依据置信度统计量与任务感知信号将样本划分到不同组，并为每组设计独立温度参数；同时引入组内置信度-精度差异（GDCA）正则化，促进组内一致性。

Result: 实验表明MT-CC在保持精度的同时显著提升校准性能。

Conclusion: MT-CC为可靠持续学习提供了一个有原则的校准框架，解决了CIL中的非对称校准问题。

Abstract: As deep neural networks are required to continuously adapt to evolving data, class-incremental learning (CIL) has become an active research area. However, most existing works primarily focus on improving accuracy while overlooking confidence calibration, which measures the trustworthiness of the model's predictions. Although temperature scaling (TS) is effective for static calibration, it has rarely been explored in continual settings where data distributions evolve over time. In this paper, we introduce Multi-Group Temperature Scaling for Continual Calibration (MT-CC), a novel post-hoc calibration framework that addresses the asymmetric calibration behavior in CIL, where the rate of confidence changes does not align with the rate of accuracy degradation across tasks, leading to different levels of miscalibration. Our key contribution is to design multiple temperature parameters through a lightweight grouping network that separates samples by confidence statistics and task-aware signals in CIL. Furthermore, a Groupwise Difference-between-Confidence-and-Accuracy (GDCA) regularization is incorporated to promote intra-group consistency. Experiments demonstrate that MT-CC significantly improves calibration performance while maintaining accuracy, offering a principled framework for reliable continual learning.

</details>


### [969] [Progress-Guided Preference Generation for Aligning Generative Control Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25692)
*Tung M. Luu,Tri Ton,Duc M. Nguyen,Xuan Thanh Nguyen,Nguyen Gia Binh,Quang Tan Nguyen,Vu Duong,Daniel Sonntag,Duy M. H. Nguyen,Vien Anh Ngo,Chang D. Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无监督偏好对齐框架PGPG，利用有序覆盖对齐度量相对专家演示的序列进度，自动生成伪偏好标签，无需人工标注即可微调生成式策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式策略在模仿学习中表现优异，但受限于专家演示稀缺；基于偏好的微调可利用次优轨迹提升性能，然而现有方法依赖昂贵的人工标注，形成人在回路瓶颈。

Method: PGPG：1）有序覆盖对齐（ordered coverage alignment），以少量专家演示为参照度量自主采集轨迹的序列进度；2）据此从无标注rollout中自动抽取伪偏好标签；3）引入若干关键改进以提升进度引导偏好的可靠性；4）无需手工设计奖励函数即可对预训练生成式策略进行偏好微调。

Result: 在多种挑战性长程操作任务上，PGPG优于标准监督微调基线；框架概念简洁、通用性强，可同时集成于扩散策略与flow-matching策略。

Conclusion: 序列进度可作为无需人工监督的有效偏好信号来源；PGPG为实现无监督偏好对齐、缓解专家演示依赖提供了简单且可跨策略类别迁移的方案。

Abstract: Generative policies have achieved strong performance in imitation learning tasks, but their success is often constrained by the limited availability of expert demonstrations. Although preference-based fine-tuning can leverage suboptimal rollouts to improve performance, existing approaches heavily rely on expensive human annotations. In this work, we introduce Progress-Guided Preference Generation (PGPG), an unsupervised preference alignment framework that eliminates the need for human-in-the-loop supervision. Our method leverages ordered coverage alignment to measure sequential progress relative to a small set of expert demonstrations, enabling the automatic extraction of pseudo-preference labels from autonomously collected rollouts. Furthermore, we introduce key enhancements to improve the reliability of these progress-guided preferences, enabling effective fine-tuning of pretrained generative policies without requiring manually designed reward functions. Extensive experiments across a suite of challenging long-horizon manipulation tasks demonstrate that PGPG outperforms standard supervised fine-tuning baselines. Moreover, our conceptually simple framework is broadly applicable across multiple classes of generative policies, demonstrating strong versatility when integrated with both diffusion and flow-matching policies.

</details>


### [970] [Stochastic Tracking of Drifting Affine Fixed Points](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25699)
*Sajad Khodadadian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究时变仿射算子下的线性随机逼近（SA），给出累积期望平方误差上界、标量高斯模型下的下界（证明常数步长的近最优性）、时间相关性影响，并提出无需噪声水平与固定点漂移量的自适应方法，最后应用于变化环境下的同步表格 TD 值函数估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有线性 SA 的有限时间分析大多假设底层算子固定，而实际问题（如变化环境中的 TD 学习）中固定点随时间变化、噪声可能跨轮相关，因此需要针对时变情形的误差刻画与步长选取方法。

Method: 1）对常数步长的线性 SA（时变仿射算子、相关观测噪声）建立迭代点与对应固定点间累积期望平方距离的界，涵盖初始误差、观测噪声与固定点漂移三项；2）在标量高斯模型下建立下界，分析时间相关性对精度的影响；3）提出利用额外有界无偏观测的自适应步长方法；4）将结论应用于生成模型访问、共同不变分布假设下的同步表格 TD 值函数估计。

Result: 上界显式分解为初始误差、噪声与固定点变化贡献；下界表明在给定条件下，适当选取的常数步长在常数因子内达到最小最坏情形累积误差，即使与使用未来观测的估计器相比亦然；自适应方法在没有噪声水平和漂移量先验知识的条件下实现近乎最优；并将结果推广至变化环境的 TD 估计。

Conclusion: 时变线性 SA 在常数步长下的累积误差可被紧致刻画，常数步长具有（阶最优）的鲁棒性；自适应方案能在未知噪声与漂移情形下保持近最优性能，并为变化环境下的值函数估计提供理论支撑。

Abstract: Linear stochastic approximation (SA) is widely used to estimate fixed points from noisy observations, but most finite-time analyses assume that the underlying operator remains fixed. We study linear SA with time-varying affine operators, where the fixed points change over time and the observation noise may be correlated across rounds. For constant-stepsize updates, we establish a bound on the cumulative expected squared distance between the iterates and the corresponding fixed points. The bound accounts for the initial error, observation noise, and changes in the fixed points over time. We also establish lower bounds for scalar Gaussian models, showing that, under specified conditions, a suitably chosen constant stepsize achieves the smallest possible worst-case cumulative error up to constant factors, even compared with estimators that use future observations. These results further quantify the effect of temporal correlation on estimation accuracy. Since choosing an appropriate stepsize generally requires knowledge of the noise level and how much the fixed points change, we develop an adaptive method that uses an additional bounded, unbiased observation of the fixed point to achieve an almost optimal algorithm without needing the knowledge of the noise level and the fixed point variation over time. Finally, we apply our results to value-function estimation using synchronous tabular temporal-difference learning in changing environments, assuming generative-model access and a common invariant distribution.

</details>


### [971] [Predictive Bandit Curriculum Reinforcement Learning via Gradient-Based Sample Group Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25704)
*Liang Xu,Shufan Shen,Zhongni Hou,Chao Bi,Yufei Zhang,Wei Lin,Guojun Yin,Shuhui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: PGB课程学习方法通过聚类投影后的样本级梯度来发现优化感知的学习单元，用轻量时序预测器预测各单元未来效用，并转换为Boltzmann采样分布实现自适应数据分配，在多种模型规模与推理基准上优于GRPO、难度课程与历史调度策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有强化学习课程学习方法存在两点不足：其一，课程单元依赖预定义的数据属性构建，可能把优化效果不同的样本归为一组；其二，效用估计仅对近期训练历史中的单一代理信号做简单聚合，无法预测效用随策略演化的变化趋势。

Method: 提出Predictive Gradient-based Bandit (PGB) Curriculum：1）基于投影后的样本级梯度聚类，发现"优化感知"（optimization-aware）的学习单元；2）使用轻量时序预测器预测各单元的未来效用；3）将预测值转换为Boltzmann采样分布，用于自适应数据分配。

Result: 在多种模型规模与多个推理基准上，PGB一致优于标准GRPO、基于难度的课程方法以及基于历史信息的调度策略，体现出更好的数据利用率与训练效率。

Conclusion: 以梯度层面的优化信号构建课程单元并结合未来效用预测的自适应调度，可有效提升强化学习课程学习的数据利用效率，超越依赖预定义属性与历史聚合的既有方案。

Abstract: Curriculum learning, which organizes training samples according to their learning priority, has been widely adopted in reinforcement learning to improve training efficiency. However, existing methods commonly construct curriculum units using predefined data properties and estimate their utility by simply aggregating a single proxy signal from recent training history.Such designs may group samples with different optimization effects and fail to anticipate how their utility evolves in relation to the policy. We propose Predictive Gradient-based Bandit (PGB) Curriculum, which first discovers optimization-aware learning units by clustering projected sample-level gradients. PGB then employs a lightweight temporal predictor to forecast the future utility of each unit and converts the predictions into a Boltzmann sampling distribution for adaptive data allocation. Experiments across multiple model scales and reasoning benchmarks show that PGB consistently outperforms standard GRPO, difficulty-based curricula, and history-based scheduling strategies, demonstrating improved data utilization and training efficiency.

</details>


### [972] [Evidence Sufficiency and Model Comparisons in MexRegQA: An Item-Level Audit of Mexican-Spanish Regulatory QA](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25710)
*Fred Hu,Yeqi Wang,Xing Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 税务/金融监管QA基准中，相似度门控的“已覆盖”条目约26%（35/135）缺失关键事实；剔除缺陷条目会改变55组配对比较中14组的显著性结论，说明仅凭机器评测的模型排名需与证据可得性分离报告。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有grounded QA基准用检索相似度判定条目“已被证据覆盖”，但相似度高不代表证据包含回答问题所需的承重事实（load-bearing facts）；若不审计证据充分性，基于这些条目的模型比较可能被证据缺陷混杂。

Method: 对墨西哥西班牙语金融监管QA数据做证据审计，标注135个“已覆盖”条目的证据状态；在事后全证据切片（n=98）上做11个提示匹配模型的比较检验；通过剔除证据缺陷条目做敏感性分析（55组配对比较）；在56个零证据条目上测准确率区间；并在10个测试腿上用允许弃答的提示做证据移除实验。

Result: 35/135覆盖条目缺失部分或全部承重事实；全证据切片上11个模型得分95–98/98，与锚点模型无显著差异（但不能据此宣称等价）；剔除缺陷条目使14/55组配对比较的名义显著性状态改变；零证据条目准确率跨度33.9%–89.3%；移除证据后10个腿准确率下降63–81个百分点，且无条目恢复到原水平。

Conclusion: 相似度门控覆盖不足以保证证据充分性，证据状态会实质影响模型比较结论；作者提出MexRegQA v1.0（192条，含来源与证据状态标签、191条冻结检索证据、预测、评判输出与离线检查），并建议grounded QA基准随证据状态标签一并发布，以将模型能力比较与证据可得性分开考察。局限：审计具结果知情性、后续扫描复用同批问题、全部评分与标签依赖机器评测而无独立人工验证。

Abstract: Similarity-gated coverage does not establish that retrieved evidence contains the facts needed to answer a question. We audit Mexican-Spanish financial-regulatory QA and find that 35 of 135 covered items lack some or all load-bearing facts. On the post-hoc full-evidence slice (n=98), eleven prompt-matched models score 95-98/98 and none differs significantly from the anchor; this does not establish equivalence. Removing evidence-defective items changes the nominal significance status of 14 of 55 pairwise comparisons. On 56 zero-evidence items, accuracy spans 33.9%-89.3%. Removing evidence from the audited items under an abstention-permitting prompt reduces accuracy by 63-81 percentage points in all ten tested legs, with no recovered items. Building on sufficient-context research, we contribute MexRegQA v1.0: 192 items with provenance and evidence-status labels, frozen retrieval evidence for 191 evaluated items, predictions, judge outputs and offline checks. The audit was outcome-aware, the later model/panel sweep reused the same questions, and all reported scores and labels rely on machine evaluation without independent human validation. We propose releasing evidence-status labels alongside grounded QA benchmarks so that model comparisons can be examined separately from evidence availability.

</details>


### [973] [Learning to Couple: Context-Adaptive Joint Denoising for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25723)
*Zilei Shao,Ian Li,Heng Zhao,Kewei Lian,Guy Van den Broeck,Zhe Zeng,Anji Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Codpula——一种上下文参数化的去噪器，将Transformer与可处理的概率推断层结合，实现上下文相关的联合分布建模，从而在扩散语言模型中缓解并行预测的条件独立性误差，并在推理基准上刷新SOTA、推进精度-延迟帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散语言模型通过并行预测多个token加速生成，但因子化去噪器将同时预测视为条件独立，产生误差。解码启发式只能控制提交哪些token而不改变因子化分布本身；现有联合建模方法又在冻结的去噪器上附加独立学习层，导致骨干网络未适配联合目标，且耦合参数跨上下文固定。

Method: Codpula由Transformer与可处理的概率推断层组成：给定部分掩码输入，Transformer输出token势（塑造逐位置预测）与紧凑门控（调制该层的耦合参数），从而在保持精确条件推断的同时获得上下文相关的联合分布。两组件在条件去噪目标下联合优化，采用保参数合法性的双流乘性更新。推理时支持标准启发式，并借助条件查询使提交决策适应候选token间的依赖，且单步内无需额外Transformer评估。

Result: 在广泛推理基准测试集上取得新的SOTA，并在数学推理与代码生成任务上推进了精度-延迟帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: 通过在骨干网络中端到端地引入上下文参数化的联合建模层，可在保持精确条件推断与推理效率的同时，从分布层面而非解码启发式层面消解并行预测的条件独立误差。

Abstract: Diffusion language models accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but factorized denoisers treat simultaneous predictions as conditionally independent. Decoding heuristics reduce the resulting errors by controlling which tokens are committed, but leave the underlying distribution factorized. Joint modeling addresses the source of the problem, yet existing methods attach separately learned layers to frozen denoisers, leaving the backbone unadapted to the joint objective and the coupling parameters fixed across contexts. We propose Codpula, a context-parameterized denoiser combining a Transformer with a tractable probabilistic inference layer. Given a partially masked input, the Transformer produces token potentials that shape per-position predictions and compact gates that modulate the layer's coupling parameters, yielding a context-dependent joint distribution while retaining exact conditional inference. We jointly optimize both components under a conditional denoising objective using a dual-flow multiplicative update that preserves valid probabilistic parameters. At inference, Codpula supports standard heuristics and uses conditional queries to adapt commitments to dependencies among proposed tokens without extra Transformer evaluations within a step. Codpula sets new state-of-the-art results across a broad suite of reasoning benchmarks while advancing the accuracy-latency Pareto frontier in mathematical reasoning and code generation.

</details>


### [974] [Anatomy of Off-Policy Policy Gradient: Importance Sampling, KL Regularization, and Baselines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25725)
*Haoqun Cao,Yurun Yuan,Tengyang Xie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文分析了LLM后训练中策略梯度方法在离策略（off-policy）场景下的理论合理性，证明一致性需要轨迹级重要性加权或带最优软值baseline的KL正则两种结构之一，并将KL路线对应于GRPG/GRPO类目标，给出有限样本regret界及baseline实现悲观性、支撑单策略覆盖界的新发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RL已成为LLM后训练的核心工具，其中策略梯度方法常被离策略地部署，但vanilla policy gradient理论仅假设on-policy采样。作者希望厘清这种off-policy部署何时被理论正当化，以及重要性采样、KL正则、baseline三要素在应对分布偏移中各自扮演的角色。

Method: 对一类一般化的离策略策略梯度更新进行理论分析：推导最优策略保持为驻点（一致性）所需的结构条件；聚焦KL正则路线，将其识别为group-relative policy gradient（GRPG）更新，建立其与轨迹级Bellman残差最小化目标的等价性，并在全策略覆盖假设下推出有限样本regret界；进一步分析baseline常数平移所实现的悲观性，通过非对称REINFORCE目标实例化并接入博弈论离线RL框架。

Result: 证明一致性要求两种结构之一：轨迹级重要性加权（受horizon诅咒困扰），或KL正则配合等于最优软值的baseline（由grouped mean实例化）。KL路线等价于轨迹级Bellman残差最小化，在全策略覆盖下获得有限样本regret界，并为经验上成功的GRPO目标某一变体提供理论解释。此外揭示baseline的隐藏作用：常数平移实现悲观性，得到单策略覆盖下的regret界。

Conclusion: 该文为LLM后训练中的离策略策略梯度提供了统一的理论视角，将重要性采样、KL正则与baseline的作用系统化，并把GRPO类方法与离线RL中的悲观性、单策略覆盖等经典思想联系起来。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central tool for large language model (LLM) post-training, where policy gradient methods are routinely deployed off-policy, even though vanilla policy gradient assumes on-policy sampling. We study when such off-policy deployment is justified, and what roles its core ingredients, including importance sampling, KL regularization, and baselines, play in handling the resulting distribution shift. We show that for a general class of off-policy policy gradient updates, consistency, in the sense that the optimal policy remains a stationary point, requires one of two structures at the optimal policy: trajectory-level importance weighting, which suffers from the well-known curse of horizon, or KL regularization with a baseline equal to the optimal soft value, instantiated by the grouped mean. Focusing on the KL route, we identify it with the group-relative policy gradient (GRPG) update, establish an equivalence to a trajectory-level Bellman residual minimization objective, and obtain a finite-sample regret bound under all-policy coverage. This also gives a theoretical account of a variant of the empirically successful GRPO objective. We further uncover a hidden role of baselines in the off-policy setting: a constant shift in the baseline implements pessimism, the standard remedy in offline RL for partial data coverage. We instantiate this via the asymmetric REINFORCE objective, and connect it to the game-theoretic offline RL framework, showing a regret bound with single-policy coverage. Together, these results offer a unified theoretical view of off-policy policy gradient in LLM post-training and connect it to classical ideas in offline RL.

</details>


### [975] [Neural Video Coding under Limited Delay: Theoretical Optimality and System Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25729)
*Likun Cai,Jun Chen,Ashish Khisti*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文将帧延迟视为显式设计参数，基于马尔可夫网络团因子化进行率失真分析，提出图因子化序列编码（GFSC）框架，证明K阶马尔可夫源下K帧延迟可在非平凡失真区域内达到联合编码率失真最优，并通过轻量神经模块实现，在不改动现有因果预测编解码器核心架构的前提下提升率失真性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经视频压缩（NVC）严格遵循因果预测编码范式，将零帧延迟当作固定约束，而非可设计参数。作者希望从信息论角度说明：允许有限帧延迟可利用延迟窗口内未来帧的相关性，降低严格因果预测无法获取的不确定性，从而改善率失真权衡。

Method: 1）基于马尔可夫网络的团因子化（clique factorization）建立严格的率失真分析；2）据此提出GFSC——有限延迟下序列视频编码的原则性框架；3）理论上证明：对具有正分布的一般K阶马尔可夫源，K帧延迟足以在非平凡失真区域实现联合编码的率失真最优；4）实践中用轻量神经模块实例化GFSC，作为插件增强现有因果预测编解码器而无需修改其核心架构。

Result: 理论方面，首次给出K阶马尔可夫源（正分布）下K帧延迟可在非平凡失真区域达到联合编码率失真最优的结果，而零延迟因果编码一般不具备此保证。实验方面，在多种NVC模型与数据集上，GFSC相较对应的因果版本稳定提升率失真性能；在相同延迟预算下，与代表性双向编解码器相比也具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 延迟应作为显式编码设计维度而非固定约束；GFSC为有限延迟序列视频编码提供了理论支撑与可落地的轻量实现，能在兼容现有因果NVC架构的同时获得率失真增益，并在匹配延迟预算下与双向编码方案竞争。

Abstract: Traditional neural video compression (NVC) methods predominantly follow strictly causal predictive-coding paradigm, treating zero-frame delay as a fixed constraint rather than delay as an explicit design parameter. From an information-theoretic perspective, allowing limited frame delay enables a codec to exploit correlations with future frames within the delay window, thereby reducing uncertainty that is inaccessible to strictly causal prediction and potentially improving the rate-distortion tradeoff. In this work, we formalize this intuition through a rigorous rate-distortion analysis builds on the clique factorization of Markov networks, and propose Graph-Factored Sequential Coding (GFSC), a principled framework for sequential video coding under limited delay. To our knowledge, we provide the first theoretical result showing that, for general $K$-order Markov sources with positive distributions, a $K$-frame delay is sufficient to attain joint-coding rate-distortion optimality over a nontrivial distortion region, a guarantee unavailable to zero-delay causal coding in general. In practice, we instantiate GFSC through lightweight neural modules, allowing existing causal predictive codecs to be augmented without modifying their core architectures. Experiments across multiple NVC models and datasets show that GFSC consistently improves rate-distortion performance over the corresponding causal counterparts. Under matched delay budgets, GFSC also achieves competitive performance compared with representative bidirectional codecs.

</details>


### [976] [How Much Does One Wrong Answer Cost? Error Propagation in Constraint Pruning with Noisy LLM Oracles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25739)
*Zhengtao Gui,Weining Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文指出约束剪枝在oracle（判定器/LLM）可能出错时应以风险而非查询数衡量：一个被接受的错误答案会传播到它蕴含的所有问题。作者给出ε的一阶风险分析：蕴含规则在随机顺序下无额外一阶风险，但s前提规则可致r^{1-1/s}级代价；实体解析的一阶风险等于ε乘查询顺序生成树的Wiener指数，pivot顺序最优（放大<2），随机顺序约m^{1/3}，most-similar-first最差。仿真与预测常数吻合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 约束剪枝（如传递性）被广泛用于减少对LLM或有噪oracle的yes/no查询，但现有分析通常假设oracle完全正确。由于一个被接受的错误答案会扩散到其蕴含的所有问题，剪枝的真实代价应按oracle出错时的风险来评估，而非仅看节省的查询数。

Method: 在每次回答以概率ε独立出错的一阶近似下，以"一个错误答案平均污染多少事实"度量风险。分两类约束分析：(1) 蕴含规则（如分类体系），分析随机顺序剪枝与多前提（s个前提）规则在共享前提数r下的风险增长；(2) 实体解析，将m条记录归并的风险刻画为查询顺序生成树的Wiener指数（两两距离总和），并比较pivot、随机、most-similar-first等顺序的放大系数。

Result: 蕴含规则随机顺序剪枝不增加一阶风险：原本会改变k个事实的错误答案以1/k概率被接受，平均代价为1个事实。含s个前提的规则打破此平衡：共享于r条规则的前提处，一个错误答案可造成r^{1-1/s}量级的事实损失。实体解析中，一阶风险=ε×生成树Wiener指数；pivot顺序放大误差小于2且最优，随机顺序约m^{1/3}，most-similar-first在一维最差、大m下二维比随机还差；多实体时误合并两实体的代价与其余实体数量无关。仿真与所有预测常数在抽样误差内一致。

Conclusion: 评估剪枝应以其在oracle出错时的风险为准则；顺序选择对纠错鲁棒性影响显著，pivot式顺序近乎最优，而常见的most-similar-first顺序在风险意义下很差。该框架可用于设计更稳健的剪枝查询策略。

Abstract: Constraint pruning saves queries to a large language model (LLM) or another noisy oracle by skipping each yes/no question implied by answers accepted earlier, for example through transitivity. Entity-resolution systems and LLM-based rankers use this idea. However, their analyses typically assume a correct oracle. We argue that pruning should be judged by its risk when the oracle errs, since an accepted wrong answer spreads to every question it implies. When each answer is wrong independently with small probability $\varepsilon$, the first-order risk is set by how many facts one wrong answer corrupts on average. We consider two kinds of constraints. For implication rules, as in taxonomies, pruning in a random order adds no first-order risk: a wrong answer that would change $k$ facts is accepted with probability $1/k$, so it costs one fact on average. Rules with $s$ premises break this balance: a wrong answer at a premise shared by $r$ rules can cost order $r^{1-1/s}$ facts. For entity resolution with $m$ records of one entity, the first-order risk equals $\varepsilon$ times the Wiener index (the total pairwise distance) of the spanning tree built by the query order. Pivot orders, which first compare one record with all others, amplify errors by less than 2 and are optimal; random orders by order $m^{1/3}$; the common most-similar-first order is the worst in one dimension and, for large $m$, worse than random in two. With several entities, the cost of wrongly merging two does not depend on how many others exist. Simulations agree with every predicted constant within sampling error.

</details>


### [977] [Bayesian Model Discovery with Language Models: Closing the Loop between Hypotheses and Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25747)
*JooKyung Yuh,Byungmin Park,Eunseo Choi,Jinheon Baek,Junmo Cho,Kyu Hyun Choi,Sung Ju Hwang,Kyong Hwan Jin,Hae Beom Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BMD将LLM驱动的假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计闭环结合：LLM提出模型族，数值引擎拟合参数、以模型证据加权并做贝叶斯模型平均，再通过最大化对模型族与参数的联合期望信息增益选择下一实验条件，并将更新后的信念与残差诊断反馈给LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学模型发现需要提出候选模型并设计能区分它们的实验。现有LLM方法依赖上下文学习预测结果与选实验，缺乏显式模型评估来系统引导假设搜索；贝叶斯方法虽能进行有原则的模型比较，却受限于预定义候选集，搜索空间有限。

Method: 提出BMD框架，闭合LLM假设生成与贝叶斯实验设计的环路：LLM提出模型族；数值引擎拟合其参数、按模型证据加权并进行预测平均；BMD通过最大化跨模型族及其参数的联合期望信息增益选择下一实验条件，同时将更新的后验信念与残差诊断反馈给LLM以指导后续提案。

Result: 在四个科学发现基准上，BMD的最终预测误差低于上下文学习方法和基于LLM的科学智能体，且更常恢复出精确的函数形式；消融实验支持数值反馈与联合目标设计的有效性。

Conclusion: 将LLM的开放式假设生成与贝叶斯模型比较、实验设计相结合，可突破预定义候选集的限制并弥补纯上下文学习缺乏显式评估的缺陷，实现更准确、可解释的科学模型发现。

Abstract: Scientific model discovery requires proposing candidate models of an unknown system and designing experiments that discriminate among them. However, LLM-based approaches typically rely on in-context learning to predict outcomes and select experiments, lacking explicit model evaluation to systematically guide hypothesis search, while Bayesian approaches enable principled model comparison but are confined to a predefined candidate set which results in limited search spaces. To this end, we introduce BMD, which closes the loop between LLM-driven hypothesis generation and Bayesian experimental design. Specifically, an LLM proposes model families, while a numerical engine fits their parameters, weighs them by model evidence, and averages their predictions. Then, BMD chooses the next experimental conditions by maximizing the joint expected information gain over families and their parameters, while feeding the updated beliefs and residual diagnostics back to the LLM to guide its next proposals. Across four scientific discovery benchmarks, BMD achieves lowest final prediction error than in-context learning and LLM-based scientific agents while recovering exact functional forms more often, with ablations supporting numerical feedback and the joint objective.

</details>


### [978] [Cognitively Decoupled Meta-Induction for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25749)
*Yuqian Wang,Yuanzheng Wang,Chaojun Xiao,Ke Xu,Bingxiang He,Jinghan Tan,Zijun Chen,Lu Chen,Yi-Xin Huo,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出CoDI（Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction），通过将任务级归纳表示（TIR）的归纳与作答解耦，并结合元学习实现跨任务的归纳器优化，从而提升ICL的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICL依赖查询与示例之间的近邻匹配，泛化到分布外（OOD）任务时性能受限；基于规则的归纳推理可提取任务级规律（TIR），但已有方法缺乏跨多样任务的通用归纳能力。

Method: 受元学习启发提出CoDI，包含两部分：（1）认知解耦框架（Cognitive-Decoupling Framework），在归纳TIR时不依赖查询（query-blind）；（2）双环元归纳学习（Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning），用于跨任务的归纳器优化。

Result: 在5个ID与OOD基准上取得显著性能提升，且推理阶段无需显式归纳即可保持OOD增益。

Conclusion: 将TIR归纳与查询解耦并借助元学习优化归纳器，可赋予模型跨任务的通用归纳能力，是提升ICL分布外泛化的有效途径。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) tackles downstream tasks conditioned on demonstrations. This paradigm relies heavily on neighbor-based matching between queries and demonstrations, limiting out-of-distribution (OOD) performance. For better generalization, rule-based inductive reasoning derives task-level regularities, which we term task-level inductive representations (TIR), before directly answering. However, existing methods lack generalizable inductive ability across diverse tasks. Inspired by meta-learning, we propose Cognitive-Decoupling meta-Induction (CoDI) for TIR-based inductive reasoning on general tasks. CoDI comprises a Cognitive-Decoupling Framework for query-blind TIR induction, and a Dual-Loop Meta-Inductive Learning method for cross-task inducer optimization.
