Empirically, CoDI achieves substantial performance gains on five ID and OOD benchmarks, and preserves OOD gains without explicit induction at inference. Code is available at https://github.com/Yuqian-Wang2277/codi-meta-induction.

</details>


### [979] [NADS: Navigator-Guided Data Selection for Mitigating Catastrophic Forgetting in Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25751)
*Jianhao Zhang,Ou Wu,Yi Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NADS通过对目标微调得到的navigator模型与预训练模型的预测散度来度量合成数据的遗忘感知效用，并用高效的效用-多样性选择构建约束集，在无原始预训练数据的情况下缓解单阶段微调的灾难性遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM单阶段微调新任务时，原始预训练数据不可得，易发生灾难性遗忘；合成数据虽可缓解，但候选池噪声与冗余严重，需有效筛选。现有方法依赖与实际训练收益对齐有限的间接代理信号，且大规模候选池上的效用-多样性选择计算开销高。

Method: (1) 按目标微调配方（不加保持正则）训练出navigator模型，其相对预训练模型的偏移反映配方导致的能力漂移；(2) 以navigator与预训练模型间的预测散度为每个合成候选打分，得到遗忘感知效用；(3) 通过高效的效用-多样性选择策略构建约束集；(4) 在新任务数据上微调，并在所选约束上蒸馏预训练行为以保持通用能力。

Result: 实验表明，NADS在新任务性能与通用能力保持之间取得更优平衡，同时降低了效用-多样性选择开销。

Conclusion: 以navigator诱导的预测散度作为遗忘感知效用信号，并结合高效效用-多样性选择，是缓解无预训练数据场景下灾难性遗忘的有效途径。

Abstract: Catastrophic forgetting is a central obstacle in single-stage fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) on a new task, especially when the original pretraining data are unavailable. Synthetic data offers a practical mitigation path, but candidate pools are often noisy and redundant, making effective selection essential. Existing methods often rely on indirect proxy signals whose alignment with actual training benefit can be limited, while utility--diversity selection over large candidate pools remains computationally demanding. To address these challenges, we propose NAvigator-guided Data Selection (NADS), a fine-tuning framework for LLMs. NADS first follows the target fine-tuning recipe without preservation regularization to obtain a navigator model, whose deviation from the pretrained model exposes recipe-induced capability drift. It then uses the predictive divergence between the navigator and the pretrained model to score forgetting-aware utility for each synthetic candidate, and constructs a constraint set through an efficient utility--diversity selection strategy. Finally, NADS fine-tunes on the new-task data while distilling pretrained behavior on the selected constraints to preserve general capabilities. Experiments show that NADS delivers a stronger balance between new-task performance and general capability preservation, while reducing utility--diversity selection overhead. Code at: https://github.com/zjh-vinky/NADS.

</details>


### [980] [Which Answers Agree? Evaluating Self-Consistency from Incomplete Logs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25752)
*Zhengtao Gui,Zexi Chen,Weining Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对自一致性（self-consistency）投票准确率的评估，本文利用随机序（majorization）理论在仅有部分日志信息的条件下推导出紧致的准确率区间界，并提出精确计算平均投票准确率的方法 Plurality-U。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自一致性通过生成多个回答并取多数投票来提升准确率，但评估其投票准确率通常需要正确性标签以及各回答间的一致性信息。仅有正确性标签时，既无法确定投票准确率，也无法判断增加投票数的收益。作者希望明确"不完整日志能说明什么"，并在保留答案计数时提供精确评估手段。

Method: 1) 针对所有正确回答映射到同一规范化答案的任务，基于经典随机序（stochastic majorization）推导准确率的紧致上下界，并用弃权计数与答案类别数加以细化；2) 推导共享同一回答池的不同投票预算间准确率变化量的紧致界；3) 当答案类别计数可得时，提出 Plurality-U——一种基于计数的动态规划方法，可在所有固定大小子集上精确平均投票准确率，消除有限池蒙特卡洛误差。

Result: 在 Scorio Lite 与 Scorio Trace 中 1,403,520 条近期推理模型输出上：记录弃权计数与答案选项可将 SuperGPQA 准确率区间宽度缩减一半以上；投票数从 9 增至 17 时，所提界相较分别合并准确率界的基线，在 SuperGPQA 上将区间宽度中位数减少 77.7%，在 14 个 GPQA 与 Adaptive-Consistency 池上减少 72.3%。在 15 个测试的池–预算设置中，有 14 个的精确计算配对中位运行时间低于 2,000 子集蒙特卡洛。

Conclusion: 本文阐明了不完整日志能证明的结论边界，并在保留答案计数时给出精确的评估流程；所提方法在区间紧致度与计算效率上均优于基线。

Abstract: Self-consistency answers a question by generating multiple responses and selecting the most frequent answer. Its evaluation requires both correctness labels and information about which responses agree; correctness labels alone generally determine neither voting accuracy nor the benefit of additional votes. For tasks in which all correct responses map to the same normalized answer, we derive sharp accuracy bounds using classical stochastic majorization, refined by abstention counts and answer-category limits. We also derive sharp bounds on accuracy changes across voting budgets that share a response pool. When answer-category counts are available, we introduce Plurality-U, a count-based dynamic program that exactly averages voting accuracy over all fixed-size subsets, eliminating finite-pool Monte Carlo error. On 1,403,520 stored outputs from recent reasoning models in Scorio Lite and Scorio Trace, recording abstention counts and answer options cuts the width of SuperGPQA accuracy intervals by more than half. For moving from 9 to 17 votes, our bounds reduce interval width by a median of 77.7% on SuperGPQA and 72.3% on 14 GPQA and Adaptive-Consistency pools, compared with a baseline that combines separate accuracy bounds. Exact computation has lower paired median runtime than 2,000-subset Monte Carlo in 14 of 15 tested pool-budget settings. These results clarify what incomplete logs can establish and provide an exact evaluation procedure when answer counts are retained.

</details>


### [981] [Remember Less, Adapt Longer: Bounded-State In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Recurrent Summary Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25758)
*Jiawen Wang,Cheng Xue,Peng Zhang,Jochen Renz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出循环摘要记忆（RSM），用固定容量摘要+短工作缓冲区实现O(1)成本的长程上下文强化学习自适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有ICRL智能体的记忆方案存在两难：增长型记忆（全历史注意力、累积摘要）的存储与单步决策成本随任务长度增长；固定大小记忆（滑动窗口、循环网络隐状态）虽有界但限制了对历史经验的访问。

Method: RSM是一种Transformer策略：精确关注近期交互构成的短工作缓冲区，并携带固定容量的早期经验摘要。当缓冲区填满时，用上一份摘要与缓冲区内容重写摘要，随后清空缓冲区，从而保持部署内存与每步决策成本对任务长度均为O(1)。

Result: 在长时程部分可观测任务上，冻结的RSM策略在训练视界8倍长度下仍维持自适应性能，内存占用约为全历史方案的1%，最终优于所有对比基线，而增长型记忆出现退化；任务配置中途变化时，RSM的重适应能力优于增长型和循环型记忆。消融显示：清空摘要或阻断访问会消除收益，而替换为其他任务的摘要可引导行为转向该任务。

Conclusion: 固定容量摘要足以支撑远超训练视界的上下文内自适应，为长时程持续学习智能体提供了成本有界且可持续的记忆机制。

Abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) enables agents to adapt to new tasks without parameter updates, relying on memory to retain what they learn from experience. For agents operating continually, existing approaches using memory trade off bounded cost against access to past experience. Approaches using growing memories, such as full-history attention and accumulating summaries, incur storage and per-decision costs that increase with task length. Fixed-size memories bound storage but restrict access: sliding windows discard older steps, while recurrent networks compress even recent interactions into a hidden state. We introduce Recurrent Summary Memory (RSM), a Transformer policy that attends exactly to a short working buffer of recent interactions and carries a fixed-capacity summary of earlier experience. When the buffer fills, RSM rewrites the summary from its previous contents and the buffer, then clears the buffer, so deployment memory and per-decision cost stay $O(1)$ in task length. On long-running partially observable tasks, frozen RSM policies sustain their adapted performance for eight times the training horizon with about 1% of full-history memory, ending ahead of every evaluated baseline while growing memories deteriorate. When the task configuration changes mid-run, RSM re-adapts better than growing and recurrent memories. Clearing the summary or blocking the policy's access to it removes its benefit, while swapping in another task's summary steers behaviour towards that task. Together, these results show that our fixed-capacity summary can sustain in-context adaptation far beyond the training horizon.

</details>


### [982] [Computation, Not Memory: Chain-of-Thought and State Tracking in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25760)
*Pedram Mouseli,Massieh Moayedi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究语言模型智能体的行动如何依赖其推理：在需要重建动态状态的文件系统任务中，推理的收益主要来自"行动前即时生成推理"，而非"在提示中保留历史推理"；且可解码的内部状态对行动预测有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体常在行动前推理，监测这种推理的价值取决于推理与行动的关联。作者想探究：当正确行动依赖变化的状态时，行动究竟如何依赖推理，从而厘清推理（生成 vs. 保留）在规则遵循中的具体作用。

Method: 构建小型文件系统任务：后台事件仅宣告哪个文件的锁被切换但不告知新值，智能体须从历史重建当前锁状态才能安全移动文件。用 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3.5-9B 分离两种推理角色——(1) 每步行动前生成推理，(2) 在提示中保留早前推理。并进行干预实验：填充文本、为另一段历史写的推理、准确的状态表格、仅一个锁值不同的历史推理；同时在无推理条件下用线性探针从激活中解码状态，并与文本分类器从对话记录中恢复状态作对比。

Result: 违反锁规则的命令减少主要来自行动时刻即时生成的推理；保留早前推理对规则遵循增益很小（仅帮助一个模型完成任务）。收益取决于推理内容：填充文本、异历史推理、准确状态表格均无法复现该收益。给出仅一个锁值不同的历史推理时，智能体会依该推理行动，甚至违背自身历史。无推理时，线性探针从激活恢复状态的效果约等于文本分类器从记录中恢复；但解码准确率无法预测哪些干预会改变智能体行动。

Conclusion: 在此设定下，推理对规则遵循的收益主要来自每步即时生成推理。无需推理即可解码的状态，对智能体实际如何行动只是有限指引。

Abstract: Language-model agents often reason before they act, and the value of monitoring that reasoning depends on how it relates to their actions. We ask how an agent's actions depend on its reasoning when the correct action depends on a changing state. In a small file-system task, background events announce which file's lock has been toggled but not its new value. The agent therefore has to reconstruct the current locks from its history before it can move files safely. With Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-9B, we separate two roles of reasoning: generating it before each action, and retaining earlier reasoning in the prompt. Most of the reduction in lock-violating commands comes from reasoning written at the moment of action. Retaining earlier reasoning adds little to rule-following, although it helps one model complete the task. The benefit depends on what the reasoning says. Filler text, reasoning written for another history and an accurate table of the state do not reproduce it. When we give the agent reasoning written for a history that differs in one lock value, the agent acts on that reasoning even against its own history. Without reasoning, linear probes recover the state from the model's activations about as well as a text classifier recovers it from the transcript. However, decoding accuracy does not predict which interventions change the agent's actions. In this setting, the benefit of reasoning for rule-following comes mainly from generating it at each step. The state that can be decoded without reasoning is a limited guide to how the agent acts.

</details>


### [983] [Detection Augmented Learning In Non-Stationary Bandit Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25782)
*Argyrios Gerogiannis,Yu-Han Huang,Subhonmesh Bose,Venugopal V. Veeravalli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出黑盒范式DAL（检测增强学习），由bandit算法、变化检测器与强制探索调度三个模块化组件构成，将平稳输入的regret迁移到分段平稳场景，并在九种bandit设定中超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究在未知环境变化信息条件下的非平稳bandit问题，现有方法往往依赖先验知识或局限于特定结构，缺乏通用且实证有效的框架。

Method: DAL采用黑盒模块化设计：输入任意bandit算法、一个变化检测器和一个强制探索调度，通过检测环境变化触发重启/探索以实现对非平稳性的适应；理论上给出统一regret界，将平稳输入的regret转移到分段平稳设定，并分析漂移环境下的适用条件；实验覆盖九种bandit设定与多种非平稳场景。

Result: 单一regret界在各设定下达到或改进已知最优界；实验表明DAL在九种设定中一致优于所有SOTA（含prior-free与prior-based方法）；bandit驱动的强制探索策略可提升性能并缩短检测延迟。

Conclusion: DAL是一种通用、模块化且无需环境变化先验的非平稳bandit框架，兼具理论保证与实证优势，且其强制探索策略的设计（由bandit驱动）对性能与检测延迟均有正向作用。

Abstract: We study the problem of non-stationary bandits without knowledge of the environmental changes. We propose Detection Augmented Learning (DAL) a black-box paradigm that comprises three modular components: a bandit algorithm, a change detector, and a forced exploration schedule. This modular design enables its applicability across a broad spectrum of bandit problems, from classical to highly structured settings. First, we provide theoretical insights into DAL's strong empirical performance: a single regret bound shows that DAL transfers the regret of its stationary input to the piecewise stationary setting, attaining or improving the best known bounds in every setting considered. We further identify conditions under which DAL performs well in drifting environments. Then, we showcase DAL's practical performance and versatility through extensive experimentation in which DAL consistently surpasses all state-of-the-art methods, both prior-free and prior-based, across diverse non-stationary scenarios in nine bandit settings. Finally, we investigate the effectiveness of the forced exploration and show that a bandit-driven strategy improves performance and shortens detection delay.

</details>


### [984] [Sector-Ring Linear Reservoirs: Sector-Wise Decay-Timescale Allocation With State Reuse Across Candidate Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25806)
*Yudai Ebato,Sou Nobukawa,Yusuke Sakemi,Takashi Kanamaru,Nina Sviridova,Kazuyuki Aihara*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Sector-Ring线性储备池(SRLR)，将特征值角度等间隔固定并按扇区分配少数几个衰减时间尺度，配合基于训练输入功率谱的输入权重缩放与模式状态复用，在8个混沌基准上均优于单一衰减时间尺度参考模型，并将搜索中模式轨迹计算量减少99.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 储备池性能取决于固定动力学是否匹配任务，而合适的内存长度与频率响应因任务而异；每个任务都需搜索储备池超参，其中反复用输入驱动储备池并采集状态是搜索开销的主要来源。线性递归储备池的动力学可按特征值分解为模式，因此特征值分布可成为设计变量。

Method: 将特征值角度固定在圆上等间隔位置，把连续角度划分为若干扇区，每个扇区从少量候选值中分配一个衰减时间尺度；用训练输入功率谱缩放输入权重，以保持各候选下模式状态尺度一致；搜索时对每个衰减时间尺度值只计算一次模式状态并在候选间复用，降低搜索成本。

Result: 在基于混沌系统的预测与重建基准上，SRLR在全部8个案例中平均测试误差均低于所有模式共享同一衰减时间尺度的参考模型，并与非线性ESN和leaky-integrator ESN基线具有竞争力；所选衰减时间尺度剖面随预测目标与预测步长变化；状态复用使搜索中计算的模式轨迹数量相对逐候选重算减少99.8%。

Conclusion: 将特征值角度分布与分扇区衰减时间尺度作为设计变量、并结合功率谱归一化与状态复用，可在显著降低超参搜索成本的同时提升储备池计算性能，且最优时间尺度剖面具有任务依赖性。

Abstract: In reservoir computing, performance depends on whether the fixed dynamics of the reservoir suit the task, and the appropriate memory length and frequency response differ across tasks. The reservoir settings are found by a search on each task, and driving the reservoir with the input and collecting its states for every candidate setting dominates the cost of the search. In a reservoir with a linear recurrence, the dynamics decompose into modes, one per eigenvalue, and the eigenvalue distribution becomes a design variable. We propose the Sector-Ring Linear Reservoir (SRLR), in which the eigenvalue angles are fixed at evenly spaced positions around a circle and one decay timescale, chosen from a few values, is assigned to each sector of consecutive angles. To keep the scale of each mode's state equal across candidates, the input weights are scaled using the power spectrum of the training input. To reduce the cost of the search, the states of the modes for each decay-timescale value are computed once and reused across candidates. On prediction and reconstruction benchmarks built from chaotic systems, the SRLR achieved, in all eight cases, a lower mean test error than a reference model in which all modes share one decay timescale, and was competitive with nonlinear echo state network and leaky-integrator echo state network baselines. The selected decay-timescale profiles changed with the prediction target and horizon. The state reuse reduced the number of computed mode trajectories in the search by 99.8% relative to per-candidate recomputation.

</details>


### [985] [Communication-Efficient Federated Domain Generalization in Edge Networks via Dynamic Prototype Regulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25810)
*Yuankun Xia,Hui Wang,Ling Yuan,Ziyu Hong,Di Yin,Yufeng Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DPGR-GCAM：一种通信高效的联邦域泛化框架，结合双参数高效微调架构与信道感知分层传输机制，并引入梯度冲突感知调制（GCAM）缓解Non-IID导致的客户端漂移，在10%参与率与衰落信道下保持收敛与跨域泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在无线物联网边缘网络部署视觉-语言模型面临两大难题：大参数量导致带宽受限衰落信道上行传输时延高；Non-IID数据加剧客户端漂移。已有特征对齐方案引入额外计算，占用本用于无线传输的时隙，在系统时延约束下更易产生掉队者（straggler）。

Method: 1) 采用双PEFT架构降低传输与计算开销；2) 设计信道感知分层传输机制，依据信道状态自适应截断载荷以最大化节点存活率；3) 提出GCAM机制，在低维特征流形上动态消解多目标优化冲突，以极小的边缘计算时延抑制客户端漂移，减少计算引起的网络中断。

Result: 实验表明DPGR-GCAM提升跨域泛化性能，并在网络衰落场景、仅10%客户端参与率下仍保持收敛。

Conclusion: 通过参数高效微调与信道感知传输协同设计、并以低维流形上的梯度冲突调制替代高开销特征对齐，可在受限无线边缘环境中实现通信高效且鲁棒的联邦域泛化。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a distributed paradigm for Internet of Things (IoT) edge networks. However, deploying Vision-Language Models (VLMs) over wireless edge networks presents distinct challenges: large model parameters increase uplink transmission latency over bandwidth-constrained fading channels, and non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) data exacerbates client drift. Existing feature alignment solutions often introduce auxiliary computations that consume time slots allocated for wireless parameter transmission, increasing the likelihood of straggler dropouts under system delay constraints. To address these issues, we propose DPGR-GCAM, a communication-efficient federated domain generalization framework. By employing a dual-parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) architecture, we design a channel-aware tiered transmission mechanism that adaptively truncates payloads to maximize node survival rates under fading conditions. To mitigate client drift, we introduce the Gradient-Conflict Aware Modulation (GCAM) mechanism. GCAM operates within the low-dimensional feature manifold to dynamically resolve multi-objective optimization conflicts with minimal edge computation latency, thereby reducing computation-induced network outages. Experiments demonstrate that DPGR-GCAM improves cross-domain generalization and sustains convergence under network fading scenarios with a 10\% client participation rate.

</details>


### [986] [Is it RL or Data? A Controlled Comparison of GRPO and Rejection-Sampling Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25812)
*Lakshya Chaudhry*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在程序化计数任务上，用 Qwen3-4B-Base + LoRA 比较 GRPO 与拒绝采样微调（RFT），保持相同 prompt、验证器与 token 上限。GRPO 在所有 prompt 集上均优于 RFT：curated 集上高 10.9 分，匹配 rollout 预算后 easy/mixed 分别高 8.4、9.2 分；迭代式 RFT 仅恢复约 30% 的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bauer et al. (2026) 发现混合难度 prompt 下 GRPO 的样本效率可达仅 easy prompt 的 5 倍，但未检验该收益是否为 GRPO 特有，还是任何在同数据上做后训练的方法都能获得。本文旨在分离"方法效应"与"数据效应"。

Method: 复现其程序化计数任务，固定 Qwen3-4B-Base 与 LoRA。六个主实验臂 = 两方法（GRPO、RFT）× 三 prompt 集（Easy、Mixed、Curated——基座模型偶可解的子集，使 GRPO 的隐式筛选显式化），每臂 3 个随机种子。假设与否证条件预先注册。为避免基线调参不足，RFT 做 27 次超参搜索，GRPO 沿用 Bauer 等人原始配方。

Result: GRPO 在各 prompt 集均胜过 RFT：curated 上留出测试高 10.9 分；事后匹配 rollout 预算比较中，easy 与 mixed 分别高 8.4 与 9.2 分。测试集上该优势在截断补全的最不利处理下仍稳健；分布外则因截断无法下结论。Curated 对 RFT 无益（-2.7 分）。混合难度数据对 RFT 有益（+3.7 分），对 GRPO 证据不确定。次级迭代 RFT 臂（从当前策略重采样）缩小 10.9 分差距中的 3.2 分（约 30%）。

Conclusion: 在单一合成任务族、单一基座模型、每臂三种子的受控条件下，GRPO 相对 RFT 的优势不能完全由数据难度或调参解释，但迭代重采样可部分弥补差距；结论的外部有效性仍受限。

Abstract: Bauer et al. (2026) showed that in low-data reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, training GRPO on mixed-difficulty prompts gives up to 5x the sample efficiency of easy-only prompts. They did not test whether this benefit is specific to GRPO, or whether another post-training method given the same data would obtain it too. We test this on their procedural counting task with Qwen3-4B-Base and LoRA, comparing GRPO to rejection-sampling fine-tuning (RFT) on the same prompts, verifier and token cap. Six primary arms cross the two methods with three prompt sets (Easy, Mixed, and a Curated subset of prompts the base model sometimes solves, which makes GRPO's implicit filter explicit). We use three seeds per arm. Hypotheses and falsifiers were registered before training. To rule out a poorly tuned baseline, RFT receives a 27-run hyperparameter sweep, while GRPO uses Bauer et al.'s recipe unchanged. GRPO outperforms RFT at every prompt set: by 10.9 points on held-out test problems with curated prompts, and, in post hoc comparisons with matched rollout budgets, by 8.4 and 9.2 points on the easy and mixed prompts. On test the advantage survives the least favorable treatment of truncated completions; out of distribution, truncation prevents a conclusion. Curating prompts does not help RFT (-2.7 points). Mixed-difficulty data helps RFT (+3.7 points), while for GRPO the evidence is inconclusive. A secondary iterated-RFT arm, which resamples from the current policy, recovers 3.2 of the 10.9-point gap (about 30%). These are controlled measurements on one synthetic task family and one base model with three seeds per arm.

</details>


### [987] [SWIFT: Self-guided Weak-to-strong dIFfusion models via Target extrapolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25844)
*Yanjin He,Cuifeng Shen,Wanzhou Lei,Maohua Li,Tao Lan,Kan Liu,Hanlin Tang,Qing Qu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Swift 提出一种自引导训练方法，用一个冻结的弱去噪器对强模型训练的目标做外推，从而在不增加推理开销的前提下提升扩散模型质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量扩散模型训练与推理期引导的计算开销都很大；作者希望在不引入额外推理成本、也不增加无条件分支或标签丢弃机制的条件下，用弱模型引导强模型训练，实现 weak-to-strong 的提升。

Method: 对每个加噪输入，将干净回归目标从弱去噪器的预测处向外外推，放大仍欠拟合的成分；弱引导可为早期训练检查点，训练主模型时无需对其反推，训练后即丢弃。理论部分用 RKHS 中有限时间总体梯度流的谱分析解释该机制。

Result: 理论上证明：当弱引导为早停模型时，存在非空的外推强度区间，使后验均值误差严格低于匹配的标准训练。实验在 CIFAR-10 和 ImageNet-256 上跨模型规模与表示均有提升；某 ImageNet-256 配置下以约一半总训练算力（含引导准备与开销）达到优于基线最佳 FID；RAEv2 上无引导 FID 1.15、有引导 0.99。

Conclusion: 目标外推是一种有效的 weak-to-strong 扩散训练途径，保留原采样器、支持条件与无条件生成，且推理为单模型、无额外引导开销。

Abstract: Training high-quality diffusion models is computationally expensive, and inference-time guidance often adds further sampling cost. In this work, we introduce Swift, a simple yet effective self-guided training method that uses a frozen weak denoiser to improve a stronger model without adding inference overhead. For each noisy input, Swift extrapolates the clean regression target away from the weak denoiser's prediction, amplifying components that remain underfit. The weak guide can be an early training checkpoint, requires no backpropagation during main-model training, and is discarded afterward. The resulting model retains the original sampler and supports both conditional and unconditional generation without label dropout or an unconditional branch. We explain this mechanism through a spectral analysis of finite-time population gradient flow in an RKHS. With an early-stopped weak guide, we prove that a nonempty range of extrapolation strengths yields strictly lower posterior-mean error than matched standard training, despite shifting the regression target away from the posterior mean. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-256 demonstrate improvements across model scales and representations. In one ImageNet-256 configuration, Swift surpasses the baseline's best FID using roughly half the total training compute, including guide preparation and training overhead. On RAEv2, it achieves FID 1.15 without inference-time guidance and 0.99 with guidance. These results establish target extrapolation as an effective approach to weak-to-strong diffusion training with efficient single-model inference.

</details>


### [988] [ACE-Trader: Adversarial Co-Evolution for Generator-Critic Trading Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25847)
*Chang Zhou,Jiarun Zhou,Xingtong Yu,Hong Cheng,Hui Zhang,Xinming Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ACE-Trader对抗协同进化交易框架，用上下文相关的记忆选择器和协同进化机制让LLM交易员与红队Agent共同从经验中学习，在美股实验中优于22个主动基线，累计收益最高、夏普比率最高、最大回撤最低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有generator-critic交易系统中，LLM交易员与红队评估Agent虽能通过反馈改进单次决策，但无法保证两者随时间共同学习进化。核心难题有二：一是某一市场条件下有效的经验在另一条件下可能失效甚至有害；二是交易结果同时反映双方行为，难以分别为两个角色提炼合适经验。

Method: 1）为交易员与红队分别设计上下文相关的记忆选择器，学习为当前决策筛选有用经验；两者共享同一反馈信号——完整记忆辅助管线与无记忆管线的净收益差，并采用强调近期结果的在线更新。2）设计协同进化机制，通过共享交易记录将两角色的记忆关联：用这些记录对照真实市场结果评估红队的风险评估质量与交易员修订的效果，分别提炼经验写入各自记忆；再将经验与对应记录链接，使交易员能依据既往批评改进提案，红队能随交易员行为变化调整审查重点。

Result: 在美股交易实验中，ACE-Trader在累计收益上优于全部22个主动基线，并在主动方法与被动基准中均取得最高夏普比率与最低最大回撤。

Conclusion: 通过记忆选择与角色间协同进化，可将对抗式critic反馈转化为双方可持续的共同提升，验证了协同进化机制在LLM交易系统中的有效性。

Abstract: Generator--critic trading systems pair an LLM-based trader that makes trading decisions with a red team agent that evaluates these decisions and provides feedback for revision. However, improving individual trading decisions does not ensure that both agents learn from experience and improve together over time. This raises an important question: how can the trader and red-Team select useful experience and learn from each other's evolving behavior? On one hand, experience that benefits decisions under one market condition may become ineffective or harmful under another. On the other hand, trading outcomes reflect both agents' actions, making it difficult to derive appropriate experience for each role. In this work, we propose ACE-Trader, an adversarial co-evolution trading framework. Specifically, we first develop separate context-dependent memory selectors that learn to identify useful experience for the current trading decision. Both selectors receive shared feedback from net-return differences between complete memory-assisted and memory-free trading pipelines, with online updates emphasizing recent outcomes. We further design a co-evolution mechanism that links role-specific memories through shared trading records. We use these records to evaluate the Red-Team's risk assessments and the effects of the Trader's revisions against realized market outcomes, then derive experience for their respective memories. By linking this experience to the corresponding records, we enable the Trader to improve its proposals based on prior critiques and the Red-Team to adjust its review focus as the Trader's behavior changes. Experiments on U.S. stock trading show that ACE-Trader outperforms all 22 active baselines in cumulative return and achieves the highest Sharpe ratio and lowest maximum drawdown across both active methods and passive benchmarks.

</details>


### [989] [Rubrics Beyond Evaluation: Exploiting Rubric Structure in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25850)
*Yuxun Huang,Yunyao Zhang,ZeLiang Chen,Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen,Junqing Yu,Zikai Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Rubric-Structured Reinforcement Learning (RSRL)框架，显式挖掘评分标准(rubrics)中隐含的能力结构来指导强化学习训练，而非仅将其作为直接奖励信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Rubrics通过将整体质量拆解为显式准则被广泛用于开放式问答评估，这些准则蕴含丰富的学习指导信息。但现有方法仅将rubrics当作直接反馈信号，未对其准则背后的能力进行显式建模，导致其能力结构在训练中基本未被利用。

Method: RSRL包含三个核心设计：(1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring：先从rubric准则中恢复隐藏的能力结构；(2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning：利用该结构将欠发达能力自举为有效学习信号；(3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing：在优化过程中保留各能力特有的收益。

Result: 实验表明RSRL同时提升整体性能和欠发达能力，在下游科学问答任务上较初始策略最高提升7.43，较非rubric结构化RL基线提升7.60。

Conclusion: 强化学习能够显著受益于rubrics中编码的能力结构，将rubric由单纯奖励信号转化为贯穿训练全程的结构化指导具有实际价值。

Abstract: Rubrics are widely used to evaluate open-ended question answering by breaking overall quality into explicit criteria. These explicit criteria make rubrics a rich source of learning guidance, yet their potential for guiding the training process has been largely overlooked. Existing methods use rubrics mainly as direct feedback signals, without explicitly modeling the capabilities behind their criteria. This leaves their capability structure largely unused in guiding the training process. We introduce Rubric-Structured Reinforcement Learning (RSRL), an RL framework that unlocks the full potential of rubrics by exploiting their structure throughout the training process, rather than treating them simply as direct reward signals. At its core, RSRL builds on three key designs: (1) Rubric-to-Capability Structuring first recovers the capability structure hidden in rubric criteria, (2) Self-Sufficient Capability Learning then uses this structure to bootstrap underdeveloped capabilities into effective learning, (3) Capability-Residual Credit Routing finally preserves capability-specific gains during optimization. Experiments show that RSRL consistently improves both overall performance and underdeveloped capabilities, boosting downstream scientific question-answering performance by up to 7.43 over the initial policy and 7.60 over non-rubric structured RL baselines, showing that reinforcement learning can substantially benefit from the capability structure encoded in rubrics.

</details>


### [990] [Statistical Learning Theory for Direct Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25856)
*Joel Wills,Yuanfan Li,Yiming Ying,Ding-Xuan Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将DPO的失效分解为网络逼近、结构误设与有限样本估计三类误差，提出以偏好对数几率（log-odds）的triangle-curl刻画Bradley–Terry结构的可表示性，并给出上下界、ReLU显式逼近速率与有限样本界，同时以contextual preference accuracy (CPA)作为政策层评估量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DPO以Bradley–Terry模型为参数化假设，从成对偏好中通过logistic目标学习；但真实偏好未必满足该可加得分差（transitive/可积）结构。作者希望厘清该建模假设失败对DPO的独特限制，将“结构误设”与“模型容量不足”“有限样本估计误差”明确区分，从而说明单纯增大模型容量无法消除的固有限制来源。

Method: 1) 用偏好log-odds的triangle-curl（三角旋度）作为结构近似误差的度量，该量恰在偏好存在Bradley–Terry表示时为零；2) 将可实现超额logistic风险上界分解为得分类逼近项与triangle-curl项，并在附加有界性假设下给出与triangle-curl成比例的下界；3) 对ReLU得分模型（含clipped模型）推导显式逼近速率，说明容量增加可消去得分逼近项而结构障碍不变；4) 为clipped经验风险最小化器建立有限样本界，分离网络逼近、结构误设与估计误差；5) 在代理风险框架下引入contextual preference accuracy (CPA)，借助标准logistic一致性与校准结果将超额风险上界转移到CPA。

Result: 得到超额logistic风险的双项上界（得分类逼近 + triangle-curl）及与triangle-curl成比例的下界；对ReLU/clipped得分模型给出显式逼近速率，表明容量增长只能消除逼近项、无法消除结构障碍；给出clipped ERM的有限样本界，实现网络逼近、结构误设、估计误差三项分离；建立DPO目标与CPA之间的一致性/校准联系，并把超额风险上界传递至CPA。

Conclusion: DPO的性能上限受偏好本身是否可被Bradley–Terry表示这一结构性因素制约，该制约由triangle-curl定量刻画且不随模型容量增大而消失；CPA可作为偏好判断与相对参考政策的成对概率比变化之间一致性的自然代理度量，并可通过一致性/校准结果承接超额风险界，但作者明确指出CPA并非生成回复质量的完整度量。

Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) learns from pairwise preferences through a logistic objective whose score-difference parameterization follows the Bradley--Terry model. We study how failure of this modeling assumption limits DPO, distinguishing structural misspecification from limited model capacity and finite-sample estimation. Our main contribution is a characterization of structural approximation error through the triangle-curl of the preference log-odds, which vanishes exactly when preferences admit a Bradley--Terry representation. We upper bound the achievable excess logistic risk by a score-class approximation term and a triangle-curl term, and establish a lower bound proportional to triangle-curl under additional boundedness assumptions. For ReLU score models, including clipped models, we derive explicit approximation rates showing that increasing capacity can eliminate the score-approximation term while leaving the structural obstruction unchanged. We further establish finite-sample bounds for clipped empirical risk minimizers that separate network approximation, structural misspecification, and estimation error. We place these results within a surrogate-risk framework by identifying contextual preference accuracy (CPA) as a natural measure of agreement between preference judgments and changes in pairwise probability ratios relative to the reference policy. Standard logistic consistency and calibration results connect DPO's objective to this policy property and transfer our excess-risk upper bounds to CPA, without treating CPA as a complete measure of generated-response quality.

</details>


### [991] [Adaptive Decoding Methods for Token-Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25860)
*Zhaonan Li,Zelei Cheng,Amritansh Mishra,Chia-Hsuan Lee,Mann Patel,Sambit Sahu,Ben Zhou,William M. Campbell*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究RLVR中rollout解码的候选token支持集应固定还是随训练动态扩大，提出从top-K=10到K=20再到全支持的支持调度方案，在4B代码RLVR任务上以150M token插值验证分数衡量的采样效率优于固定K=10（平均+1.80±0.42），与最强的固定K=20基线相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: rollout解码同时决定RLVR使用哪些轨迹以及收集轨迹所消耗的completion token数量，因此候选token支持集的设定是采样效率的重要控制变量，但此前缺乏对"固定支持vs.训练中扩大支持"的系统研究。

Method: 设计随尝试token预算增长的支持调度：top-K=10 → K=20 → 全支持；在4B代码RLVR设置下与匹配的固定K=10延续进行对比（3次运行），并与固定K=20基线比较；辅以晚期扩至全支持的变体实验、混合奖励组诊断以及单次探索性测试重放（test replay）。

Result: 调度方案在全部3次运行中于150M token插值验证值上均高于匹配的固定K=10（平均增益1.80±0.42分），与扫描中最强的固定K=20基线表现相当；晚期扩至全支持似为最有前景的变体但证据仍有噪声；混合奖励组诊断未能清晰解释增益；探索性单次测试重放给出与固定K=10完全相同的点估计。

Conclusion: rollout支持集是RLVR采样效率的重要控制因素，自适应支持调度值得进一步研究；但当前证据强度有限，结论需更多重复实验支撑。

Abstract: Rollout decoding affects both which trajectories are used for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and how many completion tokens are spent collecting them. We study whether candidate-token support should remain fixed or widen during training in the context of rollout sampling efficiency. Our main schedule moves from top-K=10 to K=20 and then to full support as the attempted-token budget increases. In a 4B code-RLVR setting, the schedule has a higher interpolated 150M-token validation value than its matched fixed-K=10 continuation in all three runs, with a mean gain of $1.80{\pm}0.42$ points. The schedule also performs comparably to a separately trained fixed-K=20 baseline, the strongest fixed-support setting in our sweep. Follow-up experiments suggest that late widening to full support is the most promising variant, although the evidence remains noisy, and mixed-reward-group diagnostics do not clearly explain the gain. An exploratory single-run test replay yields identical point estimates for the schedule and fixed $K=10$. Overall, our results show that rollout support is an important control for sampling efficiency in RLVR and motivate further study of adaptive support schedules.

</details>


### [992] [Keep the Lineages Alive: Diversity-Preserving SMC for Diffusion LLM Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25932)
*Minoo Ahmadi,Seyedarmin Azizi,Mehdi Kamal,Massoud Pedram*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 lineage-preserving SMC（LP-SMC），用 Chopthin 重采样结合输入权重下限替代多项重采样，在掩码扩散语言模型的推理期搜索中保留更多样化的候选谱系，从而提升推理覆盖率和端到端准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理期 SMC 解码可在不训练的前提下提升扩散 LLM 的推理准确率，但其效果取决于重采样步骤：需在聚焦有希望候选与保留探索多样性之间取得平衡。多项重采样会复制高权重粒子、丢弃仍可能到达正确解的谱系，而 ESS 指标无法反映这种谱系损失（其被重置为最大值）。

Method: LP-SMC：以 Chopthin 重采样替代多项重采样，通过限制返回权重中最大与最小值之比而非将权重均等化，并将不等权重前向传递；同时引入输入权重下限，限制权重相对最大值可下降的幅度，使早期低权重谱系保留恢复机会。方法在内部奖励（解码器对已提交前缀的置信度）与外部奖励（过程奖励模型）两种设置下均适用。

Result: 在两个基础模型的数学推理与代码生成基准上，LP-SMC 在所有设置下将 oracle 覆盖率提升 1.8–25.6 个点；在统一奖励模型选择器下，于 12 个设置中的 11 个提升端到端准确率，LLaDA-1.5 最高 +7.9 点，Dream-7B 最高 +18.3 点。覆盖率增益在外部奖励模型下依然保持，表明多样性保留重采样与引导信号对推理期搜索有各自独立的贡献。

Conclusion: 多项重采样导致的谱系丢失是 SMC 解码的瓶颈之一，且 ESS 不能作为有效诊断指标。LP-SMC 通过 Chopthin 重采样与权重下限在保持探索多样性的同时维持候选聚焦，稳定提升覆盖率与准确率，说明保多样性重采样是推理期搜索的独立增益来源。

Abstract: Inference-time sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) decoding can improve the reasoning accuracy of masked diffusion language models (diffusion LLMs) without post-training by resampling a population of partial generations according to a reward. Its effectiveness therefore depends on the resampling step, which must concentrate computation on promising candidates while retaining enough diversity to explore alternative reasoning paths. The reward can be internal, the decoder's own confidence on the committed prefix, or external, a process reward model scoring that prefix. Under either reward, multinomial resampling can disrupt this balance by duplicating high-weight particles and discarding lineages that may still reach a correct solution. The effective sample size (ESS) does not register this loss: multinomial resampling resets it to its maximum even as distinct lineages disappear. To retain such lineages, we introduce lineage-preserving SMC (LP-SMC), which combines Chopthin resampling with an input weight floor. Instead of equalizing weights, Chopthin bounds the ratio between the largest and smallest weights it returns and carries the unequal weights forward. The floor limits how far below the maximum a weight may fall before resampling so that lineages with low early weight keep a chance to recover. Across mathematical-reasoning and code-generation benchmarks on two base models, LP-SMC raises oracle coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct particle, in every setting, by 1.8 to 25.6 points, and raises end-to-end accuracy under a common reward-model selector in eleven of twelve settings, by up to 7.9 points on LLaDA-1.5 and 18.3 on Dream-7B. The coverage gain persists under the external reward model, which suggests that diversity-preserving resampling and the guidance signal contribute separately to inference-time search.

</details>


### [993] [Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient MCI Conversion Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25873)
*Guanghua He,Hancan Zhu,Gaohang Yu,An Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出残差引导的自适应Tucker秩分配（RG-ATA），在固定适配器参数预算下联合选择输入/输出通道秩，实现3D医学影像网络的高效微调，MCI转化预测AUC达0.7706。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在预训练3D网络的参数高效微调（PEFT）中，如何在各卷积层间合理分配有限的可训练容量是核心难题；现有固定比例Tucker适配未考虑层间重要性差异。

Method: 1）保持空间卷积核模态不变，在一个固定预算下联合为每层选择输入、输出通道秩候选对；2）从下游数据学习任务特定的代理更新（proxy updates），用候选Tucker秩对近似之；3）通过扰动分析，用逐层重构残差界定代理网络与Tucker近似网络之间的输出偏差，从而以残差为基础进行分配；4）将每层平方残差按对应代理更新能量归一化，以比较层间相对近似误差；5）用动态规划在计入通道因子与Tucker核心的全局预算约束下最小化残差总和，得到在候选秩对集合上的全局最优分配。

Result: 在ADNI队列上以海马分割预训练模型预测MCI在36个月内转化为AD，五个随机种子下平均AUC为0.7706，优于固定比例Tucker适配（0.7239）与全参数微调（0.7430）；可训练参数约0.618M，仅占全模型1.45%。

Conclusion: 自适应Tucker秩分配为3D医学影像的参数高效迁移学习提供了有效途径，在极小参数预算下优于固定秩分配与全微调。

Abstract: Allocating limited trainable capacity across convolutional layers is a central challenge in parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of pretrained three-dimensional (3D) networks. We propose Residual-Guided Adaptive Tucker Rank Allocation, which jointly selects input- and output-channel ranks under a fixed adapter-parameter budget while preserving the spatial kernel modes. To guide rank selection, we learn task-specific proxy updates from downstream training data and approximate them using candidate Tucker rank pairs. A perturbation analysis bounds the output discrepancy between the fixed proxy network and its Tucker approximation in terms of layerwise reconstruction residuals, motivating residual-based allocation. We normalize each squared residual by the corresponding proxy-update energy to compare relative approximation errors across layers. Dynamic programming minimizes their sum under a global budget constraint that accounts for both channel factors and the Tucker core. This yields a globally optimal allocation over the specified candidate rank pairs. We evaluate the method on the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) cohort for predicting conversion from mild cognitive impairment to Alzheimer's disease within 36 months, using hippocampal segmentation pretraining. Across five random seeds, the proposed method achieves a mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.7706, compared with 0.7239 for fixed-ratio Tucker adaptation and 0.7430 for full fine-tuning. The total number of trainable parameters is limited to approximately 0.618 million, accounting for only 1.45% of the full model. Adaptive Tucker rank allocation thus provides an effective approach to parameter-efficient transfer learning in 3D medical imaging.

</details>


### [994] [DeltaTrace: Efficient Signed Attribution for Reasoning Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25877)
*Chen Liang,Daoping Wu,Donghua Yang,Zhiyu Liang,Ying Zhang,Shuguang Xiong,Hongzhi Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 DeltaTrace 归因框架，度量输入 token 对固定模型回复的影响，在忠实性指标与大海捞针召回上优于 FlashTrace。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究上下文中词语如何支持或反对语言模型回复，需要解释输入 token 对固定回复的作用。

Method: 以掩码被解释上下文 token 时回复对数概率的变化为度量；为有限变化构造算子特定的局部规则，并用有效割线斜率沿计算图反向复合；每个 token 的归因为其嵌入位移与反传斜率的內积；满足局部守恒性；支持注意力与线性注意力模型，辅助内存随序列长度线性增长。

Result: 在注意力模型上，多数检索与推理任务的删除忠实性分数（RISE、MAS）最低，needle-in-a-haystack Recall 最高，较 FlashTrace 高 5.67–24.33 个百分点；在混合注意力与线性注意力模型上，9 个任务的 RISE、12 个任务的 MAS 低于 FlashTrace。

Conclusion: DeltaTrace 提供守恒、可聚合的 token 级归因，兼具忠实性与计算可扩展性，适用于注意力及线性注意力架构。

Abstract: We study how words in the context support or oppose a language model's response and present DeltaTrace, a novel attribution framework that explains the effect of input tokens on a fixed model response. DeltaTrace measures how the response's log-probability changes when the context tokens being explained are masked. To distribute this difference among source tokens, it constructs operator-specific local rules for finite changes and composes them backward through the computational graph using effective secant slopes. Each token is assigned a signed attribution as the inner product of its embedding displacement and the corresponding backward-propagated slope. Local conservation makes these contributions sum to the measured score difference and preserves their meaning when aggregated over sentences or passages. DeltaTrace supports both attention and linear-attention models, with auxiliary memory growing linearly with sequence length at fixed model dimensions and chunk size. On the evaluated attention model, DeltaTrace achieves the lowest deletion-faithfulness scores (RISE and MAS) on most retrieval and reasoning tasks and the highest needle-in-a-haystack Recall, exceeding FlashTrace by 5.67-24.33 percentage points. On the evaluated hybrid attention and linear-attention model, DeltaTrace lowers RISE on 9 tasks and MAS on 12 relative to FlashTrace.

</details>


### [995] [Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25880)
*Xidong Wu,Qi Qi,Yuqiong Ji,Shangqian Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出异步在线自蒸馏框架 AsyncOPSD，通过解耦轨迹生成与学习更新，并引入陈旧度感知策略控制与 token 级熵加权，在数学推理任务上实现 1.96–2.25 倍训练吞吐提升且平均准确率上升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线自蒸馏（OPSD）虽只需单一模型同时充当教师与学生（教师以特权信息为条件），结构简单，但同步 rollout 生成占据总训练时间的主导地位，在扩展规模时形成严重系统瓶颈。

Method: 将 rollout 生成与学习者更新解耦以实现异步训练；由于师生共享参数，异步化天然消除 OPD 多模型协调开销；针对缓存轨迹随策略演化而陈旧的问题，设计基于陈旧度感知策略控制（staleness-aware policy control）与 token 级熵加权的蒸馏目标。

Result: 在三种模型规模与数学推理基准上，训练吞吐相比同步 OPSD 提升 1.96–2.25 倍，同时平均基准准确率有所提高。

Conclusion: AsyncOPSD 证明异步化是缓解 OPSD 系统瓶颈的有效途径，且通过陈旧度与熵加权设计可避免性能退化，实现效率与效果双赢。

Abstract: Unlike on-policy distillation (OPD), which depends on a separate teacher model, on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) leverages a single language model acting simultaneously as the student and the teacher, with the teacher conditioned on privileged information. Despite this architectural simplicity, synchronous rollout generation dominates overall training time, creating a severe systems bottleneck when scaling OPSD. To address this, we introduce Asynchronous On-Policy Self-Distillation (AsyncOPSD), a framework that decouples rollout generation from learner updates to improve training throughput. Since the teacher and student share parameters, AsyncOPSD eliminates the multi-model coordination overhead inherent to OPD architectures in asynchronous training. As the student policy evolves, buffered trajectories generated by older policies become stale, potentially degrading performance. To mitigate this, we introduce a distillation objective based on staleness-aware policy control and token-level entropy weighting. Across three model sizes and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AsyncOPSD improves the training throughput by $1.96$--$2.25\times$ over synchronous OPSD while increasing average benchmark accuracy.

</details>


### [996] [Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25973)
*Suwan Yoon,Seongryong Jung,Changhee Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出非对称策略优化APSD：按rollout正确性混合学生与自教师分布——正确样本插值以保留成功行为，错误样本外推以加强纠正；并从散度分解、reverse-KL重心几何与梯度分析论证目标需依赖学生；在RLVR与丰富反馈任务上优于RL及自蒸馏基线，在Qwen3各规模上平均以2.6倍更少训练步数达到SDPO性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自蒸馏策略优化通过反馈条件下的自教师提供稠密token级监督，但直接匹配自教师分布存在两难：在正确rollout上会破坏已有的成功行为，在错误rollout上纠正力度又不足。

Method: 提出APSD，依据rollout正确性构造依赖正确性的目标分布：正确样本采用学生与自教师分布的插值（interpolation），错误样本采用超出自教师的外推（extrapolation）；理论分析包括散度分解、reverse-KL重心几何与梯度分析，强调梯度需流经学生相关目标。

Result: 在RLVR与丰富反馈两类实验设置下，APSD整体性能优于强化学习与自蒸馏基线；在Qwen3不同模型规模上平均以约2.6倍更少的训练步数达到SDPO的性能水平。

Conclusion: 正确性依赖的非对称蒸馏目标是关键：保留成功行为与加强错误纠正需分别处理，且学生相关目标上的梯度流不可或缺；APSD在性能与训练效率上均具优势。

Abstract: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.

</details>


### [997] [Out-of-Distribution Detection in Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25901)
*Nimeshika Udayangani,Flora D. Salim,Christopher Leckie,Sarah Erfani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出无回放的持续学习OOD检测框架TA-KAN：借助Kolmogorov-Arnold Network的局部神经可塑性缓解灾难性遗忘，用任务自适应分类器与几何引导OOD分数实现SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OOD-CL需同时满足无灾难性遗忘与在无法访问过去ID数据条件下识别未知样本，而现有方法依赖回放缓冲区或封闭世界假设，且基于置信度的OOD分数在无历史ID数据时退化，扩展性与可靠性受限。

Method: 以Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks为骨干，利用其固有的局部神经可塑性缓解遗忘；提出任务自适应分类器TA-KAN，通过任务级激活局部性控制缓解近因偏差、提升ID–OOD可分性；并提出不依赖历史ID数据的几何引导OOD分数，与TA-KAN置信度互补。

Result: 在保持较强ID分类性能的同时显著提升OOD检测效果，于OOD-CL benchmarks上取得state-of-the-art结果。

Conclusion: 无回放的KAN架构结合任务自适应局部性控制与几何引导评分，可有效解决OOD-CL中遗忘与无历史ID数据检测的双重难题，为可扩展、可靠的持续OOD检测提供新范式。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution detection in continual learning (OOD-CL) is highly challenging, as it requires (i) learning a sequence of tasks without catastrophic forgetting, and (ii) identifying unknown samples (OOD) without access to known (in-distribution (ID)) data from past tasks, where standard confidence-based OOD scores tend to degrade. Existing methods largely rely on a rehearsal buffer of past data or assume closed-world settings, limiting their scalability and reliability in real-world scenarios. In this paper, we propose a novel OOD detection framework for rehearsal-free continual learning, inspired by Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN), which mitigate catastrophic forgetting via their inherent local neuroplasticity. To better leverage KAN in OOD-CL, we introduce a task-adaptive classifier architecture, TA-KAN, which mitigates recency bias and enhances ID--OOD separability through task-specific control of activation locality. Furthermore, we propose a geometry-guided OOD score that complements TA-KAN classifier confidence without relying on past ID data. Our method significantly improves OOD detection while maintaining strong ID classification performance, achieving state-of-the-art results in OOD-CL.

</details>


### [998] [An Analysis of Semantic and Spatio-Temporal Co-evolution for Edge Classification on Dynamic Text-Attributed Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25906)
*Tyler Bonnet,Marek Rei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出文本-图协同演化框架，用轻量Transformer适配器结合对比预训练与语言模型保持目标，动态更新token级文本表示，在动态文本属性图边分类任务上优于冻结文本基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本属性Web图（评论网络、社区论坛、新闻知识图谱）的边分类需要高质量、自适应且随网络演化的语义表示。现有动态图方法用预训练语言模型初始化文本特征后在训练中冻结以保语义结构，因而放弃了文本表示与网络拓扑共同演化的潜在收益。

Method: 统一的文本-图对齐框架：轻量Transformer适配器通过对比预训练目标的时空梯度更新token级文本表示；引入语言模型保持目标（LM maintenance objective）将演化中的文本嵌入锚定于原始语义结构，防止语义失真。

Result: 在Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark多领域Web任务上，锚定式协同演化持续优于冻结文本基线的边分类性能；表示分析显示该方法降低各向异性、提升文本嵌入线性可分性，并将结构与时间信息编码进语义空间；计算效率分析表明该协同演化不以端到端联合训练的过高开销为代价。

Conclusion: 文本表示与图拓扑的锚定式协同演化可在可控计算成本下提升动态文本属性图的边分类与表示质量，是冻结文本策略的有效替代。

Abstract: Dynamic edge classification on text-attributed Web graphs, such as review networks, community forums, and news-derived knowledge graphs, requires high quality, adaptive semantic representations in the context of network evolution. Existing dynamic graph architectures typically initialize text feature vectors with pretrained language models and hold them static during training to preserve their semantic structure, forgoing the potential benefits of allowing them to co-evolve with network topology. In this work, we investigate the effects of enabling such co-evolution with a unified text-graph alignment framework that integrates a lightweight Transformer adapter to update token-level text representations via spatio-temporal gradients from a contrastive pretraining objective. To prevent detrimental semantic distortion, a language model maintenance objective anchors the evolving text embeddings to their original semantic structure. Evaluations on the Dynamic Text-Attributed Graph Benchmark demonstrate that this anchored text-graph co-evolution consistently improves upon the edge classification performance of frozen-text baselines across diverse Web-related domains. Representational analyses reveal that the framework reduces anisotropy, improving the linear separability of text embeddings, and effectively encodes structural and temporal information into the semantic space. A computational efficiency analysis confirms that this beneficial semantic and spatio-temporal co-evolution is achieved without incurring the prohibitive computational overhead typical of end-to-end joint training.

</details>


### [999] [Maestro: Agentic Formal Proof Development by Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25920)
*Haoyu Li,Zeren Shui,Yuhao Zhang,Ferhat Erata,Benjamin Mikek,Murali Krishna Ramanathan,Hao Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Maestro：通过全局协调处理证明失败信息的 Lean 证明与代码合成验证框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Lean 形式化证明对 LLM 智能体仍很困难。现有证明器采用分治策略递归分解证明义务，但引理无法证明的原因多样（引导不足、命题为假、分解本身有缺陷），系统无法区分；失败尝试仅报告"失败"而无更多信息，且响应局限于失败节点，不考虑整体证明或修改上层计划，导致沿错误方向持续分解直至预算耗尽、整体失败。

Method: 提出 Maestro —— 一个具备全局协调能力的 Lean 证明器 harness。证明器不仅报告失败，还报告失败原因；协调器掌握整个证明全局状态，据此选择恰当响应：引导卡住的证明器、修正错误的引理、撤回有缺陷的子树并重新规划。该框架同样可扩展至经验证的代码合成：经检验的反例可将代码退回修复。

Result: 在 7 个数学与 3 个软件验证基准上，使用四个前沿 LLM 评估。在原生编码智能体（Claude Code 或 Codex）尚未饱和的每个基准上均证明更多目标，研究级数学增益最大。Claude Opus 5 配合 Maestro 在 2026 年 6 月 arXivLean 的 48 个定理中自主证明 34 个，原生智能体为 19 个。在共享基准上超越所有已发表证明系统：PutnamBench 669/672、Lean-IMO-Bench 59/60、IMO 2026 6/6。

Conclusion: 失败信息的结构化报告与全局协调机制能有效避免在错误证明方向上的无效分解，显著提升 Lean 形式化证明与研究级数学自动证明能力，并可推广至经验证的代码合成任务。

Abstract: Lean is increasingly used to verify mathematical proofs and software produced by LLM agents, but writing formal proofs remains hard. Existing prover systems take a divide-and-conquer approach that recursively decomposes hard proof obligations into easier lemmas and splits again any lemma that resists proof. However, a lemma can resist proof for different reasons, including insufficient guidance, a false statement, or a flaw in the decomposition that produced it. Existing systems cannot tell these apart as a failed attempt reports little beyond its failure, and responses are confined to the failing node without considering the rest of the proof or revising the plan above it. The system may thus keep decomposing obligations along a flawed proof direction until the budget runs out, causing the whole proof attempt to fail. We introduce Maestro, a Lean prover harness that handles failures through global coordination. Provers report why they failed, not just that they failed, and a coordinator that sees the whole proof chooses an appropriate response, such as guiding a stuck prover, correcting a false lemma, or retracting a flawed subtree and replanning it. The same harness extends to verified code synthesis, where a checked counterexample sends the code back for repair. We evaluate Maestro with four frontier LLMs on seven mathematics and three software verification benchmarks. It proves more targets than each model's native coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) on every benchmark the agent has not already saturated, with the largest gains on research-level mathematics. With Claude Opus 5, it discovers its own proofs of 34 of the 48 theorems in the June 2026 release of arXivLean, against 19 for the native agent. It also outperforms all published prover systems on every benchmark they share, solving 669/672 PutnamBench, 59/60 Lean-IMO-Bench, and 6/6 IMO 2026.

</details>


### [1000] [UtilityBench: Measuring Language Model Utility When Errors Have Different Costs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25924)
*Qifeng Lei,Zhiyong Yang,Zitai Wang,Shilong Bao,Linchao Zhang,Qianqian Xu,Qingming Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出以“错误后果严重程度”为核心的效用评估范式，构建含15,000条可验证样本的UtilityBench，用Best-Worst Scaling量化错误代价，并引入UtilityAUC指标，揭示当前先进模型在“负责任决策”上与解题能力存在差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实部署中语言模型的错误后果差异巨大（如医疗场景单次错误可能危及患者安全），而主流评估协议将所有错误等同看待，忽略真实世界代价谱系，导致评估与风险不匹配。

Method: 提出基于效用的评估范式，显式建模错误后果差异：(1) 构建UtilityBench，15,000条具可验证答案的实例；(2) 采用Best-Worst Scaling收集标注，数据驱动地估计错误严重性（效用）；(3) 用这些量化效用决定模型应作答还是弃答，使决策与实际重要性对齐；(4) 提出UtilityAUC——按模型响应排序计算效用曲线下面积，度量效用偏好对齐而非仅错误频率；并给出理论分析。

Result: 理论上证明UtilityAUC可区分标准准确率与AURC无法区分的模型；实证评估20个SOTA模型，发现更高准确率或更先进架构并不必然带来更高UtilityAUC。

Conclusion: 模型“解决问题的能力”与“负责任的决策能力”之间存在显著鸿沟；评估应从单一正确性转向效用/代价敏感的范式，以更好反映真实部署风险。

Abstract: As language models are increasingly deployed in real-world scenarios with important outcomes, the impact of their mistakes often extends far beyond what correctness can capture. In domains like medicine, a single error can lead to serious consequences and put patient safety at risk. However, mainstream evaluation protocols still treat all errors as equal, overlooking the spectrum of real-world costs. To address this, we propose a utility-based evaluation paradigm that explicitly incorporates the varying consequences of errors. Guided by this principle, we develop UtilityBench, a large-scale benchmark of 15,000 instances with verifiable answers, quantifying error severity using Best-Worst Scaling to elicit meaningful, data-driven cost estimates. These quantified utilities shape when a model should answer or abstain, guiding it to make decisions that align with the true importance of each scenario. As another merit, we introduce UtilityAUC, a metric that measures the area under the utility curve determined by a model's response ordering, thereby enabling utility preference alignment beyond error frequency. Our theoretical analysis demonstrates that UtilityAUC can distinguish between models where standard accuracy and AURC fall short. Empirically, evaluating 20 state-of-the-art models, we find that greater accuracy or more advanced architectures do not reliably translate to higher UtilityAUC, highlighting a gap between problem-solving ability and responsible decision-making in language model evaluation.

</details>


### [1001] [Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26325)
*Abdul Rahman Iqbal,Muhammad Fawad Nasim,Amir Saleem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文检验Jev等类型化决策模型(TDMs)相比自身骨干模型是否有增益，以及在患病率(标签)漂移下其校准与阈值是否比微调分类器更脆弱。结论：决策训练并非普遍有益，TDMs在漂移下也不具独特脆弱性，其主要校准弱点是原本就存在的未校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 厂商称Jev等TDMs是"校准的"，但部署时类频率会变化，固定测试集上测得的校准在阈值应用处未必成立。现有评估存在两个空白：(1) 供应商式决策训练相对同一读出下的骨干模型的增益未被分离；(2) TDMs仅在测试集类别分布下被测过。

Method: 在五个公开数据集上、模拟漂移条件下，对相同决策比较三个TDMs(Jev、Tev1-4B、Nimble-9B)、其基座模型和两个已训练分类器；预先固定35个配对检验；并评估以模型在开发集平均预测为先验的EM先验校正(无需标签)。

Result: (1)决策训练非普遍有益：Nimble-9B(仅比Qwen3.5-9B多一个LoRA适配器)在意图任务上校准更好，但在金融情感上Macro-F1低12.0个点。(2)中度漂移下，Jev的ECE与阈值风险仅金融情感上显著高于微调的DeBERTa，分别高1.7与2.5个百分点；2000个漂移场景(探索性)平均，各数据集差距≤1个点。(3)EM先验校正(Jev均值开发预测作先验，无需标签)在ECE最高的两个数据集上将漂移下ECE降低2.7与1.8个点，但有标签重校准降幅更大。

Conclusion: 所测三个TDMs既非一致优于其骨干模型，也非在漂移下独特脆弱；就校准而言，其主要弱点是本身在无漂移时就已存在的未校准。全部输入、代码与输出已公开。

Abstract: Typed decision models (TDMs) return a probability over caller-defined options, and Jev is described by its vendor as calibrated. But in deployment class frequencies change, so calibration measured on a fixed test set need not hold where thresholds are applied. Existing evaluations leave two gaps: the gains of vendor decision training have not been separated from those of the backbone under an identical readout, and TDMs have been tested only at the test set's class distribution. We ask whether decision training improves a model over its own backbone, and whether a TDM's calibration and thresholds withstand prevalence (label) shift as well as a fine-tuned classifier's. We compare three TDMs (Jev, Tev1-4B, Nimble-9B), their base models and two trained classifiers on identical decisions from five public datasets under simulated shift, with 35 paired tests fixed before any test was computed. First, decision training is not uniformly beneficial: Nimble-9B, which differs from Qwen3.5-9B only by a LoRA adapter, is better calibrated on intent tasks but 12.0 Macro-F1 points worse on financial sentiment. Second, under moderate shift Jev's expected calibration error (ECE) and threshold risk grow significantly more than a fine-tuned DeBERTa's only on financial sentiment, by 1.7 and 2.5 percentage points; averaged over 2,000 shift scenarios (exploratory), the gap is at most one point on every dataset. Third, EM prior correction with the model's mean development prediction as its prior needs no labels and lowers Jev's ECE under shift by 2.7 and 1.8 points on the two datasets where it is highest, although labelled recalibration lowers it far more. The three TDMs we tested are neither uniformly better than their backbones nor uniquely fragile under shift; for calibration, their main weakness is the miscalibration they already have without shift. We release all inputs, code and outputs.

</details>


### [1002] [The KV-Surgeon: Compensation-Aware Offline KV-Cache Compaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25933)
*Moritz Wagner,Christophe Roux,Max Zimmer,Sebastian Pokutta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KV-Surgeon 通过二次代理模型显式建模 softmax 重归一化带来的条目间耦合，联合求解最优贪心删除与剩余条目补偿，在多个长上下文基准上显著推进 KV-cache 压缩的成本–精度帕累托前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线 KV-cache 压缩的核心是决定删除与保留哪些缓存条目。现有方法独立地为每个候选条目打分，并假设其余缓存固定不变；但注意力中的 softmax 重归一化会非线性地耦合这些决策——删除一个条目会改变所有剩余条目的注意力权重，因此逐条独立打分无法反映真实的联合效应。

Method: 提出 KV-Surgeon：利用校准数据以可计算的方式纳入条目间交互。推导出一个二次型代理目标，该目标具有闭式解，从而能够联合确定最优的贪心删除决策，并对保留下来的条目进行补偿。另给出一个计算更快的变体。

Result: 在 QuALITY、LongHealth 和 Long Code Arena 上，于所有评估的压缩比下，KV-Surgeon 在 4B 至 30B 参数的稠密模型与 MoE 模型上大幅推进成本–精度帕累托前沿。在 50× 压缩下，问答准确率较 SOTA 的 attention matching（Zweiger et al., 2026）最高提升 4 个点，成本相当；快速变体在仅为该 SOTA 五分之二成本的情况下仍超越之。

Conclusion: 将 KV-cache 压缩视为考虑注意力重归一化耦合的联合优化问题，并用可解析求解的二次代理近似，是一种有效且高效的范式；KV-Surgeon 在精度–成本权衡上优于逐条目独立打分的方法。

Abstract: Offline compaction of the key--value cache (KV-cache) reduces the cost of repeatedly querying a fixed context by constructing a smaller cache once and reusing it subsequently. The central challenge of compaction is deciding which cache entries to delete and which to retain. Existing methods score each candidate for deletion on its own, with the rest of the cache being held fixed. However, softmax renormalization of the attention operation couples these decisions in a nonlinear manner: removing one entry changes the attention weights of every remaining one. In this work, we introduce KV-Surgeon, which uses calibration data to take interactions into account in a tractable way. We derive a quadratic surrogate that admits closed-form expressions for jointly making the optimal greedy removal decision as well as compensation within the remaining entries. On QuALITY, LongHealth, and Long Code Arena, and at every evaluated compaction ratio, KV-Surgeon substantially advances the cost--accuracy Pareto frontier of dense and mixture-of-experts models from 4B to 30B parameters. At $50\times$ compaction, KV-Surgeon improves question-answering accuracy by up to four points over attention matching (Zweiger et al., 2026), the state of the art, at comparable cost. Lastly, we introduce an even faster variant, which also exceeds the state of the art while requiring only two fifths of its cost.

</details>


### [1003] [An Empirical Study of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Mixture-of-Experts LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26370)
*Minglei Li,Peng Ye,Haonan He,Jingqi Ye,Qingyu Yang,Tao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了在MoE架构上应用PEFT的设计配方，涵盖适配模块选择、适配粒度、PEFT方法选择与负载均衡目标强度，发现仅适配MoE专家、原生专家权重更新、LoRA/DoRA组合最优，且非零负载均衡系数无帕累托优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE架构因大规模参数下高效推理而日益普及，但缺乏将PEFT应用于MoE模型的系统性配方，存在关键研究空白。

Method: 在三个MoE主干模型上，针对下游任务与通用知识任务开展大规模系统实验，考察四个设计维度：适配哪些模块、以何种粒度适配MoE模块、选用何种PEFT方法、负载均衡目标的权重强度；并对MoE$^2$-LoRA进行权重级重新设计并在Qwen3上评估。

Result: 在可比参数预算下仅适配MoE专家取得最高下游性能且通用能力保持具竞争力；原生专家权重更新优于绕过专家或整个MoE模块的适配器；LoRA与DoRA共同构成高下游精度的最强工作区间；无任何非零负载均衡系数帕累托优于零基线。将MoE$^2$-LoRA的模块级旁路池移入原生专家权重后，四项上游指标提升2.4至17.9点，可训练参数减少17%，下游平均代价3.2点。

Conclusion: 该研究为MoE模型的PEFT应用提供了系统性设计指导，并验证了权重级重新设计的有效性。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are critical for adapting large models under resource-constrained settings. However, as mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures, which offer efficient inference at massive parameter scales, gain increasing prevalence in the community, a critical gap arising from the lack of systematic recipes for applying PEFT to MoE models. To narrow this gap, we conduct a large-scale systematic study that investigates a set of essential design recipes, including which modules should be adapted, which granularity should be used to adapt MoE modules, which PEFT method to use, and to what extent should the load-balancing objective be used, across three MoE backbones on downstream tasks and general knowledge tasks. Our experiments yield several key insights. First, adapting MoE experts alone achieves the highest downstream performance with competitive general capability retention under a comparable parameter budget. Second, native expert-weight updates offer a better downstream--retention trade-off than adapters that bypass experts or entire MoE modules. Third, LoRA and DoRA together define the strongest operating region for high downstream accuracy among the evaluated PEFT methods. Fourth, no nonzero load-balancing coefficient Pareto-dominates the zero baseline. We finally evaluate a weight-level redesign of MoE$^2$-LoRA on Qwen3. Moving its module-level bypass pool into native expert weights improves all four upstream endpoints by 2.4 to 17.9 points with 17% fewer trainable parameters and a 3.2-point average downstream cost.

</details>


### [1004] [Graph-to-Table Interfaces Control Relational Generalisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.25993)
*Alessandro Cagiano,Lorenzo Molfetta,Gianluca Moro,Matteo Zignani,Pasquale Minervini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文通过“匹配比较”协议（固定其余管线与评测、只改一个组件）系统检验图到表系统中编码器、上下文构造器与表格解码器能否独立评估，结论是不能：组件结论依赖于其他组件与评测/聚合协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图到表（graph-to-table）系统由编码器（把关系证据映射为特征行）、上下文构造器（选择带标签示例）与表格解码器三部分组成。已有工作报告的组件优劣往往缺乏受控对比，作者希望检验这些组件能否通过“改变一个组件、其余保持不变”的匹配比较被独立评估，即组件结论是否具有可迁移性。

Method: 采用匹配比较/受控消融范式：每次只改变一个组件，保持管线其余部分与评测协议不变。实验覆盖三种解码器（逻辑回归、CATBOOST、TABPFN-3）、三个数据域（CLUTRR、57 个 GraphLog 世界、57 个知识图谱）；对比绝对位置编码与关系计数特征、不同树深、局部特征与冻结 ULTRA 分数的组合方向，以及 pointwise TABPFN-3 读出与原生 ULTRA 的对比，并考察评测与聚合协议的影响。

Result: 1) CLUTRR 上绝对位置编码可保持所有被评测查询间的区分度并近乎完美拟合短路径设定，但因支持前缀构成捷径、在长路径失效，泛化反而不如关系计数特征。2) GraphLog 上编码器偏好依赖解码器；关系计数表示随 CatBoost 树深增加而退化。3) 跨知识图谱：在局部特征上加入冻结 ULTRA 分数稳定有益，反向加入局部特征效果更小且不稳定。4) 使用完整编码器的 pointwise TABPFN-3 读出在 57 个数据集中的 48 个上劣于原生 ULTRA。

Conclusion: 编码器评估同时依赖上下文构造与解码器，组件优劣不存在无条件结论；panel 层面的结论还可能受评测与聚合协议影响。因此图到表系统应采用联合、受控的匹配比较报告结果，谨慎解读单一组件的独立排名。

Abstract: Graph-to-table systems combine three design choices: an encoder that maps relational evidence to feature rows, a context constructor that selects labelled examples, and a tabular decoder. We investigate whether these components can be evaluated independently through matched comparisons that change one component while holding the rest of the pipeline and the evaluation constant. Across logistic regression, CATBOOST, and TABPFN-3 on CLUTRR, 57 GraphLog worlds, and 57 knowledge graphs, we show that conclusions about one component can change when the others change. On CLUTRR, absolute positional encodings maintain all distinctions among the evaluated queries and fit the short-path setting nearly perfectly; yet, they generalise worse than relation-count features because the supported prefix acts as a shortcut that breaks down on longer paths. On GraphLog, encoder preference depends on the decoder, while the relation-count representation degrades as CatBoost tree depth increases. Across different knowledge graphs, adding the frozen ULTRA score to local features is consistently useful, whereas adding local features to the score has a smaller and less stable effect. A pointwise TABPFN-3 readout using the full encoder underperforms native ULTRA on 48 of 57 datasets. These results show that encoder assessment depends jointly on context and decoder, while panel-level conclusions can also depend on evaluation and aggregation protocols.

</details>


### [1005] [Strength Controls Change How Interventions Compare Across Sparse Autoencoder Codes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26489)
*Jinchen Zhang,Zheyuan Liu,Yihan Zhu,Meng Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文研究稀疏自编码器（SAE）编码干预的“强度控制”问题：比较不同强度匹配方式（总范数匹配 vs. 输出KL标定）下，不同编码对干预效应的差异是否仍然存在。实验在 Gemma 与 Llama 上以固定特征组进行，发现整向量缩放下全输出KL标定的效应差距小于总范数匹配，位置缩放与答案排除情形下结论不同，且标定可诊断残余不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 改变 SAE 编码会同时改变干预的方向与幅度，因此比较干预效应必须先规定何者被“held equal”，即需要强度控制。已有总范数匹配与输出标定两种控制方式，但在强度匹配后不同编码是否仍产生不同效应尚不清楚，本文旨在澄清这一问题。

Method: 在 Gemma 与 Llama 上对固定特征组比较多种干预设置下的效应：整向量缩放（每输入单一系数）下对比全输出 KL 标定与总范数匹配（针对 NNLS 重拟合）；位置缩放（positionwise）下对比位置级范数匹配与全输出标定；并考察答案排除（answer exclusion）设置，以测得的效应差距为指标。

Result: (1) 整向量缩放下，全输出 KL 标定相对基于编码器的参考干预平均效应差距小于总范数匹配；在新 Llama 输入上，总范数匹配丢失 11 项参考迁移，而全输出标定保留了全部迁移判定。(2) 位置缩放下，在小规模匹配的性别一致子集上，位置级范数匹配的观测平均差距小于全输出标定。(3) 答案排除标定相比未缩放 NNLS，在主谓一致比较中缩小差距，但在性别重拟合中扩大差距；对范数匹配的构造候选，全输出 KL 标定也缩小较大差距，但若干设置下匹配覆盖率不完整。

Conclusion: 强度控制方式的选择显著影响跨编码干预效应的比较结论，不存在普遍最优的控制；由于标定依赖被评估输入的输出，它更适合作为残余不一致的诊断工具而非统一的强度基准。

Abstract: Changing sparse autoencoder (SAE) codes can alter both intervention direction and magnitude, so comparing intervention effects requires a strength control specifying what is held equal. Norm matching and output calibration provide different controls, but whether interventions yield different effects across codes after strength matching remains unclear. We compare intervention effects under these controls for fixed feature groups in Gemma and Llama and observe: (1) Whole-patch scaling. With one coefficient per input, full-output Kullback-Leibler (KL) calibration leaves smaller mean effect gaps from the encoder-based reference intervention than total-norm matching for nonnegative least-squares (NNLS) refits. On new Llama inputs, total-norm matching loses 11 reference transfers, whereas full-output calibration preserves every transfer decision. (2) Positionwise scaling. On a small matched gender-agreement subset, positionwise norm matching leaves smaller observed mean gaps than full-output calibration. (3) Answer exclusion. Compared with unscaled NNLS, answer-excluded calibration reduces gaps in the measured subject-verb agreement comparisons but increases them for gender refits. Full-output KL calibration also reduces larger gaps for norm-matched constructed candidates, although matching coverage is incomplete in several settings. Since calibration uses the evaluated input's outputs, it serves as a diagnostic of residual disagreement.

</details>


### [1006] [PnP-CF: A Consensus Flow-Matching Solver for General Inverse Problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26000)
*Dibyanshu Kumar,Magda Gregorova*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文重新审视并扩展了基于连续时间深度生成模型的即插即用（PnP）框架 PnP-CF（Consensus Flow），将其应用于包括神经网络前向算子的非线性逆问题，通过 ADMM 式对偶变量更新与时间自适应的流概率路径回拉机制促进求解器与采样器之间的共识，从而稳定算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PnP 方法借助连续时间深度生成模型作为学习到的数据分布先验，可高质量求解基于模型的反问题。但解的质量严重依赖逆问题求解器与生成模型采样器之间的交互与共识，且现有方法在非线性逆问题（尤其学习型神经网络前向算子）上表现不佳或完全失效。

Method: PnP-CF 将 flow-matching 去噪器与两项机制结合：(i) ADMM 式对偶变量更新；(ii) 时间自适应的回拉（pullback）到中间流概率路径，该回拉由随机分量与确定性分量共同构成。文中分析这两项特性如何稳定算法并促进共识。

Result: 在一系列实验中，PnP-CF 在标准线性逆问题上达到至少与最先进基线相当的质量；在非线性逆问题（包括由预训练神经网络实现的前向算子）上也表现出良好扩展性，而现有方法在此类问题上结果不理想或完全失败。

Conclusion: PnP-CF 是一种有效且可扩展的流式 PnP 框架，其 ADMM 式对偶更新与时间自适应回拉机制能够稳定优化并促进求解器与生成先验的共识，使其在线性与非线性逆问题中均具竞争力。

Abstract: Plug-and-Play (PnP) methods using continuous-time deep generative models as learned data distribution priors enable synthesizing high-quality solutions of model-based inverse problems. The quality of the solutions depends critically on the interplay and consensus between the inverse problem solver and the generative model sampler. We revisit a recently introduced flow-based PnP framework, which we refer to as PnP-CF (Consensus Flow), and extend its application to nonlinear inverse problems, including those with learned neural-network forward operators. PnP-CF combines a flow-matching denoiser with (i) ADMM-like dual variable updates and (ii) a time-adaptive pullback onto the intermediate flow probability path that combines a stochastic and a deterministic component. We discuss how these two features stabilize the algorithm and promote consensus, and demonstrate on a set of experiments that PnP-CF not only solves standard linear inverse problems with quality at least comparable to state-of-the-art baselines, but also extends gracefully to nonlinear inverse problems, including forward operators realized by pretrained neural networks, for which existing methods produce unsatisfactory results or fail completely.

</details>


### [1007] [Scenario Generalization and Sector Transfer in Real Surface Irrigation Surrogate Modelling with Tabular Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26005)
*Alessandro Cagiano,M. Aybars Seyhan,Fabiola Gangi,Matteo Zignani,Daniele Masseroni*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究表格代理模型替代高保真浅水方程模拟，预测灌区最大水深；同扇区情形表现良好，跨扇区迁移仍具挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地表灌溉规划需评估大量运行条件与空间配置，而高保真浅水方程（SWE）模拟代价高昂，需要廉价代理模型进行快速筛选。

Method: 构建以空间网格单元为样本行的表格代理模型，输入包括无人机获取的田块形态、地形、水文、空间及情景描述符，输出最大水深；对比梯度提升树、神经表格模型、AutoML 与表格基础模型（TFM），并设置两套评估范式：同扇区泛化（观测有限配置后预测同扇区未行情景）与跨扇区迁移（源扇区知识迁移至未见扇区）。

Result: 在固定的 8/32 同扇区划分下，代理模型性能较强，引入原始空间坐标尤为有效；跨扇区迁移显著更难，因目标扇区坐标与几何形状不同。扇区坐标系归一化可改善结构相似扇区间的迁移，但无法解决跨形状泛化。

Conclusion: 在所采用的固定划分下，表格代理模型适用于同扇区情景快速筛选；向未见扇区的稳健迁移仍是开放问题。

Abstract: Surface irrigation planning requires screening many operating conditions and spatial configurations, while high-fidelity shallow-water-equation (SWE) simulations are expensive. We study tabular surrogate models for predicting maximum water height from drone-derived field morphology, terrain, hydrological, spatial, and scenario descriptors, where each row represents a spatial cell under one irrigation scenario. To assess deployment feasibility, we evaluate gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular models, AutoML, and tabular foundation models (TFMs) under two regimes: same-sector generalization, where a model predicts unseen scenarios after observing a limited set of configurations in the same sector, and sector-out transfer, where knowledge learned from source sectors is transferred to an unseen sector. The main findings are twofold: a) under the evaluated fixed 8/32 same-sector split, surrogates achieve strong performance, especially with raw spatial coordinates; b) sector-out transfer is substantially harder because the target sector has different coordinates and geometry. Sector-frame normalization of spatial coordinates improves transfer across similarly structured sectors, but does not solve cross-shape generalization. Overall, tabular surrogates appear useful for same-sector scenario screening under this fixed split, while robust transfer to unseen sectors remains open.

</details>


### [1008] [A Fisher-Geometric View of Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26525)
*Liu Kaiyuan,Zhuang Ziyuan,Ma Haoxuan,Gu Yannian,Song Mingfei,Weng Rongxiang,Ye Jieping*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将多教师on-policy蒸馏与模型合并在"同源专家共享盆地"假设下证明为同一目标的二阶等价，据此提出由残差谱门控的两阶段整合方法RGBM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型合并是启发式但高效，多教师on-policy蒸馏理论严谨却需大量rollout计算且存在跨任务梯度冲突。作者希望统一二者，为合并提供理论依据并补足其精度。

Method: 理论：在共享盆地内证明多教师on-policy蒸馏目标二阶等价于Fisher合并目标，其极小点即Fisher合并的闭式解。实践：Phase 1在任务向量子空间做全参数Fisher合并的可行近似，并证明混合任务向量的系数同时混合隐式奖励，用无标注提示上的残差规划求系数、最小化最差域残差并输出能量归一化的域残差谱；Phase 2用频谱门控，对低残差域钝化，仅对谱间隙以上域训练独立分支，并以校准收缩写回。

Result: 在两个开源整合套件上，仅Phase 1的合并即达到或超过完整训练的多教师蒸馏；RGBM在此基础上进一步提升且不增加联合训练步；而所有无门控写回（含从合并结果继续联合蒸馏）均劣于该合并。

Conclusion: 合并可视为蒸馏的闭式二阶最优阶段，二者统一；残差谱为"应否继续训练、训练哪些域"提供了可量化的门控准则，实现零额外联合训练的有效整合。

Abstract: Consolidating specialized foundation models into a unified generalist is a central goal of post-training. Two approaches are in common use: model merging, which is fast but treated as a heuristic, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation, which matches distributions but demands heavy rollout compute and suffers from cross-task gradient conflict. We show that the two are one objective seen at different orders. Within a shared basin of homologous specialists, the multi-teacher on-policy distillation objective is, to second order, exactly the Fisher-merging objective. Its minimizer is therefore the Fisher merge, a classic model-merging method given by a closed-form combination of the specialists, so merging is optimal, to second order, as a closed-form stage of distillation. Building on this identification, we propose Residual-Governed Branch-and-Merge(RGBM), a two-phase consolidation procedure. Concretely, a full-parameter Fisher merge is intractable on foundation models, so Phase~1 restricts the merge to the task-vector subspace. Extending tangent-space analyses of merging, we show that the same coefficients that mix task vectors also mix implicit rewards, which lets a residual program on unlabelled prompts solve for them. The program minimizes the worst per-domain residual and reports its energy-normalized values as the domain residual spectrum. Phase~2 lets this spectrum govern what may be added: RGBM passivates domains with low normalized residuals, trains isolated branches only for domains above the spectral gap, and writes back the admitted updates with calibrated shrinkage. On two open-source consolidation suites, the Phase~1 merge alone matches or outperforms fully trained multi-teacher distillation, and RGBM improves on it further with zero extra joint-training steps, whereas every un-gated write-back, including continued joint distillation from the merge, falls below it.

</details>


### [1009] [ProtGlycanDock: Towards Accurate Protein-Glycan Docking with Tailored Dataset, Benchmark and Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26009)
*Minghao Xu,Jiaze Song,Jinyu Wang,Wentao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文构建了蛋白质-糖对接基准ProtGlycanDock，评测十种模型并提出两种微调技术，将糖构象知识注入通用分子结构预测模型，组合后取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质-糖对接对理解相关生物过程至关重要，但缺乏专门的数据集、基准与模型，阻碍了该方向的发展。

Method: 首先构建ProtGlycanDock基准，涵盖蛋白质与糖两种泛化设定；在基准上评测物理对接、机器学习对接、分子结构预测三类共十个模型；进而提出两种微调技术——以糖拓扑特征增强模型输入，以及用糖能量损失精修糖结合构象。

Result: 基准结果显示AlphaFold 3在现有方法中表现最优；两种微调技术可有效结合，达到蛋白质-糖对接的SOTA性能；分层分析与案例研究揭示了当前模型的强弱项。

Conclusion: 该工作填补了蛋白质-糖对接在数据集、基准与模型上的空白，验证了将糖构象先验注入通用结构预测模型的有效性，并为后续模型改进提供了方向。

Abstract: Performing accurate protein-glycan docking is critical to understanding protein-glycan interactions which govern many biological processes. However, this important task is hampered by the lack of tailored datasets, benchmarks and models for protein-glycan docking. To fill this blank, we first curate a standard benchmark ProtGlycanDock for training and evaluating protein-glycan docking models under both protein and glycan generalization settings. On this benchmark, we evaluate ten models in three categories, physics-based docking methods, machine-learning-based docking models and molecular structure prediction models. To obtain more precise binding poses, we further propose two finetuning techniques to inject the knowledge of glycan conformations into a general-purpose molecular structure prediction model. These two techniques respectively augment model inputs with glycan topological features and refine glycan binding pose with a glycan energy loss. Benchmark results show the superiority of AlphaFold 3 among existing methods, and the two proposed finetuning techniques can be well combined to achieve a state-of-the-art model for protein-glycan docking. Also, we perform stratified benchmark analysis and case studies to better understand the strengths and weaknesses of current models, providing insights for future model improvements. We maintain datasets at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ProtGlycanDock/ProtGlycanDock and source codes at https://github.com/kasawa1234/ProtGlycanDock

</details>


### [1010] [Truncate or Not? A Scaling Study of Looped Transformers with Truncated Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26030)
*Xuyuan Xiong,Siyu Chen,Zihan Shao,Yue Su,Weiyang Jin,Ping Luo,Zhuoran Yang,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 循环Transformer通过共享层块增加计算深度而不增加参数，本文联合改变模型规模、训练token与前后向循环次数（近600次训练），拟合统一缩放律，发现联合优化时完整BPTT优于截断，并给出计算最优循环数与两循环最佳配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为节省训练算力，循环Transformer的BPTT常被截断至最后几次循环，但这可能削弱循环带来的收益；该权衡此前缺乏系统性研究。

Method: 联合变化模型规模、训练token数以及前向与反向循环次数，开展近600组训练实验，并拟合一个通过"有效参数"刻画循环与截断效应的统一缩放律。

Result: 在等算力条件下，较少循环的完整BPTT始终优于同算力的截断设置；固定模型规模时，计算最优循环数与token预算均随算力增长；当模型规模也可自由选择时，缩放律识别出两个完整训练循环为最佳循环配置。实验中该配置相比计算最优的非循环模型损失更低，非嵌入参数约少27%，训练算力仅多8%。

Conclusion: 尽管理论上截断可节省训练算力，但在循环次数联合优化时完整BPTT更优；两循环、完整BPTT的设置是参数效率更高的计算最优循环方案。

Abstract: Looped transformers reuse a shared block of layers to increase computational depth without increasing the number of trainable parameters. They are trained with backpropagation through time (BPTT). To save training compute, BPTT is often truncated to the last few loops, although this may weaken the benefit of looping. To study this tradeoff systematically, we jointly vary model size, training tokens, and forward and backward loop counts across nearly 600 training runs and fit a unified scaling law that captures the effects of looping and truncation through effective parameters. Despite the training-compute savings of truncation, our fitted law favors full BPTT when forward and backward loop counts are jointly optimized. In matched-compute runs, full BPTT through fewer loops consistently outperforms truncated settings of the same compute. The law further shows that at fixed model size, the compute-optimal loop count and training-token budget both grow with compute. When model size is also free, the law identifies two fully trained loops as the best looped setting. Experimentally, this setting achieves lower loss than the compute-optimal non-looped model with about 27% fewer non-embedding parameters and only 8% more training compute.

</details>


### [1011] [FinHopper: A Progressive Multi-Hop Benchmark for Complex Financial Agents with Step-wise Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26036)
*Yuxuan Wu,Miaopei Lin,Qiufang Ying,Lin Dan,Hao Zhao,Qirui Liu,Yuteng Shen,Shaohui Wu,Weihong Luo,Xiku Du,Xing Tang,Hao Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FinHopper 是一个面向金融智能体的多跳检索基准，覆盖 1–6 跳、股票/基金/宏观事实，并提供金标中间答案用于过程级评估；作者还提出基于状态转移的合成框架以规模化构建数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 金融多跳检索不同于通用多跳问答：每个中间答案都是精确的类型化约束（实体、日期、事件、数值指标），直接决定下一步查询，因此小的中间错误会级联成貌似合理但错误的检索轨迹。现有基准缺乏可控推理深度与过程级监督。

Method: 构建 FinHopper 基准：以状态转移为基础的合成框架，将已验证的原子金融问答模式组合成保持依赖关系的查询链，并配以合成期定向验证、模型集成校验和金融专家的公开检索验证；评测 20 种 LLM-agent 配置，采用过程感知评分。

Result: 公开搜索工具是必要但不充分的；随跳数增加性能显著下降；最佳模型仍远低于人类专家；过程感知评分可揭示仅看最终答案时被掩盖的部分推理进展。

Conclusion: 金融多跳检索的关键瓶颈在于答案条件化的中间约束精度，需过程级评估与更深度的检索推理能力；FinHopper 提供了可控深度、可诊断的评测平台。

Abstract: Financial agents are expected to answer factual investment queries through open search, but financial multi-hop retrieval differs from general multi-hop QA in a crucial way: each intermediate answer is an exact typed constraint, such as an entity, date, event, or numerical indicator, that determines the next query. This strict answer-conditioned dependency makes small intermediate errors cascade into plausible but wrong search trajectories. We introduce FinHopper, a benchmark for complex financial agents with controlled reasoning depth from 1 to 6 hops, covering stocks, funds, and macroeconomic facts, with gold intermediate answers for process-level evaluation. To construct FinHopper at scale, we design a state-transition-based synthesis framework that composes verified atomic financial QA patterns into dependency-preserving chains, followed by targeted in-synthesis verification, model-ensemble checking, and public-search validation by financial experts. Experiments with 20 LLM-agent configurations show that public search tools are necessary but insufficient: performance drops sharply as hop depth increases, the best model remains far below human experts, and process-aware scoring reveals partial reasoning progress hidden by final-answer-only evaluation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/justajustin/FinHopper/.

</details>
